tei:div.tei:p: / ༷//rgisheX//dru/ — / mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang /
༅'i shāde/ tha 7 do pa go ོ di sa sa 1 7 ( /kha ‘ /sko/ )//7 / ga rtazo ke ( nga nga ༄ dze ba — na ḍa shā ra 4 ra — —ra zlo na snye — 4 sa ri 4 ra shā /— —— 4 — ga da da

dkar chagamachod brjod/ (1)gleng gzhi/ (4)chos rgyal mchog gi zhabs pad bstenadus rtse gzhung sogs nges med dben par bzhengs pa'i skor/ (6)mtsho snying ma hā de ba nas dam pa nyid kyis nyid la gsal 'debs dge bskul gye tshul du bzhengs pa'i skor/ (207)mtsho snying ma hā de ba nas skal bzang gi gdul bya ri ba'i tshogs kyi zhus lan zhal gdams kyi skor/ (438)mjug byang / (814)

mchod brjod/na mo ru/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i mes po gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang bo chos dbyengs mkha' la kun gyi sngon rol tu/ /mngon par byang chub sku dang ye shes yon tan rta bdun dkyil 'khor rab rgyas 'phrin las 'od zer stong 'phros pas/mkha' mnyam 'gro la thar ba'i lam bzang gsal bar mdzad de thog ma med pa'i dus nas kun gyi dpal du shar/ /dge legs nyin mor byed de bdag blo'i pad dkar 'dab stong dad pa'i rlung gis phang phung g.yo ba'i gtsug gis mchod/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro kun kun gyis dus gcig the tshom zhus kyang re re'i mdun du sku mchog mchog de bstan nas kyang / /snyan pa'i gsung dbyangs dbyangs kyis grangs med 'gro ba de dag je tshom rang rang sgra skad skad du dus gcig gcod/ /thugs ni chos dbyings dbyings las g.yo ba med bzhin 'khor 'das gnyis kyi legs dang nyes kun kun kyang sa ler mkhyen/ /lus can mtha' dag dag zhing 'khrid phyir 'khor ba ma stongs bar du sna tshogs mdzad ston ston pa mnyam med rgyal/ /mtha' bral lta ba bzang 1

bo'i g.yu ral rgyas shing bying rgod med pa'i bde gsal mi rtog sgom pa'i mche ba gtsigs/ /nyam nga med pa'i shugs 'byung 'gags med spyod pa'i sder bzhi bgrad cing sku gsum 'bras bu'i rtsal gsum lus la rdzogs/ /snyan pa'i nga ros srid gsum khyon 'gengs gangs can khrod kyi seng gcig mi la la sogs rgya bod mkhas grub kyi/ zhabs la shugs drags dad pas lag gnyis thal mo spyi bor sbyar te yang yang gus pa chen pos phyag bgyi'o/ /rnam par dkar ba'i dge legs gser gyi sa gzhi chen bo'i khyon las legs 'khrungs yon tan du ma'i 'byung gnas che/ /rim gnyis nyi zla'i ska rags dang ldan thabs mkhas bsdu ba rnam bzhi'i gdul bya nyer 'tsho gnas kyis mdzes/ /dpal dang 'byor ba'i rlabs kyi phreng ba chal chil g.yo ba rgya mtsho chen po'i dbus na phyogs rnams thams cad las/ /rnam rgyal lhun po gnyis pa chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo bdag gis byang chub thob kyang rigs kyi bdag por bzhugs/ /dgos 'dod kun 'byung nor bu ji bzhin sku gsung thugs kyi byen rlabs stsol pa'i rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad dang / /gling bzhi'i dbus kyi lhun po ji bzhin mchog thun yon tan du ma'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha/ /ma yis bu la brtse ba ji bzhin rnal 'byor pa la brtse 2

zhing bar chad sel mdzad dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang / /mi 'bral lus dang grib ma ji bzhin g.yel med grogs mdzad chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la sgo gsum gus pas 'dud/ /'dab bzang gtso bo bgrod pa'i lam la bye'us 'phur lding g.yo zhing dar dir sgrog pa bzhin du bdag nyid la/ /rgyal ba gong ma ji bzhin nyams dang rtogs pa'i 'byor bas dbul yang rnam thar rjes su kha mig yar bltas nas/ /rang gzhan chos la bskul phyir glu dbyangs gang gi rna bar lhung ba tsam kyis dad pa'i spu long rab g.yo zhing / /byang chub sa bon bskrun par nus pa dus gsum rgyal bas yang dang yang du byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol//3

gleng gzhi/de yang 'dzam bu'i gling gi tshe lo brgya ba'i dus su dpal kun tu bzang bo rdo rje 'chang gi skur bzhengs te/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / de nyid thun mong gi gdul bya la shākya thub pa'i sgur bzhengs te/ rgyu mtshan nyid kyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas zhi ba'i dbyings su mnyam par bzhag pa'i rjes su sangs rgyas kyi sprul ba bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa rgya gar chu bo gang gā phan chad du grub thob brgyad cu la sogs dpag tu med pa byon pa rnams kyis gdul bya'i don du rdo rje'i mgur dpag tu med pa bzhengs shing / khyad par dpal sa ra ha chen pos do ha rdo rje'i glu mdzad pa dang / bod yul gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir yang bstan pa snga dar gyi dus na/ bsam yas mchims phur grub chen nyi shu rtsa lnga/ lha sa dang yer par grub chen brgya rtsa/ lho brag mkhar chur grub chen nyi shu rtsa gcig dpal chen chu bo rir grub chen sum cu so lnga sogs byon pa rnams kyis rdo rje'i mgur 4

bzhengs pa bsam gyis mi khyab la/ bstan pa bar dar dang phyi dar gyi dus su yang bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i don la grub pa brnyes pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mar pa mi la ras pa ras chung rdo rje grags pa/ dwags po gling ras pa/ 'khrul zhig rgya ras pa/ grub chen me long rdo rje/ kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams/rgod tshang pa/ yang dgon pa/ rje btsun skal ldan rgya mtsho la sogs pa rnams kyis ri khrod phyogs med 'grims/ sgrub pa snying bor mdzad/ dka' spyad dang du blangs/ rang don mngon du gyur nas gzhan don du rdo rje'i mgur bzhengs pa bsam gyis mi khyab la/ bdag kyang mkha' lding dbang bo bgrod pa'i lha lam yangs par bung ba bgrod pa'i rtsal stobs zhan yang 'phur lding g.yo zhing dga' ba'i sgra dbyangs sgog pa bzhin du/ grub thob gong ma rnams ltar nyams rtogs yon tan med rung / rnam thar dri ma med pa'i rjes su kha mig yar yar bltas nas dben par sgrub pa la gzhol bzhin du rang gzhan chos la bskul phyir lhag bsam rnam par dag pas mgur dbyangs sna tshogs blangs pa 'di skal bzang blo ldan rnams la dga' ston du 'bul lo//5

chos rgyal mchog gi zhabs pad bsten dus rtse gzhung sogs nges med dben par bzhengs pa'i skor/na mo gu ru/ 'di phyi'i skyabs nas bla ma rje/ /dngos grub stsol mdzad yi dam lha/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong skyabs gyur rnams/ /spyi gtsug 'khor lo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal/ /brtse ba chen pos bdag gzhan rgyud/ /byen gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul ba'i/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /rlabs chen tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs nas/ /sku gnyis thob par mdzad du gsol/ /nyon mongs 'khrul ba'i dbang gyur pa'i/ /nyams chags sdig sgrib mthol lo bshags/ /sngar byas las ngan sdig sgrib kun/ /byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ /rang gzhan kun kyi dge ba la/ /snying nas dga' bas rjes yi rang / /dge tshogs yar ngo'i zla ba bzhin/ /thams cad gong 'phel mdzad du gsol/ /theg 6

pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /dpag med chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /rtag tu dam pa'i lha chos dang / /'bral ba med par mdzad du gsol/ /'khor ba ji srid ma stongs bar/ /myang ngan mi 'dar gsol ba 'debs/ /bslu med skyabs gnas khyed rnams dang / /nam yang 'bral med mdzad du gsol/ /dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba rnams/ /ma gyur 'gro kun don du bsngo/ /'gro la bdag dge myur smin nas/ /byang chub thob par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes yan lag bdun pa 'di ni bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//brgyud gsum rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /skyabs gsum rin chen tshogs rnams la/ /sgo gsum gus pa chen po yis/ /dus gsum kun tu bdag phyag 'tshal/ /khyed rnams thugs rje'i sprin phung las/ /byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i char phobs la/ /ma gyur 'gro ba ma lus pa'i/ /nyon mongs tsha gdung bcil du gsol/ /rdzogs pa chen por rab gzhol ba'i/ /bya ba kun btang rnal 'byor ngas/ /skal bar ldan pa'i gdul bya la/ /rgyal ba gong ma phal cher bzhin/ /glu dbyangs len pa'i dus tshod dang / /glu dbyangs ji ltar len tshul dang / /glu dbyangs blangs pa'i phan yon gsum/ /glu dbyangs len mkhan bdag gis 'chad/ /skal ldan bya btang rnal 'byor pas/ /glu dbyangs len pa'i dus tshod ni/ /7

tshogs 'khor rgya chen bskor ba'i tshe/ /rdo rje'i glu dbyangs len pa yin/ /dbang bskur dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i tshe/ /rdo rje'i glu dbyangs len pa yin/ /'khor 'das ru shan 'byed pa'i tshe/ /rdo rje'i glu dbyangs len pa yin/ /dur khrod rnams su rgyu ba'i tshe/ /rdo rje'i glu dbyangs len pa yin/ /mtsho gling skyed mos nags tshal nas/ /rdo rje'i glu dbyangs len pa yin/ /gzhan rgyud chos la bskul ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje'i glu dbyangs len pa yin/ /de tshe rdo rje'i glu dbyangs rnams/ /rang gis shes na de nyid len/ /mi shes skyes chen gong ma yis/ /gsungs pa'i rdo rje'i glu len no//'dir 'bad las byung dge ba rnams/ /rnam dag sems gyis mkha' mnyam ma'i/ /ma rig sgrib dag tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo//zhes rdo rje'i glu len pa'i dus tshod 'di ni tshogs drug rang grol kyis smras pa'o//rab 'byams rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul mgon/ /rab dkar gangs can 'gro rnams kyi/ /rab mdzes gtsug rgyan bla ma la/ /rab tu gus pas phyag bgyi'o/ /bdag la bltos bcas 'gro ba rnams/ /khyed kyi thugs rje'i lcags kyu yis/ /dbang med dad pa'i sems g.yo zhing / /nyams rtogs myu gu bskyed du gsol/ /skal bar ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /rdo rje'i glu dbyangs len 8

lugs ni/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /dbang bskur dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i tshe/ /len pa po yis lus kyi chas/ /zhi khro gang rung na bza' gsol/ /zhi chas dar dang rin po che'i/ /rgyan kyis spras shing gos dar gyi/ /lhab lhub na bza' dbu rgyan gsol/ /rdo rje'i dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /khro chas rus pa'i rgyan drug dang / /thal chen lus la byugs pa dang / /khrag thig zhag gi zo ris bya/ /bhanta phur ba 'dzin pa'o/ /lus kyis rkang ba'i bro gar ni/ /g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums byed pa dang / /g.yon brkyangs g.yas bskums la sogs bsgyur/ /lag gnyis lha yi phyag rgya'i gar/ /gang mdzes legs par 'cha' ba yin/ /ngag gis gzhan yid 'phrog pa yi/ /'dren 'gugs legs pa'i skad snyan gyis/ /dang po'i dus su dbyangs gsal byed/ /ye ge ring bo thung ngu dang / /'khyog por skad gdangs snyan pos brjod/ /de nas oṃ dang e dang tt+waṃ/ /he la sogs pas sna drangs nas/ /tshig 'bru snyan pa'i glu dbyangs len/ /sems kyis lha sku bsgom par bya/ /'khor 'das ru shan 'byed pa'i tshe/ /lus ni tha mal gcer bu la/ /phyag rgya bro gar sna tshogs bya/ /ngag gis skyo shas skye ba'i glu/ /snyan la ring ba len pa yin/ /sems kyis don bsam skyo ba bskyed/ /dben gnas 'grim dang dur khrod rgyu/ /mtsho gling 9

nags tshal la sogs par/ /rnal 'byor lta ba skyong ba'i tshe/ /lus ni rnal 'byor pa yi chas/ /ḍā ma ru dang dril bu dang / /gling bu la sogs 'bud pa dang / /me tog mgo rgyan spras par bya/ /ngag gis lta ba'i glu dbyangs len/ /sems kyis lta ba'i gnas lugs skyong / /tha mal mi yis mi mthong bar/ /shin tu gsang ba'i spyod pa yin/ /gzhan rgyud chos la bskul ba'i tshe/ /lus ni zhi zhing dul ba dang / /ngag gis gzhan yid 'phrog pa yi/ /mi rtag skyo shas bskyed mgur sogs/ /pha rol blo dang 'tsham par len/ /sems kyis gzhan phan lhag bsam bskyed/ /'di rnams glu yi len lugs so/ /'dir 'bad las byung dge ba 'di/ /'di min dge rtsa ci bsags rnams/ /rnam mang 'gro ba thams cad kun/ /kun mkhyen go 'phang thob phyir bsngo/ /zhes rdo rje'i glu yi len lugs 'di ni tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//rtsod ldan bstan pa'i snyigs ma la/ /skal ldan 'ga' yi don gzigs nas//bde ldan zhing nas byon pa yi/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /'dren mchog mchog gyur 'gro ba'i mgon/ /mgon khyod khyod kyis nyam thag nga / /nga bdag bdag 'dzin gyis bcings rnams/ /rnam mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i nus pas khrol/ /skal bar ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /tshe 'di'i bya 10

ba blos btang nas/ /thar lam byang chub sgrub pa'i tshe/ /rdo rje'i glu dbyangs blangs pa na/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs kyang tshim/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi yid rnams 'phrog /dkar phyogs lha rnams sprin bzhin 'du/ /dad dang nges 'byung gsar du skye/ /gdul bya'i blo kha chos la 'gyur/ /rang rig bde chen gsal rnams 'debs/ /lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa 'dag /khyad par bying ba sangs pa'i mchog /dge la bskul ba'i bla ma'i mchog /gcig pur 'dug tshe grogs kyi mchog /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i byin rlabs 'jug /yi dam mkha' 'gros dngos grub ster/ /chos skyong srung mas 'phrin las sgrub/ /lha 'dre mi gsum mthun rkyen sbyor/ /'khor ba'i 'brel thag chod nas kyang / /myur ba myur du 'tshang rgya'o/ /ma 'ongs skal ldan gdul bya rnams/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blos thongs la/ /dben par nyams len byed bzhin du/ /skabs skabs rdo rje'i glu dbyangs 'then/ /dge 'dis rang gzhan 'gro ba kun/ /kun gyi don gnyis lhun gyis grub/ /grub dbang mi la ji bzhin du/ /du mas glu dbyangs len par shog /ces rdo rje'i glu blangs pa'i phan yon 'di ni tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o/ /'di yang rang bzo ma yin par rgyud nyi zla kha sbyor dang / kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pa'i gsungs bzhin no//11

na mo gu ru bhyaḥ bde ldan zhing gi mgon po'i rnam 'phrul las/ /sintu'i rgya mtshor rdzus te skyes pa yi/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas spyi gzugs pad 'byung dang / /dbyer med drin can bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /spyir na srid rtse nas bzung mnar med bar/ /'khor ba'i bde sdug rnam pa sna tshogs kun/ /thog ma med nas tha ma da lta'i bar/ /las 'di ma myong ba ni gcig kyang med/ /dbang bo brgya byin la sogs lhar gyur nas/ /lha yi bdud rtsi kho na 'thungs pa ni/ /phyi yi rgya mtsho chen po las kyang lhag /deng sang rang la phan pa e 'dug soms/ /gling bzhi'i 'jig rten dag la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /'khor lo bsgyur rgyal la sogs lus blangs nas/ /mi yi longs spyod dpal 'byor ci spyad na'ang / /deng sang de yis phan pa e 'dug soms/ /byol song bying gnas kha 'thor la sogs bar/ /mgo brnyan mi 'dra phra rags lus blangs te/ /chung ba khyur mid che ba 'bug zos pa/ /deng sang thos sam mthong na sngangs shing skrag /yi dwags sogs su rnag khrag 'thungs pa dang / /khyi phag lus blangs mi gtsang zos pa sogs/ /spungs na ri rgyal lhun po bas kyang mtho/ /lcags kyi sa gzhir me lce 'bar zhing bsregs/ /lus la mtshon char 'bebs dang zangs chu ldud/ /gangs ri 'khyags 12

pa'i sbubs chud bu yug 'tshub/ /tsha grangs dmyal bar bzod dam bsam mno thongs/ /mdor na mtha' med nam mkha'i mthas khyab pa'i/ /steng 'og phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad gang na yang / /mtha' gzhal med pa'i sa dang nam mkha' ru/ /'chi 'pho ma byas gnas ni khab rtse tsam/ /med phyir thog mtha' med pa'i 'khor ba zer/ /de lta'i gnas su sangs rgyas ma byon zhing / /chos kyi sgra tsam med pa'i 'jig rten gyi/ /khams la mun bskal zhes su grags pa yin/ /de 'dre'i mun bskal mang la sgron bskal ni/ /glog 'gyu skad cig bar snang ston ltar gsungs/ /des na da res chos dang mjal dus 'dir/ /tsha grang ltogs skom gnyid la ma chags par/ /nyin mtshan dus drug ma yengs brtson 'grus gyis/ /dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar rjes zhugs nas/ /na rung tsha rung snying rus sdug bsran bskyed/ /na dang 'chi ba'i g.yul rgyal dam chos mdzod/ /lus dang sems la sdug bsngal mi 'byung ba'i/ /'phags pa'i lam du bgrod cig snying gi bu/ /gzhan phan g.yel med skyongs shig snying gi bu/ /mchog gsum dam par glo snying brang gsum gtod/ /chos skyong srung mar gegs sel 'phrin las zhus/ /'gro ba yongs la snying rje lhag bsam skyed/ /bu khyod des na bsam don myur du 'grub/ /bu khyod des 13

na bar gcod yongs mi 'tshe/ /bu khyod des na lus 'di don dang ldan/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs ni 'di yin no/ /de lta bas na rang gzhan thams cad la/ /sems bskyed smon lam gnyis kyis mtshams sbyor mdzod/ /ces pa 'di yang dad ldan dam tshig gtsang zhing snying dang 'dra ba'i slob ma tshogs drug rang grol gyis 'khor ba la skyo shas skye ba'i zhal gdams 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ngor/ o rgyan chos kyi bdag por rlom pa ngag dbang ming can gyis bris pa dge legs 'phel/na mo gu ru/ ka dag chos dbyings skye ba med pa la/ /kha yis brjod pa tsam du ma song bar/ /ga 'drar gyur kyang lam du bsre nus shing / /nga bdag 'dzin pa'i rtsa ba dbyung bar bya/ /ca co'i g.yeng ba dag la ma yengs par/ /cha lugs ngan ngon tsam gyis chog shes nas/ /ja sogs 'dod yon sred pa yongs spangs te/ /nya lto ba ltar sgrub pa snying bor gyis/ /ta thā ga ta'i bstan la zhugs dus 'dir/ /tha chad nyon mongs dug lnga yongs spangs te/ /da nas bzung ste nyin mtshan dus drug tu/ /na 'chi nges med chos la snying rus gyis/ /pa sangs lta bur rab dkar lhag bsam gyis/ /pha mtha' bral ba'i sems can thams cad kyi/ /ba lang lta bur rmongs pa'i ma rig kun/ /ma lus drungs 'byen bla med sar 'god brtson/ /tsā ri la sogs dben pa'i gnas rnams su/ /tsha grang khyad du bsad nas snying rus gyes/ /dza zhes 14

mchog gsum thugs rje rab bskul te/ /wa ler rang gnas bsam gtan skyong bar mdzod/ /zhwa ltar drin can bla ma gtsug tu bsten/ /za ma la sogs dus kun don ldan du/ /'a 'ur 'du 'dzi'i gnas las dben pa ru/ /ya mtshan snying bo longs shig snying gi bu/ /rwa ltar gyong ba'i sems 'di rab btul nas/ /la la tsam min mkha' khyab 'gro don du/ /sha rus gting nas dka' thub bsten byas nas/ /sa lam ma lus thob pa'i dam chos mdzod/ /ha cang mang bo'i tshig gis dgos pa med/ /a don dmigs med snying rje zung 'jug gis/ /ha la'i dug 'dra'i srid pa drungs phyung ste/ /a don skye med btsan sa zin par 'tshal/ /ces pa 'di ni dad ldan gyi slob ma tshogs drug rang grol gyis zhal gdams shig dgos zhes yang yang bskul ngor/ rig 'dzin ngag dbang dar rgyas kyis bris pa'o/ /yang bla ma rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang bo'i zhabs pad bsten yod pa'i dus su drin dang ldan pa'i bla ma rgyal mkhan chen rin po ches ma ltar brtse ba'i thugs kyis bdag la zhal gdams 'di rnams gnang /ka dag chos dbyings dga' ma'i lto ba nas/ /kha tog 'od lnga 'phro ba'i rdo rje'i sems/ /ga le'i zhing gi 'gro drug sgol ba'i slad/ /nga yi bla ma ngag gi dbang bor shar/ /ca co'i 'du 'dzi chos brgyad rgyang bsring ba'i/ /cha lugs dge sbyong sdom pa gsum ldan khyod/ /ja sogs gang byung 'tsho ba la brten nas/ /nya ltar 15

'khyug pa'i rang sems 'tshol la 'bod/ /ta thā ga ta'i go 'phang dam pa yang / /tha mal bzhin du gzhan nas mi 'tshol bar/ /da lta 'thob byed rang grol a ti'i lam/ /na rga 'chi ba'i 'jigs las sgol 'dir 'bod/ /pa sangs ltar dkar gzhan phan sems bskyed nas/ /pha rgod bla ma'i zhabs pad tshul bzhin bsten/ /ba lang lta bur rmongs pa'i dra ba kun/ /ma lus bla ma'i gdams ngag spu gris chod/ /tswa ri la sogs dpen pa ma bsten yang / /tsha zer bdag po 'dra ba'i chos rgyal drung / /dza lang gzung 'dzin sgol ba'i thabs mkhas lam/ /wa ler 'char ba de las dben gnas gang / /zhwa yi tog 'dra'i theg pa kun gyi rtse/ /za zi'i sgyu ma lta bu'i chos kun gshis/ /'a cag mchog dman bar ma'i rtogs byed thabs/ /ya mtshan gcig shes kun grol 'di rmad byung / /rwa lo lta bu'i sngon byon grub chen rnams/ /la la bzhin du ngal ba ma byas par/ /sha chang rigs ma'i 'dod yon spyod bzhin du/ /sa gsum bstan dang 'gro ba'i don du byon/ /ha ha chos dang mthun pa'i grogs po khyod/ /a don skye med lta ba'i rgyal po ru/ /he he go na dbu rdzogs phyag gsum gnad/ /o o sangs rgyas 'thob byed gcig mchog lags/ /zhes pa 'di ni padma bzhad pa'i rdo rjes sbyar ba'o//16

kwa ye ma gcig don du thugs ngal ma mdzad par/ /kha rog ma gyur sems can kun don du/ /ga ler don gnyis 'byung ba'i byang chub sems/ /nga bdag bral ba mi la lta bur mdzod//ca co'i bslu brid rjes su mi 'brang bar/ /cha lugs btsun tshugs sdom gsum tshul bzhin srungs/ /ja sogs 'dod yon dkor la chog shes dang / /nya lto lta bu'i chos rgyal zhabs pad sten/ /ta thā ga ta'i bstan la zhugs dus 'dir/ /tha snyad tshig la ma dga' nyams len gyis/ /da nas tshe 'di blos thongs gtan 'dun bsgrubs/ /na rga 'chi bas gtugs tshe 'gyod med gyes/ /pa tra lta bu'i rnam rtog ma mang bar/ /pha yul bdud kyi btson ra'i zhen pa chod/ /ba tshogs 'o rgyun be'us btung ba bzhin/ /ma nor lam ston bla ma'i gdams ngag longs/ /tsā ri la sogs dben pa gang bzang du/ /tsha grang khyad du bsad nas sgom sgrub gyis/ /dza ha bir bzhin nyams len byed nus na//wa ler grol rtags mi ring myur lam yin/ /zha long ma yin dal 'byor thob dus 'dir/ /za ma zhag dus sos dal mi byed par/ /'a cag 'chi ba slebs tshe 'gyod med gdeng / /ya mtshan che ba'i nyams len gcig dril dgos/ /ra ba gangs ris bskor ba'i yul ljongs su/ /la lung btsal kyang rnyed dka'i zab lam 'di/ /sha tsha snying nye'i ma rgan 17

don du yang / /sa der nyams len byas na 'phral phugs bde/ /ha ha ma rgan dam chos bar chad du/ /a a 'gro snyam 'phrin chung 'di phul ba/ /te he sangs rgyas las kyang lhag yin pas/ /o o snying du chongs la thugs stobs skyed/ /e ma blo bde mdzod dang gtan bde skyid/ /ces pa 'di yang padma ma bzhad pa'i rdo rjes smras pa'o//ha ha sha la ha cang ma dga' a ma'i sha /ja zho 'thungs na lus 'tsho rig pa dwangs/ /gzungs mar ha cang ma chags nyon mongs 'phel//ye shes phyag rgyas bde chen ngang gis 'dren//gos la ha cang ma chags hral hrul rgyu/ /gtum mo'i gos bzang gyon na bde drod 'bar/ /zas la ha cang ma chags mi gtsang rgyu/ /bsam gtan zas kyi 'tsho ba 'dzad med zas/ /nor la ha cang chags na yi dwags rgyu/ /chog shes nor tshol nor gzhan tshogs su sngos/ /gnyen la ha cang ma chags 'ching byed yin/ /'gro kun gnyen du bzung na sangs rgyas rgyu/ /dgra la ha cang sdang na rang nyid pham/ /sngon gyi las su go na blo sbyong mchog /yul la ha cang zhen na chags sdang rgyu/ /gtan yul thar ba chen pa'i grong khyer bzang / /chos la ha cang blang dor mi byed par/ /dag snang nus na kun kyang thar ba'i rgyu/ /nyams len ha cang mchong rgyug mi byed par//bla ma bde legs rtsa bar go bar gyis/ /blo sna ha cang 18

dran rgyu ma mang bar/ /bla ma'i bka' bzhin bsgrubs na ci bsam 'grub//skyabs yang ha cang mang na 'chol ba'i rgyu/ /bla ma skyabs gnas kun 'dus gtan gyi skyabs/ /rtag 'dzin ha cang che na chos skal 'chad//'chi nges cha med dam chos bsgrub na legs/ /'khor bar ha cang chags na sdug bsngal rgyu/ /gtan bde'i go 'phang bgrod phyir sems mchog skyed/ /thos rjes ha cang 'brangs na sangs rgyas ring //nye lam nyams len bla ma'i gsung bzhin mdzod//bla ma chos kyi rgyal po dang / /slob ma chos kyi snod ldan la/ /mjal phyir chos med yong rgyu lags/ /de'i bar chos bdag bde mor bzhugs/ /chos gos rgyu gtsang 'bul lo bzhes/ /sgyu ma'i nor rdzas phun tshogs kyang/ /sgyu ma lta bur mthong ba la/ /sgyu ma'i nor gyis dgos pa ci/ /sgyu mar 'bras bu bskyed pa'i phyir/ /gdams ngag zhu ba'i phyag rten du/ /lha rdzas kha shas tshes la phul/ /zhes pa 'di yang padma bzhad pa'i rdo rjes smras pa'o//rgyal kun spyi gzugs pad 'byung dang / /dbyer med chos kyi rgyal po yis/ /rjes su bzung ba'i las 'phro can/ /grogs khyed phyogs las rnam par rgyal/ /tshogs gnyis bskal par bsags pa dang / /bla ma tshul bzhin bsten pa'i 'bras/ /lam bzang rtogs pa mngon gyur pa'i/ /grogs khyod bdag sogs gtsug gi 19

rgyan/ /nyams dang rtogs pa kun gyi sgo/ /long med mi rtag 'chi ba dang / /'di snang zhen log nges 'byung blo/ /mi ldog bcos min khyod la byung / /bla ma'i byen rlabs zhugs pa dang / /sngon sbyangs bag chags sad pa'i rtags/ /dge legs gzhi gcig bla ma de/ /sangs rgyas dngos su legs mthong nas/ /bsam dang sbyor bas bka' bzhin bsgrubs/ /tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong khyod kyis byas/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs pa dang / /sngon sbyangs bag chags sad pa'i rtags/ /mar shes drin dran drin gzo sogs/ /man ngag bdun gyis sna drangs pa'i/ /bdag gzhan mnyam brjes gzhan phan sems/ /mi 'bral rtag tu khyod dang 'grogs/ /bla ma'i byen rlabs zhugs pa dang / /sngon sbyangs las 'phro sad pa'i rtags/ /'gro 'ong bde sdug kun gyi gzhi/ /sems zhes grags pa'i mtshang phyung bas/ /ngo bo ngos gzung bral ba las/ /btsal kyang khyod kyis rnyed mi 'gyur/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs pa dang / /sngon sbyangs las 'phro sad pa'i rtags/ /de lta'i sems kyi gnas lugs dang / /chos rnams rang bzhin mnyam nyid ngang / /gzung 'dzin zhen med g.yo med par/ /rtog med ting 'dzin khyod la byung / /bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs pa dang / /sngon sbyangs bag chags sad pa'i rtags/ /rnam rtog thad 20

gar gcod pa'i lam/ /ka dag gnas lugs ngo 'phrod nas/ /smra bsam brjod yul las 'das shing / /gang shar rang grol khyod la byung / /bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs pa dang / /sngon sbyangs bag chags sad pa'i rtags//rig pa ma rig sgong rgya las/ /grol ba'i rang rig ye shes gdangs/ /zer gyes khrid nas thig tshom dang / /rdor sems zhi khro khyod la snang / /bla ma'i byen rlabs zhugs pa dang / /sngon sbyangs bag chags sad pa'i rtags/ /gzhi lam dbyings rig ma dang bu/ /ngo 'phrod chos dbyings rang grol ba'i/ /'ja' lus 'od skur yongs grol zhing / /grogs khyod tshe gcig ye sangs rgya/ /bdag kyang sngon gye las 'phro can/ /lam der mos pa'i skal bzang yang/ /zin med rnam g.yeng dbang song nas/ /tshul de bsgrub pa'i skal ba dman/ /che 'dod rgyal 'gong snying du zhugs/ /go 'phang mchog de rgyang du lus/ /da res mgon khyod thugs rje'i mthus/ /myur du sgom sgrub nus par shog /mi dge'i 'khor slob dbus na 'gyings/ /bla ma'i zhabs pad gnas kyi ring / /da res mgon khyod thugs rje'i mthus/ /'bral med rtag tu bsten par shog /'dod yon dkor nag dug chus myos/ /gdams don 'chi med bdud rtsis dben/ /da res mgon khyod thugs rje'i mthus/ /gdams pas 'tsho bar 21

byin gyis rlabs/ /grags stong 'ja' tshon rjes su rgyug /mi rtag glog 'dra'i 'chi ba brjed/ /da res mgon khyod thugs rje'i mthus/ /nam 'chi nges med dran par shog /chos brgyad 'ching bas dam bcings nas/ /nges 'byung yid bzhin nor bu stor/ /da res mgon khyod thugs rje'i mthus/ /bcos min nges 'byung skye bar shog /ma dang gnyen la zhen cing chags/ /ma gyur 'gro kun ris su bor/ /da res mgon khyod thugs rje'i mthus/ /phyogs med snying rje skye bar shog /dgra la zhe sdang me ltar 'bar/ /dug gsum dgra bo gces par bzung / /da res mgon khyod thugs rje'i mthus/ /gnyis 'dzin sa bon drungs 'byen shog /bdag 'dzin 'gong bo phugs su bcug /sems ngo ma bskyangs rang dgar btang / /da res mgon khyod thugs rje'i mthus/ /gnas lugs don la ngo 'phrod shog /snang bzhi'i lam gyi chos kyi dbyings/ /zad sar ma bskyal tha mal lus da res mgon khyod thugs rje'i mthus/ /thod rgal ye shes mngon gyur shog /ngan song rgyu tshogs lhur blangs nas/ /yang dag lam dang rgyang ring byas/ /da res mgon khyod thugs rje'i mthus/ /lam sna myur du zin par shog /tshe gcig khyab bdag kun bzang zhal/ /mjal ba'i skal bzang ma byung yang / /da res mgon 22

khyod thugs rje'i mthus/ /bar dor rang ngo shes par shog /gal te bar dor ma grol kyang / /gsang bsngags sgrub pa'i rten rnyed nas/ /tshe der go 'phang mchog thob shog /kye kye grogs po khyod nyid kyang / /rnyed dka'i lam bzang de nyid las/ /skad cig tsam yang mi ldog par/ /gtan gyi btsan sa zin par mdzod/ /chos dang mthun par tshe rabs su/ /'brel ba'i grogs ngan bdag kyang ni/ /'bral med thugs brtses rtag bskyangs nas/ /gong gsol re 'bras myur smin pa'i/ /skyabs 'jug yang dag g.yel med dang / /bla ma'i thugs dang rang gi sems/ /grogs kyi sems gsum dbyer med pa'i/ /chos dbyengs chen por rtag rol zhing / /thugs rje chu zla'i zlos gar bzhin/ /sprul ba'i bkod pa bgrang yas kyis/ /'gro ba kun khyab bum bzang ltar/ /dge legs bkra shis char chen phobs/ /zhes pa 'di yang rje btsun padma bzhad pa'i rdo rjes bdag la smras pa'o//a ma grangs med byas pa'i 'gro kun/ /a mar shes pa'i snying rje phyogs med/ /a ma yongs la tshul bzhin byung na/ /a mar brten nas sangs rgyas 'thob bo/ /a ma 'di bzhin chags shing zhen tshe/ /a ma 'khor ba'i rtod phur yin zhing / /a ma thar ba'i gegs su 'gro bas/ /a ma srid las sgol thabs dka'o/ /23

a ma dkor nag dug chus bskyangs nas/ /a ma ngan 'gro'i gnas su bsgyur na/ /a mar kha dkar gting nag de las/ /a ma'i bu ngan na rag su yod/ /a ma kun tu bzang mo'i klong du/ /a ma ma lus sgol bar nus na/ /a mar drin gzo byed mkhan de 'dra/ /a ma'i bu bzang yin zhes grags so/ /a ma ma brjed dran pas skyongs la/ /a ma'i don du byang chub sgrubs shig /gnyen dang nye du brtse gdung can dang / /yul mkhar khang khyem ma lus dbang med/ /bskyur dgos dus de nam 'ong cha med/ /de dus rang gzhan 'di phyi gnyis 'phung / /de phyir da lta rang dbang yod dus/ /blos btang kun la phan phyir rnam dkar/ /tshul bzhin sgrub la brtson pa 'di ni/ /'phral phugs 'dun ma'i yang rtse yin no/ /rnam 'dren stong dang bka' gdams rim byon/ /mar mi rong ston skal ldan yab sras/ /sngon byon dam pa'i rnam thar phyogs re/ /dus 'dir 'dzin nus skal bzang lags so/ /zhes pa 'di yang rje btsun padma bzhad pa'i rdo rjes bdag la gnang ba'o//bka' drin gsum ldan bla ma yi/ /zhabs kyi padmor gus pas 'dud/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol khyod/ /kha la nyan na 'di bzhin mdzod/ /bla ma bsam sbyor gnyis kyis bsten/ /drin can 24

pha mar drin gzo gyis/ /bzang bo spyi bo'i thod bzhin khur/ /dman la bu bzhin byams par mdzod/ /grogs la bran bzhin gus par gyis/ /sdig pa'i grogs po thabs kyis spongs/ dge ba'i grogs po rgyun du sten/ /dge ba chung ngu yin yang gsogs/ /sdig pa phran bu yin yang 'dzems/ /rang skyon rkun ma ngo yis zungs/ /rang mtshang mal 'og rdo bzhin sol/ /sangs rgyas chos la dad pa skyed//'gro ba yongs la snying rje skyed/ /dad pa can la dam chos shod/ /gzhan gyi chos la skur ma 'debs/ /chos brgyad tshe 'di'i don ma sgrubs/ /mang bo'i nang du gtam ma mang / /lkog tu sdom khrims khyad ma gsod/ /bshad sgrub bstan la gang phan gyis//ltogs pa rnams la bza' ba byin/ /skom pa rnams la btung ba blud/ /grang ba rnams la gon pa byin/ /dbul bo rnams la nor rdzas byen/ /gnas med rnams la gnas khang byen/ /mgon med nyam thag mgon skyabs mdzod/ /zhim pa'i zas la ma dga' zhig /mjes pa'i mchor la ma dga' zhig /gzhan gyi skyon brjod ma byed cig /khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la byin/ /gyong dang pham kha rang gis longs/ /mdor na bdag pas gzhan gces gyis/ /'di ltar byas na chos dang mthun/ /dge 'dis rang gzhan la phan shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang 25

nyid la smras pa'o//chos rje bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol khyod/ /chos 'brel yod tshad bla ma la/ /bzang ngan med par bkur ste gyes/ /chos kyis bsdus pa'i spun rnams la/ /nye ring med par gang phan gyis/ /rgas pa'i drin can pha ma la /'di dang phyi mar bde thabs gyes/ /rang sems gyong bo 'dul ba'i phyir/ /dben pa'i nags khrod rgyun du sten/ /snying rje ma nus pa la gyis/ /sbyin pa lan po med la thongs/ /rang lus yi dam lha ri sgoms/ /snying bo lhag chad med par thon/ /rgyun du rang gi sems la ltos/ /dge ba 'gro kun don du sngos/ /glu 'di blangs pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /rang gzhan chos dang mthun par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras so//blo phugs gtad na mi bslu'i skyabs//rtsa brgyud bla ma dkon mchog gsum/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs bcas la/ /snying nas 'dud do thugs rjes zungs/ /mi lus thob nas chos med pa/ /mi tshe stong log byas pa yin / /phyi ma mi dran snying med po/ /phyin chad khyod kyis 'di bzhin gyis/ /pha ni snying rje'i 'gro ba skyongs/ /'jig rten pha 'di mi rtag 'chi/ /ma ni stong ba'i gnas lugs skyongs/ /'jig rten ma 'di mi rtag 'bral/ /grogs ni 26

bde gshegs bka' la ltos/ /'jig rten grogs kyis sdig la sbyor/ /bu ni bskyed rdzogs g.yel med sgoms/ /'jig rten bu gsos don med yin/ /longs spyod 'phags pa'i nor bdun zungs/ /'jig rten longs spyod yod kyang 'dzad/ /nor ni chog shes dgos med gsogs/ /'jig rten nor rdzas yod kyang 'dor/ /khang khyim bdag med brag phug zungs/ /'jig rten khang ba btson khang yin/ /zhing ni dad pa'i zhing sa skyed/ /'jig rten lo tog sad ser mang / /so nam chos spyod 'bad la gyis/ /'jig rten las la zin pa med/ /'du 'dzi bskyed rim spro bsdu gyis/ /'jig rten g.yeng ba sangs pa med/ /mchod gnas dkon mchog gsum po mchod/ /'jig rten dpon 'di bzang yang bslu/ /'khor ni mkha' 'gro chos skyong sten/ /'jig rten 'khor g.yog nyon mongs rgyu/ /gos ni ngo tsha khrel 'jom gyon/ /'jig rten gos rnams 'dzad pa yin/ /rgyan ni sdom khrims gtsang ma srungs/ /'jig rten gser g.yu 'chi tshe 'jog /gnyen ni rang sems bya ras skyongs/ /'jig rten gnyen 'di mthun yang 'bral/ /dgra ni bdag 'dzin 'phung rgan thul/ / /'jig rten dgra 'di btul kyang mang / /lta ba rang sems snying bor ltos/ /'jig rten chos 'dir bltas shing g.yeng / /sgom pa 27

sems nyid stong gsal sgoms/ /'jig rten chos la nyon mongs ldang / /spyod pa dug lnga rang grol thongs/ /'jig rten chos la chags sdang 'byung / /'bras bu rang sems sangs rgyas rtogs/ /'jig rten bsam pa 'grub dus med/ /mdo don dam pa'i lha chos gyis/ /'jig rten chos la snying bo med/ /de rnams ldan na mi yin nges/ /mi ldan byol song rkang gnyis yin/ /dge 'dis rang gzhan thams cad kyi/ /rgyud la phan thog 'byung bar shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//pha yul dang po skyid skyid po/ /bsdad kyin bsdad kyin bsdad na snyam/ /ci tsam bsdad kyang chog shes med/ /bar du so nam rmo rko yis/ /lus ngag yid gsum 'o brgyal myong / /sa bon phar btab nas bzung ste/ /lo legs e yong e yong snyam/ /sad dang ser ba byung gis dogs/ /rgyun du zhing gi legs nyes bltas/ /sang phod zhing gi so nam byas/ /nam yang dal ba'i go skabs med/ /dgra la zhe sdang me ltar 'bar/ /gnyen la 'dod chags chu ltar khol/ /mi shes gti mug mun ltar 'thibs/ /dam chos yid la 'ong skabs bcom/ /lan rer btab pa'i lo legs rnams/ /sad dang ser ba byung nas brdungs/ /sa bon phar btab tshur mi 'ong / /bzod glags med pa'i sdug bsngal myong / /brkus dang 28

'phrog bcom 'thab rtsod byed/ /yul ngan mu ge'i pha yul de/ /bza' med yi dwags grong khyer 'dra/ /tha ma bskyur nas 'gro ba yin/ /de phyir tshogs drug rang grol khyod/ /sdig gsog 'phung gzhi pha yul la/ /ma chags ma chags sems ma chags/ /ma 'dug ma 'dug 'bros re ran/ /'bros na dben pa'i ri la phros/ /'dul na nyon mongs sa rgod thul/ /las na dge ba'i so nam rem/ /'debs na thar ba'i sa bon thobs/ /zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//nor ni dang po bdag skyid po/ /bsod nams can zer gzhan smon po/ /yod kyin da dung yod na snyam/ /ci tsam yod kyang chog shes med/ /bar du phyugs lug btang 'dogs kyis/ /char chu'i nang na 'o re brgyal/ /phyugs rnams ri khar btang nas bzung / /rkun jag e 'ong e 'ong snyam/ /spyang kis phyugs rnams gsod kyis dogs/ /bkres skom myong bzhin legs nyes bltas/ /srod nas rkun ma byung gis dogs/ /mtshan mo'i gnyid kyi bde ba bkag /dge ba'i phyogs su gtong mi phod/ /dam chos 'ong ba'i go skabs med/ /phal cher rang yang mu ges 'chi/ /sdug bsngal drag pos sems rtsa non/ /skabs skabs jag pa rkun mas 'khyer/ /ra mdar brgyugs nas rang yang gsod/ /'phung sna 29

'dren pa'i rgyu nor de/ /dgra 'dre 'bod pa'i g.yab mo 'dra/ /tha mar sbrang ma'i sbrang rtsi bzhin/ /rang gis spyad par ma phod pa'i/ /nor rnams gzhan gyis ci bder spyod/ /rang nyid phyi mar lag stong 'gro/ /de phyir tshogs drug rang grol khyod/ /rgyu nor 'dzoms pa'i gnas skabs su/ /bsags pa'i nor la snying bo longs/ /gang yod chos kyi phyogs su thongs/ /ma gsogs ma gsogs nor ma gsogs/ /bsog na 'phags pa'i nor bdun gsogs/ /zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//grogs dang po lha mo bzhad kha ma/ /lus la rgyan dang gos kyis bklubs/ /kha 'jam tshig gis spro ba bskyed/ /gdong la bltas na 'dzum gyis bsu/ /bltas kyin da dung bltas na snyam/ /ci tsam bltas kyang chog rgyu med/ /bar du srin mo khro gtum ma/ /cungazad tsam la mi mgu bar/ /rgyab log mig log yang yang byed/ /bdud mo'i sdang mig sems la gnod/ /lhag par chos kyi bar chad byed/ /phar la tshig gcig bshad pa'i bar/ /tshur la yin min bco brgyad smra/ /khros nas skra'i bzung brdungs pa na/ /sgyid par 'jus nas mo sod zer/ /skyon mtshang tshig gis snying rtsa trog /tha ma mi sdug khro gnyer can/ /bza' sdigs thug pa bskol bskol byed/ /bltas kyin bltas kyin je btsog 'gro/ /rgyun du 30

'grogs na skyugs bro ldang / /des na tshogs drug rang grol khyod/ /bdud mo'i 'thab ya ma 'dod par/ /bsten na mtshan ldan bla ma sten/ /'grogs na rdo rje'i spun la 'grogs/ /byed na dam pa'i lha chos gyis//zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//dang po khyim mtshes phan phan po/ /g.yor skyi'i dus su dgos dgos 'dra/ /bar du khrel med na rag po//g.yar bo ma byas 'kheng ra mang / /g.yar na mi ster g.yar bsdos byed/ /tha mar sems ngan gnag sems can/ /rgyu nor 'dzom dus rku 'phrog byed/ /zhing las byed dus zhing mtshams rtsod/ /sgo rnams phye dus khyem 'dzul byed/ /rdzun dang phra mas khyim tshang dkrug /nyin re bzhin du 'thab cing 'dzing / /chags sdang dgra skad bzod glags med/ /khyem mtshes ming la chom rkun dngos/ /de phyir tshogs drug rang grol khyod/ /khyim mtshes dgra dang ma 'thab par/ /'dug na grogs med gcig pur sdod/ /bsten na dge ba'i bshes gnyen sten/ /byed na dam pa'i lha chos mdzod//cesapa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//dang po a khu chos mdzad po/ /gzan sham gyon pa'i btsun chung bo/ /chos gos gyon pa'i khrims ldan po/ /khyim tshang bza' bas thod bzhin khur/ /bza' btung phud kyis rtag tu mchod/ /31

nged kyi a khu drin can zhes/ /kha 'jam tshig gis gtang rag gtong / /kho yang dga' zhing spro ba skyes/ /dad zas gshin zas mang bo bsdus/ /dad zas gshin zas dug chu de/ /'thung shin da dung 'thung na 'dod/ /ci tsam 'thungs kyang chog shes med/ /mi gcig shi ba'i nangs par nas/ /kho bo'ang e 'bod e 'bod bsam/ /bos na ja mar e bzang dang / /yon ni ci ster gang ster snyam/ /yon ni chung na bshad rgyu mang / /bar du a khu dbang can po/ /rtsag rgan gyon pa'i rgad po bo/ /bud med bsten pa'i grub thob po/ /dom pa 'ongs dus shags 'debs po/ /rdung res byed pa'i shed can po/ /khe tshong byed pa'i tshong ba bo/ /zas nor gsog pa'i gsog 'jog mkhan/ /rang skal gcod pa'i skal chad po//gshis ngan ser sna sgos su byed/ /khyem tshang bza' bar kha tshag mang / /khyem tshang bza' ba che chung gis/ /dngos su a khus zer bzhin byed/ /lkog tu zas bzang ci bder spyod/ /a khu khyim du 'ong gi zhes/ /kha dang lag pa yang yang phyis/ /a khu'i lus la yi dwags sems/ /a khus rang skal rang gis bcad/ /ra lug gsod kyang a khur 'dri/ /bsha' 'am bsha' na gang bsha' zer/ /a khus nges par bsha' dgos zer/ /bsha' na tshon po zhig shos zer/ /a khu'i lus la bshan pa'i sems tha 32

ma a khu dbang med po/ /'tsho skyong byed pa'i g.yog rgan po/ /chad chod gyon pa'i sprang rgan po/ /ngan ngon za ba'i khye rgan po/ /khyem tshang nang nas bza' lhag po/ /'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i sgyu lus sgur/ /dge sbyor byed pa'i stobs rnams zad/ /nor rnams tsha bos bdag tu bzung / /dron po 'dod kyang skon mkhan dkon/ /zas rnams mna' ma'i lag tu shor/ /zhim po 'dod kyang ster mkhan med/ /nged kyi ban rgan hon log ces/ /kun gyis dman sa zhig tu 'jog /a khu 'gyod pa de dus skyes/ /a khu shi ba'i nangs par du/ / rta rgan kha na so med cig /bla ma zhig la phul ba'i tshe/ /a khu'i dge rtsa de nas 'grub/ /bsags pa'i nor la ser sna byed/ /a khu'i phyogs su gtong ba dkon/ /de dus a khu las ngan pos/ /dkor gye rnam smin rgyab tu 'khur/ /grogs med bar do'i 'phrang ring 'grim/ /a khu de dus yi mug ldang / /mjug tu tsha bo tsha mos kyang / /a pha a ma'i bsngo zhus mang / /a khu'i bsngo zhus thos pa dka'/ /de phyir tshogs drug rang grol khyod/ /a khu'i go sa ma 'dzin par/ /pha yul btson ra rgyab tu zhog /dkor nag dug gi chu ma thungs/ /ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms par mdzod/ /33

ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//gnyen ni dang po mthong 'dzum po/ /rgyang nas 'ongs kyang sngon nas bsu/ /'dir shog 'dir sdod lung ba 'gengs/ /bar du zas kyi kha lan can/ /tshur gcig byin na phar gcig dgos/ /'byor tshe cung zad phan srid kyang / /rgud tshe brnyas pa'i thog mar 'ong / /zas ni kham gang byen na yang / /drin 'dren ma ṇi 'don 'don byed/ /lhag par chos la mar bshol 'debs/ /tha ma chags sdang gyod gzhi cano/ /sdug tshe mi phan byol nas 'gro/ /skyid tshe za grogs de spongs la/ /tshogs drug rang grol ming can khyod/ /gnyen ni 'gro drug sems can skyongs/ /grogs su chos mdzad dam pa sten/ /ltad mo rang gi sems la ltos/ /blta rgyu legs po de na yod/ /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//'khor ba'i btson dong mkhar khang de/ /dang po sa rdo shing gi phyir/ /lus kyis ngal dub sdug bsngal myong / /bar du zhig dogs thigs chag byas/ /tha mar zhig cing ral nas 'phung / /sngon gye mi de'i shul 'di zhes/ /phyis kyi mi yis yang yang gleng / /gtsug lag khang rnams ma gtogs par/ /'jig rten khang brtsigs don med yin/ /de phyir tshogs drug rang grol khyod/ / 34

mkhar khang rgya chen ma byed par/ /brtsig na bsam gtan mkhar khang rtsigs/ /phyag bdar byeng rgod gnyis la gyis/ /zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//dang bo gcod sngags 'jigs 'jigs po/ /'dre la brdung ba'i mthu chen po/ /mgo la dom lpags khor zhig gyon/ /ske la phreng ba nyis tshar byas/ /glo la ling sgam rkang dung btags/ /yon bdag rnams kyis mthong ma thag /a khu gcod sngags 'ong gi zer/ /btags pa'i ra lug sa la bsgyel/ /lto phral pags pa dmar bshu byas/ /bar du bdud po snying nag pos/ /khrag dang sha sna ga re zer/ /rgyang nas 'bod pa'i skad po che/ /ra lug g.yang gzhi mkha' la brgyangs/ /gcod sngags lus la gshin rje'i sems/ /lug gi pags pas btums pa yi/ /rnga nag rdung ba'i snying nag po/ /hūṃ dang phaṭa kyi nga ro sgrog /sod dang gtubs kyis lung ba 'gengs/ /kha btums gtor gdan gtor gdugs zhes/ /mi dgos dgu dgos brnab sems can/ /cung zad tsam la ma mgu na/ /mthu sdigs byed pa'i khog nag po/ /tha ma 'khor ba'i gdung sems can/ /gang yod rta yi sha btags byas/ /myur du rta la zhon nas rgyug /lha 'dre'i za skal 'phrog pa'i stabs/ /yul du na tsha god kha mang / /hūṃ phaṭa 35

zer ba'i ngal med po/ /rnyed tshad glud dang yas su gtong / /yar la 'gro ba'i go skabs med/ /lo re bzhin du kha thur 'gro/ /sha khrag mchod pa'i gcod sngags la/ /ye shes sbyan ldan rgyal ba rnams/ /dpag tshad mang bo'i bar du 'bros/ /'chi khar mnar gcod sdug bsngal che/ /phyi mar dmyal ba'i gnas su lhung / /thar nas lha mir skyes na yang / /tshe thung nad mang can du skye/ /de phyir tshogs drug rang grol khyod/ /mi dge sdig pa'i lag pa yis/ /dmyal ba'i zangs chen kha ma 'byed/ /khro chu khol ma khar ma thungs/ /'dre 'dul grong chog blos thongs la/ /dkar bo dge ba'i lde mig gis/ /mngon mtho lha mi'i gser sgo phye/ /bde chen thar ba'i gser gling snyegs/ /gtan bde'i btsan sa zin par mdzod/ /gal te grong chog khyod byed na/ /gtor sha'i ra lug tshe thar gyes/ /gal te sha khrag phud dgos na/ /sngon nas/ sta gon byas na rnyed/ /gal te btsal nas ma rnyed kyang / /zan sogs rnam pa sha khrag la/ /ngo bo zag med bdud rtsi ru/ /byen gyis brlabs nas phul chog pa/ /bla ma dam pa'i dgongs pa yin/ /de ltar lag tu len nus na/ /'di dang phyi ma'i bde skyid 'byung //zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//dang po lha bu yid 'ong po/ /gces kyin da dung gces na 36

snyam/ /brtse ba'i sems la bzod glags med/ /bar du kha yi zas 'phrog po/ /mi yi bu mo nang du bcug /drin can pha ma sgo ru bton/ /lkog tu zas kyi kha zhim byas/ /pha yis bos na lan mi ster/ /a mas bos kyang ang mi khug /la las mi bsad rku 'phrog byas/ /mkhar zhing nor rdzas gzhan la 'chor/ /sdug bsngal sems la bzod glags med/ /pha mar byams pa'i bu tsha dkon/ /chos byed bu ni de bas dkon/ /ma rabs sdig pa'i las byas nas/ /pha ma bu gsum dmyal bar 'gro/ /tha ma rang skyes snying nag dgra/ /pha la 'phung rgan 'chi med zer/ /ma la 'chi med ma 'di zhes/ /tshig ngan mtshon gyi char ba 'bebs/ /'di gnyis 'chi dus mi 'dug zer/ /sdang mig lta zhing rdog thos bsnun/ /sdug bsngal yi mug gting nas slong / /mtshon gye rma la sos dus yod/ /tshig ngan rma la sos dus med/ /grang zhing ltogs kyang bcos ma zer/ /zas zhim 'jam yang gos 'dod kyang / /grang la rnyog pa'i bza' btung dang / /lci la hrul bo'i dug po bskon/ /bu yi lus la gshed ma'i sems/ /de nas pha ma shi tsa na/ /mig sngar mya ngan cung zad byed/ /med dang mug rabs smre sngags ni/ /rgyun du ma ṇi bzhin du 'don/ /nyi ma kha shas song 'phro nas/ /dran rgyu pha ma'i drin mi dran/ /mi dran rgyu 37

yi glu dbyangs len/ /de dus rang nyid 'chi bdag gis/ /'chor med zhags pas bcings nas 'khrid/ /phyi nas phan pa'i dge rtsa med/ /sngon nas rang dbang yod dus su/ /bu tshar dgos snyam chos ma byas/ /gshin rje'i drung du slebs pa'i dus/ /yi mug snying rlung yang yang ldang / /de phyir tshogs drug rang grol khyod/ /ma 'dod ma 'dod bu ma 'dod/ /ma gso ma gso bu ma gso/ /spong na rang skyes dgra bo spongs/ /gso na rig pa'i khye'u chung gsos/ /bsten na dge ba'i bshes gnyen sten/ /'grogs na chos mdzad grogs dang 'grogs/ /'dug na dben pa'i ri la sdod/ /byed na dam pa'i lha chos gyis/ /sgrol na 'khor ba'i pha rol sgrol/ /bsnyeg na rgyal ba'i go 'phang snyogs/ /zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang nyid chos la bskul phyir smras pa'o//bu mo dang po mdzes 'dzum ma/ /brtse ba'i sems kyis gces na snyam/ /las ngan dbang gis khyim dad che/ /don med mi yi g.yog la dga'/ /grogs kyi phyogs su shi lceb byed/ /drin can pha ma rgyab tu bor/ /gces nor 'khyer ba'i dbang mo che bar du lan chags 'khor med ma/ /pha mar dngos su bslangs nas 'khyer//ming bos lkog tu brkus nas 'khyer/ /ci tsam byen kyang mgu dus med/ /tha ma dri mo gdong dmar ma/ /nyes na pha ma'i 38

sdug bsngal gzhi/ /de phyir tshogs drug rang grol khyod/ /'phung gzhi bu mo ma 'dod par/ /yar la bla ma dkon mchog mchod/ /mar la dbul phongs sbyin pa thongs/ /rgyun du dam pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//rje rgyal kun spyi gzugs padma 'byung / /bdag snang ngor tha mal tshul 'dzin pa/ /pha bka' drin gsum ldan chos kyi rgyal/ /thugs brtse ba'i spyan gyis gzigs su gsol/ /grong yul na rtag tu so nam byed/ /dgon na yang tshong dang bun bskyed byed/ /dus deng sang ri khrod 'grims na skyid/ /bdag dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams dga' bsnyeg /grong yul na nor phyir lus srog gtong / /dgon na yang nor phyir sdom pa gtong / /dus deng sang ri khrod 'grims na skyid/ /bdag dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams dga' bsnyeg /grong yul na tshe 'di don du gnyer/ /dgon na yang chos brgyad don du gnyer/ /dus deng sang ru khrod 'grims na skyid/ /bdag dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams dga' bsnyeg /grong yul na 'thab rtsod 'khrug long byed/ /dgon na yang phan tshun phrag dog byed/ /dus deng sang ri khrod 'grims na skyid/ /bdag dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams dga' bsnyeg /grong yul na mi dge'i sdig la rngams/ /dgon na 39

yang 'dod yon dkor la rngams/ /dus deng sang ri khrod 'grims na skyid/ /bdag dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams dga' bsnyeg /grong yul na bza' tshang skyong dgos mang / /dgon na yang dgon pa'i skyong khur mang / /dus deng sang ri khrod 'grims na skyid/ /bdag dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams dga' bsnyeg /grong yul na rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi byed/ /dgon na yang chos min bya ba byed/ /dus deng sang ri khrod 'grims na skyid/ /bdag dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams dga' bsnyeg /grong yul na sdug bsngal mtsho chen brdol/ /dgon na yang chags sdang chu mig brdol/ /dus deng sang ri khrod 'grems na skyid/ /bdag dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams dga' bsnyeg /rje bka' gdams rnam thar skyong 'dod dang / /chos sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin 'dod rnams/ /dus deng sang ri khrod 'grims na skyid/ /gnas dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams dgar shog /chos snyan brgyud blo sbyong skyong 'dod dang / /chos byang chub lam rim bsgom 'dod rnams/ /dus deng sang ri khrod 'grims na skyid/ /gnas dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams dgar shog /lam bskyed rdzogs zab mo bsgom 'dod dang / /lam 'od gsal rdzogs chen bsgom 'dod rnams/ /dus deng sang ri khrod 'grims na skyid/ /gnas dben 40

pa'i dga' tshal nyams dgar shog /tshe 'di la phyi mig mi blta bar/ /tshe sgrub pa snyoms 'dod skal ldan kun/ /dus deng sang ri khrod 'grims na skyid/ /gnas dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams dgar shog /dge 'dis kyang rang gzhan la phan nas/ /rje dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /gnas dben pa'i dga' tshal bsten nas kyang / /chos nyams su blangs nas 'tshang rgya shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas mi gzugs can/ /pha chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo la/ /bdag snying nas dad pas gsol ba 'debs/ /sems gyong bo thul bar byin gyis rlobs/ /gnas dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams dga' na/ /sman ljongs dang nags tshal gangs ris mdzes/ /zas rang grub shing thog tshod ma mod/ /bde skyid gnyis ri khrod gnas na yod/ /gnas dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams dga' na/ /bya khu byug sngon mos skad snyan 'byin/ /chu gtsang mas lhung lhung snyan pa sgog /bde skyid gnyis ri khrod gnas na yod/ /gnas dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams dga' na/ /grogs ri dwags bag phebs rgyu zhing rtse/ /mdog rab mdzes me tog gcal du bkram/ /bde skyid gnyis ri khrod gnas na yod/ /gnas dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams 41

dga' na/ /sus ma byas rang byung brag khung de/ /dgun dro zhing dbyar dus rab tu bsil/ /bde skyid gnyis ri khrod gnas na yod/ /gnas dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams dga' na/ /dgra gnyen gnyis gang dang 'brel ba med/ /chags sdang gi zag pa ngang gis 'grib/ /bde skyid gnyis ri khrod gnas na yod/ /gnas dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams dga' na/ /gzhan che chung mi yi rgyu 'grul med/ /sems g.yo sgyu tshul 'chos ngang gis 'grib/ /bde skyid gnyis ri khrod gnas na yod/ /gnas dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams dga' na/ /tshe 'di yi rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi med/ /rang gcig pur dge sbyor ngang gis 'phel/ /bde skyid gnyis ri khrod gnas na yod/ /gnas dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams dga' na/ /dus bzhi bo rim gyis 'gyur ba'i tshe /tshe mi rtag dran nas skyo shas 'phel/ /bde skyid gnyis ri khrod gnas na yod/ /gnas dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams dga' na/ /blo rnam rig dbang bo rab tu gsal/ /nyams rtogs pa'i yon tan ngang gis 'char/ /bde skyid gnyis ri khrod gnas na yod/ /gnas dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams dga' na/ /khong bla ma mkhas grub mang bo bzhugs/ /nang sems la phan pa'i mgur dbyangs len/ /bde skyid gnyis ri khrod gnas na 42

yod/ /gnas dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams dga' na/ /rje bla ma lha yis byin gyes rlob/ /ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis dngos grub ster/ /bde skyid gnyis ri khrod gnas na yod/ /gnas dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams dga' na/ /dpa' chos skyong srung mas bar chad bsrung / /lha dkar phyogs rnams kyis mthun rkyen sbyor/ /bde skyid gnyis ri khrod gnas na yod/ /nga rnal 'byor tshe lhag ri la skyel/ /mi skal ldan yod na ri la shog /dus kun tu ri khrod dben pa bsten/ /tshe 'di nas bde nas bde bar 'gro/ /nga bza' med dgos med slong mo ba/ /'khor g.yog med dpon med rang gcig pur/ /gnas mi med khyi med lung stong na/ /'phral dpag med tshad med skyid nas blangs/ /glu 'di nyid thos tshad thams cad kyang / /rgyud dam pa'i chos la rab phyogs nas/ /nang sems nyid gyong bo 'dul phyir du/ /gnas dben pa'i ri ngogs bsten par shog / ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang gros gyis smras pa'o//ma nor thar ba'i lam ston pa'i//mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma yi/ /zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag rgyud byen gyis brlab tu gsol/ /tshe 'di mi rtag skar mda' bzhin/ /lang tsho ston dus me tog 'dra/ /dbang med 'jig rten pha rol 'gro/ /43

'chi khar mi 'gyod chos shig dgos/ /da lta'i dus 'dir le lo dang / /rnam g.yeng ngang la tshe shor na/ /phyi mar gar skye cha med pas/ /'chi khar mi 'gyod chos shig dgos/ /'jig rten phyi mar 'gro ba'i tshe/ /nye 'brel nor rdzas shul du bzhag /rang gi lus kyang 'dor dgos pas/ /'chi khar mi 'gyod chos shig dgos/ /glo bur 'chi ba byung ba'i dus/ /dam pa'i lha chos ma gtogs pa/ /gzhan rnams kun gyis bslu bar nges/ /'chi khar mi 'gyod chos shig dgos/ /rang dbang da lta yod dus 'dir/ /dam pa'i lha chos ma byas na/ /rang gis rang nyid bslus pa yin/ /'chi khar mi 'gyod chos shig dgos/ /de phyir gros 'di gsan nas kyang / /mi dge'i sdig la rab tu 'dzem/ /tshogs gnyis bre gsog phul gsog gyis/ /'chi khar mi 'gyod dga' bar nges/ /dus gsum bdag gis ci bsags dge /khams gsum 'gro la myur smin nas/ /dus gsum nyon mongs las grol te/ /sku gsum go 'phang thob par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//na mo gu ru/ drin can gye bla ma chos rgyal rje/ /byang chub kyi bar du bdag skyongs shig /reb gong gi yul skyes bya btang ngas/ /rang nyid la rang gis snying gtam smra/ /a'o khyod gtam 44

gyi rang tshod zungs/ /lab lab gtam ha cang mang drags na/ /tshig mda' de gzhan la 'phog dogs yod/ /'chal gtam gyi smra ba nyung na bzang / /a'o khyod zas kyi rang tshod zungs/ /za ma yis ha cang 'grang drags na/ /gti mug gi gnyid kyis dge sbyor chag /dka' thub dang bcud len byas na bzang / /a'o khyod gos kyi rang tshod zungs/ /mchor bo la ha cang dga' drags na/ /mi tshe ni yad ma yud la 'chor/ /ngan ngon gyi gon pa gyon na bzang / /a'o khyod grogs kyi rang tshod zungs/ /grogs po de ha cang mang drags na/ /sdig grogs dang dge grogs sna tshogs yod/ /chos grogs ni re re tsam bsten bzang / /a'o khyod gnas kyi rang tshod zungs/ /gnas gcig tu ha cang bsdad grags na/ /chags sdang dang gtam ngan sna tshogs 'ong / /phyogs med kyi ri khrod 'grims na bzang / /a'o khyod gang la'ang rang tshod zungs/ /bya byed de ha cang mang drags na/ /nyams len ni 'ong ba dka' mor gda' / /byar med kyi bya btang byas na bzang / /zhes pa 'di ni tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs pad la/ /yang yang gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /deng nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /'bral ba med 45

par bdag skyongs shig /gson dang skal ldan bya btang ba/ /phan pa'i snying gtam zab mo zhig /snying nas bshad kyis 'di dag rnams/ /snying la chongs la dam chos mdzod/ /tshe sngon bsod rnams bsags pa'i mthus/ /tshe 'dir rnyed dka'i rten bzang thob/ /mjal dka' chos dang mjal dus 'dir/ /snying nas dam pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /da ltar rang dbang rang la yod/ /so thar byang sems bla med kyi/ /sdom gsum rgyud la tshang dus 'dir/ /snying nas dam pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /mtshan ldan bla mas skal ldan la/ /gdams ngag thugs kyi yang zhun de/ /gang la gang 'dod gnang dus 'dir/ /snying nas dam pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /rang sems skye med spros bral don/ /gnas lugs mngon sum bstan pa'i tshe/ /rang sems rang ngo 'phrod dus 'dir/ /snying nas dam pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /dge 'dis rang gzhan thams cad kyis/ /sngon byon dam pa'i rnam thar ltar/ /dam pa'i lha chos nyams blangs nas/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//bka' drin gsum ldan bla ma yi/ /zhabs kyi padmor gus pas 'dud/ /bla ma bzang rung phan pa med/ /gsol ba 'debs dgos ri khrod pa/ /mi lus thob pa da res yin/ /stong log ma 46

byed ri khrod pa/ /'chi ba nam 'ong nges pa med/ /blo rgya ma che ri khrod pa/ /yul mi khyim mtshes shi ba rnams/ /bya gtong yin no ri khrod pa/ /'dod yon spyad kyang ngoms pa med/ /zhen pa ma byed ri khrod pa/ /byas pa'i las la tshar dus med/ /bya ba thongs shig ri khrod pa/ /pha yul bdud kyi btson ra 'dra/ /gtan nas spongs shig ri khrod pa/ /dge sdig las la bslu ba med/ /spang blang mdzod cig ri khrod pa/ /'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba med/ /thar lam sgrubs shig ri khrod pa/ /rang nyid bde 'dod theg dman yin/ /sems bskyed ma chung ri khrod pa/ /nyams len mang bo dgos pa med/ /gcig la dril cig ri khrod pa/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blos thongs la/ /dben pa sten cig ri khrod pa/ /'di bzhin mdzad na bde skyid kyi/ /nyi ma 'char ro ri khrod pa/ /dge 'dis rang gzhan thams cad kyi/ /blo kha chos la phyogs par shog /ces pa 'di ni tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//spyi gtsug seng ges btegs pa'i khri steng du/ /yon tan du ma'i tshogs kyis rab brgyan pa'i/ /skyon gyis ma gos drin can chos kyi rgyal/ /mi 'bral spyi gtsug 'khor lo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /ngo tsha'i gos kyi mchog ni tshul khrims yin/ /du kyu la yi gos kyis g.yogs kyang min/ /lus ni rab tu mdzes par khyod 'dod na/ /47

tshul khrims gos gyon kun gyi mig tu mdzes/ /spyi bo'i gtsug gi rgyan mchog bla ma yin/ /klu dbang gtsug gi nor bus spras kyang min/ /spyi bo'i gtsug de rab tu mdzes 'dod na/ /bla mas gtsug rgyan gyis dang kun gyes smon/ /rna rgyan mchog ni mdo sngags thos pa yin/ /rin po che yi rna rgyan btags kyang min/ /rna ba rab tu mjes pa khyod 'dod na/ /thos pa'i rgyan de thogs dang gzhan ngor mdzes/ /mgul ba'i rgyan gyi mchog ni legs bshad yin/ /rin chen sna bdun do shal 'ching kyang min/ /mgrin pa rab tu mdzes par khyod 'dod na/ /legs bshad rgyan de gsol dang gzhan yid 'phrog /lag pa'i rgyan gyi mchog ni sbyin gtong yin/ /rin chen gser gyi gdu bus brgyan kyang min/ /lag pa rab tu mdzes par khyod 'dod na/ /gtong ba'i rgyan gyis brgyan na kun gyis smon/ /dge 'dis rang nyid rgyan mchog 'di rnams kyis/ /spras nas gar song mthong thos 'gro rnams kyi/ /dbang med yid 'phrog de dag thams cad kyang / /rgyan gzhan bor nas rgyan mchog 'di gsol shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang nyid la smras pa'o//mi nga'i 'di phyi'i skyabs mgon chos rgyal rje/ /mi 'bral spyi gtsug 'khor lo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /dal 'byor mi lus rin 48

chen thob dus 'dir/ /dal med chos la 'bungs shig bya btang pa/ /'chi ba glo bur nam 'ong cha med pas/ /'chi chos snying nas gyis shig bya btang pa/ /las kyi 'bras bus nam yang mi bslu bas/ /las 'bras zhib mo gyis shig bya btang pa/ /'khor ba'i chos la snying bo til tsam med/ /'khor dang longs spyod spongs shig bya btang pa/ /dben pa bsten pa rgyal sras lag len lags/ /dben gnas ri khrod zungs shig bya btang pa/ /rnam g.yeng ngo srung mthun 'jug bya ba rnams/ /rnam pa kun tu spongs shig bya btang pa/ /ci la'ang ma chags mtshan ldan bla ma'i gsung / /ci bzhin bsgrub la gzhol zhig bya btang pa/ /gzhan rnams thams cad bde la 'god 'dod blos/ /gzhan phan thabs la 'bod cig bya btang pa/ /gang shar thams cad sems kyi rol ba ste/ /gang la'ang dgag sgrub ma byed bya btang pa/ /bsgom bya sgom byed blo dang bral ba yin/ /sgom med gnas lugs skyongs shig bya btang pa/ /snang stong gnyis med rang byung 'od gsal gyi/ /snang bzhi'i nyams len gyis shig bya btang pa/ /mdor na sgom yun ma thung tshe dang snyoms/ /mdor bsdus gnad 'gag yin no bya btang pa/ /tshogs drug rang grol 'di bzhin nyams blangs na/ /tshogs rdzogs sgrib sbyang sangs rgyas 49

'thob par 'gyur/ /bdag gis 'dis mtshon dge ba ci bsags pa/ /bdag gzhan sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o/ /gsum ldan gyi bla ma thams cad mkhyen/ /gus ldan gyi bu la rgyang nas gzigs/ /chos pa'i gzugs chos med bya bral ngas/ /rang nyid kyis rang la snying gtam smra/ /bla ma la mos gus ma skyes par/ /nyams myong ni bzang bo skyes zer rdzun/ /lo zla yi mtshams yang ma byas par/ /yi dam lha'i zhabs mthong zer ba'ang rdzun/ /mi rtag dang 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs gnyis/ /ma dran par tshe blos thongs zer rdzun/ /las 'bras la yid ches ma rnyed par/ /sdig pa khos ma byas zer ba dzun/ /phan thogs ni rdul tsam med bzhin du/ /byams snying rje byang sems skye zer rdzun/ /kun rdzob chos bden med ma rtogs par/ /lta ba khos rtogs zhes zer ba'ang dzun/ /'di drug ni 'phral du byung dogs 'dug /'di dag la rgyun du dogs zon mdzod/ /tshe 'di yi bya bar blo log na/ /lto gos kyis phongs kyang rang mi 'gyod//bla ma yi bka' dang ma 'gal na/ /dam tshig nyams zer yang rang mi 'gyod/ /dal 'byor rten chud zos ma byas na/ /chos ma byas zer yang rang mi 'gyod/ /rang sems la g.yo sgyu ma mchis na/ /50

'phags pa rnams ma mnyes zer mi 'gyod/ /stong nyid dang snying rje ma bral na/ /chos spyod zhan zer yang rang mi 'gyod/ /mnyam pa nyid rtogs pa shar ba na/ /gang zag gis gshe yang mi 'gyod pas/ /de drug dang ldan pa zhig byed dgos/ /de rnams ni rgyud la e sbyor ltos/ /sbyin pa yi lag pa 'khum mi 'khum/ /zas nor gyi kha char babs na mngon/ /tshul khrims kyi rgyan la gzab mi gzab/ /grong yul gye 'dam du tshud na mngon/ /bzod pa yi go khrab sra mi sra/ /tshig ngan gyi mda' yis brgyab na mngon/ /brtson 'grus kyi rta pho mgyogs mi mgyogs/ /thos bsam sgom thang la brgyugs na mngon/ /bsam gtan gye sku mkhar brtan mi brtan/ /byeng rgod kyi chu log brgyugs na mngon/ /shes rab kyi mdung ring rno mi rno/ /bdag 'dzin gyi snying la btab na mngon/ /'di drug dus bzang ngan mtshang de ston/ /'di dus su ltad mo khyod la blta/ /glu dbyangs 'di blangs pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /rang gzhan kun chos dang mthun par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//rgyal kun gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin padma 'byung / /de yi gsung rgyun legs bshad bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /legs par myangs pa'i rgyal sras 'gro ba'i mgon/ /skye rgu'i gtsug rgyan chos 51

rgyal zhabs la 'dud/ /khregs chod lta ba'i gnas lugs skyong ba'i tshe/ /de la gnad kyi gdams pa 'di rnams gces/ /nyams ni bzang bo ci ltar skyes na yang / /de la chags zhen yud tsam med pa gces/ /rtsub nyams mi bde ba ni ci byung yang / /de yi ngo bo lta ba shin tu gces/ /rtogs pa mtho mtho 'dra ba ci skyes kyang / /de la ngar 'dzin rlom sems med pa gces/ /rtogs pa ji ltar mtho yang bsod nams tshogs/ /bsags pa dag la 'bad pa shin tu gces/ /'khor ba rang bzhin med par shes na yang / /sdig lhung phyogs la 'dzem pa rab tu gces/ /rang sems sangs rgyas nyid du thag chod kyang / /skyabs 'gro mchod bstod sogs la 'bad pa gces/ /rang lus yi dam lha ru thag chod kyang / /bskyed rim bzlas brjod mi bskyur byed pa gces/ /sems can mi dmigs par ni mthong na yang / /byams dang snying rje'i smon lam gdab pa gces/ /bla ma rang sems yin pa rtogs na yang / /drin can bla mar mos gus byed pa gces/ /de rnams nyams su blangs na gol sa dang/ /gegs rnams thams cad grol bas shin tu gces/ /glu 'dis rang gzhan yongs la phan thogs nas/ /gegs dang gol sa kun las grol bar shog /ces pa 'di yang mkhas grub ra ga a sru'i gsung ltar tshogs drug rang 52

grol gyis rang la tshigs bcad du blangs pa'o//chos dbyings kyi nam mkha' las ma g.yos pa bzhin/ /ngo mtshar gyi gzugs sku yi 'ja' tshon de bstan/ /skal ldan gyi byis pa'i yid dbang med du 'phrog /rab mdzes kyi gtsug gi rgyan chos rgyal la 'dud/ /dad gus kyi g.yang mo yi lug dkar ni khyod/ /dge sbyor gyi ri kha ru 'gro ba yi tshe/ /rnam g.yeng gi ri spyang gis 'dzin las ni che/ /skabs skabs su ma yengs pa'i bya ra re mdzod/ /brtson 'grus kyi myur mgyogs pa'i rta pho ni khyod/ /thos bsam gye thang yangs su rgyug pa yi tshe/ /le lo yi 'obs nang du lhung las ni che/ /skabs skabs su ma yengs pa'i bya ra re mdzod/ /dag snang gi gser mig gi nya mo ni khyod/ /mched grogs kyi rgya mtsho la phyin pa yi tshe/ /chags sdang gi lcags kyu yis 'dzin las ni che/ /skabs skabs su ma yengs pa'i bya ra re mdzod/ /tshul khrims kyi sha ba yi rwa ring ni khyod/ /zhi dul gyi spang gzhongs su nyal ba yi tshe/ /nyes spyod kyi sha khye yis 'dzin las ni che/ /skabs skabs su ma yengs pa'i bya ra re mdzod/ /bsam bzang gi khri snyan gyi sa le ni khyod/ /chos bshad kyi lam chen la rgyu ba yi tshe/ /zhe sdang gi rngon pa yis gsod las ni che/ /skabs skabs su ma yengs pa'i bya ra re mdzod/ /khrel yod kyi mdzes ma ni phra mo yi 53

khyod/ /dran shes kyi rgyan bzang gis spras pa yi tshe/ /log spyod kyi mi gtsang gis gos las ni che/ /skabs skabs su ma yengs pa'i bya ra re mdzod/ /shes rab kyi smra mkhas yi ne tso ni khyod/ /rtsom pa yi zhing nang du 'gro ba yi tshe/ /nga rgyal gyi khra yis ni 'dzin las ni che/ /skabs skabs su ma yengs pa'i bya ra re mdzod/ /skyo shas kyi mthing ril ni sngon mo yi khyod/ /glu dbyangs kyi skad snyan ni 'byen pa yi tshe/ /'dod yon gyi ser ba yis 'phog las ni che/ /skabs skabs su ma yengs pa'i bya ra re mdzod/ /'dod chung gi bya rgyal ni rgod po yi khyod/ /chog shes kyi ri rtse ru 'gro ba yi tshe/ /mngon zhen gyi rnyi phra yis 'dzin las ni che/ /skabs skabs su ma yengs pa'i bya ra re mdzod/ /bsnyen sgrub kyi rgya stag ni khra bo yi khyod/ /mtshams bcad kyi nags khrod du rgyu ba yi tshe/ /gti mug gi sa mda' yis gsod las ni che/ /skabs skabs su ma yengs pa'i bya ra re mdzod/ /lta ba yi khyung chen ni rtsal ldan gyi khyod/ /chos dbyangs kyi nam mkha' la 'phur ba yi tshe/ /phyogs ris kyi dog sa ru tshud las ni che/ /skabs skabs su ma yengs pa'i bya ra re mdzod/ /sgom pa yi dar seng gi dkar mo ni khyod/ /bde gsal gyi g.ya' sngon zur 'grim pa yi tshe/ /bying rgod kyi bu yug de 'tshub las ni che/ /skabs skabs su ma yengs pa'i 54

bya ra re mdzod/ /spyod pa yi bre ser 'brong rwa sngon ni khyod/ /blang dor med rdza ri de 'grim pa yi tshe/ /tshul 'chos kyi rbab rdo yis gsod las ni che/ /skabs skabs su ma yengs pa'i bya ra re mdzod/ /'bras bu yi ded dpon ni don 'grub kyi khyod/ /sku gsum gye nor bu'i gling bgrod pa yi tshe/ /re dogs kyi chu srin khar tshud las ni che/ /skabs skabs su ma yengs pa'i bya ra re mdzod/ /chos 'khor dbus sems nyid kyi khye'u chung gi zhal/ /mgrin pa yi rab dkar dung g.yas 'khyil la gtad/ /legs bshad kyi dbugs chen gyis bus pa yi sgra/ /thos tshad kyi 'gro ba la bkra shis par shog /ces pa 'di yang reb gong gru ba tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//na mo gu ru/ phyi'i gangs ri rgyun du brtan yang / /nang seng ge brtan rgyu ma byung / /phyi'i rdza ri rgyun du brtan yang / /nang 'brong mo brtan rgyu ma byung / /phyi'i nags tshal rgyun du brtan yang / /nang rgya stag brtan rgyu ma byung / /phyi'i sgyu lus mal du brtan yang / /nang sems nyid brtan rgyu ma byung / /zhes pa 'di yang nyin zhig rnam rtog sna tshogs 'phros tshe rang nyid la blangs nas/ yang de'i lan la 'di blangs/phyi'i gangs ri rgyun du brtan na/ /nang seng ge brtan rgyu med kyang / /kho 'gro ba bkag pas mi thub/ /seng song yang 55

gangs las gzhan du/ /mi 'gro ba'i mtshang de shes na/ /seng song ba gangs ri'i rgyan yin/ /phyi'i rdza ri rgyun du brtan na/ /nang 'brong mo brtan rgyu med kyang / /kho 'gro ba bkag pas mi thub/ /'brong song yang rdza las gzhan du/ /mi 'gro ba'i mtshang de shes na/ /'brong song ba rdza ri'i rgyan yin/ /phyi'i nags tshal rgyun du brtan na/ /nang rgya stag brtan rgyu med kyang / /kho 'gro ba bkag pas mi thub/ /stag song yang nags las gzhan du/ /mi 'gro ba'i mtshang de shes na/ /stag song ba nags tshal rgyan yin/ /phyi'i sgyu lus mal du brtan na/ /nang sems nyid brtan rgyu med kyang / /kho 'phro ba bkag pas mi thub/ /sems 'phro yang stong ba nyid las/ /mi g.yo ba'i mtshang de shes na/ /sems 'phro ba rig pa'i rgyan yin/ /zhes bshad do/ /yang 'di blangs/seng sngon chad gangs la 'gro bsdad mang / /kho 'gro ba bkag pas mi thub kyang / /thabs mkhas pas bzung na cis mi thub/ /lcags sra mo'i sgrog tu 'dzin rgyu yin/ /'brong sngon chad rdza la 'gro bsdad mang / /kho 'gro ba bkag pas mi thub kyang / /thabs mkhas pas bzung na cis mi thub/ /sna tsha snar blangs nas 'dogs rgyu yin/ /stag sngon chad nags la 'gro bsdad mang / /kho 'gro ba bkag pas mi thub kyang / /thabs mkhas 56

pas bzung na cis mi thub/ /lcags sgog gis ske nas 'dogs rgyu yin/ /sems sngon chad dran rgyu bsam rgyu mang / /kho 'phro ba bkag pas mi thub kyang / /dmigs rten gyi thabs kyis cis mi thub/ /zhi gnas kyi dmigs pas 'dzin rgyu yin/ /zhes blangs pas yang de'i lan la 'di blangs/e seng ge la lta rtog ma mang bar/ /gangs ri kho rgyun du brtan par gyes/ /seng ge de shugs kyis je dal 'gro/ /'gul med du nyal ba'i dus shig 'ong / /sra mo yi sgog tu 'dzin mi dgos/ /ha cang ni 'gro bsdad mang drags na/ /bsod zad kyi seng ge de nyid la/ /khyod zer de tshad tshad ran ran yin/ /'brong mo la lta rtog ma mang bar/ /rdza ri kho rgyun du brtan par gyes/ /'brong mo de shugs kyis je dal 'gro/ /'gul med du nyal ba'i dus shig 'ong / /tsha sna ru byas nas 'dogs mi dgos/ /ha cang ni 'gro bsdad mang drags na/ /bsod zad kyi 'brong mo de nyid la/ /khyod zer de tshad tshad ran ran yin/ /rgya stag la lta rtog ma mang bar/ /nags tshal kho rgyun du brtan par gyis/ /stag mo de shugs kyis je dal 'gro/ /'gul med du nyal ba'i dus shig 'ong / /lcags sgog gis ske nas 'dogs mi dgos/ /ha cang ni 'gro bsdad mang drags na/ /bsod zad kyi 57

rgya stag de nyid la/ /khyod zer de tshad tshad ran ran yin/ /'phro ba la brtag dpyad mi byed par/ /rig pa kho rgyun du brtan par gyis/ /'phro rgod de shugs kyis je nyung 'gro/ /rtog med du gnas pa'i dus shig 'ong / /zhi gnas kyi dmigs pas 'dzin mi dgos/ /ha cang ni 'phro rgod mang drags na/ /'chad med kyi 'gyu ba de nyid la/ /khyod zer de tshad tshad ran ran yin/ /zhes bshad pa/ 'di rnams ni bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la blangs pa'o//blo gros mchog mnga' blo bzang grags pa bzhin/ /shes bya'i gnas rnams shes nas gdul bya la/ /ston pa'i gsung rab ston mdzad pha rgan rje/ /bu yis 'bod do bu la rgyang nas gzigs/ /gang bzang bla ma mang bo'i zhabs bsten kyang / /gang la dad gus snying nas ma skyes pas/ /gang gi yon tan mi rtogs skyon la rtog /gang mdzad skyon mthong mkhan khyod smyos sam ci/ /phyi nas rnyed dka'i mi lus sdig la sbyar/ /phyi ma'i yul du lag stong 'gro nyen 'dug /phyin chad bde 'gro'i sgra yang thos mi 'gyur/ /phyi bshol mkhan khyod byad zas zos sam ci/ /'chi bas mi rnams bcom pa mthong bzhin du/ /'chi ba 'ong snyam med pa'i ngang ring bo/ /'chi khar brang dang lag pa 'thab nyen gda'/ /'chi ba mi dran khyod snying lcags sam ci/ /ngan song gsum gyi sdug 58

bsngal ya nga ba/ /ngan pa'i sdig pa'i las yin shes bzhin du/ /ngan 'gro der ltung rgyu rnams lhur len pa'i/ /ngan pa khyod kyi snying la gdon gang zhugs/ /kha zhe med pa'i blo gtad mi byed par/ /kha nas dkon mchog skyabs 'dzin blo ma khel/ /kha tsam tshig gi skyabs 'gros phan ma thogs/ /kha bshad mkhan khyod gshed kyis bzung ngam ci/ /las 'bras gnyis kyi rnam dbye go lags kyang / /dge sdig gnyis la spang blang mi byed par/ /nyin mtshan gnyis ka bag med bya bas 'da'/ /'di phyi gnyis med khyod snying rul lam ci/ /dug gsum dug lnga'i srin bus rab tu gang / /khams gsum mi gtsang 'dam na skyid med kyang / /sgo gsum shugs drag rtsal stobs rab bskyed nas/ /bslab gsum skam sar mi bsnyeg dgos pa ci/ /ma gyur nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam sems can rnams/ /ma rig dbang gyur sdug bsngal myong mthong yang / /ma rnams la ni phan 'dogs blo med pa'i/ /ma rabs khyod kyi sems sgo rub bam ci/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi spyod tshul lhur blangs nas/ /rgyal ba dgyes pa'i thabs la mi brtson par/ /rgyal khams bskor nas log 'tsho sgrub mkhan khyod/ /rgyal po be har gdon gyis ma spyos sam/ /bdag med yang dag lta ba'i gnas lugs de/ /yengs med nyin mtshan med par mi skyong 59

bar/ /tshar med rnam rtog mang bo'i spro bsdu mkhan/ /snying med po khyod snying la 'dre gang zhugs/ /gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs kyang / /gsang nas nyams su mi len bshad la dga'/ /gsang sngags gzhung bzhin dam tshig mi bsrung bar/ /gsang gtam khrom sgrog mkhan khyod ma 'khrul lam/ /chos kyi sgo ru zhugs nas yun ring yang / /chos sems gnyis ka rgyab 'gal so sor song / /chos pa'i gzugs bzung log spyod lkog tu byed/ /chos dzu mkhan khyod snying la ci zhig zhugs/ /bslu med skyabs gnas zla med bla ma rje/ /thogs med byon la tshad med mthu byin gyis/ /chos med bu ngan dbang med smyo ba'i gdon/ /lhag med btul nas rjes med da lta mdzod/ /ces pa 'di yang reb gong yul gyi glu ba kha bde tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang nyid la smras pa'o//'o 'o rgyal kun 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs/ /a'u dpal ldan bla ma yin ya/ /kho re spyi bo'i rgyan du zungs dang / /te he blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o 'khor 'das bde sdug myong gakhan/ /a'u rang sems 'di nyid yin ya/ /kho re sems kyi gzhi rtsa chod na/ /he te blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o blo kha nang du phyogs la/ /a'u phu g.yo mdo dkrug sems 'di/ /kho re da lta gar yod ltos dang / /he he blo bde 60

dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o bltas dus phung bo'i nang na/ /a'u sngar nas sems zhes tshugs se/ /kho re yod snyam blo la shar na/ /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi 'o 'o phung bo 'di yi nang na/ /a'u yod na sems phung gnyis ka /kho re gcig thad gang yin ltos dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o gcig dang tha dad gnyis las/ /a'u yod tshul gzhan zhig mi sred/ /kho re snyam du blo thag chod dang/ /te te blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o phung bo 'di dang gcig na/ /a'u phung bo bzhin du sems kyang / /kho re mang bor 'gyur tshul soms dang / /te he blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o mi gcig la ni sems mang / /a'u mi srid gcig tu ma grub/ /kho re snyam du blo thag chod dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o lus sems tha dad yin na/ /a'u phung rnams yid kyis bsal ba'i/ /kho re shul na yod dgos soms dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o phung bo lnga bo 'di dang / /a'u tha dad du yang ma grub/ /kho re snyam du blo thag chod dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o de ltar legs par dpyad mthar/ /a'u sems ni mi stong tsam min/ /kho re gtan nas 61

med snyam soms dang / /he ho blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o btsal nas ma rnyed stong gsal/ /a'u de nyid lta ba yin ya/ /kho re ngang du glod la skyongs dang/ /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o bag chags shog 'dril sngar bzhin/ /a'u phu g.yo mdo dkrug byed na/ /kho re gzhi rtsa chod la zhog dang / /te te blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o de las langs tshe gang shar/ /a'u sems kyi rol bar thag chod/ /kho re sgyu ma lta bur ltos dang / /te te blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o rdzogs pa chen po'i lta ba/ /a'u go ba tsam gyis mi chog /kho re chu bo'i rgyun bzhin sgoms dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o srid pa'i nad brgya sel ba'i/ /a'u sman mchog 'di nyid yin ya/ /kho re rgyang glu'i tshul du 'then dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /zhes pa 'di yang rje btsun skal ldan rgya mtsho'i gsung mgur gyi tshig ris dang mthun par reb gong glu ba kha bde tshogs drug rang grol gyis nyin zhig rang la ku re dang bzhad gad kyi tshul du sbyar ba'o//'e 'e bod yul mun sel nyi ma/ /a'o slob dpon pad 'byung yinaya/ /kho re snying nas gsol ba thobs dang / /e ma bde skyid nyi ma 'char ro/ /'e 'e mchog thun dngos grub 'byung 62

ba'i/ /a'o nor bu bla ma yin ya/ /kho re phyag mchod gsol ba thobs dang / /e ma bde skyid nyi ma 'char ro/ /'e 'e 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho sgol ba'i/ /a'o gru de lus 'di yin ya/ /kho re da lta pha rol sgol dang / /e ma bde skyid nyi ma 'char ro 'e 'e 'chi bdag gshin rje'i dmag dpung / /a'o nam 'ong cha med yin ya/ /kho re dge sbyor go mtshon thogs dang / /e ma bde skyid nyi ma 'char ro/ /'e 'e ngan song me 'obs nang du/ /a'o lhung na bzod par dka' ya/ /kho re dkon mchog skyabs su sten dang / /e ma bde skyid nyi ma 'char ro/ /'e 'e mi dge sdig pa'i dug chu/ /a'o 'thungs na bde ba med ya/ /kho re dge ba'i bdud rtsi thungs dang / /e ma bde skyid nyi ma 'char ro 'e 'e mi dge sdig lhung kha ba/ /a'o phyags shing stobs bzhi yin ya/ /kho re nyin re bzhin du phyogs dang / /e ma bde skyid nyi ma 'char ro/ /'e 'e 'khor ba'i mi gtsang 'dam na/ /a'o nam yang bde ba med ya/ /kho re zhen pa gting nas log dang / /e ma bde skyid nyi ma 'char ro/ /'e 'e thar ba'i rin chen gser gling / /a'o shin tu nyams re dga' ya/ /kho re bsnyeg pa'i grabs shom mdzod dang / /e ma bde skyid nyi ma 'char ro 'e 'e ngo mtshar gling du bgrod pa'i/ /a'o rta mchog bslab pa yin 63

ya/ /kho re rta de zhon la song dang / /e ma bde skyid nyi ma 'char ro/ /'e 'e 'khor ba'i btson rar tshud pa'i/ /a'o 'gro kun pha ma yin ya/ /kho re phan thabs snying la chongs dang / /e ma bde skyid nyi ma 'char ro/ /'e 'e phyin drug bsdu bzhi'i shing rtas/ /a'o rang gzhan bde sar bskyal ya/ /kho re shing rta 'di nyid sten dang / /e ma bde skyid nyi ma 'char ro/ /'e 'e gsang sngags gter mdzod gser sgo/ /a'o 'byed pa'i lde'u mig dbang yin/ /kho re 'byed mkhan bla mar zhus dang / /e ma bde skyid nyi ma 'char ro/ /'e 'e dngos grub lo legs 'khrungs pa'i/ /a'o sa gzhi dam tshig yin ya/ /kho re nyes ltung sad ser srungs dang / /e ma bde skyid nyi ma 'char ro/ /'e 'e skye shi bar do'i chom rkun/ /a'o shin tu ya re nga ya/ /kho re bskyed rdzogs mdung gis snun dang / /e ma bde skyid nyi ma 'char ro/ /'e 'e srid pa'i nad brgya sel ba'i/ /a'o sman mchog rdzogs chen yin ya/ /kho re sman bzang 'di nyid gsol dang / /e ma bde skyid nyi ma 'char ro/ /'e 'e mgur dbyangs snyan mo'i khu byug /a'o kun gye rna bar snyan ya/ /kho re dben pa'i shing rtser sgrogs dang / /e ma bde skyid nyi ma 'char ro/ /ces pa 'di yang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis dbeen pa'i dga' tshal du phyi lus bde nang sems la skyid pa'i nyi ma shar ba'i 64

shugs kyis kha nas gang dran smras pa'o//'o 'o ting 'dzin sgo brgya phye nas/ /a'u ngo mtshar ltad mo gzigs pa'i/ /kho re bla ma spyi bor sgoms dang / /he te blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o kha tsam tshig tsam min par/ /a'u snying khong rus pa'i gting nas/ /kho re shugs drag gsol ba thobs dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o mi 'dod sna dgu gtong ba'i/ /a'u nga bdag 'phung rgan 'di nyid/ /kho re 'dul ba'i gshom ra mdzod dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o mchog gsum dmag gi dpung bsdus/ /a'u sor rtog mdung ring thogs la/ /kho re 'phung rgan gar yod tshol dang / /he ho blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o nam yang nga nga zer ba'i/ /a'u 'phung rgan phyi ru ma 'tshol/ /kho re phung bo'i nang du tshol dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o btsal tshe phung bo 'di dang / /a'u lhan cig grub grub 'dra ba'i/ /kho re nyams shig rgyud la shar na/ /te he blo bde dpal yon e go /'o 'o nga bdag 'phung rgan de nyid/ /a'u phung bo 'di dang gcig gam/ /kho re tha dad gang yin ltos dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o phung bo 'di dang gcig na/ /a'u phung bo bzhin du 'phung rgan/ /kho re mang bor 'gyur tshul soms 65

dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o tha dad yin na phung rnams/ /a'u so sor bsal ba'i shul na/ /kho re 'phung rgan yod dgos soms dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o de ltar dpyad mthar 'phung rgan/ /a'u ming gis phar btags ma gtogs/ /kho re gtan nas med snyam soms dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o 'di bzhin mdung gis 'phung rgan/ /a'u snying du yang yang snun la/ /kho re chos dbyengs sa la skyol dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o 'phung rgan sdod sa'i khang ba/ /a'u mdung ring ba dan can gyis/ /kho re snun la rdul du rlogs dang / /te he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o nam yang nga yi lus zhes/ /a'u zer ba'i lus po 'di nyid/ /kho re rang bzhin e grub ltos dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o bltas tshe lus po sngar nas/ /a'u tshugs thub grub grub 'dra ba'i/ /kho re rnam pa blo la shar na/ /he te blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o de ltar grub pa'i lus 'di/ /a'u yan lag rnams dang gcig gam/ /kho re tha dad gang yin ltos dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o yan lag rnams dang gcig na/ /a'u yan lag bzhin du lus 'di/ /kho re du mar 'gyur tshul soms dang / /he he blo bde 66

dpal yin e go /'o 'o tha dad yin na yan lag /a'u bsal ba'i shul na lus zhig /kho re tshugs se yod dgos soms dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o de ltar dpyad mthar lus po/ /a'u ming tsam ma gtogs gtan nas/ /kho re ma grub snyam du soms dang / /he te blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o yan lag dang po'i mgo bo/ /a'u 'di nyid rang bzhin grub pa/ /kho re e 'dug legs par ltos dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o bltas tshe sngar nas mgo bo/ /a'u tshugs se grub grub 'dra ba'i/ /kho re rnam pa blo la shar na/ /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o de ltar grub pa'i mgo de/ /a'u kha sna rnams dang gcig gam/ /kho re tha dad gang yin ltos dang / /he te blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o kha sna rnams dang gcig na/ /a'u kha mig bzhin du mgo bo/ /kho re du mar 'gyur tshul soms dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o tha dad yin na kha sogs/ /a'u re re bsal ba'i shul na/ /kho re mgo zhig yod dgos soms dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o de ltar dpyad mthar mgo zhes/ /a'u ming steng tsam min gtan nas/ /kho re ma grub snyam du soms dang / /he te blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o nam yang nga yi sor mo/ /a'u zer 67

ba'i sor mo 'di nyid/ /kho re rang bzhin e grub ltos dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o bltas tshe sor mo sngar nas/ /a'u grub grub 'dra ba'i rnam pa/ /kho re yid la wal gyes shar na/ /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o de ltar grub pa'i sor mo/ /a'u mgo mjug rked phyi nang dang / /kho re gcig gam tha dad ltos dang/ /he te blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o gcig tu grub na mgo rked/ /a'u phyi nang cha shas mang bzhin/ /kho re mang bor 'gro tshul soms dang / /te he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o tha dad yin na de rnams/ /a'u so sor bsal ba'i shul na/ /kho re sor mo yod dgos soms dang/ /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o de ltar dpyad mthar sor mo/ a'u ming tsam ma gtogs gtan nas/ /kho re ma grub snyam du soms dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o yan lag nying lag gzhan la/ /a'u sngar bzhin mdung gis snun la/ /kho re rdul phran bzhin du rlogs dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o phyi rol yul gyi snang ba'i/ /a'u ri brag 'di rnams rang bzhin/ /kho re e grub legs par ltos dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o bltas tshe sngar nas tshugs se/ /a'u ri brag grub grub 'dra ba'i/ /kho re rnam pa blo la shar na/ /he he blo 68

bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o de ltar grub pa'i ri brag /a'u sa rdo rnams dang gcig gam/ /kho re tha dad gang yin ltos dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o sa rdo rnams dang gcig na/ /a'u sa rdo bzhin du ri brag /kho re mang bor 'gro tshul soms dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o tha dad yin na sa rdo/ /a'u re re bsal ba'i shul na/ /kho re ri zhig yod dgos soms dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o de ltar dpyad mthar ri brag /a'u ming gis phar btags ma gtogs/ /kho re gtan nas med snyam soms dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o sa yi rdul phran chung ngu / /a'u 'di nyid kho rang ngos nas/ /kho re rang bzhin grub bam ltos dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o bltas tshe sngar nas rdul zhes/ /a'u grub grub tshugs thub 'dra ba'i/ /kho re rnam pa blo la shar na/ /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o de ltar grub pa'i rdul de/ /a'u phyi nang steng 'og rnams dang / /kho re gcig thad gang yin ltos dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o gcig tu grub na phyi nang / /a'u bar dang steng 'og mang bzhin/ /kho re du mar 'gyur tshul soms dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o tha dad yin na de rnams/ /a'u so 69
