sor bsal ba'i shul na/ /kho re rdul zhig yod dgos soms dang / /te he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o de ltar dpyad mthar rdul zhes/ /a'u ming zhig btags tsam ma gtogs/ /kho re rang bzhin med snyam soms dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o snang grags chos rnams kun la/ /a'u sngar bzhin mdung gis phug la/ /kho re rdul phran bzhin du thongs dang / /te te blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o de ltar rdul du rlogs la/ /a'u ngos bzung ci yang med pa'i/ /kho re gnas lugs ltad mo ltos dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o med bzhin kun rdzob chos rnams/ /a'u ngo mtshar sna tshogs snang ba'i/ /kho re sgyu ma'i ltad mo ltos dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o snang la yod par ma grub/ /a'u stong la med par ma song / /kho re zung 'jug ltad mo ltos dang / /te he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o gzung 'dzin lho sprin smug po/ /a'u stong ba med par ma song / /kho re chos dbyings nam mkhar ltos dang / / he te blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o bdag 'dzin 'bri yi 'o ma/ /a'u sor rtog rkyal bar bskrogs la/ /kho re bdag med 'bri mar longs dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o stong nyid rta la zhon nas/ /a'u chos dbyebs thang la rgyug dus/ /kho 70

re lta mgur lcag gis brobs dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o lngon shing lo 'dab rgyas dus/ /a'u sngo ljang nags kyi khrod nas/ /kho re glu dbyangs lhang lhang 'then dang / /te he blo bde dpal yin e go /zhes pa 'di ni chos med ri la dga' ba'i chogs drug rang grol gyis bdag 'dzin la sen 'debs byas pa'i dus shig tu sems la gang dran rje btsun chen po skal ldan rgya mtsho'i gsung mgur byin rlabs can gyi tshig ris dang mthun par rang nyid la smras pa'o/ /byis pa'i kha nas ci smra ba/ /pha mas mtshar du 'dzin pa ltar/ /ban rgan gang dran lab pa la/ /mkhas pa'i thugs dgongs mi khrel zhu/ /'di nyid thos tshad kyis nga bdag 'phung rgan la ci thub kyis gnod pa skyel bar gyur ciga'o 'o gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan/ /a'u blo bzang grags pa yin ya/ /kho re gsol ba rgyun du thobs dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma/ /a'u bde legs rtsa ba yin ya/ /kho re bsam sbyor gnyis kyis sten dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o dal 'byor mi lus rin chen/ /a'u yang yang rnyed par dka' ya/ /kho re dam chos snying bo longs dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o thar med 'chi bdag pho nya/ /a'u glo bur myur du 'ong ya/ /kho re 'jig rten bya ba thongs dang / /71

te he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o ngan song sdug bsngal myong dgos/ /a'u byung na tshugs thabs med ya/ /kho re ske mur dong ltar ltos dang / /he te blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi yayi/ /'o 'o mi bzod sdug bsngal de las/ /a'u skyob mkhan dkon mchog yin ya/ /kho re snying nas skyabs 'gro gyis dang / /he te blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o sdig pas sdug bsngal 'byung zhing / /a'u dge bas bde skyid 'byung ya/ /kho re sdig spangs dge ba sgrubs dang / /te te blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o lam bzang sgrub la rnam smin/ /a'u brgyad ldan rten bzang dgos ya/ /kho re rgyu de da lta sgrubs dang / /te te blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o mi dge sdig ltung sngar bsags/ /a'u sbyong byed stobs bzhi yin ya/ /kho re nyin re bzhin du sbyongs dang / /te he blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o spyir ni khams gsum gnas na/ /a'u bde ba nam yang med ya/ /kho re nges 'byung skyo shas skyed dang / /te he blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o nges legs thar ba'i gnas su/ /a'u bgrod thabs bslab gsum yin ya/ /kho re rtag tu nan tan mdzod dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o khams gsum sems can thams cad/ /a'u 72

drin can pha ma yin ya/ /kho re kun la phan sems skyed dang / /te te blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o sbyin las longs spyod 'phel zhing / /a'u lha mis snyan pa brjod ya/ /kho re gang yod sbyin par thongs dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o tshul khrims mngon mtho nges legs/ /a'u bgrod pa'i them skas yin ya/ /kho re mig 'bras bzhin du srungs dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi 'o 'o bzod pas gzugs byad mdzes shing / /a'u kun gyi yid du 'ong ya/ /kho re khong khro tshig ngan sdoms dang / /he te blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o brtson 'grus le lo 'joms byed/ /a'u gang brtsams bya ba 'grub ya//kho re dge la brtson 'grus gyis dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o bsam gtan bying rgod dpung 'joms/ /a'u lus sems dga' bde bskyed ya/ /kho re rtse gcig bsam gtan sgoms dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi 'o 'o shes rab nga bdag 'phung rgan/ /a'u 'dul ba'i gnyen po yin ya/ /kho re stong nyid don la dpyod dang / /te te blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o gzhan rgyud smin byed thabs mchog /a'u bsdu ba rnam bzhi yin ya/ /kho re gnas 73

skabs lag len gyis dang / /te he blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o gsang sngags zab mo'i mjug sgo/ /a'u dbang bskur zab mo yin ya/ /kho re mtshan ldan bla mar zhus dang / /he te blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung ba/ /a'u dngos grub gzhi ma yin ya/ /kho re srog la bab kyang srungs dang / /te he blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob pa'i/ /a'u myur lam bskyed rdzogs yin ya/ /kho re tshul bzhin nyams su longs dang / /te te blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o mdo sngags 'o ma'i mar 'di/ /a'u blo bzang grags pas blangs ya/ /kho re 'di nyid rgyun du gsol dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o khu byug ca co sgrog dus/ /a'u mgur dbyangs 'jen na skyid ya/ /kho re sngo ljang khrod nas 'then dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /zhes pa 'di yang reb gong mun pa'i gling du dam chos sgon me sbar ba'i rje btsun skal ldan rgya mtsho'i gsung mgur gyi tshig ris dang mthun par reb gong smad kyi chos med glu la dga' ba'i tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//drin can chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /yod tshul brgyad kyi snyan pa'i glu zhig len/ /mi rtag klong na brtson 'grus bskul ma yod/ /dben pa'i klong na dga' bde'i gter kha 74

yod/ /dam chos klong na 'di phyi'i bde skyid yod/ /snying rus klong na nyams rtogs yon tan yod/ /sems bskyed klong na gzhan phan 'gro don yod/ /bskyed rdzogs klong na mchog thun dngos grub yod/ /stong nyid klong na sgyu ma'i ltad mo yod/ /thod rgal klong na lha yi zhing khams yod/ /yod tshul brgyad 'di nyams len snying bor zungs/ /chos med glu la dga' ba'i bya btang ngas/ /glu dbyangs 'di yang blangs so kun phan shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//na mo gu ru/ bka' drin gsum ldan pha rgan/ /ye shes spyan ldan khyed kyis/ /brtse bas gus ldan bu la/ /rgyang nas rgyun ldan gzigs shig /ba mos yang yang mnar ba'i/ /spang rgyan me tog smug pos/ /lang tsho kho bzhin 'gyur zhes/ /rnam 'gyur bstan nas gshegs thal/ /kha rlung grang bas gzir ba'i/ /ri thang rnams kyi rtswa yis/ /skra lo kho bzhin 'gyur zhes/ /rnam 'gyur bstan nas skya thal/ /nam zla ston gyis gtugs pa'i/ /rtsi shing 'bras bu'i tshogs kyis/ /so rnams kho bzhin ltung zhes/ /rnam 'gyur bstan nas lhung thal/ /skyi ser rlung gis bskyod pa'i/ /ljon shing lo ma'i tshogs kyis/ /mdza' bshes kho bzhin 'gyur zhes/ /rnam 'gyur bstan nas gyes thal/ /nyi ma 75

steng du bab pa'i/ /sdi shing mgo yi zil bas/ /nor rdzas kho bzhin 'gyur zhes/ /rnam 'gyur bstan nas bskams thal/ /nam zla dgun gyis gtugs pa'i/ /chu bya pho ma'i tshogs kyis/ /phyi mar kho bzhin 'gro zhes/ /rnam 'gyur bstan nas 'phur thal/ /mi med ri na kun gyis/ /mi rtag rnam 'gyur bstan byung / /mi khyod mi dge spongs la/ /mi tshe dge la gzhol cig /mgrin pa glu yi mdzod nas/ /skyo mgur gos 'di thon song / /gang gi rna ba'i mdzod khang / /sus bzhag sems la phan no/ /phyi rol dngos po rnams kyis/ /mi rtag rnam 'gyur bstan dus/ /de 'dra'i rgyang glu 'then mkhan/ /tshogs drug rang grol yin snang / /glu 'di thos tshad kun gyis/ /lo 'di gzhon pa'i dus su/ /tshe 'di blo yis btang nas/ /chos 'di bsgrub par smon no/ /zhes pa 'di yang 'khor ba las 'das shing / myang 'das kyi sa lam reg pa'i 'di med phyi med kyi sprang bos rang la smras pa'o//zab zab chos ston bla mar/ /dung dung snying nas 'dud do/ /legs legs 'grig 'grig glu dbyangs/ /lhang lhang yang yang len no/ /bla ma'i bka' drin soms la/ /ci gsung bka' bzhin sgrubs shig /dal 'byor rnyed dka' soms la/ /dal med rnam g.yeng ma byed/ /mi rtag 'chi ba soms la/ /mi dge 76

sdig pa spongs shig /dkar nag las 'bras soms la/ /dkar bo'i lha chos sgrubs shig /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs soms la/ /'khor dang longs spyod spongs shig /mtha' med 'gro kun don du/ /tshad med sems mchog skyed cig /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob phyir/ /rdzogs chen nyams su longs shig /dge sems bzang bo'i ngang nas/ /dge la rtag tu gzhol cig /thun 'gor sems bskyed gal che/ /thun mthar bsngo ba gyis shig /glu 'di sems la shar tshe/ /gtam 'di rang la phan phyir/ /lag pa gnyis kyi nam mkhar/ /pir snyug gnyis kyi sprin bsdus/ /dri med shog gu'i sa la/ /chad med yig char phab bo/ /zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//na mo gu ru/ thub bstan bstan 'dzin gyi gtso bo/ /ma lus lus can gyi skyabs gnas/ /ya mtshan mtshan ldan gye bla ma/ /byen rlabs rlabs chen gye char phobs/ /dang po'i zhal mjal gyi bla ma/ /rgas pa'i drin can gyi pha ma/ /dad can yon bdag ni pho mo/ /khyem mtshes g.yas g.yon gyi rgan rgon/ /kha sems mthun pa yi grogs rnams/ /la la shi bral ni byas song / /la la gson bral ni byas song / /tshul de zhib tu rang bsams tshe/ de dus spyod tshul tsho dran byung / /sems ni phyad phyod du gyur 77

cing / /mig sgo mchi ma yis gang nas/ /'i shi sngam pa zhig shor thal/ /rgas pa'i mtshan ma yis non song / /rang yang rtag sa ni med ki /yun ring sdod shom ni ma mdzad/ /rang sems cang shes kyi rta pho/ /bslab gsum sga srab glo 'jen nas/ /thar ba'i grong khyer ni nyams dga'/ /bsnyeg pa'i grabs shom ni mdzod cig /nyin rer skyo shas re dka' yang / /zla rer skyo shas re med na/ /skabs rer skyo mgur re 'then dang / /lan rer skyo ba re skye nges/ /zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//lha la lha yi rnga bzhin du/ /gang la gang 'dod chos gsung zhing / /'khor bar khor yug tu 'khyams pa'i/ /srid la srid pa'i bar brtse mdzad/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab kyi pha rgan/ /bung ba'i bu bzhin du skyongs shig /mkha' la lang long du 'khrigs pa'i/ /lho sprin smug po ni mthug kyang / /shugs drag rlung chen dang 'phrad dus/ /phyogs bcur gtor bar ni nges pas/ /da lta legs po ru 'khrigs dus/ /sbrang char 'jam po de phobs shig /'byung ba bzhi bo la g.yar ba'i/ /sha khrag lus po ni rgyas kyang / /'chi bdag bdud po yis zin dus/ /sgyu lus 'jig par ni nges pas/ /da lta rtsal stobs dang ldan dus/ /phyag skor sgrib sbyong la 'bungs shig /dbyar dus nam mkha' la 'phyo 78

ba'i/ /g.yu 'brug skad gseng ni mtho yang / /ring min sgra skad rnams nyams pa'i/ /dus de myur mo ru 'ong nges/ /da lta nam mkha' la 'phyo dus/ /gsung snyan legs po de sgogs shig /'jig rten chos brgyad kyi don du/ /chags sdang kha skad de mtho yang / /ring min mgrin pa yi lam nas/ /dbugs kyi 'gyu ba de 'chad nges/ /da lta smra lce rang bde dus/ /grags stong bzlas brjod la 'bungs shig /bsil zhing rnyog med kyi rdza chu/ /lhung lhung dbyar dus su 'bab kyang / /yun ring mi sdod par chu thigs/ /tsam yang lus med dus 'byung nges/ /da lta rgyun bzang ni 'bab dus/ /dal med chu chen la 'dres shig /rang bde gzhan dag la gnod pa'i/ /g.yo sgyu khram gsum de 'gyu yang / /yun ring mi sdod par bdag gzhan/ /ngos mi zin dus shig 'byung nges/ /da lta blo rig ni gsal dus/ /gang zab gdams pa rnams sgoms shig /spang ri ser bo yi ngos la me tog sna tshogs pa bkra yang / /dgun gsum kha rlung ni 'tshub dus/ /dbang med rdul phran bzhin 'gro nges/ /da lta mdangs bkrag rnams rgyas dus/ /dkon mchog mchod phyir du gshegs shig /tshe sngon bsod nams kyi stobs kyis/ /tshe 'dir longs spyod ni 'byor yang / /nam zhig gang zag gzhan rnams kyi/ /79

rdzas su 'gyur bar ni nges pas/ /da lta rang dbang ni yod dus/ /yar mchod mar sbyin ni gyis shig /ces pa 'di ni tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//na mo gu ru/ bde med bde ba la 'god pa'i/ /mgon med mgon skyabs kyi bla ma/ /mi 'bral mi nga'i mgor bzhugs la/ /rjes bzung rjes 'jug gi bu nga / /mi mthun mi 'dod pa'i nyer 'tshe/ /thams cad thams cad las skyobs shig /drod dang gsher ba gnyis nyams thal/ /kha bas rtse mo ni non song / /dbyar gyi dus tshod de dran byung / /'khyags nas ser kha rnams 'gas tshul/ /spang ri ser bo ngas bsams pas/ /skyo nas kha dog ni 'gyur ro/ /skye stobs bzang bo ni nyams thal/ /ba mos lus po ni non song / /sngo ljang dus tshod de dran byung / /khyem pas zor ba yis brnga tshul/ /lo yag snye ma ngas bsams pas/ skyo nas mgo bo thur gug go /lus kyi mdangs stobs ni nyams thal/ /skra dkar gnyer ma yis non song / /gzhon nu'i dus tshod de dran byung / /shi nas pha rol tu 'gro tshul/ /bya btang rnal 'byor ngas bsams pas/ /skyo nas mgur dbyangs 'di 'then no//zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//dkon mchog rnam gsum 'dus pa'i sku/ /bla ma rnams la 80

gus pas 'dud/ /dam tshig ldan zhing dam pa'i chos/ /snying nas sgrub la snying gtam smra/ /dang po chos kyi 'go la gsum/ /bla ma dkon mchog gsum po la/ /phyag mchod byed na chos 'go yin/ /'gro drug spyi la phan pa yi/ /sems bskyed byed na chos 'go yin/ /dge dang sdig pa gnyis ka la/ /spong len byed na chos 'go yin/ /'go bo rnyed pa'i chos la gsum/ /bla ma bzang bo rnyed pa na/ /chos kyi 'go bo rnyed pa yin/ /brgyud pa dag cing sel med na/ /chos kyi 'go bo rnyed pa yin/ /gdams ngag bar ma chad pa na/ /chos kyi 'go bo rnyed pa yin/ /rmang rdo thengs pa'i chos la gsum/ /dbang bo sgo lnga tshang ba dang / /rang dbang rang la thob pa na/ /chos kyi rmang rdo thengs pa yin/ /'gyur ldog med pa'i dad pa dang / /mi gzhi rab tu legs pa na/ /chos kyi rmang rdo thengs pa yin/ /nyon mongs rtogs pa chung ba dang / /shes pa chos la gsal ba na/ /chos kyi rmang rdo thengs pa yin/ /chos kyi rtsa ba brtan la gsum/ /'chi ba snying nas dran pa na/ /chos kyi rtsa ba brtan pa yin/ /mi dge sdig la 'jem pa na/ /chos kyi rtsa ba brtan pa yin/ /'khor ba'i sdig la sems sun na/ /chos kyi rtsa ba brtan pa yin/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i chos la gsum/ /snang srid dpe char shar ba na/ /byin gyis brlabs 81

pa'i chos ni yin/ /rnam rtog bla mar shar ba na/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i chos ni yin/ /snang ba grogs su shar ba na/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i chos ni yin/ /snying bo bsdus pa'i chos la gsum/ /ci byas chos su 'gro ba na/ /snying bo bsdus pa'i chos ni yin/ /ci bsam sgrub pa'i grogs 'gro na/ /snying bo bsdus pa'i chos ni yin/ /ci smras gzhan gyi don 'gyur na/ /snying bo bsdus pa'i chos ni yin/ /lam sna zin pa'i chos la gsum/ /snying rje ngang gis skye ba na/ /lam sna zin pa'i chos ni yin/ /snang ba sgyu mar shar ba na/ /lam sna zin pa'i chos ni yin/ /nyon mongs mgo bo non pa na/ /lam sna zin pa'i chos ni yin/ /brtan pa thob pa'i chos la gsum/ /'gro la byams stobs che ba na/ /brtan pa thob pa'i chos ni yin/ /snying rje 'dzin pa che ba na/ /brtan pa thob pa'i chos ni yin/ /dngos 'dzin mtshan ma zhig pa na/ /brtan pa thob pa'i chos ni yin/ /nyal bas chog pa'i chos la gsum/ /mtshan ldan bla ma mnyes byas nas/ /sems la g.yo sgyu med pa na/ /nyal bas chog pa'i chos ni yin/ /stong nyid snying rje'i snying bo can/ /bcos min rgyud la 'byongs pa na/ /nyal bas chog pa'i chos ni yin/ /tshogs gnyis mang bsags dge rtsa rnams/ /gzhan gyi don du bsngos pa na/ /nyal bas chog pa'i 82

chos ni yin/ /sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i chos la gsum/ /sbyar ba tshad med bzhi ldan na/ /sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i chos ni yin/ /dngos gzhi rmi lam ltar shes na/ /sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i chos ni yin/ /rjes su bsngo ba'i rgyas btab na/ /sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i chos ni yin/ /sum tshan bcu yi glu dbyangs 'di/ /rnal 'byor blo la shar nas blangs/ /dge 'dis khams gsum sems can rnams/ /mthar thug sku gsum thob par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//mgrin pa'i mkha' la chos kyi chu 'dzin 'khrigs/ /ro 'dzin glog 'khyug gsung dbyangs dbyar rnga sgrog /legs bshad sbrang char gdul bya'i 'dzin ma la/ /'bebs mkhas mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mi lus gtsang ma'i shel dkar bum bzang de/ /tshul khrims gtsang ma'i lha yi gos kyis g.yogs/ /nyams rtogs gtsang ma'i bdud rtsis yongs bkang nas/ /dam chos gtsang ma'i bdud rtsi 'gro la 'gyed/ /'chi bdag dmag dpung nam 'ong nges pa med/ /bag zon gyes la tshe 'dir ma chags par/ /ri khrod dben pa'i rdzong du myur bros nas/ /'chi brod dge sbyor go khrab mtshon cha thogs/ /mi dge sdig pa'i lag pas dmyal ba yi/ /khro chu khol ma'i zangs chen kha ma 'byed/ /83

dge ba'i lde'u mig snoms la mngon mtho yi/ /dkor mdzod sgo mo 'bye da la brtson par mdzod/ /'khor ba khab kyi rtse mor gang ltar du/ /bsdad kyang bde ba'i go skabs cung zad med/ /nges legs thar ba'i padma'i ze'u 'bru'i dbus/ /bsnyegs nas bde bar nyal ba'i grabs shom mdzod/ /las nyon rba klong mang bo drag tu 'khrugs/ /mi 'dod sdug bsngal chu srin mang bos gtses/ /srid pa'i rgya mtshor byeng ba'i 'gro ba rnams/ /myur du sgol ba'i thabs dgu snying la chongs/ /chos rnams stong bar rtogs pa'i shes rab gris/ /bdag 'dzin 'ching ba'i thag nag rtsad nas chod/ /mtha' bral chos dbyengs mal du shigs se sdod/ /skabs rer snang stong sgyu ma'i ltad mor ltos/ /'di las byung ba'i dge ba'i nyal 'gro yis/ /mthong thos blo gros pad dkar bskyed bsrings nas/ /dge sbyor dri ngad bzang bos khor yug gang / /lung rtogs yon tan bcud kyis gtams par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//lha mchog gsum ngo bo bla ma la/ /bdag sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnas khams gsum 'khyams pa'i rang gzhan la/ /mchog sku gsum go 'phang bstsal du gsol/ /rje mtshan ldan bla ma'i byen rlabs dang / /chos rdzogs pa chen po'i bka' 84

drin las/ /'bad rtsol ba cung zad ma byas kyang / /nga'i mgrin par glu yi gter kha brdol/ /kha zur gsum dung gi sgo mo nas/ /gzhan skal ldan gdul bya pho mo yi/ /rgyud nyams rtogs gter gyis 'gengs pa'i phyir/ /glu snyan mo'i dga' ston 'gyed kyis nyon/ /ngas phyi rol yul la phar bltas pas/ /mtho rgyal po'i rgyal srid man chad nas/ /dma' sprang bo'i 'khar ba yan chad rnams/ /dpe rmi lam sgyu ma'i 'khor lor 'dug /mdang nyal ba'i gnyid kyi rmi lam na/ /lho 'dzam gling yongs la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /ches mtho ba'i rgyal po'i rgyal srid thob/ /sems dga' skyid glu gar rtsed 'jo byas/ /snod rin chen gser gyi phor ba ru/ /bcud 'chi med bdud rtsi'i ro mchog myang / /yongs kun las nga skyid bsam tsa na/ /gnyid sad tshe de rnams gar song med/ /yang thun gcig nyal ba'i rmi lam na/ /rang sprang rgan bza' med gos med cig /shig sro mang khur chen lus la khur/ /rta lcang dkar ber ka dag la byas/ /srang bar na khye yis za la khad/ /nga'i sdug 'dra e yod bsam tsa na/ /gnyid sad ma thag tu gar song med/ /dpe de bzhin bde sdug dgra gnyen kun/ /snang cha rnams ma 'gags snang na yang / /kun rang bzhin ma grub bya ba'i gtam/ /yang dag pa'i ye shes snang ngo la/ /85

mnyam gzhag gi rig pa zang thal le/ /khyab gdal gyi chos dbyings yangs khrol le/ /'di rgyun chad med pa'i gtan yul yin/ /sems rnam rtog snga ma 'gag cing zhig /slar 'di byed bsam blo ma skyes pa'i/ /bar rig pa 'di yin med pa yi/ /sems wal le hrig ge ye re ba/ /'di smra bsam brjod med chos kyi sku/ /rje de gsum sangs rgyas dgongs pa yin/ /'di yengs med rgyun du skyong shes na/ /chos zab dgu'i snying bo 'di la 'dus/ /'dris drags pas phral du ngo ma shes/ /sla drags pas don la yid ma ches/ /zab drags pas kun gye blor ma shong / /don yin lugs thog tu khel ba dkon/ /chos mkhas mkhas grags pa med na yang / /sems ma bcos pa 'di skyong shes na/ /yar sangs rgyas nye lam yin nges gda'/ /sems bcos min skyong ba'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//bying rgod gnyis chos sku'i dbyings su yal/ /stong gsal gyi chos dbyings ngang nyid las/ /cung zad kyang g.yo ba ma mchis pa'i/ /pha rgan des bu la rgyang nas gzigs/ /sgye med kyi rang rig 'od gsal la/ /mnyam par ni bzhag dus bying rgod kyi/ /lam khyer ni 'di ltar byas na bzang / /blo rab kyis bying rgod shar ma thag /ngo shes shing 'bring gis shar nas kyang / /cung 86

zad ni song tshe ngo shes so/ /tha ma yis yun ring song nas shes/ /blo rab kyis byeng rgod gang shar yang / /dar seng la kha ba babs pa'am/ /glang chen la tsher ma zug pa ltar/ /bca' bcos ni mi bya stong gsal gyi/ /rig pa yi ngang du ras bal bzhin/ /rang sa ru glod nas bzhag pa'i tshe/ /sbrul mdud ni rang gis bshig pa bzhin/ /bying rgod gnyis rang grol 'gro ba yin/ /'di nyid ni byeng rgod lam 'khyer ba/ /rab yin no tshogs drug rang grol ba/ /blo 'bring gis bying rgod gang byung yang / /ngo bo la cer gyis bltas pa'i tshe/ /mtsho chen la kha ba babs pa bzhin/ /stong nyid du lam lam 'gro ba yin/ /de nyid kyi ngang du bal 'jam la/ /chu btab bzhin lhod kyis glod la zhog /'di nyid ni bying rgod lam 'khyer ba/ /'bring yin no tshogs drug rang grol ba/ /tha ma yis rnam rtog ngo yis gzung / /byung gnas dang 'gro sogs rtsad bcad de/ /gang nas kyang byung ba'i sa med cing / /bar du yang 'di na gnas zhes med/ /tha mar yang 'dir song bya ba med/ /chab rom ni rim gyis chur zhu ltar/ /stong sangs kyi sngar gye rang rig gi /'od gsal gyi steng du phyam gyis 'gro/ /de nyid kyi ngang du lhod kyis glod/ /ma yengs par dran pa rgyun du skyongs/ /'di nyid ni bying rgod lam 'khye ra 87

ba/ /tha ma yin tshogs drug rang grol ba/ /'di gsum ni rang gi blo tshod dang / /sbyar nas kyang rim gyis bying rgod gnyis/ /lam du ni khyer na shin tu legs/ /dang po nas dbang bo yang rab bzhin/ /byeng rgod gnyis lam du 'khyer ba dka'/ /de ltar du byas kyang sdug btsir dang / /lung ma ni bstan du lus nyen yod/ /'od gsal la cung zad brtan thob tshe/ /blo rab kyi rnam rtog lam 'khyer bzhin/ /byas na yang sla zhing shin tu legs/ /'di sbyar gye bsod nams dri bzhon gyis/ /bying rgod sprin rang sar dag nas kyang / /'od gsal gyi nyi ma sgrib med shar/ /nyams rtogs kyi pad tshal bzhad par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang gzhan la phan phyir lhag bsam dag pas bris pa'o//'khor 'das chos rmi lam ji bzhin du sems kyi/ /rol pa ru rtogs shing sems nyid ni dngos med/ /chos sku ru rtogs pa'i chos dbyengs kyi ngang las/ /'jug ldang gi spros pa ma lus pa nub pa'i/ /drin can gyi bla ma chos rgyal la 'dud do/ /phyi rol gyi yul la phar la rang ltos dang / /'di rnams ni dang po gang las ni byung dang / /gang du ni gnas dang gang du ni 'gro sogs/ /legs pa ru dpyod dang nam mkha' yi sprin rnams/ /nam mkha' las byung zhing nam mkha' yi ngang nas/ /slar yang 88

ni nam mkha'i dbyengs su kho 'gro bzhin/ /snang grags kyi chos rnams sems nyid las byung zhing / /sems nyid kyi ngang nas slar yang ni sems kyi/ /dbyings su ni 'gro ba'i rang mtshang de rtog go /de ltar du rtogs dus snang ba yi mtshan nyid/ /rang bzhin gyis e grub legs par ni ltos dang / /dper na ni rmi lam skyes bu ni ji bzhin/ /gzung yul gye chos rnams mngon sum du snang yang / /rang bzhin gyis ma grub rmi lam ltar thag chod/ /rmi lam ltar yin snyam thag chod kyi nges shes/ /bzang bo de rnyed dus phyi rol gyi yul la/ /'di rnams ni 'di zhes 'dzin byed kyi nang gi /sems nyid la ltos dang bar snang la skyi ser/ /rlung bo ni yal bzhin 'dzin byed kyi shes pa/ /stong yal du 'gro bas rang bzhin gyis ma grub/ /thag chod kyi nges shes bzang bo de rnyed dus/ /stong ba nyid de la mtha' dbus ni e 'dug /legs po byas ltos dang mtha' dbus dang bral lo/ /mtha' dbus dang bral bar rtogs dus su phyi nang / /e 'dug ni ltos dang phyi nang dang bral lo/ /phyi nang ni med par rtogs dus su 'gro 'ong / /e 'dug ni ltos dang 'gro 'ong dang bral lo/ /'gro 'ong kyang med par legs par ni rtogs dus/ /de rnams la lta mkhan kho rang la ltos dang / /gzung 'dzin gye smag rum mthug po de 89

sangs nas/ /stong gsal gyi rang rig 'od gsal ba chos sku/ /khyab gdal gyi nam mkha' yangs pa de ldang ngo / /de nyid kyi ngang du rang sangs du phyal le/ /brten med du ye re zang thal du lhag ge /bden med du bun ne rtsa bral du khres se/ /stong nyid du rjen ne dga' 'dzum me shigs se/ /dpyad pa'i lus lhod la bde mo ru gzims shig /rnam rtog gi 'gyu bas sad pa'i 'go rtsom tshe/ /yid dpyod kyis ma 'phag sngar bzhin du gzims shig /gzims pa las bzhengs tshe snang grags gyi chos rnams/ /sems las ni gzhan du ma grub par thag bcad/ /sgyu ma ru blta zhing sgyu ma mkhan rta glang / /sprul ba ni ji bzhin bsgyed rdzogs dang tshogs bsags/ /sgrub sbyong la 'bod la bsngo smon yang mdzod dang / /bde skyid kyi nyi ma snying dbus su 'char jo glu dbyangs 'di thos tshad skye 'gro ni gang yin/ /'od gsal gye bdud rtsis ra ro ru myos shing / /gzung 'dzin gye gcong nad lus med du sangs te/ /chos dbyings kyi zhing khams yangs po ru song nas/ /gzugs sku yi bro gar sna tshogs pa byed bzhin/ /legs bshad kyi glu dbyangs 'then pa ru smon no/ /zhes pa 'di yang reb gong gi glu ba gtad med spyon pa gu yangs yan pa blo bde stong nyid kyi chang gis ra ro nas/chos dbyings kyi mal du bsdad de gang shar gyi bzi gtam gcig pur smras pa'o//90

bsam pa dag pas bye dor byas/ /spyi gtsug rgyal mtshan rtser bskyon nas/ /phyag byas mchod cing gsol btab na/ /ci 'dod re ba skong mdzad pa'i/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin po che/ /'dren mchog chos rgyal zhabs la 'dud/ /nga glu ba bzang bo ma yin yang / /drin can mtshan ldan bla mar mjal/ /ma nor zab mo'i gdams pa thob/ /de phyir rang gis go rtogs pa'i/ /gnas lugs don gye glu zhig len/ /skal ldan las 'phro can tsho nyon/ /rang rig chos sku'i nam mkha' nas/ /'khor 'das 'ja' sprin ci snang yang / /byung yang rang rig mkha' las byung / /gnas kyang rang rig mkha' la gnas/ /thim yang rang rig mkha' la thim/ /gzhan du cung zad ma g.yos go /rang rig chos sku'i sa gzhi nas/ /'khor 'das rtsi shing ci skyes kyang / /byung yang rang rig sa las byung / /gnas kyang rang rig sa la gnas/ /thim yang rang rig sa la thim/ /gzhan du cung zad ma g.yos go /rang rig chos sku'i rgya mtsho las/ /'khor 'das rba rlabs ci shar yang / /byung yang rang rig mtsho las byung / /gnas kyang rang rig mtsho la gnas/ /thim yeng rang rig mtsho la thim/ /gzhan du cung zad ma g.yos go /rmi lam skabs kyi bde sdug gnyis/ /gnyid las gzhan du ma g.yos 91

bzhin/ /'khor 'das bde sdug rang rig las/ /gzhan du cung zad ma g.yos rtogs/ /rang rig chos sku'i klong chen du/ /'khor 'das chos rnams 'ubs chud pas/ /gzhi yi rig pa chos sku las/ /gzhan du cung zad ma g.yos rtogs/ /da lta'i snang grags chos rnams kun/ /ma rtogs pa la 'khor bar snang / /bya btang gu yangs blo bde ngas/ /gang snang sgyu ma lta bur rtogs/ /mthar thug shel 'od nang nub ltar/ /gzhi snang 'khor 'das chos skur dag /gzhi yi chos sku mngon gyur tshe/ /don gyi 'bras bu thob par rtogs/ /chos sku de las ma g.yos bzhin/ /gang la gang 'dul gzugs sku 'gyed/ /'gro don 'khor ba ma stongs bar/ /rgyun chad med par mdzad par rtogs//ngas lta ba'i rang sa zin pa'i tshe/ /phyogs dang ris su ma chad par/ /dper na ci 'dra zer tsa na/ /khyab gdal nam mkha' yangs pa 'dra/ /phyogs ris med pa'i rnal 'byor bde/ /ngas sgom pa'i rang sa 'dzin pa'i tshe/ /gsal zhing 'grib pa med pa de/ /dper na ci 'dra zer tsa na/ /'dzam gling nyi ma shar ba 'dra/ /gsal 'grib med pa'i rnal 'byor bde/ /ngas spyod pa'i rang sa zin pa'i tshe/ /'di yin ngos bzung med pa de/ /dper na ci 'dra zer tsa na/ /bar snang skyi ser rlung bo 'dra/ /92

ngos bzung med pa'i rnal 'byor bde/ /ngas 'bras bu'i rang sa zin pa'i tshe/ /dper na ci 'dra zer tsa na/ /rin chen gser gyi gling phyin 'dra/ /blang dor bral ba'i rnal 'byor bde/ /phyin chad skal ldan las 'phro can/ /lta ba nam mkha' gos su gyon/ /sgom pa nyi zla phrag la khur/ /spyod pa skyi ser rlung la zhon/ /'bras bu rin chen gser gling sdod/ /bla ma dam pa'i sras po ngas /nyams glu len na 'di 'dra len/ /phyi rabs rjes 'jug ras pa tsho/ /nyams mgur 'then na 'di 'dra 'then/ /chos nyid chang gis bzi ba yin/ /rnal 'byor bzi gtam byas pa yin/ /snang ba dpe ru bkod pa yin/ /nyams myong glu ru blangs pa yin/ /gdams ngag kha ru bton pa yin/ /rang don chos sku rtogs pa yin/ /gzhan don gzugs sku 'byung ba yin/ /ci bsam lhun gyis grub pa yin/ /da ni skyid nyal byed pa yin/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin yin/ /e ma ya mtshan skal ba bzang 'di thos 'khor ba las grol shog /'di bton mtshams med lnga byang shog /'di bsgoms chos sku myur thob shog /'di reg mthar thug sangs rgyas shog /ces pa 'di yang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis snang ba ban bun gyi ngang nas gang dran lhug par smras pa'o//khyab gdal chos dbyings ngang nyid las/ /ldang 'jug spros 93

pa kun nub pa'i/ /pha rgan chos kyi rgyal po la/ /gnyis su med par gus phyag 'tshal/ /mtha' bral chos sku'i don rtogs pa'i/ /snang stong sgyu ma'i zlos gar mkhan/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /grag stong rdo rje'i glu zhig len/ /bskal brgyar bsod nams bsags pa'i mi/ /skal ldan las kyi 'phro can gyis/ /ma yengs tshig la legs par nyon/ /don de snying gi dkyil du chongs/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs kyi bcud/ /mkhas grub du ma'i lta ba'i phugs/ /mdo rgyud man ngag snying bo'i don/ /ban rgan nyams len don snying 'di/ /snang srid 'khor 'das bsdus pa'i chos/ /nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon ji bzhin du/ /thams cad sems kyi rol ba yin/ /sems nyid dper na nam mkha' ni/ /stong gsal mtha' dbus med pa bzhin/ /dbyibs dang kha dog la sogs pa'i/ /dngos po med pas stong zhing gsal/ /ya ki rgyal ba'i zhing khams nas/ /ma ki dmyal ba yan chad la/ /mtha' dbus med par khyab gdal yin/ /stong gsal khyab gdal klong yangs de/ /skye 'gag gnas med chos sku yin/ /chos sku de ni blo 'das yin/ /blo 'das de ni byar med yin/ /byar med ngang la glod la zhog /zhog ces bya ba tshig yin gyi/ /tshig gi 'dzin pa bor la thongs/ /thongs zhes bya ba blo yin gyi/ /94

blo yis byed pa dbyings su sbos/ /sted ces bya ba'ang bzang rtog yin/ /bzang ngan rtog med phyad de ba/ /gab sbas med par lhung nge ba/ /'gro 'ong med par sa le ba/ /blang dor med par lhug ge ba/ /phyogs ris med par phyal le ba/ /btang bzung med par lhan ne ba/ /gsal 'grib med par trig ge ba/ /phyi nang med par thal le ba/ /brjed yengs med par thu re ba/ /btang bzhag med par wal le ba/ /blo las 'das pa'i yul la ltos/ /tshig las 'das pa'i don la ltos/ /bzang ngan med pa'i dbyings la ltos/ /phyi nang med pa'i sems la ltos/ /bltas pas mthong ba'i yul med kyi/ /ma bltas bzhag pas chos sku mthong / /ma bsgrubs bzhag pas sems nyid 'grub/ /ma bzung lhod pas rang sa zin/ /sna tshogs shar ba'i rang bzhin la/ /sna tshogs 'gags pa med par shog /sna tshogs 'dzin pa med par shog /sna tshogs spang blang med par shog /sna tshogs 'dzin bral chos sku yin/ /ma 'gags gsal ba longs sku yin/ /sna tshogs shar ba sprul sku yin/ /thams cad sems kyi rang bzhin yin/ /rang snang gzhi med stong ba yin/ /snang stong zung 'jug yangs pa yin/ /bsgom rgyu med pas bsam rgyu med/ /bzhag rgyu med pas gtang rgyu med/ /ting nge 'dzin la thun mtshams 95

med/ /de ltar mthong ba'i gang zag la/ /sems nyid chos sku'i mkha' dbyings su/ /thams cad zung 'jug yangs pa yin/ /snang dang stong ba zung 'jug yin/ /grags dang stong ba zung 'jug yin/ /bde dang stong ba zung 'jug yin/ /sems nyid chos sku'i mkha' dbyengs su/ /thams cad tha dad med par gcig /sangs rgyas sems can 'dres pas gcig /kun rdzob don dam 'dres pas gcig /'di dang phyi ma 'dres pas gcig /sems nyid chos sku'i mkha' dbyengs su/ /thams cad bzang ngan med par mnyam/ /'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa mnyam/ /gser dngul sa dang rdo la mnyam/ /dge ba dang ni sdig pa mnyam/ /sems nyid chos sku'i mkha' dbyings su/ /thams cad mi ngan thams cad bzang / /'khor 'das snang srid thams cad bzang / /sdug bsngal bde ba thams cad bzang / /dgra gnyen bar ma thams cad bzang / /sems nyid chos sku khyab gdal la/ /'gro dang 'ong ba gnyis su med/ /chos sku thig le nyag gcig la/ /sa lam mang bo bgrod rgyu med/ /'bras bu chos sku lhun grub la/ /dge dang sdig pas bcos su med/ /de ltar rtogs pa'i gang zag gis/ /sdug bsngal mi mthong bde bar mthong / /'khor ba mi mthong 'das par mthong / /sems can 96

mi mthong sangs rgyas mthong / /de ltar skyong ba'i skal ldan tsho/ /lta ba la ni phyogs ris med/ /nam mkha' yangs pa gos su gyon/ /sgom pa la ni gsal 'grib med/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lag tu thogs/ /spyod pa la ni ngos bzung med/ /bar snang skyi ser rlung la zhon/ /'bras bu la ni blang dor med/ /rin chen gser gye gling du sdod/ /de lta bu yi gang zag gis/ /bskyed rim bsgoms na snod bcud gnyis/ /gzhal yas khang dang lha ru sgyur/ /rdzogs rim dran na gnyis 'dzin gyi/ /mtshan ma thams cad bshig la zhog /zung 'brel 'dod na bar snang gi /'ja' tshon bzhin du snang stong sgoms/ /chos spyod byed na rang 'dod kyi/ /zhen pa thams cad spongs la gyes/ /mi 'jigs go cha gyon 'dod na/ /sgo gsum yi dam lha ru sgyur/ /gzhan don rlabs chen mdzad 'dod na/ /'gro la phan pa'i sems bskyed mdzod/ /rang don bsgrub na 'du 'dzi spongs/ /dgra bgegs 'dul na snying rje skyed/ /'jig rten phyi mar bde 'dod na/ /da lta dka' ba sna tshogs spyod/ /'gro kun dbang du sdud 'dod na/ /bdag pas gzhan ni gces par zungs/ /skyid snyoms ngang la lus pa na/ /nam 'chi cha med yang yang sgoms/ /chags zhen 'dzin pa byung ba na/ /rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur ltos/ /bar chad bdud kyis 97

bred pa na/ /rang gi sems nyid gtan la phobs/ /chos bzhin byed na chos min gyi/ /bya ba thams cad dug bzhin spongs/ /dge 'di rang sems nor bu la/ /dgos 'dod 'byung bar ma shes par/ /dngos grub gzhan du re ba'i mis/ /rang ngo shes pa'i phyir du bsngo/ /zhes pa 'di yang sems nyid mkha' ltar yangs pa'i bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang gis rtogs pa 'di bzhin gzhan gyis rtogs na ci ma rung snyam nas lhag bsam dag pas/ dpal kun tu bzang bo'i dgongs pa chos sku nyag gcig 'dzub mo btsugs nas bstan pa'o/ /'dis kyang phan pa dpag tu med pa thogs par gyur cig/a bo shes rab ras chung / /chos dbyengs na chung mjes mar/ /'khrig tshig 'di bzhin shod dang / /mdzes pa'i bzhin ras ston no/ /rtsed 'jo byed pa'i sems nyid/ /khye'u chung 'di nyid dang po/ /su yi mngal nas 'ong ang / /gzhon nu ma khyod e shes/ /bar du su yi rtse grogs/ /tha ma dgong kha nyal dus/ /su yi rum na nyal ba/ /bu mo e shes smros dang / /mo yang chags pa rgyas te/ /de nas stong gsal bzhin ras/ /ras pa khyod la bstan dus/ /dus der lhan cig nyol zhig /byeng rgod tshig ngan smras na/ /g.yag 'drog byas nas mi 'dug /dran shes kha byams tshig byams/ /gyis la 'bral med 'grogs dang / /brtse gdung je bzang je bzang / /gtsigs mi 'ong na sngar bzhin/ /'khrig tshig smra ba ma gtogs/ /rgyun du stong gsal chos sku'i/ /bde ba'i ro 98

mchog bzhag nas/ /'khrig tshig ro la ma dga'/ /de yis ro zhig byed ang / /bde ba'i ro de myong zhig /nyin dang mtshan mo gnyis ka /je thung je thung song nas/ /gar song mi shes byung na/ /gtsigs ni 'ong ba'i rtags yin/ /de las langs tshe sgyu ma'i/ /rtsed mo sna tshogs byed bzhin/ /tshogs bsags bza' btung bcud can/ /lto 'grang bar du zo zhig /lhan cig nyal dang bza' btung / /gnyis ka bsten res gyis dang / /de 'dra'i skyid dga' longs spyod/ /'dzam bu'i gling na med do/ /nam zhig chos gzugs gnyis kyi/ /bu dang bu mo btsas 'ong ring bor mi thogs pha shul/ /bu dang bu mos zin no/ /lta bas mi ngoms bu mo/ /mo bzang de la mi 'grog /'grog ya med par bza' btung / /btung yang ya mtshan mi che/ /bza' btung zhim po bsten nas/ /skam bshad rkyang ba byed bzhin/ /'grog ya bu mo med par/ /pho yugs gcig pur ma 'dug /na so gzhon pa'i dus nas/ /na 'chi med pa'i bu mo/ /na chung mdzes mar 'grogs dang / /na rgas gtugs rung mi 'gyod/ /ces pa 'di yang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la nyin zhig rtse mtshar du sbyar ba'o//drin can gyi bla ma/ /chos rgyal gye zhabs la/ /lan gcig ni min par//yang yang du 'dud do/ /mdo med kyi sprang bo/ /tshogs 99

drug gi rang grol/ /sngon sbyangs kyi las 'phro/ /cung zad cig yod snang / /o rgyan gyi rgyal tshab/ /chos rgyal dang mjal zhing / /nyams rtogs kyi bdud rtsi/ /snying bum du phab pas/ /tshogs chen gyi lta ba/ /'khrul med de rtogs so/ /brag phug tu snying bo'i/ /sgrub pa la gzhol bas/ /'bad rtsol la ma ltos/ /lhod grol la langs thal/ /snang grags kyi chos rnams/ /dpe cha ru shar zhing / /mgrin pa 'di gdams pa'i/ /bang mdzod du 'dug go /dpe mang la ha cang / /mang bo ni ma ltos/ /rang byung gi rig pa'i/ /gsang mdzod ni brdol zhing / /byeng rmugs dang 'phro rgod/ /gtan med du sangs nas/ /rig pa la gsal 'grib/ /med pa 'di skyid do/ /'od gsal gye ngang la/ /nyin mtshan kun shor thal/ /rdzogs chen khos bslus 'ong / /bsam pa ni mi 'dug /de phyir na gzhan rnams/ /dge ba la bskul phyir/ /mgur dbyangs kyi pho nya/ /so so ru mngags so/ /legs bshad 'di thos tshad/ /thams cad la phan nas/ /ri khrod du sgrub la/ /yengs med du gzhol nas/ /sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang / /myur ba ru thob shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//skal ba dang ldan bdag cag skyabs/ /skyabs gnas mtshan ldan pha bla ma/ /ma ltar byams ldan rgyal rnams sras/ /sras la 100

dad ldan bdag phyag 'tshal/ /dal ba brgyad tshang bstan dang mjal/ /mjal ba rab dkar bla mar 'phrad/ /'phrad par dka' bsam bka' gdams rnams/ /rnam par thar ba bskyangs na bzang / /mkha' la rang shar 'ja' ltar yang / /yang dag rang bza' mdza' ba rnams/ /rnams las rang yang rtag gnas dka'/ /dka' bsam rang cag ma chags bzang / /dkar nag las la spang blang bya/ /bya ngan las rnams mtha' dag spangs/ /spangs nas las dkar bzang la 'bad/ /'bad na las dkar rang phan bzang / /dmyal gnas yan chad tshangs dbang lha/ /lha gnas man la gnas bzang gang / /gang gnas na yang bzang dag dka'/ /dka' gnas rnams las thar ba bzang / /ma dag gnas la 'khyams tshad ma/ /ma rnams rang la gang phan byas/ /byas pa dran la gzhan rnams yang / /yang dag sa la bzhag bsam bzang / /dpyad nas lta ba ngan pa spangs/ /spangs nas lta ba rnam dag btsal/ /btsal nas lta ba mnyam par bzhag /bzhag nas lta ba brtan na bzang / /bla ma rang las bzang ba btsal/ /btsal nas rang cag zab dbang nyan/ /nyan nas rang dgar ma bshad gsang / /gsang sngags rang nyams blang na bzang / /rgyal khams gnas la bzang ngan 101

mang / /mang yang gnas ngan thams cad spangs/ /spangs nas gnas bzang gang dgar yang / /yang dag gnas la man ngag bzang / /bya btang byams pa bya ba ngas/ /rang la phan snyam rang gtam byas/ /blangs tshad mtshar dbyangs blangs pa las/ /rnam mang rang gzhan rnams sangs rgyas/ /'jam dbyangs rab dkar dbyangs can mas/ /tshangs dbyangs grag ltar dbyangs snyan gtam/ /bya mkhan byams pa bya ba ngas/ /bya dka' zhal gdams byas pa lags/ /a'o 'a 'ur 'du 'dzi spong la/ /kho re a ti rdzogs chen sgoms shig /o lags so/ /e ya ya/ /a'o sha rkyang ri dwags gnas pa'i/ /kho re sa phyogs dben par song dang / /o lags so/ /e ya ya/ /a'o ma shi bar du bsgom dgos/ /kho re ha cang sgom yun ma thung/ /o lags so/ /e ya ya/ /a'o tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms dang / /kho re nyams dang rtogs pa 'char ro/ /o lags so/ /e ya ya/ /zhes pa 'di ni rdzogs chen rgyud 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi'i snying bo dang sbyar nas rang la rtse mtshar du blangs pa'o//'o 'o drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma/ /a'u dngos grub gter mdzod yin ya/ /kho re zhabs la gus pas thud dang / /he he legs tshogs 'byung ngo e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o ri khrod dben 102

pa'i dga' tshal/ /a'u bya btang sdod sa yin ya/ /kho re rtag tu tshul bzhin sten dang / /he he don gnyis 'grub pa e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o rgod po lding ba'i brag na/ /a'u rang byung sgrub phug yod ya/ /kho re de 'dra'i grub gnas sten dang / /he he nyams rtogs 'char ro e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o smug pa can gye ri na/ /a'u rab mjes phug pa yod ya/ /kho re de 'dra'i ri ngogs sten dang / /he he 'phral phugs skyid do e go /ya yi ya yi 'o 'o rab dkar gangs ri'i mgul na/ /a'u ngo mtshar phug pa yod ya/ /kho re de 'dra'i gangs khrod sten dang / /he he rig pa gsal lo e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o sngo ljang nags kyi khrod na/ /a'u ljon shing bsil khang yod ya/ /kho re de 'dra'i nags tshal sten dang / /he he snang ba spro'o e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o rdza ri khra mo'i khrod na/ /a'u mgo ris phug pa yod ya/ /kho re de 'dra'i rdza khrod sten dang / /he he ci bsam 'grub bo e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o g.ya' ri sngon po'i skyibs na/ /a'u yid 'ong rdo khang yod ya/ /kho re de 'dra'i g.ya' khrod sten dang / /he he ngang gis bde'o e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o dwangs gsal mtsho yi ngogs na/ /a'u skad snyan chu bya grag ya/ /kho re de 'dra'i mtsho gling sten dang / /he he rgyun du spro'o e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o bya 103

dang ri dwags sna tshogs/ /a'u yul dga'i ltad mo yod ya/ /kho re de 'dra'i grogs por 'grogs dang / /he te dga' spro 'phel lo e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o zwa dang shing thog sogs kyi/ /a'u dbyar gyi dga' ston mod ya/ /kho re de 'dra'i zas gtsang sten dang / /he he ngo mtshar che'o e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o bya btang rnal 'byor skyo grogs/ /a'u snyan pa'i mgur dbyangs yin ya/ /kho re gcig pur rgyang nas 'then dang / /he he nam yang skyid do e go /ya yi yayi/ /zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis dben pa la dga' ba'i shugs kyis rang nyid la smras pa'o//gnas dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams dga' ru/ /chos bshad sgrub thub bstan rgyal mtshan de/ /'bad brtson pa'i phyag gis bsgreng mdzad pa'i/ /khong mkhas grub yongs kyi zhabs la 'dud/ /yul pha yul bdud kyi btson khang na/ /gti mug gi mun pa rab tu nag /'dod chags kyi mi gtsang 'dam rdzab che/ /zhe sdang gi dug tsher shin tu rtsub/ /grogs chung ma'i btson srung snying rje med/ /gtan chags sdang dgra skad rgyun chad med/ /sdug bsngal gyi chad pa bzod glags med/ /sems nam yang bde ba'i go skabs med/ /sngon byon pa'i mi la yab sras dang / /yul reb gong mun sel skal ldan bzhin/ /da ma 'dug ma 'dug myur du 104

phros/ /yul pha yul btson ra rgyab tu zhog /btson bsrung gi bu mor ltag pa ston/ /gnas dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams dgar phros/ /sngon rgyal bas byang chub brnyes pa'i sa/ /khong mkhas grub mang bo bzhugs pa'i shul/ /ya mtshan pa'i dben pa'i ri ngogs na/ /ngo mtshar ba'i ltad mo sna tshogs yod/ /yar steng na lho sprin lang ma ling / /mar 'og na chu gtsang gya ma gyu/ /bar thad na rtsi shing ban ma bun/ /bya sna tshogs skad snyan kyu ru ru/ /rkang drug ldan glu len di ri ri/ /bya rgod po'i gshog rtsal sgo ro ro/ /sha ri dwags mang bo sha ra ra/ /de lta bu'i gnas su phyin pa na/ /khyem bza' tshang skyong rgyu med pas bde/ /kha mi sos dogs pa med pas bde/ /rgyab mi khebs sems khur med pas bde/ /tshong so nam rem po mi dgos bde/ /nor 'tsho skyong sdug bsngal med pas bde/ /yar gong na gnya' gnon med pas bde/ /dgra nag po'i 'thab rtsod mi dgos bde/ /chos ci byed rang dbang thob pas bde/ /dus gtan gyi 'dun ma 'grub pas bde/ /tshe 'di dang phyi ma gnyis ka bde/ /dus 'di nas bzung ste bde bar 'gro/ /da ma 'dug ma 'dug da lta phros/ /kha phyi la ma 'khor dben par phros/ /mig phyi la ma lta dben par phros/ /mi'i gtam la ma nyan dben par phros/ /cang ma bshad kha rog dben par phros/ /bya 105

rgod po rnyi las thar bzhin phros/ /mi nag can btson nas 'bros bzhin phros/ /lar bsam blo gang yang ma gtong phros/ /mar 'khor ba'i btson rar tshud pa'i mi/ /glu rab snyan stobs ldan rgyal po 'dis/ /yar dben pa'i sa ru btang nas kyang / /chos nyams len dga' bro 'khrab par shog /ces pa 'di yang 'khor ba'i btson khang na rgyun du nyal nas chags sdang gi smre sngags 'don pa'i mi rnams dben pa'i sa ru gtong e thub snyam nas/glu dbyangs kyi mi chen 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyis mngags pa'o//nyi zla bzhin du ri khrod 'grims/ /seng ge bzhin du nyam nga med/ /bya rgod bzhin du chags pa med/ /de 'dra'i skyes bu rnams la 'dud/ /mi nag grong ba'i khyim 'di na/ /zhe sdang thab nang me bzhin 'bar/ /'dod chags zangs nang ja bzhin khol/ /gti mug dud pa bzhin du 'thul/ /ser sna za ma'i kha bzhin dam/ /phrag dog sgo yi khye bzhin zug /nga rgyal khyem gye glang bzhin 'khun/ /sdug bsngal bza' btung bzhin du mang / /pha yul sdug bsngal rgya mtsho nas/ /bag phebs sdod pa ma smyos sam/ /'gro na dam pa gong ma bzhin/ /yid 'ong dben pa'i gnas la gshegs/ /ljon shing gar stabs byed pa'i gseb/ /spang ri me tog bkra ba'i ljongs/ /bung ba lang ling 'phur ba'i skyibs/ /bya skad mang bo sgrog pa'i sa/ /ri dwags rtsed bro brdung ba'i gnas/ /106

rdza chu lhung lhung 'bab pa'i ri/ /ngo mtshar dben pa'i nags khrod na/ /shing thog rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /khyim pa'i gro nas bzhin du mod/ /zwa dang sgog sngo'i tshod ma rnams/ /khyim pa'i lo yi rtswa bzhin mod/ /rab mdzes bya dang ri dwags rnams/ /khyem pa pho mo las kyang mdzes/ /rgyun du 'grogs na zhe rgyud ni/ /khyim pa pho mo las kyang 'jam/ /skad rig sna tshogs 'byen pa ni/ /khyem pa'i gling bu las kyang snyan/ /ma rig nyon mongs dug lnga rnams/ /khyim pa'i gser dngul bzhin du dkon/ /nyin re bzhin gyi dge sbyor ni/ /khyim pa'i ston thog las kyang mang / /nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan ni/ /khyem pa'i lo legs bzhin du sgye/ /khyem las dben pa 'phags pa'i tshul/ /bshad na brjod kyis mi lang ngo / /khyem gyi rab 'bar me 'obs su/ /nan gyis sdod pa ma 'khrul lam/ /ri khrod dben pa'i bsil grib tu/ /da lta bsdad na mi legs sam/ /khyem gyi gting zab chu chen du/ /mi tshugs sdod pa smyos sam ci/ /ri khrod dben pa'i skam sa ru/ /da lta bde bar bsdad na legs/ /dkor zas dug chu bdud rtsi bzhin/ /rngams bzhin spyod pa ma 'khrul lam/ /ri khrod dben par gshegs nas kyang / /dam chos bdud rtsi 'thung na legs/ /chos brgyad 'khor ba'i chu dkyil lhung / /sdug bsngal 'o dod 'bod pa'i mi/ /glu 107

dbyangs mnyan pa bzang bo 'dis/ /dben pa'i skam sar 'khrid par shog /ces pa 'di yang 'khor ba'i dug chu'i nang du sdug bsngal gyis 'gre log sna tshogs byed pa rnams dben pa'i skam sar e lon snyam nas glu dbyangs mnyan pa 'di bya btang kha bde sems skyid tshogs drug rang grol gyis btang ba'o//khyem bza' tshang skyong ba'i khur de bor/ /ma 'gro kun sgol ba'i khur chen bsnams/ /gnas dben pa'i ri la gshegs mdzad pa'i/ /khong sngon byon dam pa rnams la 'dud/ /rang skyes pa'i pha yul srin gling las/ /ches khyad 'phags dben pa'i yon tan bshad/ /sngon las 'phro can gyi skal ldan kun/ /sems skyo ba bskyed la glu 'dir nyon/ /gnyen mdza' bshes rnams dang rgyang bsrings pas/ /sems gang la'ang chags sa med pas bde/ /mi las 'phro can rnams dben par shog /tshe blo yis thongs la myur du shog /sngar 'gras pa'i dgra la rgyang bsrings pas/ /sems zhe sdang khong khro med pas bde/ /mi las 'phro can rnams dben par shog /tshe blo yis thongs la myur du shog /nor rta lug kun dang rgyang bsrings pas/ /bor stor gyi dogs pa med pas bde/ /mi las 'phro can rnams dben par shog /tshe blo yis thongs la myur du shog /phas brtsigs pa'i khang ba rgyang bsrings pas/ /zhig 'gro ba'i dogs pa med pas bde/ /mi 108

las 'phro can rnams dben par shog /tshe blo yis thongs la myur du shog /phas nyos pa'i zhing la rgyang bsrings pas/ /las so nam brel ba med pas bde/ /mi las 'phro can rnams dben par shog /tshe blo yis thongs la myur du shog /mi che chung gang dang ma 'brel bas/ /rang spyod pa ci dga' byas pas bde/ /mi las 'phro can rnams dben par shog /tshe blo yis thongs la myur du shog /nor gsog 'jog gang yang ma byas pas/ /da 'chi rung zhen chags med pas bde/ /mi las 'phro can rnams dben par shog /tshe blo yis thongs la myur du shog /bya khu byug lhang lhang skad snyan 'byen/ /des dbang med skyo ba skye ru 'jug /mi las 'phro can rnams dben par shog /tshe blo yis thongs la myur du shog /bye'u lcog ka ma bus 'gyur khug len/ /des dbang med rna ba snyan du 'jug /mi las 'phro can rnams dben par shog /tshe blo yis thongs la myur du shog /bye'u lcog gas snga bar ca co sgog /des dbang med skyabs 'gro byed du 'jug /mi las 'phro can rnams dben par shog /tshe blo yis thongs la myur du shog /zwa sgog pa shing thog phang phung g.yo/ /des dbang med ro 'dzin tshim par byed/ /mi las 'phro can rnams dben par shog /tshe blo yis thongs la myur du shog /rkang drug ldan sbrang 109

mas glu dbyangs len/ /des dbang med mgur dbyangs 'then du 'jug /mi las 'phro can rnams dben par shog /tshe blo yis thongs la myur du shog /grogs ri dwags bag phebs rtse bro rdung / /des dbang med dga' spro skye ru 'jug /mi las 'phro can rnams dben par shog /tshe blo yis thongs la myur du shog /dus rim gyis 'gyur nas 'gro ba'i tshe/ /des dbang med mi rtag dran du 'jug /mi las 'phro can rnams dben par shog /tshe blo yis thongs la myur du shog /bya pho rog sgra skad mang bo sgog /de rnal 'byor 'dug grogs sems la phan/ /mi las 'phro can rnams dben par shog /tshe blo yis thongs la myur du shog /sems dga' spro skyid pa'i dag zhing 'dra/ /gnas dben pa'i yon tan brjod mi lang / /mi las 'phro can rnams dben par shog /tshe blo yis thongs la myur du shog /gnas de 'dra bsten na ngang gis skyid/ /mi gcig kyang med na de bas skyid/ /mi las 'phro can rnams dben par shog /tshe blo yis thongs la myur du shog /glu 'di thos las 'phro can gye mi/ /rang skyes pa'i pha yul srin gling dang / /grogs 'khor g.yog chung ma srin mo la/ /yid ma chags nges 'byung stobs can gye/ /rta sprin gyi shugs can la zhon nas/ /tshe 'di la phyi mig mi blta bar/ /110

gnas dben pa'i ri khrod nyams dga' ru/ /yun mi ring myur du 'bros par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis skal ldan gzhan la smras pa'o//na mo gu ru/ rtsal gsum rjogs pa'i g.yu 'brug /dbyar gsum nam mkhar 'phyo dus/ /gsung snyan dar dir sgogs dang / /rma bya'i sems la phan no/ /lang tsho gsar ba'i lho sprin/ /mkha' la lang long 'khrigs dus/ /sbrang char 'jam po phobs dang / /khu byug sems la phan no/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol/ /phyogs med ri khrod 'grim dus/ /mgur byangs lhang lhang 'then dang / /dad can sems la phan no/ /zhes pa 'di ni rang la smras pa'o/bka' drin gsum ldan bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad sol/ /mthun pa'i lam sna chos la drongs/ /bya btang gu yangs blo bde ngas/ /dbyangs snyan zhal gdams tshul du 'then/ /skal ldan seng bzang rgya mtsho nyon/ /sgyes pa'i pha yul rgyab tu bzhag /bde skyid urge bskyur nas kyang / /dam chos snying nas mi byed par/ /rnam g.yeng le lo byed gyur na/ /dben par 'ongs pa'i dgos pa ci/ /rang gis rang mgo ma bskor bar/ /dam chos bsgrub la 111

brtson 'grus gyis/ /'di yang snying gi dkyil du chongs/ /ri khrod dben pa 'dzin dus su/ /grong yul ltad mo ma dran cig /dran na rang sems bdud kyis g.yeng / /'di yang snying gi dkyil du chongs/ /khregs chod thod rgal sgom pa'i tshe/ /sgo gsum bya byed ma mang bar ma bcos rang bab ngang la zhog /'di yang snying gi dkyil du chongs/ /nyams dang rtogs pa skyes dus su/ /bla ma grogs bzang ma gtogs par/ /brjod 'dod rang gtsigs ma che zhig /'di yang snying gi dkyil du chongs/ /ri khrod dben pa'i gnas rnams su/ /tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms pa dang / /rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyis/ /sems can kun la ci phan gyes/ /'di yang snying gi dkyil du chongs/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang bla ma'i gsung / /rang gi dge sbyor dang 'gal ba'i/ /rnam g.yeng skad cig tsam mi bya/ /'di yang snying gi dkyil du chongs/ /bdag tu bzung ba'i gnas nyid dang / /'khor dang longs spyod ma bsten par/ /'gro kun bdag gi bu bzhin skyongs/ /'di yang snying gi dkyil du chongs/ /chags sdang can gyi 'khor ma gsogs/ /nga rgyal can gyi grogs po spongs/ /'dod chags can gyi rdzas ma gsogs/ /'di yang snying gi dkyil du chongs/ /mi nag grong nas yun ring du/ /ma 'dug mi shes dgu shes kyi/ /'dre 'dul grong 112

chog ma byed cig /'di yang snying gi dkyil du chongs/ /gnas su ri khrod dben pa bsten/ /grogs su bya dang ri dwags 'grogs/ /zas gos bzang ngan med par gyis/ /'di yang snying gi dkyil du chongs/ /mthu dang sngags kyis rang gzhan kun/ /'phung la sbyor ba'i las ma byed/ /nor rdzas phyir du chos ma btsongs/ 'di yang snying gi dkyil du chongs/ /don med bya ba ma mang zhig /ha cang lab lab mang drags na/ /tshig mda' gzhan la 'phog dogs yod/ /'di yang snying gi dkyil du chongs/ /lha ru dkon mchog gsum po mchod/ /blo gtod rtsa ba'i bla mar gyes/ /de ltar byas na 'dir bde zhing / /phyi mar byang chub myur du 'thob/ /'di yang snying gi dkyil du chongs/ /skal ldan slob ma ma gtogs pa/ /'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po yi/ /dbang lung khrid gsum ma byed cig /'di yang snying gi dkyil du chongs/ /'od gsal sgoms dang g.yeng ba med/ /gcig pur sdod dang nyams rtogs 'phel/ /kha rog sdod dang kha mchu med/ /dman sa zungs dang mtho sar bsleb/ /'di yang snying gi dkyil du chongs/ /zab lam sgoms dang myur lam 'grub/ /stong nyid rtogs na snying rje skye/ /snying rje skyes na bdag gzhan med/ /bdag gzhan med na 'gro don 'grub/ /'di yang snying gi dkyil du chongs/ /mdor na tshe 113

'di blo yis thongs/ /gyong ni lto gos gtam la skur/ /skyid sdug gnyis ka ro snyoms gyis/ /'di yang snying gi dkyil du chongs/ /pham kha thams cad rang gis longs/ /rgyal kha thams cad gzhan la byin/ /tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms par mdzod/ /'di yang snying gi dkyil du chongs/ /ci byed bla ma'i gsung bzhin sgrubs/ /rtag tu rang gi sems la ltos/ /gzhi med gnas med phyogs med gyis/ /'di yang snying gi dkyil du chongs/ /bya ba thams cad blos thongs la/ /bya dang ri dwags ji bzhin du/ /rtag tu ri khrod dben pa sten/ /'di yang snying gi dkyil du chongs/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang gro nga'i/ /zhal gdams phan pa'i dbyangs snyan 'di/ /skal ldan khyod kyis sems la chongs/ /dge 'dis bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blos btang nas/ /dben par byang chub bsgrub par shog /ces zhal gdams phan pa'i dbyangs snyan 'di ni dad ldan seng bzang rgya mtshos bskul ba'i ngor tshogs drug rang grol gyis bris pa'o//dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs sprul pad 'byung dang / /dbyer med chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /kun spang gu yangs blo bde rnal 'byor pa'i/ /kha la nyan na bu khyod 'di bzhin mdzod/ /ka dag don ston drin can bla ma la/ /kha zhe med par snying nas gsol ba thobs/ /ga ru 'dug kyang bdag 'dzin nyon mongs 114

thul/ /nga bdag bral ba mi la lta bur mdzod/ /ca co'i smra ba ma mang rang tshod zungs/ /cha byad chos dang mthun pa'i bya ba gyis/ /ja gos gang byung 'tsho ba tsam bsten nas/ /nya rgyas zla ltar nyams rtogs spel bar mdzod/ /ta la'i shing sogs rgyas pa'i nags khrod kyi/ /tha mal ri dwags bzhin du mi sdod par/ /da nas nyin mtshan med par sgom sgrub la/ /nā ro'i bu brgyud bzhin du brtson par mdzod/ /pa sangs ltar dkar phan sems gzhan la bskyed/ /pha mar gyur pa'i sems can thams cad la/ /ba spu g.yo ba'i snying rje cher bsgyed nas/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i don du dam chos mdzod/ /tsā ri la sogs yid 'ong dben gnas su/ /tsha grang khyad gsod tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms/ /dza hu'i rgyun ltar khregs chod bsgom pa'i tshe/ /wa le zang thal rjen par 'jog par mdzod/ /zhwa ser dmar sogs kun la dag snang gyis/ /za zi'i rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi thams cad spongs/ /'a 'ur dge sbyor gtso bor mi byed par/ /ya mtshan che ba'i thod rgal bsgom par mdzod/ /ra thug lta bur 'dod sred dbang gyur nas/ /la lung kun tu rgyu 'grul mi mang bar/ /sha rkyang ri dwags rtse ba'i dben pa bsten/ /sa gnas rig 'dzin gong ma'i rjes 'jug mdzod/ /ha cang dran rgyu byed rgyu ma mang bar/ /a ti rdzogs chen khregs 115

chod thod rgal gnyis/ /dbyer med zung 'jug nyams su blangs gyur nas/ /tshe 'dir snang bzhi'i ye shes mthar phyin mdzod/ /ces pa 'di yang dad ldan seng bzang rgya mtshos zhal gdams shig dgos zhes bskul ngor bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//chos kyi rgyal por gsol ba 'debs/ /bu rnams blo kha chos la sgyur/ /bla ma bzang bo'i slob ma ngas/ /gdams pa bzang bo legs par bshad/ /skal bar ldan pa'i bu rnams kun/ /ma yengs dal le rna bas nyon/ /dang po mtshan ldan bla ma bsten/ /dbang khrid zab mo'i gdams pa zhus/ /thos bsam phyi yi sgro 'dogs chod/ /de nas pha yul rgyab tu zhog /nye du'i 'brel thag thams cad chod/ /grogs med gcig pur ri khrod 'grims/ /tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms par gyis/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang bla ma'i gsung / /rang gi dge la gnod pa'i las/ /skad cig tsam yang mi byed mdzod/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad thongs/ /gnas su dben gnas gang bzang sten/ /grogs su bya dang ri dwags 'grogs/ /gos su hrul bo'i gon pa gyon/ /zas ni gang byung tsam la brten/ /lto gos gtam la gyong bskur dgos/ /lha ru dkon mchog gsum po mchod/ /blo gtad mtshan ldan bla mar gyis/ /nyon mongs skye ba'i grogs po spongs/ /'dod chags skye ba'i nor 116

rdzas spongs/ /mi nag skye bo ngan pa yi/ /drung du 'dug yun ma ring zhig /'dre 'dul grong chog las ma byed/ /mo rtsis mngon shes ma 'chad cig /rang mthong nga rgyal ma che bar/ /sgo gsum zhi zhing dul bar gyis/ /mang bo'i gseb tu sdod pa'i tshe/ /ha cang long gtam mi mang gnad/ /dam tshig sdom pa tshul bzhin srungs/ /'phags pa'i nor bdun gzung bar bya/ /rgyal kha thams cad gzhan la byin/ /pham kha thams cad rang gis longs/ /mthu gtad ngan sngags ma byed cig /'jig rten chos brgyad bya ba spongs/ /snying nas thar ba don gnyer na/ /dngos po gang la'ang ma chags par/ /ri dwags lta bu zhig byed dgos/ /dben par nyams len mdzad pa'i tshe/ /don med rnam g.yeng las ma byed/ /dogs pa shar na dpe blta dang / /mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla mar dris/ /snying nas bla mar gsol ba thobs/ /mi rtag 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs rnams/ /soms la sgom la snying rus gyis/ /'gro ba yongs la snying rje bskyed/ /yi dam lha yi skyed rim sgoms/ /chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /bar chad sel ba'i 'phrin las bcol/ /rtag tu khregs chod thod rgal sgoms/ /mthun rkyen nyams len 'phel ba'i sar/ /'gro 'dug ma mang bsdad na bzang / /mthun rkyen 'dzoms kyang 'du 'dzi 117

yis/ /nyams len dge la gnod gyur na/ /gzhi gcig ma 'dug phyogs med gyis/ /rgyal ba gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /rgas kyin ri khrod je mthor thongs/ /'di no mas sems la bzhag nas kyang / /dben gnas ri khrod 'grim nus na/ /dga' bde gter kha rnyed par nges/ /dge 'dis skal ldan mang bo yis/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blos thongs shog /ces pa 'di ni dad ldan gyi slob ma mang bos tshe 'di blos gtong tshul gyi zhal gdams shig dgos zhes bskul ngor/ rgyal ba gong ma'i rjes su kha mig yar lta byed tshul gyi bslab bya 'di ni tshogs drug rang grol gyis spras pa'o//kwa ye skal ldan snying gi grogs gnyis ka /kha bde khog dkar grogs po nga yi kha/ /ga ler nyon dang phan pa'i gros 'di ga /nga bdag thul dang 'khor bar ya mi nga / /ca ne dkar yol la sogs mang ka ca/ /cha med ri khrod 'grims na mi dgos cha/ /ja chang sha thud rta nor gos dar ja/ /nya mar dga' na sdug bsngal bye tshan nya/ /tā thā ga ta'i dam chos amṛ ta/ /tha na hub gang mi 'thung mi yi tha/ /da lta mi lus thob dus myur du da/ /na 'chi bsams nas chos la 'bad nus na/ /pa ra mi ta bcu thob ri khrod pa/ /pha rgod bla ma ngan 'gro las sgol pha/ /ba sogs nor rdzas phul zhig bya btang ba/ /ma rabs srog gcod ma byed a tsa ma/ /tsa mun ṭi sogs gshin rjes khrid nas tsa/ /tsha grang dmyal 118

bar bcug na sha 'di tsha/ /dza lantar gha gan dhwa dza/ /wa la tsas shākya pra bha wa/ /zhwa tog de 'dra'i bla ma bkur ste zhwa/ /za ma bsags tshad phal cher gzhan gyis za/ /'a dur ma 'ching mchod sbyin byas na 'a/ /ya mtshan bsgyed rdzogs rdzogs chen sgoms shig ya/ /ra ltar bsdad na nyams rtogs ri bong rwa/ /la la ma yengs rtag tu sgom sgrub la/ /sha stag gyis shig chos grogs nga yi sha /sa phug brag khung nyams dga' gar yod sa/ /ha cang bsten na bu rgod yin ha ha/ /a rog snying grogs gnyis ka e go a/ /bde chen sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor gre ba bde/ /snyan ngag mi shes na yang glu 'di snyan/ /zhes pa 'di yang grogs po ri khrod pa gnyis la tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//sku mthong ba tsam gyes dad pa skye/ /gsung thos pas ngan 'gro'i 'jigs las sgrol/ /pha chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bor 'dud/ /bu dad ldan yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /phyi thos pas sgo 'dogs ngas ma bcad/ /nang nyams myong rtogs pa ma mchis kyang / /khyed dag snang bzang bo mnga' bas na/ /gtam tshig gsum mgrin pa btegs nas smra/ /spyir 'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba med/ /sgos deng sang 'jig rten bya ba la/ /don 'di yin gtad so ci yang med/ /da sdig spong dge sgrub mdzod cig 119

ang / /yar lha mi'i bdud rtsi 'thung ba dang / /mar dmyal ba'i khro chu 'thung ba gnyis/ /dus da lta gdam dbang rang la yod/ /dbang yod dus gdam kha ma nor ang / /dus lan cig thob pa'i mi lus 'di/ /yun ring bor mi 'dug myur du 'jig /da don med stong log mi byed par/ /chos snying nas mdzad na rang don ang / /khong 'chi bdag gshin rjer snying rje med/ /de nam 'ong nges pa ma mchis pas/ /da tshe 'di'i bya ba blos btang nas/ /gnas dben par sgom sgrub mdzad na ang / /dus snyigs ma'i deng sang dus skabs 'dir/ /skyid 'dod kyang sdug po shugs kyis myong / /mi shes rab can gyis bsam shes na/ /don snying bo gang la'ang med do ang/ /sngar dam chos rnam dag mdzad pa yi/ /grangs 'dren rgyu e yod sems la dris/ /de med na 'chi khar 'gyod pa 'ong / /da 'chi brod chos shig mdzad na ang / /sngar zhar dang zhor la bsags pa yi/ /sdig mi dge las kyi rnam smin gyis/ /mar ngan 'gror lhung tshe bzod thabs med/ /da sdig bshags sgrib sbyong mdzod cig ang / /mdo tril gyis dril ba'i snying bo la/ /skyabs dkon mchog gsum la snying rtsa gtod/ /ma 'gro kun don du sems mchog skyed/ /rang gang shes nyams len mdzod cig ang / /mjug dge ba 'gro kun don du sngos/ /'di 120

nyams len snying bor dril ba yin/ /don 'di bzhin bu khyod mdzad nus na/ /tshe 'di phyi kun tu bde'o ang / /gtam 'di las byung ba'i dge ba rnams/ /ma mkha' mnyam 'gro kun ma lus pa/ /dus gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo//zhes pa 'di ni dge slong dbang rgyal gyis zhal gdams shig dgos zhes bskul ngor bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//bdag tha mal lus kyi spyi gtsug na/ /gdan seng ges btegs pa'i khri steng na/ /'ja' kha dog sna lnga'i gur khang na/ /skyabs sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma rje/ /sku tha mal ma yin rdo rje 'chang / /mtshan dpe byad gzi byin ya la la/ /gsung theg chen chos sgra di ri ri/ /thugs gsal stong 'dzin med trigs se hrig /bu mos gus gdungs pas gsol ba 'debs/ /mi 'dir 'tshogs blo kha chos la sgyur/ /dus snyigs ma'i chos med bya btang ngas/ /las rgyu 'bras rnam dbye shes pa la/ /tshig kun gyis go ba'i glu zhig len/ /khrom go re 'tshogs pa kyi ler nyon/ /tshe sngon mar mi dge bcu spangs sogs/ /khrims rnam dag tshul bzhin bsrungs dang gcig /sbyin la sogs dge ba byas dang gnyis/ /mir skye ba'i smon lam btab dang gsum/ /de byas pas da lta mi lus thob/ /tshe phyi mar mi lus thob 'dod na/ /rgyu de gsum 121

bsgrubs na mi lus 'thob/ /rgyu de gsum sgrubs shig skal ldan kun/ /rgyu de gsum da lta ma bsgrubs par/ /phyi'i mi lus thob tu re ba de/ /dpe dpyid dus sa bon ma btab par/ /ston lo tog re ba ji bzhin no/ /dus da lta 'dzam bu'i gling 'di na/ /mi phal cher gzugs byed mdzes pa de/ /sngon bzod pa bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu yin/ /tshe phyi mar gzugs byed legs 'dod na/ /rgyu bzod pa bsgoms na gzugs bzang 'thob/ /da bzod pa sgoms shig skal ldan kun/ /mi phal cher mi mdzes btsog pa de/ /sngon khong khro byas pa'i rnam smin yin/ /tshe phyi mar btsog par mi 'dod na/ /rgyu khong khro spangs na gzugs mi btsog /da khong khro spongs shig skal ldan kun/ /mi phal cher chung nas chos la dad/ /chos dka' tshegs med par shes pa de/ /sngon nyan bshad byas pa'i 'bras bu yin/ /tshe phyi mar dam chos shes 'dod na/ /rgyu tshe 'dir nyan bshad byas na shes/ /da nyan bshad mdzod cig skal ldan kun/ /mi phal cher chung nas chos mi dad/ /chos bslabs kyang yun ring mi shes pa/ /sngon dam chos ma bslabs rnam smin yin/ /tshe phyi mar tshegs med shes 'dod na/ /rgyu tshe 'dir dam chos bslabs na shes/ /da dam chos slobs shig skal ldan kun/ /mi phal cher da lta phyug pa de/ /sngon sbyin pa btang ba'i 'bras bu 122

yin/ /tshe phyi mar rab tu phyug 'dod na/ /rgyu sbyin pa btang na phyug por skye/ /da sbyin pa thongs shig skal ldan kun/ /mi phal cher da lta dbul ba de/ /sngon ser snas sbyin pa ma btang lan/ /tshe phyi mar dbu bor mi 'dod na/ /rgyu ser sna spangs na dbul mi 'gyur/ /da ser sna ma byed skal ldan kun/ /mi phal cher tshe ring nad med pa/ /sngon srog gcod spangs shing gzhan srog bskyabs/ /de'i 'bras bu da lta smin pa yin/ /tshe phyi mar mi tshe ring 'dod na/ /rgyu srog gcod spangs na mi tshe ring / /da srog gcod spongs shig skal ldan kun/ /srog tshe thar thongs shig las can tsho//mi phal cher tshe thung nad mang ba/ /sngon srog gcod byas pa'i rnam smin yin/ /tshe phyi mar tshe thung mi 'dod na/ /rgyu srog ma bcad na tshe mi thung / /da srog gcod ma byed skal ldan kun/ /khyi phyugs ma brdungs 'dir 'tshogs tsho/ /mdor bsdu na tshe sngon gang byas pa/ /tshe 'di ru smin nas myang ba yin/ /tshe 'di ru dge sdig gang byas pa/ /de'i rnam smin phyi mar myong ba yin/ /tshe phyi mar bde zhing skyid 'dod na/ /dus da lta dkar bo'i chos la 'bod/ /phyi'i bde skyid 'byung ngo skal ldan kun/ /tshe phyi mar sdug bsngal mi 'dod na/ /dus da lta mi dge sdig pa spongs/ /phyi'i sdug bsngal mi myong skal ldan kun/ /glu 'di thos pho mo gang yin 123

yang / /sdig mi dge dug chu bzhin du shes/ /las dge ba bdud rtsi ltar shes na/ /sdig spangs nas dge la 'bad pa'i mthus/ /tshe phyi mar mi lus rin chen thob/ /chos nyams su blangs nas 'tshang rgya shog /ces pa 'di yang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis grong gi skye bo pho mo yongs la smras pa'o//lha bla ma dkon mchog rin po che/ /mi 'dir 'tshogs blo kha chos la sgyur/ /las rgyu 'bras shes pa'i glu zhig len/ /dal cag ge 'dir 'tshogs gsan par 'tshal/ /steng dga' ldan lha yi gnas mchog na/ /mdog rab mdzes lha dang lha mo yis/ /rang gang za 'dod pa'i 'bras bu de/ /dus da lta btab pa da lta smin/ /de khong rnams so nam mkhas pa min/ /sngon tshogs bsags byas pa'i 'bras bu yin/ /da tshogs bsags mdzod cig skal ldan tsho/ /'og na rag dmyal khams bco brgyad na/ /mdog mi sdug gshin rje'i pho nya yis/ /mtshon da lta brgyab pa da lta sos/ /de khong rnams rma sos bzang ba min/ /sngon srog gcod byas pa'i rnam smin yin/ /da srog gcod spongs shig skal ldan tsho/ /phar rgya mtsho'i 'gram na yi dwags rnams/ /zas da lta zos kyang da lta ltogs/ /de khong rnams gsus pa che ba min/ /sngon ser sna byas pa'i rnam smin yin/ /da ser sna spongs shig skal 124

ldan tsho/ /shar lus 'phags gling gi mi rnams ni/ /gling gzhan ma gsum las gzugs byad legs/ /sngon bzod pa bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu yin/ /da bzod pa sgoms shig 'dir 'dus tsho/ /lho mdzam bu'i gling gi 'o skol rnams/ /gling gzhan ma gsum las dam chos dar/ /sngon chos nyan byas pa'i 'bras bu yin/ /da chos nyan gyis shig 'dir 'dus tsho/ /nub ba glang spyod kyi mi rnams ni/ /gling gzhan ma gsum las longs spyod che/ /sngon sbyin pa btang ba'i 'bras bu yin/ /da sbyin pa thongs shig 'dir 'dus tsho/ /byang sgra mi snyan gyi mi rnams ni/ /gling gzhan ma gsum las mi tshe ring / /sngon srog gcod spangs pa'i 'bras bu yin/ /da srog gcod spongs shig 'dir 'dus tsho/ /mdor bsdu na da lta ltos dang shes/ /mi phal cher gzugs mdzes longs spyod che/ /chos dga' zhing mi tshe ring ba de/ /sngon bzod pa bsgoms dang sbyin pa btang / /chos nyan zhing srog gcod spangs pa las/ /de'i 'bras bu da lta smin pa yin/ /phyug spobs pa btsongs nas da lta'i dus/ /yang sngar bzhin dge ba ma byas par/ /phyi'i 'di bzhin 'ong snyam re ba de/ /mi zhig gis ri bong bsad shul du/ /de'i phyi lo dbyug pa 'phangs dang 'dra/ /da phyug dus chos sgrubs 'dir 'tshogs kun/ /mi phal cher btsog cing longs spyod 125

chung / /chos mi dga' tshe thung nad mang ba/ /sngon khong khro skyes shing tshogs ma bsags/ /chos ma nyan gzha na gyi srog la 'tshe/ /de'i 'bras bu da lta smin pa yin/ /med btsongs nas mi dge sdig byas na/ /tshe phyi mar je sdug je sdug 'gro/ /sdug byas kyang phyi mar bde snyam de/ /mi zhig gis dug chu khar 'thungs nas/ /phyi'i lus la mi gnod snyam pa 'dra/ /da sdig las ma byed 'dir 'tshogs kun/ /glu 'dis kyang rang gzhan kun la phan/ /las rgyu 'bras mi bslur shes nas kyang / /sdig spangs shing dge la rab gzhol mthus/ /mthar mngon mtho nges legs thob par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis kun la e phan snyam nas smras pa'o//skyabs sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum/ /de kun 'dus slob dpon chen po dang / /dbyer ma mchis drin can chos rgyal la/ /bdag rtse gcig gus pas gsol ba 'debs/'dir 'tshogs pa'i skal ldan pho mo yis/ /tshe 'di la phyi mig mi blta bar/ /rje rgyal ba gong ma'i rnam thar la/ /mig yar yar blta bar byin gyes rlobs/ /rgan bdun cu brgyad cu man chad nas/ /chung lo bzhi lo lnga yan chad kyi/ /skyes pho mo 'dir 'dus khrom pa rnams/ /'jam ldem me rnal 'byor glu la nyon/ /nga'i mgrin pa glu yi mdzod khang na/ /mgur rnam pa sna tshogs gos 126

dar yod//dbyar 'dren 'gug snyan pa'i gnyer ba yis/ /gtam kha lce bde mo'i lde mig gis/ /glu'i dkor mdzod sgo mo phye nas kyang / /dus de ring 'dir 'tshogs khrom pa la/ /rang gang 'dod mgur dbyangs gos dar ster/ /yid dad cing gus pas phyag tu longs/ /da glu ba tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /rang dben par nyams len mdzad bzhin du/ /gzhan dam pa'i chos la bskul ba'i phyir/ /tshe mi rtag dpe mgur dbyangs su len/ /dbyed lngon shing lo ma 'bus pa bzhin/ /rang chung dus lus zungs yar yar rgyas/ /dbyar lo 'dab dar zhing rgyas pa bzhin/ /na gzhon dus lang tsho dar zhing rgyas/ /ston shing lor ser thig lhung ba bzhin/ /lo lon dus skra la dkar thig lhung / /dgun tha mar rlung gis gtor ba bzhin/ /mthar 'chi bas bcom nas sgyu lus 'dor/ /mi shes rab can gyis bsam shes na/ /tshe mi rtag shing sdong lo ma 'dra/ /yun ring bor lo ma e 'dug soms/ /da 'dir 'tshogs skal ldan pho mo rnams/ /yun ring bor sdod grabs ma mdzad par/ /gzhon kha dkar dus su chos gyis dang / /mgo dkar bor song dus blo sems bde/ /tshe phyi ma'i brgyags phye ma bsgrubs pa'i/ /pho chos med 'chi khar 'gyod kyin 'chi/ /sems skyo med chos gyis 'dir 'dus tsho/ /phyogs phyogs nas 'ongs pa'i tshong 127

'dus bzhin/ /dus da lta bza' tshang khyim gang 'tshogs/ /tshong zin tshe rim bzhin 'gro ba bzhin/ /khyem bza' tshang gang bo rim bzhin 'chi/ /mi la la yar la 'gro ba bzhin/ /chos byas pa mtho ris yar la 'gro/ /mi la la mar la ragro ba bzhin/ /sdig mi dge byas pa dmyal bar 'gro/ /mjug tshong 'dus gcig kyang mi sdod bzhin/ /khyem bza' tshang gcig kyang mi sdod 'chi/ /mi shes rab can gyis bsam shes na/ /khyim bza' tshang tshong 'dus mgon po 'dra/ /khrom tshong 'dus yun ring e 'dug soms/ /dus da lta yud tsam 'tshogs dus 'dir/ /khyem bza' tshang sdig la ma sbyor bar/ /yar mtho ris skye ba'i chos la sbyor/ /khyim bza' tshang don du sdig ma byed/ /lto rgyab gnyis 'gebs phyir sdig byas na/ /rang dmyal bar 'gro bas dogs zon mdzod/ /da tshe 'di'i bya bas ma yengs par/ /yar dam pa'i lha chos bya ba gyes/ /dge 'dis kyang 'dir 'tshogs pho mo yi/ /blo dam pa'i chos la phyogs par shog /ces pa 'di yang grong gi skya ser pho mo yongs la tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//rje drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma yis/ /blo chos la bsgyur ba'i drin lan du//thugs sun ni ma byed 'dir 'dus tsho/ /snying thag pas bsnyen bkur ci nus gyis/ /lus bskyed pa'i drin can pha ma yis/ /rang legs par bskyangs pa'i drin lan du/ /rdung sdigs 128

sogs ma byed 'dir 'dus tsho/ /chos 'jig rten gnyis gas gang phan gyis/ /rang rkyen ngan pa dang 'phrad pa'i tshe/ /drin che ba'i mched grogs drin lan du/ /drin khyad gsod ma byed 'dir 'dus tsho/ /lus ngag gis phan thogs gang thub gyis/ /zhes pa 'di yang grong gi pho mo rnams la bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis spras pa'o//pha chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /spyir byang phyogs bod kyi mi rnams la/ /sku drin che ba 'di 'dra yod/ /rgya gar mkhas grub mang byon kyang / /nang nas shin tu drin che ba/ /slob dpon chen po pad 'byung dang / /mnyam med jo bo chen po yin/ /bod kyi rgyal po thams cad kyi/ /nang nas shin tu drin che ba/ /chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po dang / /khri srong sde'u btsan rnam gnyis yin/ /bod kyi lo tsā thams cad kyi/ /nang nas shin tu drin che ba/ /lo tsā thon mi saspyo ṭa/ /slob dpon bai ro tsa na yin/ /bod kyi grub chen thams cad kyi/ /nang nas shin tu drin che ba/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug mi la dang / /ras chung rdo rje grags pa yin/ /bod kyi bla ma thams cad kyi/ /nang nas shin tu drin che ba/ /kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams dang //rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa yin/ /sgos su reb gong lung ba ru/ /sku drin che ba rnam gnyis yod/ /reb gong bla ma thams cad kyi/ /nang nas shin tu drin che 129

ba/ /rje btsun skal ldan rgya mtsho dang / /rig 'dzin dpal ldan bkra shis yin/ /yang sgos bya btang rnal 'byor ngar/ /sku drin che ba rnam gnyis yod/ /bdag la drin can thams cad kyi/ /nang nas shin tu drin che ba/ /bla ma ngag gi dbang bo dang / /lus srog bskyed pa'i a ma yin/ /zhes pa 'di ni mi zhig gis khyed kyis 'di ltar chos byed pa'i drin can su yin zer ba'i lan du 'di lta bu yid la shar ba bris pa'o//no mo gu ru/ rgod sgro sems la bzhag nas/ /brag la mda' zhig 'phangs so/ /mda' ba bzang bo min rung / /sgo chung kha shas bcad nas/ /brag dmar dkyil la zug byung / /dma' mo'i sa la ma lhung / /nor bu sems la bzhag nas/ /gru yis rgya mtshor zhugs so/ /ded dpon bzang bo min rung / /rgya mcho thad sor bcad nas/ /rin chen gling du slebs byung / /srin mo'i gling du ma lhung / /'gro kun sems la bzhag nas/ /dben par sgom la zhugs so/ /rnal 'byor bzang bo min rung / /tshe 'di'i 'khri ba bcad nas/ /dben pa'i gnas su chags byung / /mi nag grong du ma lhung / /zhes pa 'di yang bud med cig gis dben par gcig pur e chags ki zer ba'i lan du rtse mtshar du tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//skyabs gcig mtshan ldan bla ma la/ /lag gnyis spyi bor thal sbyar nas/ /sgo gsum gus pas bdag phyag 'tshal/ /sku bzhi'i go 130

'phang bstsal tu gsol/ /dbyar ston gnyis kyi bar mtshams na/ /khu byug sngon mo zhe re skyo/ /snyan pa'i skad mgo dma' tshul la/ /bltas na sang 'gro gnangs 'gro red/ /kye hud bya rgyal khu byug nga / /myur du 'gro snyam zhe re 'gyod//yang yang 'dir 'ongs skad snyan grags/ /mi rnams dga' spro bsgyed par smon/ /ston dgun gnyis kyi bar mtshams na/ /spang rgyan sngon mo zhe re skyo/ /mdzes pa'i 'gying bag glod tshul la/ /bltas na sang gshegs gnangs gshegs nges/ /kye hud spang rgyan sngon mo nga / /myur du gshegs snyam zhe re 'gyod/ /yang yang sgyes nas 'dzum zhing rgod/ /dkon mchog rnam gsum mchod par smon/ /na rga gnyis kyi bar mtshams na/ /bya btang rgod po zhe re skyo/ /dar ba'i lus po rgud tshul la/ /bltas na sang 'chi gnangs 'chi nges/ /kye hud bya btang rgod po nga/ /myur du 'chi snyam zhe re 'gyod/ /yang yang dal 'byor rten bzang thob/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa 'dzin par smon/ /zhes pa 'di yang nyin zhig skyo shas than thun skyes pa'i tshe zho 'ong rgad pos smras pa'o//chos kun sgyu mar shes pa'i go mtshon thogs/ /chos brgyad dgra yi g.yul ngor pham mdzad pa'i/ /chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bor gsol ba 'debs/ /chos brgyad mgo snyoms nus par byin gyes rlobs/ /chos kyi sgor zhugs chos par khas len yang / /131

chos dang bstun tshe chos dang rgyab 'gal ba'i/ /chos dzu mkhan khyod chos bzhin byed snyam na/ /chos kyi bar chad chos brgyad mgo bo snyoms/ /rnyed kyang dga' ba ma skyes ma rnyed kyang / /gdung ba ma skyes rnyed dang ma rnyed gnyis/ /sgyu ma mkhan gyis sprul sgyur byas pa bzhin/ /soms la rnyed dang ma rnyed mgo bo snyoms/ /bde yang zhen pa ma byed mi bde yang / /sdug bsngal ma byed bde dang sdug bsngal gnyis/ /rmi lam skabs kyi bde sdug myong ba bzhin/ /soms la bde sdug gnyis ka mgo bo snyoms/ /bstod par gyur kyang nga rgyal sems ma skyes/ /smad par gyur kyang khro ba ma skyes par/ /bstod dang smad pa brag cha'i sgra dbyangs bzhin/ /soms la bstod smad gnyis ka mgo bo snyems/ /snyan pa thos kyang khengs pa'i sems ma skyes/ /mi snyan thos kyang zhum pa ma byed par/ /snyan dang mi snyan gnyis ka sgra brnyan bzhin/ /soms la snyan dang mi snyan mgo bo snyoms/ /chos brgyad mgo bo chos kyis ma bsnyams na/ /chos lugs mang shas chos bshad kha mkhas kyang / /chos dang bstun na chos gral thob par dka'/ /chos bzhin byed na chos brgyad mgo bo snyems/ /zhes pa 'di yang tshogs dus/ rang grol kyis rang la smras pa'o//chos dbyings ngang la g.yo med/ /chos rgyal ngag gi dbang 13 2

bo/ /chos brgyad chu dkyil lhung ba'i/ /chos med bu nga skyongs shig /'jig rten chos brgyad chom rkun/ /med zer sa cha mi 'dug /grong na yod pa gzhir bzhag /dgon pa na yang yod snang / /ri khrod du 'ang slebs byung / /dran shes bag yod skyes bus/ /lta ba'i mdung ring thogs la/ /chos brgyad chom rkun gang byung / /de ma thag tu sod cig /rnyed par gyur na dga' zhing / /ma rnyed gyur na mi dga'i/ /bzang ngan rtog pa bor la/ /lta ba'i ngang du glod cig /bde bar gyur na dga' zhing / /mi bder gyur na mi dga'i/ /bzang ngan rtog pa bor la/ /lta ba'i ngang du glod cig /snyan par thos na dga' zhing / /mi snyan thos na mi dga'i/ /bzang ngan rtog pa bor la/ /lta ba'i ngang du glod cig /bstod par gyur na dga' zhing / /smad par gyur na mi dga'i/ /bzang ngan rtog pa bor la/ /lta ba'i ngang du glod cig /mdor na chos brgyad rnam rtog /gang shar rjes su ma 'brangs/ /lta ba'i ngang du glod la/ /rang sar grol bar mdzod cig /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//mkhyen pas shes bya'i gnas rnams sa ler mkhyen/ /brtse bas legs bshad chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed/ /mdzad pas skal ldan gdu' bya'i yid 'phrog pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i sras po bla ma'i 133

zhabs la 'dud/ /mdo sngags chos kyi gru chen la zhugs nas/ /thar ba'i rin chen gser gling bsnyeg snyam yang / /chos brgyad srin mo'i tshogs kyis bslus nas khrid/ /chos brgyad bdud mo 'di la snying re na/ /bshad dang sgrub pa'i chos kyi rgyal mtshan de/ /thos bsam sgom gsum yu ba'i rtser bsgrengs kyang / /chos brgyad rlung dmar 'di yis yang yang bcag /chos brgyad rlung bo 'di la snying re na/ /shes rab khye'u chung brtson 'grus rtar zhon nas/ /gzhung lugs rab 'byams thang la brgyug snyam yang / /chos brgyad lcags sgrog 'di yis dam du bcings/ /chos brgyad lcags sgrog 'di la snying re na/ /mtshan ldan bla mas dgyes bzhin gnang ba yi/ /sdom gsum gtsang ma'i nor bu rin chen 'di/ /chos brgyad g.yog ngan de yis brkus nas khyer/ /chos brgyad g.yog ngan 'di la snying re na/ /chog shes rin chen gser gyi khang bzang nang / /'phags nor rin chen bdun gyi mdzod brtsigs kyang / /chos brgyad rkun mas thams cad khyer nas song / /chos brgyad rkun rgan 'di la snying re na/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis chos brgyad dgra bo 'di'i/ /snying la lag pa bzhag kyang zhe tshim dka'/ /pha bsad bu yis lag dmar la byams ltar/ /deng sang chos brgyad dgra la byams mkhan mang / /pha yi 134

srog rtsa gcod pa'i lag dmar la/ /zas nor byen nas gtong ba su yis bzod/ /gtan bde'i srog rtsa gcod pa'i chos brgyad la/ /'phags nor byen nas gtong ba su yis bzod/ /pha yi srog rtsa gcod pa'i snying nag dgra/ /yan par gtong na bu yi snying rtsa rul/ /thar ba'i srog rtsa gcod pa'i chos brgyad de/ /yan par gtong na chos pa'i snying rtsa rul/ /chos brgyad cham la 'bab mkhan mi la bzhin/ /bdag gis nges 'byung byang sems khrab rmog gyon/ /lta ba'i mtshon rnon mdung ring lag thogs nas/ /yid brnag chos brgyad dgra yi snying dkyil du/ /btab nas nam zhig cham la 'bab thub snyam/ /glu 'di thos tshad kun gyes chos brgyad dgra'i/ /'khor bshig tshang gtor rjes med brlag nus shog /ces pa 'di yang chos brgyad kyi khol bor gyur pa'i dus shig tu tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o// chos sku kun tu bzang dang yum chen mo/ /longs sku rdo rje 'chang dang rigs lnga dang / /sprul sku shāka thub pad 'byung la sogs pa/ /'dus sku drin can bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /sngon byon dam pa'i rnam thar rjes zhugs nas/ /gcig pur dben pa'i gnas la 'gro ba la/ /'du 'bral med par thugs rje'i spyan gyes gzigs/ /'gal rkyen kun sol byin rlabs dngos grub 135

stsol/ /deng sang dus ngan snyigs ma'i tha ma la/ /gang la bsams kyang nges 'byung skyo shas skye/ /bdag gi sems 'di nags ri'i khrod dga' bas/ /glu dbyangs lhang lhang 'jen bzhin nags la 'gro/ /chags sdang 'du 'dzis yengs pas chos skal 'chad/ /sgyes pa'i lu la la chags pas ci zhig bya/ /ma byas rang 'khrungs ljon shing bsil khang gnas/ /yid 'ong dben pa'i nags tshal nyams dgar 'gro/ /yod kyin chog shas mi skye ser sna 'phel/ /sgyu ma'i nor la chags pas ci zhig bya/ /'dzad med 'phags pa'i nor bdun 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid 'ong dben pa'i nags tshal nyams dgar 'gro/ /ngoms shes tshim med spyad kyin sred pa 'phel/ /bza' tung ro la chags pas ci zhig bya/ /dka' thub bcud len ngang gis byed pa'i gnas/ /yid 'ong dben pa'i nags tshal nyams dgar 'gro/ /dar zab ras dang snam ther la sogs pa'i/ /mdzes sgeg gos la dga' bas ci zhig bya/ /ngan ngon tsam gyis tsha grang skyob pa'i gnas/ /yid 'ong dben pa'i nags tshal nyams dgar 'gro/ /shed can rta sogs zhon nas rgyal khams bskor/ /ma rabs spyod ngan de 'dras ci zhig bya/ /rang gi gom pas bde bar slebs pa'i gnas/ /yid 'ong dpen pa'i nags tshal nyams dgar 'gro/ /bslabs na mi nyan 136

zag pa khong khro skye/ /nyon mongs 'phel ba'i 'khor gyis ci zhig bya/ /gcig pur gu yangs chos la spyod pa'i gnas/ /yid 'ong dben pa'i nags tshal nyams dgar 'gro/ /don med rnam g.yeng long gtam rgyun mi 'chad/ /bu slob grwa ba mang bos ci zhig bya/ /sus kyang mi mthong rang nyid bde dal gnas/ /yid 'ong dben pa'i nags tshal nyams dgar 'gro/ /rtag tu ngo srung sems 'dzin rgyun mi 'chad/ /sar nga'i yon bdag mang bos ci zhig bya/ /ngo srung sems 'dzin gang yang mi dgos pa'i/ /yid 'ong dben pa'i nags tshal nyams dgar 'gro/ /bstod dang grags pas tshe ring chos 'phel lam/ /snyan grags phyogs bcur rgyas pas ci zhig bya/ /sus kyang rang gi ming yang mi thos pa'i/ /yid 'ong dben pa'i nags tshal nyams dgar 'gro/ /ma nor dam chos bshad kyang sgro skur 'dogs/ /dus ngan gzhan don 'di yis ci zhig bya/ /rtag tu rang don thar ba sgrub pa'i gnas/ /yid 'ong dben pa'i nags tshal nyams dgar 'gro/ /'a 'ur 'du 'dzis nyin mtshan 'chor ba'i yul/ /mi nag grong du bsdad pas ci zhig bya/ /nyin mtshan gnyis ka chos gyes 'da' ba'i gnas/ /yid 'ong dben pa'i nags tshal nyams dgar 'gro/ /gangs can khrod kyi seng ge mi la ltar/ /gang la'ang ma 137
