chags tshe 'di blos btang nas/ /gang bzang nags khrod nyams dga' myur bsten te/ /gang zab gdams pa nyams su len par shog /ces pa 'di yang glu ba bzhin du chos med nags tshal nyams dgar 'gro ba'i snyom las pa tshogs drug rang grol gyes blangs so//tshe 'di'i 'khrul ba kun la rgyab phyogs nas/ /phyag chen rdzogs chen dbu ma zhi byed gcod/ /rtse gcig ri khrod dben par nyams blangs nas/ /grub brnyes dam pa gong ma rnams la 'dud/ /sngon byon dam pa'i byen gyis brlabs pa'i gnas/ /ri khrod dben pa'i yon tan bshad kyis nyon/ /skyid cing nyams dga' lha yi yul dang mtshungs/ /ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su bsgom du gshegs/ /'go ris sa gtsang jag rkun gnod pa med/ /rab tu nyams dga' bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ /tshe ring nad med yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su bsgom du gshegs/ /gangs ri sman ljongs nags tshal tshogs mang zhing / /rab mjes bya dang ri dwags mang bos gang / /chu gtsang dar gyi sgrog grol lhung lhung 'bab/ /ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su bsgom du gshegs/ /lo ma me tog 'bras bus brgyan pa'i shing / /dri bzhon rlung gis btab tshe 'dab sgra sgrog /me tog 'dzum rgod bung bas glu gar byed/ /ri khrod dben pa'i 138

gnas su bsgom du gshegs/ /brag ri'i phug dang ljon shing bsil khang dang / /gro ma shing 'bras sngo tshod sna tshogs pa/ /ro mngar zhim pa'i dbyar gyi kha zas ldan/ /ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su bsgom du gshegs/ /sngon byon dam pas byen gyis brlabs pa'i gnas/ /da lta'i skyes chen dam pa bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /ma 'ongs rgyal sras sprul ba 'byon pa'i gnas/ /ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su bsgom du gshegs/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas/ /chos skyong srung ma yul lha 'khor ba'i gnas/ /mchog thun yon tan mang bo 'byung ba'i gnas/ /ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su bsgom du gshegs/ /ri khrod yon tan cung zad brjod pa'i glu/ /tshogs drug rang grol ri la 'gro tshe blangs/ /dge ba 'di yis rang gzhan skyes bu kun/ /ri la phyin nas dngos grub mchog thob shog /ces pa 'di yang rang la spro ba bskyed phyir blangs pa'o//dpag med bskal par rgya chen tshogs gnyis bsags/ /mtha' med 'gro kun don du sems mchog bskyed/ /zad med smon lam mthu las legs 'khrungs pa'i/ /mtshungs med drin can bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /chos bzhin mdzad pa'i bya btang rnal 'byor nga / /chos min smra bar snying khams cung zad med/ /139

chos dang mthun par byed na grogs po tsho/ /chos gtam tshig 'ga' bshad kyis ma yengs nyon/ /dam chos sgrub pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzod par/ /dgra 'dul ba dang gnyen skyong la sogs kyi/ /dka' spyad bzod pa bzod pa go log go /go log de 'dra ma mdzad grogs po tsho/ /mdo sngags dam chos rnam dag sgrub pa la/ /'dun pa mi byed tshe 'di'i dpal 'byor la/ /'dun pa byed pa 'dun pa go log go /go log de 'dra ma byed grogs po tsho/ /thos bsam sgom gsum sgo nas chos kyi ro/ /mi myang 'jig rten 'di yi bde ba'i ro/ /myang ba de ni ro myang go log go /go log de 'dra ma mdzad grogs po tsho/ /sdig pa byed la snying rje mi bsgom par/ /dam chos phyir du dka' spyad byed pa la/ /snying rje byed pa snying rje go log go /go log de 'dra ma mdzad grogs po tsho/ /rang la bltos pa'i mi rnams dam chos la/ /mi sbyor tshe 'di'i dpal 'byor che thabs la/ /sbyor ba de ni gnyer sems go log go /go log de 'dra ma mdzad grogs po tsho/ /'khor 'das gnyis kyi bde dang dge ba la/ /dga' ba mi bsgom sdug bsngal dgra byung na/ /dga' ba rjes su yi rang go log go /go log de 'dra ma mdzad grogs po tsho/ /go log drug po 'di nyid shis byas nas/ /ma log pa drug nyams su len par gyes/ /'di bzhin grogs mched 140

rnams kyis mdzad nus na/ /'di phyi kun tu bde zhing skyid par nges/ /dge 'dis dam tshig gcig pa'i grogs rnams kyis/ /dge ba'i gshes gnyen jo bo'i rnam thar bzhin/ /dge sdig gnyis kyi 'dam kha ma nor bar/ /dge la gzhol nas don gnyis 'grub par shog /ces pa 'di yang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis grogs po yongs la smras pa'o//na mo gu ru/ dbyar gsum nam zla de slebs byung / /rtsal ldan g.yu 'brug nga'i skyid pa/ /lho sprin smug po dang bsdebs nas/ /lha lam yangs pa ru chas 'gro/ /me tog sna tshogs ni skyes byung / /yid 'ong bung ba nga'i skyid pa/ /'dab ma legs po de brgyangs nas/ /gang bzang me tog sar chas 'gro/ /bla mas gdams ngag ni gnang byung / /skal ldan bya btang nga'i skyid pa/ /gsal 'debs be'u bum de khur nas/ /dben gnas gang bzang la chas 'gro/ /zhes pa 'di ni tshogs drug rang grol gyis nyams dga'i gru ru blangs pa'o//rje bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mi rang la rang gros ma btab na/ /grogs gzhan gyis chos la bskul ba dkon/ /don de phyir tshogs drug rang grol nyon/ /khyod snying nas dam chos mdzad 'dod na/ /tshe 'di la phyi mig mi blta na/ /rje gong ma'i rnam thar 141

skyong 'dod na/ /yul pha yul bdud gyi btson ra yin/ /da pha yul spongs la dben pa sten/ /gnyen nye 'brel 'ching ba'i zhags pa yin/ /da 'brel thag chod la gcig pur sdod/ /nor longs spyod dgra 'dre'i g.yab mo yin/ /da zas nor longs spyod dug bzhin spongs/ /lar thams cad 'chi tshe 'jog dgos pas/ /du sa da lta bskyur la ri khrod 'grims/ /tshig 'di tsho bzhin du nyan spyod na/ /yar lha chos skal ba khyod la yod/ /ces pa 'di ni tshogs drug rang grol gyis dben gnas stag mo rdzong nas rang la spras pa'o//chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /a khu tshogs drug rang grol nyon/ /chos pa rab de gshegs pa'i tshe/ /'ja' lus 'od skur grol ba'am/ /yang na dag pa mkha' spyod gshegs/ /chos pa 'bring de gshegs pa'i tshe/ /seng ge bzhin du gangs khrod sogs/ /dben pa'i gnas su gcig pur gshegs/ /'ja' 'od ring bsrel ltas bzang 'byung / /chos pa tha ma 'chi ba'i tshe /grong nas 'chi zhing ltas bzang med/ /tshe 'dir chags pas kha chems 'jog /chos pa rab de gshegs tsa na/ /dper na khwa ta shi ba 'dra/ /phyi nang gang na'ang len rgyu med/ /chos pa 'bring de gshegs tsa na/ /dper na bya rgod shi ba 'dra/ /phyi na gos sogs len rgyu yod/ /chos pa tha ma shi tsa na/ /dper na g.yag rgan 142

bshas pa 'dra/ /phyi nang kun na len rgyu mang / /de phyir tshogs drug rang grol khyod/ /rab bam 'bring bzhin ma shi na/ /don gye chos pa ma yin nges/ /tha ma ltar du shi na ni/ /mi nag rnams dang khyad ci yod/ /chos med tshogs drug rang grol khyod/ /nyin par bza' btung long gtam lab/ /phal cher rnam g.yeng ngang nas 'das/ /dgong mor snga bar ro nyal byas/ /nyi shar bar du gnyid nas bsdad/ /lan rer snga yang phyir la gnyid/ /rgyun du gnyid dang bza' btung sems/ /nyams len mtshan mo'i glog 'gyu tsam/ /khyod kyi spyod pa 'dir bltas na/ /'chi tshe ci 'dra'i sgyug rdzogs ang / /bden pa yin ya dkon mchog mkhyen/ /de tsho soms la bsam blo thongs/ /'chi ba soms la nyams len rem/ /'dis kyang rang gzhan la phan shog /— sa pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//mngon mtho'i bde 'dod kyi byes pa gceca/ phrug de/ /dge bcu'i pha ma dang phrad na dga' ba la/ /nges 'byung rnam dag gi bshul ring mgon po de/ /bslab gsum rang yul du slebs na dga' ba la/ /byang chub sems bzang gi gser 'gyur rtsi mchog de/ /phyin drug lcags phye la jebs na dga' nga/ la/ /zhi gnas mtshan nyid pa'i pho gsar gzhon nu de/ /lhag mthong na chung 143

mar phrad na dga' ba la/ /bskyed rim gsal bo yi 'khor los sgyur rgyal de/ /rdzogs rim gling bzhir dbang bsgyur na dga' ba la/ /khregs chod gnas lugs kyi ded dpon bzang bo de/ /thod rgal nor bu dang phrad na dga' ba la/ /dam chos mdo sngags kyi them skas la 'dzegs te/ /rnam mkhyen khang bzang rtser phyin na dga' ba la/ /zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//gter chen bum bzang dpag bsam shing / /nor bu nyi ma las lhag pa'i/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /spyi gtsug 'khor lo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /sems nyid mkha' ltar rab yangs pago /rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa/ /bya btang gu yangs yan pa ngas/ /rang blo bde ba'i glu zhig len/ /skyes pa'i pha yul rgyab tu bzhag /ri khrod 'grims nas lo 'ga' song / /da lta nye ring chags sdang med/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi blo re bde/ /'grogs pa'i gnyen bshes 'khor g.yog spangs/ /gcig pur bsdad nas lo 'ga' song / /da lta nye 'brel skyong dgos med/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi blo re bde/ /nor rdzas sgyu ma lta bur mthong / /gsog 'jog ma byas lo 'ga' song / /da lta phyi rtsis sdug bsngal med/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi blo re bde/ /dgos med skyes nas gang byung rnams/ /tshogs su btang nas lo 'ga' 144

song/ /da lta ser sna'i sdug bsngal med/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi blo re bde/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis btang / /byar med byas nas lo 'ga' song / /da lta mi zin dogs pa med//rnal 'byor bdag gi blo re bde/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sgo ru zhugs/ /sdom gsum blangs nas lo 'ga' song / /da lta nyes ltung 'byung ba med/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi blo re bde/ /mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams/ /tshul bzhin bsten nas lo 'ga' song / /da lta zab rgyas gdams pa thob/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi blo re bde/ /theg pa'i yang rtse rdzogs chen gyi/ /lta ba rtogs nas lo 'ga' song / /da lta rig stong zang thal ngang / /rnal 'byor bdag gi blo re bde/ /khyad par 'od gsal thod rgal gyi/ /gdams nga/ bsgoms nas lo 'ga' song / /da lta rang snang dag pa'i zhing / /rnal 'byor bdag gi blo re bde/ /mi med lung ba'i brag phug nas/ /glu dbyangs 'brug sgra ldir ba bo/ /blo bde tshogs drug rang grol te/ /dge bas 'gro kun bde bar shog /ces pa 'di yang reb gong glu ba tshogs drug rang grol gyis nyams dga'i glu ru blangs pa'o//nges med 'chi ba 'di la rab 'jigs nas/ /don med tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad spangs/ /mi med ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal na/ /yengs med lha chos byed mkhan rnams la 145

'dud/ /chos rnams thams cad gcig kyang mi rtag ces/ /chos mdzad dam pas gsungs pa go bzhin du/ /chos min tshe 'di'i bya ba lhur len pa'i/ /chos pa'i khyu nas bud pa bdag la gzigs/ /dgung sngon mkha' nas 'od gsal nyi ma yis/ /kho bzhin mi rnams 'jig rten pha rol tu/ /rim bzhin mi sdod 'gro ba yin no zhes/ /brda chos bstan nas nub rir gshegs nas thal/ /bar snang khams nas 'ja' chon ri mo yis/ /kho bzhin gos rgyan zas nor 'dzoms na yang / /mi rtag myur du zad nas 'gro'o zhes/ /brda chos bstan nas mkha' la yal nas thal/ /sa gzhi'i khams nas tshong 'dus mgron po yis/ /kho bzhin bla ma pha ma grogs mched sogs/ /yud tsam 'tshogs pa so sor 'bral lo zhes/ /brda chos bstan nas phyogs bcur gyes nas thas/ /slob dpon 'di tshos brda chos bstan pa de/ /de bzhin thog tu bab tshe 'gyod pa 'ong / /'ong ba shes bzhin da lta 'dug phod dam/ /dam chos mi bsgrub blo gdeng ci zhig yod/ /nyam chung lus 'di 'di bzhin mi rtag par/ /rkyen chung gis 'jig 'jig pa'i tshul soms la/ /skyid chung pha yul yul mi zas nor dang / /don chung chos brgyad brgyad po dug bzhin spongs/ /skyid rung sdug rung rgyun du bya btang gyes/ /na rung 'chi rung rgyun du ri khrod 146

'grims/ /'gro rung 'dug rung rgyun du chos min spongs/ /gzhon rung rgas rung rgyun du lha chos mdzod/ /glu ba tshogs drug rang grol ming can nga / /glu dbyangs snyan mo len mkhan ma yin yang / /glu la dga' ba'i shugs kyis 'di yang blangs/ /glu 'di thos tshad kun la phan thogs shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//drin can chos kyi rgyal bo'i/ /zhabs 'a/ gus pas btud nas/ /dben pa'i dga' ba'i tshal du/ /snyan pa'i glu 'di len no/ /g.ya' spang mtshams su skyes pa'i/ /spang rgyan me tog mdzes kyang / /dgun dus med par 'gyur ba'i/ /gnas tshul bsam zhing skyo ba/ /dal brgyad 'byor bcus brgyan nga/'i/ /mi lus rin chen mdzes kyang / /nam zhig 'jig par 'gyur ba'i/ /gnas tshul bsam zhing skyo ba//bya rgyal khu byug sngon mos/ /skad snyan lhang lhang sgog kyang / /myur du yul gzhan 'gro ba'i/ /gnas tshul bsam zhing skyo ba/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol/ /mgur dbyangs lhang lhang 'then yang / /myur du pha rol 'gro ba'i/ /gnas tshul bsam zhing skyo ba/ /des na da lta gzhon dus/ /tshe 'di'i mi nor zas gsum/ /thams cad blo yib/ thongs la/ /dam pa'i lha chos gyis shig /ces pa 'di ni tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//147

na mo gu ru/ g.yu 'brug sngon mo de yang / /sa la babs na mi mdzes/ /chu 'dzin gseb tu bsdad nas/ /sgra dbyangs bsgrags na mdzes so/ /dar seng dkar mo de yang / /shod du babs na mi mdzes/ /gangs dkar ltongs su 'gyings nas/ /nga ro bsgrags na mdzes so/ /bya btang rnal 'byor de yang / /grong du 'khyams na mi mjes/ /dben par nyams len byas nas/ /mgur dbyangs blangs na mdzes so/ /zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis blangs pa'o//na mo gu ru/ sbrang char 'jam po 'bab cing chu byas skad snyan sgog /sna tshogs me tog g.yo zhing bung ba sgra bcas 'khor/ /dus mi ring bar mi mthun kha rlung 'tshub pa yis/ /sa gzhi skya bor gtong ba'i tshul la bsam zhing skyo/ /dus kyi 'gyur ldog de bzhin da lta'i gnas skabs 'dir/ /lus la nad med smra lce bde zhing blo gsal yang / /dus mi ring bar mi mthun na rga 'chi ba yis/ /bcom nas 'jig rten pha rol 'gro tshul bsam zhing skyo/ /zhes pa 'di ni tshogs drug rang grol gyis nyin zhig sems la skyo shas than thun skyes pa'i tshe blangs pa'o//dad gus kyi nya mo/ /mkhas mang mtshor phyin pas/ /chos gtam gye gnyer ma/ /sna tshogs pa g.yos thal/ /phrag dog gi lcags kyus/ /ma bzung ba skyid do/ /thos bsam gyi nyi zla/ /gsung 148

rab mkhar shar bas/ /mi shes kyi mun pa/ /mthug po de sangs thal/ /nyes spyod kyi gza' yis/ /ma bzung ba skyid do/ /dam chos kyi se 'bru/ /lon tshod la zos pas/ /bdag blo'i pho stong ba/ /cung zad cig 'grangs thal/ /gdams ngag gi mu ge /ma byung ba skyid do/ /brtson 'grus kyi rta la/ /mi rtag lcag brgyab nas/ /sgom sgrub kyi thang du/ /slebs tshod la brgyugs thal/ /le lo yi sgrog gis/ /ma bcings pa skyid do/ /spros med kyi bu mo/ /yengs med rum byas pas/ /nyams rtogs kyi bde snang / /cung zad cig skyes thal/ /rnam g.yeng gi chung grogs/ /ma slebs pa skyid do/ /gzhan phan gye me yis/ /mgur dbyangs shing sbar tshe/ /rmongs pa 'khum 'dug pa/ /'ga' re thar chod thal/ /grags 'dod kyi char gyis/ /ma bsad pa skyid do/ /zhes pa 'di yang reb gong glu ba tshogs drug rang grol gyis nyams dga'i gru ru blangs paḍa(//pha chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo la/ /bdag rtse gcig gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /bu skal bar ldan pa'i thogs med nyon/ /'di ma brjed snying gi dkyil du chongs/ /bu zang zing nor dang phrad pa'i tshe/ /'dod sred chu ltar ma khol bar/ /'phung byed rtsa bar shes bzhin du/ /zas nor dug bzhin spongs shig ang / /bu na chung mjes mar phrad pa'i tshe/ /'dod chags me 149

bzhin ma sbar bar/ /bslu byed bdud mor shes bzhin du/ /chags gtam ngag 'khyal ma lab ang / /bu tshig ngan rdeg rdung byung ba'i tshe/ /ngan lan 'khon 'dzin ma byed par/ /'gro kun pha mar shes bzhin du/ /rgyal kha thams cad byin cig ang / /bu mang bo'i gseb tu sdod pa'i tshe/ /ha cang lab lab ma mang bar/ /lha phog klu phog shes bzhin du/ /tshod bzung ran par smros shig ang / /bu dben gnas ri khrod 'grims pa'i tshe /lus la gces 'dzin ma byed par/ /'khrul snang sems su shes bzhin du/ /lta ba'i sku mkhar rdungs shig ang / /bu lus la na tsha byung ba'i tshe/ /sman dpyad rim gro ma byed par/ /lus sems so sor phral nas kyang / /nad kyi rang bzhin ltos shig ang / /bu lha 'dre'i bar chad byung ba'i tshe/ /'jigs snang rnam rtog ma byed par/ /thams cad stong bar shes bzhin du/ /bdag 'dzin rtsad nas chod cig ang / /bu bkres skom grang bas nyen pa'i tshe/ /snying rus bzod bsran ma chung bar/ /sdig sgrib 'dag par shes bzhin du/ /mi la'i rnam thar soms shig ang / /bu sgom chen bzang bor phrad pa'i tshe/ /nyams myong sba bsri ma byed par/ /rang gzhan gnyis phan shes bzhin du/ /nyams myong go bsdur gyis shig ang / /bu kha bshad mkhan dang phrad pa'i tshe/ /nyams myong 150

kha sgor ma shor bar/ /tshig la don med shes bzhin du/ /brjod med lkug rdzu thobs shig ang / /bu don gyi dri ba byung ba'i tshe/ /g.yo khram sun 'byin ma smra bar/ /bstan 'gror phan pa shes bzhin du/ /g.yo med drang bor smros shig ang / /bu tshig gi rtsod pa byung ba'i tshe/ /'gran sems phrag dog ma byed par/ /snying bo med par shes bzhin du/ /ngan shags tshig ngan ma lab ang / /bu bla ma bzang dang mjal ba'i tshe/ /rang mthong nga rgyal ma che bar/ /'brel tshad don ldan shes bzhin du/ /chos 'brel smon lam thobs shig ang / /bu mdor na rkyen snang gang byung tshe/ /chos brgyad dbang du ma song bar/ /snang stong sgyu mar shes bzhin du/ /rig pa rjen par zhog cig ang / /ang yig bcu bzhi'i zhal gdams 'di/ /rnal 'byor blo la shar nas blangs/ /skal ldan snying gi bu mchog khyod/ /sems la zungs la dga' bar gyis/ /dge 'dis skal ldan slob ma yis/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blos btang nas/ /ring min dben pa bsten nas kyang / /don gnyis lhun gyes 'grub par shog /ces pa 'di ni skal ldan gyi slob ma thogs med la bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis dben gnas stag mo rdzong nas smras pa'o//kha lo chos la sgyur mdzad pa'i/ /kha ba can byon bla ma la/ /kha tsam min par gsol ba 'debs/ /kha bshad mkhan la thugs 1du1

rjes gzigs/ /kha mkhas dkon mchog chos grags nyon/ /kha nas lab lab mi mang bar/ /kha zhe med par chos byed cing / /kha la nyan na 'di bzhin mdzod/ /kha zas 'phyor la ma dga' bar/ /kha rog gcig pur dben pa ru/ /kha ton bzlas brjod nyams len gyis/ /kha ta 'di la mi nyan par/ /kha rgyab khol bo byas gyur na/ /kha yi so lhung skra dkar sgur/ /kha lo nam tshas gtugs dus su/ /kha sems 'gyod do sems kyi bu/ /zhes pa 'di ni tshogs drug rang grol gyis slob ma chos grags la smras pa'o/ / mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /skal ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /bu spyon dkon mchog chos grags ngas/ /skyes pa'i pha yul rgyab tu bor/ /ri khrod dben pa dang du blangs/ /mtshan ldan bla ma spyi bor bsgoms/ /rdzogs pa chen po nyams su blangs/ /nyams rtogs yon tan mthar phyin nas/ /sems can 'gro don byed par shog /ces ri khrod du 'gro bar khas blangs nas 'di smon lam gyi tshul du kho rang gis blangs pa'o//na mo gu ru/ bslu med gtan gyi skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum/ /kun 'dus chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo la/ /rtag tu sgo gsum gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gzhan chos dang mthun par byin gyis rlobs/ /mgur dbyangs 'then pa bya 152

btang phal cher lugs/ /yin phyir tshogs drug rang grol nga yis kyang / /rang gzhan dge la bskul ba'i cha rkyen du/ /drug tshan drug gi glu len bu rnams nyon/ /bla ma ma bsten yon tan 'byung ba dka'/ /dag snang med na nyams rto gas skye ba dka'/ /'chi ba ma dran gdams ngag thebs pa dka'/ /'du 'dzi'i klong du byang chub bsgrub pa dka'/ /snying rus chung na grol rtags thon pa dka'/ /dka' ba ma spyad snyan grags 'byung ba dka'/ /dka' ba drug gi 'phrang 'di sgol bar gyes/ /mdo rgyud kun las bla ma'i man ngag zab/ /man ngag nang nas gnad du dril ba zab/ /de nyid rang gis nyams su len pa zab/ /nyams len byed tshe rtse gcig bsgrub pa zab/ /bsgrub pa de nyid yun du bskyal ba zab/ /yun du bskyal nas drod rtags thon pa zab/ /zab pa drug gi tshul ltar bsgrub pa gces/ /mtshan ldan bla ma bsten na rigs ldan yin/ /ci gsung tshad mar 'dzin na rgyal sras yin/ /rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin bsgrubs na dam ldan yin/ /nor la bdag 'dzin med na bya btang yin/ /'gro kun pha mar rtogs na byang sems yin/ /chos kun sgyu mar rtogs na grub chen yin/ /yin tshul drug gi tshul la gnas par gyes/ /phan sems rdul tsam med na bla ma min/ /bsam sbyor gnyis gyis mi bsten slob ma min/ /153

g.yo sgyus pha rol pham na chos pa min/ /gcig shes kun grol ma shes mkhas pa min/ /zas nor gsog 'jog che na bya btang min/ /'du 'dzi g.yeng ba che na sgom chen min/ /ma yin drug po 'di nyid shes par gyis/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i gsung la bslu ba med/ /ci gsungs tshad mar bsgrubs las zab pa med/ /dge sdig blang dor byed las dge ba med/ /dben gnas ri khrod zin las skyid pa med/ /yun du bsgrubs na mi 'grub gang yang med/ /ka dag rang byung rang ngo 'khrul ba med/ /bslu med drug po 'di nyid nyams su longs/ /thos pas phyi yi sgro 'dogs chod pa dgos/ /bsam pas gnad kyi thog tu phebs pa dgos/ /bsgoms pas yid ches grol rtags thon pa dgos/ /'chi ba bsams nas chos la snying rus dgos/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis thongs pa dgos/ /glo bur 'chi yang 'gyod med gdeng rnyed dgos/ /dgos pa drug po 'di nyid tshad mar zungs/ /drug tshan drug gi snyan pa'i glu dbyangs 'di/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol zhes byas blangs/ /dge 'dis 'gro drug sems can ma lus pa/ /nyon mongs drug las myur du grol bar shog /ces pa 'di ni skal ldan gyi slob ma sngags 'chang ba le sogs dad can 'ga' zhig gis bskul ngor dben gnas stag mo rdzong nas smras pa'o//154

na mo gu ru/ dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid//slob dpon chen po pad 'byung dang / /dbyer med chos kyi rgyal po la/ /snying nas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi/ /dad ldan sems kyi bu khyod nyon/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /zhal gdams gnang ngo snying gi bu/ /de la dgongs la lha chos mdzod/ /'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba med/ /yod par gyur kyang yud tsam yin/ /gtan gyi bde ba bsgrub pa la/ /chos las med do snying gi bu/ /gtan bde byed dam gtan sdug byed/ /da lta 'dam dbang rang la yod/ /rang dbang rang la yod thog 'dir/ /'dam kha ma nor snying gi bu/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun/ /bla ma dag la rag las par/ /mdo rgyud kun las gsung bas na/ /gsol ba thobs shig snying gi bu/ /dal 'byor tshang ba'i mi lus 'di/ /rnyed dka' u dum wa ra 'dra/ /don med chud zos ma byed par/ /snying bo longs shig snying gi bu/ /mi lus thob nas ga tsam song / /bza' btung sogs la ji tsam spyad/ /bsams na snying bo ga 'dra 'dug /dam chos mdzod cig snying gi bu/ /dam chos byed lugs mang na yang / /gang mos shig la nyams len gyis/ /dung dkar 'o mas gsos pa ltar/ /'chi dus dgos so snying gi bu/ /yul mi khyim mtshes shi ba de/ /rang nyid 'chi ba'i snga 155

ltas yin/ /'chi brod phyi ma'i brgyags phye zhig /da nas gsogs shig snying gi bu/ /nyin mo rnam g.yeng le lo byed/ /mtshan mo gti mug ro nyal byed/ /dge sbyor glog 'gyu tsam byas nas/ /nyams rtogs ma 'dod snying gi bu/ /'chi bdag rgyal po slebs pa'i tshe/ /dam chos las gzhan skyabs med pas/ /chos phyir lus srog 'dor nus pa'i/ /snying rus dgos so snying gi bu/ /dge sdig chung ngu yin yang rung / /phyi mar rnam smin shin tu che/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab dpang bzhag nas/ /blang dor mdzod cig snying gi bu/ /khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas 'di na/ /sdug bsngal ma gtogs bde ba med/ /me yi 'obs ltar bltas nas kyang / /zhen pa ldog dgos snying gi bu/ /yang sgos ngan song sdug bsngal rnams/ /soms la tshogs bsags sgrub sbyong gyes/ /dal 'byor don ldan mdzad nus na/ /bu rgod yin no snying gi bu/ /'gro ba sems can thams cad kun/ /pha mar ma gyur gcig kyang med/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems/ /yang yang sgoms shig snying gi bu/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas bgrod pa'i thabs zab lam rjogs pa chen po yin/ /snying rus sdug bsran go gyon nas/ /nyams len mdzod cig snying gi bu/ /mdor bsdus gnad 'gag 'di bzhin gyis/ /khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la byin/ /gyong dang pham 156

kha rang gis longs/ /'di min med do snying gi bu/ /gtam 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /dad pa dam tshig ldan pa yi/ /skal ldan bu la smras pa yin/ /smras pa bzhin du bsgrub par shog /ces pa 'di ni mgar rtse'i phyogs kyi dad ldan sngags 'chang rta mgrin gyis zhal gdams shig dgos zhes yang yang bskul ngor/ bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis dben gnas stag mo rdzong nas smras pa'o//kun gsal mkhyen brtse'i rta bdun dkyil 'khor las/ /kun khyab thugs rje'i 'od zer stong 'phros pas/ /kun bzang rang ngo ma 'phrod 'khor 'khyams 'gro/ /kun gyi ma rig mun sel bla mar 'dud/ /ka shi'i ras mtshungs dri med legs bshad 'di/ /kha mkhas bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /ga bur bzhin du dkar ba'i lhag bsam gyis/ /nga yi grogs po rnams la dbul bar bya/ /ca co'i gtam sogs rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi spongs/ /cha lugs ngan ngon tsam gyis chog shes gyis/ /ja sogs gang byung 'tsho ba bsten byas nas/ /nya lto ba ltar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs/ /ta thā ga ta'i chos sgor zhugs dus 'dir/ /tha snyad tshig la ha cang ma dga' bar/ /da nas bzung ste rdzogs chen don sgoms la/ /na 'chis gtugs tshe blo sems bde bar gyes/ /pa sangs ltar dkar gzhan phan sems mchog gis/ /pha mar gyur pa'i nyam thag 'gro kun la/ /ba spu g.yo ba'i snying rje 157

cher bskyed nas/ /ma lus don du dam pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /tsā ri la sogs dben pa'i gnas rnams su/ /tsha grang khod snyoms lus sems bde dus 'dir/ /dza hu'i rgyun dang yur ba gong chad la/ /wa btsugs chu ltar 'chad med khregs chod skyongs/ /zha 'theng ma yin dal 'byor tshang dus 'dir/ /za ma'i bza' btung gti mug ro nyal ngang / /'a le 'o ler mi tshe ma 'chor bar/ /ya mtshan rmad byung thod rgal bsgom par mdzod/ /ra lug la sogs nor rdzas phran tshegs phyir/ /la lung kun tu khye bzhin ma 'khyams par/ /sha rkyang ri dwags rtse ba'i dben pa'i gnas/ /sa phyogs de 'dra da lta nyid du sten/ /ha cang bu dang chung mar ma chags par/ /a ru rnam rgyal lta bu'i gcig chog chos/ /a ti yang gsang rdzogs chen nyams blangs nas/ /a don 'gyur med chos sku mngon gyur mdzod/ /ces zho 'ong la kha'i mched grogs rnams chos la bskul ba'i phyir legs bshad ka shi ga'i ras 'jam 'di ni snyom las pa tshogs drug rang grol gyis dben gnas stag mo rdzong nas smras pa'o/ /e bya btang mgrin pa glu yi dkor mdzod nas/ /legs bshad zab mo ka sha'i ras 'jam 'di/ /nyon mongs tsha grang skyob phyir phul ba lags/ /brjed med gyon la nyams len bro gar khrobs/ /zhes mched grogs yongs la gdams pa'o//158

mtha' bral lta ba zab mo'i gru chen dbus/ /mtha' yas snying rje'i dar chen rab 'phyar nas/ /mtha' med srid mtshor lhung ba'i nyam thag 'gro/ /mtha' dag sgol ba'i dad dpon bla mar 'dud/ /rang dang 'grogs pa'i bu dang chung ma dang / /rang gis bsags pa'i rdzas la sems chags nas/ /rang bzhin gnas lugs don la mi brtson pa'i/ /rang gi grogs po rnams la snying gtam smra/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i mdo sngags legs 'khrid pa'i/ /rgyal ba nyid las lhag pa'i bla ma de/ /rgyal ba gong ma'i rnam thar ji bzhin du/ /rgyal ba dngos ltar bsam sbyor gnyis kyis bsten/ /rnyed par dka' ba'i mi lus rin chen 'di/ /rnyed pa'i dus 'dir chos la mi brtson par/ /rnyed dang bkur sti'i las la brtson byas na/ /rnyed dka'i rten bzang thob kyang dud 'gro yin/ /mi rtag 'chi ba nam 'ong cha med pas/ /mi dge sdig pa spangs nas dge bsgrub phyir/ /mi med lung stong yid 'ong sa phyogs su/ /mi la ras pa'i rnam thar skyong bar mdzod/ /'khor dang longs spyod kun la chags gyur na/ /'khor ba'i gnas su zo chun 'khyud mo ltar/ /'khor zhing sdug bsngal mtha' med myong dgos phyir/ /'khor ba'i bya ba thams cad dug bzhin spongs/ /bdag gi sgye ba thog ma ma mchis phyir/ /bdag gi pha 159

mar ma gyur sems can med/ /bdag nyid drin gyis bskyangs pa'i 'gro kun la/ /bdag pas gzhan gces byang chub sems mchog sgoms/ /skye 'chi med pa'i pad 'byung thugs kyi bcud/ /dka' tshegs med pa'i zab mo'i lam bzang mchog /'gran zla med pa'i rdzogs chen lta ba la/ /'gyur ba med pa'i gdeng thob nyams len gyes/ /kun la ma grags thod rgal gdams pa 'di/ /kun las khyad par bdun gyes 'phags pa'i tshul/ /kun mkhyen klong chen mdzod las gsungs pas na/ /kun gyis brtson 'grus gyis la bsgom par mdzod/ /snying gtam ka la piṅka'i sgra dbyangs 'di/ /snying grogs rnams kyi snyan la phul ba'i don/ /snying bo med pa'i tshe 'di blos gtong ba'i/ /snying rus can re e yod bsams nas so/ /dge ba'i chos la grogs rnams bskul ba'i gtam/ /dge 'dis rang gzhan 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /dge ba'i bshes kyis rtag tu rjes bzung nas/ /dge la gzhol nas myur du 'tshang rgya shog /ces snying gtam ka la piṅka'i sgra dbyangs 'di ni snyom las pa tshogs drug rang grol gyes dben gnas stag mo rdzong nas zho 'ong la kha'i mched grogs rnams la phul ba'o//e ma ho/ dbyangs snyan ka la piṅka'i phru gu nga / /pha yul sgo nga'i sbubs las thon nas kyang / /thos bsam sgom gsum 'dab gshog legs brkyangs nas/ /yid 'ong dben pa'i dpag 160

bsam ljon shing rtser/ /'phur nas legs bshad chos kyi sgra dbyangs de/ /lhang lhang phyogs bcur yongs su sgrog pa yin/ /yid 'phrog shin tu snyan pa'i dbyangs snyan 'dis/ /gzhan yid phrogs nas ljon shing rtser 'dzeg shog /ces de rnams kyi phyogs su bltas nas brtse ba'i sems kyis de rnams 'khor ba'i bya ba bu dang chung mar spu tsam yang mi chags par las can mang bo dben par nga phyir 'brangs nas nyams len byed par gyur cig ces smon lam legs par btab bo//e glu 'di la lha dang bla ma dgyes/ /tshig 'di la mkha' 'gro rnams kyang mnyes/ /bro 'di la mthu ldan srung ma bzhad/ /dbyangs 'di la lha 'dre rnams kyang nyan/ /skyid nyi ma phu shar mdo shar lags/ /nyams dga' 'o skyid do mched grogs rnams/ /gnas dben pa dag zhing lta bu nas/ /glu 'di 'dra 'jen na nga phyir shog /ces bro 'khrab bo//kun gsal chos sku'i nam mkha' la/ /kun khyab thugs rje'i sprin 'khrigs nas//kun la chos char 'bebs mkhas pa'i/ /kun mkhyen bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /skal ldan bdag gi glu dbyangs 'di/ /dam ldan grogs rnams snyan du 'bul/ /u dum wa ra'i me tog de/ /dkon mchog drung du phul na legs/ /ri bzhi nyil ba'i 'ur sgra la/ /skrag nas myur du bros na legs/ /spun pa rlung la bskur nas kyang / /snying bo'i 'bras bu blangs na legs/ /glang 161

chen 'dam du ma byeng bar/ /rtsal stobs bskyed de bud na legs/ /ci 'dod stsol ba'i nor bu la/ /dgos 'dod gsol ba btab na legs/ /kun la dbang bsgyur rgyal po yi/ /rgyal sa bu yis bzung na legs/ /bde zhing mgyogs pa'i rta pho la/ /lcag gis yang yang brabs na legs/ /lus srog bskyed pa'i a ma la/ /rin chen rgyan cha btags na legs/ /dbus kyi ri bo'i rtser phyin nas/ /lha yi rnga chen brdungs na legs/ /mtsho gling skyed mos nags tshal nas/ /khu byug skad snyan grags na legs/ /sra zhing yang ba'i gos bzang zhig /mtshams pa'i rtags su bskur ba legs/ /zhal gdams snyan pa'i pi wang 'di/ /grogs rnams snyan du brdungs na legs/ /snying dang 'dra ba'i mched grogs la/ /snying gtam 'di bzhin mdzad na legs/ /zhes brda yis bshad pa'i zhal gdams snyan pa'i pi wang 'di ni mched grogs yongs la bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis dben gnas stag mo rdzong nas phul ba'o//e ma ho/ 'di 'dra'i glu dbyangs len pa la/ /lha dang bla ma'i byen rlabs 'jug /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyise dngos grub ster/ /chos skyong srung mas 'phrin las bsgrub/ /lha 'dre mi gsum sdongs grogs byed/ /gcig pur 'dug tshe grogs kyi mchog /de phyir skal ldan mched grogs rnams/ /'di 'dra len na ri la shog162

ces mched grogs yongs la phul ba dge'o//dge'o//dge'o//chos kyi rgyal por gsol ba 'debs/ /chos grogs yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /brda tshig don ni mi shes na/ /nges tshig 'di yin legs par nyon/ /dal 'byor mi lus thob dus 'dir/ /snying bo chos la blangs na legs/ /skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal la/ /skrag nas dben pa bsten na legs/ /tshe 'di rlung la bskur nas kyang / /dge ba'i 'bras bu blangs na legs/ /khyed rnams 'khor bar ma chags par/ /skyo shas bskyed nas bud na legs/ /mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /zab mo'i dbang khrid zhus na legs/ /skyes chen gong ma'i rnam thar de/ /khyed rnams da lta bskyangs na legs/ /ka dag khregs chod lta ba la/ /yengs med brtson 'grus byas na legs/ /khregs chod lta ba'i bogs 'don du/ /lhun 'grub thod rgal bsgoms na legs/ /rdzogs chen nyams len mthar phyin nas/ /'gro ba'i don la brtson na legs/ /yid 'ong dben pa'i gnas mchog nas/ /glu dbyangs 'di 'dra blangs na legs/ /stong gsal nam mkha' yangs pa 'di/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi 'tshams rtags lags/ /chos dang mthun pa'i grogs po rnams/ /chos byed bskul ma btab pa lags/ /sha tshas rang snying bton na yang / /sha tshil gnyis min 163

ci yang med/ /'di bzhin nyams su len nus na/ /'di phyi kun tu skyid par nges/ /kha ta byed kyang 'di min med/ /kha chems 'jog kyang 'di min med/ /dge 'dis rang gzhan thams cad kyis/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blos thongs shog /ces zhal gdams snyan pa'i pi wang gi brda grol gyi yi ge 'di ni bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis dben gnas stag mo rdzong nas bris pa'o/ /yi ge 'di rnams nga skyid pa'i shugs kyis khyed rnams kyi nang na yang nga lta bu'i skyid po byed mkhan re re gnyis gnyis e yod bsams nas/ yi ge'i khur la ma 'dzems par phul ba yin pas/ de ltar mdzad pa re re gnyis gnyis yod na nga rtsad chod la myur du shog cig nga yang khyed rnams la thag je ring du bud 'gro na'ang go shes med pa'i phyir/ nged rnams thug kyang 'di ma gtogs kha brda gzhan med/ shi 'gro yang kha chems 'di min gzhan ci yang ma mchis pas/ kun gyis thugs la bzhag nas lag tu len par zhu/ yig rten nam mkha' bcas zla tshes bzang bor phul/bla ma dkon mchog spyi bo'i gtsug tu bzhugs/ /bdag gzhan blo kha dam pa'i chos la sgyur/ /kun la 'phral phugs bde ba'i bslab bya byed/ /bod kyi tshogs drug rang grol glu la nyon/ /lto rgyab las lhag zas nor mang 'dzom dus/ /pha ma a khur gser dngul thar mdo phris/ /a mchod zhog la brgya stong 'don du chugs/ /rang yul bla ma dge 'dun yar la mchod/ /rang sde'i dbul phongs rnams la sbyin gtong gyis/ /gnyen bshes phan thogs khyem mtshes g.yor skyi gyis/ /phyugs dang sgo khye rnams la ma brdungs gsos/ /srog gcod rku 'phrog dbyen rdzun gtam ma 164

mang / /g.yag dang ra lug bsad nas chos ma bco/ /bre rgyar g.yo sgyu byas nas tshong ma byed/ /bud med ngan ma'i kha la nyan na 'phung / /mgron po khyim du su byung lha bzhin mchod/ /kha 'jam khog nag mi la blo ma 'dri/ /kha dbyen jag rkun rdzun mang grogs ma sten/ /mang bo'i nang du ha cang gtam ma mang / /gzhan gyis ma bcol las la phar ma 'tshangs/ /dpa' bos rang tshod zin na rang srog brtan/ /rtsod gzhi can gye zas gos nor ma len/ /sa chu me rlung bzhi la phod ma btsongs/ /dud chang bud med rnams la sred ma che/ /mi thub dgra la 'thabs na rang pham 'gyur/ /mi shes shes dzu mang na myur du ltung / /khog tu mi 'ju ba yi zas ma za/ /gnyid dang le lo che na don chen 'chor/ /med po za heb che na za yun thung / /phyug po ser sna che na dgra phyogs 'chor/ /ngo lkog gtam gnyis smras na kun gyis sdang / /gzhan la bsam pa gnag na bsod nams 'dzad/ /gcig gis gcig bstod phan tshun ngan ma gtam/ /rgan rgon bshad rgyu ma mang ma ṇi rem/ /kha tshag che na 'khor g.yog rnyed par dka'/ /'dod sred che na kun gyis brnyas smod mang / /grogs la ngan smras phyi nas tshor nyen che/ /kha yangs mi la gsang ba'i gtam ma smra/ /za ma bgo dus rang skal chung na mdzes/ /thos na gzhan kun dga' bskyed 165

gtam snyan rjod/ /skyid theg sdug theg go chod bran g.yog bzang / /kha nyung lag gtsang khog yangs bud med rab/ /mi tsho'i sems la gnod pa'i tshig ma smra/ /bla slob rgyal blon pha bu 'chams na skyid/ /gtong phod che ba'i mi la snyan grags che/ /ser sna che ba'i phyug por mi khas sdang / /rgyal pos kun la byams na rang sde rgyas/ /bla mas chos bzhin byas na bstan 'gror phan/ /gzhon nus rgan pa bkur na bsod nams sgye/ /grogs bzang bsten na je bzang je bzang 'gyur/ /glu 'di bya btang tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /dge 'dis 'gro kun 'phral phugs bde bar shog /ces pa 'di yang mgar rtse'i sngags pa dad ldan zhig gis bskul ngor smras pa'o //pha rgan chos rgyal rin po che/ /bu yi spyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs/ /da ni drin can bla ma yis/ /ci gsung bka' bzhin bsgrub tu 'gro/ /'du 'dzi g.yeng ba rab che ba'i/ /grong dgon sku khams bde bar bzhugs/ /bdag ni 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba dang / /bral ba'i ri khrod 'grim du 'gro/ /chags sdang gnyis ka bsgyed pa yi/ /gnyen bshes sku khams bde bar bzhugs/ /bdag ni chags sdang mi 'byung ba'i/ /chos mdzad grogs dang 'grog tu 'gro/ /dgra 'dre gnyis ka 'bod mkhan gye/ /rgyu nom sku khams bde bar bzhugs/ /bdag ni nam yang 'dzad med 166

pa'i/ /'phags pa'i nor bdun gsog tu 'gro/ /snying bo cung zad tsam med pa'i/ /tshe 'di sku khams bde brdo bzhugs/ /bdag ni phyi mar gtan bde ba'i/ /snying bo'i lha chos byed du 'gro/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyes/ /ri khrod 'grim dus shig tu blangs/ /'di nyid thos tshad skal ldan gyis/ /bla ma'i bka' bzhin chos byed shog /ces pa 'di yang reb gong glu bas smras pa'o//shing sngo ljang rgyas pa'i bsil grib kyi/ /mdog rab mdzes khu byug sngon mo nyon/ /rang 'dod pa'i ri la 'phur dus su/ /skad snyan mo mi sgrog nam tshod sgrog /da gsung dbyangs snyan mo mi sgog par/ /kha kha rog song na ngo re tsha/ /yul pha mas khang bzang nyams dga' nas/ /gos rgyan cha btags pa'i bag ma nyon/ /rang 'dod pa'i gnas la 'gro dus su/ /dbyangs snyan mo mi 'then nam tshod 'jen/ /da bag dus snyan mo mi 'then par/ /kha kha rog song na ngo re tsha/ /rje mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhabs drung gi /blo rig pa gsal ba'i bya btang nyon/ /rang 'dod pa'i ri la 'gro ba'i tshe/ /glu snyan mo mi len nam tshod len/ /da glu dbyangs snyan mo mi len par/ /kha kha rog song na ngo re tsha/ /zhes pa 'di yang dben pa'i ri la 'gro dus shig tu lam bar nas rang la glu longs zhes bskul bas de'i lan du skyid pa'i rgyang gru 'di blangs so//167

khri mtho la yangs pa'i gdan steng na/ /mi bsod nams can gye rgyal po skyid/ /'khor longs spyod rgyas na de bas skyid/ /gsung snyan mo byon na gzhan yang skyid/ /gser sga srab mdzes pa'i rta thog na/ /pho bde myur can gyi gzhon nu skyid/ /rta gom pas song na de bas skyid/ /glu snyan mo 'then na gzhan yang skyid/ /gnas ri khrod dben pa'i bsil grib na/ /chos zab mo sgrub pa'i sgom chen skyid/ /nyams rtogs pa shar na de bas skyid/ /mgur snyan mo blangs na gzhan yang skyid/ /stod dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i lha bzo tsho/ /don med pa'i yengs la ma dga' bar/ /lha'i sku gzugs legs po khyod bzos dang / /sa a mdo'i lha bzos yid smon 'chor/ /smad rgya mo glu len dar 'thag tsho/ /don med pa'i yengs la ma dga' bar/ /gos ri mo can po khyod thogs dang / /bod snam 'thag rnams kyis yid smon 'chor/ /gnas nges med ri yi bya btang khyod/ /don med pa'i yengs la ma dga' bar/ /chos zab mo tshul bzhin khyod sgrubs dang / /grong skya ser rnams kyis yid smon 'chor/ /zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis 'jig rten pa'i glu dang sgo bstun nas rtse mtshar du blangs pa'o//rje rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags/ /spyir 'gro ba yongs su thugs rjes gzigs/ /sgos bstan la gus pa'i rnal 'byor 168

pa/ /thugs brtse bas ma dor yun ring skyongs/ /rje'i bstan pa dper na nam mkha' yis/ /sa bkab bzhin phyogs kun khyab nas gda'/ /bstan de 'dzin skyes bu ri brag bzhin/ /phyogs phyogs na mang bo mang bo snang / /khyod nged gnyis sa gseb srin bu 'dra/ /bstan 'dzin yang mi thub bshig mi nus/ /rgyud dug lnga cung zad ma zhi bar/ /nga bstan 'dzin smras na blo bzang bzhad/ /nang zhe sdang mkhan gyis bstan 'dzin na/ /khyed 'dra ba'i bstan 'dzin deng sang dkon/ /rje'i bstan pa khyod kyis bzung ma snyam/ /khyod nged gnyis bstan pa'i bla btsong red/ /bla ma btsongs kha rog ga ler sdod/ /nga rnal 'byor lam la 'gro ru chugs/ /dge 'dis kyang blo bzang grags pa yi/ /bstan phyogs dus kun tu rgyas par shog /ces pa 'di yang bla rgan 'ga' res nga'i mgo'i mtshams skra mthong nas/ bya ba mi 'phrod pa byas bstan bshig ka tsho zer/ tshig ngan mang bo smras pa'i lan du bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i rnam thar bzhin/ /chos bzhin 'khor 'bangs sde rnams legs skyong zhing / /chos la thos bsam sgom gsum mdzad pa yi/ /chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo'i zhabs la 'dud/ /dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar ji bzhin du/ /du ma'i ri khrod dben pa'i gnas rnams su/ /su dang ma phrad gcig 169

pur bsdad pas skyid/ /skyid pa'i shugs kyis skyid pa'i rgyang glu len/ /tshe sngon goms pa'i bag chags shin tu bzang / /bzang bo'i chos la chung nas rab tu dad/ /dad gus mos pas mtshan ldan bla ma yang / /yang dag bsten nas zab chos thob pas skyid/ /mi lus nor bu ngur sprig gos kyis g.yogs/ /mi med ri khrod rgyal mtshan rtser bzhag pas/ /mi ni rab 'bring tha gsum su yin yang / /mi nga chos mthun mchod bkur byas pas skyid/ /nyams grib skyon gyes nam yang mi gos pas/ /nyams dga'i ri khrod dben pa'i gnas mchog tu/ /nyams su blo sbyong lam rim rdzogs chen blangs/ /nyams rtogs rgyud la cung zad shar bas skyid/ /bod yul kha ba can gyi rgyal khams kyi/ /rnal 'byor kha mkhas tshogs drug rang grol khyod/ /skyid pa'i kha pho bshad pa thos tshad kyi/ /mi rnams kha lo chos la 'gyur bar shog /ces pa 'di yang reb gong gi glu ba kha mkhas kyis smras pa'o//rab mdzes sku mchog mchog de sus mthong sngon las las kyi sgrib pa 'dag /rab snyan gsung gang gang gi rna bas thos na na 'chi'i 'jigs las sgrol/ /rab dkar thugs dgongs dgongs pas mkha' mnyam 'gro kun kun la bu bzhin byams/ /rab mang 'gro rnams rnam mkhyen sa la 'khrid mkhas mkhas pa'i 170

dbang bor 'dud/ /ko sa la yi yul gyi khyim bdag 'byor ldan tan bye langs bzhin du/ /kho ra khor yug bu dang chung ma zas nor thams cad blos thongs la/ /go ma gyon pa'i dpa' bo g.yul 'jug ji bzhin snying stobs chen po yis/ /ngo mtshar rmad byung gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i chos la sbyangs na legs/ /co ne dpon po 'dra ba'i chung ma 'khor g.yog stobs dang 'byor ba dang / /cho rigs ji ltar mtho yang yud tsam yin pas myur du 'dzad par 'gyur/ /jo bo rje dang mi la la sogs rgya bod mkhas grub rnam thar bzhin/ /nyo tshong la sogs bya ba ngan pa dor te nyams len byas na legs/ /do gal che ba'i bla ma bsten la mi shes mun pa'i smag rum rnams/ /tho rangs nam mkha' dwangs ngos nyi ma shar bzhin thos pas sgro 'dogs chod/ /do zla med pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang dam pa thob 'dod na/ /mno bsam thams cad chos la btang ste nyin mtshan rtag tu bsgoms na legs/ /po ta lar bzhugs spyan ras gzigs kyis 'gro la bu bzhin brtse ba ltar/ /pho rgod khyod kyang 'gro ba yongs la rtag tu byams dang brtse bas skyongs/ /bo la khad kyi zas snod ji bzhin cung zad rkyen la ma khro bar/ /mo gsham bu dang ri bong rwa bzhin khro ba kun dang bral na legs/ /tso rar bcug pa'i 171

nyes can 'bros bzhin yul nas bros la dben pa bsten/ /tsho tsho snum snum sha sogs zas la ha cang ma dga' dka' thub gyes/ /dzo la me yi steng du shing bsnan ja bzhin rkyen ngan grogs su khyer/ /wo lugs ji bzhin sgyid lugs ma 'dug ska rags bsdams 'dra'i snying rus legs/ /zho 'ong gtan gyi pha yul min pas yul la zhen pas ci zhig bya/ /zo mdog bzang zhing stobs rtsal rgyas pa'i da lta gzhon thog 'di nyid la/ /'o ma brtson pas bsgrogs nas 'bri mar ser bo len pa ji bzhin du/ /yo byad nyung ngu tsam la brten nas dal 'byor snying bo blangs na legs/ /ro mngar zas la tshwa chu 'thung bzhin ngoms pa med pas chog shes gyis/ /lo zla song gyin 'chi la nye bas sgrub la brtson 'grus me ltar sbor/ /sho yi me sogs chos min bya byed thams cad rgyab tu bskyur nas kyang / /so dkar dus su sgrub la gzhol dang skra dkar dus su blo bde legs/ /ho ho he te'i ku re bzhad gad la sogs ngag 'khyal ma mang bar/ /o rgyan thugs bcud rdzogs chen dben par sgoms la 'di 'dra'i mgur dbyangs longs/ /ngo mtshar che ba'i legs bshad 'di nyid rang gzhan chos la bskul ba'i phyir/ /zho 'ong la kha'i bya btang tshogs drug rang grol zhes byas blangs pa lags/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags 172

pa'i dge bas nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam 'gro kun gyis/ /dge ba'i sa gzhi gshin por bden tshig smon lam sa bon gang btab pa/ /bla ma mchog gsum thugs rje'i chu lud drod gsher bcud kyis legs bskyangs nas/ /rmad byung 'dod pa'i don gnyis 'bras bu myur ba myur du smin par shog /ces pa 'di yang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis dben gnas ge tho'i mgul nas rang la smras pa'o//'o 'o mngon mtho'i bde 'dod byis pa/ /a'u dge bcu'i pha mar 'grog dus/ /kho re mgur dbyangs mtshar gtam shod dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi 'o 'o nges 'byung thag ring mgon po/ /a'u bslab gsum grong khyer snyeg dus/ /kho re mgur dbyangs lam glu longs dang / /te he blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o byang chub sems kyi dzi bo/ /a'u phyin drug phyugs rnams 'tsho dus/ /kho re mgur dbyangs glu chung longs dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o zhi gnas khye'u gzhon nu/ /a'u lhag mthong bu mor 'grog dus/ /kho re mgur dbyangs 'khrig tshig shod dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o bskyed rim rma bya gzhon nu/ /a'u rdzogs rim gar stabs byed dus/ /kho re mgur dbyangs dar dir sgogs dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /173

ya yi ya yi/ /'o 'o khregs chod rgya mo mdzes ma/ /a'u thod rgal gos dar 'thag dus/ /kho re mgur dbyangs skyid glu longs dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi 'o 'o bya btang khu byug sngon mo/ /a'u ri khrod shing khar 'phur dus/ /kho re mgur dbyangs skad snyan sgrogs dang / /he te blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ /zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyes ku re'i tshul du bris pa'o//na mo gu ru/ seng ge gangs dkar ltongs na bde/ /rgod bo brag dmar klad na bde/ /ri dwags spang gzhongs 'jam por bde/ /nya mo mtsho yi nang na bde/ /stag mo nags kyi gseb na bde/ /nga rnal 'byor dben pa'i ri na bde/ /steng na sra ba'i brag khung bde/ /'og na sngo ljang rtswa gdan bde/ /bar na rnal 'byor sgyu lus bde/ /ngag nas glu dbyangs blangs pas bde/ /sems la nyams rtogs shar bas bde/ /yon bdag 'khor bcas bde lags sam/ /zhes pa 'di yang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis a rig gi dad can yon bdag 'ga' la rtse mtshar du blangs pa'o//e ma ri khrod dben pa na/ /dbyar dang ston gyi dus skabs su/ /ne'u thang me tog sna tshogs bkra/ /bung bas khyu brten snyan pa 'byen/ /ljon shing yal 'dab mdzes par rgyas/ /bya bye'us 174

sgra 'byin 'phur lding g.yo/ /chu mig dzing bu bsil ngad ldang / /sus 'thungs skom pa'i gdung ba sel/ /mtsho dang rdzing bu'i nang na yang / /ngang ba skad snyan yid 'ong 'phyo/ /bde 'jam yangs pa'i spang gzhongs na/ /ri dwags du ma bag phebs rgyu/ /de ltar ngo mtshar mtha' yas pa'i/ /yid 'ong dben pa'i gnas mchog tu/ /sngo ljang rtswa yi gdan 'jam steng / /nam zhig bdag nyid nyal bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol ri la dga' ba'i shugs kyis bsod snyoms su song dus shig tu smras pa'o//pha chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bdag jag rkun 'jigs las bskyab tu gsol/ /srog gcod pa'i kha zas rab spangs nas/ /'dab chags kyi drang srong bya rgod de/ /brag dmar bo bskor nas 'ong dus su/ /mda' ma 'phen stag shar skyen po tsho/ /sdig sha yi kha zas rab spangs nas/ /rir 'dug pa'i nyes med ri dwags de/ /rtswa chu yi phyir du 'ong dus su/ /me mda' yis ma rgyag rngon pa tsho/ /tshe 'di yi bya ba rab spangs nas/ /gnas dben par 'dug pa'i rnal 'byor de/ /gnas phyogs med ri khrod 'grim dus su/ /brkus 'phrog bcom ma byed ya bo tsho/ /zhesapa 'di ni dben gnas shig tu 'gro dus jag pa mi lnga tsam la 'phrad dus su jag pa rnams kyis bdag la dpe cha ma gtogs len rgyu med pas dpe cha ma blangs/ de dus su yid la shar ba blangs pa'o//175

na mo gu ru/ rje rdo rje 'chang dbang mi gzugs can/ /pha chos rgyal spyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs/ /sems ri khar phyogs pa'i rnal 'byor ngas/ /'phral skyid pa'i shugs kyis glu 'di len/ /gnas ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal na/ /dgo ba sogs ri dwags bang rtsal sbyong / /bya rgod pos mkha' la gshog rtsal sbyong / /dus rgyun du dben par bde zhing skyid/ /gangs rab dkar yol ba bres bzhin mdzes/ /smug pa yis rked bcings do shal bstar/ /shing sna tshogs dra ba dra phyed bres/ /dus rgyun du dben par bde zhing skyid/ /ngos kun na rdza chus snyan pa brjod/ /mdog rab mjes me tog 'dzum zhing rgod/ /rkang drug ldan bung bas glu dbyangs len/ /dus rgyun du dben par bde zhing skyid/ /bya sna tshogs skad snyan mang bo sgog /zas rang grub shing thog tshod ma la/ /bcud myang na zhim pa'i bro ba yod/ /dus rgyun du dben par bde zhing skyid/ /chu shing gnyis thag nyer gnas pa yis/ /'khor g.yog ni gcig kyang med na yang / /chu shing phyir ngal ba mi dgos pas/ /dus rgyun du dben par bde zhing skyid/ /chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen zas gos gnyis/ /mi dad can yon bdag rnams kyis sbyor/ /las 'dre 'dul grong chog mi dgos pas/ /dus rgyun du dben par bde zhing skyid/ /mi mang bo'i rgyu 176

'grul med pa'i stabs/ /gtam chags sdang kha skad shin tu nyung / /sems chags sdang dbang du mi 'gro bas/ /dus rgyun du dben par bde zhing skyid/ /mi'i 'dod yon dkor la ma 'bag par/ /zas ngan ngon tsam la brten pa'i mthus/ /mtshan gnyid chung rig pa shin tu gsal/ /dus rgyun du dben par bde zhing skyid/ /char kha ba ji ltar babs na yang / /chu'i thigs pa cung zad mi 'bab cing / /brag khang bar thigs tshags mi dgos pas/ /dus rgyun du dben par bde zhing skyid/ /gnas dben pa'i ri ngogs mi bsten par/ /tshe 'di la zhen cing chags pa yi/ /dus snyigs ma'i skya ser pho mo rnams/ /snying med dam yang na smyon par nges/ /tshe blos thongs dben pa sten cig ces/ /gtam rna bar bshad tshe skya ser kun/ /bong bu'i mgor dbyug pas brgyab pa bzhin/ /nag 'thom gyi song nas nyan mkhan dkon/ /don de phyir dmu rgod sems can la/ /chos bshad pas phan thogs ga la 'gyur//da de bas dben par sgrub la gzhol/ /rang gzhan gnyis 'tshengs pa'i lam rnyed snyam/ /ri smug pa can gyi khrod cig nas/ /grogs bya dang ri dwags lhan cig tu/ /nga rgad po bsdad nas glu 'di blangs/ /'di thos tshad dben pa bsten par shog /ces pa 'di yang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//177

na mo gu ru/ /'jigs 'jigs sel mdzad kyi bla ma/ /dung dung gdung shugs kyi dad pas/ /lhang lhang gsol ba ni 'debs so/ /'dzum 'dzum dgyes bzhin du byon la/ /bzang bzang byin rlabs kyi dngos grub/ /myur myur bdag rgyud la stsol cig /rgya khra sdig can kho 'ongs nas/ /gang bzang bye'u rnams zos song /'jol mo sngon mo nga lus kyang / /nam phugs thub sa ni mi 'dug /'jol mo nyam chung nga'i skyid sdug /shing nags mthug po rang mkhyen no/ /rngon pa khyi khrid kho 'ongs nas/ /gang bzang ri dwags rnams bsad song / /sha ba smug po nga lus kyang / /nam phugs thub sa ni mi 'dug /sha ba nyam chung nga'i skyid sdug /rdza ri mthon po rang mkhyen no/ /ri spyang sngon mo kho 'ongs nas//gang bzang lugs rnams ni bsad song / /lu gu khra mo nga lus kyang / /nam phugs thub sa ni mi 'dug /lu gu nyam chung nga'i skyid sdug /lug rdzi rgan po rang mkhyen no/ /nya ba rgya thogs kho 'ongs nas/ /gang bzang nya mo rnams bzung song / /gser mig nya chung nga lus kyang / /nam phugs thub sa ni mi 'dug /nya mo nyam chung nga'i skyid sdug /gting zab chu chen rang mkhyen no/ /grang reg ba mo kho 'ongs nas/ /gang bzang me tog rnams khyer song / /ljang sngon spang rgyan nga lus kyang / /nam phugs thub sa ni mi 'dug /me 178

tog nyam chung nga'i skyid sdug /nam zla'i rgyal mo rang mkhyen no/ /'chi bdag bdud po kho 'ongs nas/ /gang bzang mi rnams ni khrid song / /chos med ban rgan nga lus kyang / /nam phugs thub sa ni mi 'dug /ban rgan nyam chung nga'i skyid sdug /bla ma dkon mchog rang mkhyen no/ /grong min dgon min gyi lung stong / /sgang min gshong min gye ri sked/ /sa min shing min gyi phug par/ /shi min gson min bzhin bsdad nas/ /ja min chu min zhig 'thung bzhin/ /skya min ser min ngas blangs so/ /zhesapa 'di yang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis lha gnyan rgod rtse mthon po'i ri sul du blangs pa'o//na mo gu ru/ nges 'byung gi rta la zhon te/ /mgur dbyangs gi lcag gis brabs nas/ /thar ba yi lam la brgyugs kyang / /rtag 'dzin gye jag pas 'khor ba'i/ /'dam du bsgyel rta bzang phrogs pa'i/ /tshul 'dis kyang snang ba skyo ba/ /sems nyid kyi pha khang nang du/ /byang sems kyi 'khor los sgyur rgyal/ /spyan drangs nas rgyun du bzhugs zhes/ /gsol ba de yang yang btab kyang / /chags sdang gi mi gtsang khrod nas/ /bzhugs su khong ma 'dod phebs pa'i/ /tshul 'dis kyang snang ba skyo ba/ /shes rab kyi rin byin nyos pa'i/ /stong nyid kyi na chung mjes mar/ /yengs med du 'grogs par 'dod kyang / /bden 'dzin gye sngon 'dris mdza' 179

bos/ /yang yang du lag nas phrogs pa'i/ /tshul 'dis kyang snang ba skyo ba/ /bskyed rdzogs dang rdzogs chen them skas/ /yang yang du yar la mchongs kyang / /brtson 'grus kyi rtsal stobs zhan pas/ /tha mal gyi snang zhen 'dam du/ /yang yang du mar la lhung ba'i/ /tshul 'dis kyang snang ba skyo ba/ /lo zla yis rgyab nas bdas shing / /nyin mtshan gyis mdun nas khrid de/ /na rga yi chad pas gcod bzhin/ /skad cig ni mi sdod ban rgan/ /'chi bdag gi khrims rar 'khrid pa'i/ /tshul 'dis kyang snang ba skyo ba/ /bla ma dang dkon mchog rnam gsum/ /ban rgan nga'i bya ba thams cad//nyes tshul ni 'di la e gzigs/ /kye ma 'ang kye hud bdag gis/ /ci tshugs byed re sa gzhan med/ /skyid sdug gnyis khyed mkhyen khyed marje'i// /zhes pa 'di yang reb gong yul gyi glu ba tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//sngon rgyal rgyal sras kyi mchog gyur/ /bla ma ma lus 'gro'i skyabs kyis/ /bu ngan ngan 'gro yi 'jigs las/ /skyob bsam bsam pa'i bus re'o/ /mi med khye med rir 'dug pa'i/ /bza' med gos med kyi sprang bo/ /bu med rgyu med kyi rabs chad/ /'khor med g.yog med kyi khyi rgan/ /phyogs med gnas med kyi ri dwags/ /gtad med gtod med kyi smyon pa/ /'di med phyi med kyi 180

ban rgan/ /skyabs med mgon med nga shi nas/ /rgyus med cha med kyi bar dor/ /grogs med dbang med du 'khyams tshe/ /bslu med zla med kyi bla mas/ /thogs med 'jigs med du skyobs shig /bya rgyal khu byug ni bzhud thal/ /ngang ba skya ser gyi tshogs rnams/ /thams cad 'tshogs tshul la bltas na/ /sang 'gro gnangs 'gro rang red ya/ /yul mi khyem mtshes rnams bzhud thal/ /bya btang rnal 'byor nga'i sgyu lus/ /rgud tshul 'di tsho la bltas na/ /sang 'gro gnangs 'gro rang red ya/ /me tog ser chen ni gshegs thal/ /spang rgyan me tog gi tshogs rnams/ /smug por 'gro tshul la bltas na/ /sang gshegs gnangs gshegs ni red ya/ /mtshan ldan bla ma ni gshegs thal/ /rang gi sgyu lus kyi bkrag mdangs/ /nyams tshul 'di tsho la bltas na/ /sang gshegs gnangs gshegs ni red ya/ /cang shes rta pho de yod dus/ /thag ring mi bgrod na nam bgrod/ /gser sga legs po de bstad nas/ /bshul thag ring bo'i lam bgrod ya/ /'dod 'jo'i ba mo de yod dus/ /'o ma mi bzho na nam bzho/ /bzho ba'i zo gor de bsnams nas/ /lag pa gnyis ka yis 'then ya/ /dpa' bo'i dpung tshogs de 'dzom dus/ /dgra bo mi 'dul na nam 'dul/ /go khrab mtshon cha rnams thogs nas/ /dgra bo cham la ni 'beb ya/ /181

chu lud drod gsher gnyis 'dzom dus/ /sa bon mi 'debs par nam 'debs/ /gro nas sran ma sogs bkal nas/ /sa bon ci thebs ni byed ya/ /gser dngul gter kho ni brdol dus/ /ci lon mi byed na nam byed/ /gang yod snod cha rnams khyer nas/ /gser dngul ci lon ni byed ya/ /gru dang chu ba ni 'dzom dus/ /chu bo mi brgal na nam brgal/ /gru bar gla brngan ni byen nas/ /gting zab chu chen la brgal ya/ /dal 'byor mi lus rang thob dus/ /dam chos mi bsgrub na nam bsgrub/ /ri khrod dben pa de bsnyegs nas/ /dam chos zab mo ni sgrub ya/ /skyo ba rang skye re dka' yang / /skyo shas nges 'byung re med na/ /skyo mgur snyan mo re 'then dang / /skyo shas than thun re skye nges/ /zhes pa 'di yang reb gong yul gyi chos pa'i gzugs kyi khram pa kha bde tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//na mo gu ru/ a a dbyar gsum nam zla ni langs song a bo stong ldan me tog khyod nyon dang / /ha ha grang reg ba mo 'di'i kha rtsa'i/ /la la nam yang chags sa ni med ki /da da phang phung g.yo ba de zhog la/ /myur myur dkon mchog lha khang drung bsnyegs nas/ /kho re dgyes pa'i mchod pa ni phul ya/ /bu lo stong ldan me tog gis e go /shes yi ya ya/ /a a khu byug sngon mo ni langs song a bo ngang ba ser bo khyod nyon dang / /ha ha ston dgun 182

chu 'khyags 'di'i kha rtsa'i/ /la la nam yang chags sa ni med ki /da da dar dir sgrog pa de zhog la/ /myur myur ngang ba'i pha yul de bsnyegs nas/ /kho re sos dal bde mo ru sdod ya/ /bu lo ngang ba ser bo yis e go /shes yi ya ya/ /a a ljon shing sgye stobs ni nyams song / /a bo lo ma ser bo khyod nyon dang //ha ha skyi ser rlung bo 'di'i kha rtsa'i/ /la la nam yang chags sa ni med ki /da da shag shog 'dab sgra de zhog la/ /myur myur gzhongs kyi skyibs bzang zhig bsnyegs nas/ /kho re sos dal ngal med du sdod ya/ /bu lo lo ma ser bo yis e go /shes yi ya ya a a yul gye kho thag ni chod song / /a bo bu mo gzhon nu khyod nyon dang / /ha ha a ne bdud mo 'di'i kha rtsa'i/ /la la nam yang chags sa ni med ki /da da mgu med las ka de zhog la/ /myur myur gzhan yul skyid sa zhig bsnyegs nas/ /kho re lus bde kha skyid ni rgyob ya/ /bu lo bu mo gzhon nu mas e go /shes yi ya ya/ /a a tshe phyed yad yud la shor song / /a bo bya btang ban rgan khyod nyon dang / /ha ha na rga 'chi ba 'di'i kha rtsa'i/ /la la nam yang chags sa ni med ki /da da chos rgyal 'a 'ur de zhog la/ /myur myur ri khrod dben pa zhig bsnyegs nas/ /kho re dge sbyor 'ba' zhig la gzhol ya/ /bu lo bya btang ban rgan gyis e 183

go /shes yi ya ya/ /a a skyo shas rlan bzang de yal song / /a bo skyo bral smyon pa khyod nyon dang / /ha ha skyo med khyod rang la bltas na/ /la la skyo ba rang skye can ma red/ /da da skyo bral rang sems pa'i thog tu/ /myur myur skyo mgur snyan mo'i char phobs dang / /kho re skyo shas than thun rlan 'bab bo/ /bu lo skyo bral smyon pa yis e go /shes yi ya ya/ /zhes pa 'di yang reb gong phyogs kyi glu ba kha bde tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la rtse mtshar du blangs pa'o//na mo gu ru/ /bya rgyal rgod po'i tshogs rnams/ /mi mthong dgung du 'phur thal/ /ldum bu mang bo'i gseb na/ /bung bas ku co sgrog byung / /chu bo chen po'i tshogs rnams/ /rgya mtsho'i nang du 'dres thal/ /rdo rigs mang bo'i gseb na/ /chu phran ku co sgrog byung / /sngon gyi rgyal ba'i tshogs rnams/ /dag pa'i zhing du bzhud thal/ /brag khung skam po'i nang na/ /sprang rgan ku co sgrog byung / /bung ba lus po chung yang / /bung sgra kho las lhag snang / /rgyun du sgra dbyangs sgog pa/ /bung ba'i rang gshis yin no/ /lung phran chu bo chung yang / /ku co kho las lhag snang / /rgyun du ca co sgrog pa/ /chu phran rang gshis yin no/ /rgad po nyams rtogs med rung / /legs bshad kho las lhag snang / /rgyun du mgur dbyangs 'then pa/ /sprang rgan rang gshis yin no/ /bar snang 'ja' tshon ri mo/ /184

kha dog mdzes pa 'char dus/ /lta mkhan yod na ltos dang / /stong gsal nam mkhar yal nges/ /bya rgyal khu byug sngon mos/ /skad snyan mang po sgrog dus/ /nyan mkhan yod na nyon dang / /yul phyogs gzhan du 'gro nges/ /bya btang rnal 'byor bdag gis/ /glu dbyangs snyan mo 'then dus/ /nyan mkhan yod na nyon dang / /sa gcig mi sdod 'gro nges/ /zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//bka' drin gsum ldan bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /dam chos byed 'dod slob bu la/ /zhal gdams gnang ngo ma yengs nyon/ /sangs rgyas rgyun du mchod pa las/ /bla ma lan cig mchod pas kyang / /bsod nams dpag med thob bo zhes/ /rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pas na/ /rgyun du mchod na lta ci smos/ /de phyir bla ma'i mdzad pa la/ /log lta cung zad ma mdzad par/ /lus ngag bsnyen bkur sgrubs shig dang / /'di dang phyi ma'i bde skyid 'byung / /da lta bla ma'i thugs mnyes na/ /deng nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /bla mas rjes su 'dzin par nges/ /de phyir snying nas dga' ba sgoms/ /bla ma'i snyan du zhu log dang / /ci gsung bka' bcag thugs dkrugs na/ /rang nyid mnar med gnas su 'phen/ /de phyir mi mnyes bya ba 185

spongs/ /bla ma'i zhabs tog bsgrubs pa las/ /lhag pa'i chos shig gzhan na med/ /de phyir mnyes pa kho na sgrubs/ /da nas bzung ste 'chi rag bar/ /bla ma dkon mchog gsum po mchod/ /dbul phongs rnams la sbyin pa thongs/ /drin can pha mar bkur sti gyis/ /'gro ba yongs la phan pa sgrubs/ /spyi bor thugs rje chen po sgoms/ /snying bo ma ṇi padme thon//smyung gnas bsrung dang phyag skor mdzod/ /mdor na sdig spong dge ba sgrubs/ /de ltar lag tu len nus na/ /phyi mar bde zhing skyid par nges/ /glu 'di thos tshad thams cad kyis/ /dge la gzhol nas 'tshang rgya shog /ces pa 'di yang slob bu dge 'dun 'byung gnas kyis bskul ngor smras pa'o//pha chos kyi rgyal bor gsol ba 'debs/ /bu bdag dang gzhan rgyud byen gyes rlobs/ /dpe khrom gye dkyil na nor bu mchog /rang rnyed na shin tu dga' ba ltar/ /gnas mi khom brgyad nas mi lus mchog /dus da lta rnyed la dga' ba sgoms/ /dpe gzhan gyis lag nas nor bu de/ /'phrog e gtong snyam nas 'jigs pa ltar/ /rkyen nad gdon sogs kyis glo bur du/ /shi e 'gro snyam du 'jigs par gyis/ /dpe myur du rgyal mtshan rtser bzhag nas/ /dgos 'dod kyi gsol ba 'debs pa ltar/ /da myur du ri khrod legs bsten nas/ /gang 'dod pa'i zab chos 186

bsgrub par gyis/ /dpe gsol ba btab na dgos 'dod kun/ /nor bu las 'dzad med 'byung ba ltar/ /chos bsgrubs na mchog thun dngos grub kun/ /mi'i lus rten 'di la thob par 'gyur/ /dpe dgos 'dod byung na rang nyid dang / /gzhan kun gyi dbul phongs sel ba ltar/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub thob gyur na/ /rang gzhan gnyis 'dod don 'grub pa yin/ /dpe nor bur gsol ba ma btab na/ /de rnyed kyang don go chung ba ltar/ /chos zab mo nyams su ma blangs na/ /mi'i lus rten thob kyang don go chung / /glu 'di thos dad can pho mo yis/ /chos zab mo nyams su len par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyi smras pa'o//dang po bya btang nges 'byung can/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis btang / /bar du 'di phyi gnyis med po/ /dben par gnyid dang bza' btung sems/ /tha ma grong mtha' myul mkhan po/ /khye khar mi skrag snying stobs can/ /ngal med 'gro ba'i brtson 'grus mkhan/ /bya btang lus la sprang bo'i sems/ /de 'dra'i spyod ngan ma mdzad par/ /bdag gzhan gnyis phan byed 'dod na/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma bsten/ /mdo sngags chos la thos bsam gyis/ /dben pa'i ri la bsgom par mdzod/ /zas su ting 'dzin bcud len dang / /dka' spyad sdug khur snying rus gyes/ /187

zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis bya btang ri khrod pa rnams la smras pa'o//dang po rtsis pa khom med po/ /bcu gsum 'khor zhags min ma bslabs/ /kun gyis a khu rtsis pa zer/ /khos kyang rtsis pa'i khur de bzung / /yon bdag drung du slebs ma thag /rtsis gdan rtsis thod ci yod snyam/ /rtsis gdan rtsis thod bzang bo dgos/ /khyer shog zer ba'i kha mkhas po/ /bar du rtsis pa lag bde bo/ /rde'u dkar nag mang bo ni/ /rtsis gdan steng du legs par bkram/ /tha ma mi thub mi 'gyu ba'i/ /rim gro bkyal ba'i kha gdangs po/ /a khu rtsis pas 'di zer zhes/ /rim gro'i phyir du srog gcod byed/ /rtsis pa'i lus la bdud kyi kha/ /dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal rin gyis nyos/ /de 'dra'i lab lab ma mang bar phyi mar phan pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /gal te nad rtsis sogs byed kyang / /srog gcod la sogs mi rung zhes/ /'di phyir phan pa'i rim gro shod/ /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rtsis pa rnams la smras pa'o//dang po sman pa mkhas med po/ /rtsa mdo chu mdo 'chal 'chol bslabs/ /sdeb sbyor gang yang ma tshang ba'i/ /sman ni than ne thun ne zhig /lag phyis 'am ni sne lor bcug /khye la seng ge zer ba ltar/ /kun gyis a khu sman pa zer/ /khos kyang sman pa'i khur de bzung / /bar du sman pa shed can po/ /lag gnyis 188

tshigs bar shugs kyis gnon/ /rlung dang mkhris pa bad gan dang / /tsha grang gang yin ngos ma zin/ /khog tu gang dran kha nas lab/ /tha ma sman pa snying khams can/ /sman log byin nas 'di thungs dang / /nangs par blta rgyu zhig yod zer/ /sman pa'i lus la dug 'tshong dngos//gces phrug gsod pa'i lag dmar bos/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka 'phung la gtad/ /bdag gzhan gnyis phan mdzad snyam na/ /'gro la phan pa'i sems bskyed nas/ /sman pa mkhas pa lo zla'i bar/ /tshul bzhin bsten la thos bsam gyis/ /sman gyi gnad la mkhas par slobs/ /ming don mthun pa'i sman pa mdzod/ /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis sman pa snying khams can rnams la smras pa'o//dang po lha ba gzugs mjes po/ /lus la stod g.yogs smad g.yogs gsol/ /mgo la rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan gyon/ /bar du lha ba ngag snyan po/ /lha 'dre gnyis ka 'o dod 'bod/ /lha 'dre gang yin khog tu zhugs/ /lding skor byed pa'i rkang bde bo/ /sha pags gtsab pa'i smyo spyod mkhan/ /tha ma mgo nag mi rnams zhes/ /khyad gsod byed pa'i kha sdig mkhan/ /rim gro 'di zer chos min gyi/ /dmar bkye zer ba'i sems nag po/ /lha ba'i lus la srin po'i sems/ /de 'dre'i lha ba lha ma tsho/ /dmyal ba rin gyes ma nyo 189

bar/ /da nas dam pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /gal te dam chos mi byed kyang / /srog gcod la sogs mi rung zhes/ /'di phyir phan pa'i rim gro shod/ /dmyal bar mi 'gro lha ba tsho/ /zhes pa 'di yang lha ba mi dge sdig la hab thob byed pa rnams la tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//dang po mo ba kha bde bo/ /nad pa'i ming la ci zer zhes/ /mig gnyis zim zim brdar ba byed/ /bar du mo ba byin rlabs can/ /mo thig sogs la kha rlangs btang / /tha ma mo ba sdig rgan po/ /nad pa cham pa tsam yin yang / /nad dang gdon chen 'di 'dra 'dug /nad pa lag nas 'chor nyen che/ /rim gro 'di dang 'di 'dra dgos/ /'di rnams myur mo da lta zer/ /kho yang skrag cing ha las nas/ /a khu mo bas 'di zer zhes/ /grong ban gcod sngags khyem du blangs/ /ra lug g.yag gsum bsgyel nas bsad/ /mo ba'i lus la 'dre yi kha/ /don med tshabs chen sdig pa bsags/ /de 'dra'i mo ngan ma 'debs par/ /dam pa'i chos la 'bad par mdzod/ /gal te mo ni 'debs na yang / /srog gcod byed pa'i rim gro rnams/ /ma bshad 'di phyi gnyis ka la/ /nges par phan pa'i rim gro shod/ /de ltar mo ba mkhan rnams mdzod/ /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis mo ba rnams la smras pa'o//khyem tshang bzang ba'i kha rgyab phyir/ /a khu las lhag drin 190

can med/ /a khu'i 'khor gye khrel yod mi/ /a khu'i drin lan bsab 'dod rnams/ /kha la nyan na 'di bzhin mdzod/ /da lta a khu yod dus su/ /a khu kun gyi gong du zhog /gos gcig yod kyang a khur skon/ /zas gcig yod kyang a khur byen/ /skom gcig yod kyang a khur blud/ /dkor shig mang bo yod gyur na/ /a khus dkor rnams ma zhus rtags/ /a khus dkor sbyong mdzod cig ces/ /dge sbyor bskul ma yang yang mdzod/ /gshegs dus zas nor phal che ba/ /a khu drin can phyogs su thongs/ /a khur dkor gyi rnam smin lci/ /a khur dge rtsa yang dag dgos/ /mi yis smon pa'i dge rtsa thongs/ /bsod nams mnyam du 'thob pa yin/ /de ltar gyes shig tsha bo tsho/ /zhes pa 'di yang tsha bo tsha mo khrel yod rnams la tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//lus srog bskyed pa'i pha ma las/ /lhag pa'i drin can gzhan na med/ /khrel yod bu dang bu mo rnams/ /rgas pa'i drin can pha ma yi/ /drin lan 'jal na 'di bzhin gyis/ /gson dus drin can pha rgan dang / /a ma drin mo che la sogs/ /kha byams tshig gis dga' spro skyed/ /pha ma'i sgyu lus rgud pa na/ /lci ba'i gon pa mi theg pas/ /dro 'jam yang ba'i gos bzang skon/ /khams la 'phrod pa'i zas zhim byen/ /na dus nad g.yog rgyun du gyis/ /191

gson dus pha mar ma byams par/ /pha ma 'chi ba'i nangs par du/ /zhim po byin yang za dbang med/ /gos bzang bskon yang gon dbang med/ /des na nam 'chi cha med pa'i/ /pha mar bsnyen bkur rgyun du gyis/ /pha mar bsnyen bkur byas gyur na/ /tshe 'dir bu yi bsod nams rgyas/ /yid la ci bsam thams cad 'grub/ /shi dus drin can pha ma gnyis/ /mi rnyed yul du 'gro ba yin/ /bu ni rnyed pa'i yul nas 'dug /gang yod pha ma'i phyogs su thongs/ /pha mar dge rtsa ma byas na/ /'jig rten mi yi kha dpe la/ /a pas a par ci byas yin/ /zer bzhin bus kyang de bzhin byed/ /bla ma'i 'tsho ba byed zer bas/ /ra lug mang bo'i srog bcad pa/ /dge rtsa yin min bka' la ltos/ /dper na chu yis khyer ba'i mi'i/ /rke la rdo zhig btags nas kyang / / slar yang chu nang 'phangs dang mtshungs/ /des na drin can pha ma'i phyir/ /tshe thar gtong ba rgyal bas gsungs/ /tshe thar thongs shig bu rgod tsho/ /sngas mgo'i bla ma de nyid kyis/ /gnyis ka drangs na ngo mtshar che/ /gar song mi shes bla ma tsho/ /rang gzhan gnyis 'phung ma mdzad cig /ha cang sha la ma dga' zhig /zhal yang 'thams nas ma sdod par/ /tshe thar thongs zhes kun la shod/ /deng sang bla ma sha la dga'/ /de ltar bshad mkhan dka' mor 192

gda'/ /bu yis pha mar phan snyam na/ /sdig pa ma byed ma byed ang / /do gal che bas yang yang bskyar/ /rgyun du pha ma'i drin ma brjed/ /phyis kyang yang yang nya mchod dang / /bsngo ba gyes shig bu rgod tsho/ /zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis khrel yod bu dang bu mo rnams la smras pa'o//dang po khyim la 'gro ba'i tshe/ /drin can pha ma rgan rgon la/ /'bral mi phod kyang gson bral byas/ /pha ma'i zas nor khyer nas song / /khyo grogs lha bu 'dzum kha bo/ /lus kyi lang tsho dar la babs/ /'grogs kyin 'grogs kyin 'grogs na snyam/ /ci tsam 'grogs kyang chog shes med/ /bar du bdud po ngo nag po/ /rgyun du ngo 'dzum dkar nag bltas/ /ci tsam las kyang mgu dus med/ /a ne phye rkyal lag btsir byed/ /a byes rgyab log mig log byed/ /tha ma glang rgan rdung snying can/ /bsam gyen bsam gyin dbyug pas brdung / /tshig ngan mtshon gyis snying rtsa trog /bros nas a ner skyabs btsal yang / /gru mos phul nas de tshad zer/ /a byes bdud mos de nyos zer/ /mgon skyabs med pa'i nyam thag ma/ /sa 'bu grog tshang khar lhung 'dra/ /mi yi lus la bdud kyi sems/ /bdud po'i 'thab ya blos thongs la/ /'grogs na chos mdzad grogs dang 'grogs/ /byed na dam pa'i 193

lha chos gyes/ /zhes pa 'di yang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis grong gi bud med yongs la smras pa'o//dus gsum kun mkhyen pa'i pad 'byung / /dus gnas skabs bdag gi bla ma/ /dus da nas byang chub bar du/ /dus rtag tu thugs rjes gzigs shig /dus snyigs ma lnga bdo'i rtags su/ /dus ngan pa'i skye bo rnams kyis/ /dus rtag par mi dge sdig byed/ /dus gtan du sdod snyam rnams tshos/ /dus sang phod grabs shom byed kyang / /dus da lta 'chi ba mthong bas/ /dus de ring skyo shas skyes so/ /dus bzhi yi 'gyur ldog bzhin du/ /dus mi ring myur du 'chi bas/ /dus 'di nas bzung ste dben pa/ /dus rtag tu bsten nas chos gyis/ /dus bar mtshams sked par chos la/ /dus nam yang rtse gcig gzhol dang / /dus nam zhig 'chi rung mi 'gyod/ /dus gtan du bde zhing skyid do/ /zhes pa 'di ni tshogs drug rang grol gyis gzhan zhig shi ba mthong bas rkyen byas nas rang la smras pa'o//pha drin can bla ma rin po che/ /bu bdag gi spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /sprang blo kha dam pa'i chos la sgyur/ /yul pha yul nyams dga' skyid skyid po/ /bsdad che na chags sdang rgyun mi 'chad/ /de bas kyang pha yul spangs na dga'/ /grong thag nyer gnas pa'i dgon pa ru/ /bsdad che na grong gi nyes pa 'go /de bas kyang ri 194

khrod bsten na dga'/ /mi ngan pa sna 'dus rje dpon de/ /byas che na mi 'dod sna dgu 'ong / /de bas kyang dman sa bzung na dga'/ /khong mi chen rnams kyi zhabs phyi de/ /byas che na nyes med khrims la sbyor/ /de bas kyang dpon med byas na dga'/ /kha ja chang tshogs 'khor zhim po de/ /bsten che na dge sbyor bar chad yin/ /de bas kyang dka' thub bcud len dga'/ /nor rta lug la sogs sgo phyugs de/ /'phel che na jag rkun thog tu 'dren/ /de bas kyang nor med sprang bo dga'/ /tshe 'dir zhen grogs dang grwa slob la/ /'grogs che na rang rgyud je gyong 'gro/ /de bas kyang rang nyid gcig pu dga'/ /dus ngan pa'i yon bdag mchod gnas 'di/ /byas che na drin 'dren sgur 'debs mang / /de bas kyang phyogs med bsod snyoms dga'/ /rje dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /thugs brtse ba'i spyan gyes rtag tu gzigs/ /tshe blo yis thongs par byin gyes rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//dus gsum rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul rje/ /rje btsun chos rgyal ngag gi dbang / /dbang phyug brgyad ldan 'gro ba'i mgon/ /mgon khyod spyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs/ /gnas gcig yun ring bsdad drags na/ /rnyed tshad mi gsog chos pa dkon/ /bsags 195

na chags sdang zag pa 'phel/ /gnas kyi rang bzhin bsams byas nas/ /dal 'byor snying bo len 'dod na/ /rnal 'byor mi la ras pa bzhin/ /'jog na bdag 'dzin ri khrod skyur/ /'grim na phyogs med ri khrod 'grims/ /grwa slob 'khor g.yog mang drags na/ /chos bzhin smras kyang nyan mkhan dkon/ /lab brjod mang bo long gtam 'phel/ /'khor gyi rang bzhin bsams byas nas/ /dal 'byor snying bo len 'dod na/ /rnal 'byor mi la ras pa bzhin/ /gtor na grwa slob 'khor g.yog gtor/ /'dug na grogs med gcig pur sdod/ /nor gye gsog 'jog mang drags na/ /dgra rkun gnod 'tshe med pa dkon/ /dgra la shor na zhe sdang 'phel/ /nor gyi rang bzhin bsam byas nas/ /dal 'byor snying bo len 'dod na/ /rnal 'byor mi la ras pa bzhin/ /bskyur na nor rdzas rgyab tu skyur/ /gsog na 'phags pa'i nor bdun gsogs/ /bza' btung longs spyod mang drags na/ /thos bsam sgom gsum 'ong ba dkon/ /spyad kyin sred pa lhag par 'phel/ /zas kyi rang bzhin bsams byas nas/ /dal 'byor snying bo len 'dod na/ /rnal 'byor mi la ras pa bzhin/ /spong na zhim mngar sred pa spongs/ /bsten na ngan ngon bza' btung sten/ /mdor na tshe 'dir zhen drags na/ /'di phyi'i bde skyid 'ong ba dkon/ /196

sdug bsngal yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel/ /'khor ba'i rang bzhin bsams byas nas/ /dal 'byor snying bo len 'dod na/ /rnal 'byor mi la ras pa bzhin/ /gtong na tshe 'di blo yis thongs/ /byed na dam pa'i lha chos gyis/ /bdag gi 'dis mtshon dge ba yis/ /bdag dang khams gsum 'gro kun gyis/ /bdag pas gzhan gces byang sems dang / /bdag med gnas lugs rtogs par shog /ces pa 'di ni tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang gzhan yongs la smras pa'o//kun gyes gtsug gi bkur na yang / /khengs pa dor nas zhi dul gyi/ /mdzad pas 'gro kun yid 'phrog pa/ /'dren mchog chos rgyal zhabs la 'dud/ /'khor ba rgyal po'i btson ra 'dra/ /'khrul snang sdug bsngal dpag tu med/ /'gro na 'gro na dben par song / /byed na byed na lha chos gyis/ /tshe 'di mdang gi rmi lam 'dra/ /zang zing 'khrul bas rang nyid bslu/ /'gro na 'gro na dben par song / /byed na byed na lha chos gyis/ /rnam g.yeng tshong 'dus ltad mo 'dra/ /'du 'dzi'i ngang la mi tshe 'chor 'gro na 'gro na dben par song / /byed na byed na lha chos gyis/ /'chi bdag dgong kha'i grib ma 'dra/ /skad cig mi sdod tshur tshur 'ong / /'gro na 'gro na dben par song / /byed na byed na lha chos 197

gyes/ /bza' tshang tshong 'dus mgron po 'dra/ /da lta 'tshogs kyang myur du 'bral/ /'gro na 'gro na dben par song / /byed na byed na lha chos gyis/ /mdza' bshes shing kha'i bye'u 'dra/ /mthun par 'grogs kyang so sor 'bral/ /'gro na 'gro na dben par song / /byed na byed na lha chos gyes/ /snyan grags nam mkha'i 'brug dang 'dra/ /dar cig grags pas rang nyid bslu/ /'gro na 'gro na dben par song / /byed na byed na lha chos gyes/ /nor rdzas sbrang ma'i sbrang rtsi 'dra/ /mang bo bsags kyang gzhan gyis spyod/ /'gro na 'gro na dben par song / /byed na byed na lha chos gyis/ /shes bya nam mkha'i gza' skar 'dra/ /bslab dgos gnas la zad pa med/ /'gro na 'gro na dben par song / /byed na byed na lha chos gyes/ /chos brgyad nad pa'i sngas stan 'dra/ /ji ltar byas kyang bde ba med/ /'gro na 'gro na dben par song / /byed na byed na lha chos gyis/ /gang yang 'gro bas ma 'bad par/ /bdag gi dge bas yongs grol nas/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho stongs nas kyang / /zhi ba'i grong khyer 'gengs par shog /ces pa 'di ni bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang gzhan la phan phyir blangs pa'o//chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo/ /sngags 'chang bdud 'dul rdo rje/ /rig 'dzin 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho/ /snying nas skyabs su 198

'dzin no/ /tshe 'di rlung la bskur nas/ /mi med ri la 'gro ba'i//rgyu mtshan mi shes de bden/ /ngas bshad khyed rnams nyon cig /nor bu rin po che la/ /dgos 'dod mang bo 'byung ba/ /dga' bo 'jog po ma gtogs/ /nor bu med pas mi shes/ /mkhas grub bla ma bsten nas/ /'di phyi'i bde skyid 'byung yang / /bsten pa'i slob ma ma gtogs/ /ma bsten mi yis mi shes/ /dpyid dus sa bon btab na/ /ston dus mang bo 'phel ba/ /btab pa'i mi rnams ma gtogs/ /ma btab mi yis mi shes/ /tshe 'dir sbyin pa btang na/ /phyi mar mang bor 'phel ba/ /dad can phyug po ma gtogs/ /ser sna can gyis mi shes/ /lug gi bal rtsag nang na/ /dro 'jam bde ba yod kyang / /gyon pa'i mi rnams ma gtogs/ /ma gyon mi yis mi shes/ /dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams dgar/ /bde skyid snyan gsum yod kyang / /bsten pa'i chos mdzad ma gtogs/ /ma bsten chos pas mi shes/ /lo tog sa la btab na/ /sog ma zhor la 'byung yang / /rong gi mi rnams ma gtogs/ /'brog pa'i mi yis mi shes/ /snying nas chos bzhin byas na/ /lto rgyab zhor la 'byung yang / /chos mdzad dam pa ma gtogs/ /lto phyir rgyug pas mi shes/ /nga ni dben par 'gro la/ /skyel ma lam mkhan 'di yod/ /bla ma dkon mchog yi dam/ /mkha' 'gro chos 199

skyong yin no/ /thar ba'i lam sna 'dren phyir/ /'jig rten 'di yi lam sna/ /'dren par the tshom med pas/ /khyed rnams sems khrel mi dgos/ /e ma bla ma dkon mchog /e ma yi dam mkha' 'gro/ /e ma chos skyong srung ma/ /e ma lam mkhan bzang ngo / /zhes pa 'di yang mtsho snying du dgun 'gro dus slob ma 'ga' dang / mi ngo shes rnams kyis khyed mtsho snying du 'gro ba la nged rnams shin tu mi 'thad par 'dug khyed skyid nyo gin 'gro ang sdug nyo gin 'gro ang nged rnams kyis mi shes par 'dug lam ston med na lam yang shes dka'/ mthun rkyen yang 'dzom dka'/ de bas 'dir sdod zer ba'i tshe/rang gi yid la shar ba rtsed mo'i tshul du bris pa'o//'od gsal nyi mas gling bzhi/ /bskor ba'i rten 'brel 'grigs byung / /pad tshal bde bar sdod dang / /gling gzhan bskor nas 'ong ya/ /g.yu 'brug sngon mo mkha' la/ /'phyo ba'i rten 'brel 'grigs byung / /rdza ri bde bar sdod dang / /dgung sngon 'grims nas 'ong ya/ /bya rgyal rgod po mkha' la/ /'phyo ba'i rten 'brel 'grigs byung / /brag stod bde bar sdod dang / /dgung sngon 'grims nas 'ong ya/ /tshogs drug rang grol ri khrod//'grims pa'i brten 'brel 'grigs byung / /grwa slob bde bar sdod dang / /ri khrod 'grims nas 'ong ya/ /zhes pa 'di yang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis ri khrod 'grim dus shig tu grwa slob 'ga' la smras pa'o//sangs rgyas byang sems grub pa drang srong sogs/ /bden tshig 'grub pa thams cad dgongs su gsol/ /bdag gis smon 200

lam ji ltar btab pa rnams/ /de ltar 'grub par byen gyes brlab tu gsol/ /bstan pa'i bdag po sangs rgyas snyigs dus su/ /bstan 'dzin bshes gnyen tshul 'dzin bla ma rje'i/ /bstan bzhin nyams len byed pa'i ri pa ngas/ /bstan dang 'gro ba yongs la phan par shog /bdag 'dra'i bris sku mthong ba'i 'gro rnams kyi/ /lus kyi na tsha sems kyi sdug bsngal kun/ /nye bar zhi nas lus la bde ba dang / /sems la dga' spro dpag med 'char bar shog /rang gi rgyud la phan pa'i glu dbyangs dang / /gzhan gye rgyud la phan pa'i glu blangs tshad/ /dngos sam brgyud nas rang dang 'gro ba gzhan/ /kun gyi rgyud la phan thogs 'byung bar shog /sa phyogs gang du mgur 'bum glegs bam gnas/ /sa der bkra mi shis pa'i ming mi grags/ /sa yi rtsi bcud lo tog 'phel zhing rgyas/ /sa steng dge legs chen pos khyab par shog /mdor na bdag dang bdag gis glu blangs pa/ /mthong thos 'dri 'don klog 'chang byed pa rnams/ /gnas skabs bde zhing mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang myur ba myur du thob par shog /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas byin rlabs dang / /bdag gis dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /'dun pa drag pos smon lam ci btab pa/ /de dag thams cad gegs 201

med 'grub par shog /ces pa 'di ni 'dun pa drag pos smon lam btab pa'o//e ma ho/ /g.yo rtsol med pa'i rang lus khang bzang du/ /bying rgod med pa'i rig pa rang gsal ba'i/ /'pho 'gyur med pa'i chos sku'i btsan sa zin/ /'du 'bral med pa'i bla ma'i bkra shis shog /rang rig 'khrul med gzhi yi sangs rgyas dang / /smra bsam brjod med lam gye dam pa'i chos/ /mi 'gyur 'bral med 'bras bu'i dge 'dun te/ /don dam bslu med mchog gsum bkra shis shog /ye nas bkra shis kun tu bzang mo'i mkhar/ /mkha' mnyam rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs bkra/ /bkra shis sku thig tshom bu'i char chen rnams/ /rnam dag sems su 'bebs pa'i bkra shis shog /rang lus tsitta 'od lnga'i gzhal yas kyi/ /rang byung gdod ma'i mgon po kun bzang la/ /rang bab gnyug ma'i rgyun gyis gsol btab tshe/ /rang zhal mngon sum mjal ba'i bkra shis shog /bslu med slob dpon pad 'byung thugs kyi bcud/ /'khrul med lam bzang a ti'i don rtogs nas/ /bsgom med chu bo'i rgyun gye ting 'dzin la/ /'bral med rgyun du gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /ka dag zang thal rtog pa'i mtshon cha yis/ /ma dag dug lnga'i rnam rtog gang shar yang / /yang dag lta ba'i ngang du bsgral nas kyang / /ye dag ye shes 'char ba'i bkra 202

shes shog /spang thob med pa'i gdod ma'i rgyal sa ru/ /'gyur med rig pas rgyal sa rab bzung nas/ /khregs chod thod rgal zung 'brel nyams len la/ /nyin mtshan khor yug 'dres pa'i bkra shis shog /sgo gsum 'khrul 'khor rlung rig gnad bcings pas/ /sgron ma bzhi yis nyams blangs dbyings nang du/ /rig pa tshud de thig le gsum sbrel shar/ /chos nyid mngon sum mthong ba'i bkra shis shog /dbyings rig smin mtshams bral nas dbang bo'i sgor/ /mngon sum gsal zhing thig le'i nang du ni/ /rdor sems sku rkyang 'gul 'khrig med par gsal/ /nyams snang gong du 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog /dbyings kyis snang ba thams cad rgyas thebs pas/ /thig le'i nang du rnam snang dbyings phyug sogs/ /rig lnga'i tshom bu grangs med yongs sha ra ba'i/ /rig pa tshad la phebs pa'i bkra shis shog /nyams snang 'phel zad 'od kyi nang du ni/ /sor mor tsam snang 'khor 'das 'du shes bral/ /'byung bzhi zang thal bgrod cing mngon shes rgyas/ /chos nyid zad sar 'khyol ba'i bkra shis shog /skye 'jug sogs la dbang thob rig pa ni/ /bem por bcug pas skad 'byin 'gul ba dang / /mtshams med lnga spyad 'tshang rgya nus par byed/ /ya mtshan grub rtags ston pa'i bkra shis shog /rdzogs 203

chen ma rig mun sel sgon me 'di/ /'di ltar tshul bzhin nyams su blangs pa'i tshe/ /tshe dang chos 'byor rgyas shing 'dod pa'i don/ /don rnams chos bzhin 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /dam nyams 'dres khyer bsres bslad ma zhugs pa'i/ /dam chos mkha' 'gro'i zhal rlangs ma yal ba/ /dam ldan rig 'dzin rnams kyis nyams bzhes tshe/ /dam bca' snying rus bskyed pa'i bkra shis shog /ma rig nyon mongs chos brgyad rgyang bsrings nas/ /ma rnams don du dam chos bsgrub pa'i tshe/ /ma dang mkha' 'gros bar chad nyer 'tshe kun/ /ma bskul na yang sgrol ba'i bkra shis shog /mi tshe 'di bzung tshe rabs thams cad du/ /mi mthun bar chad ming tsam med pa yi/ /mi dmigs spros bral kun bzang dgongs bcud kyi/ /mi shigs srung ba'i 'khor lo'i bkra shis shog /ye dag gnas lugs ka dag khregs chod dbyings/ /lhun grub sku dang ye shes yongs shar nas/ /slar yang rang rig kun bzang gzhi thog tu/ /gzhon nu bum sku brnyes pa'i bkra shis shog /chos sku'i dbyings las longs spyod rdzogs sku dang / /grangs med sprul skus 'khor ba dong sprugs nas/ /'gro kun thams cad gdod ma'i sar bkod de/ /'khor ba'i ming tsam med pa'i bkra shis shog /ma nor lam bzang gsang chen rdo rje 204
