theg /theg pa'i yang rtse rdzogs pa chen po'i khrid/ /'khrid pa'i mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku/ /sku tshe bskal brgyar brtan pa'i bkra shis shog /rgyal dbang pad 'byung bi ma la sogs bka'/ /bka' gter las 'ongs snga 'gyur gsang chen bstan/ /bstan pa'i sgor zhugs rdo rje mched lcam kun/ /kun kyang zhabs pad brtan pa'i bkra shis shog /gter ston bde chen rgyal pos spyan drangs pa'i/ /gter chos kun bzang thugs kyi yang snying 'di/ /gter kha brdol ltar gang zhig srid mtha'i bar/ /gter gsar bstan pa rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /rgyal ba kun gyi nye lam gcig pu ru/ /rgyal bas yongs sngags theg mchog rdzogs pa che/ /rgyal dbang padma'i ring lugs rnying ma ba'i/ /rgyal bstan phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /dam pas byin brlabs dben pa'i ri sul du/ /dam gtsang dpon slob mched grogs lhan cig 'dzoms/ /zab gsang rdzogs pa chen po'i bshad sgrub kyi/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mi nub tshugs par shog /dam pas byin brlabs dben gnas gang bzang du/ /dam gtsang dpon slob 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis/ /dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar ji bzhin du/ /dam chos nyams su len pa'i bkra shis shog /gangs rdza g.ya' dang nags tshal dur khrod sogs/ /yid mthun bag 205

phebs ri yi rgyud bzang zhing / /byin ldan ma mo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas/ /dus kun rtag tu bsten pa'i bkra shis shog /'dren mchog shākya'i bstan pa rin po che/ /phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas pa dang / /bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams/ /sku tshe 'phrin las rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /bdag gzhan gang gis dam chos bsgrub pa la/ /lha klu gzhi bdag sde brgyad 'byung bo'i tshogs/ /gnod pa skad cig tsam yang mi sgyel zhing / /ci bsam chos bzhin 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces bkra shis rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis sbyar ba'o/ /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rje btsun zhabs dkar rdo rje 'chang chen pos mchog dman bar ma'i gdul byar gang la gang 'tsham gyi rdo rje'i mgur dpag tu med pa bzhengs pa yi ger bkod pa'i nang tshan las/ chos rgyal mchog gi zhabs pad bsten dus rtse gzhung sogs nges med dben par bzhengs pa'i skor ro//206

mtsho snying ma hā de ba nas dam pa nyid kyis nyid la gsal 'debs dge bskul gyi tshul du bzhengs pa'i skor/rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam zhi khro dang / /phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas byang sems dang / /gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag ni mthong thos dran reg 'gro rnams kyi/ /mi 'dod rkyen ngan bar chad kun zhi nas/ /tshe dang bsod nams rlung rta snyan grags rgyas/ /rtag tu bde zhing skyid par byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag ni gar song yul phyogs thams cad dang / /gang du bsdad pa'i gnas khang mal sa dang / /zas gos dpe cha yo byad gar song sar/ /chos dang bkra shis 'phel bar byen gyis rlobs/ /bdag gis lhag bsam dag pas glu dbyangs gang / /blangs tshad 'jig rten khams su yun ring gnas/ /g.yo can mi rgod sdig can sus thos kyang / /blo kha chos la phyogs par byen 207

gyis rlobs/ /bdag kyang ring min myur du sangs rgyas nas/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal myong ba'i 'gro ba kun/ /bde chen dag pa'i zhing du legs drangs nas/ /rigs drug gnas kun stongs par byen gyis rlobs/ /mdor na tshogs drug rang grol bdag nyid la/ /brten nas ma gyur sems can ma lus pas/ /gnas skabs lha mi'i bde skyid myong ba dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par byen gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//nga 'gro nga 'gro dben pa'i spang la 'gro/ /spang gshongs me tog bkra ba'i ljongs su 'gro/ /sngo rlan steng du bde bar nyal du 'gro/ /bung bas sgra dbyangs sgrog la nyan du 'gro/ /nga 'gro nga 'gro dben pa'i gnas la 'gro/ /lngon shing 'dab rgyas bsil grib bsten du 'gro/ /zhim pa'i sil tog mang bo za ru 'gro/ /khu byug skad snyan sgog la nyan du 'gro/ /nga 'gro nga 'gro dben pa'i rdza la 'gro/ /rdza ri khra mo'i sgrub phug bsten du 'gro/ /dwangs bsil rnyog med rdza chu 'thung du 'gro/ /ri dwags rtse bro brdung la blta ru 'gro/ /nga 'gro nga 'gro dben pa'i brag la 'gro/ /brag dmar bya rgod lding ba'i rtsa ru 'gro/ /ma byas rang grub brag phug bsten du 'gro/ /zwa dang sgog sogs tshod ma za ru 'gro/ /nga 'gro nga 'gro dben gnas gang dgar 'gro/ /dam pa gong ma'i rnam 208

thar skyong du 'gro/ /sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin du 'gro/ /sgyu ma'i lus po ri la 'jog tu 'gro/ /nga 'gro nga 'gro da ni myur du 'gro/ /pha yul btson ra rgyab tu bzhag nas 'gro/ /btson srung gnyen la ltag pa bstan nas 'gro/ /chags sdang smre sngags 'don 'phro bzhag la 'gro/ /nga 'gro nga 'gro 'gro na 'di ltar 'gro/ /sba dbyug bzang bo'i rta pho zhon bzhin 'gro/ /ngag nas snyan pa'i glu dbyangs len bzhin 'gro/ /sems la bla ma'i gdams ngag dran bzhin 'gro/ /dbu ma nyams su len rnams nga bzhin gyis/ /rdzogs chen nyams su len rnams nga bzhin gyis/ /phyag chen nyams su len rnams nga bzhin gyis/ /mdor na lha chos byed rnams nga bzhin gyis/ /zhes pa 'di yang reb gong glu ba tshogs drug rang grol gyis phyogs med ri khrod 'grim pa'i dus shig tu blangs pa'o//spyi gtsug 'khor lo'i rgyan du/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rin chen/ /'bral ba med par bzhugs nas/ /byin rlabs dngos grub stsol cig /brag stod shul du bzhag nas/ /bya rgyal rgod po brag las/ /je mtho je mthor 'phur nas/ /gang 'dod gnas su 'gro bzhin/ /pha yul shul du bzhag nas/ /tshogs drug rang grol yul las/ /je ring je ring song nas/ /gang 'dod dben par chas 'gro/ /ri klung gnyis gar 'phur ba'i/ /skad snyan 'byin pa'i khu 209

byug /snye ma mchu ru bzung nas/ /thag ring yul du 'gro bzhin/ /mi med ri khrod 'grim pa'i/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol/ /gsal 'debs be'u bum bzung nas/ /thag ring yul du chas 'gro/ /deng sang skya ser rnams tsho/ /pha yul bdud kyi btson rar/ /ha cang chags zhen ma che/ /'chi bdag bdud po byung tshe/ /dbang med bzhag nas 'gro dgos/ /de bas da lta chos phyir/ /skyes pa'i pha yul bzhag nas/ /ri khrod 'grims na legs mod/ /rtag tu yul nas sdod na/ /khyed rnams ma 'phyugs bzang ste/ /sngon chad skya ser mang bo la rol song ba ngas mthong / sa blta yul blta'i phyir yang / /rgyal khams phyogs med 'grims shig /skyes pa mi yis mi tshor/ /rgas pa rang gis mi shes/ /pha yul bdud kyi btson rar/ /mi tshe sdug zad ma byed/ /byas na mi mthong 'jig rten/ /pha rol snyeg dus 'gyod do/ /'gyod kyang cung zad tsam yang / /bya thabs med pa e shes/ /bshad kyang mi nyan mi rnams/ /snying med na yang smyon pa/ /deng sang gangs ri'i khrod na/ /nga 'dra'i skyid pa mi 'dug /skyid pa'i rgyang glu 'then bzhin/ /rgyal khams gzhan du chas 'gro/ /bya btang kha yi khang bzang / /tshems dkar dung gi sgo nas/ /glu dbyangs na chung mjes ma/ /ma thub shor nas bud thal/ /bod kyi skya ser kun 210

gyis/ /na chung ma 'dir ltos la/ /yag yag 'dra na lhan cig /'grogs nas ri la shog ya/ /de 'dra'i rgyang glu 'then mkhan/ /phyogs med rgyal khams 'grim pa'i/ /reb gong smad kyi glu ba/ /tshogs drug rang grol yin ya/ /glu byangs snyan mo 'di nyid/ /thos tshad las 'phro can rnams/ /dben pa'i gnas su nga bzhin//lha chos byed par gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang phyogs med kyi ri khrod dben pa 'grim dus shig tu blangs pa'o//srid par bar med du 'khyams pa'i/ /ma lus lus can dag chos bzhin/ /skyong mdzad mdzad bzang gi pha rgan/ /bu ngan ngan 'gro las skyobs shig /bya rgyal rgod po yi tshogs rnams/ /gshog sgro bzang bo de ngom bzhin/ /mkha' la yar yar du bstad nas//mi mthong dgung sngon du 'phur song / /bye'u lcog ka khyod da lta/ /nam mkhar cung zad cig 'phur kyang / /ca co mang bo de sgog bzhin/ /sa la babs pa 'di btsog ang//a kha mdo med kyi lcog ka /mtho sar bgrod pa ni dka' ang / /mkha' la yang yang du 'phur la/ /dar dir skad snyan ni sgogs ya/ /chu bo chen po yi chogs rnams/ /gnyer ma sna tshogs pa g.yo bzhin/ /rgyun chad med pa ru song nas/ /phyi yi rgya mtsho la 'dres song / /lung phran 'bab chu khyod da lta/ /lung ba'i sked bar du 'ongs kyang / /lhung 211

lhung sgra skad de sgog bzhin/ /bye mar 'thim pa 'di btsog ang / /a kha mdo med kyi chu phran/ /rgya mtshor 'dres pa de dka' yang / /yang yang sa steng du bud la/ /lhung lhung skad snyan ni sgogs ya/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba yi tshogs rnams/ /mngon shes dzu 'phrul rnams ngom bzhin/ /'brel tshad thar lam la bkod nas/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas sar bsnyegs song / /tshogs drug rang grol khyod da lta/ /dben par cung zad cig bsdad kyang / /chab chob chos bshad de byed bzhin/ /grong yul 'grim pa 'di btsog ang / /a kha mdo med kyi bya btang / /tshe gcig sangs rgyas de dka' yang / /dben par yun ring du sdod la/ /dge sbyor gang nus de mdzod ya/ /zhes pa 'di ni a rig gi nang du zas 'tshol gyi ldom bu byas dus dben pa dran pa'i shugs kyis rtse mtshar du rang nyid la smras pa'o//rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i nor bu ltar/ /ci 'dod re ba skong mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma dkon mchog rin po che/ /spyi gtsug 'ja' 'od klong du bzhugs/ /bdag ni myur du sangs rgyas nas/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal myong ba yi/ /pha ma sems can ma lus pa/ /bde ba'i zhing du 'dren par shog /khyad par bod kyi mi rnams dang / /sgos su bdag la re ltos pa'i/ /pha ma grwa slob sbyin bdag rnams/ /kun gyi thog mar 'dren par shog /bdag ni 212

mthong dang dran pa dang / /rig dang ming tsam thos pa kun/ /tshe 'di'i bar chad kun zhi zhing / /phyi mar thar ba'i bde thob shog /bdag ni gar song yul phyogs dang / /gang du bsdad pa'i gnas mal dang / /zas gos dpe cha gang song sar/ /chos dang bkra shis 'phel bar shog /bdag la bza' ba phul ba'i mi skye zhing skye ba thams cad du/ /ltogs pa'i sdug bsngal mi myong zhing / /ro brgya'i bcud ldan zas spyod shog /bdag la btung ba phul ba'i mi/ /skye zhing skye ba thams cad du/ /skom pa'i sdug bsngal mi myong zhing / /gang 'dod btung ba 'thung bar shog /bdag la gon pa phul ba'i mi/ /skye zhing skye ba thams cad du/ /'khyags pa'i sdug bsngal mi myong zhing / /dro 'jam legs pa'i gos gyon shog /bdag la bkur ste byed pa'i mi/ /skye zhing skye ba thams cad du/ /bran dang g.yog tu mi skye bar/ /mthon pa'i rigs su skye bar shog /bdag la gnas mal g.yar ba'i mi skye zhing skye ba thams cad du/ /gnas khang mal sa mi ngan par/ /bde 'jam gnas mal thob par shog /bdag la gar 'gro'i lam ston mi/ /skye zhing skye ba thams cad du/ /log pa'i lam du mi 'gro bar/ /ma nor lam du 'gro bar shog /bdag la gang mkho byen pa'i mi/ /skye zhing skye ba thams cad du/ /longs spyod rnams 213

kyis mi phongs par/ /ci 'dod thams cad 'byung bar shog /mdor na rnal 'byor bdag nyid la/ /brten nas sems can thams cad kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog /bla ma dkon mchog byin rlabs dang / /mkha' 'gro chos skyong mthu stobs dang / /bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i mthus/ /smon lam ci btab 'grub par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis grong yul du bsod snyoms su song dus shig tu bton pa'o//tshe 'di'i bya ba kun dor nas/ /dben pa'i lam bzang la zhugs nas/ /dag pa'i zhing khams nyams dga' ru/ /sngon gshegs dam pa rnams la 'dud/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol khyod/ /phyin chad 'di byed da 'di byed/ /snyam pa'i blo rgya ma che bar/ /shes pa lhod la glu 'dir nyon/ /da lta mi lus thob dus 'dir/ /ngan song sdug bsngal myong ba dang / /lha mi'i bde skyid myong ba gnyis/ /da lta 'dam dbang rang la yod/ /rang dbang rang la yod dus 'dir/ /'dam kha ma nor rigs kyi bu/ /deng sang lnga bcu kha ral yin/ /lo yang nyi shu nyer drug lon/ /tshe phyed yad yud shor nas thal/ /tshe lhag ci tsam yod mi shes/ /'chi bdag gshin rje nam 'ong med/ /de ring yin yang 'ong nyen 214

yod/ /da ni bsam mno ma mang bar/ /pha yul dug sbrul tshang 'di nas/ /'bros na dben pa'i nags la phros/ /ya ya ma 'dug da lta song / /nyams dga' rig pa dwangs pa'i sa/ /yid 'ong dben pa'i gnas mchog na/ /dri ldan me tog bzhad pa la/ /bung ba dga' bas glu dbyangs 'then/ /mtsho chu dar las grol ba la/ /chu bya dga' bas dar dir sgog /dri bzhon bser bu langs pa la/ /rkang 'thung dga' bas gar stabs byed/ /sngo ljang rtswa rnams rgyas pa la/ /rkang bzhi'i ri dwags dga' bro 'khrab/ /ljon shing yal 'dab rgyas pa la/ /bya bye'u dga' bas skad snyan 'byen/ /gcig pur ri la 'dug pa la/ /mi rnams dga' bas mthun rkyen bsgrub/ /snying nas gsol ba btab pa la/ /bla ma dga' bas byen gyis brlab/ /thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor byas pa la/ /yi dam dga' bas dngos grub ster/ /rtse gcig sgrub pa byas pa la/ /mkha' 'gro dga' bas bar chad sel/ /dam tshig sdom pa bsrung ba la/ /chos skyong dga' bas 'phrin las bsgrub/ /gzhan yang phan sems bzang ba la/ /lha 'dre dga' bas sdongs grogs byed/ /khu byug gzhan du 'gro ba bzhin/ /yul las rgyang ring ri la song / /rgod pos mkha' la stod pa bzhin/ /rgas kyin ri khrod je mthor thongs/ /ri dwags rmas ma mi mthong bzhin/ /lung stong mi khyi 215

med sar sdod/ /yod rung med rung ri khrod skyid/ /bde rung sdug rung ri khrod skyid/ /gzhon rung rgas rung ri khrod skyid/ /na rung 'chi rung ri khrod skyid/ /dge 'dis rang nyid skyes pa'i yul/ /dug sbrul tshang nas phyi ru thon/ /dben pa'i lam po che brgyud nas/ /thar ba'i gling du 'bros par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//na mo gu ru/ bde bas phongs pa'i 'gro rnams la//bde lam ston mdzad bla mar 'dud/ /bde zhing skyid pa'i mtsho snying du/ /bde bar bsdad nas glu 'di blangs/ /bde legs kun stsol bla ma la/ /bde rung sdug rung gsol btab na/ /bde skyid nyams rtogs 'char ro zhes/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs/ /bde 'gro mtho ris mi yi lus/ /bde blag nyid du thob dus 'dir/ /bde sdug 'dam kha ma nor bar/ /bde thabs lha chos gyis shig gsungs/ /bde nas bde bar 'gro ba la/ /bde lam la sogs lam rim dang / /bde gshegs thugs bcud rdzogs chen sgoms/ /bde skyid nyi ma 'char ro gsungs/ /bde gshegs gong ma'i gsung bzhin du/ /bde med 'khor ba blos btang nas/ /bde dga' rgya mtsho thob pa'i sa/ /bde ba'i ri khrod bsten na legs/ /bde 'jam stan la 'khod nas kyang / /bde la 216

'gro kun 'god 'dod blos/ /bde chen byang chub lam bzang de/ /bde blag nyid du bsgrubs na legs/ /mgrin pa gdams pa'i bang mdzod nas/ /glu dbyangs snyan mo de 'dra thal/ /tshig don snying gi dbus su zungs/ /'phral phugs bde'o bya btang ba/ /zhes pa 'di yang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis dben gnas mtsho snying nas rang nyid la smras pa'o//skyabs gsum kun 'dus bla ma la/ /sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dug gsum dbang gyur bdag gzhan la/ /sgu gsum go 'phang bstsal tu gsol/ /mi la ras pa ji bzhin du/ /rgyud la nyams rtogs ma mchis kyang / /ri la dga' ba'i bya btang ngas/ /sems la skyo shas skye glu len/ /dus tshod 'di yi ngan tshul dang / /dus ngan mi yi 'thab rtsod la/ /bsam zhing skyo shas gting nas skyes/ /bsam pa thag pas dben par 'gro/ /yod pa rnams kyis 'tsho skyong dang / /med pa rnams kyis 'tshol sgrub la/ /bsam zhing skyo shas gting nas skyes/ /bsam pa thag pas dben par 'gro/ /nad dang mu ge mang tshul dang / /na dang shi ba'i mod tshul la/ /bsam zhing skyo shas gting nas skyes/ /bsam pa thag pas dben par 'gro/ /chos pa rnams kyis chags sdang dang / /chos brgyad don du gnyer tshul la/ /bsam zhing skyo shas gting nas skyes/ /217

bsam pa thag pas dben par 'gro/ /mi shes rmongs pa mang tshul dang / /chos shes sgrub mkhan nyung tshul la/ /bsam zhing skyo shas gting nas sgyes/ /bsam pa thag pas dben par 'gro/ /chos ltar bcos pa'i mang tshul dang / /chos bzhin mdzad pa dkon tshul la/ /bsam zhing skyo shas gting nas skyes/ /bsam pa thag pas dben par 'gro/ /btsun pa nor la gdung tshul dang / /dgon pa rnams kyi 'khrug tshul la/ /bsam zhing skyo shas gting nas skyes/ /bsam pa thag pas dben par 'gro/ /chos byed dam pa dmod tshul dang / /sdig byed skye bo bkur tshul la/ /bsam zhing skyo shas gting nas skyes/ /bsam pa thag pas dpen par 'gro/ /rtag tu tshong dang so nam byed/ /rtags tsam 'dzin gye mang tshul la/ /bsam zhing skyo shas gting nas skyes/ /bsam pa thag pas dben par 'gro/ /'dod chung chog shes ma mchis pas che chung med pa'i mdzad pa la/ /bsam zhing skyo shas gting nas skyes/ /bsam pa thag pas dben par 'gro/ /mdor na bya btang rnal 'byor nga / /tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad la/ /bsam zhing skyo shas gting nas skyes/ /bsam pa thag pas dben par 'gro/ /'di ltar bdag gi snyan pa'i glu/ /glu dbyangs gang blangs dge tshogs kun/ /kun bzang go 'phang bde blag tu/ /du ma'i 'go 218

rnams thob phyir bsngo/ /zhes pa 'di ni tshogs drug rang grol gyis dben gnas mtsho snying nas rang la phan phyir blangs pa'o//sku gsung thugs yon mkha' dang mnyam/ /mnyam med drin can chos kyi rgyal/ /rgyal ba sras bcas 'dus pa'i dpal/ /dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /dung dung snying nas yang yang du/ /lhang lhang gsol 'debs gsal gsal sku/ /lam lam ston la snyan snyan gsung / /lhang lhang rna bar yang yang sgogs/ /bya rgyal khu byug skad bzhin du/ /'dren 'gug legs pa'i skad snyan gyes/ /yid 'ongs dben pa'i yon tan rnams/ /ma 'ongs skal ldan rnams la bshad/ /tshe 'di'i rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi med/ /lha chos rnam dag ngang gis 'ong/ /skal ldan yod na ri la shog /shog dang bde skyid nyi ma 'char/ /dgra gnyen gang dang ma 'brel bas/ /chags sdang gang yang skyes yul med/ /skal ldan yod na ri la shog /shog dang bde skyid nyi ma 'char/ /dus bzhi rim gyes 'gyur ba'i tshe/ /dus kun mi rtag 'chi ba dran/ /skal ldan yod na ri la shog /shog dang bde skyid nyi ma 'char/ /mi 'dzad chog shes nor gyis phyug /mi 'dang snyam pa'i sdug bsngal med/ /skal ldan yod na ri la shog /shog dang bde skyid nyi ma 'char/ /'khrul ba'i bya byed ngang gis 'grib/ /nyams rtogs yon tan 219

ngang gis 'phel/ /skal ldan yod na ri la shog /shog dang bde skyid nyi ma 'char/ /dad dang nges 'byung shugs drag skye/ /lha dang bla ma'i byin rlabs 'jug /skal ldan yod na ri la shog /shog dang bde skyid nyi ma 'char/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gang bzang rnams/ /dge la gzhol bzhin ri na yod/ /skal ldan yod na ri la shog /shog dang bde skyid nyi ma 'char/ /rab mjes bya dang bye'u rnams/ /rab tu dga' ba'i skad snyan sgog /skal ldan yod na ri la shog /shog dang bde skyid nyi ma 'char/ /bung ba mang bos glu dbyangs len/ /sha ba la sogs ri dwags rtse/ /skal ldan yod na ri la shog /shog dang bde skyid nyi ma 'char/ /kha dog mi gcig sna tshogs pa'i/ /me tog mang bo phang phung g.yo/ /skal ldan yod na ri la shog /shog dang bde skyid nyi ma 'char/ /ljon shing mang bos gar stabs byed/ /chu gtsang mang bos lhung sgra sgrog /skal ldan yod na ri la shog /shog dang bde skyid nyi ma 'char/ /bde na bde na gcig pur bde/ /skyid na skyid na ri khrod skyid/ /skal ldan yod na ri la shog /shog dang bde skyid nyi ma 'char /rnam dkar 'dis mtshon dge ba rnams//rnam mang ma gyur 'gro ba rnams/ /rnams mkhyen rgyal ba'i yon tan rnams/ /rnam pa kun tu 'thob phyir bsngo/ /zhes pa 'di ni bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis dben 220

gnas mtsho snying nas smras pa'o// ’blo gros bzang thugs rgyud dar bas 'jam 'jam dbyangs dngos grags pa 'gro ba'i mgon/ /mgon de dang dbyer med chos kyi rgyal/ /rgyal sras kyi mchog gyur khyod la 'dud/ /drin can gyi bla ma rin po che/ /spyi gtsug gi rgyal mtshan rtser bskyon nas/ /mos gus kyis gsol ba 'debs nus na/ /mchog thun gyi dngos grub char bzhin 'bab/ /dal 'byor gyi mi lus gru chen dbus/ /dam chos kyi dar bo che phyar nas/ /brtson 'grus kyi rlung gis bskyod nus na/ /'khor ba yi rgya mtsho'i pha rol sgol/ /'dod sred kyi bung ba khra bo de/ /mi rtag pa'i char gyes bskul nus na/ /srid bde yi me tog blos btang nas/ /thar ba yi skam sar myur du snyog /mi shes kyi mun pa'i khang ba ru/ /thos bsam gyi sgron me 'degs nus na/ /shes rab kyi mig 'bur ches cher gsal/ /blang dor gyi gnas rnams thams cad mthong / /nges 'byung gi lus mdzes rma bya la/ /glu dbyangs kyi 'brug sgra sgrog nus na/ /ri khrod kyi shing khar yar 'phur nas/ /nyams len gyi gar rnams yang yang byed/ /tshul khrims kyi sa gzhi gtsang ma ru/ /chos spyod bcu'i chu lud legs sbyar nas/ /sgon lam gyi sa bon 'debs nus na/ /mngon mtho dang nges legs 221

'bras bu smin/ /sems nyid kyi ka la piṅka la/ /thabs shes kyi gshog pa 'dogs nus na/ /rnam mkhyen gye mkha' la myur 'phur nas/ /legs bshad kyi dbyangs snyan lhang lhang sgog /dge 'dis kyang thub bstan rgyal mtshan de/ /bshad sgrub kyi yu ba la brten nas/ /skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /yang yang du bdag gis 'dzin nus shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang nyid la phan phyir dben gnas nyams dga' mtsho snying ma hā de ba nas blangs pa'o//rdo rje 'chang dang thugs dgongs dbyer med pa'i/ /drin can bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs med rgyal khams nyul ba'i bya btang ba/ /tshogs drug rang grol rang la 'di skad smra/ /bla ma dkon mchog gsum la phyag mchod gyis/ /phyi mar sangs rgyas 'thob bo rgyal khams pa/ /dad pas kun nas slong la gsol ba thobs/ /byen rlabs tshe 'dir 'byung ngo rgyal khams pa/ /'chi ba bsams na cis kyang dgos med skye/ /yid la dran par gyes shig rgyal khams pa/ /nor rdzas sgyu ma yin pas snying bo med/ /rtag tu chog shes sten cig rgyal khams pa/ /da lta'i dus 'dir dam pa'i chos la 'bod/ /'jig rten phyi mar phan no rgyal khams pa/ /brtsigs pa'i mkhar khang mi rtag tha mar 'jig /gtan du sdod dbang med do rgyal khams pa/ /de phyir dgos med 222

mkhar las ma byed par/ /dben par sgom sgrub gyis shig rgyal khams pa/ /dad dang brtson 'grus yon tan kun gyi gzhi/ /mchog tu gces pa yin no rgyal khams pa/ /pho mo rang mthong che chung da re shes/ /mi lus stong zad ma byed rgyal khams pa/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i chos la snying bo med/ /snying bo'i lha chos mdzod cig rgyal khams pa/ /snying nas chos bzhin byas na ltogs dogs med/ /lto rgyab zhor la 'byung ngo rgyal khams pa/ /glo snying brang gsum dam pa'i chos la gtod/ /nam yang bslu ba med do rgyal khams pa/ /rang la mtsho snying ri nas phan phyir blangs/ /rang gzhan kun gyi rgyud la phan par shogargyal mtshan tog gi nor bu ltar/ /gang 'dod re ba skong mdzad pa'i/ /drin can bla ma rin po che/ /ci bsam 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /klu blon chen po gnas pa'i mtsho/ /mtsho sngon zhes bya'i dbus kyi ri/ /ri bo ma hā de ba'i gnas/ /gnas chen de ru glu 'di blangs/ /seng ge'i phru gu dkar mo khyod/ /chung ngu'i dus nas gangs la dga'/ /rgyun du gangs stod 'dzin nus na/ /ngo mtshar g.yu ral mgo la rgyas/ /rgya stag phru gu khra bo khyod/ /chung nas tsan dan nags la dga'/ /rgyun du nags stod 'dzin nus na/ /ngo mtshar gra 'dzum lus la bkra/ /nya mo'i phru gu gser mig 223

khyod/ /chung nas rgya mtsho'i nang la dga'/ /rgyun du mtsho dkyil 'dzin nus na/ /ngo mtshar gser mig lus la 'khyil/ /bla ma dam pa'i sras po khyod/ /chung nas dben pa'i ri la dga'/ /rgyun du ri khrod bsten nus na/ /ngo mtshar nyams rtogs yon tan skye/ /mi med lung stong rgyal ba'i zhing / /rang nyid gcig pu rgyal ba'i sras/ /dka' thub ting 'dzin mdzad med zas/ /a shad gtum mo 'dzad med dgos/ /'di 'dra bsten na ngo mtshar che/ 'di rnams rgyun du bsten nus shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol shin tu skyid pa'i shugs kyis glu ru blangs pa'o//dge sbyor gye padmar/ /dad gus chu blugs tshe/ /kha ton gye 'dab ma/ /je rgyas su bud thal/ /rnam g.yeng gi ser bas/ /ma brdungs pa bzang ya/ /'dod chung gi brag ri/ /chog shes spang brgyan tshe/ /dga' bde yi rtsi shing / /sna tshogs pa skyes thal/ /mngon zhen gye thog gis/ /ma bshig pa bzang ya/ /skyo shas kyi 'jol mo/ /skyo mgur 'drogs phud tshe/ /ri khrod kyi shing khar/ /yar yar du 'phur thal/ /'dod yon gyi khra yis/ /ma bzung ba bzang ya/ /tshul khrims kyi bu mo/ /zhi dul rgyan spras tshe/ /legs spyad kyi gnas la/ /dga' bzhin du bzhud thal/ /log spyod kyi a nes/ /ma mnar ba bzang ya/ /bsam gtan gyi sha ba/ /dran 224

shes rtswas 'grangs tshe/ /bde gsal mi rtog pa'i/ /spang gshongs su nyal thal/ /bying rgod kyi sha khyis/ /ma bzung ba bzang ya/ /shes rab kyi mar me/ /ches cher du sbar tshe/ /blang dor gyi gnas rnams/ /cung zad cig mthong thal/ /mi shes kyi mun pas/ /ma khebs pa bzang ya/ /zhes pa 'di yang glu ba tshogs drug rang grol gyis nyams dga' ba'i shugs kyis blangs pa'o//na mo gu ru/ spang gshongs 'jam por nyal ba'i/ /ri dwags rnams tsho nyon dang / /da lta rtswa chu 'thung zhing / /phan tshun rtse bar 'dug ste/ /glo bur rngon pa slebs dus/ /lus srog 'dor bar nges pas/ /de gong rdza ri mthon por/ /phros la bde bar sdod cig /me tog rtse la 'khor ba'i/ /bung ba rnams tsho nyon dang / /da lta 'phur lding g.yo zhing / /sgra dbyangs sgrog par 'dug ste/ /glo bur char ba babs nas/ /gshog sgro rnam par nges pas de gong gang 'dug tshang du/ /song la bde bar sdod cig /mtsho snying ri la 'dug pa'i/ /rang re rnams tsho nyon dang / /da lta lang tsho rgyas shing / /nad med bde bar 'dug ste/ /glo bur 'chi ba slebs tshe/ /sgyu lus 'jig par nges pas/ /de gong ri khrod dben pa/ /bsten la sgom sgrub gyis shig /ces pa 'di ni tshogs drug rang grol gyis blangs pa'o//225

skyu ru ra lag mthil bzhag bzhin du/ /du ma'i 'gro'i skyon dang yon tan rnams/ /rnam dag gi thugs kyis sa ler mkhyen/ /mkhyen brtse dang nus ldan bla mar 'dud/ /sngon dus su skyes chen bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /gnas chen ni khyad 'phags mtsho snying ri/ /ri 'dabs kyi brag la gnas pa'i tshe/ /tshe blos btang rang la bza' sdigs byas/ /dam pa rnams bsten tshe log rtog 'phel/ /dam gtsang grogs song tshe ngan smra brjod/ /dam chos de bsgrub tshe khye bzhin 'khyams/ /dam nyams khyod bsam tshe mi 'gyod dam/ /bza' btung gnyis 'dzoms dus chos pa'i gzugs/ /dgra 'dre gnyis gnod dus tha mal ba chos sems gnyis bstun dus gtan 'gal khyod/ /'di phyi gnyis med dus ci byed snyam/ /rang gi skyon kha ba tsam bzhag nas/ /gzhan gye skyon ba mo tsam la 'phya/ /bla ma'i skyon sgos su rtog mkhan khyod/ /snying la skyon rgyal 'gong ma zhugs sam/ /skyabs gsum dang bla ma'i spyan snga ru/ /sdom gsum ni bsrung bar khas blangs nas/ /sgo gsum gyi log spyod lkog tu byed/ /dug gsum gye g.yog khyod ngo mi tsha'am/ /ri khrod du bsdad dus grong la spro/ /dge sbyor du zhugs dus snang ba sun/ /mnyam gzhag tu bzhag dus gnyid 'dod skye/ /pha rol tu 'gro dus khyod skyid snyam/ /bla ma ni snga 226

spangs phyi ma bsten/ /yi dam ni snga bskyur phyi ma bsgrub/ /chos skyong ni snga bzhag phyi ma mchod/ /de rnams kyi sngon chad skyon ci rig /gos su yang ras gos snam ther dang / /zas su yang sha thud mar rnams dang / /grogs su yang long gtam lab mkhan 'dod/ /nyams su yang de len khyod ya mtshan/ /dam chos kyi ro mchog khyod mi myang / /gti mug gi ro yis khyod myos pas/ /gson po yi ro las khyod shi na/ /shi sa na ro yang khyod las gtsang / /zhes pa 'di yang mtsho snying du bsdad dus gti mug gnyid shin tu lci bas snga bar langs 'dod mi skye ba'i tshe rang la dge bskul du tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//chos kyi rgyal por gsol ba 'debs/ /mi rtag 'chi bas rgyud bskul nas/ /dam chos nyams su len pa la/ /brtson 'grus 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs/ /nyon dang bya btang ri khrod pa/ /nyin mo bza' btung long gtam lab/ /mtshan mo snga bar ro nyal byas//spyod ngan 'di la khyod ltos dang / /khyod kyis thos tshad dran tshad kyi/ /mi ni shi ba rnams bgrongs la/ /sngon chad mi 'di ma shi zhes/ /tshe thar e yod khyod soms dang / /da ni mi 'di mi 'chi zhes/ /gdeng can su yod bsam blo thongs/ /'chi ba 'di la dgra gnyen gye/ /rim pa 'dug gam mi 'dug ltos/ /'chi ba ran dang mi ran gyi/ /tshod bzung 'dug gam mi 'dug ltos/ /khyod kyis 227

ma mthong ma rtogs pa/ /skyes tsam nyid nas 'chi bdag kho/ /gnya' khung thog na zhon nas yod/ /la la btsas ma thag tu gsod/ /la la dar bab dus su gsod/ /la la rgas ba'i dus su gsod/ /mi 'di lo cang ma lon pas/ /'chi ni ma ran bshad sa med/ /bu ni gcig pu 'di min med/ /bu ni zhog ces bshad sa med/ /las ka mang bo las dgos pas/ /mi khom par yod bshad sa med/ /'on te go ni ma chod par/ /slar yang log nas byung ba med//rgan rgon sha zad rus zad tsho/ /ma mkho bzhag nas lus pa med/ /btsan pos 'thab kyang mi thub ste/ /dmag dpung mang bo'i dbus nas kyang / /dmag dpon rgyal po shi ba yod/ /mgyogs pas bros kyang mi thar te/ /'dab chags nam mkhar 'gro ba yang / /'chi bdag pho nyas bzung tsa na/ /sa la spob kyis lhung ba yod/ /gang du gab kyang mi thub ste/ /rgya mtsho'i gting du gnas pa'i nya/ /'chi bdag kho yis bzung tsa na/ /skam la phyung nas shi ba yod/ /phyug pos nor gyes blu sa med/ /'dzam gling nor la dbang 'byor yang / /nor rdzas gseb tu gum pa yod/ /byad bzhin mjes pas thub pa med/ /lha dang lha mo 'dra ba'i mi/ /dbyibs dang kha dog phun sum tshogs/ /gos dang rgyan cha du mas spras/ /'jig rten 'di na thams cad kyis/ /smon pa'i 228

gnas su 'dzin pa yang / /la la rgas te 'chi ba dang / /la la phun sum tshogs pa'i dus/ /'chi ba khyod kyis ma mthong ngam/ de bzhin chus khyer g.yang lhung dang / /dug byung mtshon brgyab khang brdibs nas/ /shi ba mang bo ma mthong ngam/ /shul na yod pa'i mi rnams kyis//la las kha rtsang nged gnyis kyis/ /za ma zas nas lhan cig bsdad/ /'gro bsdad mang bo'i shom ra byas/ /long med shi ba i shi zer/ /la las na nangs nged gnyis kyis/ /kha ta mang bo byas pa yin/ /a kha snying rje la sogs zer/ /de 'dra zhig ni de ring yang / /khyod la mi 'ong gdeng ci yod/ /shi na sngar byas las dbang gis/ /khyod la 'gro sa mang bo med/ /ngan song gsum po de ru lhung / /lhung na sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig las/ /skyid ni e yod bsam blo thongs/ /do nub 'chi rung mi 'gyod pa'i/ /gdeng zhig yod na ngo mtshar che/ /khyod kyis ro nyal byed tshul la/ /bltas na gdeng zhig yod mod snyam/ / med na 'di ltar sdod tshugs na/ /khyod rang gdon gyis smyos sam ci/ /gdeng zhig ma thob 'chi ba'i dus/ /dbugs len gshed po la sogs pa'i/ /'byung bo du mas mtha' nas bskor/ /da za da 'khyer zer ba'i dus/ /'gyod kyang cung zad bya thabs med/ /de bas snying rtsa rab non pa'i/ /chos shig mi byed 'dug phod dam/ /rang gis rang la 229

snying rje na/ /nyin par rnam g.yeng bya ba spongs/ /mtshan mo gti mug ro nyal zhog /da lta nyid du mi 'gyod pa'i/ /chos shig mi byed sdod ri shi /snyam du zhe mna' khyod skyol la/ /sgrub pa'i brtson 'grus me ltar sbor/ /'dis kyang rang gzhan la phan nas/ /rnam g.yeng gti mug ro nyal spangs/ /dam pa'i chos la rab gzhol nas/ /gtan gyi btsan sa zin par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//na mo gu ru/kha bde sems skyid kyi bya btang khyod/ /nam mkha' yangs pa la dpe zhog la/ /mtha' dbus med pa yi sgom zhig rgyob/ /lho sprin smug po de 'khrigs pa'i tshe/ /gzhan gyis 'bad rtsol gyes sel mi dgos/ /lho sprin nam mkha' yi cho 'phrul yin/ /nam mkha' kho rang gi ngang du zhog /rang sar grol ba la je tshom med/ /gu yangs blo bde ba'i glu ba khyod/ /mtsho snying ri bo la dpe zhog la/ /g.yo 'gul med pa yi sgom zhig rgyob/ /rtsi shing sna tshogs pa skyes pa'i tshe/ /gzhan gye 'bad rtsol gyis sel mi dgos/ /rtsi shing ri bo yi cho 'phrul yin/ /ri bo kho rang gi ngang du zhog /rang sar grol ba la the tshom med/ /gtad med smyon pa yi ri ba khyod/ /khri gshog mtsho mo la dpe longs la/ /kha gting med pa yi sgom zhig rgyob/ /rba rlabs mang bo de g.yo ba'i tshe/ /gzhan 230

gye 'bad rtsol gyis sel mi dgos/ /rba rlabs mtsho mo yi cho 'phrul yin/ /khri gshog mtsho mo yi ngang du zhog /rang sar grol ba la the tshom med/ /rdzogs pa chen po yi rnal 'byor khyod/ /khyab gdal zang thal gyi rang rig 'di/ /skyong dus rtog med kyi sgom zhig rgyob/ /bzang ngan rnam rtog de 'phro ba'i tshe/ /yid dpyod rtsol ba yis sel mi dgos/ /rnam rtog rang rig gi cho 'phrul yin/ /rig pa kho rang gi ngang du zhog /rang sar grol ba la je tshom mid/ /ces pa 'di yang gtad med spyon pa tshogs drug rang grol gyis mtsho snying nas rang la smras pa'o//rje chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo la/ /bdag gsol ba 'debs so byen gyis rlobs/ /lus mi rtag g.yar bo lta bu la/ /gos rgyan cha spras pa shin tu blun/ /nor bsags pa shul du ldus rgyu la/ /sdig ser sna byed pa shin tu blun/ /sdug rtsa ba grogs bu 'khor rgyas la/ /dga' gces 'dzin byed pa shin tu blun/ /dus gtan bde'i dam chos mi bsgrub par/ /tshe 'di don bsgrub pa shin tu blun/ /rkyen cung zad mi bzod ngan song gi /sdug bzod mod snyam pa shin tu blun/ /dgra 'chi bdag nam 'ong cha med par/ /yun ring bor sdod snyam shin tu blun/ /khyod blun po'i khyu ru ma 'tshangs par/ /da mkhas pa'i gral du e tshud ltos/ /glu 'di yang 231

rang la phan phyir blangs/ /mi gzhan dag la yang phan thogs shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//mtshan ldan gyi bla ma rin po che/ /'gro kun la thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /yang sgos su bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /yid bzhin gye nor bu dgos 'dod ni/ /'byung na yang rlom sems med pa bzhin/ /rlom sems ni med pa'i sbyin pa thongs/ /rab mdzes kyi me tog padma de/ /'dam nang du skyes kyang ma gos bzhin/ /nyes ltung gis ma gos tshul khrims srungs/ /gces phrug gi bu la dus rgyun du/ /a ma yis snying nas gces pa bzhin/ /'gro kun la khro med bzod pa sgoms/ /sgeg mo yi mgo 'am gos la me/ /shor ba de myur du gsod pa bzhin/ /le lo ni med pa'i brtson 'grus brtson/ /skyi ser gyi rlung gis ma bskyod pa'i/ /mar me ni g.yo med gsal ba bzhin/ /bying rgod dang bral ba'i bsam gtan sgoms/ /rtsi shing gi ri bo chen po la/ /me shor na ches cher 'bar ba bzhin/ /'chal ba med shes rab ches cher skyed/ /phar phyin drug rgyal sras spyod pa yin/ /'gro don du khyod kyis spyad par gyes/ /dge 'dis kyang rang gzhan la phan shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//pha rgan chos kyi rgyal po la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis 232

rlobs/ /lus kyi mi dge ba rnams spongs/ /lus ni snang stong lha skur sgoms/ /lus kyi sgrib pa kun dag nas/ /lus ni rgyal ba'i sku ru 'gyur/ /ngag gi mi dge ba rnams spongs/ /brag cha bzhin du sngags zlos shig /ngag gi sgrib pa kun dag nas/ /ngag ni rgyal ba'i gsung du 'gyur/ /yid kyi mi dge ba rnams spongs/ /gsal stong 'dzin med ngang la zhog /yid kyi sgrib pa kun dag nas/ /yid ni rgyal ba'i thugs su 'gyur/ /lta ba rang stong chen po yin/ /lta rgyu med pa lta ba'i mchog /sgom pa rang gsal 'dzin med yin/ /sgom rgyu med pa sgom pa'i mchog /spyod pa dgag sgrub med pa yin/ /spyod rgyu med pa spyod pa'i mchog /dam tshig bsrung med nyams med yin/ /bsrung rgyu med pa dam tshig mchog /'bras bu skye med chos sku yin/ /skye rgyu med pa 'bras bu'i mchog glu dbyangs 'di nyid thos tshad kyi/ /rgyud la phan thogs 'byung bar shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//blo spyong bdud rtsi'i thigs pa bzhugs so//rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /bdag blo dam pa'i chos la sgyur/ /nyon dang bya btang ri khrod pa/ /dam pa'i lha chos sgrub pa'i rten/ /dal 'byor mi lus thob pa'i rgyu/ /tshul khrims sbyin sogs dge ba'i las/ /phun sum tshogs pa bsgrub dgos pas/ /233

sems can nang na rgyu dge ba/ /sgrub pa shin tu nyung bas na/ /'bras bu dal 'byor thob pa dkon/ /dud 'gro la sogs 'gro ba'i rigs/ /gzhan la ltos na dal 'byor rten/ /thob pa nyin skar tsam du 'dug /bdag gis da re dal 'byor gye/ /mi lus rin chen thob pa 'di/ /don med chud zos mi 'gyur bar/ /dam chos rnam dag cig byed dgos/ /snyam du sgoms shig ri khrod pa/ /da lta'i tshe la nges pa med/ /'chi ba'i rkyen ni shin tu mang / /de ring tsam yang mi 'chi ba'i/ /gdeng ni rang la mi 'dug pas/ /da lta dam pa'i chos byed dgos/ /snyam du sgoms shig ri khrod pa/ /dge ba dang ni sdig pa'i las/ /'bras bu bde sdug 'byung gsungs pas/ /sdig pa thams cad rab spangs shing / /dge ba ci nus bsgrub par bya/ /snyam du sgoms shig ri khrod pa/ /dge bas rang gzhan la phan shog/rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /byang sems 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /nyon dang bya btang ri khrod pa/ /skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed kyis/ /yan lag bdun pa phul nas ni/ /lha dang bla mar gso' ba thobs/ /lus kyi gnad ni drang bor sdod/ /dbugs ni phyir 'gro nang 'gro gnyis/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig bar du bgrongs/ /de ltar byas na bsam gtan gye/ /snod rung 234

'gyur ro ri khrod pa/ /phyi rol ri dang khang khyem sogs/ /snod bcud 'di dag thams cad ni/ /dper na rmi lam ji bzhin du/ /rang gi sems kyi 'khrul snang yin/ /rang bzhin grub pa rdul tsam med/ /sems nyid ya ki spyi gtsug nas/ /ma ki rkang mthil bar du tshol/ /btsal tshe sgye 'gags gnas gsum gyes/ /stong zhing kha dog dbyibs sogs med/ /lus kyi phyi nang gang na yang / /mi gnas ci yang ma grub cing / /ci yang mi rnyed pa zhig 'ong / /de ltar 'tshol mkhan ngo bo la/ /ltos dang stong sang 'dzin med 'gyur/ /stong sang de ga'i ngang nyid du/ /mnyam par zhog cig ri khrod pa/ /de nas thun mtshams thams cad du/ /rang gzhan snod bcud ci snang rnams/ /dper na rmi lam sgyu ma ltar/ /rang bzhin med par shes par gyis/ /sgyu ma'i seng ge glang sogs kyis/ /phan tshun gnod dang rmi lam du/ /bde sdug myong ltar dkar nag las/ /nam yang bslu ba med snyam du/ /snang stong sgyu ma'i ngang nyid nas/ /tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong la sogs la/ /brtson par mdzod cig ri khrod pa/ /dge 'dis rang gzhan la phan shog /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /byang sems 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /nyon dang bya btang ri khrod pa/ /sdug bsngal byung ba thams cad ni/ /bdag nyid gces par bzung ba las/ /235

'byung zhes rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs/ /de phyir khyod kyis da nas bzung / /bdag 'dzin 'di la dgra ru ltos/ /bdag 'dzin 'phung rgan nam byung ba'i/ /dus su kho rang ngo bor ltos/ /bltas pas gang yang mi 'dug tshe/ /don med ci'i phyir bdag tu 'dzin/ /snyam du bdag 'dzin spang bar mdzod/ /nyon dang bya btang ri khrod pa/ /phan bde thams cad sems can rnams/ /gces par bzung las 'byung ngo zhes/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyis gsungs/ /de phyir khyod kyis da nas bzung / /sems can thams cad gnyen du bzung / /mchog dman bar ma thams cad la/ /phan thogs mdzod cig ri khrod pa/ /dge 'dis rang gzhan la phan shog /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /byang sems 'byongs par byin gyes rlobs/ /nyon cig bya btang ri khrod pa/ /rang gi tshe 'di'i drin can ma/ /mdun du gsal bar rab dmigs la/ /bdag ni a ma 'di nyid kyi/ /lto bar gnas pa nas bzung ste/ /chud ma gzon par legs bskyangs pas/ /da lta sangs rgyas bstan par mjal/ /lam bzang sgrub pa'i skal ba ldan/ /ma 'di shin tu drin re che/ /tshe 'di kho na ma zad kyi/ /tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas/ /tha ma da lta thug gi bar/ /lan grangs mang bor ma 236

byas nas/ /byas dus byams pa'i mig gis bltas/ /zhim pa'i nu zho kha ru blud/ /gces pa'i sha yi drod la bslan/ /cher song zas zhim mang bo byin/ /dro 'jam yang ba'i gos kyis g.yogs//phan pa dpag tu med pa btags/ /me chu g.yang la sogs pa yi/ /'jigs pa rnams las rab tu bskyabs/ /de 'dra'i dka' las sna tshogs kyis/ /bskyangs pas shin tu drin re che/ /gnas skabs mthar thug bde ba yis/ /phongs pa'i drin can a ma 'di/ /gnas skabs bde ba sna tshogs dang / /mthar thug byang chub bde ba dang / /ldan par gyur na ci ma rung / /snyam du byams pa shugs drag sgoms/ /mi 'dod sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa/ /myong ba'i ma 'di snying re rje/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag dang / /bral bar gyur na ci ma rung / /snyam du snying rje shugs drag sgoms/ /da ni myur du bdag nyid kyis/ /drin can a ma'i drin lan du/ /phan 'dogs gnod pa bsal bar bya/ /drin can ma la gang gnod na/ /tshe 'di'i sdug bsngal dngos su gnod/ /skye ba gzhan du mi dge'i las/ /rnams dang nyon mongs gnod pas na/ /de rnams bdag gis blang bar bya/ /snyam du drin can ma'i rgyud na/ /yod pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad dang / /mi dge las dang nyon mongs rnams/ /dud pa nag po'i rnam pa ru/ /ma yi sna bug 237

g.yas nas 'thon/ /rang gi sna bug g.yon nas zhugs/ /snying gi dkyil na dus kun tu/ /nga nga zer ba'i mgo thog tu/ /sib sib thim pa'i mos pa gyis/ /ma yi sdug bsngal las nyon rnams/ /thams cad bdag gi snying nang du/ /byung na snyam pa'i 'dun pa ni/ /drag tu gyis shig ri khrod pa/ /drin can ma la cis phan na/ /bde dang dge ba'i las phan pas/ /bdag gi bde dang dge ba rnams/ /thams cad ma la gtang bar bya/ /snyam du rang gi bde dge rnams/ /'od zer dkar bo'i rnam pa ru/ /rang gi sna bug g.yas nas 'thon/ /ma yi sna bug g.yon nas zhugs/ /zhugs pas a ma 'phral bde zhing / /dam chos bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen 'dzom/ /phugs su 'tshang rgya nus tsam du/ /gyur par sgoms shig ri khrod pa/ /'dis kyang rang gzhan la phan shog /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /byang sems 'byongs par byen gyis rlobs/ /nyon dang skal ldan ri khrod pa/ /tshe 'di'i pha yang mdun du dmigs/ /rang gis skye ba blangs pa'i grangs/ /bgrangs na grangs kyis mi chod ces/ /thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas gsungs/ /de phyir bdag gi pha 'di ni/ /tshe 'dir bdag gi phar gyur nas/ /phan pa dpag tu med pa btags/ /sgye ba gzhan du bdag gi ma/ /byas pa grangs kyis mi chod pa/ /byas 238

dus byams pa'i mig gis bltas/ /zhim pa'i nu zho kha ri blud/ /gces pa'i sha yi drod la bslan/ /cher song zas zhim mang bo byen/ /dro 'jam yang ba'i gos kyis g.yogs/ /phan pa dpag tu med pa btags/ /me chu g.yang la sogs pa yi/ /'jigs pa rnams las rab tu bskyabs/ /de 'dra'i dka' las sna tshogs kyis/ /bskyangs pas shin tu drin re che/ /gnas skabs mthar thug bde ba yis/ /phongs pa'i drin can pha rgan 'di/ /gnas skabs bde ba sna tshogs dang / /mthar thug byang chub bde ba dang / /ldan par gyur na ci ma rung / /snyam du byams pa shugs drag sgoms/ /mi 'dod sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa/ /myong ba'i pha 'di snying re rje/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag dang / /bral bar gyur na ci ma rung / /snyam du snying rje shugs drag sgoms/ /da ni myur du bdag nyid kyis/ /drin can pha 'di'i drin lan du/ /phan gdags gnod pa bsal bar bya/ /drin can pha mar gang gnod na/ /tshe 'di'i sdug bsngal dngos su gnod/ /skye ba gzhan du mi dge'i las/ /rnams dang nyon mongs gnod pas na/ /de rnams bdag gis blang bar bya/ /snyam du drin can pha'i rgyud na/ /yod pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad dang / /mi dge'i las dang nyon mongs rnar/sa/ /dud pa nag po'i rnam pa ru/ /pha yi sna bug 239

g.yas nas 'thon/ /rang gi sna bug g.yon nas zhugs/ /snying gi dkyil na dus kun tu/ /nga nga zer ba'i mgo thog tu/ /sib sib thim pa'i mos pa gyis/ /pha yi sdug bsngal las nyon rnams/ /thams cad rang gi snying dkyil du/ /byung na snyam pa'i 'dun pa ni/ /drag tu gyis shig ri khrod pa/ /drin can pha la cis phan na/ /bde dang dge ba'i las phan pas/ /bdag gi bde dang dge ba rnams/ /thams cad pha la gtang bar bya/ /snyam du bdag gi bde dge rnams/ /'od zer dkar bo'i rnam pa ru/ /rang gi sna bug g.yas nas 'thon/ /pha yi sna bug g.yon pa nas/ /zhugs pas pha de 'phral bde zhing / /dam chos bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen 'dzom/ /phugs su 'tshang rgya nus tsam du/ /gyur par sgoms shig ri khrod pa/ /dge 'dis rang gzhan la phan shog /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /byang sems 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /nyon dang skal ldan ri khrod pa/ /rang gi pha ma'i mtha' skor du/ /sems can thams cad yod par dmigs/ /bdag gi skye ba grangs med pas/ /bdag gi skye ba gzhan rnams su/ /sems can 'di dag thams cad kyis/ /bdag gi a ma ma byas med/ /skye ba gzhan du bdag gi ma/ /byas dus byams pa'i mig gis bltas/ /zhim pa'i nu zho kha ru blud/ /240

gces pa'i sha yi drod la bslan/ /cher song zas zhim mang bo byen/ /dro 'jam yang ba'i gos kyis g.yogs/ /phan pa dpag tu med pa btags/ /me chu g.yang la sogs pa yi/ /'jigs pa rnams las rab tu bskyabs/ /de 'dra'i dka' las sna tshogs kyis/ /bskyangs pas shin tu drin re che/ /gnas skabs mthar thug bde ba yis/ /phongs pa'i ma gyur 'gro ba rnams/ /gnas skabs bde ba sna tshogs dang / /mthar thug byang chub bde ba dang / /ldan par gyur na ci ma rung / /snyam du byams pa shugs drag sgoms/ /mi 'dod sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa/ /myong ba'i 'gro kun snying re rje/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag dang / /bral bar gyur na ci ma rung / /snyam du snying rje shugs drag sgoms/ /da ni myur du bdag nyid kyis/ /ma gyur 'gro ba'i drin lan du/ /phan gdags gnod pa bsal bar bya/ /drin can 'gro la gang gnod na/ /tshe 'di'i sdug bsngal dngos su gnod/ /tshe rabs gzhan du mi dge'i las/ /rnams dang nyon mongs gnod pas na/ /de rnams bdag gis blang bar bya/ /snyam du 'gro ba thams cad kyi/ /rgyud la yod pa'i sdug bsngal dang / /mi dge las dang nyon mongs rnams/ /dud pa nag po'i rnam pa ru/ /'gro kun sna bug g.yas nas 'thon/ /rang gi sna bug g.yon nas zhugs/ /241

snying gi dkyil na dus kun tu/ /nga nga zer ba'i mgo thog tu/ /sib sib thim pa'i mos pa gyis//'gro ba'i sdug bsngal las nyon rnams/ /thams cad rang gi snying nang du/ /byung na snyam pa'i 'dun pa ni/ /drag tu gyis shig ri khrod pa/ /drin can 'gro la cis phan na/ /bde dang dge ba'i las phan pas/ /bdag gi bde dang dge ba rnams/ /thams cad 'gro la gtang bar bya/ /snyam du rang gi bde dge rnams/ /'od zer dkar bo'i rnam pa ru/ /rang gi sna bug g.yas nas 'thon/ /'gro kun sna bug g.yon pa nas/ /zhugs pas 'gro kun 'phral bde zhing / /dam chos bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen 'dzom/ /phugs su 'tshang rgya nus tsam du/ /gyur par sgoms shig ri khrod pa/ /dge 'dis rang gzhan la phan shog /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /byang sems 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /nyon dang skal ldan ri khrod pa/ /de ltar lan mang bsgoms pa'i mthar/ /thun mtshams rnams su rang sems la/ /chags sdang rmongs sems skye ba'i tshe/ /bdag ltar 'dod chags zhe sdang dang / /gti mug skyes pa'i sems can ni/ /mang bo yod pas de rnams kyi/ /dug gsum bdag la 'dus nas kyang / /de rnarmas chags sdang rmongs gsum dang / /bral bar gyur 242

cig snyam du sgoms/ /spyod lam kun tu tshig 'di thon/ /sems can rnams kyi sdig pa dang / /sdug bsngal thams cad bdag smin cing / /bdag gi bde dang dge ba rnams/ /sems can rnams la smin gyur cig /ngag tu brjod cing 'dun pa yang / /drag tu gyis shig ri khrod pa/ /dge 'dis rang gzhan la phan shog /ces kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems thun mtshams rnams su bsgom tshul 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /mi 'dod 'gal rkyen grogs su sgyur/ /nyon dang bya btang ri khrod pa/ /dben par gcig pur sdod pa'i dus/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal ci byung yang / /kun rdzob nyid du 'di ltar du/ /snang yang dper na rmi lam du/ /me yis tshig gam chus khyer nas/ /nyam thag pa ltar rang gi sems/ /'khrul nas snang ba ma gtogs pa/ /rang bzhin grub pa rdul tsam yang / /med do snyam du bsgom par gyes/ /nyon dang bya btang ri khrod pa/ /de nas rang gi lus sems gnyis/ /blo yis so sor phye nas kyang / /nyon mongs yang na sdug bsngal de/ /rang bzhin grub pa e 'dug ltos/ /bltas tshe gang yang mi rnyed par//stong bar gyur tshe de'i ngang du/ /mnyam par zhog cig ri khrod pa/ /dge 'dis rang gzhan la phan shog/243

rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rkyen ngan lam gyi grogs su sgyur/ /nyon dang bya btang ri khrod pa/ /rnal 'byor rang la gnod byed pa'i/ /mi 'am mi min byung ba'i tshe/ /gnod byed 'di yis thog med nas/ /bdag gi a ma grangs med byas/ /byas dus kho rang sdig sdug dang / /gtam ngan gang la'ang ma 'dzems par/ /bdag la phan pa byas byas nas/ /sngon dus bdag gi don gyi phyir/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs myangs/ /da lta kho rang nyon mongs pa'i/ /gdon gyis yid dkrugs dbang med smyos/ /bdag nyid tshe sngon kho rang gi /nye du yin pa ngo ma shes/ /bdag gi las ngan gyes bskul nas/ /'di yis bdag la gnod pa'i las/ /byas na de yi rnam smin gyes/ /phyi mar sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur/ /bdag la brten nas 'di nyid kyis/ /sngon dus sdug bsngal yun ring myangs/ /da yang myong nges snying re rje/ /don la 'di ni bdag nyid la/ /gnod byed ma yin bdag 'di la/ /gnod byed nyid du yong 'dug pas/ /da ni gnod byed 'di nyid kyi/ /sdig sdug thams cad bdag la smin/ /bdag gi bde dge ma lus pa/ /gnod byed 'di la smin gyur cig /snyam du gtong len yang yang gyis//dge 'dis rang gzhan la phan shog /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /rkyen ngan lam gyi grogs 244

su sgyur/ /nyon dang bya btang ri khrod pa/ /khyad par gnod byed khye lta bu//dngos su mthong ba'i gnod byed pa//dngos su phan pa ci thogs gyes/ /dngos su phan 'dogs ma nus na/ /bdag la gnod byed 'di nyid ni/ /sdug bsngal bral nas bde dang ldan/ /myur du bla na med pa yi/ /byang chub go 'phang thob par shog /snyam du soms la ngag tu brjod/ /phyin chad bdag gis dge ba'i las/ /ci byed thams cad gnod byed 'di'i/ /don phyir bya snyam sems bsgyed gyis/ /gnod byed lha dang 'dre yin na/ /bdag gis thog ma med pa nas/ /de yi sha khrag zos 'thungs pas/ /de yi lan du rang nyid kyi/ /sha khrag 'di la ster snyam du/ /gnod byed mdun du rang gi lus/ /blo yis kha phye sha dang khrag /rus pa nang khrod gang 'dod zo/ /snyam du blo yis lings kyis skyur/ /ngag tu 'di ltar brjod par gyes/ /phaṭaḥ gces shing mkho ba'i sgyu lus 'di/ /gnod byed khyod la phangs med ster/ /sha zo khrag thungs rus pa 'cho/ /nang khrol la sogs gang 'dod zo/ /de nas gnod byed de nyid kyis/ /sha zos khrag 'thungs bkres skom zhi/ /lus sems zag med bde bas gang / /gnod pa'i bsam sbyor kun zhi nas/ /byang chub sems dang ldan par sgoms/ /de nas sha khrag za ba yi/ /snang sred lha 'dre thams cad la/ /byin pas sha 245

zos khrag 'thungs nas/ /ngoms shing tshims te rang gzhan la/ /gnod pa'i bsam sbyor kun zhi nas/ /byang chub sems dang ldan par sgoms/ /gzhan yang mdze nad la sogs pa/ /sdug bsngal drag po byung gyur na/ /sdug bsngal 'di nyid ma byung na/ /bdag ni tshe 'di'i shom ra yi/ /dbang song dam chos mi dran par/ /'dug pa 'di yis dran du bcug /'di ni bla ma dkon mchog gi /'phrin las yin snyam dam chos la/ /nyin mtshan med par 'bad par gyes/ /dge 'dis rang gzhan la phan shog/rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la 'dud//rkyen ngan lam gyi grogs su sgyur/ /nyon dang bya btang ri khrod pa/ /gzhan yang gnod byed 'di nyid kyis/ /bdag la byang chub sems mchog gnyis/ /sbyong phyir bskul ma byas pas kyang / /'di nyid shin tu bka' drin che/ /bdag ni gnyen po dang bral nas/ /nyon mongs skye ba ma tshor dus/ /'di yis sbran pa'i bka' drin gyis/ /'di nyid bla ma'i sprul ba 'am/ /yang na sangs rgyas sprul ba zhig /yin snyam soms shig ri khrod pa/ /mdor na bla ma la brten nas/ /byang chub sems nyid skye ba ltar/ /gnod byed nyid dang sdug bsngal la/ /brten nas rang gi rgyud 'di la/ /byang chub sems gnyis skyes 'dug pas/ /'di yis bdag la go bcad do/ /snyam du 246

sgoms shig ri khrod pa/ /de ltar byas na mi mthun pa'i/ /rkyen ngan lam gyi grogs su 'gyur/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /rkyen ngan lam gyi grogs su sgyur/ /nyon dang bya btang ri khrod pa/ /rang la sdug bsngal byung ba'i tshe/ /sdug bsngal 'di nyid med na dga'/ /snyam pa'i bsam pa byung ba'i tshe/ /khyod kyis sdug bsngal mi 'dod cing / /bde ba 'dod na bde ba'i rgyu/ /tshogs gsogs zhes pa'i brda' yin gyis/ /snyam du bla ma dkon mchog mchod/ /dge 'dun sde la bsnyen bkur dang / /dbul bo rnams la sbyin gtong dang / /'byung bor gtor ma gtong ba sogs/ /mdor na lus ngag yid gsum gye/ /sgo nas tshogs gsog la 'bad nas/ /bla ma dkon mchog gsum po la/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed maṇḍal 'bul/ /bdag ni na bar legs gyur na/ /na bar byin gyes bslab tu gsol/ /bdag ni sos par legs na yang / /sos par byen gyis brlab tu gsol/ /bdag ni shi ba legs na yang / /'chi bar byin gyes brlab tu gsol/ /re dogs med pa'i gsol ba thobs/ /khyod kyis sdug bsngal mi 'dod na/ /sdug bsngal rgyu yi sdig las rnams/ /spongs shig ces pa'i brda' yin gyis/ /snyam pa byas la sngar byas kyi/ /sdig pa rnams la dug khong du/ /song ba 247

lta bu'i 'gyod sems dang / /phyin chad srog la bab na yang / /mi byed snyam pa'i dam bca' yis/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byed pa dang / /stong nyid bsgom zhing gzungs sngags bzla/ /gnod byed gdon la gtor ma phul/ /khyod kyis bdag gi byang chub sems/ /sbyong ba'i grogs byas bka' drin che/ /da dung sems can sdug bsngal kun/ /bdag la smin par mdzad du gsol/ /snyam du zhe nas gsol ba thobs/ /de ltar byed par mi nus na/ /gdon la gtor ma phul nas kyang / /byams dang snying rje gnyis bsgoms la/ /nga yis khyod la 'phral yun du/ /gang phan bya yi gdon khyod kyis/ /nga yis dam chos bsgrub pa la/ /bar chad ma byed ces bsgrag go /chos skyong rnams la gtor ma phul/ /chos kyi 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang / /mthun rkyen 'grub pa'i gsol ba thobs/ /de ltar byas na rkyen ngan kun/ /dge la bskul ba'i bshes gnyen yin/ /ma dga' ma byed ri khrod pa/ /dge 'dis rang gzhan la phan shog/rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /glo bur rkyen ngan grogs su sgyur/ /nyon dang bya btang ri khrod pa/ /nad dang gdon dang dgra la sogs/ /glo bur sdug bsngal byung tsa na/ /'jig rten khams na 'di lta bu'i/ /sdug bsngal 'byung ba mang yod pas/ /de 248

rnams thams cad snying re rje/ /snyam du de dag sdug bsngal rnams/ /thams cad bdag la 'ub kyis bsdus/ /bdag la gnod byed 'di nyid kyis/ /byams sems sbyong ba'i grogs byas pas/ /bka' drin che'o snyam du sgoms/ /gzhan gyi sdug bsngal mthong na yang / /de ma thag tu rang la longs/ /rang ngam gzhan la nyon mongs pa/ /shugs drag skyes tshe gzhan rnams kyi/ /nyon mongs thams cad bdag nyid la/ /'dus par gyur cig snyam du sgoms/ /de ltar byas na rkyen ngan rnams/ /byang chub sems kyi grogs su 'gyur/ /dge 'dis rang gzhan la phan shog /rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /nyon dang bya btang ri khrod pa/ /deng nas bzung ste bdag nyid kyis/ /zla ba 'di dang lo 'di dang / /ma shi'i bar dang sangs ma rgyas/ /bar du byang chub sems gnyis dang / /nam yang 'bral bar mi bya'o/ /snyam du 'phen pa yang yang thongs/ /nyin re bzhin du byang chub kyi/ /sems gnyis rtag tu sbyong bar gyis/ /byang chub sems gnyis sgye ba dang / /'phel ba'i don du tshogs gsog mdzod/ /bdag nyid gces 'dzin rnam rtog ni/ /byung dus 'di yis thog med nas/ /sdug bsngal sna tshogs la sbyar zhing / /mi tshe 'di yang sdig sdug dang / /dam 249

chos 'dod bzhin ma byung ba/ /thams cad 'di yis lan pa yin/ /snyam du rang nyid gces 'dzin gyi/ /rnam rtog de nyid sgong bar gyes/ /dge sbyor thams cad byas 'jug tu/ /da nas sangs rgyas ma thob bar/ /byang chub sems dang mi 'bral zhing / /rkyen ngan ci byung thams cad kyang / /chos 'di'i grogs su 'khyer bar shog /ces pa'i smon lam 'debs par mdzod/ /bla ma dkon mchog yi dam dang / /mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad la/ /mchod dang gtor ma phul nas kyang / /bla ma dkon mchog rin chen dang / /yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams/ /bdag gis smon lam gang btab pa/ /de bzhin 'gyur bar mdzad du gsol/ /snyam du 'dod gsol gyis shig ang / /dge 'dis rang gzhan la phan shog / rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byen gyis rlobs/ /nyon dang bya btang ri khrod pa/ /'chi nges nad kyis thebs pa'i tshe/ /yo byad ci yod thams cad kyis/ /bla ma dkon mchog mchod pa dang / /ngan slong rnams la sbyin pa thongs/ /gang la'ang chags zhen med par gyis/ /bla ma dkon mchog rin chen la/ /yan lag bdun pa phul nas kyang / /bdag gis bar do'i gnas skabs dang / /tshe rabs phyi ma thams cad du/ /nam yang 250

byang chub sems gnyis po/ /sbyong bar byen gyis brlab tu gsol/ /chos 'di ston pa'i bla ma dang / /mjal bar byen gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes pa'i gsol ba shugs drag thobs/ /bdag gis tshe rabs thams cad du/ /byang chub sems gnyis sbyong bar shog /tshe rabs kun tu dam chos 'di/ /ston pa'i bla mar mjal bar shog /ces pa'i smon lam 'debs par gyis/ /bdag gi gces 'dzin rnam rtog 'dis/ /sngar yang sdug tu bcug pa yin/ /da dung 'di dang ma bral na/ /'di yis bde ru mi ster 'dug /da lta bdag gis lus gces par/ /bzung bas sdug bsngal bar 'dug ste/ /brtags na lus sems gang la yang / /bdag tu bzung rgyu cang mi 'dug /snyam du bdag 'dzin spong bar mdzod/ /bdag gis bar do'i gnas su yang / /byang chub sems gnyis sbyong bar bya/ /snyam pa'i 'phen pa yang yang thongs/ /de nas sngar gye byang chub kyi/ /sems gnyis sbyong tshul dran byas te/ /'chi khar gzhogs g.yas 'og tu bcug /lag g.yas 'gram sbyar mje'u chung gis/ /sna bug g.yas pa khogs la rlung / /sna bug g.yon par rgyu ru chugs/ /rlung gi 'gro 'ong la bskyon nas/ /gtong len gnyis ka sbyong bar mdzod/ /de rjes 'khor ba'i skye 'chi sogs/ /thams cad rang gi sems snang 251

yin/ /sems nyid ci yang ma grub par//shes pa'i ngang la blos ci yang / /ma 'dzin rang sar glod la zhog /de ltar byang chub sems gnyis ka /spel zhing bsgoms 'phror 'chi bar mdzod/ /dge 'dis rang gzhan la phan shog /rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /nyon dang bya btang ri khrod pa/ /theg pa che chung thams cad kyi/ /dgos pa bdag 'dzin 'dul la 'dus/ /chos ni byas tshad bdag 'dzin gyi/ /gnyen por ma song ci byas rnams/ /don med nyid du song ba yin/ /dam chos byas tshad bdag 'dzin 'di/ /'dul ba'i gnyen por song gyur na/ /blo sbyong rgyud la skyes rtags yin/ /chos ni chos su song ma song / /khyad par 'di yis shes pas na/ /'di ni chos pa thams cad po/ /srang la 'jal ba'i rgya ma yin/ /gzhan rnams kun gyis jo bo de'i/ /rgyud la nges par chos skyes 'dug /chos pa bzang bo de yin zhes/ /gzhan gyis ma khrel ba de yang / /dpang bo yin mod khyad par du/ /rang la rang gis ma khrel ba/ /blo 'byongs rtags ni yang dag yin/ /phyin chad rkyen ngan gang byung yang / /blo sbyong lam du 'khyer bas chog /snyam pa'i blo yi gdeng yod na/ /blo 'byongs tshad gcig 'di yang yin/ /glo bur gnod byed 252

la sogs pa'i/ /rkyen ngan byung na zhe sdang sogs/ /mi skye rkyen ngan de nyid ni/ /blo sbyong grogs su 'gror 'dug na/ /blo 'byongs tshad yin rtags 'di rnams/ /byung yang da dung sbyong bar mdzod/ /dge 'dis rang gzhan la phan shog/rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byen gyes rlobs/ /nyon dang bya btang ri khrod pa/ /so so thar ba nas bzung ste/ /gsang sngegs rdo rje theg pa'i bar/ /rang gis ji ltar khas blangs pa'i/ /bslab pa ma nyams bsrung bar gyis/ /shing gnyan gcod cing mje bo dang / /'grogs sogs tho co'i spyod pa spongs/ /mi yis gnod pa bzod pa la/ /lha 'dres gnod pa mi bzod dang / /che la gus shing chung la brnyas/ /gnyen la byams shing dgra la sdang / /phyogs re ba rnams spong bar gyis/ /rang nyid gces par 'dzin pa'i blo/ /bdag pas gzhan gces pa la sgyur/ /zhar ba tshul khrims 'chal sogs la/ /mi snyan tshin rnams brjod pa spongs/ /spyir na sems can thams cad dang / /khyad par chos sgor zhugs rnams kyi/ /skyon mthong tshe na rang snang 'di/ /ma dag pa yin de rnams la/ /de 'dra'i skyon ni yod snyam med/ /snyam du skyon rtog blo de spongs/ /rang rgyud nyon mongs gang che ba/ /gnyen po'i chos kyis thog mar thul/ /blo sbyong byas pas 253

tshe 'di yi/ /rnyed dang bkur sti la sogs dang / /phyi mar lha mi'i bde ba dang / /rang nyid gcig pur 'khor ba las thar bar 'dod pa la sogs pa'i/ /rang don thams cad spong bar mdzod/ /dngos po bden par 'dzin pa dang / /bdag nyid gces 'dzin rnam rtog dang / /'dres pa'i dge sbyor thams cad spongs/ /pha rol gnod pa byas pa la/ /'khon du bzung nas 'khon 'dzin las/ /nam yang mi ldog pa de spongs/ /gzhan gyes tshig ngan smra lan du/ /sems la gnod pa'i tshig ngan ni/ /ma smra nyes pa byung na yang / /'di yis lan zhes smra ba sgongs/ /gzhan gyis gnod pa byas pa rnams/ /zhe la bzhag nas gnod pa'i lan/ /'jal ba'i dus tshod byung tsa na/ /'jal ba de nyid sgong bar mdzod/ /mi yi skyon mtshang 'bru ba dang / /mi ma yin pa'i srog sngags ni/ /'don pa la sogs gzhan sems la/ /gnod pa drag po 'byung ba spongs/ /rang la babs pa'i gcu gal lam/ /khog ngan g.yo sgyus gzhan dag la/ /bsgyur ba de nyid spong bar mdzod/ /longs spyod thabs ni sna tshogs kyis/ /'thob par byed pa'i bsam sbyor spongs/ /phugs su rang la phan 'dod nas/ /gzhan la pham kha len pa dang/ /'dre dang gdon dang nad zhi bar/ /'dod nas blo sbyong byed pa spongs/ /blo sbyong sgo nas nga 254

rgyal dang / /rlom sems chen po byed pa spongs/ /rang gi nye du grogs mched sogs/ /shi na de dag zas nor dang / /dpe cha la sogs nga la 'ong / /yon bdag rnams la na tsha dang / /shi chad byung na tshogs gsog 'ong / /rang dang mnyam pa'i sgom chen pa/ /shi na nga la sku bsod rgyas/ /dgra bo shi na gnod byed ni/ /mi 'ong nga 'tshengs snyam pa spongs/ /dge 'dis rang gzhan la phan shog /rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyes rlobs/ /nyon dang bya btang ri khrod pa/ /zas gos sogs la spyod pa'i tshe/ /gzhan phan sems kyis spyod par mdzod/ /blo sbyong bsgoms pas na tsha dang / /'dre gdon mi yis sdang ba dang / /rang gi nyon mongs cher song nas/ /blo sbyong sgom snying mi 'dod pa/ /byung na 'jig rten khams 'di na/ /bdag gi nyes pa 'di lta bu/ /byung ba'i sems can mang yod pas/ /de dag thams cad snying re rje/ /de dag kun gye nyes pa rnams/ /thams cad bdag la 'dus gyur cig /snyam du gtong len bsgom par mdzod/ /snga dro byang chub sems gnyis dang / /'bral med bya snyam 'phen pa thongs/ /'phen pa btang bzhin nyin mo ru/ /dran shes gnyis kyis zin par gyes/ /dgong mo nyal tshe nyin par gyi/ /spyod 255

pa rtogs la byang chub kyi/ /sems dang 'gal ba byung 'dug na/ /bla ma dam pa rnams dang mjal/ /dam chos 'di 'dra thob nas kyang / /bya ba ngan pa 'di bzhin du/ /byed pa khyod 'dra 'ang snyam du/ /rang la ngan smras mang bo brjod/ /tshar chod snying nas 'gyod bshags gyis/ /phyin chad 'di bzhin mi byed par/ /bya'o snyam pa'i dam bca' gyis/ /ma 'gal 'dug na e ma ho/ /bla ma dam pa rnams dang mjal/ /theg pa chen pa'i zab chos thob/ /dben pa'i gnas su 'ongs pa yang / /don dang ldan zhes rang nyid kyis/ /rang la gzengs bstod spro ba skyed/ /phyi nas bdag gis 'di bzhin du/ /byo'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa gyis/ /'khor dang longs spyod la sogs pa/ /phun sum tshogs pa byung ba na/ /de yi khengs drags ma sgyes par/ /sgyu ma lta bur shes pa dang / /gzhan la phan thabs ci 'gyur gyis/ /rgud de 'og nas 'gro ba la/ /chu las med pa byung na yang / /sgyu ma lta bur shes pa dang / /gzhan gyi rgud pa bdag nyid la/ /len cing zhum pa med par mdzod/ /chos ni spyi yi dam tshig dang / /khyad par blo sbyong dam tshig ni/ /rang gi srog las gces par srungs/ /nyon mongs skyes tshad dang po'i dus/ /dran dka' bar du ldog par dka'/ /tha mar rgyun ni chod dka' bas/ /dang po nyon mongs skyes ma thag /ngos bzung 256

bar du gnyen po stobs/ /bskyed nas spongs la tha ma yis mi 'byung phyir du 'bad par bya/ /dge 'dis rang gzhan la phan shog/rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byen gyes rlobs/ /nyon dang bya btang ri khrod pa/ /dam chos sgrub pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo/ /bla ma bzang bor mjal dang gcig /rang blos las su rung ba'i chos/ /tshul bzhin nyams su len dang gnyis/ /dam chos bsgrub la dgos pa yi/ /mthun rkyen thams cad tshang dang gsum/ /rang la tshang na dga' ba sgoms/ /gzhan la rgyu de gsum po ni/ /legs par tshang ba'i smon lam thobs rang la de gsum ma tshang na/ /'jig rten khams na bdag lta bu'i/ /rgyu gsum ma tshang dam pa'i chos/ /rna lam ma byung mang yod pas/ /de rnams thams cad snying re rje/ /de dag rnams la rgyu gsum po/ /ma tshang nyes pa bdag nyid la/ /'dus par gyur cig snyam du sgoms/ /theg pa chen po'i yon tan rnams/ /bla mar mos gus rag las pas/ /bla mar mos gus nyams med dang / /blo sbyong theg chen chos 'di nyid/ /bsgom la spro ba nyams med dang / /thag pa che chung bslab bya rnams/ /phra mo tshun chad nyams med srungs/ /lus dang ngag yid gsum po ni/ /dge dang 'bral ba 257

med par gyis/ /yul ni sems can thams cad dang / /sems can ma yin pa rnams la/ /phyogs ris med par sbyong ba dang / /blo la gang shar thams cad la/ /blo sbyong bdag gis khyab byas nas/ /kha tshig tsam ni ma yin par/ /gting nas 'byongs par byed pa gces/ /rang gi 'gran zlar 'dug pa dang / /rang dang lhan cig 'grogs pa dang / /phar la gnod pa ma byas kyang / /tshur la gnod pa byed pa dang / /las ni dbang gis rang nyid kyi/ /snying mi sdug pa la sogs pa/ /gang sgyes dga' ba thams cad la/ /lhag par byams dang snying rje gnyis/ /bsgom la pha ma la sogs pa'i/ /yul ni gnyen po thams cad la/ /gnod par 'gyur la khyad par du/ /sbyang ba byed par rab tu gces/ /zas gos la sogs 'dzoms pa dang / /gzhan gyis gnod pa med pa dang / /khams bzang ba la sogs pa yi/ /mthun rkyen 'dzoms la mi blta bar/ /mthun rkyen ma 'dzoms dus na yang / /ma 'dzoms pa de byang chub sems/ /gnyis kyi sgo nas lam du 'khyer/ /sngon chad thog ma med pa nas/ /lus ni ji snyed blangs pa rnams/ /don med nyid du song nas 'dug /da re mi tshe 'di nyid la/ /don gyi gtso bo gcig bsgrub dgos/ /tshe 'di'i don pas dam chos gtso/ /chos la bshad sgrub rnam gnyis las/ /lhag par sgrub 258

pa byed pa gtso/ /bsgrub pa gzhan las byang chub kyi/ /sems gnyis rgyun du sbyong ba gtso/ /de yang lung rig gnyis kyi sgos/ /sbyongs la bla ma'i man ngag la/ /brten nas phur tshugs sbyong ba gtso/ /spyod lam gzhan las rang nyid kyis/ /mal du bsdad nas sbyong ba gtso/ /yul spong ba las gnyen po ni/ /brten pa gtso bas gtso che ba/ /de rnams nyams su len par gyis/ /dge 'dis rang gzhan la phan shog /rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byen gyis rlobs/ /nyon dang bya btang ri khrod pa/ /dam chos sgrub pa'i sdug bsngal ni/ /mi bzod tshe 'di'i dgra 'dul dang / /gnyen skyong la sogs dka' sbyad rnams/ /bzod pa bzod pa go log go /dam chos sgrub la 'dun mi byed/ /tshe 'di'i dpal 'byor la sogs la/ /'dun byed 'dun pa go log go /thos pa bsam pa sgom pa yi/ /sgo nas chos kyi ro mi myang / /'jig rten 'di yi bde ba'i ro/ /myang ba ro myang go log go /mi dge sdig pa byed pa la/ /snying rje mi bsgom dam chos phyir/ /dka' thub byed la snying rje ni/ /bsgom pa snying rje go log go /rang la ltos pa'i mi rnams ni/ /dam pa'i chos la mi sbyor bar/ /tshe 'di'i dpal 'byor che thabs la/ /sbyor ba gnyer sems go log go /'khor 'das 259

gnyis kyi bde dge la/ /dga' ba mi bsgom dgra la sdug /byung na dga' ba bsgom pa ni/ /rjes su yi rang go log go /go log drug po rab spongs la/ /ma bog pa drug nyams su longs/ /chos la nges shes ma skyes pas/ /res byed res mi byed pa de/ /spongs la rgyun chad med par sgoms/ /blo sbyong nyid la blo khol la/ /blo sna ma mang 'bad par gyis/ /rang rgyud nyon mongs gang che ba/ /rtog dpyod gyis la spong bar mdzod/ /pha rol gzhan la rang nyid kyi/ /drin yod pa dang rang gis chos/ /yun ring dos drag byas pa dang / /mkhas dang btsun pa la sogs pa'i/ /yus mi byed pa shin tu gces/ /bdag la gzhan gyis mi mang sar/ /dma' sar 'bab pa la sogs pa/ /lan dang ko long byed pa spongs/ /cung zad tsam la dga' mi dga'/ /rnam 'gyur ston pa de yang spongs/ /gzhan la phan ni btags pa'am/ /chos byas pa la gzhan dag gis/ /tshig gi gtang rag e 'ong dang / /grags snyan e 'ong re ba spongs/ /mdor na mi tshe tril bo la/ /byang chub sems mchog rnam pa gnyis/ /thun gye dngos gzhi thun mtshams su/ /dus kun rtag tu legs sbyangs nas/ /'byongs pas gdeng ni thob par mdzod/ /dge 'dis rang gzhan la phan shog /'jig rten 'di yi bya ba spangs/ /'phral la zas 'tshol bya dang 260

'dra/ /ming dang don mthun bya btang ba/ /tshogs drug rang grol bya ba ngas/ /blo sbyong bdud rtsi'i thigs pa 'di/ /blo chung rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /blo sbyong don bdun 'gros ltar bkod/ /blo dman yongs la phan par shog /ces blo sbyong bdud rtsi'i thigs pa'i skor tsho rdzogs so//rje drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /bdag dad pas lhang lhang gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs brtse bas gang na bzhugs kyang byon/ /mi bdag gi spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /sngon mi khom gnas su mang skyes kyang / /da dal 'byor thob pa bla ma'i drin/ /sa mtha' 'khob skyes kyang sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan pa dang mjal ba bla ma'i drin/ /bo gzhon dus dge sdig ngo mi shes/ /da blang dor shes pa bla ma'i drin/ /mdo sngags kyi zab chos mang bo gnang / /da nyams len byed 'di bla ma'i drin/ /zhing so nam khe tshong ma byas kyang / /chos mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa bla ma'i drin/ /lus bsrung ba'i 'khor lo ma btags kyang / /gdon gang gis ma gtses bla ma'i drin/ /mi rang las gzhon pa mang shi yang / /rang da dung gnas pa bla ma'i drin/ /nang 'dod sred chu ltar khol na yang / /sdom dam tshig ma shor bla ma'i drin/ /sems gti mug mun pas khebs na yang / /chos blo gros rgyas pa bla ma'i drin/ /261

tshur rang mthong nga rgyal che na yang / /gzhan khyad du mi gsod bla ma'i drin/ /sems zhen chags che rung phyogs phyogs su/ /lto'i phyir du mi brgyug bla ma'i drin/ /chos sems gnyis da dung ma 'dres kyang / /chos zhen pa ma log bla ma'i drin/ /rang sna thag gzhan la mi ster bar/ /mi rang gis 'dzin 'di bla ma'i drin//rje bla ma bka' drin shin tu che/ /bdag skyid sdug da dung bla ma mkhyen/ /blo chos su 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs/ /chos lam du 'gro bar byen gyis rlobs/ /chos bar chad med par byin gyis rlobs/ /nyams rtogs pa 'char bar byin gyes rlobs/ /chos lam du 'gro bar byin gyes rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyes smras pa'o//nang ting 'dzin sgo 'phar brgya phye nas/ /ngo mtshar ba'i dag snang ltad mo ni/ /sna tshogs la ngoms med gzigs pa yi/ /pha chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bor 'dud/ /sems gsal stong ngang du mnyam gzhag dus/ /skabs phal cher rnam rtog 'phro ba'i tshe/ /slar mang du spros la 'phro gnas la/ /khyad ci 'dug rtsad gcod gyis la ltos/ /yang lha 'dres phan gnod ltar byed pa'i/ /lha 'dre gnyis khyad par ci 'dra 'dug /khyad med pa mi srid dkar nag gam/ /yid 'ong dang mi 'ong la sogs pa/ /khyad shin tu che'o 262

snyam du ltos/ /yang de bzhin bde sdug snang ba la/ /khyad ci 'dug khyad par mi 'dug na/ /ji ltar du mi 'dug blta bar gyis/ /yang snang ba sems gnyis gcig yin nam/ /tha dad du 'dug gam blta bar gyes/ /yang rang gi sems ni sangs rgyas thugs/ /de gnyis la bzang ngan ci 'dra 'dug /gcig yin nam tha dad gang red ltos/ /yang sems la skye 'chi 'gro 'ong dang / /mtha' dbus dang phyi nang e grub ltos/ /ma bltas na de dag shan mi phyed/ /pha bla mar gsol ba 'debs kyin ltos/ /yang bzang ngan khyad par mi 'dug na/ /bsgom tsa na khyad med 'gro 'dug gam/ /ma bsgoms dus khyad mi 'dug gam ltos/ /yang 'khor bar skyes pa bdag 'dzin khos/ /lan gsungs pas bdag de gang la zer/ /lus yin na lus kyi mgo bo dang / /ro stod dang yan lag nying lag dang / /don snying lnga snod drug sha khrag rus/ /phyi'i pags pa skra sen gang la zer/ /sems yin na snga phyi bar gsum gye/ /shes pa ni gang yin zhib tu ltos/ /yang rang gi lus 'di gang la zer/ /mgor mgo zer ma gtogs lus mi zer/ /de bzhin du lus kyi yan lag rnams/ /re re nas so sor phyes la ltos/ /sems lta thog bzhag nas bsgom byung gi /shes rab kyis blta ba shin tu gces/ /snga mo nas brdar sha ma 263

bcad na/ /yon tan ni gang yang mi sgye bar/ /gdams ngag gi zhabs 'dren byed pa yin/ /de ltar du dpyad nas bltas pa'i tshe/ /phar ming gis btags tsam ma gtogs pa/ /bzang ngan dang ngos bzung rdul tsam yang / /ma rnyed par rang sems gsal stong dang / /dbyer med du phyam gyis song ba'i tshe/ /gnas lugs kyi steng du rjen ne zhog /'di legs sbyar rnam dkar dge ba'i tshogs/ /mi bdag dang bdag 'dra'i gzhon nu rnams/ /dbyings stong ba'i na chung mdzes ma dang / /lhan cig tu 'grogs pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang gzhan yongs la phan phyir smras pa'o//bka' dang dgongs 'grel gdams par shar/ /bka' gdams mes po 'brom ston sogs/ /bka' gdams bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /bka' gdams gong ma'i byen gyis rlobs/ /nyon dang bya btang ri khrod pa/ /mu stegs log pa'i lam zhugs kyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan la rab tu sdang / /bstan 'dzin dge 'dun rnams la sdang / /de 'dra'i gnas de mi bde'i gnas/ /bsdad na mi bde'i sems 'byung bas/ /sdang dang sdang yul rnams spangs nas/ /bde ba'i gnas su song na bzang / /tshul khrims 'chal ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /tshul khrims ldan pa dag 264

la sdang / /dam tshig nyams pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /dam tshig ldan pa dag la sdang / /de 'dra'i gnas de mi bde'i gnas/ /bsdad na mi bde'i sems 'byung bas/ /sdang dang sdang yul rnams spangs nas/ /bde ba'i gnas su song na bzang / /nyon dang bya btang ri khrod pa/ /bsod nams can gye gang zag gis/ /bsdu bzhis gzhan gyi don byed pa/ /'dod pa can gyes mi bzod par/ /phrag dog dbang gis sdang bar byed/ /de 'dra'i gnas de mi bde'i gnas/ /bsdad na mi bde'i sems 'byung bas/ /bde ba'i gnas su song na bzang / /'jig rten dag na rmongs pa rnams/ /rang gi chos dang mi mthun pa'i/ /gzhan gyi chos pa zhig mthong na/ /nga dang kho zhes rab tu sdang / /de 'dra'i gnas de mi bde'i gnas/ /bsdad na mi bde'i sems 'byung bas/ /sdang dang sdang yul rnams spangs nas/ /bde ba'i gnas su song na bzang / /nyon dang bya btang ri khrod pa/ /bas mtha' yang na dgon pa'am/ /dur khrod gnas sam shing drung ngam/ /rgya mtsho'i 'gram mam gad skyibs sam/ /shin tu dben pa'i gnas rnams su/ /phyin nas phyag gsum yang na bdun/ /zla phyed zla re lo re tsam/ /sdang dang mi bde ma byung tshe/ /dge sbyor ci 'phel gzhan don bya/ /sdang dang mi bde byung ma thag /ri bong mal nas 265

langs pa bzhin/ /bde ba'i gnas su bros na bzang / /nyon dang bya btang ri khrod pa/ /mkhar lan mi bzang rang shong tsam/ /gzhan gyis mi rig skyibs yod tsam/ /'jog kyang mi chag spang ra 'am/ /g.ya' 'am lo ma'i spyil bu 'am/ /gad pa'i phug gam brag skyibs bsten/ /gang du 'dug kyang dkon mchog gi /mchod dang mchod yul rgyun ma gcod/ /khrims ldan thar ba don gnyer rnams/ /rgyun chad med par skyob par byed/ /de tshe lha rten la sogs pa'i/ /mchod yul mang bo chags pa'i rgyu/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar paṃ yig las/ /pad sdong bsgyed de rtsa brgyud kyi/ /bla ma dkon mchog yi dam lha/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong kun/ /bzhugs so yan lag bdun pa phul/ /'phral phugs bde ba'i gsol ba thobs/ /de ni dben par 'dug pa'i tshe/ /chags pa med pa'i chos su bzang / /dge 'dis bya btang ri ba yis/ /bka' gdams gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /sdang dang sdang yul rnams spangs nas/ /bde ba'i gnas song chos byed shog /cesapa 'di yang bya btang ri khrod pa tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//bla ma spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /chos dang mthun par byen gyis rlobs/ /nyon dang bya btang ri khrod pa/ /chos bzhin byed na 'di bzhin mdzod/ /chos pa'i mtshang du gang che na/ /chags sdang 266

'di nyid che ba yin/ /gang du chags sdang yul byung tshe/ /sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin du ltos/ /mi snyan tshig ngan thos pa'i tshe/ /brag cha bzhin du blta bar mdzod/ /sems can thams cad pha mar sgoms/ /drin soms bde dang sdug bsngal brjes/ /sems can kun gyi sdug bsngal kun/ /dbugs la drongs la tshur la longs/ /rang gi bde dge ci yod pa/ /rlung la bskyon la phar la spros/ /bde skyid byung tshad gzhan la byin/ /sdug bsngal byung tshad rang la longs/ /khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la byin/ /gyong dang pham kha rang gis longs/ /gal te gsod pa zhig byung yang / /srog len yin par shes par gyis/ /slar yang de la snying rje bskyed/ /yid kyis sdig pa rang la longs/ /de ltar byas na ci 'ongs na/ /'tshang rgya ba la shin tu nye/ /dge 'dis rang gzhan thams cad kyis/ /bdag pas gzhan gces sems 'byongs shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /nyon dang bya btang ri khrod pa/ /smra ba mang bo sdig pa'i rgyu/ /sems can nyon mongs rgyu las byas/ /phrag dog khong khro lhan skye bas/ /gcig la bstod na gcig khro zhing / /don med khong khros dge rtsa 'joms ming ngan 'dogs shing zur za gtong / /bstod pa gcig la smad pa 267

brgya/ /ngag gi nyes pas dgra bo 'gug /ngag gi nyes pas bshes dang 'bral/ /ngag gi nyes pas lce steng du/ /phyi mar rmo dor stong gis rmo/ /'jam pa'i tshig kyang mang gyur na/ /skad kyi dpangs kyis 'byed par byed/ /mi ni la la bstod byas kyang / /dogs pa langs nas mtshang la 'phog /bstod pas dgra bo 'gug par srid/ /ngan la bstod pa byas gyur na/ /lhag par de nyid khong khro skye/ /bzang la bab kyis brjod gyur kyang / /smad pa bzhin du khro bar 'gyur/ /spyi'i ched bshad na sgos mi 'khrugs/ /sgos gtam lab na spyi dgra ldang / /ku re tha ma 'thab mor 'gro/ /kha 'thab byas mthar brdung re byed/ /brdung re byas mthar srog dang 'bral/ /srog dang bral na ngan 'gror 'gro/ /ngag la brtag pa shin tu gces/ /du ma 'dug na smra bcad bzang / /dad can 'dug na bzang bo smros/ /mkhas pa 'dug na yon tan bstod/ /btsun pa 'dug na btsun la bstod/ /bzang bo 'dug na lag len smra/ /sdig can 'dug na bags kyis gzhol/ /gnyen por 'gro na gang yang smros/ /gzhan du ngag gi nyes pa bsdams/ /gzhan la gtam rnams ma smras sngon/ /gtam de mgrin par bskyil byas nas/ /de la re ltos 'dug mi 'dug /chags sdang gnyis bcas 'dug mi 'dug /gzhan la gshe bar 'dug mi 268

'dug /sgo skur tshig tu 'gro mi 'gro/ /ngag 'khyal yin nam dzun tshig yin/ /phra ma yin nam tshig rtsub yin/ /dngos kyis gnod dam shugs kyis gnod/ /'phags pa'i tshig gam byes pa'i tshig /don dang ldan nam mi ldan blta/ /'gro na smra sgor gtang bar bya/ /mi 'gro mgrin pa'i a la stems/ /gzhan yang bsam gtan sgom pa'i rtsar/ /kha ton klog par mi bya'o/ /dred po sgur ba 'debs pa'i rtsar/ /kha ton lag len mi bya'o/ /gzhan yang theg pa dman pa la/ /theg chen bsgrags na skyon du 'gyur/ /bla ma mkhan slob la sogs la//rang nyid dad gus che gyur kyang / /chags sdang can gyi rtsar mi sdod/ /snod min tha mal skye bo la/ /gsang ba sgog pa byur du che/ /mdor na mngon shes ma thob bar/ /spyir yang ngag ni bsdam pa gces/ /sgos su mang bo'i gseb tu chod/ /snyan dang mi snyan tshig thos kyang / /lkugs pa'i tshul du gnas par gyis/ /'dis kyang rang gzhan la phan shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//grong 'a 'ur 'du 'dzi'i gnas spangs nas/ /yar gangs ri nags tshal spang gshongs sogs/ /gnas dben par da lta bzhugs pa yi/ /rje bla ma rnams la gus pas 'dud/ /sprang ri khrod zin par byen gyis rlobs/ /sems gyong bo thul bar byin 269

gyes rlobs/ /ri smug pa can gye khrod cig na/ /sems gyong bo 'dul sa'i phug pa yod/ /der song nas sems 'di ma btul na/ /grong yul nas thul ba dka' mor gda'/ /mi nga ni dpen pa'i ri la 'gro/ /gzhan skal ldan yod na nga phyir shog /shing sna tshogs rgyas pa'i khrod cig na/ /sems gyong bo 'dul sa'i bsil khang yod/ /der song nas sems 'di ma btul na/ /grong yul nas thul ba dka' mor gda'/ /mi nga ni dben pa'i nags la 'gro/ /gzhan skal ldan yod na nga phyir shog /ri gangs kyis brgyan pa'i khrod cig na/ /sems gyong bo 'dul sa'i spang gshongs yod/ /der song nas sems 'di ma btul na/ /grong yul nas thul ba dka' mor gda'/ /mi nga ni dben pa'i spang la 'gro/ /gzhan skal ldan yod na nga phyir shog /brag bya rgod lding ba'i khrod cig na/ /sems gyong bo 'dul sa'i brag phug yod/ /der song nas sems 'di ma btul na/ /grong yul nas thul ba dka' mor gda'/ /mi nga ni dben pa'i brag la 'gro/ /gzhan skal ldan yod na nga phyir shog /rdza sha 'brong gnas pa'i khrod cig na/ /sems gyong bo 'dul sa'i rja phug yod/ /der song nas sems 'di ma btul na/ /grong yul nas thul ba dka' mor gda'/ /mi nga ni dben pa'i rdza la 'gro/ /gzhan skal ldan 270

yod na nga phyir shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//'e 'e drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma/ /a rog snying nas yang yang dran dus/ /kho re snying gi dkyil du sgoms dang / /ha ha nam yang blo bde e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'e 'e rab mdzes 'ja' sprin 'di rnams/ /a rog mkha' las byung zhing mkha' la/ /kho re slar yang thim tshul soms dang / /ha ha nam yang blo bde e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'e 'e chu rlabs chu bur 'di rnams/ /a rog mtsho las byung zhing mtsho la/ /kho re slar yang thim tshul soms dang / /ha ha nam yang blo bde e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'e 'e rtsi shing lo tog 'di rnams/ /a rog sa las byung zhing sa la/ /kho re slar yang thim tshul soms dang / /ha ha nam yang blo bde e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'e 'e 'khor 'das gnyis kyi chos rnams/ /a rog sems las byung zhing sems la/ /kho re slar yang thim tshul soms dang / /ha ha nam yang blo bde e go /ya yi ya yi/ /'e 'e dpe de phyi ru zhog la/ /a rog don de nang du bskor la/ /kho re mgur dbyangs snyan mo 'then dang / /ha ha nam yang blo bde e go /ya yi ya yi/ /zhes pa 'di yang nyin zhig sbrang char 'jam po babs shing chu byas skad snyan sgog mtsho la rba rlabs sna tshogs g.yo zhing / 'ja' tshon zhig kyang lam lam shar tshe/ pha bla ma rnams yang yang dran zhing sems la dga' skyo sna tshogs pa shar ba'i tshe snang ba de rnams dpe ru bzhag nas tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la mtsho snying nas smras pa'o//271

'e 'e bka' drin gsum ldan bla ma/ /a bo spyi bo'i gtsug tu sgoms la/ /bu lo gsol ba yang yang thobs dang / /ha ha blo bde skyid ya e go /go go ya yi/ /'e 'e ya ki nam mkha' 'di nyid/ /a bo dpe ru zhog la mtha' dbus/ /bu lo bral ba'i bsgom zhig rgyob dang / /ha ha blo bde skyid ya e go /go go ya yi/ /'e 'e steng gi nyi zla 'di nyid/ /a bo dpe ru zhog la gsal 'grib/ /bu lo med pa'i bsgom zhig rgyob dang / /ha ha blo bde skyid ya e go /go go ya yi/ /'e 'e ma ki rgya mtsho 'di nyid/ /a bo dpe ru zhog la kha gting / /bu lo med pa'i bsgom zhig rgyob dang / /ha ha blo bde skyid ya e go /go go ya yi/ /'e 'e pha ki ri bo 'di nyid/ /a bo dpe ru zhog la g.yo 'gul/ /bu lo med pa'i bsgom zhig rgyob dang / /ha ha blo bde skyid ya e go /go go ya yi/ /'e 'e sems nyid stong gsal khyab gdal/ /a bo zang thal rjen la bying rgod/ /bu lo med pa'i bsgom zhig rgyob dang / /ha ha blo bde skyid ya e go /go go ya yi/ /'e 'e snang ba dpe ru zhog la/ /a bo sems la phan pa'i glu dbyangs/ /bu lo dben pa'i ri nas 'then dang / /ha ha blo bde skyid ya e go /go go ya yi/ /zhes pa 'di yang nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa'i dus shig tu tshogs drug rang grol gyis mtsho snying rtse nas nyams dga'i glu ru blangs pa'o//na mo rgu ru/ brgyud pa bzang bo khungs can/ /kun tu 272

bzang nas brgyud pa/ /bla ma chos rnams kun mkhyen/ /pha rgan chos kyi rgyal po/ /dam chos theg pa'i yang rtse/ /zab chos rjogs pa chen po/ /nga rang chogs gnyis gsog pa'i/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol/ /lta ba phyogs lhung bral ba/ /rig stong zang thal rjen pa/ /sgom pa yid byed bral ba/ /spros bral ma bcos lhug pa/ /spyod pa tshul 'chos bral ba/ /blang dor dgag sgrub med pa/ /'bras bu re dogs bral ba/ /gdod nas lhun gyis grub pa/ /skal ldan mos gus can tsho/ /lam 'dir mos na nga yi/ /drung du myur du shog dang / /rjogs chen myur lam ston ya/ /bsgoms na rgyud la nyams rtogs/ /sgyes na blo bde 'byung nges/ /nga rang skyid pa'i shugs kyis/ /kha nas skyid glu shor thal/ /skyid pa'i rgyang glu thos tshad/ /skyid po 'ong bar gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang reb gong glu ba tshogs drug rang grol gyes nyams dga' ba'i shugs kyis smras pa'o//'chi bdag g.yul las rnam rgyal ba'i/ /pha rgan chos kyi rgyal po la/ /mos gus drag pos gsol ba 'debs/ /'chi bar 'jigs par byin gyis rlobs/ /lus kyi lang tsho dar la bab /ras phrug gos chen mchor gos gyon/ /gser dngul byu ru mu tig sogs/ /rin chen rgyan cha sna tshogs btags/ /lha yi bu mo dang mtshungs pa'i/ /'jig rten mi rnams thams cad kyis/ /smon 273
