pa'i gnas su 'dzin pa yi/ /na chung bu mo gzhon nu ma/ /rab mdzes bltas pas mi ngoms kyang / /'chi bdag gshin rje khrel med pos/ /glo bur mal sa'i nang du bsgyel/ /'chi bdag gshin rje bsam log po/ /bu mo bsgyel nas ci zhig byed/ /mchor gos rgyan cha rgyab nas bshus/ /khyod kyis ci zhig bskon rgyu yin/ /bde bar yul du 'dug mi 'jug /bu mo khrid nas gang du 'gro/ /bza' btung tsam zhig mi 'khyer bar/ /khyod kyis ci zhig ster 'dangs yin/ /shul na 'dug pa'i snying med tsho/ /bu mo 'khrid du 'jug phod dam//rgyu nom yod tshad kun byin nas/ /bu mo gces ma mi blu 'am/ /yang na mkhas pas zhu ba byas/ /bu mo phyir la mi len nam/ /de gnyis byas nas mi lon na/ /pha bus 'thab nas mi 'phrog gam/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis mi lon na/ /bu mor rdzong ba mi byed dam/ /gzugs bzang gos dang rgyan gyis mdzes/ /'gro na rta bzang zhon nas 'gro/ /'dug na 'bol gdan mdzes par 'dug /za na sha thud mar chur za/ /'thung na ja bzang 'o zho 'thung / /langs na kun gyis bsu skyel byed/ /ya ki tshang gi gces phrug ces/ /mi rnams kun gyis yid smon byed/ /gnyen bshes mang bo 'tshogs pa'i dus/ /zhim pa'i ja chang 'thung zhor la/ /rna cha gdu bu 'khrol bzhin du/ /glu gar rtsed 'jo mang bo 274

byed/ /shin tu skyid pa'i gces phrug kyang / /'chi bdag gshin rje snying nag po/ /glo bur byung nas sa la bsgyel/ /'chi bdag gshin rje bsam nag po/ /khyod kyis gces phrug ci la bsgyel/ /dkar 'jam sha ni gcer bur phyung/ /khyod kyi lag de 'gro phod dam/ /gnyen bshes dbus nas rtser mi 'jug /gces phrug khrid nas gang la 'gro/ /shul na yod pa'i pha ma tsho/ /bu yi tshab tu mi 'gro 'am/ /dpa' bos ral kha mi byed par/ /gces phrug 'khrid du 'jug phod dam/ /bu dang tsha bo rgyu nor 'dzoms/ /dro 'jam bde ba'i mal sar bsdad/ /rgyags rung bu yis 'di zo dang / /ngoms rung mna' mas 'di thungs zer/ /bde skyid 'dzoms pa'i rgan rgon tsho/ /skyid re myong gin mi 'jug par/ /'chi bdag gshin rje bsam log po/ /glo bur byung nas rgan rgon khrid/ /'chi bdag gshin rje bsam log po/ /rgan rgon khrid nas gang du 'gro/ /bza' btung byed pa'i 'phro yang bskyur/ /khyod kyis ci zhig ster 'dangs yin/ /steng na yod pa'i rtsag pa bshus/ /khyod kyis de bas lhag ci bskon/ /dro sa'i mal nas thur du 'khrid/ /khyod kyis gang nas 'jog snyam ang / /snga song zhon pa'i rta yang bskyur/ /khyod kyi zhon pa gang na yod/ /'khor g.yog gcig kyang 'khrid mi 'jug /khyod kyis ja bskol ster ram ci/ /shul na yod pa'i snying 275

rul tsho/ /rgan rgon 'khrid du 'jug phod dam/ /bu mo mdzes mas 'chi bdag la/ /mgo bskor btang na mi sdod dam/ /bu dang tsha bos mtshon thogs nas/ /gshin rjer 'thab na mi gtong ngam/ /dmag dpung mang bos mtha' bskor nas/ /bkag nas bsdad na mi khogs sam/ /gal te 'khrid na rta med par/ /rgan rgon rkang thang gtong phod dam/ /kun kyis bza' btung ba cha bzung / /rgan rgon bskyal nas mi 'gro 'am/ /a kha khrel med na rag tsho / /pha ma rgan rgon 'khrid du bcug /shul nas ngus pas ci la phan/ /skud pa dkar nag rgyun thag can/ /dug hrul khrab de rgyab tu gon/ /dbyug pa gnyis kyi mtshon cha thogs/ /khye ngan dmag la 'thab bzhin du/ /sprang zas 'tshol ba'i dbul bo'i mi/ /nam zhig na tshod rgas pa'i dus/ /yar gyi la yang ma chod cing / /mar gye thur yang mi phebs par/ /ltogs skom sha zad rus zad kyang / /'chi bdag gshin rjes bzung nas 'khrid/ /'chi bdag gshin rje sems med po/ /sprang bo khrid nas gang du 'gro/ /a kha sha zad rus zad sprang / /mi 'jog khyod la ci'i phyir mkho/ /phyi ma'i lam ring ma thon na/ /khyod kyis khur nas 'gro 'am ci/ /dug hrul sprang phor yan chad bskyur/ /gcer bur 'gro la dgos pa ci/ /a kha 'chi bdag las ngan pos/ /mi 'khrid sems can gcig kyang 276

med/ /gcig kyanga'akhyer du mi 'jug par/ /gcer bur khrid pa btsog re ang / /thams cad 'khrid tshul 'di tsho la/ /bltas na ban rgan mi 'jigs sam//khyod kyang 'di yi rang bzhin yin/ /glo bur 'chi bdag gshin rjes bzung / /gos slog yan chad mal du bzhag /'khrid nyes byas nas ma khrid gong //'bros na dben pa'i ri la phros/ /byed na dam pa'i lha chos gyes/ /dge 'dis rang gzhan thams cad kyis/ /'chi bdag gshin rjer rab 'jigs nas/ /dam pa'i chos kyi rtar zhon nas/ /thar ba'i lam la 'bros par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//'dzam gling mkhas rnams gtsug gi rgyan/ /'phags pa klu sgrub sprul ba dngos/ /byams pa dge legs rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /da re dal 'byor mi lus thob/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma las/ /dam chos thos pa'i skal ba dang / /ldan pa shin tu ngo mtshar che/ /mdo sde rnams dang khyad par du/ /gsang sngags bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen gyi/ /gdams pa zab mo thos nas ni/ /nyams su blangs na tshe gcig la/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang thob pa yin/ /gal te don ma rtogs pa dang / /tshe 'dir nyams su ma lon na/ /dam tshig bsrungs na skye ba gsum/ /bdun nam bcu drug tshun chad du/ /ma bsgoms na 277

yang 'tshang rgya zhes/ /kun bzang rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs/ /de phyir bla ma du ma bsten/ /dam chos nyan la 'bad na 'tshengs/ /phyi mar thos pas phan pa tsam/ /sbyin pa btang bas mi phan gsungs/ /chos sgra rna bas lan cig tsam/ /thos kyang yon tan dpag med yod/ /dge slong u pa ku te zhes/ /bya bas dam chos 'chad pa'i sgra/ /khye mo gcig gi rna bas thos/ /khye mo sgrib pa srab gyur nas/ /khye mo de nyid tshe'i dus byas/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed lha ru skyes/ /dge slong zhig gi khang ba yi/ /gdung rtsa dag na bya thi ba/ /gcig ni dgong dus nyal ba des/ /dge slong tho rangs yar bzhengs nas/ /'phags pa sdud pa bton pa'i sgra/ /rna bas yang yang thos pas bya/ /thi ba'i sgrib pa srab gyur nas/ /shi ma thag tu mi lus thob/ /dkon mchog gsum la rab tu dad/ /rab tu byung nas sngar thos pa'i/ /'phags pa sdud pa thos pa'i mod/ /blo la 'dzin ni ma dgos par/ /thos pa tsam gyis blor zin skad/ /des na tshe 'dir dam chos la/ /go ba yang yang ma skyes kyang / /chos sgra rna bas thos tsam gyes/ /sgrib pa dag nas phyi ma la/ /chos kyi bag chags 'jog pa yin/ /de phyir dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten/ /dam chos nyan la tshe 'dir 'bod/ /thos pa yang yang byas tsa na/ /mi tshe 'dir yang go ba 'ong / /dang po 278

cung zad mi go yang / /rjes su bag re go nas 'ong / /der brten shes rab je cher 'gro/ /mjug tu chos rnams thams cad kyi/ /tshig don gang la'ang mi rmongs par/ /shes par 'gyur la tshegs med do/ /thos pa'i tshoms las 'di skad gsungs/ /thos pa'i chos rnams shes par byed/ /thos pas sdig las ldog par 'gyur/ /thos pas don ma yin pa spang //thos pas mya ngan 'das pa 'thob/ /ces gsungs dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ /dge ba dang ni sdig pa'i chos/ /ma thos bar du shes mi 'gyur/ /thos nas chos rnams rnam par shes/ /thos nas sdig pa bsten mi byed/ /thos nas sdig pa spang bar byed/ /thos nas mya ngan 'das pa 'thob/ /ces sogs thos pa'i phan yon ni/ /mdo sde rnams las rgya cher gsungs/ /de phyir dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten/ /dam pa'i chos la thos pa gyis/ /mkhan chen dge bshes rin po cher/ /gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs/ /rje btsun bla ma'i byen rlabs kyis/ /kun gyes thos pa byed par shog /pha yul btson ra rgyab tu bskyur/ /dben pa bsten nas sgom sgrub byed/ /o rgyan 'phrin las rnam rgyal la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byen gyes rlobs/ /dam chos gang la nyan na yang / /snod kyi skyon rnams spang dgos pas/ /dper na snod ni kha sbubs kyi/ /279

steng nas mar la chu blugs kyang / /nang du ye mi 'ong ba ltar/ /dang po chos la nyan tsa na/ /gnyid dang rmugs pa'i dbang du song / /shes pa gzhan du yengs pa dang / /ting 'dzin bsgoms pas chos nyan yang / /sems la go ba ye mi 'ong / /des na chos la nyan pa'i tshe/ /dper na snod de kha sbubs nas/ /steng nas mar la chu blugs bzhin/ /gnyid rmugs la sogs skyon de dag /spangs te shes pa ma yengs par/ /sing nge yer re byas la nyan/ /dper na snod zhabs brdol ba la/ /nang du mar la chu blugs kyang / /gang blugs 'phral du zhabs nas zags/ /nang du ye mi chags pa ltar/ /dam chos bag re go ba de/ /zhe nas dran pas ma bskyangs na/ /de ma thag tu brjed nas 'gro/ /blo la ci yang mi chags pas/ /des na bag re go ba de/ /dper na snod zhabs brdol ba la/ /zags lhan byed ltar dran pas bzung / /dper na snod ni mi gtsang ba'i/ /dri ma can nam dug can gye/ /nang du bza' btung rgyu ci blugs/ /phyi nas longs spyod mi btub ltar/ /chos la thos pa byed tsa na/ /shes blos grags pa 'dod nas ni/ /chos la thos pa byed pa dang / /mi mang 'tshogs sar gzhan kha rgod/ /gcog snyam thos pa byed pa dang / /chos 'di bslab la rgyal khams gzhan/ /rnams su song nas rnyed bkur btsal/ /280

snyam nas thos pa byed pa dang / /gzhan la 'gran sems phrag dog dbang / /che chung ma bzod de phyir du/ /chos la thos pa byed pa rnams/ /thos pa dri ma can yin te/ /de ni byang chub thob pa'i rgyur/ /nam yang mi 'gro thos pa gang / /byas tshad sdig pa 'ba' zhig 'gyur/ /de yi chos kyis rang gzhan la/ /phan pa gang yang mi thogs pas/ /des na thos bsam gang byed kyang / /dper na snod kyi mi gtsang ba'i/ /dri ma ngan pa kun bkrus nas/ /bza' btung bzang bo blugs pa bzhin/ /tshe 'di rnam par rtog pa yis/ /kun nas bslangs pa de rnams spangs/ /bsam pa dad gus dang ldan pa'i/ /sgo nas chos la nyan par 'tshal/ /o rgyan 'phrin las rnam rgyal la/ /gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs//drin can bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis/ /'gro ba yongs la phan phar shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//rig pa'i gnas rnams kun la mkhas/ /mdo smad mkhas pa yongs kyi rgyan/ /bla ma bi'u thang dpal ldan la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /chos la nyan pa'i gnas skabs su/ /snod kyi dri ma kun spang dgos/ /bla mas dam chos gsung la nyan/ /mi 'dod 'di bas nga rang bzang / /chos la da dung nga mkhas so/ /snyam pa'i nga rgyal sems skye bzhin/ /dam pa'i chos 281

la nyan mi rung / /rka mgo ma thon chu khrid kyang / /mi 'ong bzhin du nga rgyal gyes/ /nyan na yon tan mi skye bas/ /nga rgyal sems smod zhi dul gyi/ /sgo nas chos la nyan par 'tshal/ /chos dang bla ma'i skyon brtags na/ /khe bas nyen che rang nyid kyi/ /chos dang bla ma'i skyon rtog tu/ /mi rung bas na 'di gal che/ /skyon rtog blo rnams bkag nas nyan/ /gzhan gyes bla ma'i skyon brjod pa/ /nye skad bla mas gsung mi 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas dngos lags sgos la bzlog /de la mi nyan da dung gzhan/ /rnams kyis bla ma'i skyon brjod na/ /rang nyid gzhan du langs te 'gro/ /yang na rna ba lag pas 'geb//gzhan gyis bla ma'i skyon brjod pa//nyan na'ang dam tshig nyams par gsungs/ /chos nyan chag kyang le lo dang / /snyom las byas nas don mi gnyer/ /nyan kyang rung la ma nyan rung / /snyam nas gal chung 'dzin pa spangs/ /chos 'di shin tu gal che bas/ /med mi rung bas sems kyis nyan/ /mig ni gzugs la yengs pa dang / /rna ba sgra la yengs pa na/ /sems kyang de rjes yengs 'gro bas//mig dang rna ba gzugs sgra la//ma yengs sems mi yengs par nyan/ /bsgom dang gnyid rmugs rnams spangs nas/ /shes pa gsal le sang nge byas/ /dam chos gsung la nyan par 'tshal/ /chos thun ring bas skyo ba dang //don 282

ma go bas skyo bar gyur/ /a kha da 'phro bcad na rung / /snyam pa skyes na chos nyan pa'i//dri ma yin pas sngon rgyal po//byi ling gar ling zhes bya bas/ /chos tshig bzhi ba gcig gi phyir/ /sku lus lcags gzer stong tsho gcig /btab pa'i lo rgyus yang rgyal po/ /ga na sha ni nga li zhes/ /bya bas chos tshig bzhi ba gcig /thos phyir sku lus mar me stong / /btsugs dang byang sems rtag tu ngus/ /'phags pa chos 'phags drung du chos/ /gsan pa'i yon du sku btsong dang/ /lus kyi rtsa chen thams cad phug /dam chos 'chad pa'i sa phyogs su/ /chag chag btab dang nā ro bas/ /te lo'i mdun du chos nyan pa'i/ /phyir du dka' chen bcu gnyis dang / /dka' chung bcu gnyis mdzad tshul dang / /rje btsun mi las mar pa nas/ /dam chos gsan phyir sku rgyab la/ /sgal ba gsum tsam 'byung rag bar/ /sras mkhar dgu thog brtsigs pa sogs/ /sgyes chen dam pa gong ma rnams/ /dam chos gsan phyir lus longs spyod/ /gang la'ang phangs pa cang med pas/ /dka' ba spyad pa'i tshul bsams la/ /da lta bdag la zab rgyas chos/ /dka' ba cung zad spyod mi dgos/ /mal sa dron po'i nang nas bsdad/ /thos rgyu'i skal ba ldan pa 'di/ /a re dga' snyam bla mas chos/ /nyin mtshan bar ma chad du gsungs/ /na yang dga' 283

spros nyan par 'tshal//rje btsun bla ma dpal ldan la/ /gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs/ /bla ma dpal ldan byen rlabs kyis/ /skye bo yongs la phan thogs shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//jo 'brom khu rngog la sogs pa'i/ /bka' gdams rnams thar lhur bzhes pa'i/ /bla ma dge 'dun rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byen gyis rlobs/ /thos pa byed pa'i dus skabs su/ /tshig la ci zhig btags kyang chog /zer nas nan tan mi byed par/ /don gcig pu la nan tan byed/ /tshig nor don yang nor 'gro bas/ /ma nor tshig bzung bsam tsa na/ /don yang ma nor ba zhig skye/ /chos tshig gcig pu nan tan byed/ /don la nan tan ma byas na/ /chos mang blo la zin na yang / /ne tso'i kha ton bzhin 'gro bas/ /de phyir tshig don gnyis ka la//nan tan byas nas 'dzin dgos gsungs/ /chos de'i bsdus don dgos don dang / /tshig don gang yin cha med par/ /bzung na phyin chad de'i chos kyis/ /rang gzhan gnyis la phan mi thogs/ /de phyir chos gang gsungs pa de'i/ /don rnams so sor 'byed par gyes/ /bla mas drang bor gsungs na yang / /chos na de skad zer ba med/ /zer nas log par 'dzin pa ni/ /shin tu skyon che dug 284

bzhin spongs/ /gal ni che che'i rigs 'dzin cing / /chung chung mi 'dzin bskyur na chos/ /mgo med 'jug med du song nas/ /phyi nas gzhan la phan mi thogs/ /de phyir nyan dus rang gi blos/ /'chun tshad 'dzin la 'bad par gyis/ /bla ma dge 'dun rgyal mtshan la//gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs//dge 'dun rgyal mtshan byin rlabs kyis/ /rang gzhan rgyud la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//bde gshegs bstan pa yongs rdzogs la/ /mkhas shing grub pa mchog brnyes pa'i/ /bla ma blo bzang dar rgyas la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /dper na gzhon nu 'dod chags can/ /rnams kyis bu mo mdzes ma gzhan/ /mthong na dga' zhing spro ba bzhin/ /dang po chos dang bla ma rnams/ /spyod yul mthong dus dga' spro dang / /dad pa khyad par can byed dgos/ /dper na skom pas gdungs pa'i mis/ /chu zhig 'tshol la 'bad pa bzhin/ /'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal du/ /shes shing sgye 'chis rab 'jigs nas/ /chos dang bla ma dam pa zhig /snying nas 'dod pas 'tshol ba dgos/ /dper na ma dang bu 'phrad pa'i/ /dus na phan tshun yid ches bzhin/ /bla ma dam pa dang mjal te//zab rgya'i dam chos thos tsa na//chos dang bla mar yid 285

ches dgos/ /dper na glang chen nyi mas gdungs/ /chu ru 'jug pa'i dus skabs su/ /gang gis bkag kyang mi thub bzhin/ /chos la thos bsam sgom gsum gang / /byed kyang na tsha sdug bsngal dang //dgra bgegs la sogs rkyen gang gis/ /bar du mi chod pa zhig dgos//bla ma blo bzang dar rgyas la//gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs/ /blo bzang dar rgyas byen gyes rlobs/ /thos tshad 'gro la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//mngon shes rdzu 'phrul yon tan mnga'/ /dbang lung khrid gsum gter gye bdag /bla ma bsod nams snyan grags la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /chos byed pa la dad pa dgos/ /dad pa yon tan ma lus pa/ /'byung ba'i gzhi ma lta bu ste/ /de yang ma cig lab sgron gyes/ /dad pa zhing sa gshin po 'dra/ /dad pa 'tsho byed mkhas pa 'dra/ /dad pa bud med mdzangs ma 'dra/ /dad pa 'bri mo bzang mo 'dra//dad pa g.yang mo lug dang 'dra/ /dad pa yod pa'i mi rnams la/ /dgos 'dod ma lus 'byung bar 'gyur//zhes dang sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ /dad pa ldan pa'i gang zag gis/ /rang bzhin dngos grub thams cad 'grub/ /ces gsungs de na yon tan gyi/ /gzhi ma dad pa 'di nyid yin/ /dad pa yod pa'i mi rnams la/ /dkar bo'i chos 286

rnams thams cad 'byung / /dper na yid bzhin nor bu la/ /dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba 'dra/ /dad pa med pa'i mi rnams la/ /dkar bo'i chos rnams mi 'byung ste/ /dper na sa bon mes tshig la/ /'bras bu mi 'byung ba dang 'dra/ /des na yon tan thams cad kyi/ /gzhi ma dad pa byed gal che/ /bla ma bsod nams snyan grags la/ /gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs/ /bsod nams snyan grags byin rlabs kyis/ /'gro ba yongs la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//rgyun du nyams bzhes thugs dam ni/ /nyin re bzhin du 'chag med mdzad/ /bla ma thar shul khri rgan la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs//dang po dam chos nyan tsa na//nad pa ma gtogs mgo g.yogs dang / /zhwa gyon pa dang thod bcings dang / /skra yi cod pan byas nas ni/ /dam chos nyan du mi rung bas/ /de dag phud cing bkrol nas nyan/ /gzhan yang gdugs phub rta zhon dang //khri stan mthon por bsdad nas chos//nyan mi rung bas rang dma' sar/ /bsdad nas nyan dgos skyes rabs las/ /rab tu dma' ba'i stan la 'dug /dul ba'i dpal ni rnam par bskyed/ /dga' dang ldan pas mig gis blta//tshig gi bdud rtsi 'thung ba bzhin/ /gus pa bskyed de rtse gcig rgyud/ /287

rab tu dwangs la dri med yid/ /nad pas sman pa'i tshig nyan bzhin/ /rim gro gcig la chos nyon cig /ces gsungs pa ltar nyan par 'tshal/ /gzhan yang lag na mtshon cha thogs/ /'khar ba om tshugs byas pa dang //lag pas ri mo 'bri ba sogs//byas te chos nyan mi rung bas/ /mtshon sogs yod na rtsar bsnyal la/ /lag gnyis thal mo sbyar nas nyan/ /rkang ba skyil krung byas pa dang //rkang ba brkyangs dang gzhogs nyal byas//ltag zur bstan nas nyan mi rung / /bla ma'i mdun nas phyag mang 'tshal/ /tsog pur bsdad de chos la nyan/ /bla mas dam chos gsung ba'i tshe /skad gseng mthon pos gtam smra dang / /ku re bzhad gad rol mo 'khrol/ /shab shub gtam ye mi bya bar/ /chos thun mgo nas mjug gi bar/ /thams cad blo rtse chos gtad de/ /kyi le 'bol le 'jam ldem me//chos gsung ba la nyan gal che/ /chos thun thon tshe bka' drin che//la sogs tshig gi gtang rag dang / /chos dang chos ston bla ma yi/ /mtshan ni rkyang bas brjod mi bya/ /bla mas dam chos gsungs pa la/ /nyan tshe chos 'di zab mi zab nga yi blo la yod pa dang / /mthun nam mi mthun zhig blta dang / /bla ma 'di la shes tshod dang / /go tshod ci 'dra 'dug blta'o/ /snyam du chos nyan mi rung bas/ /bsam pa de dag rnams spangs nas/ /288

sems can thams cad don du bdag /myur du sangs rgyas 'thob par bya/ /de phyir dam pa'i chos la nyan/ /nyams su len par bya snyam pa'i/ /bsam pas chos la nyan par 'tshal/ /bla ma khri rgan rin po cher/ /gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs/ /drin can bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis/ /sems can rnams la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//nad kyis gdungs la sman sbyin gtong / /nyon mongs can la chos sbyin mdzad/ /bla ma sman rgan rin po che/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /dper na nad sna mang bos btab/ /lo mang mal sa'i nang du lhung / /sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa myong / /phar la mi 'chi tshur mi gson/ /nad pa sha zad rus zad bzhin/ /rang nyid rgyun ring gso dka' ba/ /sdug bsngal drag po bskyed pa'i nad/ /nyon mongs nad sna mang bos zin//khams gsum 'khor ba'i mal du lhung //sdug bsngal dpag med myong ba yin/ /yin pa rang gis ngos zin dgos/ /dper na rlung mkhris bad gan sogs/ /nad kyis btab pa'i mi de yis/ /nad rnams gso phyir sman pa btsal/ /yang dang yang du de btsal bas//sman pa mkhas pa zhig rnyed na/ /'phrad ma thag nas dga' spro skyes/ /sman pas ci gsungs bka' la nyan/ /gus pas bsnyen 289

bkur byed pa bzhin/ /rang nyid dug gsum dug lnga sogs/ /nyon mongs nad sna du ma yis/ /btab pa gso phyir chos ston pa'i/ /bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshol/ /rnyed nas khur du mi 'gro bar/ /rgyan du bzung nas ci gsung sgrubs/ /gus pa chen pos bsnyen bkur byed/ /dper na nad pas sman pa des/ /sbyar ba'i sman la dus rgyun du/ /gces spras chen po byed pa ltar/ /bla mas dam chos gsungs pa gang / /rnams la gal bo cher mthong nas/ /'bad pa du mas gces spras su/ /'dzin cing brjed pa la sogs pa'i/ /sgo nas chud zos gtong mi bya/ /dper na nad pas sman pa'i sman/ /sbyar ba ma 'thungs nad zhi bar/ /mi nus snyam nas 'thung ba ltar/ /bla mas bstan pa'i gdams pa rnams/ /rang gis nyams su ma blangs na/ /nyon mongs nad gzhol mi nus par/ /mthong nas nan tan nyams su len/ /dper na mdze can lag pa dang / /rkang ba chad pas sman thun ni/ /re re gnyis gnyis tsam bsten pas/ /phan thogs ci yang mi 'byung ltar/ /rang nyid thog ma med pa nas/ /nyon mongs nad gzhi 'tshab can gyis/ /thebs la bla ma'i gdams ngag lan/ /re re gnyis gnyis nyams blangs pas/ /ci yang mi phan chu bo yi/ /rgyun bzhin 'bad pa gal che gsungs/ /dper 290

na sman pa mkhas pa btsal/ /rnyed nas sman thun gcig mi 'thung / /sman sbyor kho na lhur blangs kyang / /nad pa nad las mi thar bzhin/ /bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen btsal/ /rnyed nas gsungs pa'i gdams pa rnams/ /nyams su ma blangs mang bo zhig /shes kyang rang nyid nyon mongs pa'i/ /nad las grol bar mi 'gyur ro/ /dper na sman pas sman byin kyang / /nad pas blangs nas ma 'thungs na/ /sman pa'i sman gyis ma nyes te/ /nad pa de nyid nyes pa bzhin/ /bla ma dam pas chos bstan kyang / /rang gis nyams su ma blangs na/ /bla ma chos gnyis ma lan te/ /rang nyid kho na lan pa yin/ /dper na sman pas 'di thungs zhes/ /byen pa'i sman mang bzang ba de/ /nad pas blangs nas 'thungs gyur na/ /nad las rim bzhin grol ba bzhin/ /bla mas bstan pa'i dam chos rnams/ /rang gis nyams su blangs gyur na/ /nyon mongs nad las grol bar 'gyur/ /de phyir bla mas gang bstan pa/ /nan tan nyams su len pa gces/ /sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ /sgyes bu dam pa yin pa la/ /yin par shes na bcom ldan 'das/ /rjes su dran nas gus pa bskyed/ /chos 'di nyan pa'i mthur brten nas/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che/ /'jig rten khams su yun ring du/ /gnas par gyur na ci ma 291

rung / /snyam du bsams nas chos la nyan/ /bla ma sman rgan rin po cher/ /gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs/ /rje btsun bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis/ /sems can rnams la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//rgyal bstan yid bzhin nor bu la/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pas bye dor byed/ /'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sprul sku la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /rnyed bkur grags pa la sogs la/ /ma bltas bsam pa bzang bo'i sgos/ /gzhan la dam chos bstan gyur na/ /phan yon dpag tu med pa yod/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /mchod pa'i mchog tu 'gyur ba yin/ /gaṅgā'i bye snyed sangs rgyas zhing/ /rin chen bdun gyis yongs bkang nas/ /dga' rab sems kyis rgyal ba la/ /phul ba gang gis sems can gcig /tsam la tshigs bcad gcig bstan na/ /rin chen phul ba'i phan yon las/ /tshigs bcad byin pa'i phan yon ni/ /brgya stong khri 'bum las kyang che/ /gaṅgā'i bye snyed 'jig rten khams/ /gser gyes bkang nas gzhan zhig la/ /sbyin las dus ngan da lta'i tshe/ /tshigs bcad gcig tsam brjod na yang / /gser gyi sbyin pa btang ba las/ /phan yon che zhes mdo las gsungs/ /mang bo bshad na smos ci dgos/ /klu yi 292

rgya mtshos zhus pa yi/ /mdo las chos kyi sbyin btang na/ /mngon shes thob par bshad pa dang / /seng ges zhus pa'i mdo las kyang / /chos kyi sbyin pa btang gyur na/ /skye ba dran par gsungs pa dang / /ting nge 'dzin gye rgyal po las/ /chos kyi sbyin pa zang zing gi /sbyin las khyad par 'phags pa'i tshul/ /mang bo gsungs shing sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phangs myur du thob par gsungs/ /lhag bsam bskul ba'i mdo las kyang / /dam chos bshad pa'i phan yon ni/ /nyi shu gsungs pa 'di lta ste//dran dang blo gros blo dang ldan/ /brtan dang shes rab ldan par 'gyur/ /'jig rten las 'das shes rab rtogs/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug chung / /bdud kyis de la glags mi rnyed/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis dgongs par 'gyur/ /mi ma yin pas de bsrung zhing / /lha rnams de la gzi byin bsgyed/ /mi mdza' rnams kyis glags mi rnyed/ /mdza' bshes rnams ni mi phyed 'gyur/ /tshig btsun mi 'jigs pa thob cing / /yid bde mang dang mkhas pas bsngags/ /chos kyi sbyin pa de rjes su/ /dran par bya bar 'os par 'gyur/ /zhes sogs mdo sde du ma nas/ /chos bstan phan yon dpag med gsungs/ /de phyir gzhan gyi blor 'tsham pa'i/ /dam chos ston la 'bad par gyes/ /'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i 293

sprul sgu la/ /gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs/ /rje btsun bla ma'i byen rlabs kyis/ /sems can rnams la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//gnas chen khyad 'phags shel dgon du/ /sku gsung thugs rten du ma bzhengs/ /bla ma chu dmar rin po cher/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /gzhan la dam chos ston pa'i tshe/ /rnyed bkur phrag dog 'gran sems dang / /phyi bshol byed pa'i le lo dang / /yang yang 'chad pas skyo ngal dang / /bdag gi yon tan sgrog pa dang / /gzhan gye skyon gleng dam chos kyang / /zab pa sbas nas mi zab ston/ /snyan grags sogs la lta ba spangs/ /ma gyur nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam pa'i/ /sems can thams cad don du bdag /sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par bya/ /de phyir sems can nyon mongs pa'i/ /nad kyis rtag thebs thams cad la/ /dam chos sman gye sbyin btang nas/ /nyon mongs nad rnams gso bar bya/ /chos bstan bsod nams bdag gis chos/ /bshad pa'i yon no snyam du bsam/ /mdo sde 'chad dus rang nyid ni/ /ston pa shāka thub sogs su bsgom/ /sngags chos 'chad dus kun bzang dang / /rdo rje 'chang la sogs par bsgom/ /rang gis dam chos bshad pa'i sgra/ /yan lag drug cu'i gsung du 294

gyur/ /rang gi 'khor na yod pa dang / /phyogs bcu'i sems can thams cad kyis/ /rang rang skad du thos gyur nas/ /mi shes rmongs pa thams cad sangs/ /tshig don gnas rtogs mi brjed gzung / /spobs pa la sogs thob par bsam/ /mjug tu bshad dang nyan pa las/ /byung ba'i dge ba sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang / /sems can thams cad gnas skabs su/ /bde skyid mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /bla ma chu dmar rin po cher/ /gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs/ /drin can bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis/ /'gro ba yongs la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o// thugs rgyud 'jam zhing chos la mkhas/ /'pho ba bsgoms pas rtags bzang thon/ /bla ma myang ba'i rab 'byams la /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyes rlobs/ /dam chos 'chad pa'i bla ma dang / /nyan pa rnams la gshe ba dang / /skur ba btab na nyes dmigs che/ /sangs rgyas mi spong ba'i mdo las/ /sems can thams cad mig phyung bas/ /chos smra ba la gshe bsam pas/ /bltas na de bas nyes pa che/ /sems can thams cad bcings pa las/ /chos smra ba la rgyab phyogs nas/ /bsdad na nyes pa snga ma bas/ /brgya yi char yang nyer mi 'gro/ /de ni ci yi phyir zhe na/ /295

chos smra ba la skur btab na/ /sangs rgyas skur ba btab phyir ro//sangs rgyas bkur dang mchod phyag 'tshal/ /'dod pas dam chos smra ba la/ /bsnyen bkur mchod dang phyag bya'o/ /de ni ci yi phyir zhe na/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' las 'byung phyir/ /zhes gsungs pas na chos smra la/ /gshe zhing skur ba 'debs mi bya/ /dad cing gus pas bsnyen bkur dang / /mchod cing phyag dang skor ba bya/ /dam chos 'chad pa'i sa phyogs kyi/ /rdul dang nyal nyil kun bsal nas/ /sa la chu yis chag chag gdab/ /rin chen khri bshams gdugs rgyal mtshan/ /ba dan du mas mdzes par bya/ /me tog bdug sgos mar me sogs/ /ci 'byor mchod pa legs par bshams/ /mdor na dus kun chos smra ba/ /sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i 'du shes kyis/ /bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs par bya/ /bla ma myang ba'i rab 'byams la/ /gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs/ /drin can bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis/ /sems can yongs la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//'phags pa chos 'phags bsten pa'i phyir/ /dka' ba bsam gyis mi khyab spyad/ /byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngur/ /gsol ba 'debs so byen gyis rlobs/ /mdo dang rgyud sde chen po 296

las/ /ston pa shākya thub pa dang / /rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis/ /da lta snyigs ma'i dus skabs su/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen skur sprul nas/ /sems can don mdzad gsungs pas na/ /rang gi drin can bla ma rnams/ /rdo rje 'chang ngam sangs rgyas dngos/ /'o na sangs rgyas skyon kun zad/ /yon tan kun ldan yin pa la/ /bla ma la la thugs gtum zhing / /bla ma la la ser sna che/ /bla ma la la 'dod chags che//bla ma la las chos mi shes/ /bla ma la la nga rgyal che/ /bla ma la la phrag dog che/ /skyon ni mang bo yod pas na/ /sangs rgyas dngos shig ga la yin/ /snyam na skyon ltar snang ba rnams/ /rang snang ma dag dbang gis yin/ /sngon dus legs pa'i skar ma yis/ /sangs rgyas ci mdzad skyon du mthong / /rje btsun chen po thogs med kyis/ /rje btsun byams pa khye mor mthong / /nā ros grub chen te lo pa/ /nya ni gson sreg byed par mthong / /rje btsun dge tshul tshem bu bas/ /rdo rje phag mo mdzo mor mthong / /sngon gyi dam pa phal cher la/ /'khrul snang de 'dra tsam byung na/ /las nyon gting lhung 'o skol la/ /snang tshul phyin ci log de 'dra/ /ci'i phyir mi 'byung dper bzhag nas/ /dung ni rab tu dkar ba la/ /ser bo med kyang rwa/khris nad can/ /mig la ser bor snang ba de/ /dung gi skyon min kho'i skyon bzhin/ /bla 297

ma rnams la skyon med kyang / /skyon ltar snang ba de nyid ni/ /bla ma rnams kyi skyon ni min/ /'o skol rnams kyi skyon yin nges/ /bla ma rnams la skyon cung zad/ /tsam med mkhas btsun bzang gsum sogs/ /yon tan khyad par can mang mnga'/ /gzhan yang mar pas mi la yi/ /las sgrib 'dag phyir sku rgyab la/ /sgal ba gsum tsam byung rag bar/ /sras mkhar dgu thog brtsig bcug ltar/ /bla ma rnams kyis mdzad pa ni/ /bzang ngan sna tshogs ston pa la/ /thugs dgongs ci 'dra yod mi shes/ /bzang ngan mdzad pa gang la yang / /log lta cung zad mi byed par/ /ci mdzad legs pa'i yon tan du/ /bltas nas dad pa byed gal che/ /rje btsun chen po rtag tu ngur/ /gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs/ /rtag tu ngu yi byin rlabs kyis/ /skye dgu yongs la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//grub chen te lo bsten pa'i phyir/ /dka' chen dka' chung mang bo mdzad/ /rje btsun paṇa chen nā ro bar/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir 'dul dka' ba'i/ /rang dang 'gro rnams 'dren slad du/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas tha mal mi'i/ /gzugs su sprul nas byon pa lags/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams/ /skyon zad yon tan ldan pa'i 298

cha'i/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang khyad ma mchis/ /rang gi ngos nas phyogs bcu yi/ /sangs rgyas las kyang lhag yin te/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis 'gro ba mang / /smin grol lam la sngar bkod mod/ /sangs rgyas nye ring yod nas rang / /yal bar dor ba ma yin kyang / /brag phug kha byang 'khor ba la/ /nyi ma mi 'char ba bzhin rang / /skal ba dman pas sangs rgyas rnams/ /dngos su mjal dang gsung ma thos/ /sngon nas da bar 'khor bar 'khyams/ /da re la yang sku drin can/ /bla ma rnams dang ma mjal na/ /slar yang dkon mchog sgra tsam yang / /mi thos 'khor bar 'khyam dgos la/ /da re bla ma thams cad kyis/ /zab rgya'i chos ni mang bo bstan/ /nyams len nus na thar ba dang / /thams cad mkhyen pa thob par nges/ /sangs rgyas dngos dang zhal mjal yang de bas lhag pa ston rgyu med/ /gzhan yang brtse bas zas gos dang / /gnas mal yan chad gnang ba dang / /nad gdon bar chad 'jigs las bskyabs/ /sha tsha'i bslab bya bstan pa sogs/ /bka' drin lam du stong gsum bo/ /gser gyis bkang nas phul na yang / /drin lan 'jal bar ga la nus/ /rang la sangs rgyas thams cad las/ /bla ma bka' drin lhag par che/ /rtag tu gus pas mnyes pa sgrubs/ /mi mnyes bya ba thams cad 299

spongs/ /rje btsun chen bo nā ro bar/ /gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs/ /grub chen nā ro'i byin rlabs kyis/ /rang gzhan rgyud la phan par shog/lho brag mar pa bsten pa'i phyir/ /dka' ba dpag tu med pa spyad/ /rje btsun mi la ras pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /rang la shin tu drin che ba'i//mtshan ldan bla ma dam pa rnams/ /mnyes na snying dang mig gnyis kyang / /'bul dgos byung yang cis mi 'bul/ /sngon dus sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /slob pa lam gye gnas skabs su/ /chos tshig re re gsan pa'i phyir/ /sku lus mar me stong tsho btsugs/ /lcags gzer stong tsho btab pa dang / /bu dang bu mo longs spyod sogs/ /phangs pa med par phul ba dang / /rtag tu ngu yis chos 'phags ni//bsten phyir gzhan la sha rus btsongs/ /lus kyi rtsa chen rnams phug nas/ /khrag gis chag chag gdab pa dang / /jo bos bla ma gser gling par/ /byang chub sems kyi gdams pa ni/ /zhu phyir rgya mtsho chen por zhugs/ /zla mang dka' ba spyad pa dang / /'brom gyis jo bo bsten tshul dang / /nā ros te lo bsten tshul dang / /mi las mar pa bsten pa sogs/ /dam pa gong ma'i chos phyir du/ /lus dang longs spyod thams cad la/ /phangs med phul nas dka' 300

ba'i rigs/ /bsam kyis mi khyab spyad pa bzhin/ /bla ma mnyes phyir lus longs spyod/ /nang nas gang bzang yid 'thad 'bul//bya bar dka' ba ci gsungs kyang / /phan pa'i dgos pa zhig yod snyam/ /tsham tshom med par snying stobs can/ /g.yul ngor 'jug pa lta bur gyis/ /gtan nas mi rung ba gsungs kyang / /tshig gis bshad sbyangs yang dag mdzod/ /bsku mnye dril phyi gdan 'bul dang / /bsnyun g.yog bza' btung phud kyis mchod/ /bstod pa'i dbyangs kyis gsol ba 'debs//yon tan cung zad tsam mthong yang / /che ru btang nas gzhan la sgogs//mdor na lus srog longs spyod rnams/ /phangs med drin can bla mar 'bul//khyad par bka' bzhin bsgrub pa la/ /bla ma shin tu dgyes pas na//bla ma rnams kyis gang bstan pa'i/ /chos la thos bsam sgom gsum gyis/ /rje btsun mi la ras pa la/ /gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs/ /mi la ras pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /rang gzhan rgyud la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku//drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud//smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rtag tu bla ma'i ngor blta ba/ /bu ni 301

mdzangs pa lta bu dang / /dbyen gyis nam yang mi phyed pa/ /mi shigs rdo rje lta bu dang / /bla ma'i bya ba'i khur 'khur ba/ /mi skyom sa gzhi lta bu dang / /sdug bsngal gang gis mi bsgul ba/ /khor yug ri bo lta bu dang / /bla mas ci bsgos bzang ngan las/ /byed pa bran g.yog lta bu dang / /che ba'i nga rgyal rnams spangs pa/ /phyag bdar byed pa lta bu dang / /bya dka'i khur lci ba rnams kyang / /'dzin pa thag pa lta bu dang / /bla mas bka' bkyon byas pa la/ /mi khro khye rgan lta bu dang //dus kun 'gro zhing 'ong ba la/ /mi skyom shing gru lta bu dang / /bzang ngan skyid sdug thams cad kun/ /theg pa zam pa lta bu dang / /tsha grang sdug bsngal kun bzod pa//mgar gye 'og rdo lta bu yi/ /sems kyis mtshan ldan bla ma la/ /bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa bya/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku//drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bla ma tshul bzhin bsten gyur na/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang thob la nye/ /dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad 302

dgyes/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen mi phongs dang / /ngan 'gro'i gnas su lhung mi 'gyur/ /ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal myong ba'i las/ /tshe 'di'i sdug bsngal phra mo tsam/ /tha na rmi lam rtsub mo zhig /rmis pa tsam gyis byang bar 'gyur/ /las nyon gnyis kyis tshur thub dka'/ /byang sems spyod par mi 'gal zhing / /de la dran pa dang ldan pas/ /yon tan tshogs kyis je mthor 'gyur/ /mdor na gnas skabs mthar thug gi /bsam don thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /bla ma tshul bzhin mi bsten par/ /bla ma'i bka' bcag thugs dkrugs pa/ /la sogs mi dgyes las byas na/ /tshe 'dir nad gdon dgra la sogs/ /mi 'dod sdug bsngal sna tshogs 'ongs/ /phyi mar ngan 'gro'i gnas su skye/ /de phyir mi mnyes bya ba spongs/ /mnyes pa'i thabs la 'bad par mdzod/ /ma shes dbang gis mi mnyes pa/ /byas na de ma thag tu bshags//glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyis rlobs/ /'khor ni rnam bzhi mi rgyu ba'i/ /303

mtha' 'khob kla klo glen lkug dang / /las 'bras dkon mchog med zer ba'i/ /log lta can dang 'jig rten khams/ /sangs rgyas ma byon pa rnams dang / /dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang / /'du shes med pa'i lha tshe ring / /rnams su skyes na chos sgrub par/ /mi khom da lta dal dus 'dir/ /dam chos sgrub pa'i dus skabs yin/ /dam pa'i lha chos sgrub pa'i rten/ /mi lus rin chen thob pa dang / /gangs can bod 'dir 'khor rnam bzhi/ /ma tshang na yang dge slong pha/ /yod phyir don gye yul dbus yin//da re don gye yul dbus skyes/ /yan lag nying lag rna ba sogs/ /dbang bo tshang zhing mtshams med las//ma byas byed du ma bcug pas/ /las mtha' ma log 'byon dka' ba'i/ /sangs rgyas byon dang chos bstan dang / /bstan pa ma nub gnas pa dang / /de yi rjes su 'jug pa dang / /gzhan gyis rang la chos sgrub pa'i/ /mthun rkyen zas gos la sogs pa/ /snying nas brtse bas ster ba ste/ /dam chos bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen rnams/ /'byor ba'i dus 'dir chos bsgrub dgos/ /da re blang dor ma nor ba/ /byas nas mngon mtho lha mi dang / /nges legs thar ba tsam pa dang / /thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang yang / /snyigs dus tshe thung 'di nyid la/ /thob par nus pa'i dal 'byor rten/ /da re rnyed pa yid 304

bzhin gye/ /nor bu rnyed pa las kyang lhag /ngan song gsum sogs mi khom gnas/ /bskal pa brgyad khrir btsal gyur kyang / /rnyed dka'i rten 'di don med byas/ /slar yang gnas der log gyur na/ /mi de gdon gyes smyos dang 'dra/ /de phyir dal 'byor mi lus 'di/ /thob dus chos kyi snying bo longs/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyis rlobs/ /ngan 'gro bde 'gro'i shi 'phos nas/ /ngan 'gror skyes pa sa rdul 'dra/ /bde 'gror skyes pa phyag sen rtses/ /bzhes pa'i rdul dang 'dra zhes gsungs/ /ngan 'gror skyes kyang las ngan pa/ /zad nas bde 'gror skye snyam na/ /sdug bsngal myong bzhin 'phral 'phral sdig /bsags nas ngan 'gro'i shi 'phos kyang / /slar yang ngan 'gro brgyud dgos te/ /bde 'gro'i ming tsam thos mi 'gyur/ /de ltar yang yang rnyed dka' ba'i/ /rten bzang dal 'byor mi lus 'di/ /rnyed dus chud zos sus gtong phod/ /myur du chos kyi snying bo longs/ /rgya mtshos cher 305

g.yengs gnya' shing gi /bu gar rus sbal mgrin chud ltar/ /mi lus thob dka' thub pas gsungs/ /sran ma spar gang gyang logs la/ /gtor na chags pa shin tu dkon/ /'on kyang re re gnyis gnyis chags/ /sngon chad ngan 'gror skyes pa'i grangs/ /sran ma sa la lhung dang mnyam/ /mi lus thob pa re gnyis tsam/ /gyang gi logs la chags dang 'dra/ /bde 'gro tsam zhig thob pa la/ /tshul khrims sna gcig tsam bsrung dgos/ /dal 'byor mi lus thob pa la/ /tshul khrims rnam dag gzhi gzung zhing / /sbyin pa sogs kyis grogs byas nas/ /smon lam rnam dag mtshams sbyor dgos//rgyu de da lta bsgrub pa nyung / /dal 'byor rten bzang thob pa dkon//dmyal ba rnams las yi dwags nyung / /yi dwags rnams las dud 'gro nyung / /dud 'gro gzhan rnams phar la zhog /ri klung gcig gnas srin bu la/ /bod yul mi yi grangs tsam 'dug /mi lus nyin skar bzhin du dkon/ /da re tshe 'jug 'di nyid la/ /gtan gyi btsan sa ma zin na/ /phyin chad mi lus thob pa dka'/ /da ni chos kyi snying bo longs//glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog /306

sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /shin tu rnyed dka'i dal 'byor rten/ /thob kyang dam chos bsgrub pa la/ /ga le sos dal byed khom med//myur du mi rtag 'jig par nges/ /lus ni ci 'dra zhig blangs kyang / /'chi bas mi tshugs gcig tsam med/ /sngon byon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /skye 'chi rang dbang thob rnams kyang / /gdul bya rtag 'dzin can chos la/ /bskul phyir mya ngan 'da' tshul bstan/ /drang srong mngon shes lnga dang ldan/ /mkha' la bya bzhin 'gro ba sogs/ /rdzu 'phrul can rnams thams cad kyang / /sdod pa'i thabs shig ma rnyed na/ /rang nyid lta bu smos ci dgos/ /tshangs pa rgya byin 'khor bsgyur dang //dga' bo 'jog po rnams kyang shi /rgya gar bod yul mkhas grub dang / /rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' gshegs/ /rang gi pha ma mkhan slob grogs/ /dgra gnyen bar ma phal cher shi /sngon chad skyes pa tshe thar zhes/ /lus pa mthong thos gcig kyang med/ /yod dam med snyam the tshom tsam/ /za ba'i mi gcig mi srid na/ /rang nyid gcig pu dmigs bsal byas/ /'chi mi dgos pa ga la 'ong / /gang du bsdad kyang mi 'chi ba'i/ /sa phyogs de ni yod pa min/ /bros pas mi thar 307

rdzas sngags dang / /sman sogs rkyen gyes bzlog tu med/ /'brid byed bar ma chad du yod/ /da lta lo brgya thub pa dkon/ /drug cu thub pa'i dbang byas kyang / /tshe lo drug cu lon pa'i mi/ /sang 'chi gnangs 'chi lta bu yin/ /tshe lo lnga bcu lon pa'i mi/ /tshe lhag lo bcu tsam min med/ /de bzhin la las sum gnyis dang / /la las tshe phyed song ba mang / /tshe lhag cung zad tsam yod pa/ /lo zla zhag gis myur du 'dzad/ /gson pa'i tshe yang dam pa'i chos/ /byed skabs cung zad tsam min med/ /gzhon nu'i dus su chos mi dran/ /rgas dus dran yang chos mi nus/ /bar gye tshe yi phyed ka gnyid/ /phyed ka rnam g.yeng bza' btung dang / /na ba sogs kyis khyer shul na/ /dam chos byed la lo lnga drug /tsam min med pas dam pa'i chos/ /sgrub khom med par myur du 'chi/ /des na tshe 'di'i phun tshogs kun/ /ji ltar 'dzoms rung des ci bya/ /'chi ba'i dgra ni dgag tu med/ /rang gi thog tu nges par 'ongs/ /'khrid nas pha rol 'gro dgos na/ /sems yod sgyes bu tshe 'di yi/ /bslu brid dag la dga' zhing chags/ /tshe 'di'i phun tshogs kun spangs nas/ /phyi mar skyid pa'i lha chos gyes/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs 308

rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'chi nges nam 'chi cha yang med/ /do dgong yin yang 'chi nyen yod/ /rgas nas 'chi ba'i nges pa med/ /la la btsas ma thag tu 'chi/ /la la gzhon nu dar bab dus/ /glo bur nad mtshon dug gis 'chi/ /kha sang yod pa'i mi de ring / /shi ba thos pas shul gyi mi/ /la las nged gnyis kha sang nyin/ /za ma zos nas lhan cig bsdad/ /zla ba phyi ma'i shom ra bting / /glo bur shi ba ma bzang zer/ /la las da nangs skad cha yang / /'di dang 'di 'dra mang bo lab/ /a kha snying rje gzhon nu yin/ /da dung 'chi ni ma ran zer/ /de 'dra rang la de ring tsam/ /mi 'ong nges pa ci yang med/ /'chi rkyen mang la gson rkyen nyung / /dug dang mtshon chas brgyab pa dang / /gnod sbyin rgyal po btsan ma mo/ /sogs kyis srog ni 'phrog pa mang glo bur chus 'khyer me yis 'tshig /g.yang la lhung dang gad pa brdibs/ /gza' rgod gdong thug la sogs rkyen/ /char rlung gseb kyi mar me 'dra/ /gson rkyen zas gos sman la sogs/ /yin yang zas dug sman ma 'phrod/ /byis pa gos kyis kha srubs 309

dang / /gnas khang bdibs dang mdza' bos bslus/ /gson pa'i rkyen yang 'chi rkyen du/ /'gyur bas gson rkyen mi snang ngo / /lus 'di shin tu nyam chung bas/ /nam 'chi nges pa med pa yin/ /chu yi lbu ba lta bu'i lus/ /nad gdon chen po mi dgos par/ /tsher ma zug pa tsam rkyen la/ /snyad btags 'jig par 'gyur bas na/ /'chi rkyen cung zad tsam gyis lus/ /gzhom pa shin tu sla ba yin/ /des na nam 'chi cha med pas/ /myur du chos shig mi byed par/ /sos dal byas nas sdod phod dam/ /da lta nyid du 'chi nyen gda'/ /chos kyis nyin mtshan 'da' bar mdzod/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'chi ba zer ba'i 'brug bzhin grags/ /'chi bdag thog dang 'dra ba de/ /nges par thog tu bab pa'i tshe/ /dam chos ma gtogs phan mkhan med/ /mo sman rim gros bzlog mi nus/ /mkhas pas zhu ba byed sa med/ /dpa' mdzangs dmag gis bsrung mi nus//rgyu nor byen nas blu sa med/ /sdar ma 310

bros nas 'gro sa med/ /de tshe lus la nad kyis gdungs/ /sha dang khrag bskams bkrag mdangs nyams/ /mo sman rim gro ba rnams bros/ /rkang lag g.yab cing 'khun bu 'chor/ /ci zhig zos kyang 'phrod mi 'gyur/ /mngar mo zos kyang kha mor tshor/ /nyin mtshan gnyis gar mal du lhung / /nye du 'brel bas mtha' bskor nas/ /gdong la hrig hrig blta ba'i tshe/ /srog gcod nad la bgo thabs med/ /sdug bsngal rang nyid ga cig pus myong / /gnyen bshes snying dang 'dra ba la/ /'grogs dbang phyi mar 'khrid dbang med/ /brtsigs pa'i mkhar khang bsags pa'i nor//mkho dgu'i yo byad ci yod pa/ /gcig kyang rang la 'khyer dbang med/ /gnyen bshes zas nor longs spyod kyi/ /gang gces 'bral glags mi phod la/ /mig gis blta zhing chags bzhin du/ /rang dang lhan cig sngon 'grogs pa'i/ /sha rus yan chad mal du bzhag /'jig rten pha rol gcig pur 'gro/ /'jig rten 'di yi snang ba nub/ /gshin rje pho nya mthong nas skrag /dbugs kyi 'gyu ba chad pa'i tshe/ /nye 'brel rnams kyis shi zer nas/ /tha gus bsdams te yol bas bsgribs/ /ngu 'bod byed cing gza' skar brtsi/ /shi dge dur 'debs shom ra 'ding / /tshe 'dir ser snas bsags pa'i nor/ /rang gis spyad 311

par ma phod pa/ /gnyen grogs 'khor gyes ci bder spyod/ /rang nyid lag pa stong ba ru/ /cha med bar do'i lam 'phrang brgyud/ /rgyus med gcig pur 'gro dus 'gyod/ /ngan song 'jigs pa chen po mthong / /rab tu skrag nas glo snying 'dar/ /de tshe mgon skyabs chos ma gtogs/ /gzhan gyes cung zad tsam mi phan/ /de 'dra'i dus shig lo brgya tshun/ /'ongs shing nam 'ong cha med pas/ /mi phan tshe 'di'i gnyen bshes dang / /nor rdzas zhen pas ci zhig bya/ /thams cad shul du bzhag nas 'gro/ /gang la'ang chags med zhen med gyis/ /thag ring phyi ma'i lam brgyud nas/ /'gro dus brgyags phye chos kho na/ /sdod grabs byas pas ci zhig bya/ /'jig rten phyi mar 'gro grabs gyis/ /da lta 'chi rung mi 'gyod par/ /brod pa skye ba'i lha chos mdzod/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyes rlobs/ /rnyed dka' don che dal 'byor rten/ /mi rtag myur du 'jig pa yin/ /zhig na rtswa phung mes bsregs 312

bzhin/ /med nas mi 'gro sgye dgos la/ /skyes na bde 'gro ngan 'gro gnyis/ /ma gtogs gzhan du skye sa med/ /bde 'gro ngan 'gror skye ba'i dbang / /rang la med de las dbang che/ /dge dang mi dge las gnyis kyis/ /'phangs pa bzhin du skye bar 'gyur/ /mi dge'i las kyis ngan song du/ /skyes na sdug bsngal bzod par dka'/ /'di nas dpag tshad sum khri dang / /nyis stong 'og na dmyal ba ni/ /yang sos zhes bya de yod la/ /de nas rim bzhin dpag tshad ni/ /bzhi stong bzhi stong gis chod pa'i/ /'og na dmyal ba gzhan bdun yod/ /dmyal ba yang sos gnas skyes pa'i/ /sems can 'tshogs nas las dbang gis/ /byung ba'i mtshon cha sna tshogs pa/ /rim gyis byung bas gcig la gcig /rdeg re byas pas de nas brgyal/ /thams cad sa la 'gyel ba dang / /mkha' las khyed rnams yang sos par/ /gyur cig ces pa'i sgra 'byung ngo / /sos te langs nas sngar bzhin du/ /brdegs shing sdug bsngal dpag med myong / /dmyal ba thig nag gnas skyes pa'i/ /sems can dmyal srung rnams kyis bzung / /thig nag mang btab sog les 'dra/ /mtshon chas gshags nas sdug bsngal myong / /dmyal ba bsdus 'joms gnas skyes pa'i/ /sems can gcig tu 'dus pa'i tshe/ /dmyal 313

srung rnams kyis lcags kyi ri/ /ra lug rta dang glang bo che/ /seng ge stag gi gdong 'dra ba/ /gnyis re bar du 'tshangs par byed/ /de nas bar du btsir nas sgo/ /kun nas khrag gi rgyun 'bab cing / /de nas ri gnyis gyes pas sos/ /thams cad sngar bzhin 'dus pa na/ /lcags kyi 'khrul 'khor che nang du/ /bcug nas bur shing 'tshir bzhin btsir/ /de nas phyi ru phyung bas sos/ /'dus pa'i tshe na yar steng nas/ /lcags kyi pha bong chen po lhung / /lcags kyi gzhi la gcod pa dang //'byed dang brdung dang dmyal bar byed/ /de dus khrag gi rgyun 'bab bo/ /dmyal ba ngu 'bod gnas sgyes pa'i/ /sems can de dag gnas 'tshol tshe /lcags kyi khang ba'i nang song na/ /de ma thag tu sgo 'grig ste/ /lcags khang nang nas me 'bar bsreg /'gro sa mi 'dug snyam du ngu / /dmyal ba ngu 'bod chen po'i gnas/ /skyes rnams lcags khang nyis rim gyi/ /nang du zhugs tshe de ma thag /sgo 'grig nang nas me lce 'bar/ /bsregs tshe 'gro ba'i sa mi 'dug /snyam du ngu 'bod chen po byed/ /tsha ba'i dmyal ba'i gnas skyes pa'i/ /sems can dmyal srung rnams kyis bzung / /lcags zangs dpag tshad du ma yod/ /tsha zhing 'bar ba'i nang du bsreg /lcags kyi gsal shing me 'bar bas/ /'phongs nas phug ste spyi 314

bor 'byin/ /kha min rna ba sna'i bu ga /ba spu'i khung bu thams cad nas/ /me lce 'bar dang lcags kyi gzhi/ /rab tu 'bar ba gan rkyal lam/ /kha sbub bzhag ste lcags kyi tho/ /tsha zhing rab tu 'bar bas brdung / /rab tsha'i dmyal ba'i gnas skyes pa'i/ /sems can dmyal srung rnams kyis bzung / /lcags kyi gsal shing rtse gsum pa/ /'phongs nas btsugs te rtse mo gsum/ /phrag gong gnyis nas spyi bor 'byin/ /kha sgo sogs nas me lce 'bar/ /lcags sle'u tsha zhing 'bar bas lus/ /thams cad snam bus dkris bzhin dkre/ /lcags zangs chen po khro khol ba'i/ /nang du 'tshod cing sha khrag rnams/ /zhig nas keng rus ltar gyur tshe/ /phyir phyung lcags kyi sa gzhir 'grem/ /sha khrag skyes tshe nang du 'jug /lhag ma gzhan ni tsha ba 'dra/ /mnar med dmyal ba'i sa phyogs su/ /dpag tshad brgya phrag du ma zhig /yod pa 'bar zhing me mched de/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i shugs 'ongs nas/ /de ru skyes pa'i sems can rnams/ /pags pa sha khrag rim gyis 'tshig /mar me sdong bu bzhin du lus/ /thams cad me yis khyab cing 'bar/ /phyogs gzhan gsum nas me 'bar nas/ /'ongs pas phyogs bzhi'i me rnams 'dres/ /ngu ba'i skad kyis sems can zhig /yin par shes pa ma gtogs pa/ /me dang lus gnyis 315

lhan cig tu/ /'ur 'ur 'bar bas lus mi mthong / /lcags kyi sa gzhir lcags kyi ri/ /'bab 'dzeg byed du 'jug pa dang / /kha nas lce phyung lcags phur gyis/ /glang gi ko ba bzhin du brgyangs/ /lcags kyi sa gzhir gan rkyal bzhag /lcags kyi 'byed byed dag gis kha/ /phye nas lcags kyi tho lum 'bar/ /kha ru 'jug par byed pa dang / /khro chu khol ma kha nang blugs/ /khog rnams tshig nas smad nas byung / /lhag ma gzhan ni gang yod pa/ /rab tu tsha ba'i dmyal ba 'dra/ /mi yi me las bskal pa ni/ /'jig pa'i me ni bdun 'gyur tsha/ /de las tsha ba'i dmyal ba brgyad/ /me ni bdun 'gyur tsha ba yin/ /tsha dmyal brgyad kyi mer bltas na/ /mi'i me kha ba tsam du bsil/ /sdug bsngal de dag yun thung ngu / /tsam zhig myong bas mi chog ste/ /tsha dmyal brgyad kyi tshe thung ba/ /dmyal ba yang sos tshe tshad ni/ /mi yi lo ni khrag khrig gcig /ther 'bum chen po drug dang ni/ /ther 'bum gnyis ni yin zhes bshad/ /dmyal ba 'og ma 'og ma rnams/ /nyis 'gyur nyis 'gyur tshe ring zhing / /mi dge'i sdig pa ma zad bar/ /srog dang nam yang 'bral mi 'gyur/ /da lta'i spyod tshul ngan pa 'dir/ /bltas na de las yun ring zhig /mi 'ong nges pa ci zhig yod/ /lus la me stag lhung ba yang / /skad cig tsam 316

yang mi bzod na/ /sdug bsngal de dag thog tu bab/ /yun ring myong dgos su yis bzod/ /'di dang phyi ma de'i bar na/ /dbugs kyi 'gyu ba 'di min med/ /do nub tsam la shi nas ni/ /de ru lhung na ci zhig bya/ /tshe 'di'i kha rgyab gnyis kyi phyir/ /mi dge'i las ngan bsags pa rnams/ /spyos sam gdon gyis zin pa yin/ /tsha dmyal rnams su skye ba'i rgyu/ /tshe 'dir srog gcod byed pa dang / /ma byen len dang mi tshangs spyod/ /dzun gyi tshig bshad phra ma smra/ /tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal smra ba dang / /brnab sems gnod sems log lta rnams/ /chen po byas pa rnams yin zhes/ /gsung rab rnams nas yang yang gsungs/ /sngon chad 'di 'dra'i mi dge'i las/ /mang bo nges par bsags yod pas/ /las de da lta sbyong ma nus/ /do nub tsam la shi nas ni/ /de ru skyes na ci zhig bya/ /da ni sngar byas sdig pa la/ /snying nas gnong 'gyod bshags pa gyes/ /phyin chad srog la bab na yang / /mi dge bcu la 'dzem par mdzod/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smrin cing grol 317

bar byen gyis rlobs/ /tsha dmyal brgyad po re re la/ /rtsig ngos bzhi bzhi sgo bzhi bzhi/ /yod pa de dag phyi rol tu/ /lcags kyi ra bas bskor nas yod/ /ra ba la yang sgo bzhi bzhi/ /yod cing sgo de re re na/ /nye 'khor dmyal ba 'di rnams yod/ /de yang me ma mur gyi 'obs/ /tsha ngar pus mo nub pa yod/ /mi dge las kyis der skyes pas/ /sems can de dag gnas 'tshol du/ /'gro dus de ru rkang ba bzhag /pags pa sha khrag 'jig par 'gyur/ /rkang ba yar la btegs pa'i tshe/ /slar yang myur du sha pags sgye/ /de yi 'dabs na mi gtsang 'dam/ /yod la de ru skyes pa yi/ /sems can gnas 'tshol 'dam de la/ /brgal tshe mgo bo man chad nub/ /de nas mchu rnon 'bu yis lus/ /phug ste rkang la gtugs nas 'bru/ /de yi 'dabs na spu gri'i lam/ /yod la der skyes sems can gyis/ /rkang ba bzhag na pags pa sha /gcod cing btegs tshe sha pags skye/ /de'i 'dabs nags tshal ral gri yi/ /lo ma can zhes bya ba yod/ /der sgyes sems can gnas 'tshol ba/ /de dag thams cad nags tshal der/ /song nas nags tshal de'i bsil grib/ /dag la brten cing 'khod pa na/ /shing las ral gri babs te lus/ /gshag dang yan lag nying lag gcod/ /sa la 'gyel tshe khyi sre bo/ /mang bo 'ongs te rgyab nas 318

za/ /de yi 'dabs na shal ma li'i/ /sdong bo yod de sems can der/ /song ba de la 'dzeg tu 'jug /'jeg tshe tsher ma rnams kyi kha/ /thur du blta la 'bab pa'i tshe/ /gyen bltas lus kun gshag par byed/ /lcags kyi bya khra mang bo mgo /phrag gong babs nas mig 'bras 'bru//de yi 'dabs na tsha ngar che/ /chu klung rab med ces bya yod/ /der skyes sems can nang der 'tshod/ /steng 'og 'gro zhing bsreg par byed/ /dper na me sbar zangs nang chu/ /khol ba'i nang du nas blugs 'dra/ /gshin rje pho nya mang bo bsdad/ /phyi ru 'ong du mi ster la/ /'ongs pa lcags kyi sa gzhi la/ /gan rkyal bzhag nas ci 'dod 'dri/ /skrag nas ci yang mi 'dod zer/ /'on kyang bkres so skom zer nas/ /kha ru zangs zhun khol ma dang / /lcags kyi tho lum 'bar ba bcug /skom zhing bkres na 'di zo zer/ /tshe tshad nges pa med par bshad/ /'on kyang mi dge'i sdig las kyi/ /nus pa ma zad de srid du/ /nam yang srog dang 'bral mi 'gyur/ /sbug bsngal de dag yun ring myong / /nye 'khor dmyal ba de rnams su/ /skye ba'i rgyu ni mi dge bcu/ /chen po byas pa rnams yin gsungs/ /sngar byas sdig pa'i las rnams la/ /snying nas 'gyod pas bshags pa gyis/ /phyin chad srog la bab na yang / /mi dge bcu la shin tu 'dzems/ /glu 319

'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sgu/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyes rlobs/ /grang dmyal brgyad ni tsha dmyal brgyad/ /thad ga'i byang phyogs dpag tshad ni/ /khri phrag re re'i pha rol yod/ /kun gye 'og gzhi kha ba'i thang / /'khyags pa'i chab rom mtha' gangs ris/ /bskor zhing kha ba bu yug 'tshub/ /kha ba bu yug rlung gis bskyod/ /phyogs bzhi'i lus la 'debs par byed/ /'di nas dpag tshad sum khri dang / /nyis stong 'og na chu bur can/ /yod la de nas dpag tshad ni/ /nyis stong nyis stong gis chod pa'i/ /'og na grang dmyal gzhan bdun yod/ /grang ba'i dmyal ba chu bur can/ /gnas su skyes pa'i sems can rnams/ /lus la gos med gcer bur grang / /chu bur byung zhing 'khums nas 'dug /de yi 'og na grang dmyal ni/ /chu bur brdol ba'i gnas yod de/ /de ru skyes pa'i sems can rnams/ /rab tu grang bas chu bur brdol/ /de yi 'og na grang dmyal ni/ /so tham gnas yod der skyes pa'i/ /sems can grang bas skad mi 320

thon/ /so yis tham tham byed pa yin/ /de'i 'og grang ba'i dmyal ba ni/ /kye hud zer ba'i gnas yod de/ /de ru skyes pa'i sems can rnams/ /grang bas skad 'don mi nus par/ /shub bus kye hud kye hud zer/ /de'i 'og grang ba'i dmyal ba ni/ /a chu zer ba'i gnas yod de/ /de ru skyes pa'i sems can grang / /des kyang shub bus a chu zer/ /de'i 'og grang ba'i dmyal ba ni/ /utpal ltar gas gnas yod de/ /de ru skyes pa'i sems can lus/ /kha rlung chen pos btab pa yis/ /lus ni kha dog sngo ba dang / /ser kha lnga 'am drug tu gas/ /de'i 'og grang ba'i dmyal ba ni/ /padma ltar gas gnas yod de/ /der skyes sems can lus mdog dmar/ /kha bcu de las mang bar gas/ /de'i 'og grang ba'i dmyal ba ni/ /padma chen po ltar gas gnas/ /yod la der skyes sems can rnams/ /lus ni kha dog shin tu dmar/ /kha brgya tsam du gas pa'o/ /grang dmyal gong ma gong ma las/ /'og ma 'og ma bdun 'gyur grang / /sdug bsngal yun thung tsam ni min/ /bang ba til khal brgyad cu tsam/ /shong ba til gyis gang ba zhig /mi lo brgya brgya 'das nas til/ /re re phyi ru dor ba na/ /til 'bru zad nas bang ba stongs/ /yun de lta bu chu bur can/ /tshe'i tshad de 'dra nyi shu ni/ /chu bur brdol ba'i tshe tshad yin/ /de 321

bzhin snga ma snga ma las/ /phyi ma phyi ma nyi shur 'phar/ /de la cung zad tsam mi skrag /da dung tshe 'di'i lto rgyab phyir/ /sdug la hab thob byed mkhan snying / /rul lam lcags las byas sam ci/ /grang ba'i dmyal ba de rnams su/ /skye ba'i rgyu ni mi dge bcu/ /chen bo byas pa rnams yin gsungs/ /des na sngar byas las rnams la/ /snying nas 'gyod pas bshags pa dang / /phyin chad mi dge bcu la 'dzems/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyis rlobs/ /nyi tshe ba ni tsha dmyal brgyad/ /grang dmyal brgyad kyi 'khor na yod/ /la la mi yi yul na'ang yod/ /gnas la nges pa med pa yin/ /mang nyung ma nges la la mang la la gnyis sam gcig min med/ /sdug bsngal mtha' gcig ma nges te/ /gtun dang ka ba thab kha dang / /thag pa zangs dang phyags ma sogs/ /dbyibs dang ldan pa'i lus blangs nas//sdug bsngal yun ring nyams su myong / /tshe la nges pa med pa yin/ /'on kyang sdig pa'i rgyu ma zad/ /bar du 'bras bu sdug bsngal myong //'khor 322

ba'i sdug bsngal rnams nang nas/ /ngan song sdug bsngal bzod par dka'/ /de yi nang nas dmyal ba'i sdug /skad cig tsam yang bzod par dka'/ /tshe 'dir nyin gcig mdung rnon po/ /sum brgyas rgyun du btab pa yi/ /sbug bsngal de la dmyal ba'i sdug /chung ngu tsam gyi cha yang med/ /dmyal ba'i nang nas mnar med kyi/ /sdug bsngal gzhan las ches che ste/ /skye ba'i rgyu ni mi dge bcu/ /chen po byas pa rnams yin gsungs/ /des na sngar byas sdig pa la/ /snying nas 'gyod pas bshags pa dang / /phyin chad srog la bab na yang / /mi dge bcu la 'dzem par gyis/ / glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku//drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyis rlobs/ /yi dwags byeng gnas 'dzam gling 'og /dpag tshad lnga brgya 'das pa na/ /grong khyer ser skya zhes bya ba/ /rtswa dang chu dang shing la sogs/ /'dod pa'i dngos po ci yang med/ /de ru skyes pa sha khrag bskams/ /mdog nag gdong ba skra yis khebs/ /shin tu kha skam lce yis ldag /phyi sgrib can gyi yi 323

dwags kyis/ /chu mig mtsho dang mtshe'ur mthong / /phyin na mtshon cha thogs pas bsrungs/ /btung du mi ster la la ni/ /drung du song na rnag dang khrag /sogs su mthong nas 'thung mi 'dod/ /nang sgrib can gyi yi dwags kyi/ /kha ni khab kyi mig tsam dang / /mgrin pa rta rnga yan lag rnams/ /'jag skya tsam dang lto ba'i tshad/ /ri gtos tsam yod zas skom gnyis/ /mi rnyed rnyed kyang khar mi shong / /cung zad shong yang mgrin mi thar/ /thar kyang lto ba mi khengs shing / /khengs kyang rkang lag gis mi theg /sdug bsngal sngar bas che ba myong / /zas skom sgrib can yi dwags kyis/ /zas skom gang rnyed sbyad ma thag /khog nas me 'bar lus po 'tshig /ljan ljin za ba'i yi dwags kyis/ /bshang gci spyod cing kha cig gis/ /rang sha za zhing de dag la/ /dgun gyi dus su nyi ma grang / /dbyed kyi dus su zla ba'ang tsha/ /kha 'thor mi yi yul na'ang yod/ /tshe tshad mi yi zla ba gcig /zhag tu byas pas kho rang lo/ /lnga brgya lnga stong khri sogs thub/ /skye ba'i rgyu ni mi dge bcu/ /'bring tsam byas pa rnams yin gsungs/ /des na sngar byas sdig pa la/ /snying nas 'gyod pas bshags pa dang / /phyin chad mi dge bcu la 'dzems/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde 32 4

zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyes rlobs/ /dud 'gro byeng gnas ri rab kyi/ /chu mtshams man chad khong gseng gi /mun pa rab tu gnag par yod/ /lus kyi che chung mdog dbyibs sogs/ /mtha' gcig ma nges sna tshogs pa/ /dper na chang gi sbang ma ltar/ /mang bo yod pa'i che ba yis/ /chung ba thams cad khyur mid byed/ /chung ba 'dus nas che ba za/ /lus po phar thal tshur thal 'bugs/ /mun pa shin tu gnag pa yis/ /lag pa'i rkyang bskum tsam mi mthong / /che bas chung ba rab tu mnan/ /dbugs kyi 'byen rngub tsam mi nus/ /sdug bsngal yun ring nyams su myong //dud 'gro kha 'thor lha dang mi'i/ /yul na yod pa thams cad ni/ /ri dwags rnams ni rngon pa khyes/ /bdas nas bros kyang mi thar gsod/ /phan tshun gcig gis gcig gsod cing / /srog chags phra mo nyi mas 'tshig /dud 'gro klu yi rigs rnams la/ /bye tshan mkha' lding 'jigs pa yod/ /lha 'am mi yi dbang gyur pa/ /rnams ni bkol dang sna 'bug cing / /mi theg bzhin du khal phyi 'gel/ /brdungs tshe ro smad 'khyogs nas 'gro/ /ma bzod 'u thug 'gyel 325

la byas/ /lus po na tshas gang bzhin 'khur/ /'phongs zad rgyab rnams sgal bas khengs/ /sos dal nyin gcig sdod dbang med/ /la la sha dang pags pa'i ched/ /bsgyel nas gsod grabs byas pa'i tshe/ /skrag nas gsod mkhan bshan pa'i ngor/ /hrig hrig bltas kyang dbang med du/ /kha bsum yang na gris mgo gcod/ /gzhan yang dbang bo gcod pa dang / /spu 'breg rmo dang bcings pa dang / /bzho dang bkres skom tsha grang sogs/ /sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa yod/ /tshe tshad ring mtha' bskal par gnas/ /thung ba snga dro phyi dro tsam/ /sgye ba'i rgyu ni mi dge bcu/ /chung ngu spyad pa rnams yin gsungs/ /da lta shi nas de 'dra ba/ /zhig tu skyes na ci zhig bya/ /des na sngar byas sdig pa la/ /snying nas 'gyod pas bshags pa dang / /phyin chad srog la bab na yang / /mi dge bcu la 'dzem par gyes/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog / sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyis rlobs/ /sngon chad tshe 'di'i lto rgyab phyir/ /mi 326

dge'i las ni mang bo bsags/ /dge ba legs po nyin gcig la/ /byas pa dran rgyu mi 'dug na/ /shi ma thag tu ngan song du/ /lhung nas sdug bsngal myong bar nges/ /dper na rang la gnod pa'i dgra/ /lo gcig tshun la 'ong nges la/ /nges par nam 'ong cha med par/ /shes nas dal bar mi sdod par/ /pha rol dgra yi 'jigs pa las/ /skyob mkhan dpon zhig 'tshol ba ltar/ /ngan song sdug bsngal rang thog tu/ /lo brgya tshun la 'ong nges la/ zla ba phyi ma mnar med kyi/ /dmyal ba gang snga cha med par/ /shes nas ngan song 'jigs pa las/ /skyob pa'i skyabs shig 'tshol re ran/ /dper na pha rol dgra las stobs/ /kha dregs chung ba'i dpon zhig gis/ /rang nyid pha rol dgra'i 'jigs las/ /skyob par mi nus pa bzhin du/ /tshangs pa khyab 'jug dbang phyug sogs/ /lha mi mthu bo che bsten kyang / /ngan song 'jigs las skyob mi nus/ /dper na pha rol dgra bo las/ /stobs dang mnga' thang che ba'i dpon/ /zhig gis rang nyid pha rol dgra'i/ /'jigs las nges par skyob nus bzhin/ /ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa chen po las/ /dkon mchog gsum gyis skyob par nges de phyir dkon mchog rnam gsum la/ /nangs nub kun tu skyabs 'gro gyes/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos 327

dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sgu/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyes rlobs/ /sangs rgyas skyabs su song ba yis /'jig rten lha la gtan gyi skyabs/ /mi bcol chos la skyabs song bas/ /sems can rnams la gnod mi bya/ /dge 'dun rnams la skyabs song bas/ /mu stegs pa dang 'grogs mi bya/ /sangs rgyas sku gzugs bzo rgyu ngan/ /gang la sangs rgyas dngos su mos/ /gsung rab tshig bzhi yan chad la/ /dam chos dkon mchog yin par mos/ /rab byung rtags tsam 'dzin pa la/ /dge 'dun dkon mchog yin par mos/ /sgo gsum mi gus pa rnams spongs/ /gus pas mchod bstod bkur bar gyes/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sgu/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs song 328

ba'i/ /gnas skabs mthar thug phan yon ni/ /nang ba sangs rgyas gral du chud/ /sdom pa kun gyi rten du 'gyur/ /sngar bsags las sgrib srab cing 'dzad/ /bsod nams rgya chen thob par 'gyur/ /ngan 'gror mi ltung mi min gyi/ /gnod pas mi tshugs ci bsam 'grub/ /myur du sangs rgyas 'thob pa sogs/ /skyabs song bsod nams gzhal mi nus/ /de phyir dkon mchog rnam pa gsum/ /gtan gyi skyabs su legs bzung nas/ /rgyun du skyabs 'gror 'bad par mdzod/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs//mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mi dge ba las sdug bsngal 'byung / /bde ba nam yang 'byung mi 'gyur/ /dge las bde ba kho na 'byung / /sdug bsngal nam yang 'byung mi 'gyur/ /da lta tsha bas gdungs pa'i dus/ /rlung ni bsil bo rang lus la/ /phog pa'i bde ba yan chad po/ /sngon gye dge ba'i 'bras bu yin/ /tsher ma zug pa'i sdug bsngal yan/ /sngon gyi mi dge'i 'bras bu yin/ /dge sdug chung ngu tsam byas kyang / /'phel nas 'bras bu chen po 329

'byen/ /sngon dus dge tshul kyun des gzhan/ /dge slong dbyangs mi snyan pa la/ /khyod kyi dbyangs 'di khye zug pa'i/ /skad dang 'dra zhes smras pa yis/ /skye ba lnga brgya khye'i lus blangs/ /de bzhin mi dge 'phel stobs che/ /byes pa zhig gis sangs rgyas la/ /sa ni snyim pa gang phul bas/ /chos rgyal mya ngan med du skyes/ /de bzhin dge las 'phel stobs che/ /dper na gro nas ma btab na/ /lo tog smin pa mi phrad bzhin/ /dge sdig gnyis ni ma byas na//bde sdig gang la'ang phrad mi srid/ /dper na sa bon gang btab pa/ /ser ba la sogs rkyen gzhan gyis/ /ma bcom chud zos mi 'gro bar/ /lo tog legs par smin pa bzhin/ /dge ba'i las ni gang byas pa/ /zhe sdang la sogs rkyen gzhan gyis/ /ma bcom chud zos mi 'gro bar/ /'bras bu bde ba smin par 'gyur/ /dper na khog tu song ba'i dug /sman sngags sogs kyis ma bcom na/ /cung zad chud zos mi 'gro bar/ /bzod med sdug bsngal bskyed pa bzhin/ /mi dge sdig pa'i las gang byas/ /bshags pa sogs kyis ma sbyangs na/ /nam yang chud zos mi 'gro bar/ /'bras bu sdug bsngal smin no zhes/ /thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas gsungs/ /sangs rgyas gsung la bslu ba med/ /yid ches nges pa rab bskyed nas/ /dkar nag las la spang blang 330

gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyis rlobs/ /mi dang mir chags rta nor lug /ri dwags nya sogs srog chags rnams/ /mtshon cha rdo dang dbyug pa dug /mthu gtad la sogs gang yin gyi/ /sgo nas rang gis gsod pa dang / /gzhan la gsod bcug srog gcod las/ /chen po byas na dmyal bar skye/ /'bring byas yi dwags gnas su skye/ /chung ngu byas na dud 'gro'i gnas/ /skyes nas sdug bsngal yun ring myong / /thar nas mi ru skyes na yang / /srog gcod byed la rab tu dga'/ /tshe thung nad mang mi ru skye/ /yul phyogs bza' btung sman lo 'bras/ /la sogs mthu chung yul du sgye/ /de phyir srog gcod las ma byed/ /ngo lkog gang du'ang dug bzhin spongs/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i 331

bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin kyis rlobs/ /gzhan gyi gser dngul rta nor lug /ja ras gos dar la sogs pa'i/ /dngos po che chung gang yin kyang //'phrog gam 'phrog tu bcug pa dang / /'jab bus brkus dang brku ru 'jug /g.yar dang bcol ba g.yo thabs kyis/ /len dang gzhan gyi nor rdzas blangs/ /de yi skyin pa ma 'jal dang / /bre dang rgya ma la sogs la/ /g.yo sgyu byas nas ma byin pa/ /chen po blangs na dmyal bar skye/ /'bring gis yi dwags gnas su skye/ /chung ngu blangs na dud 'gro'i gnas/ /skyes nas sdug bsngal yun ring myong / /mi ru sgyes kyang ma byin pa/ /len la dga' zhing longs spyod chung / /longs spyod gzhan dang thun mong 'gyur/ /yul phyogs lo 'bras nyung ba dang / /sad ser than pa la sogs che/ /'bras bu smin dka'i yul du skye/ /de phyir ma byin mi len par/ /ngo skog gang du'ang dug bzhin spongs/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol 332

bar byin gyis rlobs/ /gzhan gyi chung ma rab byung ma/ /bag mar ma song pha dang ma/ /sogs kyis bsrung dang rgyal po yi/ /chad pa phog nas khrims bcas dang / /gzhan gyes gla gzhal smad 'tshong ma/ /rang gi nye dur spyod pa dang / /mngal sgo min pa'i bshang lam dang / /rang gi lag pa'i sor mo sogs/ /rtsol bas khu ba 'byen pa dang / /bla ma pha ma'i nye 'khor dang / /sku gzugs dam chos mchod rten dang / /skye bo mang bos mthong ba'i gnas/ /spyod yul bud med la gnod pa'i/ /sa phyogs mi bde 'bar 'bur can/ /sra ba sogs nas spyod pa dang / /zla mtshan 'dzag pa'i dus skabs dang / /zla ba tshang ba'i sbrum ma dang / /bsnyen gnas gnas dang nyin mo dang / /nad pa mya ngan byed rnams dang / /mi mos pa la nan gyis spyod/ /rang la 'thad kyang lnga las lhag /rang gis spyad dam gzhan dag la/ /spyod du bcug nas mi tshangs pa/ /chen po spyad na dmyal bar sgye/ /'bring gis yi dwags gnas su skye/ /chung ngu spyad na dud 'gro'i gnas/ /skyes nas sdug bsnga' yun ring myong / /thar nas mi ru skyes na yang / /mi tshangs spyod la rab tu dga'/ /'khor g.yog gang la blo gtad med/ /chung ma blangs la 'gran zla mang / /yul phyogs bshang gci 'dam rdzab sogs/ /mi gtsang mang bo'i yul du skye/ /de phyir mi tshangs spyod 333

ma byed/ /ngo lkog gang du'ang dug bzhin spongs/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku//drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin rlobs/ /mig gis gzugs ni mthong ba la ma mthong zer zhing ma mthong ba/ /bdag gis mthong zhes dzun smra dang / /de bzhin rna ba sna dang lce/ /lus dang yid kyi dbang bo la/ /brten nas rdzun gtam smra ba dang / /gzhan yang 'di ltar dzun shod ces/ /smra ru bcug nas dzun gye tshig /chen po smras na dmyal bar skye/ /'bring gis yi dwags gnas su skye/ /chung ngu smras na dud 'gro'i gnas/ /skyes nas sdug bsngal yun ring myong / /thar nas mi ru skyes na yang / /rdzun la dga' zhing skur 'debs dang / /gzhan gyes bslu dang yul phyogs der/ /rdzun gyes phal cher bslu ba mang / /'jigs pa mang bo'i yul du skye/ /de phyir rdzun gyi tshig ma smra/ /ngo lkog gang du'ang dug bzhin sgongs/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs 334

rgyas thob par shog/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyes rlobs/ /bden pa'i tshig gam rdzun tshig gis/ /sems can mthun pa rnam 'byed cing / /mi mthun pa rnams mi bsdum par/ /rang gis byed dam gzhan gyis mir/ /byed du bcug nas phra ma'i tshig /chen bo smras na dmyal bar skye/ /'bring gis yi dwags gnas su skye/ /chung ngu smras na dud 'gro'i gnas/ /skyes nas sdug bsngal yun ring myong / /thar nas mi ru sgyes na yang / /phra ma smra la rab tu dga'/ /g.yog 'khor ngan la mi 'grig dang / /sa phyogs 'bar 'bur ljang ljongs dang / /ngam grog g.yang sa che ba sogs/ /bgrod par dka' ba'i yul du skye/ /de phyir phra mas gzhan ma 'byed/ /ngo lkog gang du'ang dug bzhin sgongs/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyis rlobs/ /rab tu byung dang pho skyes dang //bud med 335

rnams la sdom shor dang / /khye rgan bdud mo la sogs pa'i/ /mi snyan tshig ngan smras pa dang / /sod chod gtubs dang rgyob la sogs/ /pha rol gzhan sems la gnod pa'i/ /tshig ngan rnam pa sna tshogs pa//rang gis smra 'am gzhan gyi mir/ /smra ru bcug nas tshig rtsub ni/ /chen po smras na dmyal bar skye/ /'bring gis yi dwags gnas su skye/ /chung ngu smras na dud 'gro'i gnas/ /sgyes nas sdug bsngal yun ring myong / /thar nas mi ru sgyes na yang / /tshig rtsub smra la rab tu dga'/ /mi snyan rnam pa sna tshogs thos/ /gang smras 'thab mo'i tshig tu 'gyur/ /yul phyogs sdong ldum tsher ma mang / /rdo dang gseg ma mang ba sogs/ /rab tu rtsub pa'i yul du sgye/ /de phyir rtsub pa'i tshig ma smra/ /ngo lkog gang du'ang dug bzhin spongs/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'thab mo mtshang 'bru rtsod 'gyed tshig /rgyal blon chom rkun dmag la sogs/ /'du 'dzi'i gtam rnams smra ba dang / /glu gar tshig rnams brjod pa dang / /dga' 336

mgur spyad pa smra ba dang / /shin tu nyam thag smre sngags tshig /log pa'i 'tsho ba'i smra ba sogs/ /spyon pa bzhin du don med pa'i/ /mtho bshad dma' bshad sna tshogs pa/ /rang gis smra ram gzhan gye mir/ /smra ru bcug nas ngag 'khyal tshig /chen po smras na dmyal bar skye/ /'bring gis yi dwags gnas su skye/ /chung ngu smras na dud 'gro'i gnas/ /skyes nas sdug bsngal yun ring myong / /thar nas mi ru skyes na yang / /ngag 'khyal la dga' tshig bzung bar/ /mi 'os ma nges spobs par 'gyur/ /yul phyogs ljon shing 'bras mi chags/ /dus min 'bras chags chags dus su/ /mi chags ma smin smin par snang / /rtsa ba mi brtan yun ring du/ /mi gnas pa sogs yul du skye/ /de phyir ngag 'khyal tshig ma smra/ /ngo skog gang du'ang dug bzhin spongs/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyis rlobs/ /gzhan gyis bdag tu bzung ba'i rta/ /nor lug rgyan gos gnas khang dang / /'khor g.yog la sogs 337

gang yin yang / /nga la byung na ci ma rung //'byung bar gyur cig ci zhig gis/ /blangs na snyam pa'i brnab sems ni/ /chen po byas na dmyal bar skye/ /'bring gis yi dwags gnas su skye/ /chung ngu byas na dud 'gro'i gnas/ /skyes nas sdug bsngal yun ring myong / /thar nas mi ru skyes na yang / /brnab sems la dga' 'dod pa che/ /chog mi shes dang yul phyogs ni/ /phun tshogs thams cad lo re dang / /zla ba zhag re bzhin du nyams/ /'bras bu mi 'phel yul du skye/ /de phyir brnab sems ma byed par/ /ngo skog gang du'ang dug bzhin spongs/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang //mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyis rlobs/ /rang dang mi mthun dgra la sogs/ /rang gis gsod cing brdeg snyam dang / /gzhan gyi na tsha shi chad dang / /god kha la sogs mi 'dod pa/ /mang bo byung na snyam pa dang / /shi nas dmyal bar mar song nas/ /yar la kha mi 'khor du chugs/ /snyam pa'i gzhan la gnod pa'i sems/ /chen po byas na dmyal bar skye/ /'bring gis yi dwags gnas su skye/ /chung ngu 338

byas na dud 'gro'i gnas/ /skyes nas sdug bsngal yun ring pyong / /thar nas mi ru skyes na yang / /gnod sems la dga' mi phan 'tshol/ /phan pa mi 'tshol yul phyogs nas/ /nad yams 'khrug pa mang ba dang / /chom rkun gcan gzan sbrul la sogs/ /gnod pa mang ba'i yul du skye/ /de phyir gnod sems ma byed par/ /ngo lkog gang du'ang dug bzhin spongs/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyes rlobs/ /mi dge sdig pa'i las byas kyang / /dmyal bar skye zhes smra ba dzun/ /yar bltas gnam dang mar bltas sa/ /bar 'dir dmyal bar ci la ldog /dge ba byas na tshe bsod rgyas/ /bde'o skyid do zer ba'ang rdzun/ /'di ba tshang gis lha chos byas/ /da lta de bas sdug cig med/ /sangs rgyas mi bden chos mi bden/ /dge 'dun mi bden thams cad dzun/ /las 'bras med ces log lta ni/ /chen po byas na dmyal bar skye/ /'bring gis yi dwags gnas su skye/ /chung ngu byas na dud 'gro'i gnas/ /339

skyes nas sdug bsngal yun ring myong / /thar nas mi ru skyes na yang / /log ltar dga' zhing lta ba ngan/ /g.yo sgyu che zhing yul phyogs ni/ /rin po che la sogs pa yi/ /'byung khungs bzang bo mi ldan dang / /dngos po mi gtsang ngan pa'i rigs/ /mang zhing skyabs dang dpung gnyen rnams/ /gang yang med pa'i yul du skye/ /de phyir log lta ma byed par/ /ngo lkog gang du'ang dug bzhin spongs/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyes rlobs/ /mi dge bcu yi nyes dmigs shes/ /de dag byed pa'i kun slong tsam/ /yan chad bsdams nas sgo gsum po/ /de dag rnams dang ma 'dres par/ /byed pa dge ba bcu yin pas/ /dge bcu chen po byas gyur na/ /khams ni gong ma'i lha ru skye/ /'bring byas 'dod khams lha ru skye/ /chung ngu byas na mi ru skye/ /dge bcu byed la rab tu dga'/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par 340

shog /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyise rlobs/ /srog gcod spangs pas tshe ring 'gyur/ /yul phyogs bza' btung sman la sogs/ /rab tu mthu che'i yul du skye/ /ma byen len spangs longs spyod che/ /dgra rkun la sogs gnod 'tshe med/ /yul phyogs lo 'bras mang ba dang / /sad ser med pa'i yul du skye/ /mi tshangs spyod spangs g.yog 'khor la/ /blo gtad rung la chung ma bzang / /gzhan gye 'gran zla gcig kyang med/ /yul phyogs gtsang zhing spos ngad ldan/ /shin tu nyams dga'i yul du skye/ /rdzun tshig spangs pas skur 'debs med/ /gzhan gyes mi bslu yul phyogs ni/ /rdzun gyis bslu ba med pa dang / /'jigs pa med pa'i yul du skye/ /phra ma spangs pas g.yog 'khor rnams/ / bzang la phan tshun mthun par 'gyur/ /sa phyogs 'bar 'bur la sogs med/ /bgrod par sla ba'i yul du skye/ /tshig rtsub spangs pas snyan pa thos/ /gang smras mthun pa'i tshig tu 'gyur/ /yul phyogs sdong ldum tsher ma sogs/ /med la 'jam pa'i yul du skye/ /ngag 'khyal spangs pas tshig bzung 'os/ /nges pa'i spobs par 'gyur ba dang / /yul phyogs ljon 341

shing 'bras bu chags/ /dus su smin pa'i yul du skye/ /brnab sems spangs pas 'dod pa chung / /chog shes rab tu che bar 'gyur/ /yul phyogs phun sum tshogs pa rnams/ /mi nyams 'phel ba'i yul du skye/ /gnod sems spangs pas mi phan pa/ /mi 'tshol phan pa 'tshol bar 'gyur/ /yul phyogs nad 'khrug chom rkun sogs/ /gnod pa med pa'i yul du skye/ /log lta spangs pas lta ba bzang / /g.yo sgyu med cing yul phyogs ni/ /rin chen 'byung khungs dang ldan zhing / /skyabs dang dpung gnyen yod par skye/ /de phyir dge bcu bsgrub par gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'a dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mi dge bcu bo spangs pas kyang / /bde 'gro'i rten bzang zhig rnyed mod/ /'on kyang rnam mkhyen sgrub pa'i rten/ /mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig grub na/ /lam gang bsgoms kyang sa chod ni/ /gzhan dang mi 'dra ba yod pas/ /rten de bsgrub tshul 'di lta ste/ /mi tshe ring na yun ring du/ /dge ba mang 342
