bo gsog nus pas/ /de yi rgyu la sems can la/ /mi 'tshe mi 'tshe'i bsam pa sten/ /gzhan gyes mi dang ra lug sogs/ /gsod pa dgag cing tshe thar gyis/ /gzugs byad mdzes na gdul bya 'du/ /tshig la nyan dang bya bar sems/ /de yi rgyu la bzod pa sgoms/ /rten la mar me me tog phul/ /gzhan la gos rgyan gsar ba byin/ /rigs ni mtho na bsgo ba las/ /mi 'da' bsgrub par byed pas na/ /de yi rgyu la nga rgyal choms/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal zhing / /bla ma mkhan slob la sogs la/ /khri stan 'bul dang pha dang ma/ /grogs mched sogs la bkur ste gyis/ /dbang phyug che na sems can rnams/ /bsdus te smin par byed nus pas/ /de yi rgyu la zas nor gyes/ /mchod sbyin mang bo gtong bar gyis/ /tshig btsun pas na sems can rnams/ /sdud cing smin par byed nus pas/ /de yi rgyu la rdzun phra ma/ /tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal spong bar gyes/ /dbang ni che bar grags pa na/ /myur du bsgo ba nyan pas na/ /de yi rgyu la phyi ma la/ /rang la yon tan sna tshogs pa/ /'byung ba'i smon lam 'debs pa dang / /dkon mchog bla ma pha ma mchod/ /pho ru skyes na spobs pa che/ /chos la legs byed nyung bas na/ /de yi rgyu la pho yi lus/ /thob la dga' zhing mo yi lus/ /thob la ma dga' pho'i 343

dbang bo/ /ma gcod gzhan la gcod ma 'jug /stobs dang ldan na rang gzhan gyi/ /bya ba gang la'ang spro shugs che/ /so sor rtog pa'i stobs thob na/ /mngon par shes pa myur bas na/ /de yi rgyu la gzhan gye mis/ /gtan nas mi nus pa rnams ni/ /rang gis byed cing rang nyid dang / /bsdoms nas nus pa thams cad la/ /grogs byed pa dang bza' btung byin/ /de ltar rnam smin brgyad ldan rten/ /thob pa'i rgyu la 'bad par gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sngar byas mi dge'i las rnams dang / /'phral du nyes pa gang byas rnams/ /stobs bzhi'i sgo nas sbyang dgos pas/ /de yang skyabs su 'gro ba dang / /byang chub sems sgom rten gye stobs/ /mi dge las kyis ngan song du/ /lhung na sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa/ /yun ring myong dgos tshul bsams nas/ /sngar bsags las la dug khong du/ /song ba lta bu'i 'gyod pa ni/ /bsgyed pa rnam par sun 'byen stobs/ /sher phyin la 344

sogs mdo sde rnams/ /'dzin dang klog pa la sogs pa/ /stong nyid bsgom dang yig brgya sogs/ /gzungs sngags zab mo bzla ba dang / /sangs rgyas sku gzugs bzhengs pa dang / /sangs rgyas sangs rgyas mchod rten la/ /mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul ba dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan la sogs/ /brjod pa gnyen po kun spyod stobs/ /phyin chad srog la bab na yang / /mi byed dam bca' nyes pa las/ /slar log stobs yin stobs bzhi yi/ /sgo nas bshags na sdig pa gang / /byas pa 'dag pas 'bad par gyes/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mi rtag myur du 'chi ba dang / /shi nas ngan 'gror lhung ba'i tshul/ /bsams na 'jig rten 'di'i blo log /phyi ma'i bde 'gro don gnyer skyes/ /skyabs su 'gro dang dkar nag las/ /nges pa'i sgo nas sdig pa spangs/ /dge ba bsgrubs na phyi ma ru/ /bde 'gro'i go 'phang thob mod kyang / /bde 'gro'i go 'phang tsam thob pas/ /chog gam snyam na mi chog 345

ste/ /dper na nag can mi zhig bzung / /nyen re bzhin du dbyug pa yis/ /bsnun sogs chad las sna tshogs pa/ /bcad pas sdug bsngal bzod med myong / /zla ba 'ga'i 'phror gsod pa zhig /nan gyis ngo chen sogs byas pas/ /dbyug pas bsnun pas sdug med par/ /skabs der cung zad tsam bde yang / /'on kyang de las ma thar phyin/ /gsod pa'i sdug bsngal myong dgos bzhin//dge ba'i las kyis phyi ma ru/ /bde 'gro'i go 'phang zhig thob nas/ /skabs der cung zad tsam bde yang / /'on kyang sdug bsngal rtsa ba nas/ /spangs pa'i thar ba ma thob phyin/ /rang gis sngar byas las bzang gis/ /'phen pa zad nas ngan song ltung / /sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa myong / /gzhan yang 'khor ba'i gnas 'di ru/ /las nyon dbang gis sgyes phyin chad/ /sdug bsngal ma gtogs bde ba med/ /de phyir thar ba don gnyer dgos/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyes rlobs/ /ngan song gsum gyi gnas skyes na/ /sdug 346

bsngal yod pa smos ci dgos/ /lha mi'i gnas su skyes na yang / /ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal tsam med kyang / /de yi cha 'dra'i sdug bsngal mang / /dper na me ni che chung gnyis/ /gang gis bsregs kyang sdug bsngal bzhin/ /'khor ba'i gnas 'di'i mtho dman gar/ /skyes kyang sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig yin/ /mi la skyes pa'i sdug bsngal ni/ /ma yi mngal du gnas pa'i dus/ /mi gtsang dong du nyal ba 'dra/ /ma yis bza' btung tsha ba zhig /bsten na me dong lhung ba 'dra/ /ma yis bza' btung grang ba zhig /bsten na 'khyags sbubs gnas pa 'dra/ /ma de mchongs dang brgyugs pa na/ /g.yang la lhung 'dra'i sdug bsngal myong / /btsas dus pags pa bshus pa 'dra/ /stan la bzhag tshe tsher dong du/ /bskyur ba lta bu'i sdug bsngal dang / /ma yi pang du blangs pa'i tshe/ /bye'u phrug khra yis 'khyer ba 'dra/ /lte ba'i thag pa bcad pa'i dus/ /srog rtsa bcad 'dra'i sdug bsngal dang / /dro 'jam gon pa bskon na yang / /rma 'bras reg 'dra'i na tsha 'ong / /rdzong khug nang du bsnyal ba'i tshe/ /bkyigs nas btson dong 'phangs pa 'dra/ /'og na dri chus brlan pa'i stabs/ /mi bde ltogs skom lus 'khyags dang / /yan lag thams cad sprid nas na/ /'di byung nochad par mi shes ngu / /de phyir skye ba'i sdug bsngal ming / /med 347

pa'i thar ba don du gnyer/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mi la rgas pa'i sdug bsngal ni/ /drang bor skyes pa'i sgyu lus sgur/ /nag por skyes pa'i skra lo dkar/ /mkhur tshos khrag gi tshom bu yal/ /zas rnams bldad pa'i so rnams bud/ /lus la mi 'dod gnyer ma mang / /mig kyang mi gsal rab rib mthong / /rna bas mi thos go log go /lus stobs zad pas langs 'dug dka'/ /sems kyang mi gsal brjed ngas che/ /tsha grang bkres skom rkyen mi theg /yul mi khyem mtshes brnyas bcos byed/ /khyem tshang bza' bas 'chi ran zer/ /de phyir rgas pa'i sdug bsngal ming / /med pa'i thar ba don du gnyer/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing 348

grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mi la na ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ /glo bur nad gdon drag pos zin/ /nyin re'i mnar gcod bzod par dka'/ /langs 'dug mi thub mal du nyal/ /za tshod 'thung tshod sman pa dang / /nye 'brel rnams kyis bzung nas ni/ /yid 'ong zas dang skom gyi rigs/ /gnod kyis dogs nas ster mi 'gyur/ /yid du mi 'ong zas skom sman/ /gtar sreg rnams ni e phan snyam/ /mi 'dod bzhin du nan gyes byed/ /mo sman rim gro gang byas kyang / /gnod pa bskyal ba bzhin du 'gro/ /de phyir na ba'i sdug bsngal ming / /med pa'i thar ba don du gnyer/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mi la 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ /nad tshabs cher song mo sman dang / /rim gro byed rnams shub shub lab/ /rim pa bzhin du rang yul bsnyegs/ /gnyen bshes rnams kyis mtha' bskor nas/ /mchi ma phyung nas smre sngags 'don/ /la las/ shi dge dur 'debs sogs/ /shom ra byed dus 349

nad pa ni/ /bkrag mdangs nyams nas yi dwags 'dra/ /kha bskams mchu badzes mig gnyis kyang / /dong lhung dbugs phreng chad la nye/ /mgo mi theg cing lus mi theg /yar khyogs mar snyol mang bo zer/ /ldab ldib gtam gyis kha chems 'jog /gnyen bshes ngus tshe hrig trig blta/ /mig nas mchi ma re gnyis 'dor/ /grogs med gcig pur phyi mar 'gro/ /de phyir 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal ming / /med pa'i thar ba don du gnyer/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyis rlobs/ /gzhan yang mi yi sdug bsngal ni/ /mi mthun dgra dang phrad pa dang / /phrad kyis dogs pa'i sdug bsngal dang / /yid 'ong gnyen bshes bral ba dang / /'bral gyis dogs pa'i sdug bsngal dang / /phyugs la jag rkun gor la sogs/ /byung dang 'byung dogs sdug bsngal dang / /lo tog sad ser la sogs kyis/ /bcom dang bcom dogs sdug bsngal dang / /phyug pos rta nor lug gsum gyi/ /'tsho skyong mi thub sdug 350

bsngal dang / /dbul bos zas nor e rnyed phyir/ /khye bzhin nyul ba'i sdug bsngal dang / /zha long 'on pa lkugs pa dang / /bran g.yog 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal dang / /na tsha bkres skom 'thab rtsod dang / /gtugs gsher la sogs sdug bsngal mang / /de phyir mi yi sdug bsngal ming / /med pa'i thar ba don du gnyer/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyes rlobs/ /lha ma yin gyi sdug bsngal ni/ /lha yi longs spyod phun tshogs la/ /phrag dogs skyes nas lhar 'thab tshe/ /lha yi mtshon chas gnod mang bskyal/ /la la gson sreg byed pa dang / /chu la 'phen dang mgo bo gcod/ /snying 'don nang khrol rlug pa sogs/ /sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa myong / /las ka thams cad dmag la byed/ /sdug bsngal lan cig tsam ma yin/ /nyi ma re re bzhin du myong / /de phyir lha min sdug bsngal ming / /med pa'i thar ba don du gnyer/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas 351

skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyis rlobs/ /'dod lha rnams kyi sdug bsngal ni/ /'chi la nye dus lus mdangs nyams/ /stan la 'dug snying mi 'dod cing / /me tog phreng ba brnyings pa sogs/ /'chi ltas mang bo byung ba na/ /de rnams 'chi ltas yin par shes/ /'chi snyam sems sdug mang bo byed/ /phyi mar gar skye brtags nas shes/ /brtags tshe dmyal ba lta bu la/ /skye na skyes dang khyad med pa'i/ /sdug bsngal zhag bdun sogs myong la/ /lha yi zhag po nyung shos la/ /mi lo nyis brgya lnga bcu yod/ /sdug bsngal yun ring phyong nas 'chi/ /gzhan yang bsod nams che ba'i lha/ /chung bas mthong bas spa bkong dang / /stobs chen lha yis stobs chung lha/ /gnas nas gzhan yang bsgrod pa dang / /lha ma yin la 'thab pa'i tshe/ /sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong ba yin/ /gzugs khams gzugs med khams gnyis na/ /mngon gyur sdug bsngal med na yang / /sngon las 'phen pa zad pa na/ /'og tu ltung ba'i sdug bsngal yod/ /de phyir lha yi sdug bsngal ming / /med pa'i thar ba don du 352

gnyer/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyis rlobs/ /las dang nyon mongs rnam gnyis kyi/ /dbang du gyur nas 'di byed pa/ /thams cad 'du byed sdug bsngal yin/ /dper na tsha ba'i rma 'bras 'dra/ /'di yi thabs ni sna tshogs kyis/ /sdug bsngal du ma bskyed pas na/ /sdug bsngal gzhan gnyis bskyed byed kyi/ /rtsa ba 'du byed sdug bsngal yin/ /'gro 'dug bza' btung nyi ma dang / /grib ma ha cang bsten drags na/ /sdug bsngal bskyed pa la sogs pa/ /'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal zer ba yin/ /dper na rma 'bras chu bsil bas/ /btab na bar der bde snang yang / /'gyur nas sdug bsngal bskyed pa 'dra/ /mu ge'i thog tu nad yams dang / /mje yi thog tu phol mig dang / /grang nad thog tu tshad nad dang / /rgas pa'i thog tu na tsha gzhan/ /byung ba lta bu sdug bsngal gye/ /sdug bsngal yin pas 'gro ba drug /sdug bsngal gsum gyis mnar tshul la/ /bsams na 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /thams cad sdug bsngal phung 353

bor 'dug /de phyir sdug bsngal gsum gyi ming / /med pa'i thar ba don du gnyer/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyes rlobs/ /phung bo 'di yis rgas pa dang / /na dang 'chi ba la sogs pa/ /tshe 'di'i sdug bsngal kun gye snod/ /byed dang phyi ma'i sdug bsngal gyi/ /sna 'dren byed cing sdug bsngal gyi/ /sdug bsngal 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal gnyis/ /'di phyi gnyis shar 'dren par byed/ /phung bo grub na 'du byed kyi/ /sdug bsngal rtag tu 'grogs pas na/ /dper na khur chen zhig 'khur ba/ /ma phog bar du bde med bzhin/ /phung bo 'di dag ma bral bar/ /sdug bsngal ma gtogs bde ba med/ /de phyir sdug bsngal phung bo 'di/ /spangs nas thar ba don du gnyer/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i 354

bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyis rlobs/ /gzhan yang 'khor ba'i gnas 'di na/ /dgra rnams gnyen du 'gyur ba dang / /gnyen rnams dgra ru 'gyur 'gro bas/ /phan gnod byed la yid brtan med/ /skye ba 'phos nas dgra gnyen gnyis/ /go ldog ma zad tshe 'dir yang / /phan tshun 'gyur nas 'gro bar gda'/ /re zhig dgra yang mdza' bor 'gyur/ /de bzhin mdza' bo'ang dgra ru 'gyur/ /kha cig bar mar 'gyur ba dang / /bar ma de nyid dgra ru 'gyur/ /des na yid brtan mi rung bas/ /gnyen la chags pa don mi 'dug /sngon chad sems can gcig gis ma/ /byas nas nu zho 'thung ba de/ /bsags nas rgya mtsho chen po bzhi/ /de yi tshad tsam yod ces gsungs/ /de bzhin semase can thams cad kyis/ /ma byas nu zho 'thung ba de/ /gcig pu gzhal bar ga la nus/ /da yang tshe mjug 'di nyid la/ /thar ba'i btsan sa ma zin phyin/ /'khor ba'i gnas su yang 'khyams nas/ /de bas ches mang 'thung bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin lha yi bdud rtsi sogs/ /'khor ba'i bde ba ci tsam zhig /sngon chad spyad kyang ma tshims par/ /lhag par sred pa cher 'phel nas/ /bde ba de dag cha tsam la/ /'gran par mi phod sdug bsngal myangs/ /sngon dus yang yang dmyal ba yi/ /355

zangs zhun bskol ba gang 'thung ba/ /phyi yi rgya mtsho chen po la/ /de yi cha tsam yod pa min/ /sngon dus khye dang phag gyur nas/ /mi gtsang zos pa gang yin pa/ /dbus kyi ri yi rgyal po yi/ /tshad las shin tu lhag par 'gyur/ /sngon dus mdza' bshes rnams dang bral/ /'khor ba'i gnas su gang ngus pa/ /mig gi mchi ma'i thigs pa rnams/ /bsags na rgya mtsho las kyang mang / /sngon dus phan tshun rtsod pa'i phyir/ /mgo bo bcad pa gang yin pa/ /spungs na mtho tshad lha tshangs pa'i/ /'jig rten las kyang thal bar 'gyur/ /da yang thar ba'i btsan sa zhig /ma zin phyin chad 'khor ba'i gnas/ /yun ring 'khyams nas sdug bsngal myong / /de phyir 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ming / /med pa'i thar ba don du gnyer/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyes rlobs/ /sngon dus sems can re re'i lus/ /blangs nas dor ba'i rus pa rnams/ /ma god da lta yod na ni/ /lhun po'i tshad dang mnyam pa yod/ /lus thob pa la yid brtan 356

med/ /rang gi ma dang ma'i ma zhes/ /bgrang ba'i ched du sa chen po/ /rgya shug tshig gu tsam pa byas/ /bgrangs kyang sa yis lang mi 'gyur/ /de phyir sems can thams cad kyis/ /sngon dus rang gi ma rkyang ba/ /byas pa bgrangs na grangs mi chod/ /ma de rnams kyis mngal mi gtsang / /nang du nyal nas sdug bsngal myangs/ /sngon dus tshangs pa brgya byin dang / /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po sogs/ /'jig rten pa rnams mchod 'os su/ /gyur kyang lus kyi 'phen pa zad/ /slar yang 'khor ba'i yang bran 'gyur/ /mthon por gyur kyang yid brtan med/ /'chi dus gcig pur grogs med par/ /'jig rten pha rol 'gro dgos pas/ /'grogs pa'i grogs la yid brtan med/ /sngon dus rab lha'i bdud rtsi dang / /'bring ma'i nu zho 'thung ba dang / /tha ma mi gtsang khye lud dang / /khro chu khol ma la sogs pa/ /phyi yi rgya mtsho chen po las/ /mang ba 'thungs kyang bzang bos tshims/ chog shes ma byung ngan pa rnams/ /'thungs pas sun te zhen ma log /da bar myang ba des chog gi /da ni dal 'byor lus thob dus/ /'khor ba 'di la rgyab bstan nas/ /thar ba'i bde ba don du gnyer/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar 357

thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyis rlobs/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal myong ba'i rgyu/ /las nyon gnyis yin khyad par du/ /nyon mongs 'di nyid gtso bo yin/ /nyon mongs rtsa ba bdag 'dzin yin/ /bdag tu bzung ba la brten nas/ /bdag gzhan so sor ris su gcod/ /de ltar bcad pa la brten nas/ /rang gi phyogs la chags pa dang / /gzhan gyi phyogs la zhe sdang skye/ /de la brten nas nyon mongs pa/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong thams cad rgyas/ /nyon mongs dbang gis las bsags nas/ /sngon dus rigs drug so so'i lus/ /blangs nas sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa/ /da lta'i bar du myang ba yin/ /da yang nyon mongs 'di nyid la/ /dgra ru bltas nas ma spangs phyin/ /slar yang sngar bzhin las bsags nas/ /'gro ba rigs drug so so'i lus/ /blangs nas sdug bsngal myong bar nges/ /des na nyon mongs gang byung ba/ /dgra ru bltas nas spong bar gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/358

sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyis rlobs/ /thar ba'i bde ba don gnyer na/ /bslab pa gsum la bslab ngagos la/ /tshul khrims bslab pas nyon mongs pa/ /mngon gyur thams cad sun 'byen nus/ /ting 'dzin bslab pas nyon mongs pa/ /mngon gyur rnams kyi mgo gnon nus/ /shes rab bslab pas nyon mongs pa thams cad rtsa ba nas bcad de/ /'bras bu thar ba mya ngan las/ /'das pa thob par byed nus pas/ /shes rab bslab pa rang rgyud la/ /skye bar byed la sems las rung / /ting 'dzin bslab pa sngon 'gro dgos//ting 'dzin bslab pa rang rgyud la/ /skye bar byed pa de la yang / /sems ni g.yeng ba med pa'i phyir/ /tshul khrims bslab pa sngon 'gro dgos/ /'di gsum rgyud dang 'bras bu'i tshul/ /go rim ma log nyams blangs na/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las grol nas/ /thar ba'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla 359

ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'khor ba spyi yi nyes dmigs shes/ /srid pa mtha' dag me 'obs ltar/ /mthong nas nyon mongs sdug bsngal ba/ /nye bar zhi ba'i thar ba la/ /thob 'dod blo bsgyed bslab gsum la/ /bslab na 'khor ba las grol bas/ /thar ba thob nas 'khor ba'i gnas/ /slar yang ltung ba ma yin yang / /de tsam zhig gis chog snyam nas/ /mi chog dper na nag can zhig /btson du bzung nas btson dong las/ /thabs kyis bros nas thar na yang / /nor rdzas gang yang med pa bzhin/ /'khor ba'i gnas nas thar na yang / /skyon zad yon tan rdzogs pa yin/ /phyogs re ba yin rang gi don/ /yongs su rdzogs pa zhig byed na/ /skyon rnams kun zad yon tan kun/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob dgos la/ /gzhan yang dper na ma bu gnyis/ /me dong lhung na bu dong khar/ /thon pa'i thabs byas thon tsa na/ /a ma nang na gnas pa de/ /mi len yal bar dor gyur na/ /bu de shin tu khrel chung bzhin/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la spyod pa'i/ /sems can thams cad drin can ma/ /yin pas rang nyid thar ba tsam/ /don du gnyer nas thar tsa na/ /sems can 'khor bar gnas pa rnams/ /yal bar dor nas bsdad gyur na/ /de las 360

khrel chungagazhan na med/ /ma gyur sems can thams cad kyang / /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las sgol dgos/ /de ltar 'gro ba gzhan gyi don/ /byed kyang sangs rgyas thob dgos pas/ /des na rang gzhan 'tshengs pa yi/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang don du gnyer bar gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyis rlobs/ /sems can ngos nas bde ba 'dod/ /sdug bsngal mi 'dod mtshungs pas na/ /sems can 'ga' zhig nye bar bzung / /phan 'dogs gnod pa sel ba dang / /'ga' zhig ring bar bzung nas gnod/ /phan pa mi 'tshol ye mi rigs/ /rang gi ngos nas tshe 'khor ba/ /thog ma med nas da lta'i bar/ /sems can thams cad lan mang bor/ /bdag gi gnyen du ma gyur med/ /des na sems can gang la chags/ /sems can gang la sdang bar bya/ /snyam du nye ring chags sdang spongs/ /da lta'i pha ma spun zla sogs/ /yid du 'ong ba'i gnyen rnams kyis/ /tshe rabs sngon ma mang bo la/ /dgra ru gyur pa'i 361

grangs mi chod/ /dgra nam byas dus rang nyid la/ /mi 'dod gnod pa tshad med bskyal/ /da lta'i dgra sogs rang yid du/ /mi 'ong bas kyang tshe sngon dus/ /rang gi pha ma spun zla dang / /bu dang bu mo chung ma sogs/ /byas pa grangs kyis mi chod pas/ /byas dus phan pa tshad med btags/ /mi 'dod gnod pa rnams las bskyabs/ /des na dgra gnyen gang la yang / /nye ring chags sdang byed pa spongs/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyis rlobs/ /'khor ba thog ma ma mchis pas/ /bdag gi skye ba'ang thog ma med/ /yul 'dir ma skyes bya ba dang / /lus 'di ma blangs bya ba'ang med/ /sems can thams cad pha dang ma/ /phu nu sring mo la sogs pa/ /ma byas gcig med khyad par du/ /sems can re re'i mi'i rten la/ /bdag ma ma byas gcig kyang med/ /lan grangs mang bor ma byas pa/ /bgrangs na grangs kyis chod mi 'gyur//de yi rgyu mtshan sangs rgyas kyi/ /yum gyes sku tshe mang bo ru/ /ma byas gsungs shing gang zag gzhan/ /de yang 362

de ltar byas gsungs pa/ /sangs rgyas gsung la bslu ba med/ /des na sems can thams cad ma/ /yin la yin par shes par gyes/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun//gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku//drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyis rlobs/ /sems can rnams kyis ma byas dus/ /tshe 'di'i ma yis bskyangs pa bzhin/ /zla bcu'i bar du mngal du bzung / /btsas dus 'jam pa'i stan la bzhag /rab tu brtse bas lag tu blangs/ /'jam po sha yi drod la bslan/ /mngar ba'i nu zho yang yang blud/ /byams pa'i mig gis ngo tsho bltas/ /lo lo gces go sems rten 'dir/ /shog zer snyan pa'i ming nas bos/ /snabs ni khas phyis mi gtsang ba/ /lag pas dor nas chung dus bskyangs/ /cher song zas gos gang yod pa/ /rang gis spyad par mi phod kyang / /bu la dga' zhing spro bzhin byen/ /mdor na phan pa dpag med btags/ /gnod pa tshad med las bskyabs pas/ /sems can thams cad drin can yin/ /sngon tshe bdag gi ma byas pas/ /sems can rnams kyi lus srog kyang / /rang gi 363

don du dor ba mang / /dper na ltogs dus gang la yang zas byen pa la khyad med bzhin/ /tshe 'di'i ma dang tshe sngon mas/ /drin gyis bskyangs la khyad med par/ /des na 'gro kun drin can ma/ /yin la yin par shes par gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /ma gyur sems can thams cad kyis/ /yang yang drin gyes bskyangs lan du/ /rang gis drin gzo zhig byed dgos/ /sems can 'phral phugs bde skyid na/ /drin gzo med kyang skyon med mod/ /de ltar ma yin sems can rnams/ /gnas skabs mthar thug bde bas phongs/ /sdug bsngal du mas mnar ba la/ /drin gzo byed dgos drin gzo la/ /sems can thams cad 'khor ba las/ /bsgral nas thar ba'i go 'phang la/ /'god par bya'o snyam du sgoms/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang //mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla 364

ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyis rlobs/ /rang gi tshe 'di'i ma yis gtso/ /byas pa'i sems can thams cad la/ /zag med bde ba phar la zhog /zag bcas bde ba tsam yang med/ /bde ba 'dod na'ang bde ba'i rgyu/ /sgrub ma shes par sdug bsngal rgyu/ /bsgrubs pas bde ba med pa'i khar/ /sdug bsngal du ma'i rgyu gsog pa'i/ /ma gyur sems can bde ba dang / /bde rgyu ldan na ci ma rung / /sems can thams cad bde ba dang / /bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan gyur cig /sems can thams cad bde ba dang / /bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par bya/ /snyam du byams pa bsgom par gyes//glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs//byams pa bsgoms pa'i phan yon ni//lho phyogs 'dzam bu'i gling tsam la/ /byams pa bsgoms na der dbang ba'i/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por skye/ /gling gnyis bsgoms na der dbang ba'i/ /zangs kyi 'khor los sgyur rgyal 365

'gyur/ /gsum la bsgoms na der dbang ba'i/ /dngul gyi 'khor los sgyur rgyal 'gyur/ /gling bzhir bsgoms na der dbang ba'i//gser gyi 'khor los sgyur rgyal 'gyur//stong ni dang po gnyis pa la/ /bsgoms na der dbang bdag bor 'gyur/ /stong gsum po la bsgoms gyur na//de la dbang ba'i tshangs par 'gyur/ /sems can thams cad la bsgoms na/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par gsungs/ /des na sems can thams cad la/ /rgyun du byams pa bsgom par gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang //mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /dmyal ba'i tsha grang sdug bsngal rnams/ /myong ba'i 'gro kun snying re rje/ /yi dwags bkres skom sdug bsngal rnams/ /myong ba'i 'gro kun snying re rje/ /dud 'gro'i bkol spyod sdug bsngal rnams/ /myong ba'i 'gro kun snying re rje/ /mi yi skye rga na 'chi sdug /myong ba'i 'gro kun snying re rje/ /lha min 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal rnams/ /myong ba'i 'gro kun snying re rje/ /lha yi 'pho ltung sdug bsngal rnams/ /myong ba'i 'gro kun snying re 366

rje/ /ma gyur 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sdug bsngal gyi/ /rgyu dang bral na ci ma rung / /'gro kun 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dang / /sdug bsngal rgyu dang bral bar bya//snyam du snying rje bsgom par gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku//drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyis rlobs/ /snying rje bsgoms pa'i phan yon ni/ /snying rje chen po zhig skyes na/ /ma gyur sems can 'khor ba las//sgrol phyir dam bca' byed par nus/ /de ltar dam bcas pa de yang / /tshogs gnyis chen po ma bslabs par/ /mi 'grub mthong nas bya dka' ba'i/ /tshogs chen gsog la sems kyi dpa'/ /mi zhum nges par 'jug par nus/ /zhugs na ring bor mi thogs par/ /myur du tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs nas/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas thob nas theg dman bzhin/ /zhi bar mi gnas 'khor ba ni/ /ma stongs bar du rigs drug gi /'gro ba rnams kyi don mdzad pa'ang/ /snying rje chen po'i mthu yin no/ /dper na 'khor los sgyur rgyal gye//'khor lo rin 367

chen gang yod sar/ /dpung gi tshogs rnams yod pa bzhin/ /snying rje chen po gar yod der/ /sangs rgyas chos kun yod pa bzhin/ /srog gi dbang bo mchis gyur na/ /dbang bo gzhan rnams mchis pa bzhin/ /snying rje chen po mchis gyur na/ /byang chub sems dpa'i chos rnams kyang / /mchis par 'gyur zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ /snying rje rgyun du bsgom par gyes/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyes rlobs/ /'khor ba spyi dang ngan song gi /sdug bsngal bzod med myong ba yi/ /ma gyur sems can ma lus pa/ /sdug bsngal de dag thams cad dang / /bdag gis myur du bral bar bya/ /zag bcas lha mi'i bde ba dang / /zag med thar ba'i bde ba yis/ /phongs pa'i ma gyur sems can kun//bde ba phun sum tshogs pa dang / /bdag gis ldan pa zhig bya'o/ /snyam du lhag bsam bsgom par gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde 368

zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyes rlobs/ /da lta rang gis gzhan gyi don/ /byed pa phar zhog rang don yang / /ma grub 'dug pas sems can gzhan/ /don byed pa la 'tshang rgya dgos/ /rang don mthar phyin zhig byed na'ang / /sangs rgyas go 'phang thob dgos te/ /sangs rgyas sku la mtshan dpe ldan/ /rab mjes lta bas chog mi shes/ /gsung dbyangs snyan cing 'gro ba gzhan/ /so so'i skad du chos ston nus/ /thugs kyis shes bya thams cad mkhyen/ /thugs rjes 'gro la nye ring med/ /'phrin las 'bad med lhun grub pa'i/ /sgu gsung thugs kyi 'od zer re/ /spros kyang sems can dpag tu sked/ /sangs rgyas sa la 'god par nus/ /des na tshe 'di'i drin can ma/ /gtso byas sems can thams cad kyi/ /don du myur ba myur du bdag /sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par bya/ /snyam du smon pa sems bskyed gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i 369

bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyis rlobs/ /rang nyid thog mar sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang thob par byed pa'i thabs/ /sbyin sogs byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /bslab bya rnams la ma bslabs na/ /skyon rnams kun zad yon tan kun/ /ldan pa'i sangs rgyas mi thob par/ /mthong nas chags med sbyin gtong dang / /nyams med tshul khrims bsrung ba dang / /skyo med dge la brtson 'grus dang / /khro med bzod pa bsgom pa dang / /g.yeng med bsam gtan bsgom pa dang / /'chal med shes rab bskyed pa sogs/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ /bsam pa thag pas slob par bya/ /snyam du 'jug pa sems bskyed gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /phan yon sems bskyed byas pa na/ /bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /sras su gyur pas dgra bcom rnams/ /rigs gyi sgo nas zil gyis gnon/ /'jig rten lha dang 370

mi rnams kyi/ /phyag dang mchod pa'i gnas su 'gyur/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal bsrung ba yi/ /srung ma nyis 'gyur gyis ni bsrung / /gnyid bog myos dang bag med par/ /gyur kyang gnod sbyin mi ma yin/ /gnyug mar gnas pas gnod mi nus/ /yams dang 'go ba'i nad zhi bar/ /byed pa'i gsang sngags rigs sngags tshig /gang zag gzhan gyis ma grub pa'ang / /byang chub sems ldan gang zag gis/ /'grub par 'gyur na gang zag gzhan/ /rnams kyis 'grub pa smos ci dgos/ /de nyid gnas sar 'jigs pa dang / /mu ge mi min gnod pa rnams/ /mi 'byung sngar byung zhi bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas zhing khams ma lus pa/ /gang gi rin chen kyis bkang ste/ /'jig rten mgon la phul ba bas/ /gang gi lag gnyis thal mo sbyar/ /byang chub sems bskyed byas pa na/ /de ni khyad par 'phags zhes gsungs/ /rdo rje gdan la jo bo yis/ /skor ba mdzad cing ci byas na/ /sangs rgyas thob snyam dgongs pa na/ / sku gzugs chung bas che ba la /myur du sangs rgyas 'dod pa yi/ /gang la bslab zhes dris pa'i tshe/ /sku gzugs che bas byang chub kyi/ /sems la bslab par bya dgos gsungs/ /gasto la yi nam mkha' na/ /bud med rgan ma zhig 'dug par/ /gzhon ma zhig gis dris par yang / /lan yang 371

sngar ltar mdzad par skad/ /des na myur du 'tshang rgya sogs/ /byang chub sems kyi bsod nams la/ /gzugs su grub rgyu zhig yin na/ /nam mkha' la yang shong mi 'gyur/ /des na rgyun du sems bskyed gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyis rlobs/ /sems can ngos nas bya spyod ni/ /ci zhig 'dra yang rang ngos nas/ /sems can gcig kyang blos mi spong / /sems bskyed gong du 'phel phyir du/ /dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa sogs/ /tshogs gsog byed la brtson par bya/ /gzhan yang bla ma grogs sogs la/ /tha na ku re bzhad gad phyir/ /rdzun gyis mgo bskor byed pa dang / /dge ba byed pa'i gang zag la/ /'gyod pa bskyed dang theg chen la/ /zhugs dang byang chub sems dpa' la/ /zhe sdang dbang gis mi snyan pa'i/ /tshig smra ba dang g.yo sgyu sogs/ /sems bsgyed nyams pa'i rgyu rnams spangs/ /mchog dman bar ma gang la yang / /tha na bzhad gad phyir du yang / /shes bzhin rdzun tshig smra ba spongs/ /rang gis gdul bya 372

theg dman la/ /mi 'jug theg pa chen por 'jug /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la/ /ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed pa dang / /de dag bsngags pa phyogs bzhir brjod/ /sems can rab 'bring su la yang / /g.yo sgyu byed pa rtag tu spongs/ /bsam pa drang bor byed pa sogs/ /sems bskyed 'phel ba'i rgyu la slobs/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyis rlobs/ /rnyed bkur grags pa la sogs la/ /mi blta bsam pa bzang bo'i sgos/ /chos kyis phongs pa'i sems can la/ /dam chos ci shes ston pa dang / /gzhan gyis tshig don 'dri ba'i tshe/ /dga' zhing spro bzhin ci shes slobs/ /pha rol dam chos snod rung du/ /shes tshe gleng mo'i tshul gyis kyang / /de la thos bsam sgom gsum gyis/ /shes rab bskyed na ci tsam zhig /gzhan la bskyed pa de tsam gyis/ /skye ba phyi mar rang nyid la/ /shes rab skye bar 'gyur ba dang / /chos sbyin zang zing sbyin pa las/ /phan yon shin tu che bar gsungs/ /des na gzhan gye blor 373

'tsham pa'i/ /dam chos ston la 'bad par gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyis rlobs/ /rgyal po chom rkun la sogs pa'i/ /mi yi 'jigs pa stag dred dang / /dug sbrul bya dang gcan gzan sogs/ /mi ma yin pa'i 'jigs pa dang / /sa chu me rlung la sogs pa'i/ /'byung ba'i 'jigs pas nyen pa yi/ /sems can thams cad srog skyob gyis/ /tha na nyam chung 'bu srin yang / /chus 'khyer nyi ma mes 'tshig pa/ /mthong na de dag thabs mkhas kyis/ /'jigs pa de las skyob par mdzod/ /bskyabs na phyi mar rang nyid ni/ /'jigs bral bde ba thob par 'gyur/ /des na 'jigs pas nyen pa yi/ /sems can rab 'bring gang mthong yang / /'jigs las skyob la 'bad par gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/374

sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyes rlobs/ /kha lan snyan grags la sogs pa/ /re ba spangs te sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang 'thob phyir longs spyod kyis/ /bla ma dkon mchog mchod pa dang / /ngan slong rnams la sbyin gtong dang / /chos mdzad grogs la phan 'dogs sogs/ /ser sna med par gzhan dag la/ /gang 'os yo byad gtong bar gyis/ /gtong rgyu med dus bdag yid kyis/ /zas gos gser dngul nor bu sogs/ /mang bo sprul nas sems can la/ /byin pas phongs pa'i sems can gyis/ /'dzad med longs spyod thub par bsam/ /sbyin pa btang na gnas skabs su/ /bde skyid snyan gsum 'byung ba dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur/ /des na lus dang longs spyod la/ /chags pa med par gtong bar gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangasargyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mi dge bcu spong la sogs pa'i/ /ji 375

ltar khas blangs sdom pa rnams/ /mig 'bras bzhin du bsrung bar gyis/ /phyin drug la sogs dge chos rnams/ /rang gi rgyud la ma skyes pa/ /gsar du bskyed cing skyes zin pa/ /nyams pa med par gong 'phel thongs/ /rang gis tshul khrims srung ba'i sgos/ /sems can rnams kyang tshul khrims sogs/ /dge ba rnam par dag par sbyor/ /smin grol lam la 'god par gyes/ /tshul khrims bsrung ba'i phan yon ni/ /'bad dang rtsol ba ma byas kyang / /nyer mkho'i yo byad 'du ba dang / /stobs kyis sdigs pa med na yang / /sgye 'gro thams cad 'dud pa dang / /phan ma btags dang ngo mi shes/ /mis kyang ngang gis byams pa dang / /rkang rjes rdul yang lha dang mi/ /rnams kyis spyi bor len pa dang / /mchod pa'i zhing du 'khyer bar gsungs/ /bskal pa gaṅgā'i bye snyed du/ /zas skom rin po che yi gdugs/ /ba dan mar me phreng ba yis/ /sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig la/ /rim gro byas las sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan pa 'jig la nye dus 'dir/ /gang gis nyin mtshan gcig tsam la/ /tshul khrims bsrung ba bsod nams che/ /des na mi dge bcu spong sogs/ /tshul khrims nam yang mi gtang bar/ /mig bzhin bsrung la 'bad par gyes/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs 376

bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rang gi zhing khang nor rnams dang / /zas gos gang yang gzhan gyi mis/ /dngos su 'phrog gam 'phrog tu bcug /'jab bus brkus dang brku ru bcug /g.yar bo bcol bo g.yo thabs kyis/ /len dang sems la gnod pa'i tshig /ngan pa smra dang mtshang 'bru dang / /rdo mtshon dbyug pas brdung ba dang / /tha na nyes pa cung zad tsam/ /med par mgo bo gcod na yang / /sngon gyi las dang 'gro ba kun/ /drin can pha ma yin tshul dang / /khong khro skyes pa'i nyes dmigs dang / /bzod pa'i phan yon rnams bsams nas/ /khong khro skad cig tsam zhig kyang / /mi bskyed skye ba dug ltar du/ /spongs la gnod pa gang byas kyang / /lan du phan pa bsgrub par gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol 377

bar byin gyis rlobs/ /dper na nam zhig gdon gyis smyos/ /rang gis rang la brdeg pa dang / /bu dang bu mo la sogs la/ /rdo dang dbyug pas brdung ba dang / /tshig ngan smra ba sogs byas kyang / /a ma smyos pa shes bzhin du/ /bu dang bu mo gang yin yang / /lan du khro bar ga la rigs/ /mi khro tsam du ma zad par/ /gdon dang bral thabs byed pa bzhin/ /ma gyur sems can nyon mongs pa'i/ /gdon gyes spyos pas dbang ma thob la las gzhan la mi dga' ba'i/ /zhe sdang la sogs nyon mongs pa/ /skyes na rang nyid lcebs pa dang / /mtshon gyes 'debs dang g.yang la mchong //rang la gnod pa byed gyur na/ /gzhan la byed pa smos ci dgos/ /des na gzhan gyes gnod byas kyang / /ma gyur sems can nyon mongs pa'i/ /gdon gyis smyos pa shes bzhin du/ /rang nyid lan du khro mi rigs/ /lan du mi khro tsam ma zad/ /nyon mongs gdon gyis dbang med du/ /smyos pa'i ma 'di snying re rje/ /myur du nyon mongs gdon 'di dang / /bral bar gyur na ci ma rung / /bral bar gyur cig bral ba zhig /da ni bdag gis bya snyam du/ /dngos su pha rol nyon mongs pa/ /zhi ba'i phan 'dogs byed pa dang / /dngos su phan 'dogs ma thub na/ /yid kyis snying rje shugs drag bskyed/ /gtong len gnyis ka 378

mang bo gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rang la dbyug pa la sogs kyis/ /brdungs tshe dngos su gnod byed la/ /khro na dbyug par khro dgos te/ /brgyud pa ded na dbyug pa de/ / pha rol mi des rbad pa bzhin/ /pha rol mi de nyon mongs pa'i/ /gdon gyis dbang med rbad pas na/ /khro na pha rol mi'i rgyud kyi/ /nyon mongs pa la khro dgos soms/ /yang na rang gi sngon las kyis/ /pha rol mi de dbang med du/ /bskul ba yin pas khyod khro na/ /rang la khro dgos snyam du soms/ /da lta sdug bsngal phra mo tsam/ /mi bzod lan du khros gyur na/ /khong khro'i 'bras bu phyi ma la/ /mnar med dmyal ba'i me nang du/ /rang nyid lhung na ci zhig bya/ /cung zad tsam yang bzod par dka'/ /snyam du rang la brdeg pa dang / /tshig ngan sna tshogs smra na yang / /khro med bzod pa bsgom par gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /379

mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sgu/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyes rlobs/ /gzhan gyis rang la gnod byed tshe/ /gnod byed 'di yis thog med nas/ /bdag gi a ma grangs med byas/ /byas dus sdig sdug gtam ngan dang / /lus srog gang la ma 'jems par/ /bdag la phan pa grangs med byas/ /gnod pa tshad med pa las bskyangs/ /gnod byed 'di nyid drin can yin/ /bdag la brten nas gnod byed 'di'i/ /tshe sngon sdug bsngal myong bar nges/ /bdag gis 'di yi drin lan du/ /da lta gnod pa phra mo zhig /ci'i phyir mi bzod bzod dgos 'dug /snyam du khro med bzod pa bsgom/ /da lta kho rang nyon mongs pa'i/ /gdon gyis yid dkrugs smyos pa la/ /bdag gi sngon las ngan pas bskul/ /'di yis bdag la gnod byas nas/ /de yi 'bras bu phyi ma la/ /ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal 'di myong nges/ /bdag la brten nas 'di yis sngon/ /sdug bsngal sna tshogs yun ring myangs/ /da yang bdag la brten nas 'dis/ /phyi mar sdug bsngal myang bar nges/ /don la bdag la 'di nyid ni/ /gnod byed ma yin bdag 'di la/ /gnod byed nyid du song 'dug 380

pas/ /a kha shin tu snying re rje/ /'di la phan pa ci zhig bya/ /snyam du snying rje shugs drag bskyed/ /dngos su phan pa ci thogs dang / /yid kyis gtong len yang yang gyes/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zas gos gnas mal la sogs kyis/ /phongs dang na tsha la sogs pa/ /byung dus 'di nyid tshe rabs sngon/ /rang gis las ngan bsags pa yi/ /'bras bu da lta smin pa yin/ /dper na gsod dgos nag can zhig /sor mo bcad nas btang ba bzhin/ /mi yi sdug bsngal chung ngu 'di/ /tsam zhig myang ba la brten nas/ /phyi mar dmyal bar skye ba'i las/ /rnams kyang dag 'gro snyam du soms/ /mi 'dod sdug bsngal byung ba'i dus/ /bzod pa bsgoms na sngar byas kyi/ /sdig sgrib thams cad 'dag pa dang / /tshogs gsog pa la zhugs par soms/ /gnod byed 'di nyid drin re che/ /snyam du phan pa'i drin gzo gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos 381

dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyis rlobs/ /ma gyur sems can kun don du/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang thob pa'i phyir/ /dam pa'i lha chos sgrub pa'i dus/ /sdug bsngal gang zhig byung na yang / /bzod bsran bskyed pa la brten nas/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang thob pa la/ /shin tu nye bar 'gyur bas na/ /sdug bsnga' gang dang 'phrad pa'i tshe/ /dbu bo gter dang 'phrad pa bzhin/ /mi dga' byur du mi blta bar/ /dga' zhing spro ba dang bcas te/ /dang du blangs nas bzod bsran bskyed/ /sdug bsngal 'di nyid med na dga'/ /snyam du sdug bsngal mi 'dod na/ /phyin chad sdug bsngal rgyu spongs zhes/ /bskul ma byas par 'dug snyam du/ /mi dge sdig pa spong bar gyis/ /bde ba 'dod pa'i dus skabs su/ /bde ba 'dod na bde ba'i rgyu/ /tshogs gsog mdzod ces bskul mar 'dug /snyam du tshogs gsog ci thub gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/382

sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyes rlobs/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan dang / /gang zag chos kyi bdag med dang / / sangs rgyas byang sems rnams mthu dang / /legs spyad nyes spyad gnyis kyi rgyu/ /'bras bu 'dod dang mi 'dod dang / /thob bya byang chub thob thabs kyi/ /byang sems bslab pa'i lam rnams dang / /gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis sogs/ /dam pa'i lha chos de dag kun/ /ji ltar yin la nges rnyed nas/ /'dzin cing yang yang sems par gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyis rlobs/ /bzod pa bsgom pa'i phan yon ni/ /dgra dang 'byed pa mi mang zhing / /bde dang yid bde mang bar 'gyur/ /'gyod pa med par 'chi ba dang / /shi nas bde 'gror skye bar 'gyur/ /zhe sdang dug sbrul gsod pa la/ /bzod pa mkha' lding lta bu yin/ /gnod sems me chen gsod pa la/ /bzod pa 383

chu bo lta bu yin/ /tshig rtsub mda' yis mi phug par/ /bzod pa go cha lta bu yin/ /khyad par 'gro ba rnams kyi mig /yid rab 'phrog pa'i gser mdog can/ /mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa'i/ /mdzes pa'i gzugs mchog bsgrub pa la/ /bzod pa bzo bo mkhas pa 'dra//bzod pa'i phan yon brjod mi lang /des na bzod pa bsgom par gyes/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sems can don du sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang thob phyir bskal chen stong / /gcig la zhag tu byas pa yis/ /zhag po sum cu zla ba gcig /zla ba bcu gnyis lo byas pas/ /bskal chen grangs med 'bum phrag re//sems can gcig gi phyir du yang / /mnar med dmyal ba'i me nang du//gnas nas sangs rgyas bsgrub dgos kyang / /brtson pa nam yang mi 'dor bar/ /bya'o snyam pa'i go cha gyon/ /de 'dra'i go cha zhig gyon nas/zab dang rgya che'i dge ba'i chos/ /rang gi rgyud la sdud pa dang / /'gro ba gzhan yang dge la 'god/ /rang gzhan don gang bsgrub 384

na yang / /gnyid dang le lo dbang mi gtang / /skyo ngal med pa khyem pa yis/ /so nam byed pa lta bur gyis/ /gang la 'jug kyang dpa' mi zhum/ /dpa' bo g.yul du 'jug ltar gyes/ /bar mtshams med par gaṅgā sogs/ /chu bo chen po'i rgyun ltar gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /brtson 'grus byas pa'i phan yon ni/ /skyo med brtson 'grus che ba yis/ /mi thob mi 'grub gang yang med/ /'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das pa'i/ /dgos pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /ring bor mi thogs sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang myur du thob pa 'ang / /brtson 'grus mthu la rag las pas/ /des na sngon byon mi la sogs//dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /thos bsam sgom gsum gang gi dus/ /brtson 'grus me ltar sbar bar gyes/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/385

sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyis rlobs/ /tshe blos btang nas sa bzang zhing / /grogs bzang yid mthun dben gnas su/ /tshul khrims rnam par dag par gnas/ /skye bo mang bo 'grogs 'dris dang / /'dod 'dun rnam rtog rags pa spangs/ /'dod chung chog shes la gnas nas/ /bde ba'i stan la lus kyi gnad/ /rnam snang chos bdun legs par bca'/ /mdun du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /byon nas mngon sum bzhugs par mos/ /de la shes pa rtse gcig tu/ /gtod la rgyun du ma brjed par/ /yid la thu re dran par gyis/ /brjed ma thag nas sngar ltar bsgom/ /de ltar yang yang gsal btab nas/ /bsgoms na skabs skabs sangs rgyas kyi/ /sku de yid ngor mngon sum du/ /bzhugs pa lta bu'i nyams 'char gsungs/ /rang sems bzhag na ri ltar brtan/— btang na dmigs pa kun la 'jug /lus sems las rung bde chen ni/ /ma skyes bar du bsgom par gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog /386

sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sgu/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyes rlobs/ /phan yon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /rjes su dran pa yin pas na/ /bsod nams mtha' yas 'thob par 'gyur/ /sems can lus la dga' bde rgyas//mthong chos bde bar gnas pa dang / /dge ba'i dmigs pa gang la yang / /rang sems bkod du rung ba dang / /dbang med phyin ci log yul la/ /g.yeng bar 'gyur ba kun zhi nas/ /nyes spyod chen po mi 'byung zhing / /dge ba gang byas stobs chen dang / /zhi gnas brtan na mngon shes dang / /rdzu 'phrul sogs kyang bsgrub par nus/ /khyad par zhi gnas la brten nas/ /lhag mthong rtogs pa skye sla bas/ /'khor ba'i rtsa ba gcod nus pa/ /la sogs phan yon yod pa'i tshul/ /soms la ting 'dzin bsgom par gyes/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sgu/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyis rlobs/ /phung bo lnga bo 'di'i steng du/ /rtog pas 387

btags tsam ma yin pa'i/ /nga zhig grub na phung bo dang / /gcig tu grub bam tha dad grub/ /gcig tu grub na phung bo bzhin/ /nga yang mang bor 'gyur dgos la/ /yang na nga gcig yin pa bzhin/ /phung rnams cha med gcig tu 'gyur/ /nga dang nga yi phung bo zhes/ /so sor phye nas ming btags pa/ /de yang don med nyid du thal/ /phung bo lnga dang gcig ma yin/ /tha dad yin na phung bo lnga/ /re re byas nas bsal shul na/ /nga kho 'di zhes bstan rgyu dgos/ /de ltar dpyad pas nga med pa'i/ /nges shes lhang gis skyes pa na/ /nges shes rgyun de bying rgod dang / /bral bar rtse gcig skyong bar gyis/ /gzhan yang sha rus gdos bcas kyi/ /yan lag lnga bo 'tshogs tsam gyis/ /lus 'di'i steng du rtog pa yis/ /btags tsam ma yin tshugs thub tu/ /grub pa'i lus po zhig yod na/ /yan lag lnga bo 'di nyid dang / /gcig tu grub bam tha dad grub/ /gcig tu grub na yan lag bzhin/ /lus kyang du ma yod par 'gyur/ /yan lag lnga dang gcig ma yin/ /tha dad grub na yan lag rnams/ /bsal ba'i shul na lus 'di zhes/ /ston rgyu yod dgos de mi 'dug /des na lus zhes ming tsam min/ /gtan nas med snyam nges shes drongs/ /mdor na nga dang phung bo dang / /ri dang khang khyim la sogs pa/ /'khor 388

'das chos rnams ma lus pa/ /rtog pas btags tsam ma yin par/ /rang ngos grub pa rdul tsam yang / /med par nges pa'i nges shes dang / /rgyun de skyong ba mnyam gzhag ni/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i skyong tshul lo/ /rjes thob dus su gang snang yang / /bden med rdzun pa rmi lam dang / /sgyu ma lta bu'i rnam rol tu/ /'char ba dag la bslab par gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs//phan yon stong nyid gtam tsam yang go na thar ba'i sa bon 'jog /chos rnams thams cad stong mi stong / /snyam du je tshom tsam zos kyang / /srid pa hrul bor byed par 'gyur/ /khams gsum sems can thams cad la/ /gang gis ji srid 'tsho yi bar/ /'tsho ba'i yo byad du mas tshogs/ /bsags las gang gis stong ba nyid/ /thun gcig bsgoms pa bsod nams che/ /yun ring bsgoms na smos ci dgos/ /khang stong mun pa lo stong tsam/ /song bar mar me gcig btegs na/ /skad cig nyid la sel ba bzhin/ /bskal pa grangs med bsags 389

pa'i sdig /stong nyid rtogs na lhag med 'dag /yun ring bsgoms na spyan mngon shes/ /rju 'phrul dpag med thob pa dang / /myur du byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /des na stong nyid thugs dam gyi/ /mthil du bzung nas bsgom par gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku//drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /gzhan don byed na sems can la/ /mkho ba byen nas 'khor du bsdu/ /de nas bzhin ras dga' zhing 'dzum/ /bzhin du 'tshams 'dri la sogs pa'i/ /'jig rten tshul dang mthun pa yi/ /snyan tshig smras nas dga' bar gyis/ /de nas dad dang tshul khrims dang / /thos pa gtong ba la sogs pa'i/ /'phral phugs phan dang bde ba'i thabs/ /chos kyi snyan tshig brjod par gyes/ /de skad smras pas dge phyogs la/ /pha rol spro tshe rang rang dang / /'tsham pa'i dge ba byed du 'jug /gzhan la bstan bzhin rang nyid kyang / /de dang mthun par spyod par gyis/ /de ltar thabs mkhas sgo nas gzhan/ /gdul bya mngon 390

mtho nges legs kyi/ /go 'phang 'god la 'bad par gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /phar phyin theg pa'i lam tsam la/ /brten na bskal pa grangs med gsum/ /sogs kyi bar du mgo rkang lag /gtong ba la sogs bya dka' ba'i/ /spyod pa spyad nas sangs rgyas dgos/ /dus ring bo dang lam gyi tshogs/ /che ba de 'drar mi ltos par/ /lam de da lta snyigs dus kyi/ /tshe thung gcig la brtson 'grus can/ /sangs rgyas thob pa gsang sngags yin/ /rang gi ngos nas sems can gcig /tsam gyi sdug bsngal bsal phyir du/ /bskal par dmyal bar gnas nus pa'i/ /go cha brtson 'grus yod na yang / /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gyis/ /mnar ba'i tshul la bsam pa'i tshe//de ring tsam yang rang nyid kyis/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang thob dgos te/ /ci'i phyir zhe na sangs rgyas nas/ /skad cig re la sdug bsngal gyis/ /mnar ba'i sems can dpag tu med/ /sdug bsngal de las sgol bar nus/ /391

des na thun mong lam gyis rgyud/ /sbyang ba sngon du legs btang ste/ /phar phyin theg pa'i ring lam de/ /gcig pu tsam la mi zhen par/ /myur lam rdo rje theg pa'i sgor/ /bde blag nyid du 'jug par gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyes rlobs/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma la/ /bsnyen bkur bka' bzhin sgrub pa sogs/ /'bad pa du mas mnyes par byas/ /gsang sngags smin byed dbang bskur zhus/ /dbang dus ji ltar khas blangs pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa bsrung tshul rnams/ /shes par byas nas nyams med srungs/ /de nas grol byed bskyed rdzogs dang / /khyad par zab lam rdzogs pa che/ /lo dang zla ba'i bar du 'khrid/ /gnad rnams ji bzhin legs rtogs nas/ /dam pa'i byen rlabs dben pa'i gnas/ /na bun dngul mdog rked la 'khril/ /ri dwags du mas rtse bro brdung / /bya rnams dga' bas 'phur lding g.yo/ /nyams dga' mthun rkyen thams cad tshang / /'gal rkyen med pa zhig tu song / /bla 392

ma'i gsung bzhin yid gnyis dang / /the tshom med par bsgrub par gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog /ces pa 'di rnams byang chub lam gyi rim pa shar sgom byas dus shig tu smras pa'o//rje dam pa gong ma rnams la 'dud/ /sems skyo ba skye bar byen gyis rlobs/ /lugs gnyis kyis phan btags grwa slob kyis/ /dus deng sang bla mar sgo skur 'debs/ /chos mnyam du nyan pa'i grogs rnams kyis/ /dus deng sang phan tshun ngan smra brjod/ /phar phan btags gnyen dang yon bdag gis/ /dus deng sang tshur la 'khon tsho byed/ /khong dam pas gcig gis gcig bstod pa/ /dus deng sang chos pa 'gran thub lta/ /rgyud 'dul tshul dam chos bshad pa rnams//dus deng sang kha bshad mkhan zer 'phya/ /kha kha rog ting 'dzin sgom pa rnams/ /dus deng sang bying bas non tsho zer/ /chos snying bo yig drug bgrang ba de/ /dus deng sang dman dman zhig tu byed/ /chos bar chad 'du long mang ba de/ /dus deng sang bsod nams can du grags/ /tshe blos btang 'phags nor gsog pa de/ /dus deng sang rang mdo med par sems/ /tshe 'di yi yo byad gsog pa 393

de/ /dus deng sang rang mdo can du byed/ /khong mkhas btsun dman sa 'dzin pa de/ /dus deng sang kun gyes brnyas bcos byed/ /g.yo sgyu byed sdig la mi 'jem pa/ /dus deng sang kun gyis spyi bor 'khur/ /tshe 'di yi bya bzhag byed pa de/ /dus deng sang phan sems can du byed/ /tshogs ming btags kha lan byed pa de/ /dus deng sang chos kyi mchog tu byed/ /chos phyir du dka' ba spyod pa de/ /dus deng sang snying rje'i yul du byed/ /rtsa bzhi yi sdom pa nyams pa tshos/ /dus deng sang gzhan ngor chab tsho len/ /dgon dge 'dun nang khrims bsdams pa de/ /dus deng sang rgan pa gong mas bshig /chos thos bsam byas nas mi bsgom par/ /dus deng sang mkhas pa grong chog byed/ /tshe phyi mar phan pa'i chos mi dgos/ /dus deng sang bza' btung yod pas chog /spun shi tshe e 'chi bltas yod bzhin/ /dus deng sang ser mo skya sar 'bab/ /dbang zab mo rjes gnang nor phyir du/ /dus deng sang bla mas brgya stong byed/ /dgon nang chen rnams dang grwa shag na/ /dus deng sang bud med skung sa mang / /bsgom thos bsam gang yang mi byed par/ /dus deng sang bya btang gnas skor byed/ /gnas dben par sgrub pa lhur len pa/ /dus deng sang nyin par skar ma tsam/ /bsgom byas kyin bla mar rtogs 394

'bul ba/ /dus deng sang ming yang med par gyur/ /don de phyir mi nga dben gnas su/ /rje gong ma'i rnam thar skyong du 'gro/ /gzhan skal ldan yod na dben par shog /rje gong ma'i rnam thar mnyam du skyong //dus snyigs ma'i mi rnams bya spyod la//sems skyo ba skyes nas glu 'di blangs/ /gang thos tshad rnams kyis snyigs dus kyi/ /bya spyod pa ngan pa 'dor bar shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis sems la skyo shas than thun skyes pa'i dus shig tu sbyar ba'o//'dul rgyu'i dgra yang med la/ /skyong rgyu'i gnyen yang med par/ /phyogs med ri khrod 'grim pa'i/ /chos pa rnams kyi skyid la/ /phar bltas dpon po med la/ /tshur bltas g.yog po me da par/ /phyogs med ri khrod 'grim pa'i/ /chos pa rnams kyi skyid la/ /gar song rtsad gcod med la/ /'dir shog zer mi med par/ /phyogs med ri khrod 'grim pa'i/ /chos pa rnams kyi skyid la/ /'dug na las rgyu med la/ /'gro na lus rgyu med par/ /phyogs med ri khrod 'grim pa'i/ /chos pa rnams kyi skyid la/ /gsal 'debs be'u bum zhig khur/ /sba dbyug phyag tu bsnams nas/ /phyogs med ri khrod 'grim pa'i/ /chos pa rnams kyi skyid la/ /phyag bdar khrod kyi gos 'chang / /bza' btung slong mor brten nas/ /phyogs med ri khrod 'grim pa'i/ /chos pa rnams 395

kyi skyid la/ /smug pa can gyi ri na/ /sgom thag khor cig gyon te/ /ting nge 'dzin la zhugs pa'i/ /chos pa rnams kyi skyid la/ /na na 'dri mi med la/ /shi na ngu mi med par/ /ri dwags lta bur 'chi ba'i/ /chos pa rnams kyi skyid la/ /tshe mjug 'di la de 'dra'i/ /skal ba bdag la byung na/ /tshogs drug rang grol dga' ba/ /tshogs drug rang grol skyid pa/ /zhes pa 'di yang nyin zhig sems la shar ba ltar bris pa'o// —sngon med ded dpon chen po/ /kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams/ /rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa/ /rgyal dbang lnga ba gsum gyis/ /rmad byung mkhyen rab gru bzung / /mdo rgyud rgya mtshor zhugs nas/ /mkhas grub klu dbang bye ba'i/ /zhabs la legs par gtugs nas/ /klong chen rab 'byams bzang bos/ /mdzod bdun shing rta rnam gsum/ /kun mkhyen blo bzang grags pas/ /lam rim sngags rim chen mo/ /rgyal dbang lnga ba chen pos/ /lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung / /rdzogs chen rig 'dzin zhal lung / /yid bzhin nor bu blangs nas/ /phyi rabs bod khams yongs la/ /brtse bas 'jog pa mdzad pa/ /bskal brgyar bsod nams bsags pa/ /ma gtogs 'phrad par dka' ba'i/ /skye dgu'i 'dod don kun skongs/ /396

gdams pa'i nor bu 'di la/ /da lta phrad pa rnams kyis/ /dad gus rgyal mtshan rtser zhog /thos bsam sgom pa'i mchod bstod/ /gsol ba rgyun du thobs dang / /mchog dang thun mong gnyis kyi/ /dgos 'dod ma lus 'byung nges/ /zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//na mo gu ru/ 'o 'o mtshan ldan bla ma'i gsung la/ /a'u nam yang bslu ba med ya/ /kho re ci gsungs bka' bzhin sgrubs dang //he te blo bde dpal yin e go /o ya yi/ /e ya ya/ /'o 'o dal 'byor mi lus brten nas/ /a'u sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob ya/ /kho re thob thabs lha chos gyis dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /o ya yi/ /e ya ya/ /'o 'o 'che nges nam 'chi cha med/ /a'u do nub yin rung 'chi ya/ /kho re myur du lha chos mdzod dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /o ya yi/ /e ya ya/ /'o 'o 'khor ba'i btson dong nang na/ /a'u nam yang bde ba med ya/ /kho re thar ba'i grong khyer snyogs dang //he he blo bde dpal yin e go /o ya yi/ /e ya ya/ /'o 'o thar ba'i gnas su 'khrid pa'i/ /a'u lam mkhan dkon mchog yin ya/ /kho re ma gtong thu bar 'jus dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /o ya yi/ /e ya ya/ /'o 'o 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i 'gro kun/ /397

a'u drin can pha ma yin ya/ /kho re byams dang snying rje sgoms dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /o ya yi/ /e ya ya 'o 'o 'gro kun 'khor ba'i gnas nas/ /a'u sgrol la 'tshang rgya dgos ya/ /kho re byang chub sems bzang skyed dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /o ya yi/ /e ya ya/ /'o 'o rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob thabs/ /a'u dam pa'i lha chos yin ya/ /kho re rtag tu lha chos gyis dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /o ya yi/ /e ya ya/ /'o 'o btsal na sems kyi gnas lugs/ /a'u nam mkha' lta bu yin ya/ /kho re ngang du glod la zhog dang / /he te blo bde dpal yin e go /o ya yi/ /e ya ya/ /'o 'o gang snang chos rnams ma lus/ /a'u rang bzhin grub pa med ya//kho re sgyu ma lta bur ltos dang / /dhe he blo bde dpal yin e go /o ya yi/ /e ya ya/ /'o 'o dam chos bdud rtsi gsol dus/ /a'u glu dbyangs blangs na spro ya/ /kho re snyan pa'i glu chung longs dang / /he te blo bde dpal yin e go /o ya yi/ /eyaya/ /zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis sbyar ba'o//na mo gu ru/ tshogs drug rang grol/ /bsten sar bsten dgos/ /bla ma bsten dgos/ /spong sar spong dgos//grogs ngan spong dgos//gtong sar gtong dgos/ /tshe blos gtong dgos/ /398

len sar len dgos/ /sgrub brgyags len dgos/ /'gro sar 'gro dgos/ /dben par 'gro dgos/ /'dug sar 'dug dgos/ /mal nas 'dug dgos/ /yangs sar yangs dgos/ /lta ba yangs dgos/ /dog sar dog dgos/ /spyod pa dog dgos/ /che sar che dgos/ /yon tan che dgos/ /chung sar chung dgos/ /nyon mongs chung dgos/ /sgrub sar bsgrub dgos/ /rang don bsgrub dgos/ /byed sar byed dgos/ /gzhan don byed dgos/ /dgos so snyam na//sems la zungs ya//na mo gu ru bhya/ bla ma'i byen gyis rlobs/ /tshogs drug rang grol ya/ /phan pa'i glu dbyangs longs/ /snang srid sems su shes/ /sems nyid stong bar rtogs/ /rtogs pa phyogs 'dzin med/ /lta ba'i mthar thug yin/ /ma yengs rtsi yis bzung / /ma bcos ngang la bzhag /dmigs gtad der 'dzin med/ /sgom pa'i mthar thug yin/ /mi mthun lam du byas/ /mthun yul zhen pa bcad/ /blang dor dgag sgrub med/ /spyod pa'i mthar thug yin/ /ci byung bden med shes/ /bzang ngan spang blang med/ /gal med byung rgyal gtong / /gegs sel mthar thug yin/ /snang ba ban bun song / /'khrul ba shag shig zhig /zhen pa rang log song / /drod rtags mthar thug yin/ /las nyon ma rig sangs/ /399

chos sku'i rang sa zin/ /gzugs sku'i gzhan don mdzad//'bras bu'i mthar thug yin/ /'di yang glu ba ngas/ /blangs nas dben par song / /thos tshad thams cad kyi/ /sems la phan par shog/bla ma chos kyi rgyal pos/ /bdag gzhan blo kha chos sgyur/ /nyon dang tshogs drug rang grol/ /da lta snyigs ma'i dus su/ /che sa 'dzin pa'i dus min/ /dman sa 'dzin pa'i dus yin/ /'khor g.yog bsten pa'i dus min/ /dben pa bsten pa'i dus yin/ /slob ma spel ba'i dus min/ /nyams rtogs spel ba'i dus yin/ /tshig phyir 'brang ba'i dus min/ /don la bsam pa'i dus yin/ /'gro bsdad mang ba'i dus min/ /sa gcig sdod pa'i dus yin/ /chos bshad byed pa'i dus min/ /sgrub pa byed pa'i dus yin/ /min dang yin drug glu 'di/ /e go tshogs drug rang grol/ /dge 'dis 'gro ba ma lus/ /sangs rgyas thob par gyur cig/dpal ldan bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag gzhan smin cing gro' bar byen gyes rlobs/ /dam chos nyi ma shar 'dra'i sgor zhugs nas/ /mngon spyod ngan las byed pa ngo re tsha /'jig rten mgon po'i spyan sngar khas blangs nas/ /lkog tu nag chang bsten pa ngo re tsha/ /bla med byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ /gzhan la skur ba 'debs pa ngo re tsha/ /phung bo mi 400

gtsang rgyan gyes rab brgyan nas/ /legs 'dod bye dor byed pa ngo re tsha/ /zeg pa chen po yin zhes khas blangs nas/ /shes rab snying rje bral ba ngo re tsha/ /gsang sngags zab mo'i chos kyi sgor zhugs nas/ /khas blangs dam tshig nyams pa ngo re tsha ngo re tsha ba drug gi glu dbyangs 'di/ /bya btang chogs drug rang grol blangs nas song //sdug bsngal rtsa ba 'khor 'dab rgyas pa la/ /dga' zhing brtse gdung che ba 'di yang glen/ /phung bo mi rtag chu bur lta bu la/ /lhag par bkur ste byed pa 'di yang glen/ /nor rdzas rtswa kha'i zil ba lta bu la/ /rtag par re nas gsog pa 'di yang glen/ /shi nas ngan 'gror mi skye gdeng med par/ /tshe 'di 'ba' zhig byed pa 'di yang glen/ /sdug bsngal phran tshegs mi bzod ngan song gi /sdug bsngal bzod du re ba 'di yang glen/ /zab la rgya che'i chos la mi spyod par/ /'dod don dkor la rngams pa 'di yang glen/ /glen pa drug gi glu dbyangs chung ngu 'di/ /tshogs drug rang grol zhes byas blangs nas song //gzhan las rang nyid lhag par bya ba'i phyir/ /mdo sngags chos la thos pa bya ba log /rnyed pa snyan dang grags pa byung du re/ /gzhan la chos bshad byed pa 'di yang log /gzhan gyes 401

rang la bsnyen bkur 'ong du re/ /so thar sdom pa bsrung ba 'di yang log /rgyal khams mang bo bdag gi dbang du bsdu/ /snyam nas sbyin pa gtong ba 'di yang log /drag pos 'gro ba gzhan zhig 'phung snyam nas/ /yi dam lha bsnyen byed pa 'di yang log /rang nyid bde zhing skyid po 'ong du re/ /gzhan la gnod pa byed pa 'di yang log /log pa drug po shes pa'i glu chung 'di/ /tshogs drug rang grol rang dgar blangs nas song / /mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po dang / /blo bzang grags pa yab sras sogs/ /sngon byon dam pa rnams la 'dud/ /bdag gzhan sgo gsum byin gyis rlobs/ /sdod sa'i khang chen rgya che phub/ /rgyu nom ka cha'i gsog rum byas/ /dge slong yin zhes ma smra zhig /smras na rgyal sras thugs mi mnyes/ /rta nor ra lug mang bo bsdus/ /'tsho skyong khyem pa 'dra ba byas/ /dge slong yin zhes ma smra zhig /smras na rgyal sras thugs mi mnyes/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba nyams pa dang / /nyams kyis dogs nas sdug bsngal byas/ /dge slong yin zhes ma smra zhig /smras na rgyal sras thugs mi mnyes/ /tshe 'di'i 'dod pa shin tu che/ /gnod sems sogs dang ma bral bar/ /dge slong yin zhes ma smra zhig /smras na rgyal sras thugs mi mnyes/ /'jig rten pa dang lhan cig bsdad/ /long gtam 402

mang bos nyin mtshan 'das/ /dge slong yin zhes ma smra zhig /smras na rgyal sras thugs mi mnyes/ /gnod pa phra mo'ang mi bzod cing / /phan 'dogs phra mo'ang byed mi nus/ /dge slong yin zhes ma smra zhig /smras na rgyal sras thugs mi mnyes/ /mi mnyes drug gi glu dbyangs 'di/ /tshogs drug rang grol blangs nas song / /glu 'dis dge slong thams cad kyi/ /rgyad la phan thogs 'byung bar regab/ ra legs pa'i gdams pa mi 'tshol bar/ /log pa'i mthu dpe 'tshol ba 'khrul/ /ri khrod dgon pa mi 'grim par/ /grong du rgyug skor byed pa 'khrul/ /gcig pur sgom sgrub mi byed par/ /'khor ngan nang du chos 'chad 'khrul/ /chags med sbyin pa mi gtong bar/ /lag tu gang byung gsog pa 'khrul/ /dam pa'i lha chos mi byed par/ /'jig rten mi chos byed pa 'khrul/ /grogs bzang kha la mi nyan par/ /grogs ngan ngag bzhin byed pa 'khrul/ /'khrul ba drug po shes pa'i glu/ /tshogs drug rang grol blangs nas song //dngos grub 'byung gnas bla ma yin/ /'gro kun drin can pha ma yin/ /ri khrod bde ba'i zhing khams yin/ /snang srid sgyu ma rmi lam yin/ /sems nyid rtogs na sangs rgyas yin/ /'di phyi'i 403

bde thabs lha chos yin/ /mi chos ma spangs chos pa min/ /so nam ma spangs rab byung min/ /'dod pa ma spangs dge slong min/ /phan sems med na bla ma min/ /bya ba ma btang sgom chen min/ /dmar chog byed na sngags pa min/ /yin min drug gi glu dbyangs 'di/ /tshogs drug rang grol blangs nas song //chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /nyon dang tshogs drug rang grol ba/ /snying nas thar ba don gnyer na/ /'phags pa'i rigs bzhir gnas pa dgos/ /'phags pa'i rigs bzhi gang yin na/ /chos gos ngan ngon tsam gyis chog /bsod snyoms ngan ngon tsam gyis chog /mal cha ngan ngon tsam gyes chog /yo byad ngan ngon tsam gyis chog /bzhi bo 'di yin 'di bzhi la/ /gnas pa'i gang zag de'i rgyud la/ /byang chub phyogs kyi chos kun gnas/ /'phags pa'i rigs bzhir mi gnas pa'i/ /rgyud la 'khor ba ngan song rgyu/ /mi dge sdig pa thams cad gnas/ /des na tshe 'di blos thongs la/ /'phags pa'i rigs bzhir gnas par gyis/ /gnas na lha chos skal bar ldan/ /rang dang thos tshad dad can rnams/ /'phags pa'i rigs bzhir gnas par shog /chos rgyal zhabs pad la gus pas 'dud do/ /rjes 'jug 404

slob bu la thugs rjes gzigs shig /'jig rten chos brgyad la dga' sdug ma byed/ /sdig pa'i grogs po la phyi thag ma ring / /nye du 'brel ba la gdung sems ma che/ /bla ma dkon mchog la dad gus ma chung / /lus dang longs spyod la chags zhen ma che/ /thos bsam sgom gsum la brnag pa ma chung / /rnyed bkur 'du 'dzi la zur bstod ma byed/ /nyams len dka' thub la sdug bsran ma chung / /'khor ba sdug bsngal la bde bar ma 'dzin//ma gyur 'gro ba la snying rje ma chung / /chos kun sgyu mar ltos bden par ma 'dzin/ /rang sems sangs rgyas yin gzhan du ma 'tshol/ /glu dbyangs 'di nyid kyis rang la phan zhing / /thos tshad rnams la yang phan par gyur cig /chos rgyal ngag dbang wang zhabs la gus pas 'dud/ /rang gzhan thams cad la phan pa'i glu dbyangs len/ /rang nyid kha zhan gyis dogs nas sde rer 'ju/ /'dre yis 'khyer kyis dogs khro bo'i bsnyen pa byas/ /nam phugs ltogs kyis dogs gsog 'jog mang bo byed/ /gtam ngan phog gis dogs tshul 'chos spyod pa byed/ /de tsho'i gseb nas chos byas nas 'tshang rgya bar/ /'dod de des mi 'ong dper na lug gcig bshas/ /pags pa rkyal ba gcig brang sha spu 'byar gcig /de gnyis 'dod na yang 405

'ong ngam bsam blo thongs/ /su yis gnod bskyal kyang de la lan ma byed/ /bzod pa sgoms shig dang sde re ra 'ju mi dgos/ /'dre yis glags 'tshol du byung yang lus srog 'drer/ /byen la bdag 'dzin thongs drag sngags bzla mi dgos/ /lto rgyab gnyis med kyang blo phugs chos la gtod/ /chos phugs sprang la gtod sprang phugs 'chi ba la/ /gtod dang dad can gyes mchod gnas byed pa yin/ /sog rum bya mi dgos 'phya smod ci byung yang / /zol zog med par gyis mjug tu thams cad kyi/ /yid du 'ong ba yin tshul 'chos bya mi dgos/ /mdor na tshe 'di dang chos gnyis ma bsres par/ /chos dang ci mthun gyis ci bsam 'grub par nges/ /glu dbyangs 'di nyid kyang tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /rang gzhan thams cad kyi rgyud la phan par shog /pha chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /sprang 'dod pa zad par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe 'di phyi'i sdug ba sngal ma lus pa /tshe 'di yi 'dod pa bsgrubs pas lan/ /da tshe 'di'i 'dod pa'i bsgrub bya skyur/ /tshe 'di yi bsgrub bya che tsa na/ /sems mi bde yar mar 'gro rgyu mang / /de mang na sdig sdug gtam ngan gsum/ /rang mi 'dod bzhin du thog tu 'ong / /don de phyir 'dod pa'i blo ma mang / /'di spang dgos 'dod pa'i blo spangs 406

na/ /skyid 'go dang bde 'go tshugs pa yin/ /tshe 'di phyi yi bde ba bsgrub pa la/ /dus rtag tu ci yang mi 'dod la/ /nor ci yang mi gsog pa zhig dgos/ /blo chos gtad chos phugs sprang la gtad/ /sprang tha ma 'chi ru 'jug pa dgos/ /blo de 'dra skyes na lha 'dre dang / /mi rnasas kyis 'o brgyal myong mi 'jug /tshe 'di yi 'dod pa che tsa na/ /mis 'phya smod rang yang sdug pa yin/ /tshe phyi mar ngan song gnas su lhung / /don de phyir 'dod chung chog shes gyes/ /dman sa bzung chos min bya ba dor/ /chos bzhin du gyes dang mi yis smon/ /rang tshe 'dir skyid la phyi mar bde/ /mdor bsdus na tshe 'di'i 'dod pa la/ /blo ma log 'di phyir bde ba med/ /blo log na bde ba btsal mi dgos/ /tshe 'di phyi'i bde ba shugs kyis 'ong / /glu 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /gang thos tshad 'dod pa zad par shog /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /nyon dang dad ldan chos mthun bu/ /chos mgo mtha' ru 'don pa la/ /khro med bzod pa bsgom pa gces/ /tshur ri'i ngos nas 'ben btsugs na/ /phar ris mda' 'phangs phog pa bzhin/ /tshe sngon gzhan la gnod byas pas/ /tshe 'dir gnod pa byung ba yin/ /des na rang nyid ma lan yang / /gzhan gyis rang la gnod byed dus/ /rang 407

gi sngon las yin soms la/ /khro med bzod pa bsgom par gyes/ /spyon pas gzhan la gnod bskyal na/ /ma smyos mi yis snying re rje/ /zer zhing lan mi byed pa ltar/ /'gro ba nyon mongs gdon gyis smyos/ /rang la gnod pa byed na yang / /lan mi byed par snying rje skyed/ /mkhan po med na sdom pa med/ /slob dpon med na shes rgya med/ /de bzhin gnod byed dgra med na/ /bzod pa med pa'i tshul soms la/ /rang la ngan smra brdeg pa sogs/ /byung dus bzod pa ster mkhan gyi/ /slob dpon yin par shes byas la/ /rang nyid bzod pa len mkhan gye/ /slob mar sgoms la khro mi bya/ /rmi lam dgra la gnyid sad dus//rang bzhin med snyam mi khro ltar/ /da lta'i dgra yang don dam par/ /rang bzhin med pa'i tshul soms la/ /khro med bzod pa bsgom par gyis/ /'di thos chos mdzad skyes bu yis/ /gzhan gyis gnod pa'i mda' 'phangs tshe/ /khro med bzod pa'i go cha gyon/ /chos mgo mtha' ru 'don par shog /chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rang dang rang gi slob bu yis/ /rang don tshe 'dir mngon gyur nas/ /gzhan don nus par byin gyes rlobs/ /rgyud la nyams rtogs ma mchis pas /gzhan la chos bshad mang byas kyang / /ngal ba ma gtogs phan 408

mi thogs/ /snod stong gcig nas gcig byo 'dra/ /brod thob brtan pa ma thob pas/ /gzhan la phan yang rang la gnod/ /bum pa gang byos gzhan gyi snod/ /gang yang rang nyid stongs pa 'dra/ /brtan pa thob nas sems can don/ /grub tshad byas na shin tu legs/ /gter chen bum pas dngos grub ci/ /byung yang gang stongs med pa 'dra/ /dper na sman gyi sdong bo de/ /myu gu'i dus su gcod dus min/ /yal 'dab me tog 'bras smin dus/ /gzhan gyi nad rnams gso dus yin/ /de bzhin brtan pa ma thob bar/ /gzhan la dam chos 'chad dus min/ /brtan pa thob nas sems can don/ /skyo ngal med pa byed dus yin/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /dge 'dis rang dang rang gi bus/ /sngon du dben par rang don byas/ /phyi nas gzhan don byed par shog /chos sku nyag gcig gangs las g.yo ba med/ /gzugs sku rnam gnyis g.yu ral phyogs brgyar g.yo/ /'chad rtsod rtsom gsum rtsal ldan mi'i seng ge /nyon mongs bdud bzhi las rgyal bla mar 'dud/ /rtag 'dzin gdon de khog tu zhugs nas kyang / /rtag par mi rnams 'chi ba mthong na yang / /brtag dpyad tsam yang mi byed rang gzhan gyes/ /rtag tu 'chi ba dran par byen 409

gyis rlobs/ /dam chos chos nas gsungs bzhin gdul bya la/ /spel legs legs pa'i tshig gis legs gdams pas/ /chos rgyal rgyal ba'i bstan 'dzin slob bu ngas/ /glu dbyangs dbyangs snyan dam pa'i chos su len/ /mi lus thob tshe tshe la longs med pa'i/ /yang yang tshul 'di 'di ltar ma bsams par/ /lo zla 'das na na tshod yol ba'i mthar/ /'chi bdag sleb dus dus der 'gyod pa skye/ /de phyir mi 'chi snyam pa'i blo ring bo/ /da re stong log byas na 'dun ma 'khrul/ /yongs grags 'chi ba zer ba'i 'jigs po che/ /nam mkha'i thog ltar steng du 'bab pa'i tshe/ /zas nor longs spyod yod kyang mi phan gyes/ /phyugs po rnams tsho sgren mo lag stong 'chi/ /gshin rje chos rgyal mdun na phyug sa med/ /phyug po 'dod na dam pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /stobs dang dpa' rtsal che yang mi phan gyis/ /dpa' bo rnams tsho wa skad 'chor gyin 'chi/ /gshin rje chos rgyal mdun na dpa' sa med/ /dpa' bo 'dod na dam pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /gzugs mdzes lha sku 'dra yang mi phan gyis/ /mdzes ma rnams tsho kha sna brdzes nas 'chi/ /gshin rje chos rgyal mdun nas mdzes sa med/ /mdzes par 'dod na dam pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /ngag 'jam smra lce bde yang mi phan gyis/ /mkhas pa rnams tsho ldab 410

ldib bshad kyin 'chi/ /gshin rje chos rgyal mdun na mkhas sa med/ /mkhas par 'dod na dam pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /bran dang 'khor g.yog mang yang mi phan gyis/ /mi chen rnams tsho grogs med gcig pur 'chi/ /gshin rje chos rgyal mdun na che sa med/ /che bar 'dod na dam pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /mchor dang rgyan cha yod kyang mi phan gyis/ /mchor bo mchor mos rgyan cha bzhag nas 'chi/ /gshin rje chos rgyal mdun na mchor sa med/ /mchor bo 'dod na dam pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /bza' btung zhim po 'dzoms kyang mi phan gyis/ /kha zhim mkhan tsho za dbang med par 'chi/ /gshin rje chos rgyal mdun na za rgyu med/ /zhim po za na dam pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /gshin rje rgyal pos khrims ra ya nga bar/ /de ring tsam yang mi 'khrid nges pa sked/ /de phyir sang bya gnangs byar ma 'jog par/ /da lta da lta dam pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /de ltar bsams na gtan nas mi sdod go /go bzhin dam chos mi bsgrub phyugs pas phyugs/ /phyugs kyang g.yang kha mthong na skrag pa skye/ /skye mtha' 'chi na 'di la cis mi skrag /mdor na 'chi kha dam chos ma gtogs pa/ /'jig rten bya ba gang gis phan pa med/ /ma byed ma byed sdig pa'i las ma byed/ /byed na byed na dam pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /dge ba 'dis mtshon 411

gang bsags dge ba'i mthus/ /dge 'dun gtsug rgyan blo bzang grags pa bzhin/ /dge ba'i chos rnams 'gro la bstan nas kyang / /dge legs nyin mor byed par bdag 'gyur shog /ces pa 'di yang slob bu blo bzang don 'grub kyis zhal gdams 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes yang yang bskul ngor/ reb gong yul gyi chos pa'i gzugs kyi khram pa kha bde tshogs drug rang grol gyis dben gnas mtsho snying ma hā de ba nas bris pa dge legs 'phel/bskal pa bskal par btsal kyang mjal dka' ba'i/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal sras mtshan ldan bla ma rje/ /chos rgyal chos smra zhabs kyi padmo la/ /yang dang yang du gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpyid kyi dus su ljon shing lo ma 'bus/ /dbyar dus lo 'dab thams cad dar zhing rgyas/ /ston dus ser thig lhung zhing sa la lhung / /tshul 'dis rkyen byas 'chi ba dran nas skyo/ /rab mdzes gser gye mdangs 'dzin spang ri la/ /na bun dngul gye mdog 'dra rked la 'khril/ /de yang gar song med par myur du yal/ /tshul 'dis rkyen byas 'chi ba dran nas skyo/ /sa thag ring bo nas 'ongs khu byug gis/ /rtag tu dga' ba'i skad snyan mang bo bsgrags/ /ston 'go gug tshe gar song cha med thal/ /tshul 'dis rkyen byas 'chi ba dran nas skyo/ /lho yi g.yu 'brug sngon mos dbyar rnga bsgrags/ /sbrang char 'bab cing 'ja' tshon ri mo 'char /dbyar gsum nam zla'i tha mar sgra skad nyams/ /tshul 'dis rkyen 412
