byas 'chi ba dran nas skyo/ /ri thang rnams su 'dam skyes gcal du bkram/ /rkang ba drug ldan mang bos sgra dbyangs sgrog /ston dus rim bzhin mdog nyams med par song / /tshul 'dis rkyen byas 'chi ba dran nas skyo/ /lo yag snye ma g.yu yi mdog ltar mdzes/ /dri gzhon rlung gis bskyod tshe phang phung g.yo/ /ston dus khyem pa pho mos zor bas brngos/ /tshul 'dis rkyen byas 'chi ba dran nas skyo/ /rab gsal rta bdun shar ri'i rtse nas 'ongs/ /rang gzhan kun la phan bde'i 'od zer 'gyed/ /ring bor mi sdod nub kyi ri rtser nub/ /tshul 'dis rkyen byas 'chi ba dran nas skyo/ /mtho la rab yangs stong gsal lha lam gyi/ /lta na sdug pa'i chu 'dzin sprin dkar rnams/ /glo bur rlung chen langs nas phyogs bcur gtor/ /tshul 'dis rkyen byas 'chi ba dran nas skyo/ /bya rnams phal cher rang rang yul bsnyegs shing / /chu rnams phal cher 'khyags shing bskams pa dang / /thang rnams thams cad skya bor song ba yi/ /tshul 'dis rkyen byas 'chi ba dran nas skyo/ /dang po'i dus su zhal mthong gsung thos pa'i/ /bla ma phal cher deng sang mi bzhugs par/ /rang rang gang 'dod sangs rgyas zhing khams bsnyegs/ /tshul 'dis rkyen byas 'chi ba dran nas skyo/ /rang nyid skyes pa'i pha yul de nyid kyi/ /pha ma pha tshan 413

rgan rgon lo lon rnams/ /da lta'i dus 'dir thams cad mi sdod par/ /rim bzhin 'jig rten pha rol bsnyegs nas song / /tshul 'dis rkyen byas 'chi ba dran nas skyo/ /rang nyid chung 'grogs dus kyi grogs po rnams/ /da lta'i dus 'dir thams cad mi sdod par/ /glo bur myur du 'jig rten phyi mar thal/ /tshul 'dis rkyen byas 'chi ba dran nas skyo/ /mi rnams phal cher da nangs snga dro'i dus/ /lus bde rta zhon gos gyon rtse zhing 'gro/ /dgong kha'i dus su mi de shi ba'i ro/ /sum lteb byas nas bla ma gdan 'dren snang / /tshul 'dis rkyen byas 'chi ba dran nas skyo/ /de bzhin 'chi ba nam 'ong cha med pas/ /phyi mar bde bar 'dod na ban rgan khyod/ /ma 'dug ma 'dug dam pa'i lha chos gyis/ /ma gsogs ma gsogs gang yod sbyin pa thongs/ /dge 'dis rang gzhan mi rtag 'chi ba yis/ /dge la bskul nas tshe mjug 'di nyid la/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /dge ba'i chos la gzhol nas 'tshang rgya shog /ces pa 'di ni ston kha shing lo ser zhing phal cher lhung gin yod pa'i dus su bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//yang nyin zhig snying grogs bstan 'dzin nyi ma la zhal gdams mgur zhig zhu ba la cung zad bstod pa'i sgo nas zhu don 'di ltar phul/skyabs gcig drin can bla ma la/ /yid gnyis je tshom dang bral ba'i/ /sgo gsum gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /sgu bzhi'i go 414

'phang bstsal tu gsol/ /blo gros chung ngu'i skra rtse ru/ /grogs kyi yon tan rgya mtsho las/ /chu thigs tsam zhig blangs nas kyang / /dad ldan bdag gis gar bgyid do/ /dbus kyi lhun po'i lho yi phyogs/ /'dzam gling sa yi byang gi ngos/ /ri bo gangs can zhes bya'i rgyud/ /dmu rgod reb gong yul phyogs su/ /grogs khyodagazugs sku'i nyin byed de/ /thub bstan dri med mkha' yi rgyan/ /skal bzang pad tshad gnyen gcig tu/ /da lta shar ba ma lags sam/ /sngon sbyangs bsod nams bsags pa'i mthus/ /grub thob mi la'i rnam 'phrul mgon/ /zla med bla ma'i rjes su bzung / /ma nor zab mo'i gdams pa rnams/ /bum pa gang byos tshul du gnang / /thos bsam zag med bdud rtsi'i ros/ /khyod thugs blo gros lus stobs rgyas/ /snang grags sgyu ma thugs la shar/ /spang dka'i tshe 'di blo yis btang / /spyad dka'i snying rus drag po yis/ /sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan de/ /'dzin mkhan khyod gcig ma lags sam/ /byang chub sems kyi g.yu ral rgyas/ /yang dag lta ba'i mche ba gtsigs/ /sgu gsum 'bras bu'i rtsal gsum rdzogs/ /bslab gsum gangs dkar ltongs su 'gyengs/ /snyan pa'i nga ros sa steng g.yo/ /gangs can khrod kyi seng gcig pu/ /da lta mgon khyod ma lags sam/ /chu bo'i rgyun 415

bzhin dge la brtson/ /zag med ting 'dzin zas kyis 'tsho/ /smyung gnas stong phrag lhag tsam bsrungs/ /phyi mar dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /bu ni pha khyem 'gro ba bzhin/ /grogs khyod 'gro ba ma lags sam/ /chos ltar bcos pa'i grogs ngan bdag /da lta mjal ba skal ba bzang / /da re khyed la zhu ba ni/ /grogs khyod rjes 'jug gang zag la/ /sems la phan pa'i zhal gdams mchog /snyan pa'i mgur zhig gnang bar zhu/ /zhes phul bas zhal gdams 'di nyid bdag dang blo bzang don 'grub gnyis la gsungs so//drin can bla ma rtag tu spyi bor sgoms/ /rten 'brel de las che ba med do ang / /thob dka'i dal 'byor chud gzon ma byed par/ /don ldan dam chos snying bo longs shig ang / /mi rtag 'chi ba rgyun du thugs dam gyes/ /gdams ngag de las che ba med do ang / /las 'bras chos la zhib tu nan tan gyis/ /gnad 'gag de las che ba med do ang / /'jigs rung ngan song gsum la dogs zon gyes/ /'jigs pa de las che ba med do ang / /khas blangs tshul khrims mig 'bras bzhin du srungs/ /thar ba'i them skas de las med do ang / /ma gyur 'gro la byams brtse drag tu sgoms/ /drin gzo de las che ba med do ang / /pha rol phyin drug bsdu bzhi zhi lhag sgoms/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi spyod 416

tshul yin no ang / /khyad par rdo rje'i theg la mos gus gyis/ /shin tu mjal dka'i dam chos yin no ang / /lus ngag yid gsum dge la lhod med rem/ /sgo gsum sdig sgrib myur du 'dag go ang / /zhesapa'o//kwa ye blo bzang don 'grub/ /kha ta tshig 'ga' bshad kyi/ /ga ru 'gro 'am 'dug kyang / /nga yi tshig bzhin gyis shig /ca co'i tshig ngan ma bshad/ /cha byad chos dang stun cig /ja chang sha thud mar la/ /nya bzhin sred pa ma che/ /ta thā ga ta'i chos mdzod/ /tha mal gnyid la ma dga'/ /da lta lha chos mdzod dang / /na 'chis gtugs tshe mi 'gyod/ /pa tra bzhin du 'khyogs nas/ /pha rol mi mgo ma bskor/ /ba glang la sogs 'gro la/ /ma bzhin byams par mdzod cig /tsā ri'i dben gnas min yang / /tsha grangs snyoms pa'i gnas su/ /dza hu'i rgyun bzhin chos gyes/ /wa bzhin lto phyir ma rgyugs/ /zhwa bzhin bla ma bsten la/ /za ma gos kyis mchod cig /rwa bzhin rgyud ni ma gyong / /la la chos min ma byed/ /sha stag nyams len mdzod dang / /sa lam rim gyis 'thob bo/ /ha cang myur ba myur du/ /a'o grub thob ma 'dod/ /tshig 'di yid la zungs dang / /'di dang phyi ma kun tu/ /skyid pa'i nyi ma 'char ro/ /e go blo bzang don 'grub/ /ces 417

pa 'di yang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis blo bzang don 'grub la ja thog cig tu smras pa'o//ka kha yan chad slob pa'i bla ma la/ /kha tsam min par snying nas gsol ba thobs/ /ga na 'dug kyang g.yo sgyu khram gsum dang / /nga rgyal la sogs nyon mongs dug lnga spongs/ /ca co'i gtam ngan gang yang mi thos pa'i/ /cha med dben pa'i ri nas 'dug dus su/ /ja ras gos dar rgyu nor mi bsam par/ /nya rgyas zla bzhin dge sbyor je 'phel mdzod/ /ta la'i shing sogs rgyas pa'i nags khrod kyi/ /tha chad gcan gzan bzhin du ma 'dug par/ /da nas bzung ste na so rgas kyi bar/ /na dang 'chi ba'i g.yul rgyal dam chos mdzod/ /pa sangs lta bur dkar ba'i phan sems kyis//pha mas gtso byas 'gro kun bu bzhin skyongs/ /ba mo'i steng du nyi ma phog pa bzhin/ /ma rig 'khrul ba rtsad nas e chod ltos/ /tsa min ṭi sogs 'chi bdag gshin rje yis/ /tsha grang dmyal bar mi 'khrid thabs la 'bod/ /dza ha bar bzhin sems nyid stong gsal de/ /wa ler nyin mtshan kun tu skyong bar mdzod/ /zhwa lham la sogs mdzes pa'i rgyan gos dang / /za ma la sogs chos kun sgyu mar ltos/ /'a 'ur che ba'i grong du ma sdod par/ /ya rabs khyod kyis rgyun du dben pa sten/ /ra ba gangs ris bskor ba'i yul ljongs 'di'i/ /la lung gnyis ga'i 418

ri khrod nyams dga' ru/ /sha thang bskyed la nyams len 'di bzhin mdzod/ /sa gsum zla med mi la ras pa bzhin/ /ha cang brtson 'grus de ltar dka' na yang / /a rog de la kha mig yar lta gyis/ /zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis blo bzang don 'grub la smras pa'o//e ma rgyal sras grogs kyi thugs/ /dri med pad dkar bzhad pa'i phyir/ /lag gnyis 'chi med lha lam du/ /pir snyug chu 'dzin smug po 'khrigs/ /rab dkar shog gu'i 'dzin ma la/ /dgu ba'i tshes pa drug gi nyin/ /kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams kyi/ /gsung mgur lha yi bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /yi ge'i char ba myur phab mthus/ /snying grogs thugs kyi pad dkar de/ /yang dang yang du rgod pa dang / /nyams rtogs yon tan sbrang rtsis gtams/ /skal bzang slob ma rkang drug gis/ /nangs nub med par khor yug nas/ /skyo ngal med par gar byed cing / /rgyun chad med par chos zhus sgra/ /'gag pa med par sgog par shog /sor mo'i skyes bu gzhon nu de/ /snyug gu'i cang shes rta la zhon/ /shog gu'i nyin mtshan brgya lhag lam/ /snyug gu'i rta yis nyin rer gcod/ /yi ge'i rta rjes char bzhin 'bebs/ /skyes bu cig gi bde re ang / /rta pho cig gi mgyogs re ang / /rta rgyugs byed pa'i skyes bu rnams/ /rta rgyugs byed na 'di ltar gyis/ /zhes pa 'di yang grogs po 419

bstan 'dzin nyi mas kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pa'i gsung mgur le tshan gnyis kho la cig phris zer bas nyin gcig tu bris nas mjug tu 'di rtse mtshar du bris nas byin pa'o//na mo gu ru/ zhal mthong gsung thos kyi bla ma rnams/ /da lta phal cher ni sangs rgyas kyi/ /zhing khams gang 'dod du bzhud de thal/ /mnyam 'grogs dam gtsang gi mched grogs rnams/ /da lta phal cher ni mi 'phrad pa'i/ /'jig rten pha rol tu bzhud de thal/ /'tsho ba sbyor mkhan gyi yon bdag rnams/ /da lta phal cher ni mi mthong ba'i/ /'jig rten phyi ma ru bzhud de thal/ /ngo shes rang yul gyi rgan rgon rnams/ /da lta phal cher ni phyir mi 'ong / /'chi ba'i lam chen la zhugs te thal/ /da ni yun ring zhig mi sdod par/ /mched grogs yon bdag dang rgan rgon tsho/ /bzhud nas song sa der rang yang 'gro/ /yun ring sdod shom gyi khang las dang / /rgyu nom gsog 'jog ni ma byed par/ /'gro grabs mchod sbyin sogs chos la 'bod/ /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la 'dud/ /dka' sbyad nus par byen gyis rlobs/ /bza' btung bzang bor dga' ba yi/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol nyon/ /sha chang ja thud mar chur sogs/ /bza' btung bzang bo'i don ched du/ /dang po bsod nams khe tshong dang / /bran g.yog bzo rigs 'thab rtsod 420

sogs/ /sdug bsngal du ma zhig myong dgos/ /bar du jag rkun bya khye yis/ /'khyer gyis dogs nas mel tshe dgos/ /chu dang shing blangs me bus nas/ /g.yo bskol sdug bsngal mang bo myong / /tha ma kha ru bzhag pa na/ /lce yis zhim mngar bde ba'i ro/ /skad cig tsam myangs mid pa na/ /ro myang bde ba'i rgyun chad nas/ /gcin rtug mi gtsang nyid du gyur/ /mi gtsang yang yang bsal ba'i phyir/ /dro 'jam bde ba'i mal sa bzhag /khyi kha char chu mun nag tu/ /'gro dgos pa sogs sdug bsngal che/ /bde ba glog 'gyu tsam don du//sdug bsngal dpag med su yis myong / /lto rkyal tshogs drug rang grol khyod/ /lto phyir sdug bsngal ma myangs par /zas su gang byung kha sgor zo/ /skom du ja min chu min thungs/ /dka' spyad sgo nas gtan bde'i rgyu/ /dam pa'i chos la 'bad par mdzod/ /de ltar byas na sngar bshad pa'i/ /sdug bsngal khyod kyis myong mi dgos/ /gnas skabs bde zhing mthar thug tu/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob par 'gyur/ /dge 'dis rang gzhan thams cad kyis/ /dka' spyad byas nas chos sgrub shog /ces pa 'di yang nyin zhig ltogs nas bza' btung bzang bo dran tshe smras pa'o//pha 'gran gyi do med rin po che/ /pha chos kyi rgyal por gsol ba 'debs/ /pha ma sogs blos btang bu nga la/ /pha khyed kyi 421

thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /tshe 'di yi bde skyid thams cad btang / /tshe phyi ma'i bde thabs chos mi bsgrub/ /tshe gnyid dang le lo'i ngang la zad/ /tshe 'di med phyi med ban rgan khyod/ /sngon gti mug gnyid du ci tsam log /da bsams na snying bo ga 'dra 'dug /sems yod na snga bar langs re ran/ /nyal ma 'dug ma 'dug yar la longs/ /sngon ro nyal byas nas ci tsam bsdad/ /da bsams na snying bo ga 'dra 'dug /sems yod na drang bor 'dug re ran/ /log ma 'dug ma 'dug drang bor sdod/ /sngon long gtam mang bo ci tsam lab/ /da bsams na snying bo ga 'dra 'dug /sems yod na long gtam gcod re ran/ /gtam ma lab ma lab kha de tshums/ /sngon bza' btung zhim po ci tsam zos/ /da bsams na snying bo ga 'dra 'dug /sems yod na dka' spyad byed re ran/ /dkor ma za ma za dka' ba spyod/ /sngon 'dang log mang bo ci tsam brgyab/ /da bsams na snying bo ga 'dra 'dug /sems yod na 'dang rgyag gcod re ran/ /'dang ma rgyag ma rgyag bsam med sdod/ /sngon tshe 'di'i bya ba ci tsam byas/ /da bsams na snying bo ga 'dra 'dug /sems yod na tshe blos gtong re ran/ /yid ma chags ma chags tshe blos thongs/ /sngon chos sgor zhugs nas ci tsam song / /da rgyud na nyams 422

rtogs ga 'dra 'dug /sems yod na bsgom la 'bad re ran/ /da ma yengs ma yengs rtse gcig sgoms/ /pha drin can bla ma rin po che/ /bu gnyid dang le los mi non par/ /sgom sgrub la brtson 'grus skye ba dang / /nyams rtogs pa 'char bar byin gyes rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//shing tsandan sdong bo'i lding khang na/ /bya lus mdzes rma bya zhe re snyoms/ /e shi re zhe re ma snyoms dang / /dbyar 'ongs nas g.yu 'brug grag rgyu red/ /shing sna tshogs rgyas pa'i nags khrod na/ /bya khu byug sngon mo zhe re snyoms/ /e shi re zhe re ma snyoms dang / /'brug grags na sbrang char 'bab rgyu red/ /zhing ri phyi gru bzhi'i chag ka na/ /pho zhing las mkhan rnams zhe re snyoms/ /e shi re zhe re ma snyoms dang / /char babs na lo legs 'ong rgyu red/ /ri yid 'ong nyams dga'i bsil grib na/ /tshe blos btang rnal 'byor zhe re snyoms/ /e shi re zhe re ma snyoms dang / /lo legs na phye rtsam mod rgyu red/ /ces pa 'di yang bro kha tshar ba'i dus shig tu rtse mtshar du 'jig rten pa'i glu ltar tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//rje bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus de ring rang la gros 'di 'debs/ /khyod grwa slob 'khor g.yog ma 'dod par/ /da gcig pur sdod la nyams len gyis/ /khyod khang khyem sdod sa 423

ma 'dod par/ /da ri khrod 'grims la nyams len gyis/ /khyod 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba ma 'dod par/ /da bya byed spongs la nyams len gyes/ /khyod snyan grags gdul bya ma 'dod par/ /da chos brgyad spongs la nyams len gyis/ /khyod dgra 'dul gnyen skyong ma 'dod par/ /da pha yul spongs la nyams len gyis/ /da legs po gyon na ma 'dod par/ /da gos hrul gyon la nyams len gyis/ /khyod zhim po zos na ma 'dod par/ /da gang byung zo la nyams len gyis/ /khyod ja chang 'thung na ma 'dod par/ /da rtsam thang thungs la nyams len gyis/ /khyod lto phyir 'khyams na ma 'dod par/ /da mal sar sdod la nyams len gyis/ /khyod mal sa'i gnyid na ma 'dod par/ /da brtson 'grus skyed la nyams len gyis/ /glu 'di yang rang la phan phyir blangs/ /dge 'dis kyang 'gro kun bde skyid shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//rje chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bor 'dud/ /khyod nyon dang tshogs drug rang grol ba/ /las byas kyin da dung byed dgos mang / /da bya byed 'jog pa'i dus la bab/ /dgra btul gyin da dung 'dul rgyu mang / /da rang rgyud 'dul ba'i dus la bab/ /gnyen bskyangs kyin da dung skyong dgos mang / /da rgyang du bskyur 424

ba'i dus la bab/ /nor bsags kyin da dung gsog dgos mang / /da chags med bya ba'i dus la bab/ /don byas kyin da dung byed dgos mang / /da rang don sgrub pa'i dus la bab/ /phar song gin da dung 'gro sa mang / /da mal sa gnon pa'i dus la bab/ /zos 'thung shin da dung zos na 'dod/ /da zas gcig byed pa'i dus la bab/ /gnyid log gin da dung gnyid rgyu mang / /da snga bar langs pa'i dus la bab/ /gtam bshad kyin da dung bshad rgyu mang / /da smra bcad byed pa'i dus la bab/ /chos bslab kyin da dung slob rgyu mang / /da nyams len byed pa'i dus la bab/ /glu 'di yang rang la phan phyir blangs//gzhan thos tshad rgyud la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//khams gsum na zla med/ /tsong kha pa mkhyen no/ /bdag snying gi padmo'i/ /ze'u 'bru ru bzhugs shig /lam rim gye gzhi lam/ /'bras gsum gye rnam gzhag /mgrin pa ru btegs nas/ /cung zad cig 'then no/ /gzhi'i skabs su chos rnams/ /ming btags tsam ma gtogs/ /rang ngos nas rdul tsam/ /ma grub pa'i don dam/ /bden pa de rtogs nas/ /ming btags ni tsam la/ /shes bya rnams yod pa'i/ /kun rdzob kyi bden pa/ /'jog tshul de shes nas/ /lam skabs su thabs shes/ /phyogs re ba ma 425

yin/ /bsod nams dang ye shes/ /tshogs gnyis po zung 'brel/ /rang nyams su blangs pas/ /'bras bu'i skabs chos gzugs/ /sku gnyis po thob 'ong / /glu dbyangs 'di 'jam dbyangs/ /mi gzugs su shar ba//blo bzang gi legs bshad/ /sa gsum gyi sgron me/ /lam rim gyi drin las/ /bka' gdams pa'i bu brgyud/ /bya btang ba byams pa/ /chos dar gyes blangs so/ /rab snyan gyi glu dbyangs//'brug sgra de thos tshad/ /skal ldan gyi rma byas/ /thabs shes kyi gshog brkyangs/ /rnam mkhyen gyi tsandan/ /shing kha ru 'phur shog /ces byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi mgur dbyangs 'di ni ri khrod pa byams pa chos dar gyis spras pa'o//shes rab kyi ral gri rnon po de/ /ngar 'dzin gye dgra yi snying du btab/ /stong sang gi ngang du sgol mdzad pa'i/ /snying stobs can rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rmi lam gyi gnas skabs tshun chad du/ /nga nga snyam snying gi dkyil 'di na/ /dam breng nge 'dzin pa'i 'phung bshig go /de cham la 'bebs par byen gyis rlobs/ /rang nyid la dngos su gzhan zhig gis/ /phan gnod gang byas pas bde sdug gi /rtog pa zhig mngon gyur yod na rab//de ga'i chog med na rang nyid la/ /sngar dus su phan gnod gang byas shig /blos gsal thobs gsal btab dus skabs su//426

der phan gnod 'di 'dra byas snyam du/ /phan gnod byas pa'i yul nga zhig /rang snying gi dkyil nas lhang lhang 'char/ /shar ba na nga de gang na 'dug /brtags pa'i tshe sngon chad snying dkyil na/ /yod snyam pa ma gtogs gang steng du/ /grub yod pa'i thag chod ma nges pa/ /de ltar du legs par brtags pa'i tshe res lus kyi steng na yod pa 'dra/ /res sems kyi steng na yod pa 'dra/ /mthar lus sems 'tshogs tsam de'i steng du/ /phar rtog pas btags tsam ma yin par/ /dang po nas nga zhig tshugs thub tu/ /grub yod kyi snyam pa shar ba'i tshe/ /nga lus sems steng du grub yod na/ /lus sems dang gcig tu yod pa'am/ /yang na ni tha dad du yod dgos/ /de gnyis las ma gtogs yod tshul zhig /gtan nas med snyam du blo thag chod/ /nga lus sems gnyis dang gcig ma yin/ /gcig yin na nga dang lus sems zhes/ /ming so sor btags pa don med 'gyur/ /gcig la ni ming gnyis dgos pa ci/ /yang gcig na lus sems gnyis bzhin du/ /nga de yang gnyis su 'gyur dgos la/ /mi gcig la nga gnyis yod mi srid/ /yang gcig na phung bo mer sreg dus/ /nga de yang me la bsreg dgos 'dug /ci'i phyir na lus dang gcig pa'i phyir/ /lus bsregs nas med bzhin nga de yang / /427

phyis med dgos de ni 'gal ba che/ /las byas pa chud gzon ma byas par/ /'phrad la sogs nyes pa du ma yod/ /nga lus sems gnyis dang lhan cig tu/ /ma grub 'dug snyam du blo thag chod/ /lus sems gnyis gzhan du nga yod dgos/ /ci'i phyir na nga yi lus grang gi /nga'i sems 'di sdug gi zer gin mod/ /de so sor yod rtags yin snyam du/ /lus sems gnyis yod kyi so sor sol/ /so so ru bsal ba'i shul de na/ /nga de nyid 'di zhes ston rgyu zhig /yod dgos te de 'dra cang mi 'dug /nga lus sems gnyis las tha dad du/ /ma grub 'dug snyam du blo thag chod/ /de ltar du dpyad pas de yan chad/ /nga nga zhes rang gi snying dkyil na/ /nga mig gis mthong rgyu yod 'dra ba/ /nga lag pas 'dzin rgyu yod 'dra ba/ /de rdul phran tsam yang ma rnyed par/ /stong phyam gyis song dus nga zhes pa/ /ming phar la btags pa tsam ma gtogs/ /tshur rang ngos grub pa rdul tsam med/ /nga mi 'dug snyam pa'i nges shes kyi//rgyun byeng rgod bral ba rtse gcig skyongs/ /rjes thob tu nga sogs chos thams cad/ /dpe sgyu ma lta bur shes par gyis/ /'di legs sbyar rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /nang snying gi dkyil du gnas bcas nas/ /sdug sna dgu 'dren pa'i 'phung rgan po/ /dgra ngar 'dzin cham la 'bebs nus shog /ces 428

pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis ngar 'dzin la 'dzing dus shig tu smras pa'o//spyan ras gzigs dbang rgyal po'i tshul bzung / /bod khams bde la bkod pa'i drin can/ /srong btsan sgam po'i zhabs la 'dud do/ /da dung rigs drug spyi dang khyad par/ /bod la thugs rje'i sbyan gyes gzigs la//byang chub ma 'thob bar du skyongs shig /'dul ba smod cing sdom pa tshul bzhin/ /mi bsrung bshes gnyen gol sa'i chos yin/ /mdo sde sgod cing bka' la klog 'don/ /mi byed bshes gnyen gol sa'i chos yin/ /mngon par smod cing zab mo'i don la/ /mi mos bshes gnyen gol sa'i chos yin/ /ston chen nyams len mi byed nga rgyal/ /che na bdud kyis bcos pa'i chos yin/ /sgom chen 'jig rten 'du 'dzi'i g.yeng ba/ /che na bdud kyis bcos pa'i chos yin/ /btsun pa tshul 'chos mkhas la lkog na/ /sdom med bdud kyis bcos pa'i chos yin/ /grags pa'i phyir du 'khor dang longs spyod/ /gsogs na dred por shor ba'i chos yin/ /nor phyir gzhan la mgo bskor bslu brid/ /byed na dred por shor ba'i chos yin/ /zas phyir slong 'dod rku 'dod gdungs pa/ /che na dred por shor ba'i chos yin/ /rang sems bzhag nas sangs rgyas gzhan du/ /'tshol na bka' dang 'gal ba'i chos yin/ /bla ma bzhag nas 429

skyabs gnas gzhan du/ /'tshol na bka' dang 'gal ba'i chos yin/ /pha ma bzhag nas mchod gnas gzhan du/ /'tshol na bka' dang 'gal ba'i chos yin/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro rgyun du/ /nus na gol sa med pa'i chos yin/ /mi dgos bcu bo gtan nas spang bar/ /nus na gol sa med pa'i chos yin/ /bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhabs tog /nus na gol sa med pa'i chos yin/ /lus kyi las su phyag skor sdom pa/ /bsrungs na lung dang mthun pa'i chos yin/ /ngag gi las su kha ton bzlas brjod/ /byed na lung dang mthun pa'i chos yin/ /yid kyi las su bskyed rdzogs la sogs/ /bsgoms na lung dang mthun pa'i chos yin/ /gzhan gyes dam pa'i chos la gshe skur/ /'debs na dma' sa bsnyegs pa'i chos yin/ /rang gis chos la yid gnyis the tshom/ /za na dma' sa bsnyegs pa'i chos yin/ /bdud kyis byin brlabs chos la nyams len/ /byed na dma' sa bsnyegs pa'i chos yin/ /sbyin pa gtong zhing tshul khrims rtag tu/ /bsrungs na mtho sa 'grims pa'i chos yin/ /bzod pa bsgom zhing brtson 'grus rtag tu/ /rtsom na mtho sa 'grims pa'i chos yin/ /bsam gtan bsgoms shing shes rab rtag tu/ /bskyed na mtho sa 'grims pa'i chos yin/ /blo dman blo dang sbyar 430

nas dam chos/ /gsungs na shes rab dman pa'i chos yin/ /tshig nyung don tshang zab mo'i gdams pa/ /ston na shes rab dman pa'i chos yin/ /gang gsung dpe dang don gnyis 'brel nas/ /gsungs na shes rab dman pa'i chos yin/ /nad gdon sel ba la sogs tshe 'dir/ /phan pa kun la dgos pa'i chos yin/ /las sgrib sbyangs shing nyams grib sel ba/ /byed pa kun la dgos pa'i chos yin/ /dge tshogs bsogs kyang chos kyi bag chags/ /'jog pa kun la dgos pa'i chos yin/ /lus ngag yid la 'dod pa gting nas/ /med na dam pa don gyi chos yin//zas nor 'khor la 'dod pa gting nas/ /med na dam pa don gyi chos yin/ /thos bsam sgom la rlom sems gting nas/ /med na dam pa don gye chos yin/ /bya ba btang nas rgyun du sems nas/ /blta na rtse mor phyin pa'i chos yin/ /'dre 'dul spangs nas yi dam lha bsnyen/ /byed na rtse mor phyin pa'i chos yin/ /mi dgos spangs nas dge ba'i las la/ /'bad na rtse mor phyin pa'i chos yin/ /rang lus snang stong lha yi sgu ru/ /bsgoms na lus la bde drod skye'o/ /ngag gis snying bo rgyun chad med par/ /bzlas na ngag la nus pa 'byung ngo / /sems nyid stong gsal ngang du rang bab/ /bzhag na sems la rtogs pa 'char ro/ /sum tshan bcu 431

gsum glu dbyangs 'di ni/ /chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i gsung gi /'gros bzhin tshogs drug rang grol blangs so/ /'di nyid thos tshad chos rgyal srong btsan/ /sgam pos rjes su bzung nas tshe 'dir/ /thar ba'i lam sna zin par gyur cig /mtshan ldan bla ma bka' drin can/ /spyi bor pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs/ /g.ya' ri gangs ri rdza ri gsum/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi pha yul yin/ /sha ba dgo ba rna ba gsum/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi sgo phyugs yin/ /khu byug pho rog lcung ka gsum/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi khyim bya yin/ /sram dang wa mo ri spyang gsum/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi sgo khyi yin/ /spra ba me cha me rdo gsum/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi khyim mtshes yin//ri bong bra dang tsi gu gsum//rnal 'byor bdag gi 'dug grogs yin//rgyab dang rkang ba lag pa gsum/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi 'khor g.yog yin/ /gri dang khab skud khug ma gsum/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi yo byad yin/ /skyogs dang ba ma sbud pa gsum/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi thab cha yin/ /phying 'gag ras gzan sham thabs gsum/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi gon pa yin/ /na dang sngo sgog sil thog gsum/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi kha zas yin//g.ya' chu rdza chu gangs chu gsum/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi btung ba yin/ /zhes pa 'di yang bdag gi go lag ngan 432

zhing / gri zhig yod par gri shubs med/ me cha zhig yod pa sne ya chag pa/ mi 'gas mthong nas tshe blos btang sha stag red zer 'dzum zhing dgod pa'i tshe/nga la yod phyug po yin zhes rtse mtshar du khong rnams la tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//dbus gtsang lha lam lta bu la/ /nyi zla zung gcig shar 'dra ba'i/ /rgyal ba paṇa chen rnam gnyis la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byen gyis rlobs/ /bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten/ /dam pa'i lha chos mkhas par 'gyur/ /chos la thos bsam mang du gyes/ /dbang rtul yin yang chos shes 'gyur/ /dam chos rtag tu yid la gyis/ /rang gi sems la phan phar 'gyur/ /chos byed pa la gcig pur sdod/ /lus ngag yid gsum bde bar 'gyur/ /dam pa'i chos la nyams len gyes/ /mchog thun dngos grub 'byung bar 'gyur/ /lhag par bskyed rdzogs nyams su longs/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur/ /tshe 'dir yun ring sdod long med/ /myur du 'chi ba'i 'du shes zhog /'khor dang nye 'brel rnams mi rtag /myur du 'bral dgos 'du shes zhog /nor rdzas gang yod 'chi tsa na/ /'khyer dbang med pa'i 'du shes zhog /rang gi yul nas dus gtan du/ / sdod dbang med pa'i 'du shes zhog /rang lus mi rtag bem rig gnyis/ /so sor 'bral ba'i 'du shes zhog /'chi dus dam pa'i chos ma gtogs/ /gang gis mi phan 'du shes zhog /chos kyi don rnams 433

shes par gyes/ /bde skyid thams cad de las 'ong / /rtag tu dam chos sdom pa srungs/ /legs tshogs thams cad de las 'ong / /rtag tu nam 'chi cha med soms//skyo shas brtson 'grus de las 'ong / /rtag tu chos kyi don la soms//lus sems zhi ba de las 'ong / /rtag tu 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal soms/ /thar 'dod shugs drag de las 'ong //rtag tu sems kyi gzhi rtsa chod/ /gsal stong nyams myong de las 'ong / /rgyal ba paṇa chen rnam gnyis la/ /gsol ba 'debs bzhin glu 'di blangs/ /rgyal ba paṇa chen byin rlabs kyis/ /thos tshad bde zhing skyid par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//bla ma dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag gzhan sgo gsum byen gyis brlab tu gsol/ /bdag gis dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba rnams/ /'gro kun sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /bdag ni mthong ngam 'dra sku mthong tshad kyi/ /rgyud la byams dang snying rje skye bar shog /bdag gi rnam thar phyogs tsam thos pa yis/ /tshe blos btang nas bsgrub la gzhol bar shog /nam mkha' sa gzhi 'di nyid nam gnas bar/ /bdag gis mgur dbyangs gang blangs gnas par shog /sprin med nam mkhar nyi ma shar ba bzhin/ /rgyal khams yongs la dar zhing rgyas 434

par shog /bum bzang dpag bsam shing dang nor bu ltar/ /'gro la 'phral phugs legs tshogs ster bar shog /gang gis mgur 'bum par du brkos pa yis/ /rang don 'grub nas gzhan don byed par shog /rgyal khams mang bor rgya cher spel ba yis/ /rgyal ba'i go 'phang bde blag thob par shog /glegs bam gang du gnas pa'i yul phyogs su/ /mi mthun rgud pa'i ming yang mi grags shog /na bza' ska rags bzang bo sus phul ba/ /lus ni bzang bo'i gos dang mi 'bral shog /me tog bdug spos mar me phul ba yis/ /gzugs mdzes dri zhim rig pa gsal bar shog /spyi bor bzhag nas bkur ste byas pa de/ /kun gyis spyi bo'i rgyan bzhin bkur bar shog /lus kyis reg tshad lus kyi sgrib pa dag /phyi mar mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku thob shog /ngag gis bton tshad ngag gi sgrib pa dag /phyi mar yan lag drug cu'i gsung thob shog /yid kyis de don bsam tshad yid sgrib dag /phyi mar mkhyen brtse che ba'i thugs thob shog /lan cig thos tshad yid sgrib byang zhing dag /phyi mar sku gnyis mngon du 'gyur bar shog /mdor na 'dri 'don klog 'chang mthong thos kun/ /tshe 'dir bde skyid phyi mar sangs rgyas shog /bla ma dkon mchog gsum gye byen rlabs kyis/ /smon lam gang btab 435

de bzhin myur 'grub shog /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis shog /rtsa gsum lha chos rnams kyi bkra shis shog /chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyi bkra shis shog /rgyal ba rnams kyi sku yi bkra shis shog /rgyal ba rnams kyi gsung gi bkra shis shog /rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs kyi bkra shis shog /rgyal rnams sku gsung thugs kyi bkra shis shog /lus la bde drod 'bar ba'i bkra shis shog /ngag la nus pa 'byongs pa'i bkra shis shog /sems la rtogs pa 'char ba'i bkra shis shog /lus ngag yid gsum bde ba'i bkra shis shog /dpon slob mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i bkra shis shog /tshe yang thams cad ring ba'i bkra shis shog /'dzad med longs spyod rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i bkra shis shog /nyin mtshan chos kyis 'da' ba'i bkra shis shog /mchog thun dngos grub thob pa'i bkra shis shog /ci bsam thams cad 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis chen pos phyogs bcur khyab gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang mgur 'bum gye mjug tu bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis sbyar ba'o//rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rje btsun zhabs dkar rdo rje 'chang chen pos mchog dman bar ma'i gdul byar gang la gang 'tsham gyi rdo rje'i mgur dpag tu med pa bzhengs pa yi ger 'khod 436
pa'i nang tshan las/ mtsho snying ma hā de ba nas dam pa nyid kyis nyid la gsal 'debs dge bskul gyi tshul du bzhengs pa'i skor ro//

mtsho snying ma hā de ba nas skal bzang gi gdul bya ri ba'i tshogs kyi zhus lan zhal gdams kyi skor/na mo gu ru/ byin rlabs stsol ba'i dngos brgyud bla ma rje/ /dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam zhi khro'i lha/ /bar chad sel ba'i mkha' 'gro chos skyong la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyes rlobs/ /ri khrod dben par nyams len byed bzhin du/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos kun gyi snying bo'i don/ /tshigs su bcad nas glu ru blangs pa rnams/ /bstan 'gro yongs la phan par byin gyes rlobs/ /yid bzhin nor bu rgyal mtshan rtse mo ru/ /bkur tshe dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba ltar/ /mgur 'bum 'di nyid lha mi'i khrom dkyil du/ /sgog tshe kun la phan par byin gyis rlobs/ /nor bu dar zab nang du sbas bzhag kyang / /nang der bkra shis g.yang kun 'byung ba ltar/ /mgur 'bum grong dgon gang du bzhag na yang / /bkra shis g.yang kun 'khyil bar byen gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di ni bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis dben gnas mtsho snying nas smras pa'o//438

'gro rnams sgol ba'i khur chen bsnams/ /'gro drug thar ba'i gnas 'dren pa'i/ /'gro mgon rgyal ba thugs rje can/ /'gro kun kha lo chos la sgyur/ /'gro ba'i don du glu zhig len/ /'gro la phan par byin gyes rlobs/ /rgyal po blon por chos shig dgos/ /rgyal po blon por chos yod na/ /rgyal mtshan bzang ba'i rtse mo ru/ /yid bzhin nor bu btegs pa 'dra/ /mi lus thob pa don go che/ /rgyal po blon pos lha chos mdzod/ /mkhas pa dpa' bor chos shig dgos/ /mkhas pa dpa' bor chos yod na/ /lcags kyi pha bong gru bzhi la/ /gser 'gyur rtsi yis thebs pa 'dra/ /mi lus thob pa don go che/ /mkhas pa dpa' bos lha chos mdzod/ /a yi a byes chos shig dgos/ /a yi a myes chos yod na/ /rin chen gser gye phor ba ru/ /'chi med bdud rtsi blugs pa 'dra/ /mi lus thob pa don go che/ /a yi a phyes lha chos mdzod/ /bu dang mna' mar chos shig dgos/ /bu dang mna' mar chos yod na/ /dngul dkar bum pa bzang bo ru/ /seng ge'i 'o ma blugs pa 'dra/ /mi lus thob pa don go che/ /bu dang mna' mas lha chos mdzod/ /mchor bo mchor mor chos shig dgos/ /mchor bo mchor mor chos yod na/ /srab 'jam yang ba'i gos chen la/ /bkra shis ri mo bkra ba 'dra/ /mi lus thob pa don go che/ /mchor 439

bo mchor mos lha chos mdzod/ /tsha bo tsha mor chos shig dgos/ /tsha bo tsha mor chos yod na/ /rin chen shel gyi mchod rten la/ /sna tshogs phra yis spras pa 'dra/ /mi lus thob pa don go che/ /tsha bo tsha mos lha chos mdzod/ /g.yog po g.yog mor chos shig dgos/ /g.yog po g.yog mor chos yod na/ /sa zhing gshin po'i zhing sa la/ /lo legs snye ma 'khrungs pa 'dra/ /mi lus thob pa don go che/ /g.yog po g.yog mos lha chos mdzod/ /khyim tshang bza' bar chos shig dgos/ /khyim tshang bza' bar chos yod na/ /rin chen sna lnga'i khang bzang du/ /mi 'dzad gter gyis bkang ba 'dra/ /mi lus thob pa don go che/ /khyim tshang bza' bas lha chos mdzod/ /mi rnams kun la chos shig dgos/ /mi rnams kun la chos yod na/ /rin chen gser gyi gling phyin nas/ /kun gyis gser dngul blangs pa 'dra/ /mi lus thob pa don go che/ /thams cad dam pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /ces pa 'di yang a khu bla ma rgya lding gis bskul ngor tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /'gro ba yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /nyon dang dad ldan skye bo kun/ /'o skol khams gsum 'khor ba ru/ /'khyams nas skye 'chi grangs med byas/ /'chi thebs re la skye thebs re/ /skye thebs re la pha ma re/ /440

'gro kun pha mar ma gyur med/ /pha ma re res lan mang du/ /pha ma byas pa'i grangs mi chod/ /pha ma sems can thams cad kyis/ /rgyu ni nyon mongs 'ba' zhig spyad/ /'bras su ngan song gsum la sogs/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs myangs/ /'di dag rang la 'dren pa bab/ /rang gis da lta'i gnas skabs su/ /pha ma sems can mi 'drongs yang / /dkon mchog gsum la zhu snyam du/ /bdag dang pha ma dang bcas pa/ /'khor ba spyi dang khyad par du/ /ngan song gsum las bskyab tu gsol/ /snyam du skyabs 'gro yang yang gyes/ /dam chos gang zhig bsgrubs na yang / /thog mar pha ma kun don du/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par bya/ /de phyir dam pa'i lha chos ni/ /bdag gis bsgrub par bya snyam du/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par gyis/ /las 'bras nam yang chud mi za/ /grib ma bzhin du rjes su 'brang / /las ngan ma bsags sdug mi myong / /dge ba ma byas bde mi myong / /de phyir mi dge'i sdig la 'dzems/ /dkar bo'i dge la 'bad par mdzod/ /glu dbyangs 'di thos skye bo yi/ /rgyud la phan thogs 'byung bar shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//bod kyi mkhas grub gong ma rnams/ /bod khams yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /bod yul dad can pho mo nyon/ /deng sang 441

snyigs ma'i dus skabs 'dir/ /mi rnams kun gyes gcig gcig gi /skyid sdug shes pa shin tu dkon/ /bla ma dro zhing rgyags pa'i tshe/ /dgon pa'i skyid sdug phar la zhog /grwa ba'i skyid sdug shes pa dkon/ /dpon po dro zhing rgyags pa'i tshe/ /sde ba'i skyid sdug phar la zhog /nang 'khor skyid sdug shes pa dkon/ /phyug po dro zhing rgyags pa'i tshe/ /med po'i skyid sdug phar la zhog /g.yog po'i skyid sdug shes pa dkon/ /bu tsha dro zhing rgyags pa'i tshe/ /khyem tshang skyid sdug phar la zhog /pha ma'i skyid sdug shes pa dkon/ /a ne dro zhing rgyags pa'i tshe/ /khyem mtshes skyid sdug phar la zhog /mna' ma'i skyid sdug shes pa dkon/ /bza' tshang dro zhing rgyags pa'i tshe/ /sgo khye'i skyid sdug phar la zhog /a khu'i skyid sdug shes pa dkon/ /de tsam ma shes phyi ma ru/ /thar ba thob pa phar la zhog /mi lus thob pa shin tu dkon/ /skyid sdug mi rtag sprin bar gye/ /nyi ma 'dra bas skyid pa'i tshe/ /gcig gcig skyid sdug shes par mdzod/ /gtam 'di chogs drug rang grol gyis/ /da lta'i skyid pa rnams la smras/ /thos tshad yongs la phan thogs shog /ces pa 'di yang gzhan gye skyid sdug mi shes pa rnams dang shes pa rnams la dran gso byas pa'o//mi ngan phal cher gyi kha 'di 'og sgo 'dra/ /bza' sdigs mi 442

gtsang la nam yang 'dzad pa med/ /bza' sdigs mi gtsang dris khyem tshang bza' ba sun/ /'og sgor kha gcod cig yod na ci ma rung / /chad med bza' sdigs mkhan kha yi 'og sgo sdoms/ /mi ngan phal cher gyi kha 'di grod pu 'dra/ /phra ma rdzun tshig gi slo khu rgyun chad med/ /kha 'byed slo khu yis rang gzhan gnyis ka rdzob/ /grod pur kha bcing zhig yod na ci ma rung / /kha 'byed rdzun tshig mkhan kha yi grod pu sdoms/ /mi ngan phal cher gye kha ni lho sprin 'dra/ /mi snyan tshig rtsub kyi ser ba rgyun chad med/ /tshig rtsub ser ba yis rang gzhan dge 'bras 'joms/ /lho sprin rlung zhig gis gtor na ci ma rung / /mi snyan tshig rtsub mkhan kha yi lho sprin sdoms/ /mi ngan phal cher gyi kha 'di rgya sgo 'dra/ /long gtam bzang ngan gye 'grul ba rgyun chad med/ /long gtam 'grul ba yis rang gzhan dge sbyor gcog /sgo la zwa zhig ni yod na ci ma rung / /long gtam tshar med kyi kha yi rgya sgo sdoms/ /zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyes smras pa'o//bud med la la ni bye'u lcog ka 'dra/ /long gtam lab mkhan gye mo la lha chos dkon/ /bud med la la ni nags gseb rma bya 'dra/ /byi dor rem mkhan gyi mo la lha chos dkon/ /bud med la la ni tshong 'dus khe ba 'dra/ /g.yo sgyu khram pa mkhan mo la 443

lha chos dkon/ /bud med la la ni rnga mong bu shi 'dra/ /sdig sdug gtam ngan mkhan mo la sta chos dkon/ /zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//bla ma dkon mchog thugs rje can/ /snyigs dus rgan rgon bla rgan gyis/ /don med smra ba mi mang bar/ /kha ton nus par byen gyis rlobs/ /dad can rgan rgon bla rgan tsho/ /kha ta tshig 'ga' bshad kyis nyon/ /khye rnams rgas kyin 'gro 'dug mang / /mi rnams rgas kyin smra ba mang / /rgan rgon bla rgan phal cher gyis/ /khyim tshang bza' ba thams cad la/ /ya gi las can tshang gis sngar/ /las don 'di 'dra byas nas 'grub/ /'o skol bza' ba las ngan tshang / /rem rem da song da las dang / /'dir song 'di las 'di shod dang / /me sbor thal pho chu longs dang / /da longs da nyol da zo sogs/ /dgos dang mi dgos mang bo lab /bu yis a pha kha rog dang / /bu mos a ma kha rog dang / /kun gyis a khu kha rog zer/ /rgan rgon bla rgan gtam ma mang / /gzhan gyis g.yor skyi slong ba'i tshe/ /bu dang mna' mas g.yor bskyis ster/ /bshad na rgan rgon bla rgan ni/ /mal na ro bzhin nyal ba yang / /mal sas yar la mgo btegs nas/ /ma ster ma g.yor bskyi mi rung / /nged tshor shin tu mkho gi zer/ /bu dang 444

mna' ma tsha bo yis/ /kha rog byas nas kha bkag kyang / /ma ster ma ster ster na yang / /ngan pa chung ngu chung ngu byin/ /ma g.yor ma bskyi g.yor bskyis na/ /phyir la myur mo myur mo zer pha rol mi de yul du song / /khyim tshang bza' bar 'di skad zer/ /de ba'i bu dang mna' ma rnams/ /g.yor skyi ster la shin tu bzang / /rgan rgon 'phung rgan 'chi med dam/ /bla rgan hon log ngan gi zhes/ /zer ba mang bo ngas kyang go /rgan rgon bla rgan kha de tshums/ /gzhan gyis tshur la cung zad tsam/ /gnod pa byas na khong khro skye/ /de bas nged la ngan byas pas/ /bu ngan khyod 'dra 'dug phod dam/ /song la brdung ngam sod la thongs/ /de dang de 'dra mang bo lab/ /rgan rgon bla rgan kha lan nas/ /gyod sna kha mchu phal che ba/ /'ongs pa sngon chad ngas kyang mthong / /rgan rgon bla rgan kha nyes nas/ /rang nor zhing khang shor ba dang / /bu yang 'chi ru bcug pa yod/ /rgan rgon bla rgan kha de tshums/ /cig re'i 'go tsho 'dug no red/ /rgan rgon bla rgan phal che ba /khyim tshang khyim mtshes mi 'dod pa/ /phal cher rang gi kha yis lan/ /a rog rgan rgon bla rgan tsho/ /kha de rang gi yin na zungs/ /rgan rgon bla rgan kha shas 'tshogs/ /phu'i sha mdo yi dgo ba sogs/ /don med long gtam mang bo lab/ /chags sdang 445

nyon mongs sna tshogs skyes/ /'khon 'dzing 'thab rtsod 'ongs pa mang / /rgan rgon bla rgan bshad tshod zungs/ /rgan rgon bla rgan rnams 'khrul nas/ /kho bos bshad kyin ma bsdad na/ /khyem tshang bza' ba 'thor gi snyam/ /kha nas gzhan la 'di skad zer/ /nged kyi 'di tshor 'di gyis zhes/ /ma bshad ci yang mi shes zer/ /bu dang mna' ma'i bsam pa la/ /de tsho nged la ma bshad kyang / /mi shes dud 'gro ma red snyam/ /dgos med bshad pa mang mi dgos/ /nged tshos mi 'jog kha rog zer/ /rgan rgon bla rgan smra ba gcod/ /bza' tshang tshong 'dus mgron po 'dra/ /mgron po yun ring mi sdod gyes/ /tshe mjug la mgo'i nyi zer 'dra/ /nyi zer yun ring mi 'dug 'gro/ /'chi bdag bdud ni grib ma 'dra/ /skad cig mi sdod tshur tshur 'ong / /gshin rje chos rgyal rtsis grangs zhib/ /drung du song na ci bshad snyam/ /sdig pa byas na dmyal bar 'phen/ /tsha grang sdug bsngal bzod par dka'/ /dge ba byas pa yar la gtong / /lha mi'i bde skyid mi 'dod dam/ /mdor na khyem tshang bza' ba yis/ /ci zhig byed kyang byed du chugs/ /smra ba chod la kha ton rem/ /gal te smra na chos 'jig rten/ /las don ga la chen yin na shod/ /de min mi bshad dgu bshad kyi/ /smra ba ma mang ma mang ang / /glu 'di thos 446

tshad rgan rgon dang / /bla rgan rnams kyis khyem tshang la tshod med smra ba mi mang bar/ /kha ton bzlas brjod byed nus shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis grong gi rgan rgon bla rgan rnams la smras pa'o//spyan ras gzigs dang dbyer med pa'i/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bdag gzhan 'gro ba thams cad la/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs su gsol/ /nyon dang dad ldan skye bo kun/ /'khor ba'i gnas 'dir skyes phyin chad/ /sdug bsngal rkyang ba ma gtogs pa/ /bde ba'i go skabs cung zad med/ /'khor ba shin tu gting zab cing / /rgya che chu bo'i gzhung dang 'dra/ /'gro kun chu bo de nyid la/ /bying ba'i nyam thag mi dang 'dra/ /'phags pa thugs rje chen po ni/ /de las sgol ba'i gru ba 'dra//snying bo yi ge drug ma ni/ /de las sgol ba'i gru dang 'dra/ /'khor ba'i chu bo chen po las/ /thar bar 'dod pa'i skal ldan kun/ /'phags pa thugs rje chen po bsten/ /snying bo yi ge drug ma thon/ /'khor ba srin mo'i gling dang 'dra/ /'gro kun der tshud tshong ba 'dra/ /thugs rje chen po sgol mkhan gyi/ /rta mchog sprin gye shugs can 'dra/ /grogs dang bu tshar mi chags pa/ /srin mo bu la mi chags 'dra/ /snying bo yig drug bgrangs pa ni/ /rta la 'jus nas 'gro ba 'dra/ /'khor ba srin mo'i gling 'di nas/ /447

thar bar 'dod pa'i skal ldan kun/ /'phags pa thugs rje chen po bsten/ /snying bo yi ge drug ma thon/ /'khor ba jag rkun gcan gzan sogs/ /'jigs pa che ba'i lam 'phrang 'dra/ /'gro kun rgyus med cha med kyi/ /lam 'phrang de ru 'gro mi 'dra/ /'phags pa thugs rje chen po ni/ /gang la'ang mi 'jigs skyel ma 'dra/ /snying bo yi ge drug ma ni/ /lam rgyus mkhan gye mi dang 'dra/ /'khor ba 'jigs pa'i lam 'phrang las thar bar 'dod pa'i skal ldan kun/ /'phags pa thugs rje chen po bsten/ /snying bo yi ge drug ma thon/ /'khor ba rgyal po'i btson dong 'dra/ /'gro kun btson dong de nyid du/ /tshud pa'i nag can mi dang 'dra/ /thugs rje chen po de nyid las/ /skyob byed btson blu bdag po 'dra/ /snying bo yig drug 'don pa de/ /zas nor mang bo rab byin nas/ /srog blus thar bar byas pa 'dra/ /'khor ba rgyal po'i btson ra las/ /thar bar 'dod pa'i skal ldan kun/ /'phags pa thugs rje chen po bsten/ /snying bo yi ge drug ma thon/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'tsho dka' zhing / /zug gzer che ba'i gcong nad 'dra/ /'gro kun gcong nad de nyid kyis/ /rtag tu thebs pa'i mi dang 'dra/ /'phags pa thugs rje chen po ni/ /nad de gso ba'i sman pa 'dra/ /snying bo yi ge drug ma 448

ni/ /gso bar byed pa'i sman dang 'dra/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gcong nad las/ /thar bar 'dod pa'i skal ldan kun/ /'phags pa thugs rje chen po bsten/ /snying bo yi ge drug ma thon/ /'khor ba mtho zhing rab gzar ba'i/ /thar dka'i g.yang sa chen po 'dra/ /'gro kun g.yang sa de nyid la/ /lhung ba'i nyam thag mi dang 'dra/ /'phags pa thugs rje chen po ni//dpyang thag 'dren pa'i mi dang 'dra/ /snying bo yi ge drug ma 'di/ /shin tu sra ba'i dpyang thag 'dra/ /'khor ba'i g.yang sa de nyid las/ /thar bar 'dod pa'i skal ldan kun/ /'phags pa thugs rje chen po bsten/ /snying bo yi ge drug ma thon/ /glu dbyangs 'di thos thams cad kyis/ /bod kyi lha skal spyan ras gzigs/ /gtan gyi skyabs su legs bsten nas/ /snying bo yig drug 'don par shog /tshe zad 'chi ba'i dus skabs su/ /nam yang bslu ba med pa yi/ /thugs rje chen pos zhal bstan nas/ /dag pa'i zhing du 'khrid par shog /ces pa 'di yang rang gzhan kun la phan phyir tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//bod yul gyi lha skal spyan ras gzigs/ /bod rnams la thugs rje'i spyan gyes gzigs/ /bod phyogs la phan pa'i glu zhig len/ /bod mi la phan par byin gyis rlobs/ /ri rab ni ka shi 449

ga'i ras kyis/ /lo brgya'i 'phror lan re phyis kyang 'dzad/ /yi ge drug lan gcig brjod pa yi/ /phan yon ni nam yang 'dzad mi 'gyur/ /lus po sgur kha yi so rnams lhung / /mgo bo yi skra dkar gnyer ma mang / /phyi ma ru sang 'gro gnangs 'gro ba'i/ /rgan rgon rnams ma ṇi padme bgrongs/ /rgya mtsho ni skra yi nyag gcig gis/ /phyi rol tu gtor yang nam zhig 'dzad/ /yi ge drug lan gcig brjod pa yi/ /phan yon ni nam yang 'dzad mi 'gyur/ /ldang ba'i dus rtod phur 'don bzhin ldang / /'gro na yang chang 'thung bzhin du 'khyor/ /phyi ma ru sang 'gro gnangs 'gro ba'i/ /rgan rgon rnams ma ṇi padme bgrongs/ /sa gzhi yi rdul phran thams cad ni/ /re re nas bgrangs na grangs kyis chod/ /yi ge drug lan gcig brjod pa yi/ /bsod nams ni grangs kyis chod mi 'gyur/ /sdod pa'i dus sa rdo chad bzhin 'dug /mal sa nas 'phred du ro bzhin nyal/ /phyi ma ru sang 'gro gnangs 'gro ba'i/ /rgan rgon rnams ma ṇi padme bgrongs/ /dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas byang sems rnams/ /thams cad kyis yi ge drug ma yi/ /phan yon ni brjod kyang brjod mi lang / /bgrangs na yang grangs kyis chod mi 'gyur/ /rna ba yis mi thos mig mi gsal/ /a yo dang a na kha nas 'chor/ /phyi ma ru sang 'gro gnangs 'gro ba'i/ /rgan 450

rgon rnams ma ṇi padme bgrongs/ /glu dbyangs 'di thos tshad bod yul gye/ /rgan rgon rnams ma ṇi 'don par shog /bton pa'i mthus tshe 'dir bde zhing skyid/ /phyi ma ru bde ba can skye shog /ces pa 'di yang bod yul gyi rgan rgon dad can rnams la tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//skyabs mchog 'phags pa thugs rje chen po la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bod la thugs rjes gzigs/ /bod kyi lha skal spyan ras gzigs dbang gi /mtshan mchog gang gis brjod kyang thos tshad kyi/ /'gro rnams tshe 'di'i nyes pa kun las bskyabs/ /phyi mar bla med byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /gsung mchog yig drug bzla ba'i mi de yi/ /lus kyi phyi nang gnas pa'i srog chags rnams/ /myur du ngan song gnas las thar ba dang / /lus kyi rlung phog sems can sgrib pa 'dag /yi ge drug ma brag gam rtsig pa la/ /bris na de nyid mthong tshad sems can rnams/ /myur du bla na med pa yang dag par/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob par 'gyur/ /de phyir bod kyi dad can pho mo tsho/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi mtshan nas brjod/ /yi ge drug ma bzla dang 'bri la 'bod/ /'di nyid thos tshad rnams la phan thog shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar/ /thugs rje'i 451

spyan gyis 'gro ba yongs la gzigs/ /bla ma spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ /mos pa'i bu la thugs rje'i spyan gyes gzigs/ /phyi snod 'jig rten mi rtag na bun 'dra/ /nang bcud sems can mi rtag sgyu ma 'dra/ /pha yul mi rtag dri za'i grong khyer 'dra/ /mi rtag dran na ye ge drug ma thon/ /lus 'di mi rtag g.yar ba'i rgyan cha 'dra/ /mdza' bshes mi rtag shing kha'i bye'u chung 'dra/ /zas nor mi rtag rtswa kha'i zil ba 'dra/ /mi rtag dran na yi ge drug ma thon/ /rgan pa mi rtag la mgo'i nyi zer 'dra/ /gzhon nu mi rtag dbyar kha'i me tog 'dra/ /thams cad mi rtag tshong 'dus mgron po 'dra/ /mi rtag dran na yi ge drug ma thon/ /nyi zla dgung la gnas pa gza' yis zin/ /seng ge gangs la gnas pa 'bu yis gzhig /bya rgod brag la gnas pa rnyi yis zin/ /mi rtag dran na yi ge drug ma thon/ /stag mo nags la gnas pa sa mdas bsad/ /ri dwags spang la gnas pa rngon pas bsad/ /nya mo chu la gnas pa lcags kyus bzung / /mi rtag dran na yi ge drug ma thon/ /bye'u chung shing khar gnas pa khra yis khyer/ /me tog spang la bkram pa ba mos bsad/ /lo tog zhing la skyes pa zor bas brngas/ /mi rtag dran na yi ge drug ma thon/ /za ma phugs ma yod pa khyi yis khyer/ /gos rgyan snod na yod pa tsi 452

gus gtubs/ /ra lug sgo na yod pa spyang kyis bsad/ /mi rtag dran na yi ge drug ma thon/ /glu 'di thos tshad mi rnams 'chi ba'i dus/ /lhang lhang yi ge drug mas gsol btab tshe/ /bu bu ma 'jigs la sogs gsung bzhin du/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna 'dren par shog /ces pa 'di yang sngo rgya'i bla mas bskul ngor tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//bod kyi lha mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /bod yul mun sel padma 'byung / /bod rnams gtsug rgyan blo bzang grags/ /bod khams yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /bod kyi tshogs drugo rang grol glus/ /bod la phan par byen gyis rlobs/ /rgyal po blon por chos shig dgos/ /rgyal po blon por chos med na/ /dper na brag stod bya rgod 'dra/ /'dug sa mtho rung don go chung / /don go yod par mdzad 'dod na/ /rgyal po blon pos lha chos mdzod/ /mkhas pa dpa' bor chos shig dgos/ /mkhas pa dpa' bor chos med na/ /dper na ne tso rgya stag 'dra/ /kha mkhas dpa' rung don go chung / /don go yod par mdzad 'dod na/ /mkhas pa dpa' bos lha chos mdzod/ /a yi e myes chos shig dgos/ /a yi e byes chos med na/ /dper na sdong rgan khog rul 'dra/ /ma shi bsdad kyang don go chung / /don go yod par mdzad 'dod 453

na/ /a yi e byes lha chos mdzod/ /bu dang mna' mar chos shig dgos/ /bu dang mna' mar chos med na/ /dper na bye ba smug ril 'dra/ /sog rum shes rung don go chung / /don go yod par mdzad 'dod na/ /bu dang mna' mas lha chos mdzod/ /mchor bo mchor mor chos shig dgos/ /mchor bo mchor mor chos med na/ /dper na skya ka khra ril 'dra/ /gos rgyan yag rung don go chung / /don go yod par mdzad 'dod na/ /mchor bo mchor mos lha chos mdzod/ /tsha bo tsha mor chos shig dgos/ /tsha bo tsha mor chos dmad na/ /dper na sgo phyugs gces pa 'dra/ /khog pa rgyags rung don go chung / /don go yod par mdzad 'dod na/ /tsha bo tsha mos lha chos mdzod/ /g.yog po g.yog mor chos shig dgos/ /g.yog po g.yog mor chos med na/ /dper na glang rgan bong rgan 'dra/ /'khur shed che rung don go chung / /don go yod par mdzad 'dod na/ /g.yog po g.yog mos lha chos mdzod/ /khyem tshang bza' bar chos shig dgos/ /khyem tshang bza' bar chos med na/ /dper na tshong 'dus mgron po 'dra/ /lhan cig 'tshogs kyang don go chung / /don go yod par mdzad 'dod na/ /khyem tshang bza' bas lha chos mdzod/ /mi rnams kun la chos shig dgos/ /mi rnams kun la chos med na//dper na mgo ril nor 454

dang 'dra/ /mi lus thob pa don go chung / /don go yod par mdzad 'dod na/ /thams cad dam pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//drin can bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /nyon dang dad can pho mo tsho/ /tshe 'di'i drin can pha ma yis/ /bu dang bu mo'i lto rgyab phyir/ /pha ni khye bzhin phyogs bzhir 'khyams/ /nyin par lto bcag mtshan mo gnyid/ /spangs nas gang mkho khyer nas 'ongs/ /ma yang nyin gcig mi sdod par/ /zhing las so nam bkal 'thag byas/ /nyin 'gro mtshan mo nyal na yang / /bu dang bu mo'i lto rgyab 'di/ /ji ltar byed snyam bsam blo btang / /rgyun du pha ma sems khur che/ /zas ngan za zhing gos hrul gyon/ /khong gnyis ji ltar song na yang / /zas gos yod pa'i gang bzang rnams/ /bu dang bu mor legs par byin/ /tha na bu dang bu mo la/ /cham pa mgo na tsam byung yang / /sems mi bde bar rim gro byas/ /de nas che ru song tsa na/ /bu la chung ma len pa'am/ /yang na chos bslabs rab byung byas/ /bu mo gnas la rdzong ba sogs/ /phan pa dpag tu med pa btags/ /de 'dra'i dka' las sna tshogs kyis/ /bskyangs pa'i drin can pha ma yis/ /yar gye la yang mi chod cing / /mar gye thur yang mi bobs dus/ /pha ma drin can 455

skyong dus yin/ /khrel yod bu dang bu mo tsho/ /pha ma rgan rgon drin can rgyab/ /dro 'jam yang ba'i gos kyis g.yogs/ /dro ba'i mal du bde bar zhog /tshogs gsog ma ṇi 'don du chugs/ /nam mkho'i dus su bza' btung byen/ /na dus rgyun du nad g.yog gyis/ /de ltar pha mar bkur byas na/ /tshe 'dir tshe dang bsod nams rgyas/ /skye bo gzhan gyis bkur ba dang / /yid la ci bsam thams cad 'grub/ /phyi mar mtho ris gnas su skye//rgas pa'i drin can pha ma la/ /rgas dus mi 'dod pa byas na/ /tshe 'dir nad mang tshe yang thung / /lo re bzhin du kha thur 'gro/ /skye bo gzhan gyis brnyas pa dang / /brgya bsam gcig kyang 'grub mi 'gyur/ /phyi mar ngan 'gro'i gnas su skye/ /de phyir dad can gzhon pa tsho/ /drin can pha ma mchod cing bkur/ /pha mas mi 'dod las ma byed//glu 'dis rang gzhan la phan shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//mchod 'os skyabs gyur thams cad la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byen gyis rlobs/ /'jig rten pa rnams 'khrul nas ni/ /lha chos byed pa'i skal ba zhig /byung na dga' ba mi bsgom par/ /bu zhig byung na shin tu dga'/ /bu med pa rnams mya ngan byed/ /dgra bo lus las chad pa la/ /sems yod su zhig dga' bar 456

byed/ /dang po btsas dus sdug bsngal myangs/ /lus kyi bkrag mdangs 'phrog par byed/ /bar du gang yod za ma rnams/ /byen pas kha yi zas skal 'phrog /dro 'jam legs pa'i gos gang yod/ /bskon pas rgyab kyi gos kyang 'phrog /tha ma bu dang bu mo yi/ /kha rgyab ma 'dang ma khebs nas/ /sdig pa byas pas dmyal ba ru/ /song nas mi thar srog kyang 'phrog /dang po lus kyi mdangs 'phrog po/ /bar du zas gos nor 'phrog po/ /tha ma pha ma'i srog 'phrog po/ /rang las skyes pa'i dgra bo la/ /bu zhes su zhig dga' dga' byed/ /bu yod rnams kyis lto rgyab phyir/ /sdig las ma byed lha chos mdzod/ /bu med rnams kyis dgra bo de/ /med la mya ngan ci'i phyir byed/ /phyi mar song na bde skyid kyi/ /nyi ma 'char bas lha chos rem/ /glu 'dis kun la phan thogs shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'dud/ /'chi ba dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /lus 'di gad kha'i sdong rgan 'dra/ /lus sems nam zhig 'bral cha med//ston kha'i shing gi lo 'bras dang / /'dra bas 'chi bar nges pa med/ /sos ga'i dus kyi me tog dang / /'dra ba'i tshe la long med pas/ /nges par lha chos byed dgos rem/ /de yang nam 'chi nges pa med/ /la la ma yi mngal du 457

'chi/ /la la btsas ma thag tu 'chi/ /la la byes pa gzhon dus 'chi/ /la la dar la bab dus 'chi/ /myur du lha chos byed dgos rem/ /'chi la bya gtong bstud mar 'ong / /yul mi nye du shi ba dang / /zla grogs rnams dang bral ba dang / /rang gi mgo yi skra rnams dkar/ /lus la gnyer ma byung ba dang / /kha yi so rnams bud pa dang / /lus stobs shor ba la sogs pa/ /rnams ni 'chi ba'i bya gtong yin/ /da lta lha chos byed dgos rem/ /'chi dus ci tsam yod kyang 'jog /bu grogs yod kyang 'grogs dbang med/ /nor rdzas yod kyang 'khyer dbang med/ /de dus lha chos dgos pas rem/ /gtam 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /rang gzhan yongs la phan phyir smras/ /thos tshad lha chos phyi bshol du/ /mi 'jog myur du rem par shog /ces pa 'di yang gzhan la phan du re nas smras pa'o//nyon dang dad ldan skye bo rnams/ /smyung bar gnas pa lan gcig tsam/ /bsrungs na bskal pa bzhi khri yi/ /'khor ba phyi ru bsnyil bar 'gyur/ /mtshams med lnga dang las sgrib kun/ /byang dang phyir mi ldog pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sar gnas 'gyur/ /skye ba dman pa'i bud med kyis/ /smyung gnas lan gcig tsam bsrungs na/ /shi 'phos gyur tshe sa dang por/ /gnas 458

pa'i byang sems skyes bu ru/ /gyur nas 'khor bar rgyab phyogs 'gyur/ /de phyir dad ldan skye bo kun/ /smyung gnas bsrung la 'bad par gyis/ /smyung gnas srung ba'i gang zag la/ /nangs par 'tsho ba zhig drangs na/ /sa brgyad byang chub sems dpa' la/ /'tsho ba drangs dang mnyam pa yin/ /gso sbyong blangs mtshams la drangs na/ /dgra bcom pa la drangs dang mnyam/ /de phyir dad ldan skye bo kun/ /rang gis bsrung bar mi nus kyang / /gzhan gyis srung la zhabs tog sgrubs/ /smyung gnas bsnyen tshad song ba'i mi/ /spyan ras gzigs dang mtshungs pas na/ /mi de mthong tshad kha rlangs dang / /'dres pa'i rlung de phog tshad dang / /ri mgo mthon po'i rtser phyin na/ /mi de mthong tshad sems can rnams/ /ngan song gnas su lhung mi 'gyur/ /mi de chu la brgal ba'i chu//'thung tshad mi de'i grib ma gang / /phog tshad de la reg tshad kyi//sems can ngan song las thar zhing / /bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur/ /de phyir dad ldan skye bo kun/ /sgyung gnas mang bo bsrung ba yi/ /mi de spyan ras gzigs dngos su/ /ltos la zas gos la sogs pa'i/ /'brel ba legs po 'jog par gyis//zhes snang gnas phan yon 'di yang dad ldan yongs la phan phyir rgyud dang /byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan la 'phags pas dngos su gsungs pa dang / bla ma gong ma'i gsung bgros dang 459

mthun par tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//bsnyen gnas sdom pa 'di nyid ni/ /tshegs chung phan yon shin tu che/ /bsrungs pa'i phan yon cung zad tsam/ /bshad kyis khyim pa pho mos nyon/ /tshes pa 'argyad la bsnyen gnas kyi/ /sdom pa tshul bzhin bsrungs gyur na/ /bcad gtub dmyal ba las thar nas/ /bskal pa sum cu'i sdig pa byang / /bco lnga'i nyin par bsnyen gnas kyi/ /sdom pa tshul bzhin bsrungs gyur na/ /grang ba'i dmyal ba las thar nas/ /bskal pa sum cu'i sdig pa byang / /gnam stong nyin par bsnyen gnas kyi/ /sdom pa tshul bzhin bsrungs gyur na/ /tsha ba'i dmyal ba las thar nas/ /bskal pa brgya yi sdig pa byang / /de phyir khyem pa dad can tsho/ /bsnyen gnas sdom pa ci thub srungs/ /bsnyen gnas ma bsrungs dus skabs su//mar khu rgya mtsho tsam pa la/ /sdong bu ri rab tsam pa zhig /btsugs nas mar me phul ba las/ /sdom pa srung ba'i nyi ma der/ /mar khu thigs pa tsam zhig la/ /sdong bu khab rtse tsam pa zhig /btsugs nas mar me phul ba de/ /phan yon shin tu che ba yin/ /bsnyen gnas bsrung ba'i nyi ma der/ /tshogs bsags rgya chen byas gyur na/ /phyi mar 'dod khams lha ru skye/ /tshogs bsags 'bring tsam byas pa na/ /rab tu phyug pa'i mi ru skye/ /460

tshogs bsags cung zad tsam byas kyang / /phyi mar mi lus gtsang ma 'thob/ /de phyir sdom pa srung ba'i nyin/ /tshogs bsags gyis shig dad can tsho/ /da lta mi lus thob pa sngon/ /tshul khrims bsrungs pa'i 'bras bu yin/ /da lta gzugs byad bzang ba sngon//bzod pa bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu yin/ /da lta longs spyod che ba sngon/ /sbyin pa btang ba'i 'bras bu yin/ /da yang de ltar byas gyur na/ /phyi mar de 'dra 'byung ba yin/ /de phyir khyim pa pho mo tsho/ /kha la nyan na de bzhin mdzod/ /da yang khyim pa pho mo nyon/ /na nas bsnyen gnas sdom pa bsrung / /ma thub bzhag na 'chor ba min/ /na ba sos nas ma bsrungs na/ /sdom pa 'chor bas bsrung bar gyis/ /brjed nas rtsam pa sogs zos kyang / /bshags te bsrungs na nyes pa med/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i rdzas/ /zos na sdom pa 'chor ba min/ /zos nas sngar ltar ma bsrungs na/ /sdom pa 'chor bas bsrung bar mdzod/ /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyes khyim pa rnams la smras pa'o//sgye med chos dbyings ngang nyid las/ /'gags med gzugs skur legs bzhengs nas//'khrul med lam bzang ston mdzad pa'i/ /mtshungs med chos rgyal zhabs la 'dud/ /dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /dam sdom mig 'bras ltar bsrungs 461

shing / /dam chos nyams su len mkhan ngas/ /dam gtsang grogs rnams dgyes glu len/ /bla mar dad gus drag po skyes/ /byin rlabs zhugs pas shes rgyud ni/ /chos dang 'dres pas blo re bde/ /skyon rtog ma shor ngo mtshar che/ /'khor ba me mur 'obs ltar mthong / /'dod yon btsan dug lta bur shes/ /nges 'byung skyes pas blo re bde/ /zhen pa log pa ngo mtshar che/ /nyam thag 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /drin can pha ma yin par shes/ /gzhan phan sems bskyed blo re bde/ /chags sdang bral ba ngo mtshar che/ /yangs so che'o chos kyi dbyings/ /nam mkha' 'dru ste spros dang bral/ /lta ba'i thag chod blo re bde/ /phyogs ris bral ba ngo mtshar che/ /bde'o gsal lo mi rtog ngang / /nyi zla 'dra ste 'od re gsal/ /bsgom pa'i thag chod blo re bde/ /byeng rgod bral ba ngo mtshar che/ /chos rnams thams cad rang snang tsam//sgyu ma 'dra ste bden zhen med/ /spyod pa'i thag chod blo re bde/ /blang dor bral ba ngo mtshar che/ /rang rig dri med chos kyi sku/ /nor bu 'dra ste lhun gyis grub/ /'bras bu'i thag chod blo re bde/ /re dog bral ba ngo mtshar che/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /gang du bsdad kyang nyams re dga'/ /su dang 'phrad kyang blo re bde/ /sdug bsngal bral ba ngo mtshar che/ /bya btang gu yangs blo bde 462

ngas/ /rtag tu nam yang gtan bde glu/ /blangs pa 'dis kyang rang bde zhing / /'gro ba gzhan yang kun bde shog /ces pa 'di yang reb gong glu ba tshogs drug rang grol gyis nyams dga' ba'i shugs kyis blangs pa'o//mtho la yangs pa yi dgung sngon mthon po dang gcig /de la 'khor ba yi mun sel nyi ma dang gnyis/ /gnas skabs 'brel ba de bzhag pa yud tsam zhig gda'/ /dgung sngon nam mkha' khyod sku khams ci bde ru bzhugs/ /'dzam gling nyi ma nga gling gzhan skor ba la 'gro/ /dgung sngon mthon po khyod sprin gyis ma bsgribs pa byas/ /'dzam gling nyi ma nga gza' yis ma bzung ba byas//yang yang lhan cig tu 'dzom pa'i smon lam ni 'debs/ /mtho zhing sra ba yi ya gi brag dmar dang gcig /de la 'khor ba yi bya rgyal rgod po dang gnyis/ /gnas skabs 'brel ba de bzhag pa yud tsam zhig gda'/ /brag stod mthon po khyod sku khams ci bde ru bzhugs/ /bya rgyal rgod po nga dgung sngon 'grim pa la 'gro/ /brag stod mthon po khyod thog gis ma bshig pa byas/ /bya rgyal rgod po nga rnyi yis ma bzung ba byas/ /yang yang lhan cig tu 'dzom pa'i sgon lam ni 'debs/ /dwangs gsal rnyog med kyi chu bo gaṅgā dang gcig /de la 'khor ba yi nya mo gser mig dang gnyis/ /gnas skabs 'brel ba de bzhag pa yud tsam zhig 463

gda'/ /chu bo gaṅgā khyod sku khams ci bde ru bzhugs/ /nya mo gser mig nga rgya mtsho 'grim pa la 'gro/ /chu bo gaṅgā de rgyun de ma chad pa byas/ /nya mo gser mig nga lcags kyus ma bzung ba byas/ /yang yang lhan cig tu 'dzom pa'i smon lam ni 'debs/ /ldum rar 'khrungs pa yi me tog utpal dang gcig /de la 'khor ba yi stag chung bung ba dang gnyis/ /gnas skabs 'brel ba de bzhag pa yud tsam zhig gda'/ /ldum ra'i me tog khyed sku khams ci bde ru bzhugs/ /yid 'ong bung ba nga spang gzhongs me tog sar 'gro/ /me tog utpal khyod sad kyis ma khyer ba byas/ /bung ba khra ril nga ser bas ma phog pa byas/ /yang yang lhan cig tu 'dzom pa'i smon lam ni 'debs/ /'tsho ba sbyor mkhan gyi yon bdag pho mo dang gcig /de la 'khor ba yi rnal 'byor ras pa dang gnyis/ /gnas skabs 'brel ba de bzhag pa yud tsam zhig gda'//yon bdag pho mo tsho sku khams ci bde ru bzhugs/ /rnal 'byor ras pa nga ri khrod nyams dga' ru 'gro/ /dad can yon bdag tsho ma shi ma 'thor ba byas/ /rnal 'byor ras pa nga ma na ma 'das pa byas/ /yang yang lhan cig tu 'dzom pa'i smon lam ni 'debs/ /zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis dad can yon bdag pho mo rnams la smras pa'o//464

'o 'o rngon pa khye khrid bslebs thal/ /a'u sha ba smug po ma 'dug /kho re rdza ri mthon po snyogs dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o bya khra sdig can bslebs thal/ /a'u 'dab chags bye'u ma 'dug /kho re shing nags mthug po snyogs dang / /te he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o bye la g.yo can bslebs thal/ /a'u byi ba smug ril ma 'dug /kho re bu ga phugs ring snyogs dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o nya bda' ngo nag bslebs thal/ /a'u nya mo gser mig ma 'dug /kho re mtsho yi dkyil de snyogs dang / /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /'o 'o skra dkar gnyer ma bslebs thal/ /a'u bya btang ban rgan ma 'dug /kho re ri khrod dben pa snyogs dang/ /he he blo bde dpal yin e go /zhes pa 'di yang rje skal ldan ras pa'i gsung dang mthun par reb gong glu ba tshogs drug rang grol gyis dben pa la yid spro pa'i shugs kyis smras pa'o//pha drin can bla ma'i gsung bzhin/ /tshe 'di la ltag pa bstan nas/ /gnas ri khrod nyams dga' bsten dus/ /ngas gdams ngag glu ru los len/ /mi sdig can rngon pas ri nas/ /mar dmyal bar ngu bzhin 'gro ba'i//rgyu ri dwags mang bo gsod tshe/ /dga' bzhin du glu dbyangs len na/ /ngas dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams dgar/ /yar thar bar dgod bzhin 'gro 465

ba'i/ /rgyu dam pa'i lha chos sgrub tshe//ngas glu dbyangs ci'i phyir mi len/ /glu mi len kha rog bsdad las/ /nga sri bshol 'ong ni ma snod/ /skabs skabs su glu dbyangs len pa/ /khong ri ba phal cher lugs yin/ /nyams rtogs pa'i yon tan med rung / /nga glu la dga' ba'i shugs kyis//rang gzhan rnams chos la bskul phyir/ /sngar glu dbyangs mang bo blangs so//mi nga 'dra'i ri ba rnams tsho/ /gnas dben par nyams len byed tshe/ /nang rang gi sems la phan pa'i/ /glu re re longs dang skyon med/ /ces pa 'di yang gzhan mang bos khyed kyis sngon chad glu dbyangs mang bo 'then 'dug ces smras tshe/ reb gong smad kyi glu ba tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//bla ma spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /dkor zan bdag la thugs rjes gzigs/ /gzhan gyis gang phul nor rdzas rnams/ /blangs nas chos phyogs mi gtong bar/ /khyim tshang phyogs su btang gyur na/ /phyi mar de yi rnam smin gyes/ /len mkhan rnga mong lus su skye/ /grod pu che la mi 'grang zhing / /rkang ba tsha zhing bu dad che/ /nor bdag rnga mong bdag por 'gyur/ /bkol spyod lan chags 'ded du 'ong //de ma yin pa'i lan chags stong //nyi khri 'ded du 'ong ba yin/ /de phyir tshogs drug rang grol khyod/ /rnga mong zhig tu mi skye bar/ /'dod na nor rdzas chos phyogs thongs/ /466

thams cad gtong bar mi nus kyang / /phyed ka btang na e bzang snyam/ /glu 'di dkor zan ban rgan nga //nga 'dra rnams la phan thogs shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyes smras pa'o//skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma yi/ /zhabs kyi padmor gus pas 'dud//khyod kyi byen rlabs thugs rje yis/ /'dir 'tshogs blo kha chos la sgyur/ /bya btang byams pa chos dar ngas/ /tshegs chung don ni rab tu che//khyed rnams lag len thub pa yi/ /tshogs gsog byed tshul glu zhig len/ /'dir 'tshogs dad can pho mo nyon//lus 'di mi rtag chu bur 'dra//nor rdzas rtswa mgo'i zil ba 'dra/ /bza' tshang tshong 'dus mgron po 'dra/ /'chi bdag nam 'ong nges pa med/ /'chi tshe chos min mgon skyabs med/ /dkar nag las la bslu ba med//phyi mar bde zhing skyid 'dod na//'di bzhin mdzod cig dad can tsho/ /bla ma dge ba'i bshes bsnyen rnams/ /bsod snyoms phyir du phebs pa'i tshe/ /gang yod 'brel ba bzhag gyur na/ /phyi ma'i dus na 'brel stobs kyis/ /bla mas 'dren par the tshom med//de phyir bla ma che chung gang //rang gi sgo rtsar phebs pa'i dus/ /'brel ba zhog cig 'dir 'dus tsho/ /zas gos gnyis kyis rab phongs pa'i/ /sprang bo sgo rtsar 'ongs pa'i dus/ /bza' btung gon pa byin gyur na/ /phan yon dpag 467

tu med pa yod/ /de phyir sprang bo su 'ongs kyang / /mthong dus sgo yi khye khogs la/ /zas gos byen cig 'dir 'dus tsho/ /rgas pa'i drin can pha ma la/ /rgas dus bkur ste byas gyur na/ /tshe 'dir tshe dang bsod nams rgyas/ /phyi mar mtho ris gnas su skye/ /de phyir drin can pha ma yis/ /rang nyid chung ngu'i dus skabs su/ /'jam pa'i gon pa bskon tshul dang / /zhim pa'i bza' btung byin tshul dang / /snyan po'i ming nas bos tshul sogs/ /pha ma'i drin de dran gyis la/ /gson dus 'jam po'i gon pa dang //zhim pa'i zas byen gtam snyan shod//shi ba'i dus su dge rtsa dang //phye nas nyams mchod bsngo ba rnams/ /yang yang gyis shig 'dir 'dus tsho/ /bran g.yog sgo yi khye rnams la/ /byams na snyan grags phyogs bcur rgyas//kun gyis bkur zhing mchod par 'gyur/ /de phyir bran g.yog sgo khye la/ /bza' btung byen cig 'dir 'tshogs tsho/ /'o zho 'thung ba'i ma 'bri dang / /bkal khur byed pa'i khal rta sogs/ /drin can pha ma las lhag pa'i/ /drin dang ldan pa'i sgo phyugs la/ /byams na phan yon dpag med yod/ /de phyir bsha' dang btsong ba sogs/ /khrel med bya ba mi byed par/ /rang gi sgo nas 'chi ru chugs/ /rgas dus khal yang ma 'gel bzang / /gal te khal ni 'gel na yang / /rdo dang dbyug pas mi 468

brdung zhing / /yang mo khol cig khrel yod tsho/ /gzhan yang lus kyis phyag skor dang / /sgyung gnas sdom pa bsrung ba dang / /ngag gis kha ton bzlas brjod dang / /sems kyis bslu med dkon mchog la/ /dad pa byed cing 'gro kun la//phan sems skyed cig 'dir 'dus tsho//khyem tshang bza' ba che chung gi /su yis dge ba byed na yang / /de la bar chad mi byed par/ /dga' bas mchod bkur byas gyur na/ /bsod nams mnyam du 'thob pa yin/ /de phyir dge ba sus byed kyang / /mthun rkyen sgrubs shig 'dir 'dus tsho/ /gzhan yang sems can thams cad ni/ /pha mar ma gyur gcig kyang med/ /lus ngag phan thogs gang thub mdzod/ /gnod pa ma byed skal ldan tsho//mdor bsdus gnad 'gag 'di bzhin mdzod//sdig pa ci yang mi byed par//dge ba che thub chung thub gyis/ /dge ba gang byas mjug tu yang / /phyi mar lha 'am mir skyes nas/ /lha chos byed pa'i smon lam thobs/ /de ltar lha chos byed nus na/ /tshe 'dir yid la ci bsam 'grub/ /phyi mar mngon mtho lha mi ru/ /skye ba yin no 'dir 'dus tsho/ /'di thos dad can pho mo yis/ /'di bzhin dge la rab gzhol mthus//phyi mar lha mi'i lus rten thob//lha chos byas nas 'tshang rgya shog /ces pa 'di yang zhabs drung gi mjal ba dad can pho mo rnams la byams pa chos dar gyis mtsho snying 469

nas smras pa'o//mgon po 'od dpag med pa dang / /sbyan ras gzigs dbang mthu chen thob//nye ba'i sras chen brgyad la sogs//phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams la 'dud/ /'dir 'tshogs dad can pho mo rnams/ /'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba med/ /gtan du bde zhing skyid pa yi/ /bde ba can du skye 'dod na/ /skye ba'i rgyu gsum 'di ltar sgrubs/ /skye ba 'di yi 'og rol tu/ /bde ba can du bdag skyes nas/ /sdug bsngal du mas mnar ba yi/ /mar gyur 'gro drug sems can rnams/ /bde ba can gyi zhing khams su/ /bdag nyid gcig pus 'dren par bya/ /snyam pa'i sems bskyed byed dang gcig /de yi phyir du bsod nams kyi/ /tshogs gsog bya snyam dge ba'i las/ /ci thub rab tu 'bad dang gnyis/ /de ltar dge ba gang byas mjug /bde ba can gyi zhing khams dang / /mgon po 'od dpag med pa rnams/ /rang gi yid la dran byas nas/ /dge ba gang byas zhing khams der/ /skye phyir bsngo smon byed dang gsum/ /'di gsum byas na skye bar gsungs/ /'di gsum sgrubs shig 'dir 'dus tsho/ /glu 'di thos tshad thams cad kyis/ /rgyu de gsum po rab bsgrubs nas/ /'di nas tshe 'phos gyur ma thag /bde ba can du skyes nas kyang / /'od dpag med 470

kyi zhal mthong shog /ces pa 'di yang zhabs drung tshang gi mjal ba dad can mang bo la byams pa chos dar gyis mtsho snying nas smras pa'o//mtshan ldan bla ma bka' drin can/ /mos pa'i bu la byen gyis rlobs/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /zhal gdams ster ro yid la zhog /'khor los sgyur rgyal rgyal sa de/ /'dzin rgyu byung yang tha mar ltung / /chung ma lha phrug gzhon nu dang / /'grogs rgyu byung yang mi rtag 'bral/ /rnam thos sras kyi longs spyod de/ /thob rgyu byung yang myur du 'dzad/ /dal 'byor rnyed dka'i mi lus 'di/ /da lta thob kyang 'jig par nges/ /'khor ba'i bya ba thams cad la/ /bsams na snying bo gang yang med/ /snyeng bo med pa'i bya byed las/ /snying bo'i lha chos bye da bsams na/ /dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba thobs/ /sems can thams cad pha mar sgoms/ /drin can bla ma pha ma mchod/ /dbul phongs rnams la sbyin pa thongs/ /rgyun du nam 'chi cha med soms/ /rang lus snang stong lha ru sgoms/ /ngag gis gsang sngags zab mo zlos/ /stong nyid don la mnyam par zhog /dge ba 'gro kun don du sngos/ /glu dbyangs 'di thos thams cad kyi/ /rgyud la phan thogs 'byung bar shog /ces pa 'di yang zhabs drung ma phyag gi dad can yon bdag dge slong bstan 'dzin lhun grub la tshogs drug rang grol gyis mtsho snying nas smras pa'o//471

sku 'gyur ba med pa rdo rje'i sku/ /gsung 'gag pa med pa tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ /thugs g.yo ba med pa chos sku'i ngang / /skyabs bslu ba med pa gtan gye skyabs/ /lha thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs/ /spyir 'gro ba yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /khyad par du bod la thugs rjes gzigs/ /sgos 'dir 'tshogs rnams la thugs rjes gzigs/ /tshig cal col ma lab rgan rgon tsho/ /gtam shab shub ma mang gzhon nu tsho/ /sems yengs yengs ma byed rig pa gtod/ /kha kha rog rnal 'byor glu la nyon/ /dus da lta mi lus thob dus 'dir/ /chos rnam dag bsgrub na sgrub dbang yod/ /'di rnyed dka' don che nor bu 'dra/ /da chud zos ma gtong yig drug thon/ /dus da lta mi tshe shin tu thung / /tshe gnod mang rlung nang mar me 'dra/ /mi kha sang yod pa de ring med/ /da nam 'chi mi shes yig drug thon/ /spyir 'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba med/ /sgos ngan song sdug bsngal bzod par dka'/ /zhing bde ba can dang po ta lar/ /da 'gro mi yod na yig drug thon/ /lha thugs rje chen po byin rlabs myur/ /gsung yi ge drug ma nus mthu che/ /'don gtso bor byed pa'i mi rnams kyis/ /da nyin mtshan med par yig drug thon/ /gsung rab kyi snying bo yig drug 'di/ /yar thar bar 'gro ba'i 472

them skas yin/ /mar 'gro ba rigs drug sgo gcod yin/ /da rgan gzhon med par yig drug thon/ /tshe 'di ru 'dug dus sku rim yin/ /tshe phyi mar 'gro dus bro kha yin/ /tshe 'di phyi gnyis ga'i nom pa yin/ /tshe gang bor yi ge drug ma thon/ /gsung yig drug mthong thos dran reg dang / /'bri 'dod rnams gnas skabs bde zhing skyid/ /mthar sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob par gsungs/ /da nangs nub med par yig drug thon/ /dpe sa rdul bgrangs na grangs kyis chod/ /gsung ma ṇi lan gcig brjod pa yi/ /phan yon ni bgrangs na grangs mi chod/ /da 'gro rung 'dug rung ma ṇi thon/ /glu 'di nyid thos tshad 'gro ba rnams/ /lha thugs rje chen pos rjes bzung nas/ /dus gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar ri bo ta lar 'dren par shog /cesapa 'di yang a rig gi gnas mjal ba kha shas la tshogs drug rang grol gyis mtsho snying nas smras pa'o//rgya chen tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho bsrubs pa'i dpal las legs par 'khrungs pa yi/ /yon tan kun gye 'byung gnas chen po thabs mkhas bsdu bzhi'i bang rim can/ /lugs gnyis nyi zla'i rgyan gyes mdzes shing skye dgu gling bzhi'i dbus na brjid//phyogs las rnam rgyal lhun po gnyis pa zla med bla ma mchog de'i drung / /sngon byon dam pa'i rnam thar rjes zhugs nas/ /mi med 473

ri la gnas pa'i bu nga yis/ /pha yi gsang gsum yon tan dran bzhin du/ /lag gnyis thal sbyar gsol ba 'debs 'bras ni/ /mgon khyod gzugs sku dri med pad dkar la/ /mchog gsum thugs rje nyal 'gros bskyed bsrings shing / /lung rtogs yon tan du ma'i sbrang rtsis gtams/ /thabs mkhas bsdu bzhi'i dri ngad khor yug ldang / /skal bzang bung ba'i tshogs rnams yid phrogs pas/ /nangs nub kun tu skyo ngal med par 'khor/ /chos zhus sgra dbyangs dar dir sgrog 'dug ces/ /gtam snyan sgra 'dzin bu gar son ma thag /bdag blo'i shing bal dga' ba'i dri bzhon gyis/ /lan gcig ma yin yang yang phyogs bcur bskyod/ /phran chung slob bu bdag kyang rje khyod kyi/ /bka' drin thugs rje'i shel dkar bum bzang las/ /dal 'byor mi lus rin chen kong bu ru/ /bla ma'i gdams ngag 'bru mar sdong ras bkang / /shugs drag brtson pas sgron me sbar ba'i mthus/ /sngar bas nyams rtogs ches cher gsal gyur par/ /mi 'dod rlung gis nam yang ma bskyod pa/ /'di yang bla ma'i bka' drin yin par go /rin chen gser skyogs ma gtogs rab 'phangs pa'i/ /seng ge'i 'o ma lta bu'i zhal gdams dang / /yo byad skyes bcas brtse bas gnang ba rnams//'dir son dga' bde dngos 474

mjal lta bur shar/ /da res mgon la skyabs 'jug zhu ba ni/ /tshe sngon las kyis 'brel ba'i pha bu gnyis/ /sgyu lus dbang gis tha dad snang na yang / /'od gsal chos sku'i klong na ro gcig mod/ /'on kyang skye med btsan sa ma zin stabs/ /khyod sku dri bral pad dkar dran pa'i mod/ /bdag lus bung ba lan brgyar 'phur lding g.yo/ /khyod gsung rab snyan dbyar rnga dran pa'i mod/ /bdag ngag gar mkhan gsol 'debs dar dir bsgrags/ /khyod thugs 'chi med lha lam dran pa'i mod/ /bdag yid 'dab bzang 'dab gshog yang yang brkyangs/ /gson yang bla ma las gzhan skyabs mi 'tshol/ /shi yang re sa bla ma las gzhan med/ /de phyir bu nga byang chub ma thob bar/ /nam yang 'dor med mdzod cig rin po che/ /byang chub thob kyang rigs kyi bdag por bzhugs/ /mgrin pa longs spyod rin chen gser gling nas/ /zhu tshig bzang bo'i nor bu 'di blangs nas/ /kha ba'i mdangs 'dzin lha rdzas gos kyis bklubs/ /khyod phyag mi nub rgyal mtshan rtse ru phul/ /yang yang rnyed dka'i mi lus thob dus 'dir/ /bzang bzang dge sbyor byed pa'i ri ba ngas/ /dung dung snying nas skyabs 'jug zhus pa la/ /'dzum 'dzum dgyes pa'i sgo nas gzigs su gsol/ /'di ltar rje la skyabs 'jug 475

zhus pa'i mthus/ /deng nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob bar/ /brtse chen thugs kyis rjes su 'dzin pa dang / /'di phyi'i bsam don thams cad 'grub par shog /ces pa 'di yang drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo'i zhabs drung du slob bu tshogs drug rang grol gyis mtsho snying nas skyabs 'jug zhus pa'o//sngon smon rta bdun stobs kyis legs dungs bsil ldan bod yul lha lam rgyan/ /gtong ba'i 'od stong 'gyed pa'i bstan 'dzin 'dus sde pad tshal 'dzum rgod shog /'khor 'bangs gling bzhi phan bde'i nyi ma 'od po che/ /sku drin ma las lhag pa'i byams brtse'i mnga' bdag a ba'i zhabs drung du/ /phran chung slob bu bdag gi gus zhu ni/ /gzugs sku rab gsal rta bdun dkyil 'khor la/ /'gal rkyen bar chad chu 'dzin gyis ma bsgribs/ /phan bde'i 'od stong 'gyed bzhin bzhugs yod ces/ /gtam snyan lha yi rnga chen lan mang du/ /brdungs pa yang yang sgra 'dzin gyis thos pas/ /bdag blo'i lha bu gzhon nu dga' spro yi/ /bro gar lan gcig ma yin yang yang 'khrab/ /bdag kyang zla med chos rgyal yab yum gyi/ /bka' drin thugs rje'i gru chen la brten nas/ /'jig rten chos brgyad gting zab rgya mtsho brgal/ /ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal gser gling 476

bsnyegs/ /sku gsum nor bu dgos 'dod char ‘nabebs de/ /blangs nas bdag gzhan re ba skong snyam nas/ /len thabs bla ma'i gdams ngag zab mo yis/ /myur du e lon brtson 'grus byed bzhin yod/ /zhu yig lha bu gzhon nu rab mdzes la/ /spyan gye lha mo mdzes mas legs gzigs phyir/ /dri med lha rdzas na bzas mdzes byas nas/ /mtsho snying lha yul dang mtshungs gnas nas phul/ /zhes pa 'di yang drin can bla ma chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo'i yum la bde zhus kha btags phul dus tshogs drug rang grol gyis bris pa'o//spyir ni rgyal bstan rin chen nam mkha'i rgyan/ /sgos su gdul bya gling bzhi'i mun sel mchog /yang sgos bdag blo'i pad dkar rgyas pa'i gnyen/ /mgon khyod gzugs sku nyi gzhon shar ba'i mod/ /bdag blo'i pad dkar dad spro'i bser bu yis/ /rang dbang med par dga' bro 'khrab tu bcug /phran chung slob bu bdag kyang mgon khyod kyi//skye sngon rnam thar ri mo snying dbus su/ /bkod nas rje la gsol ba 'debs bzhin du/ /da lta dkar bo dge la gzhol bzhin yod/ /mgon khyod gzugs sku nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ /mi 'dod nyer 'tshe lho sprin smug po yis/ /nam yang sgrib med lhang nger gsal ba dang / /bstan dang 'gro don rlabs chen 'byung ba'i phyir/ /rtsa gsum lha dang chos 477

skyong srung ma la/ /gsol 'debs 'phrin bcol nam yang byed par zhu/ /zab zab chos ston drin can bla ma la/ /dung dung snying nas skyabes 'jug zhu ba ni/ /gang gang bdag gi chos mthun ci bsam don/ /de de bzhin du 'grub pa'i dge legs stsol/ /dri med dung mdog dar gyi gshog pa can/ /zhu tshig snyan mo khu byug sngon mo'i bya/ /gnas chen mtsho snying dben pa'i dga' tshal nas/ /khyed phyag dpag bsam shing rtser tshes la 'phur/ /zhes pa 'di yang mkhan chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen byams pa dge legs rgyal mtshan rin po che'i sprul sku la mtshams zhus kha btags phul dus tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//rgyal ba'i gsung rab rab 'byams kun/ /ji bzhin legs shes shes rab kyis/ /blang dor 'byed mkhas mkhas pa'i mchog /bla ma'i byen rlabs rlabs chen stsol/ /mkhas grub skye phreng rim 'dzin pa'i/ /ngur smrig 'chang ba'i dge slong mchog /snying grogs la kha sku skyes sogs/ /grogs po rnams la glu 'di 'bul/ /bla ma'i zhabs pad bsten dus su/ /skyon la nam yang ma rtogs shig /brtags na skyon gyi phung bor mthong / /dag snang mos gus skyed cig ang / /thos pa'i slob gnyer byed dus su/ /rang mthong nga rgyal ma che zhig /che na yon tan yar bskyed med/ /sgo gsum zhi dul gyis shig ang / /grogs dang lhan cig 478

'grogs dus su/ /'gran sems phrag dog ma byed cig /byas na khong khros dam tshig nyams/ /gnyom chung mthun po gyis shig ang / /dben par gcig pur 'dug pa'i tshe/ /grong yul dga' grogs ma dran zhig /dran na dben par 'dug mi tshugs/ /sems nyid nang du khug cig ang / /bsgom la snying rus bskyed dus su/ /tshe 'di'i skyid 'dod ma dran zhig /dran na rnyed bkur phyir du rgyug /dka' spyad sdug khur gyes shig ang / /nyams rtogs rgyud la shar dus su/ /skye bo gzhan la ma bshad cig /bshad na lam rtags yon tan 'grib/ /yengs pa med par sgoms shig ang / /zab lam rdzogs chen bsgom dus su/ /'dre 'dul grong chog ma byed cig /byas na sgom la bar chad mang / /mtshams dam smra bcad gyis shig ang / /mdor na dus rnam thams cad du/ /gnyom chung gyis la ri khrod zungs/ /dman zas za zhing gos hrul gyon/ /tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms shig ang / /chos gos ngur smrig lo mas mdzes/ /chos byed mched grogs pad tshal du/ /chos mthun rnal 'byor rta bdun ngas/ /chos gtam 'od zer 'gyed pa 'dis/ /nyams len rtse dga' rgod pa dang / /nyams med tshul khrims dri zhim rgyas/ /nyams rtogs bcud bzang rab 'khyel nas/ /nyams pa med par gnas par shog /479

ces pa 'di yang grogs po la kha sku skyes sogs sog phyogs kyi grogs po bya btang ri khrod pa rnams la tshogs drug rang grol gyis gnas chen mtsho snying nas brtse ba'i sems kyis phul ba'o//nam 'chi cha med ma dran/ /tshe 'di'i bya bas g.yengs pa'i /snying med smyon pa bdag la/ /bla ma'i thugs rjes gzigs shig /sha ba smug po gzhon rung / /glo bur rngon pas bsad thal/ /shul na lus pa'i yu mo/ /shod du ma 'bab rdza zungs/ /rngon pa nam 'ong mi shes/ /rgyun du btsan sa zungs ya/ /bslebs tshe bros na 'dod kyang / /rngon pas 'bros dbang mi ster/ /nya mo gser mig gzhon rung / /glo bur nya bdas bsad thal//shul na lus pa'i nya chung / /mtsho mtha' ma bskor dkyil zungs/ /nya bda' nam 'ong mi shes/ /rgyun du btsan sa zungs ya/ /bslebs tshe bros na 'dod kyang / /nya 'das 'bros dbang mi ster/ /grogs po na tshod gzhon rung / /glo bur nyid du shi thal/ /shul na lus pa'i bya btang / /grong du ma 'khyams ri zungs/ /'chi bdag nam 'ong mi shes/ /rgyun du lha chos mdzod ya/ /'chi tshe chos byed 'dod kyang / /'chi bas byed dbang mi ster/ /yun ring sdod shom blo rgya/ /ches cher bskyed pa bsgyur nas/ /'chi brod chos byed nus par/ /bla ma'i byin gyes rlobs shig /ces pa 'di yang chos mthun grogs po zhig yod pa glo bur du shi ba thos pas rkyen byas nas tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//thog ma'i mgon kun bzang / /mi gzugs su shar ba'i/ /480

mtshan ldan gyi bla ma/ /chos rgyal la 'dud do/ /rang rigs ni 'gyur med/ /nam mkha' yi dbyings bzhin/ /mtha' dbus ni med par/ /khyab gdal du 'dug go /gang snang gi chos rnams/ /bar snang gi 'ja' bzhin/ /snang stong gi gzigs mor/ /lam lam du shar byung / /rnam rtog kun chu las/ /chu bur ni rdol bzhin/ /shar ba dang grol ba/ /dus mnyam du bud thal/ /chos dbyings kyi thang nas/ /'khor 'das kyi ltad mo/ /sna tshogs pa mthong bas/ /ngo mtshar zhig skyes so/ /chos 'khor dbus padma'i/ /dga' tshal gye rang sems/ /bung ba kho nyams rtogs / /sbrang rtsi'i ros myos nas/ /lta mgur gyi sgra dbyangs/ /snyan mo 'di blangs so/ /dge ba yis 'gro kun/ /'bad med du grol shog /ces pa 'di yang reb gong glu ba tshogs drug rang grol gyis blangs pa'o//bde legs stsol mdzad bla ma rje/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /bde zhus lan du rnal 'byor nga / /bde tshul glu dbyangs len gyes nyon/ /nyams dga' mtsho snying ri bo yi/ yid 'ong rang byung brag phug na/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol bde/ /nye 'brel skyong dgos med pas bde/ /dgon pa'i skyong khur med pas bde/ /phyugs kyi 'tsho skyong med pas bde/ /khe tshong zhing las med pas bde/ /bor stor dogs pa med pas bde/ /481
