sdang dgra'i 'jigs pa med pas bde/ /dbang chen gnya' gnon med pas bde/ /kha mchu rtsod pa med pas bde/ /lus la na tsha med pas bde/ /sems la sdug bsngal med pas bde/ /bde gi snyam na nga bzhin mdzod/ /de skad smras pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /rang gzhan gtan du bde bar shog /ces pa 'di yang slob bu bstan pa phan bdes lo sar zhig gi tshe gcig nangs par bde zhus byas pa'i lan du tshogs drug rang grol gyis blangs pa'o//mtshan ldan bla ma yi g.yu 'brug sngon mo de/ /spyi gtsug 'ja' 'od kyi chu 'dzin gseb tu bzhugs/ /zab rgyas gdams pa yi dbyar rnga sgog bzhin du/ /byen rlabs dngos grub gyi sbrang char 'jam po phobs/ /mi med khye med kyi lung ba stong ba na/ /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi'i dgras mi tshugs rdzong zhig gda'/ /rdzong de 'dzin rgyu zhig byung na dga' ba la/ /rgyun du 'dzin rgyu zhig byung na skyid pa la/ /mi rtag 'chi ba yi rta ra yangs pa na/ /sgrub pa'i brtson 'grus kyi myur mgyogs rta zhig gda'/ /rta der zhon rgyu zhig byung na dga' ba la/ /rgyun du zhon rgyu zhig byung na skyid pa la/ /rtsa gsum 'khor lo yi mdzod khang bzang bo na/ /a shad gtum mo yi dro 'jam gos shig gda'/ /gos de gyon rgyu zhig byung na dga' ba la/ /rgyun du gyon rgyu zhig byung na skyid pa la/ /skye 482

med chos dbyengs kyi bu mo gzhon nu mar/ /rig pa stong gsal gyi gces phrug bu zhig gda'/ /de dang 'grogs rgyu zhig byung na dga' ba la/ /rgyun du 'grogs rgyu zhig byung na skyid pa la/ /rang lus rin po che'i lha khang nyams dga' na/ /stong gsal zhi khro yi lha sku sna tshogs gda'/ /lha tshor mjal rgyu zhig byung na dga' ba la/ /rgyun du mjal rgyu zhig byung na skyid pa la/ /zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis gang shar thol byung du bris pa'o//thog ma'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang / /dus 'dir mi yi tshul 'dzin pa'i/ /sgu drin 'khor med bla ma la/ /da lta mtsho snying dben gnas 'dir/ /mjal ba skal ba shin tu bzang //de ring lo sar tshes gcig la/ /sems la phan pa'i zhal gdams shig /bu la brtse bas gnang bar 'tshal/ /zhes pa slob bu thub bstan rgya mtshos skul tshig tu phul ba 'di'i lan du/rnal 'byor tshogs drug rang grol nga / /glu ba bzang bo ma yin yang //bu khyed glu longs glu longs zer/ /da re don dam glu zhig len/ /kha dog mdzes pa'i 'ja' dang gcig /lho sprin lang long 'khrigs pa gnyis/ /byung yang mkha' las byung ba yin/ /thim yang mkha' la thim par 'gyur/ /rba rlabs chal chol g.yo dang gcig /chu bur sna tshogs byung ba gnyis/ /byung yang mtsho 483

las byung ba yin/ / thim yang mtsho la thim par 'gyur/ /kha dog sngo ljang rtswa dang gcig /yal 'dab rgyas pa'i ljon shing gnyis/ /byung yang sa las byung ba yin/ /thim yang sa la thim par 'gyur/ /bde skyid dag pa'i zhing dang gcig /sdug bsngal che ba'i 'khor ba gnyis/ /byung yang sems las byung ba yin/ /thim yang sems la thim par 'gyur/ /rtogs na chos rnams sems kyi 'phrul/ /sems nyid rtogs na sangs rgyas yin/ /sems la bltas pas mthong ba med/ /mthong med dper na nam mkha' 'dra/ /'khor 'das re dogs gnyis spongs la/ /gnas lugs stong gsal chos dbyings kyi/ /ngang du glod la mer gyis sdod/ /go 'am skal ldan snying gi bu/ /zhes blangs pa'o//rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /khyed rgyang nas 'ongs pa'i skal ldan bu/ /da tshe mjug 'di la 'di bzhin mdzod/ /dus da lta'i gnyen grogs kun gyes bslu/ /tshe 'di ni yud tsam zad nas 'gro/ /nor zas gos gang la'ang ma chags par/ /rje rgyal ba gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin//tshe 'di yi bya ba blo yis thongs/ /gnas yid 'ong ri bo mthon po'i ngos/ /spang me tog nags tshal khor yug can/ /yid bag phebs ri dwags rgyu zhing rtse/ /mdog rab mdzes bya bye'u 484

'phur lding g.yo/ /rkang drug ldan sgra dbyangs sgog pa la/ /gzhan che chung mi yi long gtam gyi/ /sgra nam yang mi thos sa ru song / /gos ngan ngon 'tsho ba bsod snyoms gyes//rdo'i khang ba rang byung nyams dga' ru/ /lus grib ma'i grogs dang lhan cig tu/ /chos dbu rdzogs phyag chen gang yin yang / /dus khor yug nyams su len nus na/ /nang sems la nyams rtogs nyi ma 'char/ /zhesapa 'di yang rdzogs chen dgon gyi slob bu sangs rgyas chos 'phel gyis zhal gdams shig dgos zhes bskul ngor tshogs drug rang grol gyis mtsho snying nas smras pa'o// bla ma dkon mchog gsum gtan gye skyabs su 'dzin/ /thos bsam sgom gsum gang la brtson 'grus che/ /lus ngag yid gsum nyes pa'i skyon ma gos/ /rnam dag bslab gsum rgyan ldan mgon khyod drung / /nyam chung lus 'di rtag par re ba'i blos/ /don chung tshe 'di'i bya bas tshe phyed shor/ /phran chung rwa rgya'i byams pa zla 'od kyis/ /yig chung sgo gsum gus pas 'bul 'bras ni/ /sngon bsags bsod nams dpag med las grub pa'i/ /mgon khyod gzugs sku 'od gsal rta bdun de/ /mi 'dod nyer 'tshe sprin gyis ma bsgribs par/ /lhang nger bzhugs zhes gtam snyan 'od stong de/ /bdag blo'i padmo'i tshal du lhung ma thag /dga' dad gnyis kyi 'dzum rgod dbang med shor/ /chos 485

sems gnyis ka rgyab 'gal so sor btang / /chos gos rnam gsum 'chang nas tshe 'di yi/ /chos brgyad dkar nag khra gsum g.yog byed pa'i/ /chos pa'i gzugs brnyan bdag kyang bde bar mchis/ /sgom chen khyed kyi rnam thar bzang bo la/ /kha tsam min par rjes su yi rangs byas/ /khyed la zhi gnas rtogs pa zhig skyes yod/ /zer ba e bden bden na ngo mtshar che/ /da dung nyams len phyogs re de tsam gyis/ /thugs tshim ma gnang nges 'byung byang sems dang / /yang dag lta ba rim gnyis la sogs la/ /bag chags zhog ces thal sbyar gsol ba 'debs/ /rab gus zhu 'bul 'phrin yig dam pa 'di/ /rab 'jam lha rdzas dar gyes rab brgyan te/ /rab mang 'du 'dzis dben pa'i ri sul nas/ /rab dkar dad pa'i sems kyis dge bar phul/ /zhes pa 'di yang sku drin 'khor med mkhan chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen byams pa dge legs rgyal mtshan rin po che'i thugs kyi sras mchog lung rtogs yon tan du mas rgyud yongs su gtams pa'i grogs po byams pa zla 'od kyis bdag la bskur bas de'i lan du/bde zhing nyams dga'i ri khrod rgyal mtshan rtse'i/ /bde legs stsol mdzad bla ma yid bzhin nor/ /bde ba 'dod kyang bde rgyu sgrub ma shes/ /bde bas phongs pa'i dbul bo bdag la dgongs/ /mgon khyod sngon sbyangs bag chags shin tu bzang / /bzang bo'i chos mdzad yongs la chung nas dad/ /dad gus 486

bzang bos mtshan ldan bla ma yang / /yang dag bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin bsten/ /skyon med dal 'byor rnyed dka' don che dang / /long med 'chi ba 'di la thugs 'jigs nas/ /don med tshe 'di'i mi nor zas gsum dang / /skyid med pha yul btson ra rgyab tu spangs/ /'jigs rung ngan song g.yang sar rab 'jigs nas/ /'jigs las skyob mkhan mchog gsum skyabs su bsten/ /'jig rten 'di ru sdug spangs dge ba bsgrubs//'jigs pa med pa'i dpa' gdeng khyod kyis rnyed/ /phyi mar rnam smin brgyad ldan lus thob pa'i/ /rgyu de rnams kyang da lta sgru ba la brtson/ /sdig ltung rnams ni 'dag thabs stobs bzhi yi/ /bshags pa rnam dag mdzad pa ya mtshan che/ /srid rtse nas bzung dmyal ba yan chad kyi/ /sred gsum gnas rnams me mur 'obs ltar mthong / /srid pa'i bde la mngon zhen gting nas log /srid las thar 'dod shugs drag thugs la 'khrungs/ /thar dka' 'khor ba'i me dong chen po las/ /thar thabs bslab gsum them skas la brten te/ /thar bar dka' ba'i 'khor ba'i me dong nas/ /thar ba'i dong khar bsnyegs la mgran zla su/ /ma rig nyon mongs dbang song sdug myong ba'i/ /ma gyur 'gro ba'i don du thugs bskyed nas/ /ma rabs spyod ngan spangs nas rgyal 487

sras spyod/ /ma lus sgrub la brtson pa 'di rmad byung / /g.yo med zhi gnas yol bas rnam rtog rlung / /'ong med bkag nas lhag mthong sgron me sbar/ /thog med nas 'grogs bdag 'dzin mun pa bsal/ /bdag med logs bris gzigs pa e ma ho/ /gsang sngags nyams su len mkhan bla ma la/ /gsang sngags dbang bzhi tshad ldan sngon du zhus/ /gsang sngags gzhung bzhin dam tshig legs bsrungs nas/ /gsang sngags rim gnyis sgom pa skal ba bzang / /dben par drang srong gcig pur gnas pa bzhin/ /dben zhing nyams dga' gong mas byen brlabs pa'i/ /dben gnas gangs rdza g.ya' brag nags khrod sogs/ /dben pa'i gnas su mdo sngags nyams len byas/ /de ltar mgon khyod nyams su blangs pa'i tshe/ /tshe ring nad med lus sems rtag tu bde/ /bde 'gro'i lus rten 'di la ring min du/ /du ma'i nyams rtogs thugs la 'khrungs pa'i mthus/ /log pa'i lam du zhugs pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /ma nor lam du rim gyis 'khrid la mkhas/ /mdo sngags lam gyi rim pa mthar phyin pa'i/ /'khrul med lam ston dge ba'i bshes gnyen mchog /khyod thugs shel dkar bum bzang las thon pa'i/ /legs bshad rab dkar seng ge'i 'o ma de/ /bde 'jam dar dkar lam bzang legs brgyud 488

nas/ /bdag blo'i dngul dkar bum stong nang du son/ /mdo sngags gnyis kyi lam gnad zhal gdams 'di/ /rgyu nom gnyis med bdag la 'phrod ma thag /dad gus gnyis kyis dbang med yid g.yos nas/ /lag pa gnyis kyi sor bcu spyi bor khyer/ /mi med ri khrod dben pa'i brag khung du/ /chos med byi ba tshang nyal lta bu nga / /zla med bla ma khyod kyis thugs brtse bas/ /'khrul med legs bshad gnang ba bka' drin che/ /dben gnas rnams su dmigs rten ka ba la/ /mi gnas 'gro ba'i rang sems glang spyom de/ /e gnas dran shes thag pas btags pa bden/ /zhi gnas rjes mthun tsam zhig e thob snyam/ /nyams dga'i ri khrod dpen par mdo sngags chos/ /nyams su len mkhan mgon khyod snyan khung du/ /nyams la yar bsgyed med ngas zhu rgyu kun/ /nyams med sdom ldan slob bu'i ngag na gsal/ /dung dung snying nas snyigs dus 'gro mgon la/ /lhang lhang gdungs pa'i dbyangs kyis gsol ba 'debs/ /'dzum 'dzum dgyes pa'i sgo nas ri ba ngar/ /bzang bzang zhal gdams mang bo da dung gnongs/ /dam gtsang grogs dang 'grog gam gcig pu ru/ /dam tshig sdom pa tshul bzhin legs bsrungs nas/ /dam chos mdo sngags nyams su len pa la/ /dam pa khyod dang mtshungs par byen gyes 489

rlobs/ /yid gnyis je tshom med par nyams blangs mthus/ /tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs sgrib gnyis ma lus byang / /sku gnyis go 'phang myur du 'thob gyur nas/ /don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par byen gyis rlobs/ /chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i rnam thar bzhin/ /chos bzhin 'khor 'bangs sde rnams legs skyong zhing / /chos la thos bsam sgom gsum mdzad pa yi/ /chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo'i slob bu nga / /dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar ji bzhin du/ /du ma'i ri khrod dben pa'i gnas rnams su/ /su dang ma 'phrad gcig pur bsdad pas skyid/ /skyid pa'i shugs kyis gus pa'i zhu yig 'di/ /lha chos byed mkhan mgon khyod zhabs drung du/ /lha klu la sogs dkar phyogs pa gnas pa'i/ /lha yul dang mtshungs gnas chen mtsho snying nas/ /lha rdzas dri med dang bcas zla tshes phul//pha chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bor 'dud/ /bu'i lus sems bde bar byin gyis rlobs/ /yul pha yul steng nas zhe sdang 'byung / /ngas da lta rgyab tu spangs pas bde/ /gnyen nye 'brel steng nas gdung sems 'byung / /ngas da lta ltag pa bstan pas bde/ /rgyu nom pa'i steng nas ser sna 'byung / /ngas da lta gsog 'jog ma byas bde/ /zas zhim mngar steng nas 'dod sred 490

'byung / /ngas da lta ngan ngon zos pas bde/ /grong dgon sde'i steng nas rnam g.yeng 'byung / /ngas da lta ri khrod 'grims pas bde/ /'khor grwa slob steng nas chags sdang 'byung / /nga da lta gcig pur bsdad pas bde/ /nga rnal 'byor bde tshul glu dbyangs 'di/ /gang thos tshad bde zhing skyid par shog /ces pa 'di yang bde zhus zhig gi lan du tshogs drug rang grol gyis gnas chen khyad 'phags mtsho snying nas smras pa'o//mtshan ldan bla ma de zhing khams gzhan du gshegs/ /chung 'dris chos mthun grogs glo bur nyid du shi /sprang rgan rang nyid ni dben pa'i ri la lus/ /mtshan ldan bla ma de bsten pa skad cig tsam/ /chos mthun grogs po dang 'grogs pa skad cig tsam/ /gdams ngag zhu 'phro dang kha ta byed 'phro lus/ /rgyun du bsten rgyu zhig byung na dga' ba la/ /rgyun du 'grogs rgyu zhig byung na spyid pa la/ /tshong 'dus mgon po bzhin yud tsam 'tshogs nas bral/ /'khor ba'i mtshan nyid de bsams nas skyo ba skyes/ /zas nor longs spyod la smon pa mi 'ong gi /snying bo'i lha chos shig byed 'dod snying la shar/ /zhes pa 'di yang drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho rin po che gshegs pa dang / snying grogs rdo rje tshe brtan shi ba thos pas rkyen byas nas sems la skyo shas drag po skyes tshe tshogs drug rang grol gyis mtsho snying nas smras pa'o//drin can chos rgyal zhabs la 'dud/ /dad ldan bu yis 491

'jig rten gye/ /chos brgyad dkar nag khra gsum rnams/ /blo yis thongs par byen gyis rlobs/ /sngon sbyangs las kyi 'phro sad pa'i/ /skal ldan snying gi bu mchog po/ /bya btang seng bzang rgya mtsho la/ /brtse bas yi ge bskur ba'i don/ /bu khyod bskur ba'i yi ge rnams/ /ma nyams pha yi lag tu son/ /dge slong sdom pa mnos pa dang / /dbang lung mang bo thob pa la/ /dga' spro tshad las 'das pa sgyes/ /bdag kyang gzugs phung bde ba'i ngang / /dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' bzhin du/ /nyams len yar ngo'i zla bzhin du/ /gong nas gong du spel bzhin yod/ /da ni skal ldan bu khyod la/ /pha rgan kha ta tshig 'ga' bshad/ /mos gus gdung bas gsan par 'tshal/ /tshe srog chu yi lbu ba 'dra/ /nam 'chi cha yang mi 'dug pas/ /do nub yin yang 'chi nyen yod//ha cang blo rgya ma che bar/ /do nub 'chi rung mi 'gyod pa'i//gdeng zhig myur du e rnyed ltos/ /snyigs dus dmu rgod sems can la/ /phan pa'i dam chos bshad na yang / /phan thogs chen po mi 'byung bar/ /sgo skur mang bo 'ongs pa'i phyir/ /de bas lung stong la sogs pa/ /shin tu dben pa'i ri khrod du/ /gcig pur sgrub la gzhol nus na/ /'gro don de gas 'ong ba yin/ /bu khyod 'gro don zer ba yi/ /'a 'ur 'du 'dzis nyin mtshan gnyis/ /'da' ru bcug 492

yod thos pa'i mod/ /pha rgan tshogs drug rang grol nga'i/ /sems la dga' skyo sna tshogs shar/ /gnas gcig spor dgos na yang sgor/ /min yang mtshams bcad 'dag 'byar gyis/ /nyin mtshan med par nyams len la/ /brtson 'grus me bzhin rab tu sbor/ /kha ni ja chang chos spyod la/ /ma dga' rtag tu khregs chod dang / /thod rgal gnyis la nan tan mdzod/ /da nas bzung ste skal ldan bu/ /chos brgyad dkar nag khra gsum rnams/ /rang 'thag chu bcad bzhin du thongs/ /da dung skal ldan bu khyod nyon/ /gcig pur sgrub la gzhol nus na/ /nyams rtogs nyi ma khong nas 'char/ /tshe ring tshe sgrub byed mi dgos//tshe mjug 'di la bu khyod kyis/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka 'tshengs pa yi/ /lam mchog myur du rnyed dam snyam/ /bshad pa gtso cher byas gyur na/ /lus dang sems la duḥ kha dang / /tshe la gegs kyang cung zad cig /'ongs ang snyam pa sems la shar/ /de phyir tshe sgrub tshe thar thongs/ /bla ma'i bka' bzhin sgrub la rem/ /gzhan yang yang slob thams cad kyis/ /bu khyod gtsug gi rgyan du bsten/ /theg pa kun gyi mchog gyur pa/ /lam bzang rdzogs pa chen po yi/ /sngon 'gro tshad ldan btang ba la/ /dga' spro yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel/ /da ni yang slob skal ldan rnams/ /legs par mthong bas mos gus 493

gyis/ /ci gsung bka' bzhin bsgrub par 'tshal//tshe 'di'i bya ba blos thongs la/ /tshe 'dir gtan gyi btsan sa zhig /zin pa'i thabs la kun gyis rem//ngas kyang slob ma yang slob kyi/ /rgyud la nyams rtogs yon tan rnams/ /myur du skye ba'i dmigs pa dang / /sgrub la bar chad med pa yi/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs rnams la/ /'phrin las bcol ba la sogs pa/ /byed pas kun gyi sems la zhog /dga' zhing spro bzhin nyams len la/ /nyin mtshan med par 'bad nus na//slob bu yang slob shes rgyud la/ /nyams rtogs nyi ma myur du 'char/ /dge 'dis skal ldan slob ma dang //yang slob dad ldan thams cad kun/ /seṅge rgod kyi phru gu bzhin/ /pha bas lhag pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di ni snying gi bu mchog seng bzang rgya mtsho la bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis mtsho snying dben gnas nas bskur ba'o// dpag bsam shing dang nor bu rin chen ltar/ /ci 'dod dngos grub ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /drin can bla ma'i zhabs la gus pas 'dud/ /skal ldan grogs mched yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /pha yul bdud kyi btson ra'i nang nas thon/ /btson srung nye 'brel yongs la ltag pa bstan/ /dben pa'i ri nas snyan pa'i glu len pa'i/ /glu ba tshogs drug rang grol ming 494

can ngas/ /zho 'ong grogs rnams rna ba'i mdzod khang du/ /glu dbyangs bzang bo'i nor bu rin chen 'bul/ /dam pa'i lha chos byed lugs mang na yang / /zab lam gdams pa bsgom pa skal ba bzang / /rtse gcig bla med byang chub sgrub dus su/ /tshe 'di'i 'jig rten chos brgyad don ma sgrubs/ /bsgrubs na nyams len byed la khom dus med/ /ma khom rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob mi 'gyur/ /drin can bla ma'i zhabs tog byed dus su/ /ngas byas snyam pa'i khong yus ma che zhig /che na drin can bla ma'i thugs mi mnyes/ /ma mnyes nyams rtogs yon tan skye mi 'gyur/ /rdo rje spun grogs lhan cig tshogs dus su/ /gral mgo mtho dang kha rgan ma 'dod cig /'dod chags zhe sdang skyes nas dam tshig 'khrug /'khrugs na dge sbyor gang byas lam mi 'gro/ /dam tshig sdom pa tshul bzhin srung ba'i dus/ /mi nag pho mo'i drung du ma nyal cig /nyal na 'dod chags zhe sdang sna tshogs skye/ /skyes na dam tshig sdom pa dbang med 'chor/ /ri khrod dben pa'i ri la sdod dus su/ / grong gi ltad mo nam yang ma dran cig /dran na dben pa'i ri la sdod mi thub/ /ma thub grong du khye ldom bzhin du 'khyam/ /chos la thos bsam sgom gsum gang byed kyang / /rang mthong nga rgyal khengs pa ma skyes shig /skyes na nyon mongs dug 495

lnga'i me ro ldang / /langs na yon tan yar bskyed cung zad med//nyams rtogs yon tan nyag nyug skye dus su/ /brjod 'dod rang rtsis ma che khog tu sbos//brjod na ma dang mkha' 'gro thugs mi dgyes/ /ma dgyes lam rtags yon tan skyes pa 'grib/ /grong du 'tsho ba'i phyir du ldom pa'i dus/ /chos zog rkyang bas mi mgo ma skor cig /bskor na phyi mar ngan song gsum du skye//skyes na sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa myong / /mdor na dam pa'i lha chos sgrub dus su/ /tshe 'di'i 'dod pa ha cang ma che zhig /che na mi tshe yad ma yud la 'chor/ /shor na 'chi tshe 'gyod pa skye bar 'gyur/ /'di dag blo ldan grogs po khyed rnams la/ /ma bshad na yang sa ler rab shes mod/ /'on kyang gangs la nyi ma phog pa na/ /sngon las rab tu dkar la 'gal ba ci/ /bar tu sra zhing 'khyags pa'i chab rom steng / /rta bdun 'od stong yang yang lhung ba na//gzi brjid mi bzod zhu nas chur 'gro ltar//dad ldan zho 'ong grogs mched khyed rnams la/ /yang yang nga yis chos la bskul ba'i mthus/ /tshig ka ma bzod tshe 'di blos btang nas//dben par dam chos sgrub phyir 'gro bar shog /ces pa 'di yang reb gong smad kyi bya btang ri khrod pa kha bde sems skyid kyis zho 'ong grogs po rnams la mtsho snying nas brtse ba'i sems kyis bris pa'o//496

mi nga'i skyabs mgon bla ma rje/ /mi 'brel spyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs/ /mi rnams blo kha chos la sgyur/ /mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad sol//bya btang chogs drug rang grol ngas//ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i dge slong mchog /snying grogs ngag dbang mchog ldan sogs/ /grogs po rnams la snying gtam bshad/ /mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma ni/ /sangs rgyas dngos su legs mthong nas/ /rtag tu bsam dang sbyor ba yis/ /tshul bzhin sten cig snying gi grogs/ /mi lus rin chen thob dus 'dir/ /gtan bde byed dam gtan sdug byed/ /da lta rang dbang yod dus 'dir/ /gtan bde sgrubs shig snying gi grogs/ /skyes pa'i tha ma nges par 'chi/ /nam 'chi cha med 'chi dus su/ /lha chos ma gtogs skyabs med pas/ /dam chos sgrubs shig snying gi grogs/ /ngan song gsum gye sdug bsngal rnams/ /myong dgos byung na tshugs thabs med/ /skyob mkhan bslu med dkon mchog gsum/ /skyabs su sten cig snying gi grogs/ /dge sdig chung ngu yin yang rung / /phyi mar rnam smin shin tu che/ /dge ba'i las la 'bad pa dang / /sdig pa spongs shig snying gi grogs/ /mi dge sdig ltung sngar bsags rnams/ /bshags pa'i thabs mchog stobs bzhi yin/ /nyi ma re re dzee bzhin du/ /bshags sdom mdzod cig snying gi grogs/ /'khor 497

ba'i gnas na bde ba med/ /rang sems cang shes rta pho la/ /bslab gsum sga srab glo 'then nas/ /thar lam bgrod cig snying gi grogs/ /khams gsum sems can thams cad ni/ /pha mar ma gyur gcig kyang med/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems/ /yang yang sgoms shig snying gi grogs/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi spyod pa'i mchog /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus/ /bsam gtan shes rab bsdu dngos bzhi/ /nan tan slobs shig snying gi grogs/ /mtshan ldan bla mar gsang sngags kyi/ /'jug sgo dbang dang byen rlabs zhus//dbang dus khas blangs dam tshig rnams/ /tshul bzhin srungs shig snying gi grogs/ /zeg pa kun gyi mchog gyur pa/ /lam zab bskyed rim rdzogs rim dang / /rdzogs chen khregs chod thod rgal la/ /nyams len mdzod cig snying gi grogs/ /de ltar nyams su len pa'i tshe/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blos thongs la/ /la lung brag khung mgo ris bsten/ /bsten nas rtse gcig nyams su longs/ /gtam 'di mtsho snying ri bo nas/ /dad ldan snying grogs rnams la smras/ /smras pa bzhin du nyams blangs nas/ /tshe mjug don ldan mdzad nus shog /ces pa 'di ni bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis mtsho snying lha yul gnyis pa nas khrel yod ngo tsha dad gtong tshul khrims thos pa shes rab kyi nor dang ldan pa'i don gyi phyug po snying grogs ngur sprig 'chang ba'i dge slong ngag dbang mchog ldan sogs mched grogs yongs la brtse ba'i sems kyis smras pa'o//498

bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa shākya thub/ /bod yul mun sel nyi ma blo bzang grags/ /reb gong sgron me skal ldan rgya mtsho sogs/ /sngon byon mkhas grub du ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /sngon smon las kyis 'brel ba'i snying gi grogs/ /dben gnas bkra shis 'khyel ba'i rtse mo yi/ /dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i snyan lam du/ /grogs po nga yis snyan pa'i glu zhig 'bul/ /mkhas grub du ma'i skye phreng rim 'dzin pa'i/ /sa gsum zla med sgu gzhogs rin po ches/ /brtse bas chos dang zang zing gnyis ka yis/ /yang yang drin gyis bskyangs pa'i tshul soms la/ /ci gsung bka' bzhin sgrubs dang ci bsam 'grub/ /bla ma dge bskul dbu mdzad rgan rnams kyis/ /'grig lam kun spyod bcas pa ji bzhin du/ /byas na sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin de la zer/ /'grig lam kun spyod mi brtsi rgyab 'gal na/ /sangs rgyas bstan bshig zer ba gzhan na gang / /de phyir skal ldan snying gi grogs po tsho/ /dngos dang lkog nas drin can bla ma la//gshe shing skur 'debs ngan smra skyon rtog spongs/ /dge 'dun nang khrims rgan gzhon kun gyis rtsis/ /rtag tu dge 'dun sde rnams thugs mthun sgos/ /bshad dang sgrub pa'i bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zungs/ /de ltar bzung na phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang / /bla ma yi dam 499

mkha' 'gro chos skyong gis/ /dbang bsgur byin brlabs mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /dkar phyogs lha rnams kun gyis sdongs grogs byed/ /dge 'dun sde rnams yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel/ /ci bsam don rnams 'bad med lhun gyes 'grub/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan pa dpag med 'byung / /dge 'dis skal ldan snying gi grogs rnams kyis/ /bshad dang sgrub pa'i bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan de/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i yu ba la brten nas/ /thugs mthun sgo nas mi nub 'dzin par shog /ces pa 'di yang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis bkra shis 'khyil ba'i grogs po rnams la mtsho snying nas smras pa'o//pha rgan chos rgyal ngag gi dbang / /rje btsun 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho dang / /drin can sngags 'chang rdo rjer 'dud/ /grogs mched blo kha chos la sgyur/ /pha yul me mur 'obs nas thon/ /ri khrod dben pa'i bsil grib na/ /nyams rtogs bdud rtsis rab myos pa'i/ /kun spangs tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /sha nye snying grogs bande la/ /brtse ba'i sems kyis glu 'di 'bul/ /rnyed dka'i mi lus thob na yang / /tshe 'di'i bya bas rtag g.yengs pa'i/ /snying grogs phal cher chos med du/ /glo bur shi ba thos pa'i mod/ /chung dus 'grogs pa'i snying grogs khyod/ /chos med 'chi la rab phangs nas/ /snying nas kha ta tshig 'ga' smra/ /dung 500

ba'i sems kyis ma yengs nyon/ /mi lus g.yang mo lug dkar la/ /lo dang zla ba'i pho nya yis/ /zhag dang za mas brdungs nas ded/ /'chi bdag gshin rje'i bshan pas bskor/ /skad cig mi sdod phar phar 'gro/ /'jigs rung gshin rje'i bshan pa yi/ /zhal du myur du gsol la khad/ /da lta ma gsol gong 'di ru/ /'bros na dben pa'i ri la phros/ /nyin mo rnam g.yeng le lo byas/ /mtshan mo gti mug gnyid du song / /tshe phyed zad pa ma tshor ram/ /tshe lhag ci tsam yod mi shes/ /'chi bdag bdud ni nam 'ong med/ /do nub yin yang 'ong nyen yod/ /de dus 'gyod kyang phan pa med/ /de bas da lta 'chi na yang / /mi 'gyod chos shig bya snyam na/ /nye 'brel 'ching ba'i zhags nag 'dra/ /bcings pa btsan grol myur du gyis/ /zas nor rtswa kha'i zil ba 'dra/ /ser sna ma byed sbyin pa thongs/ /'dod yon lan tshwa'i chu dang 'dra/ /ngoms pa med pas chog shes mdzod/ /chung ma srin mo'i bslu brid 'dra/ /bslu bar nges pas dogs zon gyis/ /pha yul bdud kyi btson dong 'dra/ /nga phyir myur du bros la shog /thams cad 'chi tshe 'jog dgos pas/ /da lta bzhag na don chen 'grub/ /mi gtsang phyis pa'i rdo bzhin du/ /da lta da lta bskyur la shog /'di bzhin snying grogs nyan spyod na/ /lha chos byed pa'i 501

skal ba yod/ /sha tsha'i gtam 'di grogs kyi mchog /sha nye blo ldan bande yis/ /sha rkyang rtse ba'i ri sul du/ /sha stag nyams len byed nus shobag /ces pa 'di ni tshogs drug rang grol gyis snying grogs sha nye bande la snying gtam mtsho snying dben pa'i ri nas smras pa'o//nyes pa'i skyon rnams kun dang bral/ /yon tan ma lus yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /drin can bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /'khor ba'i btson ra rgyab tu bskyur/ /ma nor lam lton bla ma la/ /brten nas thar ba'i grong khyer du/ /'gro 'dod 'dun pa drag po sgyes/ /brtson 'grus myur ba'i rta pho la/ /nges 'byung lcag gis yang yang brabs/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhabs drung bsnyeg /las 'phro can rnams tshur nyon dang / /bde chen shar ba'i grong khyer du/ /'khrid mkhan bla ma dam pa la/ /ji ltar bltas nas bsten snyam na/ /bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su blta/ /de yi rgyu mtshan gang zer na/ /rgyu mtshan rnga bo che'i mdo las/ /mya ngan ma byed kun dga' bo/ /nga ni phyi ma'i dus su ni/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyid sprul nas/ /khyod la sogs pa'i don byed 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa dang kye rdor las/ /phyi ma'i dus su gyur pa na/ /nga nyid slob dpon gzugs kyi sku/ /zhes gsungs pa dang dpa' bos kyang / /slob dpon dang ni rdo rje 'dzin/ /tha dad par ni mi 502

brtag go /zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pas so/ /bla ma sangs rgyas dngos nyid du/ /bltas na ji ltar mchod zer na/ /mchod tshul bla ma lnga bcu par/ /'dir mang smras pa ci zhig dgos/ /bla ma dgyes byed gang yin bya/ /mi mnyes byed kun spangs pa ni/ /de dang de la 'bad de brtag /dngos grub slob dpon rjes 'brang zhes/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid gsungs par/ /shes nas dngos po thams cad kyis/ /bla ma yongs su mnyes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa dang rang shar las/ /de ltar man ngag slob dpon la/ /rang lus dang ni rin chen rdzas/ /shin tu dkon pa dag gis bsten/ /zhes gsungs pa dang thal 'gyur las/ /man ngag lung gi slob dpon la/ /khu bo pha dang ma dang mig /rin chen bu chung nor gye dbyeg /rab tu gces dang yid 'thad dbul/ /zhes dang lnga bcu pa las kyang / /rang gi dam tshig slob dpon ni/ /sbyin min bu dang chung ma dang / /rang srog gis rtag bsten byas na/ /longs spyod g.yo ba smos ci dgos/ /zhes pa la sogs gsungs bzhin no/ /de ltar tshul bzhin mchod byas na/ /phan yon ci 'dra 'byung zer na/ /mchod pa'i phan yon de nyid las/ /de byin sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /rtag tu phul ba nyid du 'gyur/ /de phul bsod nams tshogs yin te/ /tshogs las 503

dngos grub mchog tu 'gyur/ /zhes dang ye shes rgya mtsho las/ /rang gi rdzas dang yo byad kyis/ /bla ma mnyes par sus byas pa/ /'dis ni khams gsum 'khor ba las/ /sprul sku'i zhing du dbugs dbyung nas/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i sar gshegs so/ /zhes dang sam bhu ṭa'i rgyud las/ /gang phyir phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i bsod nams pas/ /slob dpon ba spu'i khung gcig mchog /de phyer slob dpon mchod byed pa/ / sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpas gzigs/ /zhes dang dgongs pa 'dus pa las/ /des na sangs rgyas stong phrag la/ /bskal pa stong du mchod byas pas/ /bla ma'i ba spu'i khung re la/ /tsandan thigs pa gcis byugs pa/ /stong phrag char yang phod pa min/ /zhes dang me lce phreng ba las/ /gal te rnal 'byor blo can gyis/ /rang zas gos la gyong bskur nas/ /bla ma rdo je mchod pa ni/ /zhing gi khor yug rgyal khams na/ /dge slong dpag tu med pa la/ /ston mo lan stong byas pa bas /zas sam yang na gos kyang rung / /bla ma lan cig mchod pa yi/ /bsod nams brgya phrag brjod mi rdzogs/ /zhes dang rdo rje ro langs las/ /gang gi bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /bza' btung phud kyis rtag tu mchod/ /'dir yang bza' btung 'phel ba dang / /'khor los 504

sgyur rgyal 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang yon tan bdud rtsi yi/ /rgya mtsho 'byung ba'i rgyud las kyang / /nam mkha' gang ba'i sangs rgyas la/ /sna tshogs rin chen spungs pa yis/ /stong gsum gang bar phul ba bas/ /bla ma/'i ba spu nyag gcig la/ /mar gyi thigs pa gcig byugs pa/ /bsod nams brgya phrag char mi phod/ /zhes dang rdo rje snying bo ni/ /sra ba 'byung gnas rgyud las kyang / /bla ma rtag tu bsten pa'i mis/ /mkha' 'gro'i gzugs rnams mthong ba dang / /de yi byen rlabs 'jug pa dang / /dus gsum lung yang ston pa dang / /skye shi gnyis la dbang thob 'gyur//zhes dang gzhan yang de nyid las/ /bla ma bsnyen bkur byas pa'i mi/ /longs spyod mchog dang ldan pa dang / /'khor 'dab rgyas shing bsod nams ldan/ /'gro ba yongs las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang rdo rje me lce las/ /bla ma nyid dang bla ma'i 'khor/ /nye 'khor g.yog dang bcas pa la/ /gser la sogs pa'i yon phul na/ /sangs rgyas zhing khams brjod med pa'i/ /gtso 'khor 'bum phrag grangs med la/ /bsnyen bkur mchod pa grangs med pas/ /bsod nams 'di ni char mi phod/ /ces gsungs sogs la dgongs nas kyang / /'gro ba'i mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ /mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs nas/ /bla ma mchod pa yang dag 505

brtsams/ /de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen gye/ /ye shes mchog de 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang gzhan yang bla ma nyid/ /bsgom dang dran dang gsol 'debs na/ /phan yon a ti bkod pa las/ /gang gis bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /snying gi dkyil dang spyi bo'i gtsug /yan lag mthil du gang bsgoms pa/ /sangs rgyas stong gi yon tan de/ /gang zag de yis 'dzin par 'gyur/ /zhes dang dam tshig bkod pa las/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa'i lha/ /bskal pa 'bum du bsgoms pa bas/ /bla ma dran pa 'bum char min/ /bsnyen sgrub bzlas pa sa ya bas/ /bla ma'i gsol 'debs lan gcig dga'/ /zhes dang gzhan yang bla ma yi/ /ci gsung bka' ni ma bcag na/ /chos skyong srung ma rnams kyis kyang / /bar chad gnod tshe thams cad las/ /skyob cing dgongs pa 'dus pa las/ /bka' zur ma bcag chos bsrungs na/ /chos skyong srung ma mthu chen rnams/ /bu bzhin rtag tu bsrung bar byed/ /ces sogs phan yon mtha' yas so/ /bla ma smad dang thugs dkrug sogs/ /byas na nyes pa ci zer na/ /nyes dmigs bla ma lnga bcu par/ /slob dpon la ni smod pa de/ /yams dang mdze dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang rims dang dug rnams kyis/ /rmongs chen de ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /rgyal po me dang sbrul 506

gdug dang / /chu dang mkha' 'gro rkun po dang / /gdon dang log 'dren rnams kyis kyang / /bsad nas sems can dmyal bar 'gro/ /nam yang slob dpon dag gis ni/ /kun tu sems dkrug mi bya ste/ /gal te rmongs pas byas gyur na/ /dmyal bar nges par 'tshod par 'gyur/ /mnar med la sogs 'jigs rung ba'i/ /dmyal ba bstan pa gang yin pa/ /slob dpon la ni smod pa rnams/ /der ni gnas par yang dag bshad/ /ces dang dgra nag bka' 'grel du/ /drangs pa las kyang 'di skad gsungs/ /tshigs bcad gcig tsam nyan pa las/ /gang gis bla mar mi 'dzin na/ /khye yi skye ba brgya blangs nas/ /spe sha can du skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang khyad par bla ma la/ /dmigs nas khong khro sgyes pa na/ /bskal par bsags pa'i dge rtsa 'joms/ /khong khro skad cig ci tsam zhig /sgyes pa'i grangs dang mnyam pa yi/ /bskal par dmyal bar sdod dgos zhes/ /dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las gsungs phyir/ /sngar byas yod rnams bshags pa dang / /phyin chad mi mnyes bya ba spongs/ /mdor na bla ma mnyes byas na/ /gong du bshad pa'i phan yon rnams/ /'byung 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /bla ma mi mnyes bya ba rnams/ /spangs nas sngar bshad nyes pa rnams/ /rmi lam du yang myong mi 'gyur/ /tshe 'dir 507

bde la phyi mar skyid/ /myur du sangs rgyas 'thob par 'gyur/ /nyin mtshan kun tu dam chos 'di/ /kha ton gyes la yang yang soms/ /zhes pa 'di yang dad ldan slob ma grwa ba 'ga' la phan du re nas tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//rje btsun mi la la sogs pa'i/ /dben pa'i gnas su grub pa brnyes/ /sngon byon grub thob thams cad la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /gong ma'i rnam thar ri mo de/ /snying dbus bkod nas phyogs med kyi/ /ri khrod 'grim pa'i rnal 'byor glu/ /ri ba gsar ba rnams tsho nyon/ /dbyar ni me yi dus yin pas/ /gangs dang ri rtse la sogs pa/ /bsil sar bsil khang nang du sgoms/ /zas gos spyod lam de mthun gyes/ /ston ni rlung gi dus yin pas/ /nags khrod brag rjong la sogs pa/ /bsil drod snyoms pa'i gnas su sgoms/ /zas gos spyod lam de mthun gyis/ /dgun ni chu yi dus yin pas/ /sa phug brag phug la sogs pa/ /dro ba'i gnas su bsgom par bya/ /zas gos spyod lam de mthun gyis/ /dbyed ni sa yi dus yin pas/ /ri dang nags tshal mtsho gling sogs/ /bsil drod snyoms pa'i gnas su sgoms/ /zas gos spyod lam de mthun gyes/ /dge 'dis ri ba thams cad kyis/ /'byung bzhir g.yar ba'i lus bde zhing / /508

sems spro nyams rtogs yon tan ni/ /ring min myur du skye bar shog /ces pa 'di yang ri ba gsar ba rnams la tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//sha rkyang ri dwags rnams rtse ba'i ri khrod kyi/ /ljon shing me tog rnams mthong bas rkyen byas nas/ /drin can bla ma yi gzugs sku yid la shar/ /yang yang mjal rgyu zhig byung na dga' ba la/ /yid mthun bag phab kyi bya rigs sna tshogs pa'i/ /skad snyan grags pa de thos pas rkyen byas nas/ /drin can bla ma yi gsung dbyangs yid la shar/ /yang yang mjal rgyu zhig byung na dga' ba la/ /mtho zhing yangs pa yi sprin med lha lam gye/ /nyi ma gzhon nu de mthong bas rkyen byas nas/ /drin can bla ma yi mkhyen brtse yid la shar/ /yang yang mjal rgyu zhig byung na dga' ba la/ /zhes pa 'di yang nyin zhig chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo'i zhabs pad bsten dus/ sku'i dbyebs gsung gi gdangs thugs rjes bskyangs tshul rnams yid la shar tshe tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//lam nges 'byung nags kyi khrod na 'gying / /byams snying rje byang sems thig le ba kra/ /yang dag pa'i lta ba'i dpa' rtsal rdzogs/ /rje rgya stag lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /sdom dam tshig gtsang ma'i gangs la nyal/ /chos lta sgom spyod pa'i rtsal gsum rdzogs/ /nyams rtogs pa'i g.yu ral mkha' la g.yengs/ /rje seng chen lta 509

bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /lam bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen grur zhugs nas/ /mar 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho myur du bsgral/ /mchog sku gsum nor bu'i gling du phyin/ /rje ded dpon lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /nyon shes sgrib gnyis kyi sgong rgya grol/ /thabs shes rab gnyis kyi gshog sgo rgyas/ /yar rnam mkhyen nam mkha' yangs par lding / /rje khyung chen lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /gnas ri khrod sprin gyi gseb na mdzes/ /gsung mgur dbyangs snyan pa'i 'brug sgra sgog /gtam snyan grags char ba phyogs bcur 'bab/ /rje g.yu 'brug lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /bdag sngon chad nyon mongs gdon gyes smyos/ /ma 'gro la gnod 'tshe mang bo byas/ /tshe 'di yi bya bas g.yengs g.yengs nas/ /tshe phyed rnams shor ba ngas ma mthong / /gnyid bza' btung kho na'i dbang song bas/ /nyin mtshan gnyis gar shor ngas ma shes/ /mi gzhan gye skyon la bltas bltas nas/ /tshur rang skyon yod pa ngas ma mthong / /da pha yi zhal gdams me long la/ /bu bdag gis bltas pas rang skyon mthong/ /ngo tsha zhing 'gyod pa drag po byung / /'di pha khyod bka' drin yin par go /dus da dung pha rgan rin po che/ /lus nyon mongs lho sprin rab gtor nas/ /nyams rtogs pa'i nyi zla mthong ba la/ /rlung shugs drag lta bu'i gdams pa zhu/ /tshe gang bor 510

sgrub la gzhol ba 'di/ /pha bla ma mnyes pa'i zhabs tog yin/ /dus da nas ci gsung bka' bzhin du/ /bsgrub nges pa bdag gi dam bca' yin/ /bu byang chub go 'phang ma thob bar/ /phas nam yang thugs kyis rtag tu skyongs/ /gnas dben par mgon khyod ji bzhin du/ /tshe sgrub pa snyoms par byin gyis rlobs//zhes slob bu ri khrod pa blo bzang don grub kyis da dung zhal gdams shig dgos zhes skul tshig tu smras pa 'di'i lan du/dbyings kun mkhyen mkha' las ma g.yos bzhin/ /bdag 'gro kun byis pa'i snang ngo ru/ /sku'i 'ja' tshon lam lam ston mdzad pa'i/ /pha chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bor 'dud/ /rje bla ma chos rgyal bka' drin las/ /nga dbul bos sgyed rdo gser shes ltar/ /rang sems nyid sangs rgyas yin pa de/ /dus da lan shes pa ngo mtshar che/ /yar sangs rgyas zer ba'i sgra bo che/ /phyi gzhan du btsal nas rnyed mi srid//tshur nang du tshol dang myur du rnyed/ /khyod rang sems sangs rgyas rtogs 'dod na/ /spyir snang srid 'khor 'das bsdus pa'i chos/ /sna tshogs su snang ba thams cad po/ /dpe mkha' las 'ja' sprin snang ba bzhin/ /gang snang yang sems nyid gcig pu'i 'phrul/ /'ja' sprin rnams snang yang stong ba bzhin/ /gang snang yang rang bzhin ma grub stong / /sems 511

lus kyi phyi nang bar gsum dang / /phyi 'byung ba bzhi sogs gang la gnas/ /rtsar chod dang ci yang mi rnyed par/ /dpe sprin med dwangs pa'i nam mkha' bzhin/ /sems gnas lugs stong gsal 'dzin med mthong / /de'i ngang du glod la lhan ne zhog /yang rnam rtog 'phro tshe de ma thag /slar sems nyid rang gi ngang du zhog /dpe 'ja' tshon shar ram lho sprin 'khrigs/ /gang snang yang nam mkha'i cho 'phrul bzhin/ /lam bskyed rjogs tshogs gsog gang byed kyang / /sems gcig pu'i 'phrul du shes pa dang / /'ja' sprin gnyis gang snang stong ba bzhin/ /de kun kyang stong bar shes pa dang / /sems khyab gdal nam mkha' yangs pa ltar/ /shes bzhin pa'i ngang nas byed pa gces/ /glu 'di nyid blangs pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /ma nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam sems can gyes/ /nang rang sems sangs rgyas zhal bzang de/ /dus ring min myur du mjal bar shog /ces smras pa'o//bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /ang gi yon bdag dad can pa/ /gtong phod can tsho tshur nyon dang / /rgas pa dbyar dgun ston dpyid 'dra/ /rim gyis 'gyur ba yid la zungs/ /gzhon nu'i dus su lha chos mdzod/ /na ba bye'u chung rdo phog 'dra/ /stobs nus zad pa yid la zungs/ /na tsha med dus lha 512

chos mdzod/ /'chi bdag ri gzar rbab rdo 'dra/ /gang gis kyang mi bzlog yid la zungs/ /ma shi gong 'dir lha chos mdzod/ /rgas pa na dang 'chi ba gsum/ /thog tu bab dus lha chos dka'/ /de bas da lta lha chos mdzod/ /ces pa 'di yang yon bdag dad pa dang gtong phod can rnams la tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//ri khrod gnas su grub pa brnyes/ /bla ma gong ma rnams la 'dud/ /ri ba tshogs drug rang grol glur/ /skal ldan las 'phro can tsho nyon/ /pha yul sdug bsngal rgya mtsho ru/ /chos brgyad rba rlabs phyogs brgyar g.yo/ /las nyon chu srin kha ru 'gro/ /sdug bsngal na tsha bzod glags med/ /bde ba cung zad mi gda' na//sems yod su zhig rtag tu sdod/ /sdug bsngal myong bzhin sdod pa'i mi/ /spyos sam yang na gdon gyes zin/ /bde skyid 'dod pa'i sems yod rnams/ /da ni ma 'dug 'di bzhin mdzod/ /nges 'byung gru la brten nas ni/ /pha yul sdug bsngal rgya mtsho sgrol/ /ri khrod dben pa'i rin chen gling / /snyogs la dge sbyor nor bu mchog /len pa'i thabs la 'bad par mdzod/ /de lta'i glu ngabyangs snyan mo 'di/ /ri khrod rin chen gling mchog gi /ded dpon tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /pha yul sdug bsngal rgya mtsho ru/ /bying ba'i skye bo rnams la gdams/ /'di thos las 'phro can 513

gyi mi/ /ri khrod rin chen gling bsnyegs nas/ /dge sbyor nor bu mi len ri/ /snyam du zhe mna' lan gsum skyol/ /myur du skyo shas stobs bskyed la/ /myur du 'ong ba'i thabs la 'bod/ /myur du 'ongs na dga' ba la/ /myur du 'ongs na skyid pa la//zhes pa 'di yang mtsho snying nas smras pa'o//bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /dad ldan bu la byin gyis rlobs/ /lha chos byed 'dod slob bu gnyis/ /nyams su len na 'di bzhin mdzod/ /drin can bla ma pha ma gsum/ /lham bzhin ma brnyas zhwa bzhin bkur/ /pha yul nor rdzas khyem thabs gsum/ /dug dang 'dres pa'i zas bzhin spongs/ /gangs ri rdza ri nags khrod gsum//pha mkhar bzhin du rgyun du zungs/ /phyag dang skor ba kha ton gsum/ /khyam pa'i so nam bzhin du rem/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum/ /'jig rten 'di yi dpon bzhin sten/ /bya ba gtam dang dran rgyu gsum/ /gser dngul bzhin du nyung bar gyis/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /pang du sbrul lhung bzhin du spongs/ /ser sna phrag dog nga rgyal gsum/ /dgra bzhin ltos la 'bur 'joms gyis/ /ngo tsha khrel yod tshul khrims gsum/ /gon pa bzhin du 'bral med sten/ /thos pa bsam pa sgom pa gsum/ /yar ngo'i zla bzhin gong 514

'phel mdzod/ /mdor na sgo gsum dge ba la/ /bkol ba dpon bo'i g.yog bzhin gyis//dge 'dis skal ldan slob bu yi/ /blo kha chos la phyogs par shog /ces pa 'di yang a rig nags tshang sprul sku rin po che'i tsha bo gnyis la zhal gdams shig dgos zhes bskul ngor tshogs drug rang grol gyis mtsho snying nas smras pa'o//nyon dang yon bdag gzhon pa tsho/ /pha ma rgan rgon rnams kyis ni/ /snabs dang lud pa kha yis phyis/ /mi gtsang ba ni lag pas phyis/ /byams pa'i mig gis yang yang bltas/ /mngar ba'i nu zho kha ru blud/ /de nas zas zhim snum zan byin//cher song pho bas zhu tshad byen/ /zla ba 'ga' re song 'phro nas/ /'dzum re byas pa'ang pha ma gnyis/ /dga' ba bsam gyes mi khyab byas//de nas gom pa re gnyis tsam/ /'degs shes tsa na nged kyi bu/ /'di zer dga' bzhin gzhan la ngom/ /gos g.yogs sha yi drod la bslan/ /de nas 'gro 'dug thub pa nas/ /me chu g.yang sogs 'jigs las bskyabs/ /za lugs 'gro lugs yan chad bslabs/ /de nas che ru song tsa na/ /bu de gzhan du song shul nas/ /za ma bzang bo zhig rnyed kyang / /rang gis spyad par mi phod par/ /bu la ster snyam tshags byas 'jog /gos rgyan 'jam yang mdzes pa rnams/ /bu la dga' ba'i sems kyis bskon//bu 515

la bzang zhig yod na bsgrags/ /skyon zhig yod na 'gebs shing gsang / /de nas khyem so zin pa'i tshe/ /bu la chung ma len pa dang / /zhing khang nor rnams bu la sprod/ /bu mor gos rgyan sna tshogs pa/ /btags nas gnas la rdzong ba sogs/ /de 'dra'i dka' las sna tshogs kyis/ /pha mas bu tsha bskyang bskyangs nas/ /rgas khar phan du re ba'i tshe/ /la las phan lan mi 'jal steng / /tha na kha yang grag dbang med/ /phe thobs brang rdungs kha rog zer/ /rkang tho lag tho la sogs pas/ /snye phung bzhin du yang yang brdungs/ /rma med lus po na tshas 'gengs/ /tshig ngan rdo log khog tu 'jog /sdug bsngal 'khyags pa 'ju dus med/ /ci ltar pha mas byams pa bzhin/ /bu tshas pha mar byams pa dkon/ /'on kyang khrel yod gzhon nu tsho/ /pha ma de 'dra'i drin che na/ /sems med bu zhig ma gtogs pa/ /drin de khyad gsod su yis nus/ /pha ma gnyis la mi byams pa'i/ /bu de gdon gyis spyos pa yin/ /pha ma'i drin lan 'jal 'dod kyi/ /khrel yod bu tsho 'di bzhin gyes/ /khang ba'i dro sar pha ma zhog /dro zhing yang ba'i gos kyis g.yogs/ /khams dang mthun pa'i zas zhim byin/ /tsha zhing zhim pa'i ja rgod blud/ /sems la phan pa'i tshig 'jam smros/ /pha mas ci zer kha la nyon/ /de ltar pha mar byams byas na/ /rgas 516

pa'i drin can pha ma yi/ /sems la dga' bde'i nyi ma 'char/ /shi nas pha rol song na yang / /shul du lus pa'i bu de yi/ /ci bsam 'grub pa'i smon lam 'debs/ /pha ma la mgo'i nyi zer 'dra/ /nyi zer yun ring mi sdod 'gro/ /pha ma lan gcig mgron po 'dra/ /mgron po yun ring mi sdod 'gro/ /pha ma bya rgyal khu byug 'dra/ /khu byug yun ring mi sdod 'gro/ /'gro ba'i nangs par pha ma la/ /gces gces 'dra ba'i kha bzang de/ /bshad kyang pha mas nyan dbang med/ /'jam po bskon yang gon dbang med/ /zhim po byen yang za dbang med/ /de nas bzung ste pha ma gnyis/ /dngos su mthong ba phar la zhog /rmi lam du yang mthong mi 'gyur/ /mi mthong yul du 'gro ba'i dus/ /bu bzang khrel yod thams cad kyi/ /mgo yi nyi zla nub pa yin/ /mya ngan mun pas khengs pa yin/ /bu ngan khrel med thams cad kyi/ /mig gi ling tog bud ni yin/ /dri bo'i mig rtsa bsal ni yin/ /bdud po'i mya ngan sangs ni yin/ /mdze bo shul la lus ni yin/ /pha ma shi ba'i nangs par du/ /khrel yod bu tshos 'di bzhin gyes/ /shi bo'i ra mda' lha chos yin/ /mi yis smon pa'i dge rtsa thongs bu yis ci bsam lhun gyes 'grub/ /pha ma shi ba'i nangs par du/ /khrel med bu tshos 'di 'dra byed/ /shul gyi nor la nga dbang 517

zer/ /spun zla mi 'cham 'khon 'dzing 'ong / /pha ma rgan rgon las ngan gyis//bsags pa'i nor rnams don med song / /rang skyes dgra bo'i lag tu shor/ /ro de mtsher na 'jog pa 'am/ /yang na rir 'phen me la bsreg /yang na chur bskyur dong du sba/ /nyi ma kha shas song 'phro nas/ /glu blangs ha ha zer zhing dgod/ /mi rnams kun gyis la yog nas/ /pha mar de 'dra byas gyur na/ /brgya bsam gcig kyang mi 'grub zer/ /gtam ngan mi khas lung ba 'gengs/ /de phyir yon bdag gzhon nu tsho/ /de tsho soms la bsam blo thongs//drin lan 'jal na da lta rem/ /zhesapa 'di yang dad ldan zhabs drung dge slong ngag dbang blo bzang gis khyim pa rnams la phan pa'i zhal gdams shig dgos zhes bskul ngor tshogs drug rang grol gyes smras pa'o//bde med 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las/ /bde ldan thar ba'i rin chen gling mchog tu/ /bde bar 'gro kun 'khrid pa'i ded dpon mchog /bde legs gzhi gcig bla ma bdag la dgongs/ /mgon bo khyod ni sngon nas sangs rgyas kyang / /mgon med snyigs dus dmu rgod 'gro rnams kyi//mgon skyabs mdzad phyir tha mal snang ngo ru//mgon khyod dge slong tshul 'dzin e ma ho/ /nyams med sdom gsum mig 'bras bzhin du bsrungs/ /yengs med sgrub la brtson pa mthong ba'i mod//dad med dred po 518

chos brgyad khol bo nga //dbang med lag gnyis thal mo sbyor du bcug /cha gnyis za nyal rnam g.yeng ngang du zad/ /cha gcig tsam gyi tshe zhabs 'di nyid la/ /cha lugs btsun tshugs bzung nas mgon khyod bzhin/ /cha med dben par dge sbyor byed par smon/ /na gzhon mang bo sngon chad shi ba dran/ /na 'chir 'jigs nas phyi ma'i don chen du//na tshod yol ba'i sprang btsun dad gus kyis/ /na bza' 'di 'bul bdag tshogs rdzogs phyir bzhes/ /tshe yi mjug 'dir chos shig byed pa la/ /tshe la glo bur bar chad med pa dang / /tshe 'di'i bslu brid dbang du mi 'gro bar/ /tshe lhag don ldan byed pa zhig khyed mkhyen/ /zhes slob bu kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis phu thung zhig byin dus smras pa 'di'i lan du/rgyal ba gong ma'i rnam thar ji bzhin du/ /rgyal bstan rin chen 'dzin skyong spel mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i sras mchog bla ma rin po che/ /rgyal mtshan tog ltar spyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs/ /dung dung snying nas drin can bla ma la/ /lhang lhang gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis gsol ba 'debs/ /'dzum 'dzum dgyes pa'i sgo nas slob bu la/ /bzang bzang mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /zla med mtshan ldan bla ma'i bka' bzhin du/ /don med tshe 'di'i bya ba blos btang nas/ /nges med dben pa'i ri la 519

gcig pu ru/ /'jigs med gnas pa bdag gis glu dbyangs len/ /pha yul pha mkhar nor rdzas blo yis btang / /sdig byed sdig pa'i grogs po thabs kyis spangs/ /dge sgrub dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang bsten pa'i//bu rgod bu khyod rnal 'byor glu la nyon/ /rje btsun rtag tu ngu yis chos 'phags dang //rje btsun nā ro pa yis te lo dang / /rje btsun mi las mar pa bsten pa bzhin/ /rje btsun bla ma bsam sbyor gnyis kyis sten/ /rnyed par dka' ba'i mi lus rin chen 'di/ /rnyed pa'i dus 'dir byang chub mi bsgrub par/ /rnyed sogs chos brgyad khol bo byas gyur na/ /rnyed dka'i mi lus thob kyang don go chung / /tshe 'di mi rtag nam mkha'i glog dang 'dra/ /tshe 'dir yun ring sdod shom ma 'dzin par/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad blo yis thongs /'jigs bral dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro dang / /'jig rten 'di ru dge sdig blang dor mdzod/ /srid rtse nas bzung mnar med yan chad kyi/ /srid gsum gnas na bde ba cung zad med/ /srid pa'i bde la nam yang ma chags par/ /sred las thar thabs bslab pa gsum la slobs/ /ma rig nyon mongs dbang song sdug myong ba'i/ /ma gyur 'gro ba'i don du sems bskyed la//ma rab spyod spong rgyal sras spyod pa rnams/ /ma lus sgrub la zhum 520

pa med par gyis//gsang sngags nyams su len mkhan bla ma la/ /gsang sngags dbang bzhi tshad ldan sngon du zhus/ /gsang sngags gzhung bzhin dam tshig legs bsrungs la/ /gsang sngags bskyed rdzogs nyams su len par mdzod/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /yang dang yang du bsngags pa'i myur lam mchog /yang gsang rdzogs chen khregs chod thod rgal gnyis/ /yang yang nyams su len pa shin tu gces/ /dben par drang srong gcig pur gnas pa bzhin/ /dben zhing nyams dga' dam pas byen brlabs pa'i/ /dbeen gnas gangs rdza g.ya' dang nags tshal sogs/ /dben pa'i gnas su gcig pur nyams su longs/ /'di ltar slob bus nyams su len pa'i tshe/ /tshe ring nad med lus sems rtag tu bde/ /bde 'gro'i lus rten 'di la ring min du/ /du ma'i nyams rtogs rgyud la 'char bar shog /ces smras pa'o//nyams dga' mtsho snying ri bo na/ /spos dang dri bzang chi li li/ /ljon shing lo 'dab khri li li/ /me tog sna tshogs khra lam lam/ /bung ba glu len di ri ri/ /khor yug rgya mtsho me re re//nya mo zas 'tshol sha ra ra/ /rba rlabs sna tshogs nyi li li/ /chu bya skad snyan kyu ru ru/ /steng na nam mkha' sa la la/ /dri med nyi zla 'od 521

lam lam/ /zim bu'i sbrang char si li li/ /'ja' tshon ri mo ya la la/ /de ltar ngo mtshar mtha' yas pa'i/ /yid 'ong rang byung brag phug tu/ /snyom las mkhan nga nyal nyal nas/ /nyin gcig khams gseng byas pa'i tshe/ /slob bu thub bstan rgya mtsho yis/ /zhal gdams dgos zhes 'di skad zer// —e ma rnam dag bslab gsum gyi/ /sgo nas rang rgyud legs par btul/ /mang thos lung gi yon tan mnga'/ /zab mo lta ba'i don rtogs shing / /slob ma rnams las yon tan lhag /smra mkhas snying rje rab tu che/ /gzhan don sgrub la brtson 'grus ldan/ /yang yang 'chad la mi skyo ba'i/ /dge ba'i bshes kyi mtshan nyid bcu/ /ldan pa'i snyigs dus 'gro mgon lags/ /da lta snyigs ma'i dus skabs kyi/ /bdag dang —bdag 'dra'i ji ltar bya/ /brtse bas bslab bya gnang du gsol// e ma chags sdang phyogs lhung bral/ /blang dor 'byed nus shes rab can/ /chos la don gnyer chen po ldan/ /chos dang chos smra ba la gus/ /yid ni legs par gtod pa ste/ /yon tan lnga ldan snying gi bu/ /bdag gis chung dus chos ma dran/ /cher song lha chos dran na yang / /tshe phyed yad ma yud la shor/ /tshe lhag ci yod mi shes snyam/ /mtshan nyid grwa sar nga ma bsdad/ /mdo sngags gzhung la ngas ma sbyangs/ /dpe mang zhib tu ngas ma bltas/ /bla 522

ma'i gnang ba'i gdams ngag dang / /gcig pur ri la tshugs pa tsam/ /ma gtogs yon tan spu tsam med//de phyir kha rog nyal du chugs/ /mi shes smra ba nyung na mdzes// mgon khyod sngon sbyangs bag chags bzang / /bzang bo'i chos la chung nas dad/ /dad gus bzang bos bla ma yang / /yang dag bsten nas zab chos gsan/ /dal 'byor rnyed dka' don che dang / /phangs med mi rtag 'chi ba dran/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis btang / /le lo snyom las ma mdzad par//gong ma'i rnam thar ji bzhin du/ /du ma'i ri khrod dben gnas su/ /su dang ma 'phrad gcig pur bsgoms/ /sgom byung rtogs pa'i shes rab brdol/ /da lta gdams ngag kun la mkhas/ /mdo rgyud man ngag snying bo'i don/ /sngon chad glu ru blangs pa thos/ /ske ni yod pa'i snga ltas su/ /du ba sngon po gnam la 'phyo/ /chu 'dzin mkha' la 'khrigs pa'i tshe/ /sbrang char g.yu 'brug grags pa yin/ /gser ni sa phyogs gar yod kyang / /rang 'od mkha' la 'char ba yin/ /rtogs ldan rnal 'byor phal cher gyis/ /nyams mgur glu dbyangs len pa yin/ /ne'u gsing spang la char babs na//dri ldan me tog gsar ba skye/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen la/ /gsol ba btab na 'dod dgu 'byung / /ngang ba'i tshogs rnams sgrog gyur na/ /rab tu dga' ba'i skad snyan 523

'byin/ /blo ldan mkhas par gsol btab na/ /blo dang 'tsham pa'i bslab bya ston/ /snyigs dus skyes mchog khyod nyid la/ /sngon smon las kyis gnas 'dir mjal/ /zhal gdams tshig 'ga' ma thos na/ /ma mjal ba dang cis mi 'dra/ /mgon khyod thugs la de dgongs la/ /brtse ba chen pos gsung bar zhu// 1bu khyod sngon bsags bsod nams mthus/ /tshe 'dir tshe ring nad med cing / /rigs gzugs 'byor dang dbang phyug dang / /shes rab yon tan bdun gyis mdzes/ /dal 'byor tshang ba'i mi lus thob/ /chos mdzad kun la dag snang che/ /bdag gis sngon chad gang smras la/ /mkhas pa dgyes pa'i sdeb sbyor med/ /'on kyang byis pas ci smras rnams/ /rgan pos thos na mi khro ltar/ /blo chung nga 'dras gang smras la/ /blo ldan mkhas pa mi khro snyam/ /rgan po byis pas smras pa la/ /mtshar nas yang yang bskul ba ltar/ /blo dman bdag gis smra ba la/ /mtshar nas yang yang bskul gyur na/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis gang dran smra/ /skal ldan bu khyod ma yengs nyon/ /gangs can bod du yongs grags pa'i/ /ma nor zab mo'i lam bzang mchog /dbu ma rdzogs chen phyag chen dang / /zhi byed gcod rnams gang mos la/ /thog mar thos bsam nan tan gyis/ /nyams su len tshul legs shes nas/ /de don 524

tshul bzhin bsgom par mdzod/ / ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal dran/ /de las skyob mkhan dkon mchog gsum/ /gtan gye skyabs su legs 'dzin pa'i/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /da lta thos bsam byed mkhan mang / /sgom mkhan mi ni shin tu nyung / /thos bsam byas nas bsgom dgos sam/ /shes pa tsam gyes chog gam ci/ / 1 bu khyod ma yengs tshur la nyon/ /'o ma mar gyi rgyu yin mod/ /ma bskrogs bar du mar mi 'byung / /til ni snum gyi rgyu yin yang / /ma btsir snum ni ga la 'ong thos bsam byas nas ma bsgoms na/ /'bras bu sangs rgyas thob mi 'gyur/ /de phyir shes pas mi chog par/ /gang shes rtse gcig bsgom pa gces// las 'bras bslu ba med mkhyen nas/ /sdig spangs dge ba rab tu bsgrubs/ /gtan du bde ba'i btsan sa bzung / /mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /thos bsam byas pas mi chog par/ /rtse gcig bsgom la rag las na/ /gang du gnas nas bsgoms na bzang / /blo dman bdag la bstan du gso// dad pa can khyod legs par nyon/ /gang zhig sgom byed skyes bu yis/ /'jig rten chos brgyad 'khri ba bcad/ /'du 'dzi'i gnas rnams rab spangs nas//dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /ri khrod gnas su bsgom par bya// ༈'khor ba me mur 'obs ltar 525

mthong / /bslab pa gsum dang de'i nang nas/ /tshul khrims mig 'bras ltar srung ba'i/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /'du 'dzi'i gnas rnams ma spangs na/ /skyon ni ci yod gsung du gsol// 1khrems ldan dge slob da yang nyon/ /dben par mi sdod 'du 'dzi la/ /dga' ba'i mi la thar ba dka'/ /'du 'dzir gnas pa'i skyes bu de/ /dug lnga 'jig rten chos brgyad dang / /mi dge bcu dang bsam gtan gyi/ /sgrib lngar rtag tu 'grogs pa'i phyir/ /dge bcu bslab gsum phar phyin drug /sdom gsum bsgyed rdzogs rdzogs chen dang / /lta sgom spyod gsum chos spyod bcu/ /tshogs gnyis lam dang bral bas na/ /zhi lhag ting 'dzin ga la yod/ /de phyir 'du 'dzi'i nyes skyon ni/ /rgyal bas du ma gsungs pa yin// byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas/ /phyin drug bsdu bzhi la sogs pa'i/ /rgyal sras spyod pa rlabs chen spyod/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /'o na 'du 'dzi'i gnas bsrings nas/ /dben par bsdad na yon tan ci// — chags med stong phod can khyod nyon/ /'du 'dzi'i gnas rnams rab spangs nas/ /ri sul dben par gcig pu ru/ /drang srong lta bur gnas gyur na/ /nyes skyon ngang gis mi 'byung zhing / /yon tan mtha' dag shugs kyis 'thob/ /dngos po gang la'ang chags med par//526

ri khrod gnas pas sbyin pa rdzogs/ /'dod chags skye ba'i yul rkyen dang / /bral ba'i tshul khrims rnam par dag /mi sdug rkyen dang ma phrad pas/ /khong khro med par bzod pa'i ngang / /gcig pur gnas pas brtson 'grus ldan/ /'du 'dzi med pas bsam gtan 'phel/ /bsam rgyu chos las gzhan med pas/ /shes rab skyes shing de bzhin du/ /dran dang shes bzhin ngang gis ldan/ /dge ba bcu dang bslab pa gsum/ /sdom gsum bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen dang / /lta sgom spyod gsum chos spyod bcu/ /tshogs gnyis ngang gis 'phel ba dang / /zhi lhag ting 'dzin shugs kyis skye/ /mchog thun dngos grub ma lus 'thob/ /de phyir rgyal ba sras bcas kyis/ /dben pa'i yon tan rgya cher gsungs/ / —zhi gnas yol bas rnam rtog rlung / /bkag nas lhag mthong mar me sbar/ /gnas lugs bris sku blta mdzad pa'i/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /'o na ri khrod dben pa ru/ /gnas la 'gal rkyen mi 'byung ngam// thos pa can khyod da yang nyon/ /ri khrod gnas na 'dug pa la/ /lung stong ri brag bdag po med/ /der gnas bya dang ri dwags kyis//mi snyan tshig ni brjod mi bya/ /nor rdzas khyer rgyu ma mchis pas/ /jag rkun gnod pa 'ong mi 'gyur/ /chags sdang skye ba'i yul med pas/ /mi mthun 'gal rkyen ngang gis 527

med// 1dbang thob dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrungs/ /bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen nyams su blangs/ /lam bzang rtogs pa mngon gyur pa'i/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /'o na de ltar ri khrod du/ /bsdad na mthun rkyen tshang lags sam// 1 khrel yod bu khyod da yang nyon/ /mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa yod//sa phug brag phug bya skyibs sogs/ /ma brtsigs khang bzang nyams dga' yod/ /'bab chu srog chags yod pa dang / /dri ldan rtsi shing nags tshal dang //sman spos me tog sna tshogs yod/ /sngo dang shing 'bras la sogs pa'i/ /kha zas zhim po sna tshogs yod/ /rang la nam dgos dus skabs su/ /spyod kyang gzhan gyis ser sna med/ /rngon pa rdzi bo shing 'thun gyes/ /ri khrod gnas pa'i dge sbyong la/ /dad gus mos bsam mthun rkyen bsgrubs/ /snyan pa gong du song nas sgog /de yi stobs kyis grong yul gyi//dad can skye bo pho mo yis/ /ci 'byor zas gos mthun rkyen ster/ /de phyir ri khrod 'grim par kyis// 1rab 'byams gzhung lugs kun la mkhas/ /nyes ltung dri mas ma gos btsun/ /gzhan phan byang chub sems gyis bzang / /mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che//'o na ri khrod dben pa na/ /mi mthun 'gal rkyen bar chad med/ /mthun rkyen tshang na chos byed mi/ /thams cad 'gro bar rigs pa la/ /da lta 528

ri na sdod pa nyung / /de ni ci yis lan pa yin// 1 ngo tsha mkhan khyod da yang nyon/ /mi mthun 'gal rkyen bar chad med/ /mthun pa'i rkyen kun tshang ba yi/ /ngo mtshar lha yul las lhag pa'i/ /ri khrod dben pa'i gnas mchog de/ /skal med rnams kyis ngo ma shes/ /rnam rtog can rnams the tshom skyes/ /'du 'dzi bsod nams can rnams kyis/ /phyi bshol lus pas skal ba chad/ /de phyir ri na sdod pa nyung / /ri khrod dbeen pa'i dga' tshal de/ /sngar 'das 'phags pa'i gshegs shul yin/ /da lta'i dam pa'i bzhugs gnas yin/ /ma 'ongs skal ldan 'gro sa yin/ /mkhas btsun rnams kyis smon sa yin// mkhas shing grub pa mchog brnyes kyang / /'khor dang longs spyod rgyang bsrings nas/ /bya btang 'ba' zhig mdzad pa yi/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /de ltar yun ring ri khrod du/ /grogs med gcig pur gnas pa'i tshe/ /nyin mo skyo bar mi 'gyur ram// shes rab can khyod da yang nyon/ /shin tu nyams dga'i ri ngogs na/ /'grogs na bde ba'i grogs mang yod/ /gzugs dang kha dog mi 'dra ba'i/ /yid 'ong ri dwags bag phebs rgyu//phan tshun rtse zhing sgra skad 'byin/ /yun ring 'dris na drung du 'ong / /nam zla dpyid sos dbyar gyi dus/ /ri klung thams cad g.yu mdog 'dra/ /me tog 'bras ldan 529

shing kha ru/ /khu byug stong ltong dga' bas sding / /chu rgyun gtsang mas lhung sgra sgog /sus 'thungs skom pas gdungs pa sel/ /spang gzhongs me tog rab mdzes ldan/ /bung ba mang bos glu len bskor/ /lung stong spang thang na klung na/ /rta phyugs dzi bo phan tshun rtse/ /mtsho dang rdzing bu chu ngogs na/ /ngang ba skad snyan yid 'ong 'phyo/ /nyin mo nam yang skyo mi 'gyur/ /'du 'dzi sdug bsngal bya byed med/ /mi dang 'grogs na chags sdang 'byung / /de phyir rang nyid gcig pur bde// nam yang dben pa'i ri khrod na/ /seng ge bzhin du gcig pur rgyu/ /'jigs med gnas nas sgrub la brtson/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /'o na nyin mo mi skyo yang / /mtshan mo'i dus su mi 'jigs sam// rgyud 'jam khog yangs da yang nyon/ /bdag med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /mtshan mo'i dus su 'jigs pa med/ /gal te 'jigs byed byung ba'i tshe//dge la bskul ba'i bla ma dran/ /'jigs pa'i yang dag lta ba yang / /brjed med rtag tu bsgom du 'jug /sems la brtan pa myur du 'thob/ /grong du nyon mongs 'du 'dzis g.yengs/ /mtshan mo bag med gnyid log pa'i/ /sems la brtan pa thob dus med/ /rnal 'byor btang snyems can rnams kyis/ /nyam nga'i gnas su bsgom pa gces// byams dang snying 530

rje'i sprin 'khrigs nas/ /phan bde'i lo tog spel ba'i phyir/ /'gro la chos char 'bab mkhas pa'i/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /'o na ri khrod dben pa ru/ /mi min gnod 'tshe mi 'ong ngam// bsam bzang bu khyod da yang nyon/ /lus srog jed la bor byas nas/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems/ /bdag med lta ba bsgoms gyur na/ /'byung bo mi min gdug sems can/ /gdug pa'i sems zhi byang sems ldan/ /bsrung ba'i go cha gzhan mi dgos/ /ri khrod dben par gnas pa la/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams/ /rab tu dgyes pas byin brlab 'gyur/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems kyis/ /bu bzhin dgongs nas rtag tu gzigs/ /chos la dga' ba'i lha rnams kyis/ /rtag tu de yi bar chad sel// thos bsam sgom gsum nyams 'gyur ba'i/ /mdza' bshes sbyin bdag khyem rnams la//nam yang chags pa mi mdzad pa'i/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /'o na ri khrod dben pa ru/ /gnas la gdams ngag su yis ston// byams sems can khyod da yang nyon/ /ri khrod dben par gnas pa la/ /gdams ngag ston mkhan mang bo yod/ /nam zla dus bzhi'i 'gyur stobs kyis/ /rtsi shing kha dog 'gyur ba dang / /me tog gsar rnying brje ba dang / /ba mos rtsi thog bskams pa dang / /531

rlung gis lo 'bras brul 'gyur zhing / /shing phung bya bye'u 'du gyes dang / /'bab chu rnams kyi dar rgud dang / /mtsho dang lteng ka zhu 'khyags dang / /chu bya 'du zhing gyes pa dang / /ri dwags nges med gnas 'pho dang / /nyi zla gza' skar 'char nub dang / /lo zla nyin zhag 'gyur la sogs/ /kun gyis 'khor ba'i chos rnams la/ /rtag pa gang yang med do zhes/ /yang yang mi rtag brda chos ston/ /de yis rkyen byas skyo shas sgye/ /bya bye'us bye'u phrug gso ba dang / /ri dwags phru gu skyong ba yis/ /'di ltar 'gro ba byams dgos zhes/ /byams dang snying rje'i brda chos ston/ /de yis rkyen byas rang rgyud la/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems/ /bcos ma min pa skye bar 'gyur/ /ston gyi nam mkha' g.ya' dag gis/ /sems nyid stong gsal chos kyi sku/ /kho dang mtshungs zhes brda chos ston/ /de yis rkyen byas ri khrod pas/ /skye med chos sku'i don rtogs 'gyur/ /mkha' la shar ba'i 'ja' tshon dang / /gangs dkar ri sked na bun dang / /thang la rgyu ba'i smig rgyu yis/ /'khor 'das chos rnams kho 'dra zhes/ /bden med stong nyid brda chos ston/ /de yis rkyen byas chos rnams kun/ /bden med stong bar rtogs par 'gyur/ /shes na phyi rol dngos po rnams/ /dam chos ston pa'i slob dpon yin//532

—dran shes skyes bus gnyen po'i mtshon/ /bsnams nas chags sogs nyon mongs dgra/ /byung ma thag tu 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /'o na ri khrod dben pa ru/ /'tsho bas phongs na ci ltar bya// —snying rje can khyod da yang nyon/ /chags med ri khrod gnas pa la/ /'tsho ba mi min mkha' 'gros sbyor/ /zhe 'dod kun bral rnal 'byor la/ /ci 'dod 'byung ba chos nyid yin/ /gal te 'tsho bas phongs gyur na/ /rab kyis ting 'dzin zas su za/ /'bring gis sngo tshod bcud len dang / /tha mas gnas skabs bsod snyoms bya/ /cung zad rnyed nas ri khrod snyeg /rnyed bkur ro la chags mi bya/ /gal te rnyed bkur la chags na/ /nyams brod yon tan nyams gyur nas/ /nyes skyon ma lus 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de phyir dad ldan snying gi bu/ /bar snang rlung bzhin ma chags par/ /ri dwags bzhin du ri khrod gnas/ /longs spyod phun sum tshogs gyur kyang / /khengs pa'i nga rgyal mi bya zhing / /dbul yang zhum pa ma byed ang // rang nor gzhan gyis phrogs pa 'am/ /'phrog tu bcug kyang de nyid la/ /chags med dga' bas ster mdzad pa'i/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /'o na ri khrod gnas pa'i tshe/ /na tsha byung na ci ltar bya// byang sems can khyod da yang nyon/ /ri khrod gnas pa'i gang zag la/ /533

sdug bsngal na tsha ci byung yang / /byang chub sems gnyis la sogs pa'i/ /bla mas bstan pa'i man ngag rnams/ /bsgom par bya ba ma gtogs pa/ /sman dang rim gro la sogs pa'i/ /thabs gzhan de dus btsal mi bya/ /khyad par rkyen snang phra rags la/ /lus kyi gces 'dzin dor byas nas/ /phung bo zan du bsgyur bar bya/ /de yis rkyen snang rang sar zhi/ /gal te nad tshabs cher gyur kyang / /nam yang nges par 'chi dgos pas//chos phyir shi na shin tu legs/ /ri ba'i 'chi sa ri khrod yin/ /snyam du sman thun gcig tsam gyi/ /phyir yang grong du 'bab mi bya//ri dwags rmas ma ji bzhin du/ /shi ba mi yis mi thos shing / /ro rul bya yis mi mthong bar/ /'chi bar byed pa ri ba'i lugs// rang la nyes pa med bzhin du/ /gzhan gyis mgo bo gcod na yang / /nam yang khro ba mi mdzad pa'i/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /'o na rgyun du ri khrod du/ /gnas nas gzhan don mi byed dam// /dri ba mkhan khyod da yang nyon/ /ri dwags rmas ma ji bzhin du/ /gcig pur ri khrod gnas gyur na/ /'gro don zhor la lhun gyis 'grub/ /'du 'dzir zhugs nas grong bskor ba'i/ /chos bshad man ngag byin pa yis/ /phan thogs chen bo 'byung mi 'gyur/ /da lta snyigs ma'i mi rnams kyi/ /phal cher drung du phyin pa'i tshe/ /'bros sam 534

yang na yib par 'gyur//lam du phrad na bzung nas 'gro/ /yun du 'grogs na sun pa sla/ /phar la bros na mjug na 'ded/ /yib pa'i dus na 'tshol du 'ong / /zas nor 'dod la mi ster bar/ /mi 'dod pa yi thog tu spungs/ /mkhas pas bshad na de mi nyan/ /mi shes pa la nan gyis zhu/ /de phyir log pa'i skye bo rnams/ /'dul las ri khrod dben pa ru/ /gnas nas sgrub la brtson byas na/ /g.yo can mi rgod sdig can yang / /ri khrod gnas pa de mthong na/ /dad brtson shugs drags gting nas skye/ /de phyir bu khyod gzhan don du/ /ri khrod dben pa rtag tu sten// mang bos bkur zhing mchod na yang / /khengs pa dor nas zhi dul gye/ /mdzad pas kun gyi yid 'phrog pa'i/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /'o na dad can 'ga' zhig gis/ /spyan 'dren byung na mi 'gro 'am// smra mkhas bu khyod da yang nyon/ /dad pas grong du spyan 'dren na/ /mngon shes yod na sems can de/ /'dul ba'i dus la bab na 'gro/ /de min bdud kyi bslu brid du/ /shes par byas la ri khrod nas/ /gom gang tsam yang 'phag mi bya/ /gal te lan cig phyin sred na//de nas lan grangs mang bo ru/ /'gro dgos byung na ri klung gnyis/ /rjes kyis gang nas bdud kyis 'khyer/ /dben par brtan pa thob pa'i tshe/ /535

nyams rtogs brtan g.yo brtag pa'i phyir/ /cung zad tshogs nyul ma gtogs pa/ /brod med rang gar phyin gyur na/ /thog mar nyams rtogs bzang snyam byed/ /de nas nyams brod med par 'gyur/ /des na byang chub ma thob bar/ /bla ma mgo yi thod bzhin khur/ /ri khrod dben pa zhwa ltar sten/ /byang chub sems gnyis phyugs bzhin 'tshos/ /dam sdom mig 'bras bzhin du srungs/ /nga rgyal rlom sems dug bzhin spongs/ / bu bzhin bskyangs pa'i mi rnams kyis/ /dgra bzhin blta yang de nyid la/ /slar yang lhag par byams mdzad pa'i/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /'o na rlom sems nga rgyal ni/ /byas na skyon ni ci zhig 'byung // ri 'dzin bu khyod da yang nyon/ /ri khrod gnas pa rlom 'gyur zhing / /nga bzang snyam pa'i nga rgyal gyes/ /bdag bstod gzhan la smod pa de/ /bdud kyis brlams sam rmongs pa yin/ /nga rgyal rlom sems thar lam gegs/ /gzhan dag smad pas ngan 'gror ltung / /de phyir bskal par ri khrod du/ /gnas kyang byang chub thob mi 'gyur/ /rgyu mtshan gtan tshig de bas na/ /nga rgyal rlom sems mi bya zhing / /bdag bstod gzhan la smod mi bya// nyes pa'i skyon rnams kun dang bral/ /yon tan ma lus yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /snyigs dus 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig 536

bu/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /'o na ri khrod dben pa ru/ /nyams su ji ltar len par bya// snying rus can khyod da yang nyon/ /ri khrod dben par gnas pa'i tshe/ /lus la hrul bo'i gon pa gyon/ /zas su gang byung ngan ngon zo/ /skom du tshwa med rdor med thungs/ /nam yang mi yis mi mthong zhing / /brgya la mi yis mthong ba'i tshe/ /rje btsun mi la ras pa yis/ /zwa tshod bsten pa'i dus skabs bzhin/ /zas med sha skam mdog nag pa'i/ /skyes bu 'di 'dra snying rje zhes/ /sdang dgra'i mchi ma 'chor ba zhig /da ni lag len mi 'gel ri/ /snyam du zhe mna' lan gsum skyol/ /phugs nor bcu bo snying la chongs/ /nam 'chi cha med yang yang soms/ /bdag ni ri khrod 'dir 'ongs nas/ /rtse gcig nyams len mi byed par/ /mi nor zas gsum 'dod gyur na/ /yul nas 'dug mod ci la 'ongs/ /rang gis rang mgo ma skor cig /dam chos nyams su ma blangs na/ /yul spangs ri khrod 'dir 'ongs pa/ /dgos pa ci zhig yod soms la/ /tha mal mi sdod snying rus skyed/ /nyams rtogs legs po ma skyes bar/ /'phongs rul gdan rdol shi yang rung / /snyam du 'jig rten rnam rtog spongs/ /bla ma'i gdams ngag nyams su longs// —yid bzhin nor bu rin chen ltar/ /gang gis mchod cing gsol 537

btab na/ /ci 'dod re ba skong mdzad pa'i/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /'o na de ltar nyams blangs na/ /gnas skabs mthar thug ci zhig 'byung // /chos mthun bu khyod da yang nyon/ /de ltar nyams su blangs gyur na/ /gnas skabs bde skyid snyan gsum 'byung / /'gro ba'i don rnams shugs la 'grub/ /mthar thug mngon par rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs par/ /ma lus sems can don mdzad 'gyur/ /ri chos phul byung gser phreng 'di/ /ri 'dzin bu yis bsgul ba'i ngor/ /ri la dga' ba'i rnal 'byor ngas/ /ri bo mtsho snying gnas nas smras/ /zhes pa 'di yang slob bu thub bstan rgya mtsho'i dri ba dris lan du bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mos pa'i bu la byen gyes rlobs/ /sdig pa spyad na ngan song du//'gro bas mi dge las rnams spongs/ /dge ba byas na mtho ris dang / /thar bar 'gro bas dge la spyod//'gro kun drin can pha ma yin/ /kun la byams dang snying rje sgoms/ /sems bskyed sangs rgyas sa bon 'dra/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed mdzod/ /bdag 'dzin 'ching ba gcod byed gri/ /bdag med lta ba yin pas sgoms/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang myur du 'thob par 'gyur/ /538

'dis kyang rang gzhan yongs la phan/ /lha chos byas nas 'tshang rgya shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smrasapa'o//rje bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bu bstan pa bzang bo gus pas nyon/ /grogs rab 'bring tha gsum su 'grogs kyang / /rang sprang bo'i bu bzhin dman sa zungs/ /tshig shin tu 'jam po smra ba'i sgos/ /gos bza' btung yod na gang mkho byen/ /skyon mthong yang gzhan la mi sgog par/ /dpe sa 'og gter bzhin sbos la zhog /grogs bzang ngan 'bring gsum su la'ang / /dus nam yang gnod pa mi byed par/ /phan thogs dang ci 'dra zhig yin yang / /phan lan du dngos sam brgyud nas kyang / /phan 'dogs pa rten 'brel chos nyid yin/ /phan btags rnams rang la zhen dbang gis/ /rang yon tan gang yod de'i steng du/ /sgo btags nas gzhan la sgog par byed/ /de'i gnad kyis rang la sngar dus su/ /'brel med pa rnams kyang dad pa dang / /ci 'byor bas bsnyen bkur byed par 'gyur/ /'di thos tshad yongs la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang slob bu bstan pa bzang bos bskul ngor tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//gnyen po'i mdung ring rnon po phyag tu bsnams/ /nyon mongs dgra rnams cham la 'bebs mdzad pa'i/ /bka' 539

gdams bla ma rnamam la gus pas 'dud/ /nyon mongs dmag dpung thul bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i man ngag sprin gyi rdo/ /thogs nas ri khrod nam mkhar 'phyo ba yi/ /rnal 'byor g.yu 'brug glu dbyangs sgra sgog la/ /skal ldan slob bu rma bya gzhon nu nyon/ /byams dang snying rje'i 'dab ma rab brkyangs nas/ /byang chub sems kyi mkha' la mi 'phur bar/ /chags sdang gnyis kyi mi gtsang 'dam lhung nas/ /nyon mongs dri mas gos pa'i bya des ci/ /e ma slob bu ya rabs rma bya mchog /rab gsal shes rab mig gis yar la ltos/ /byams dang snying rje gnyis kyi gshog pa rkyongs/ /byang chub sems kyi ljon shing rtse ru 'phur/ /yang dag lta ba'i mdung ring lag thogs nas/ /nyon mongs dmag dpung 'dul ba'i shom ra byas/ /kho bo thog tu byung dus mi 'thab par/ /bag med ri skyibs 'bros pa'i mi des ci/ /e ma slob bu dran shes snying stobs can/ /nyon mongs dgra yi dmag dpung slebs pa'i dus/ /bag med ri yi skyibs su ma bros par/ /lta ba'i mdung ring thog la zing nge bud/ /blo sbyong don bdun shel dkar me long du/ /bltas nas rang sems gzhon nu'i bzhin ras la/ /nyon mongs dri ma'i skyon gyes gos pa rnams/ /byang chub sems gnyis chu yis yang yang khrus/ /dge 540

'dis slob bu rma bya gzhon nu'i chogs/ /rkyen ngan dug gi skyon gyis ma gos steng / /lhag par byang chub sems gnyis nyams len gye/ /sgro mdongs kha dog ches cher gsal bar shog /ces pa 'di yang slob bu ri khrod pa thub bstan rgya mtsho la smras pa'o//sangs rgyas kun dngos rtsa ba'i bla mar/ /gsol ba 'debs so byen gyis rlobs shig /rnal 'byor bdag gis lhag bsam dag pas/ /glu dbyangs len la bu khyod nyon cig /snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams thams cad/ /dper na sgyu ma rmi lam ji bzhin/ /rang gi sems nyid gcig pu'i 'phrul yin/ /sems de gar yod zhib tu tshol dang / /gang yang mi rnyed stong ba nyid yin/ /stong ba de la 'gro 'ong skye 'gags/ /gsal 'grib mtha' dbus e yod ltos dang / /ci yang mi rnyed gyur dus de ltar/ /'tshol mkhan kho la ngos bzung e yod/ /ltos dang 'di zhes ston rgyu mi rnyed//thams cad stong ba nyid du phyam gyis/ /song dus stong sang de yi ngang du/ /shes pa lhod kyis glod la zhog dang / /rnam rtog snga ma thams cad 'gags nas/ /rnam rtog phyi ma ma 'ongs bar der/ /stong gsal rjen pa smra rgyu med pa'i/ /nyams su myong rgyu 'dug pa de nyid/ /lta ba'i gnas lugs mthar thug yin pa'i//ngang du ma bcos rang bab zhog cig /sangs rgyas lag tu 541

bzhag pa yin pas/ /gnas lugs 'di dang 'bral med gyis dang / /tshe gcig lus gcig sangs rgyas thob par/ /'gyur zhes o rgyan chen pos gsungs so/ /de yi ngang la mi gnas rnam rtog /'phro tshe rtog dpyod gang yang ma byed/ /shes pa rang sor glod la zhog dang / /rnam rtog de ma thag tu zhi nas/ /gnas lugs stong gsal rjen pa 'char ro/ /de yi ngang du glod la zhog cig /bying rmugs gnyid gsum gang byung dus su/ /lta stangs shes pa ngar bskyed sa le/ /sang nge hrig ge rjen ne zhog dang / /byeng rmugs gnyid gsum rang sar dwangs nas/ /gnas lugs stong gsal rjen pa 'char ro/ /de yi ngang du glod la zhog cig /rjes thob dus na dper na sgyu ma'i/ /rta glang rnams dang rmi lam snang ba/ /sgyu ma mkhan dang gnyid las byung bzhin/ /chos rnams thams cad sems su thag chod/ /sgyu ma rmi lam snang stong ji bzhin/ /chos rnams thams cad de ltar ltos shig /sgyu ma mkhan gyes lha yul dmyal ba/ /sprul dang gnyid log dus su rmi lam/ /bzang ngan rmis nas bde sdug myong ba/ /mngon sum grub bzhin dge sdig gnyis las/ /'bras bu bde sdug 'byung bar yid ches/ /bskyed la sgyu ma mkhan gyis zhing khams/ /sprul bzhin phyi snod gzhal yas khang dang / /nang bcud lha dang sgra rnams sngags 542

sgra/ /yin par mos pa'i nga rgyal brtan na/ /dag pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig 'char ro/ /gzhan yang gang byed sgyu ma rmi lam lta bur spyod dang ngo mtshar che'o/ /glu dbyangs 'di yis skal ldan yongs la/ /phan pa dpag med thogs par gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang slob bu bstan pa phan bdes bskul ngor tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//thugs rje che mnga' bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /rang yul spangs pa'i ri ba ngas/ /rang gzhan yongs la gros 'di 'debs/ /bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni/ /bsten la zab mo'i gdams pa nyon//chos shes tsam gyis 'tshang mi rgya/ /shes pas mi chog nyams su longs/ /sems la gnod pa'i yul spongs la/ /rtag tu dge ba 'phel sar sdod/ /brtan pa ma thob 'du 'dzi gnod/ /ri khrod dben pa zhwa ltar bsten/ /nyon mongs skye ba'i grogs po spongs/ /dge 'phel grogs bsten de sems zungs/ /'jig rten bya ba tshar dus med/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis thongs/ /gzhan gyes ci bshad khar ma nyan/ /mtshan ldan bla mas gang gsung sgrubs/ /gus pa chen pos legs bsgrubs na/ /ring bor mi thogs 'bras bu 'byung / /snying nas chos bzhin byas gyur na/ /lto rgyab zhor la 'byung bar nges/ /'dod yon tshwa chu 'thung ba bzhin/ /ngoms pa med pas chog shes mdzod/ /543

dregs rlom nga rgyal khengs pa'i sems/ /smod la zhi zhing dul bar gyis/ /bsod nams zer ba'i 'du 'dzi de/ /chos kyi bar chad yin pas spongs/ /rnyed bkur bdud kyi zhags pa yin/ /'ching bar nges pas zhen pa thongs/ /bstod dang grags pa'i tshig rnams ni/ /bslu brid yin pas snabs bzhin dor/ /bde skyid snyan gsum 'dzoms na yang / /yud tsam yin pas rgyab tu skyur/ /'di bas phyi ma'i lam thag ring / /phyi ma'i rgyags phye nor rnams gsogs/ /'chi tshe thams cad bzhag nas 'gro/ /gang la chags med zhen med gyes/ /dman pa rnams la snying rje bskyed/ /khyad du gsod dang brnyas pa spongs/ /dgra spun sde ris gang la yang / /sdang zhen phyogs ris med par mdzod/ /yon tan can la phrag dog ni/ /ma mdzad gus pas yon tan longs/ /nam yang gzhan gye skyon ma brtags/ /rang skyon rtogs la skyon rnams spongs/ /rang dge ma bsams gzhan dge soms/ /kun la bran bzhin gus par mdzod/ /'gro la pha ma'i 'du shes bskyed/ /rtag tu kun la byams par gyis/ /bzhin mdangs gsal zhing 'dzum bzhin du/ /byams pa'i yid kyis tshig 'jam smros/ /smra ba mang na 'khrul ba 'byung / /tshod bzung ran par smras na bzang / /bya ba mang na dge sbyor chag /chos min bya ba thams cad zhog /544

snying bo med pa'i las rnams la/ /rtsol ba ma byed don go med/ /dam pas khrel na shi dang 'dra/ /g.yo sgyu med par drang bo gyis/ /tshe 'dir sdug bsngal ci 'byung rnams/ /sngon gyi las su go bar gyes/ /bde ba thams cad bla ma yin/ /bka' drin yin pas drin gzo mdzod/ /rang rgyud ma thul gzhan gyi rgyud/ /mi thul thog mar rang rgyud thul/ /mngon shes med par 'gro ba gzhan/ /smin par mi nus sgrub la brtson/ /bsags pa'i nor rnams bzhag nas 'gro/ /nor rdzas phyir du sdig ma gsogs/ /longs spyod g.yo ba 'di nyid la/ /snying bo med pas mchod sbyin thongs/ /tshe 'dir mdzes shing phyi ma ru/ /bde ba'i tshul khrims rnams dag srungs/ /zhe sdang mtshon cha byung ba'i dus/ /khro med bzod pa'i go cha gyon/ /le los rang gzhan don mi 'grub/ /dge ba'i las la brtson 'grus skyed/ /rang sems 'dul dka'i glang bo che/ /bsam gtan ka ba brtan por thogs/ /ma rtogs log rtog dra ba rnams/ /shes rab ral gris rtsad nas chod/ /'khor ba'i 'dam rdzab 'di nyid na/ /skyid med thar ba'i skam sar gshegs/ /de ltar mdzad na 'di phyi ru/ /bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa 'byung / /gtam 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyes/ /rang gzhan yongs la phan phyir smras/ /de skad smras pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /545

rang gzhan sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces pa 'di yang a rig gi dad can mchog ldan phun tshogs sogs khong rnams pa 'gas bskul ngor tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /blo chos la phyogs par byen gyis rlobs/ /nga bya btang rnal 'byor glu dbyangs la/ /khyed rnam grol nyon la yid la zungs/ /mi lus 'di yid bzhin nor bu 'dra/ /rnyed shin tu dka' ba yid la zungs/ /tshe mi rtag nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon 'dra/ /yun ring bor mi sdod yid la zungs/ /khyim bza' tshang tshong 'dus mgron po 'dra/ /kun so sor 'bral ba yid la zungs/ /rgyu dbyar dus rtswa mgo'i zil ba 'dra/ /dus rgyun du mi rtag yid la zungs/ /mar dmyal khams me yi 'obs dang 'dra/ /sdug bzod par dka' ba yid la zungs/ /srog bcad pa gshin rje'i zhags thebs 'dra/ /mthar dmyal bar khrid pas yid la zungs/ /brkus 'phrog bcom byas pa dom blangs 'dra/ /slar skyin pa 'jal dgos yid la zungs/ /mna' zos pa dug chu 'thungs pa 'dra/ /phyis sdug bsngal myong ba yid la zungs/ /sdig ltung ba khu tshur brag brgyab 'dra//tshur sdug bsngal myong ba yid la zungs/ /dzun bshad pa rang thog sa spungs 'dra/ /sdug rgyun du myong ba yid la zungs/ /mtshang brus pa brag 546

la gtam smras 'dra/ /lan de 'dra 'byung ba yid la zungs/ /chos byas pa gser dngul blangs pa 'dra/ /gang byas tshad 'tshengs pa yid la zungs/ /lus dal bar ma sdod phyag skor rem/ /kha dal bar ma sdod ma ṇi thon/ /sems bzang na ci byas chos su 'gro/ /mi gzhan la bsam pa dkar bo gyes/ /glu 'di nyid thos tshad thams cad kyi/ /blo dam pa'i chos la phyogs par shog /ces pa 'di yang dge slong rnam grol gyis zhal gdams shig dgos zhes bskul ngor tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//'khor 'das chos kun lag mthil skyu ru ra/ /rlon pa bzhag nas bltas ltar sa ler mkhyen/ /zhal nas nam yang dzun gye tshig mi gsung / /dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag dang bdag 'dra'i snyigs dus skye bo yis/ /dkar nag las 'bras bslu ba med shes nas/ /mi dge las rnams phra zhing phra ba spangs/ /dge tshogs mtha' dag bsgrub par byin gyis rlobs/ /da lta mi lus rin chen thob dus 'dir/ /yar 'gro dam pa'i lha chos mi byed par/ /mar 'gro mi dge las rnams byed pa yi/ /snyigs dus skya ser pho mo bsgrims te nyon/ /'o skol 'dzam bu gling ba 'di'i 'og nas/ /dpag tshad stong phrag nyi shu 'das pa na/ /lcags kyi khang ba gru bzhi ngos re la/ /dpag 547

tshad bcu gnyis yod pa de dbus na/ /seng ges btegs pa'i mtho ba'i khri'i steng na/ /gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po zhes bya bzhugs/ /phyag tu srid pa las kyi me long dang / /khram shing dkar nag thogs nas legs nyes 'byed/ /mtha' skor phyogs mtshams rnams su mdog mi sdug /gshin rje pho nya mgo brnyan mi 'dra ba/ /mtshon cha thogs pa grangs med shig shig byed/ /mi gang shi ba dmyal ba'i gshed mas 'khrid/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i lha yis mdun nas bsus/ /mnyam por 'ongs pa'i bdud kyis rgyab nas ded/ /gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du 'gro /'e tsho 'e tsho sems yod pho mo rnams/ /da lta da lta mi 'chi nges pa med/ /ma byed ma byed mi dge las ma byed/ /byed na byed na dge ba'i las la 'bod/ /drung du song na zhal nas 'di skad du/ /khyod ni sangs rgyas bstan pa dar sar skyes/ /mtshan ldan bla ma mang bo'i zhal nas ngas/ /dge sdig gnyis kyi rtsis grangs zhib mo brgyab/ /dge byas yar gtong sdig byas mar gtong zhes/ /gsungs pa thos nas chos byas yod mod snyam/ /gsung mchog yi ge drug ma ci tsam bton/ /phyag skor sgyung gnas bsnyen gnas ci tsam bsrungs/ /dkon mchog mchod pa dge 'dun bsnyen bkur dang / /ngan slong sbyin gtong pha ma'i zhabs tog sogs/ /548

dge ba gang byas thams cad drang bor shod/ /srog bcad ma byen pa blangs mi tshangs spyod/ /rdzun dang phra ma tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal dang / /brnab sems gnod sems log lta la sogs pa'i/ /mar 'gro mi dge las rnams ma byas mod/ /byas sam ma byas drang bor shod shod zer/ /'jigs so 'jigs so de dus ci zhig zhu/ /mi rnams mi rnams dam pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /'di dang 'di 'dra'i dge ba byas lags zhes/ /mang bo mang bo bshad rgyu yod ni gyis/ /de skad gsungs tshe dge ba byas pa'i mi/ /dga' bzhin skad gseng mthon pos 'di skad zhu/ /legs so bdag ni sngon bsags bsod nams mthus/ /gling gi mchog gyur 'dzam bu'i gling du sgyes/ /rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i bstan par mjal/ /chung nas bstan dang bstan 'dzin rnams la dad/ /cher song bla ma mang bo'i zhabs pad bsten/ /dbang lung man ngag gdams pa mang bo zhus/ /khyed kyi dge sdig rtsis grangs zhib bo zhes/ /lan gcig ma yin yang yang rna bas go /thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas gsung gang la'ang / /mi bden mi srid snyam nas dge ba'i las/ /yi ge drug ma phyag skor 'di tsam byas/ /smyung gnas bsnyen gnas gnyis la 'di tsam song / /dkon mchog mchod pa pha ma'i zhabs tog dang / /sems can srog bskyabs sbyin btang tshangs 549
