par spyad/ /bden smra 'khon pa bsdums dang tshig 'jam smras/ /don dang ldan pa'i gtam bshad chog shes byas/ /byams pa sgom dang las 'bras yid ches sogs/ /dge ba'i las ni gang thub 'bad pa lags/ /mi dge las ni shes bzhin byas pa med/ /ma shes bzhin du byas 'dra e yod snyam/ /bar bar bshags pa mang bo byas yod lags/ /zhus tshe lhan cig skyes pa'i lha bzhengs nas/ /phyag gsum btsal nas 'dzum bzhin 'di skad zhu/ /e ma chos rgyal chen po bdag la dgongs/ /mi 'di'i cha rgyus thams cad nga la yod/ /mi 'di'i yul dang pha ma 'di skad yin/ /kho bo chung nas dkon mchog gsum la dad/ /sems can rnams la byams dang snying rje che/ /yig drug phyag skor smyung gnas bsnyen gnas bsrungs/ /dkon mchog mchod pa dbul bor sbyin pa btang / /bla ma pha ma'i zhabs tog byas pa sogs/ /kho yis sngar zhus rnams la rdzun med bden/ /mi 'dis dkar bo dge ba byas pa'i grangs/ /'di zhes rde'u dkar bo mdun du spungs/ /mi 'di mtho ris lha 'am mi yul du/ /da lta chos rgyal khyed kyis thongs shig zer/ /de nas mnyam por 'ongs pa'i bdud langs nas/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i lha yis gang zhus rdzun/ /mi 'dis mi dge 'di dang 'di 'dra byas/ /mi dge gang byas rnams kyi grangs 'di 550

zhes/ /rde'u nag po gang yod mdun du 'jog /mi 'dis gzhan yang mi dge byas yod lags/ /ngan 'gro'i gnas su mi 'di thongs shig zer/ /de ltar bshad res byed dus bdud pham nas//lha de rgyal du chugs shig 'dir tshogs tsho/ /de nas las kyi me long nang du blta/ /khyod kyis dge ba byas pa 'di red ces/ /las kyi me long rang la bstan pa'i tshe/ /nang du bltas pas sngar byas dge ba'i las/ /sa ler mthong tshe sngar las lhag par dga'/ /de nas dkar nag rde'u mang nyung rtsis/ /rgya mar 'jal nas khram shing dkar bo la/ /yi ge bris nas zhal nas 'di skad du/ /mi khyod mi lus thob pa don ldan byas/ /nga ni chos kyi rgyal po yin pas na/ /mi dge byas pa mtho ris gtang ba dang / /dge byas ngan 'gror btang ba gcig med ces/ /mtho ris lha'am mi yul 'gro ba'i lam/ /bstan nas da ni mi khyod lam 'dir song / /sngar bzhin dge ba gyes la shog cig gsungs/ /legs so zhus nas mtho ris lam la 'gro/ /lha 'am mi yul gzhan du 'gro dgos na/ /mi de kha phyir phyogs nas 'di skad zer/ /'dzam bu gling du 'gro ba'i mi yod na/ /nga bzhin dkar bo dge ba byas gyur na/ /mtho ris gnas su 'gro gi shod cig zer/ /da lta sdug rung dam chos byed pa'i mi/ /de dus dgod bzhin mtho ris 551

gnas su 'gro/ /ma na ma shi gong 'dir chos byed dgos//ma byed ma byed rnam g.yeng las ma byed/ /ma 'dug ma 'dug da lta lha chos rem/ /ma nyal ma nyal phyag skor kha ton gyis/ /mi dge sdig pa byas pa'i mi rnams ni/ /gshin rje chos rgyal drung du song tsa na/ /gshin rje chos kyi rgyal pos sngar ltar 'dri/ /dris tshe la la dngangs nas lus po 'dar/ /la las mchi ma 'byen bzhin smra mi nus/ /la las bdag gis chung dus chos ma dran/ /cher song khyem tshang bza' ba mang bo yi/ /lto rgyab gnyis ka ma 'dang ma khebs nas/ /dam chos bsgrub la khom skal ma byung lags/ /bla ma mang bos dmyal ba'i sbug bsngal dang / /tshe tshad la sogs bshad pa yang yang du/ /go rung mi bden bshad tshod yin bsams nas/ /cung zad khom yang don gnyer ma byas lags/ /'di bzhin dge sdig rtsis grangs zhib mo zhig /rgyag gin yod pa da min ngas ma mthong / /da ni khyem du phyir la nga cig thongs/ /dge ba'i phyogs la 'bad nas 'ong lags zer/ /de nas mnyam por 'ongs pa'i bdud langs nas/ /phyag gsum 'tshal nas 'dzum bzhin 'di skad zhu/ /e ma chos rgyal bdag la snyan gson dang / /mi 'di'i cha rgyus thams cad nga la gsal/ /zhu rgyu mang bo nga yi kha na yod/ /mi 'di skyes pa'i yul dang pha ma 'di/ /kho bo chung nas sdig pa'i 50 2

las la dga'/ /mthong tshad khyi la rdo dang dbyug pas rdung / /bye'u phrug blangs dang bya byi mang bo bsad/ /cher song ra lug ri dwags nya la sogs/ /sems can rigs ni mang bo bsad nas zos/ /mi bsad rta ded pha ma gnyis la brdungs/ /brkus dang 'phrog bcom la sogs mi dge'i las/ /mi 'dis byas tshad grangs ni 'di yin zhes/ /rde'u nag po mang bo mdun du spungs/ /chos rgyal khyed kyis da cang gsung mi dgos/ /mi 'di dmyal ba ma gtogs 'gro sa med/ /las kyi me long nang du lta rgyu med/ /rgya mar 'jal rgyu'ang cang med da khrid zer/ /de nas lhan cig skyes pa'i lha bzhengs nas/ /bzhin mdangs gnag nas mi 'dis chung ngu'i dus/ /dam chos ma dran cher song sdig grogs kyi/ /dbang du song nas dge ba cher ma byas / /'di dang 'di 'dra'i dkar bo dge ba byas/ /dge ba gang byas grangs ni 'di yin zhes/ /rde'u dkar bo gang yod mdun du 'jog /mi 'dis sngar zhus ltar du phyir thongs dang / /dge ba'i las la 'bad nas 'ong lags zer/ /mnyam por 'ongs pa'i bdud kyis lan 'di 'debs/ /ha ha sngon chad mi 'ga' phyir btang nas/ /'ongs pa'i mi khyod mthong ngam thos sam ci/ /lha khyod lab lab ma mang kha rog zer/ /de ltar bshad res byed dus lha pham nas/ /bdud 553

de rgyal du ma 'jug sems yod tsho/ /de nas las kyi me long nang du blta/ /khyod kyis mi dge gang byas 'di red ces/ /me long bstan pa'i nang du bltas pa'i tshe/ /sngar byas mi dge sdig pa'i las rnams ni/ /mthong tshe sngar bas 'gyod pa drag po skyes/ /de nas dkar nag rde'u zhib tu rtsis/ /rgya mar bkyags nas khram shing nag po la/ /yi ge bris nas zhal nas 'di skad du/ /mi khyod mi lus thob pa don med byas/ /nga ni chos kyi rgyal po yin pas na/ /sngon chad mi dge'i sdig pa byas pa'i mi/ /mtho ris btang dang dge ba byas pa'i mi/ /ngan 'gror btang ba'i mi ni gcig kyang med/ /gshin rje pho nya rnams la 'di skad gsungs/ /mi 'di ma 'jog dmyal ba'i gnas su khyer/ /lo 'am bskal pa 'di 'dra'i bar zhog ces/ /de dang de 'dra'i zhal gsung 'jigs po go /bsam zhing bsam zhing 'jigs skrag 'gyod pa skye/ /ma byed ma byed mi dge bcu ma byed/ /byed na byed na da lta dge bcu sgrubs/ /de nas gshin rje pho nya mang bo yis/ /a la la dang ha ha'i gad rgyangs bsgrags/ /ske la 'chor med zhags pa nag po 'debs/ /lus la mtshon cha rnon po mang bos btab/ /sod chod rgyob gtubs la sogs dgra skad 'then/ /spyi bo sa la btsugs nas lam nag gi /nang du thur du 'khrid dus 'di skad zer/ /554

'dzam bu gling du 'gro ba'i mi yod na/ /nga bzhin lto rgyab phyir du sdig ma byed/ /byas na dmyal bar 'gro gi shod cig zer/ /da lta dgod bzhin sdig las byed pa'i mi/ /de dus ngu bzhin sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur/ /mi rnams mi rnams bsam blo zhib tu thongs/ /'jigs so 'jigs so de dus ci zhig bya/ /ma byed ma byed mi dge'i las ma byed/ /myur bar myur bar dge ba'i las la rem/ /glu dbyangs 'di nyid thos tshad thams cad kyis/ /dkar nag las 'bras bslu med shes byas nas/ /nag po mi dge'i las rnams thams cad spangs/ /dkar bo dge ba'i las la 'bad par shog /ces pa 'di yang slob bu ngag dbang bkra shis kyis kun la phan pa'i zhal gdams shig dgos zhes bskul ngor tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//dpe dgos 'dod kun 'byung nor bu yis/ /gzhan ci 'dod re ba skong ba bzhin//yar thar 'dod skal ldan gdul bya yi/ /yid gang 'dod chos gsung chos kyi rgyal/ /rang nam 'dod dus su spyi gtsug tu/ /sems gang 'dod dngos grub stsol phyir bzhugs/ /steng mtho la yangs pa'i nam mkha' de/ /kho 'pho 'gyur med par gnas pa'i tshe/ /nang lho sprin lang long 'khrigs na yang / /slar sngar bzhin 'pho 'gyur ma byung bas/ / nang lho sprin rang sar yal ba dang / /mkha' 'pho 'gyur med par gnas 555

pa mtshar/ /bar sra zhing brtan pa'i ri bo de/ /kho g.yo 'gul med par gnas pa'i tshe/ /nang rtsi shing phyi ru rgyas na yang / /slar sngar bzhin g.yo 'gul ma byas pas/ /nang rtsi shing rang sar thim pa dang / /ri g.yo 'gul med par gnas pa mtshar/ /smad dwangs gsal rnyog med rgya mtsho de/ /kho bri gang med par gnas pa'i tshe/ /nang rba rlabs phyogs bcur g.yo na yang //slar sngar bzhin bri gang ma byas pas/ /nang rba rlabs rang sar zhi ba dang / /mtsho bri gang med par gnas pa mtshar/ /gnas dben par 'dug pa'i sgom chen nga / /sems stong gsal mnyam gzhag ngang gnas tshe/ /nang bzang ngan rnam rtog 'phro na yang / /slar sngar bzhin mnyam gzhag ngang gnas pas/ /nang rnam rtog rang sar zhi ba dang //bsgom rgyun chad med par gnas pa mtshar/ /'di chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' drin yin/ /dus da dung drin lan sgrub pas 'jal/ /shugs brtse bas gzigs shig ngag gi dbang / /glu 'di thos sgom chen thams cad kyi/ /sems rnam rtog dbang du mi 'gro bar/ /bsgom rgyun chad med par skyong nus shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis mtsho snying dben pa'i spang gzhongs me tog phang phung g.yo zhing bung ba lang ling 'phur ba'i ri skyibs nas blangs pa'o//mdo rgyud gsung rab thams cad nas/ /sangs rgyas las 556

kyang cher bsngags pa'i/ /zla med skyabs mgon bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byen gyes rlobs/ /bla dpon bya rgyal rgod po 'dra/ /'chi bdag bdud ni thag rnyi 'dra/ /rnyi yis nam 'dzin cha med pas/ /bla dpon rnams tsho dogs zon gyis/ /btsan po seng ge dkar mo 'dra/ /'chi bdag bdud ni srin bu 'dra/ /srin bus nam gsod cha med pas/ /btsan po rnams tsho dogs zon gyis/ /mkhas pa ne tso smra mkhan 'dra/ /'chi bdag bdud ni rgya khra 'dra/ /rgya khras nam 'dzin cha med pas/ /mkhas pa rnams tsho dogs zon gyis/ /dpa' bo rgya stag khra bo 'dra/ /'chi bdag bdud ni sa mda' 'dra/ /sa mdas nam gsod cha med pas/ /dpa' bo rnams tsho dogs zon gyis/ /rgan rgon gad kha'i sdong rgan 'dra/ /'chi bdag bdud ni rlung chen 'dra/ /rlung gis nam bsgyel cha med pas/ /rgan rgon rnams tsho dogs zon gyis/ /gzhon pa lha khang log bris 'dra/ /'chi bdag bdud ni thigs chu 'dra/ /thigs pas nam brdung cha med pas/ /gzhon pa rnams tsho dogs zon gyes/ /byis pa ston ga'i me tog 'dra/ /'chi bdag bdud ni ba mo 'dra/ /ba mos nam 'khyer cha med pas/ /byis pa rnams tsho dogs zon gyis/ /mdor na tshe srog mar me 'dra/ /'chi rkyen mang ba char rlung 'dra/ /glo bur nam gsod cha med pas/ /557

rgan gzhon bar mas dogs zon gyis/ /de la phan pa'i thabs 'tshol na/ /bsten na mtshan ldan bla ma sten/ /nyan na zab mo'i gdams pa nyon/ /bsgoms na dben pa'i ri la sgoms/ /yang na yul nas dkon mchog mchod/ /dbul phongs rnams la sbyin pa thongs/ /rgyun du bla ma pha ma bkur/ /mjug tu bsngo ba smon lam thobs/ /de ltar byas na tshe rabs kun/ /bde zhing nam zhig sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /'di thos gnas skabs bde zhing skyid/ /mthar thug byang chub thob par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//chos mdzad yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /chos kyi sgor zhugs gang zag rnams/ /chos dang mthun par byin gyis rlobs/ /dal 'byor mi lus thob dus 'dir/ /nyin mtshan kun tu dam chos la/ /thos bsam sgom gsum byed pa de/ /chos pa rnams kyi lag len yin/ /nyon mongs yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel/ /dkar chos tho rangs rgyu skar ltar/ /'grib pa'i pha yul spong ba de//chos pa rnams kyi lag len yin/ /me tog sna tshogs gcal du bkram/ /bung bas snyan pa'i sgra sgrog pa'i/ /dben pa'i ri ngogs bsten pa de/ /chos pa rnams kyi lag len yin/ /'grogs pa'i mdza' bshes so sor 'bral/ /bsags 558

pa'i nor rdzas shul du 'jog /tshe 'di blo yis gtong ba de/ /chos pa rnams kyi lag len yin/ /'grogs na dug gsum cher 'phel zhing / /byams dang snying rje 'grib byed pa'i/ /grogs po ngan pa spong ba de/ /chos pa rnams kyi lag len yin/ /bsten na nyes pa zad 'gyur zhing / /yon tan tshogs rnams 'phel 'gyur ba'i/ /bshes gnyen dam pa bsten pa de/ /chos pa rnams kyi lag len yin/ /'jig rten lha la skyabs mi 'tshol/ /nam yang bslu ba med pa yi/ /dkon mchog skyabs su bsten pa de/ /chos pa rnams kyi lag len yin/ /bzod dka' ngan song sdug bsngal rnams/ /sdig las 'bras bur thub pas gsungs/ /sdig pa'i las rnams spong ba de/ /chos pa rnams kyi lag len yin/ /srid pa'i bde la mi chags par/ /nam yang mi 'gyur thar ba yi/ /bde ba don du gnyer ba de/ /chos pa rnams kyi lag len yin/ /drin can ma rnams sdug gyur na/ /rang bde ci bya sems can rnams/ /sgol phyir sems mchog bskyed pa de/ /chos pa rnams kyi lag len yin/ /sdug bsngal bdag bde 'dod las byung / /bde ba gzhan phan sems las byung / /bdag bde gzhan sdug brje ba de/ /chos pa rnams kyi lag len yin/ /bdag nor gzhan gyis phrogs na yang / /lus dang longs spyod dus gsum gyi/ /dge ba de la bsngo 559

ba de//chos pa rnams kyi lag len yin/ /nyes pa med bzhin rang gi mgo /gcod kyang yid kyis mi de yi/ /sdig pa bdag la len pa de/ /chos pa rnams kyi lag len yin/ /rang la gzhan gyis mi snyan pa/ /sna tshogs sgog kyang byams sems kyis//de yi yon tan brjod pa de/ /chos pa rnams kyi lag len yin/ /mtshang 'bru tshig ngan smra ba'i mi/ /dge ba'i bshes su 'du shes kyis/ /de la gus pas 'dud pa de/ /chos pa rnams kyi lag len yin/ /bdag gis bu bzhin bskyangs pa'i mis/ /bdag la dgra bzhin blta na yang / /slar yang lhag par brtse ba de/ /chos pa rnams kyi lag len yin/ /gzhan gyis brnyas 'thab byed na yang //slar yang de nyid bla ma bzhin/ /rang gi spyi bor 'khur ba de/ /chos pa rnams kyi lag len yin/ /'tsho bas phongs shing mi yis brnyas/ /nad dang gdon gyis btab kyang slar/ /'gro kun sdug bsngal len pa de/ /chos pa rnams kyi lag len yin/ /'gro ba mang bos bkur zhing mchod/ /nor rdzas phul kyang snying bo med/ /shes nas khengs pa med pa de/ /chos pa rnams kyi lag len yin/ /zhe sdang dgra bo ma btul na/ /phyi rol dgra bo btul kyang 'phel/ /de phyir rang rgyud 'dul ba de/ /chos pa rnams kyi lag len yin/ /'dod yon lan tshwa'i chu dang 'dra/ /ci tsam spyad kyang ngoms pa med/ /gang 560

la zhen chags spong ba de/ /chos pa rnams kyi lag len yin/ /yid 'ong yul dang phrad pa'i tshe/ /'ja' bzhin mdzes kyang bden med du/ /bltas nas zhen chags spong ba de/ /chos pa rnams kyi lag len yin/ /mi 'dod rkyen dang phrad pa'i tshe/ /rmi lam skabs su sdug pyong ltar/ /bden med 'khrul bar blta ba de/ /chos pa rnams kyi lag len yin/ /lus dang longs spyod thams cad la/ /nam yang chags pa mi mdzad par/ /gang yod sbyin par gtong ba de/ /chos pa rnams kyi lag len yin/ /khrims med rang don mi 'grub na/ /gzhan don bsgrub pa smos ci dgos/ /de phyir tshul khrims bsrung ba de/ /chos pa rnams kyi lag len yin/ /zhe sdang skad cig gcig gis kyang / /bskal pa du ma'i dge rtsa gzhom/ /de phyir bzod ba bsgom pa de/ /chos pa rnams kyi lag len yin/ /tshogs gnyis bsod nams bsags pa'i phyir/ /mgo la me shor gsod pa ltar/ /myur du brtson 'grus bskyed pa de/ /chos pa rnams kyi lag len yin/ /rnam g.yeng tshogs rnams rab bcom nas/ /lus sems shin sbyangs bde ba'i ros/ /myos byed bsam gtan bsgom pa de/ /chos pa rnams kyi lag len yin/ /shes rab med na phar phyin lnga'i/ /sangs rgyas thob par mi nus pas/ /khyad par shes rab bsgyed pa de/ /chos 561

pa rnams kyi lag len yin/ /rang rgyud rang gis ma brtags na/ /chos pa'i gzugs gyis chos min byed/ /rgyun du rang rgyud brtag pa de/ /chos pa rnams kyi lag len yin/ /theg chen la zhugs gang zag gis//nyes pa brjod na rang nyid nyams/ /de phyir nyes pa mi gleng ba//chos pa rnams kyi lag len yin/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i bya ba rnams/ /nyams pa'i mdza' bshes sbyin bdag khyim/ /rnams la chags pa spong ba de/ /chos pa rnams kyi lag len yin/ /rtsub pa'i tshig gis gzhan sems 'khrugs/ /de phyir gzhan yid mi 'ong ba'i/ /mi snyan tshig rtsub spong ba de/ /chos pa rnams kyi lag len yin/ /nyon mongs dgra bo ma byung dus/ /dran shes skyes bus gnyen po'i mtshon/ /bzung nas 'bur bcom byed pa de/ /chos pa rnams kyi lag len yin/ /mdor na bya ba ci byed kyang / /rgyun du dran shes legs bsten nas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis bsgrub pa de/ /chos pa rnams kyi lag len yin/ /de ltar byas pa'i dge ba rnams/ /'gro kun sangs rgyas thob pa'i phyir/ /'dun pa drag pos bsngo ba de/ /chos pa rnams kyi lag len yin/ /chos pa rnams kyi lag len 'di/ /chos pa'i gzugs 'dzin ri ba ngas/ /chos min bya ba mi 'dod pa'i/ /chos byed 'dod la phan phyir smras/ /'di nyid thos tshad mi rnams kyis/ /562

'di dang mi mthun rnams spangs nas/ /'di bzhin lag tu blangs pa'i mthus/ /'di phyi kun tu skyid par shog /ces pa 'di yang slob bu bstan pa phan bdes zhal gdams shig dgos zhes bskul ngor tshogs drug rang grol gyis spras pa'o//drin can bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /'chi ba yang yang dran par byen gyes rlobs/ /gangs la gnas pa'i seng ge dkar mo de/ /srin bu khog tu zhugs te gsob nas bsad/ /'di yang mi rtag 'chi ba'i dpe gcig yin/ /tshul 'di soms la mi lus snying bo longs/ /chu la gnas pa'i nya mo gser mig de/ /lcags kyu rnon pos bzung nas nya bdas bsad/ /'di yang mi rtag 'chi ba'i dpe gcig yin/ /tshul 'di soms la mi lus snying bo longs/ /rdza rir gnas pa'i sha ba smug po de/ /ske mda' 'phangs nas rngon pa rnams kyis bsad/ /'di yang mi rtag 'chi ba'i dpe gcig yin/ /tshul 'di soms la mi lus snying bo longs/ /nags la gnas pa'i rgya stag khra bo de/ /sa mda' rnon pos mchan du brgyab nas bsad/ /'di yang mi rtag 'chi ba'i dpe gcig yin/ /tshul 'di soms la mi lus snying bo longs/ /sgo la gnas pa'i ra dang lug rnams ni/ /glo bur sa la bsgyel nas g.yog pos bsad/ /'di yang mi rtag 'chi ba'i dpe gcig 563

yin/ /tshul 'di soms la mi lus snying bo longs/ /rgan gzhon bar ma'i mi rnams phal cher ni/ /me chu dug mtshon nad kyis glo bur bsad/ /'di yang mi rtag 'chi ba'i dpe gcig yin/ /tshul 'di soms la mi lus snying bo longs/ /'di nyid thos tshad 'chi bas rgyud bskul nas/ /dal ba'i rten la snying bo len par shog /ces pa 'di yang dge slong byams pa mtha' yas kyis bskul ngor tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku/ /mdo rgyud man ngag ston pa'i gsung / /mkhyen brtse yon tan mnga' ba'i thugs/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rnyed dka'i rten thob bstan dang mjal/ /mkhas grub bla ma mang bsten pa'i/ /dad ldan snying gi bu mchog la/ /spyi sgos bslab bya bshad kyis nyon/ /bla ma'i drung du 'dug dus su/ /skyon rtog rnam g.yeng ma byed par/ /ci mdzad legs par ltos shig dang / /phyin rlabs myur du rgyud la 'jug /mched grogs rnams dang 'grogs dus su/ /nye ring phyogs cha'i chags sdang gis/ /gcig zer gcig la ma lab par/ /mthun po gyes dang ci bsam 'grub/ /deng sang chos lugs mang na yang / /thams cad sangs rgyas lam du gcig /kun la ma smod dag snang sbyongs/ /chos spongs nyes pas mi gos 564

bzang / /zhe sdang lan gcig skyes na yang / /sngar byas dge kun 'joms par gsungs/ /bzod pa sgoms dang dge mi 'joms/ /phyi ma'i dus na gzugs bzang thob/ /dad zas gshin zas zer ba de/ /phral du zhim yang phugs su gnod/ /byung dus khong 'dzum mi byed par/ /dkor sbyong mdzod dang rnam smin med/ /grong dgon gang na'ang bde ba med/ /sdug bsngal chu chen gnyer ma 'dra/ /dben pa'i ri khrod sten cig dang / /'phral phugs gnyis kyi bde skyid 'byung / /'jig rten las la tshar dus med/ /'dod yon spyad kyang ngoms pa med/ /dam pa'i lha chos mdzod cig dang / /gtan gye 'dun ma 'grub par nges/ /snyigs dus tshe la nges pa med/ /do nub yin yang 'chi nyen yod/ /chos la phyi bshol ma byed par/ /myur du gyis dang 'chi tshe dga'/ /tshe 'di'i kha rgyab sus kyang sla/ /phyi ma'i bde ba rnyed par dka'/ /da lta dam chos gyis shig dang / /'jig rten phyi mar bde zhing skyid/ /skyid sdug gdam ka yod dus 'dir/ /ngan 'gro'i rgyu rnams ma bsgrubs par/ /mngon mtho nges legs rgyu sgrubs dang / /da nas bde nas bde bar 'gro/ /mang bo'i nang du 'dug dus su/ /tshig rtsub rdzun gtam ma lab par/ /tshig 'jam drang bor spros shig dang / /mi kun dga' zhing yid du 'ong / /565

gcig pur 'dug dus sems la ltos/ /mi dge'i sems spangs dge sems dang //stong nyid snying rje sgoms shig dang / /bde skyid nyi ma 'char bar nges/ /spyi sgos bslab bya'i glu dbyangs 'di/ /dben gnas khyad 'phags mtsho snying nas/ /dad ldan bu la legs par gdams//mgrin pa legs bshad bang mdzod nas/ /glu dbyangs snyan mo de 'dra thal/ /tshig don ma brjed yid la zungs/ /'phral yun bde'o snying gi bu/ /dge 'dis skal ldan slob ma yi/ /gtso byas mkha' mnyam mgro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog /ces pa 'di yang a rig gi slob bu grags pas bskul ngor tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//bla ma la gus sgrub la rab tu brtson/ /shes rab che zhing 'dzin chags cung zad med/ /shes rgyud dar bas 'jam zhing lhod chags po/ /skal ldan snying gi bu la glu 'di 'bul/ /mtho la yangs pa'i stong gsal nam mkha' la/ /mtha' dang dbus med 'phel 'grib gang stong med/ /'gro dang 'ong med gnas pa med pa ltar/ /rang gi sems nyid de bzhin shes par gyis/ /me long rab du dwangs pa'i nang nyid du/ /bltas tshe gzugs brnyan ma 'dres gsal ba na/ /snang yang rang bzhin ma grub stong ba ltar/ /rang gi lus 'di de bzhin shes par gyis//dbyar dang ston kha'i 566

dus su ri bo la/ /na bun lang long sked la langs pa na/ /snang yang rang bzhin ma grub stong ba ltar/ /zas nor longs spyod de bzhin shes par gyis/ /brag ri'i kha nas bzang ngan gtam bshad tshe/ /brag ca bzang ngan lhang lhang thos pa na/ /grags kyang rang bzhin ma grub stong ba ltar/ /bstod smad sgra rnams de bzhin shes par gyis/ /mtshan mo gnyid du log pa'i gnas skabs su/ /rmi lam bde sdug mang bo rmis pa na/ /snang yang rang bzhin ma grub stong ba ltar/ /bde sdug thams cad de bzhin shes par gyes/ /sgyu mar mkhas pas sgye bo mang bo yi/ /mdun nas sgyu ma'i rtsed mo byas pa na/ /snang yang rang bzhin ma grub stong ba ltar/ /'khor ba'i chos rnams de bzhin shes par gyis/ /dbyar dus nyi shar char zil 'bab pa'i tshe/ /'ja' tshon sna lnga ma 'dres shar ba na/ /snang yang rang bzhin ma grub stong ba ltar/ /'das pa'i chos rnams de bzhin shes par gyis/ /mtshan mo dwangs bsil rnyog med chu nang du/ /zla ba skar ma'i gzugs brnyan shar ba na/ /snang yang rang bzhin ma grub stong ba ltar/ /chos rnams thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis/ /zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis slob bu thub bstan rgya mtsho la smras pa'o//dpe nor bur gsol ba btab pa na/ /gzhan ci 'dod re 567

ba skong ba bzhin/ /rje drin can bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub bstsal tu gsol/ /dpe rgya mtsho chu yi gter yin yang / /gzhan sa stong chu bo kun 'bab bzhin/ /mi mkhas pa yon tan mjod 'dzin pa/ /des gzhan gyi legs bshad rin chen bsdu/ /dpe rdul dang 'dres pa'i lcags phye rnams/ /len khab len rdo yis shes pa bzhin/ /gzhan skye bo yon tan yod med pa'i/ /blang dor la blo gros ldan pa mkhas/ /dpe nam mkha' lding gis dug can sbrul/ /gsod nus kyi khwa tas mi sod bzhin/ /mi shes rab ldan pas nyes pa dag /sel nus kyi blun pos sel ba min/ /dpe rnga la dbyug gus ma bsnun par/ /rnga sgra skad che ba mi mngon bzhin/ /khong mkhas par brtsad cing ma dris na/ /nang yon tan ci yo da gting mi dpog /dpe sngar dus gzhan la bcol ba'i nor/ /phyis nam mkho'i dus na yod pa bzhin/ /rang nangs par 'chi yang yon tan slob/ /tshe phyi mar mkhas pa 'ong ba yin/ /dpe dri ldan me tog rgyang ring yang /rkang drug ldan bung ba 'du ba bzhin/ /rang yon tan ldan na skye bo kun/ /ma bsdus kyang rang gi 'khor du 'du/ /dpe 'od gsal nyi ma zla ba yis/ /gling bzhi yi mun pa sel ba bzhin/ /mi mkhas pas yon tan kun bslabs nas/ /mthar phyin pa gcig gis 568

kun la phan/ /dpe chu klung rnyog pa chud zon pa/ /de nor bus dwangs par byed pa bzhin/ /mi blo chung bros nyes 'khrugs pa'i tshe/ /khong blo ldan thabs kyis bde bar gso/ /dpe khu byug skom pas gdungs na yang / /char ma gtogs sa'i chu mi 'thung bzhin/ /khong mkhas pa ci ltar thabs rdugs kyang / /mi blun po 'jug pa'i lam mi 'gro/ /dpe srog chags grog ma mig med kyang / /mig yod pa gzhan las mgyogs pa bzhin/ /khong shes rab ldan pa mgo bskor kyang / /rang bya ba'i cha la rmongs mi 'gyur/ /dpe yung ba dang ni tsha la las/ /mdog gzhan zhig sgye bar 'gyur ba dang / /mi blo gros ldan pa gnyis bgros na/ /gzhan blo gros legs pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dpe glang chen rtsal stobs che na yang / /glang dzi yi bzhon par 'gyur ba bzhin/ /thabs mkhas na mi chen rnams tsho yang / /rang bran du bsgo ba ga la dka'/ /dpe ba yi 'o ma kun gyes bzho/ /chu 'o ma ngang bas 'byed pa bzhin/ /skyon yon tan gnyis ka sus kyang shes/ / 'dres yod pa 'byed shes mkhas pa yin/ /dpe bal bo'i se'u za mi dgos/ /kha dog las bro ba shes pa bzhin/ /blo ldan na gzhan gyes ma bshad kyang / /rnam 'gyur las pha rol bsam pa go /dpe dri zhim 'byung na ri dwags kyi/ /lte ba las gla rtsi len pa 569

bzhin/ /legs bshad ni byes pa'i kha nas kyang / /khong mkhas pa rnams kyis len pa yin/ /dpe nor bu gzhan du brin pa tsam/ /phyi'i rgya mtsho'i nang du mi brin bzhin/ /mi mkhas pa rang gi yul bas kyang / /yul gzhan du song na mchod par 'gyur/ /dpe nyi ma lam lam shar ba na/ /sa'i me tog 'dzum zhing bzhad pa bzhin/ /glu 'di nyid lhang lhang blangs pa'i mthus/ /khong mkhas pa dga' zhing spro bar shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//dpe yid bzhin nor bu rin chen bzhin/ /rang gang 'dod dngos grub stsol mdzad pa'i/ /pha 'gran gye do med rin po che/ /bu bdag la brtse bas cung zad dgongs/ /bdag las nyon dgra yis dbang med du/ /gnas khams gsum 'khor ba'i btson dong bskyur/ /dus nyin bzhin na rga'i chad pas mnar/ /mthar 'chi bdag pho nyas gsod pa la/ /bdag kha tsam min par skrag pa skye/ /pha nyam thag 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs/ /da skyabs med bdag gi skyabs mdzod cig /tshig thos pas ngan 'gror lhung mi srid/ /de bsgoms pas 'khor bar 'khyams mi srid/ /chos nges don zab mo lta ba'i 'khrid/ /bu bdag la brtse bas gnang du gsol/ /chos lta ba'i 'gags 'dus mgur ma zhig /dus ring min stsol ba bla ma mkhyen/ /thugs byams dang snying rje'i bdag 570

nyid can/ /mgon khyod kyi rnam thar dri med bzhin/ /sprang ri khrod zin par byen gyes rlobs/ /zhes slob bu rab 'byams pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis lta 'khrid cig dang lta mgur zhig dgos zhes skul tshig tu smras pas lan du/chos sku nam mkha' lta bu las/ /gzugs sku 'ja' tshon ji bzhin du/ /gang la gang 'dul skur ston pa/ /drin can bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /stong nyid rtsal ldan seng ge nga / /nyams myong gangs la rab 'gying nas/ /rdo rje glu yi nga ro sgog /skal ldan seng phrug dga' bas nyon/ /sems nyid chos sku mthong ba'i tshe/ /dper na ci 'dra zer tsa na/ /tho rangs nam mkha' dwangs pa 'dra/ /go 'am skal ldan seng phrug po/ /de yi ngang la bzhag pa'i tshe/ /dper na ci 'dra zer tsa na/ /ri rtser phyin nas bltas pa 'dra/ /go 'am skal ldan seng phrug po/ /de nyid 'bral med skyong ba'i tshe/ /dper na ci 'dra zer tsa na/ /thang chen dkyil du sdod pa 'dra/ /go 'am skal ldan seng phrug po/ /rang sems chos sku'i rtsal de las/ /chos rnams thams cad 'byung ba de/ /dper na ci 'dra zer tsa na/ /nam mkha'i 'ja' sprin 'byung ba 'dra/ /go 'am skal ldan seng phrug po/ /rang sems chos sku'i mkha' dbyings su/ /chos rnams thams cad brten pa de/ /dper na ci 'dra zer tsa na/ /mkha' la snod bcud brten pa 'dra/ /go 'am skal ldan 571

seng phrug po/ /chos rnams rang bzhin stong ba de/ /dper na ci 'dra zer tsa na/ /chu nang shar ba'i zla gzugs 'dra/ /go 'am skal ldan seng phrug po/ /spyan dang mngon shes 'char ba de/ /dper na ci 'dra zer tsa na/ /sna tshogs gzugs brnyan 'char ba 'dra/ /go 'am skal ldan seng phrug po/ /de ltar ma rtogs 'gro ba la/ /bcos min snying rje skye ba de/ /dper na ci 'dra zer tsa na/ /sgyu mar skrag pa'i bu chung la/ /pha mas snying rje skye ba 'dra/ /go 'am skal ldan seng phrug po/ /las 'bras bslu ba med pa de/ /dper na ci 'dra zer tsa na/ /rmi lam skabs kyi bde sdug 'dra/ /go 'am skal ldan seng phrug po/ /mthar thug rang snang phyi rol chos/ /nang gi nyon mongs rtogs tshogs rnams/ /rang sems chos skur thim pa de/ /dper na ci 'dra zer tsa na/ /mkha' la na bun yal ba 'dra/ /go 'am skal ldan seng phrug po/ /rang sems chos sku mngon gyur tshe/ /dper na ci 'dra zer tsa na/ /sprin thag chad pa'i nam mkha' 'dra/ /go 'am skal ldan seng phrug po/ /chos sku'i dbyengs las ma g.yos bzhin/ /gzugs sku rnam gnyis 'byung ba de/ /dper na ci 'dra zer tsa na/ /mkha' la 'ja' tshon 'char ba 'dra/ /go 'am skal ldan seng phrug po/ /ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs bar/ /'gro don rgyun mi 'chad pa de/ /dper 572

na ci 'dra zer tsa na/ /dpag bsam shing dang nor bu 'dra/ /go 'am skal ldan seng phrug po/ /de ltar nga ro bsgrags pa la/ /dad pa'i lus stobs rab tu rgyas/ /mos gus g.yu ral sngon po 'chang / /dben pa'i gangs la 'phyo ba yi/ /blo ldan seng phrug dga' bar mdzod//ces smras so//dpe yid bzhin nor bu rin po che/ /rgyal mtshan gye rtse mor brgyan pa bzhin/ /rje mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /bdag spyi gtsug 'khor lo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /da pe rgya gar skad rigs rgya gar gye/ /mis go yi bod kyis mi go bzhin/ /khong mkhas pa'i legs bshad mkhas pa yis/ /don go yi blun pos go ba dka'/ /dpe phyug por yo byad mang na yang / /gzhan nor rdzas dang du len pa bzhin/ /khong mkhas pa yon tan dpag med kyang / /gzhan yon tan chung ngu yin yang slob/ /dpe ri dwags rgyal po bkres na yang / /glang spyi bo myur du 'gems pa bzhin/ /mi blo chen blo gros rgud na yang / /slar lhag par blo gros stobs ldan 'gyur/ /dpe mkha' la gza' skar shar ba rnams/ /steng nyi zla lta bur mi gsal bzhin/ /mi yon tan sna re tsam shes pas/ /gzhan rgyal khams yongs la phan mi thogs/ /dpe 'phags rgyal gyis ni bram ze'i bu/ /gcig pu yis dgra tshogs 573

bcom pa bzhin/ /khong mkhas pa shes rab kyis bsrungs na/ /dgra mang bo byung yang ga la tshugs/ /dpe gcan gzan rgyal po seng ge de/ /grogs mi dgos gcig pur 'jigs med bzhin/ /mi khong mdzangs bsod nams bsags pa de/ /rang gcig pu yin yang kun las rgyal/ /dpe rgyal bu zla ba'i shes rab kyis/ /sngon bran bzang 'di phyir bskyabs pa bzhin/ /tshe 'di dang 'jig rten phyi ma yi/ /bde thabs de sgrub pa shes rab yin/ /dpe ri dwags rgyal po stobs ldan pa/ /de ri bong blo ldan gyis bsad bzhin/ /rang blo dang ldan na nyam chung yang / /gzhan stobs ldan dgra bos ci byar yod/ /dpe bu de btsa' dus na tsha che/ /na tsha med bu zhig btsas dka' bzhin/ /yon tan de slob pa'i dus na sdug /bde bar ni sdod la mkhas mi srid/ /dpe gnyid kyi bde bar chags pa na/ /sang don chen bsgrub dgos 'chor ba bzhin/ /bde chung ngu tsam la chags pa de/ /gzhan chen po'i bde ba thob mi 'gyur/ /dpe phyi yi rgya mtsho che na yang / /gzhan chu chen 'dres pas ngoms med bzhin/ /khong mkhas pa yon tan dpag med kyang / /gzhan legs bshad blangs pas ngoms pa med/ /dpe chu yi thigs pa bsags pa des/ /snod chen po rim gyes 'gangs pa bzhin/ /yon tan de rgyun du bslab gyur 574

na/ /dus ring min thams cad mkhyen par gyur/ /dpe nyi ma'i 'od kyis byis pa rnams/ /'khum 'dug pa dros nas bde skyid bzhin/ /glu 'di blangs pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /ma 'gro kun bde zhing skyid par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//u tshugs che ba'i dpon po dang gcig /shin tu kha ngan bud med dang gnyis/ /rlung khams che ba'i a khu dang gsum/ /'di gsum kha ya ma byas na bzang / /'dang rgyag mi phog pho gsar dang gcig /sdig la rngams pa'i ban log dang gnyis/ /rnam dbye mi shes blun po dang gsum/ /'di gsum la kha ya ma byas na bzang / /dmar chog byed pa'i ban gcod dang gcig /mthu gtad byed pa'i sngags nag dang gnyis//jag brkus byed pa'i mi skya dang gsum/ /'di gsum 'grogs ya ma byas na bzang / /grong chog mkhan gyi bla ma dang gcig /snyom las mkhan gyi sgom pa dang gnyis/ /ser sna che ba'i phyug po dang gsum/ /'di gsum sgrub ya ma byas na bzang / /zhes pa 'di yang grogs po tshe dbang rab brtan la tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//bla ma nyams rtogs can la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'di blos btang dben pa'i gnas mchog tu/ /gcig pur bdag gzhan lta ba skyong ba'i tshe/ /nyams snang sna tshogs 'char bar byen gyes 570

rlobs/ /brtson 'grus bskyed nas lta ba sgom pa'i tshe/ /yun ring ma bsgoms snyams nas bltas tsa na/ /yun ring 'das na sems ni zin pa'i rtags/ /yun ring bsgom mo snyams nas bltas tsa na/ /ci yang ma song sems ni ma zin rtags/ /sems gnas rtags su bya ba gang la yang / /'jug snying mi 'dod sngar bas le lo cher/ /song nas lus dang sems la lhod chags 'ongs/ /spyod lam ma bcos spyon pa 'dra ba byung / /tshe 'di'i bya ba gang la'ang dgos med skye/ /shin tu dben par gcig pur sdod snying 'dod//lus la na zug med cing zo mdog bde/ /kha zas sred pa chung la ma zos kyang / /bkrag mdangs rgyas nas rmi lam 'khrul snang 'gags/ /mar gyur 'gro la sngar bas snying rje skye/ /'dod pa med par chags sdang chung ba dang / /bla ma grogs la brtse gdung che ba dang / /dgra gnyen gang la'ang nye ring med pa dang / /dga' dang mi dga' zhum pa med pa dang / /gtsang dme dgag sgrub spang blang med pa dang / /lus la shig sro srin bu med pa dang / /lus yang nam mkhar 'phags pa snyam byed cing / /dbugs kyi 'gyu ba mi tshor shes rgyud 'jam/ /sems nyid 'bol le lhag ge sang nge ba/ /dga' zhing dgod cig 'chor dang mtha' dbus bral/ /nam mkha' dbyer med 'dres song snyam pa dang / /576

nyi ma zla ba shar ba snyam byed cing / /ston gyi dus su nam mkha' sprin med pa'i/ /dkyil ltar shin tu gsal la ma 'gags shing / /li ting gtsang ma'i nang du chu blugs nas/ /nyi mar bzhag nas bltas ltar dwangs pa dang / /de yi ngang nas bltas na dngos po spu'i/ /rtse mo gshags pa'i cha gcig yan chad mthong / /dngos su nam mkha' bya ltar 'phur bar nus/ /chos rnams thams cad sgyu ma ltar song nas/ /ri brag rtsig pa rnams la thal byung 'gro/ /rang gi lus ni 'dam ltar brdzi ba dang / /zan ltar gcod cing bal ltar g.yengs na yang / /lus la sdug bsngal cung zad tsam mi 'byung / /gang la blta yang sems nyid rang lugs su/ /bzhag pas chos rnams thams cad gsal bar mthong / /bsgrubs dang ma bsgrubs yi dam lha zhal mthong / /sangs rgyas zhing khams tshad med mthong bar 'gyur/ /tshogs drug rang grol seng ge dkar mo ni/ /ri khrod dben pa'i gangs la gcig pur 'gying / /nyams kyi 'char tshul ngar skad 'di bsgrags la/ /skal ldan seng phrug dga' bas nyams len mdzod/ /ces pa 'di yang dam pa gong ma'i gsung ltar skal ldan rnams la phan phyir tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//lo brgya thub pa'i mi ni shin tu dkon/ /lo drug cu thub pa'i dbang byas kyang / /lo re bzhin du mi tshe je thung 'gro/ /lo lon 577

dus su chos byed 'dod na yang / /lo yi stobs kyis tsha grang rkyen mi theg /lo gzhon dus su dam chos byed re ran/ /lo legs snye ma zor bas 'breg pa bzhin/ /lo chung yin yang glo bur 'chi nyen yod/ /lo zlar phyi bshol ma byed myur du gyis/ /lo 'dab rgyas pa'i nags khrod la sogs su/ /lo re zla re tsam ni ma yin par/ /lo ni ci yod bar du dge la sbyor/ /zhes pa 'di yang slob bu blo bzang nor 'phel la gdams pa'o//'jig rten 'di yi phun tshogs la/ /ma chags ri khrod dben pa ru//khor yug chos la gzhol rnams la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byen gyes rlobs/ /bka' gdams gong ma'i rjes 'jug tsho/ /mnyam med jo bos gang gsungs pa/ /de de bzhin du da lta snang / /tshe 'di'i lto rgyab gnyis kyi phyir/ /rab byung cha lugs len par byed/ /grong yul nom pa dgon par 'jog /grwa khang nang na byes pa ngu / /gtsug lag khang gi khyams smad dang / /dgon pa'i nang chen phal cher na/ /bud med la las bal 'khel zhing / /bud med la las thags 'gran 'thag /bud med la las bzhon ma bzho/ /sgye bo pho mo mang bo 'tshogs/ /glu gar dmag jag 'thab rtsod sogs/ /nyon mongs skye ba'i gtam ngan lab/ /tshul khrims ldan pa'i dge slong la/ /skye dman bud med mi ldang 578

sdod/ /rab byung la las 'di skad zer/ /mo bzang 'di ni gzugs byad mdzes/ /'byor ba che zer ngo 'dzin byed/ /rab byung la las 'di nga'i ma/ /sring mo yin zer grwa khang nas/ /ma sring zhag gis sdod du 'jug /kho bo'i ma sring yin mod kyi/ /gzhan gyi ma sring ga la yin/ /rab byung gnyen po stobs chung gi /sdom pa'i sa bon gting nas nyams/ /kye ma kye hud nyes pa de/ /bdud mo phugs su bcug pas lan/ /mchod khang nang du gnya' shing dang / /gshol mda' grong khyem gos slog 'jog /khyim pa'i mal zhabs rkang 'og tu/ /rab byung ngur smrig 'jog dang badzi/ /glegs bam zas gos mar me yi/ /stegs byed chos la ska rags dang / /na bza' mi bskon sa rdul chags/ /'thor bar byed pa'i dus ngan 'dir/ /mkhas pas btsun pa khyad du gsod/ /btsun pas mkhas pa khyad du gsod/ /sgom chen rnams kyis thos bsam pa/ /khyad du gsod cing thos bsam pas/ /sgom chen pa rnams khyad du gsod/ /rang las mtho ba mi bkur zhing / /rang las dman pa mi skyong bar/ /rang dang mnyam par 'gran sems byed/ /'phags pa'i nor gyis phyug pa yi/ /dge slong rnams ni gral mjug gnas/ /nyon mongs dug lngas rab tu phyug /ngo tsha khrel med gral mgor gnas/ /snyigs ma'i bstan pa 579

chu dang 'dra/ /bzang bo gser dngul 'dra ba de/ /steng du mi theg gting du byengs/ /ngan pa spun pa 'dra ba de/ /gting du mi 'dug steng du gnas/ /bzang btsun yon tan can rnams la/ /ngan rnams kha 'grig 'phya zhing smod/ /mkhas btsun dman cha len pa de/ /ngo tsha khrel med la la yis/ /'gab tu bzhag nas 'di skad zer/ /khyod ni skyid dam ja zhig thungs/ /'di tsho zo dang khyod 'dra ba'i/ /sbyor ba lhod po snga mo nas/ /nga'i khar nyan na lto gos kyang / /'di las bzang ba 'ong ba yin/ /slar yang shog la bza' btung gyes/ /ma thub dus su las grogs mdzod/ /nor gyi gsog lugs 'di 'dra gyis/ /zas ma mchis na srog ma mchis/ /chos rgyags mi dgos su zhig yod/ /glen pa mdo med khyod 'dra zer/ /mngar la srog ni myur 'phrog pa'i/ /dug chu 'dra ba'i bslab bya ston/ /a ma lha dang 'dra ba de/ /kun gyis mi bkur de 'dra ba'i/ /tshul khrims 'chal ba nor phyir shor/ /nyon mongs khol bor gyur pa rnams/ /bkur zhing bstod pa la sogs pa'i/ /ming snyan 'dogs shing de bzhin 'bod/ /tshul khrims mi bsrung mi rnams kyis/ /tshul khrims bsrungs tshul bshad pa dang / /tshul khrims can la 'phya zhing smod/ /rmongs pa gang yang mi shes pas/ /mkhas par kha bshad mkhan zer 'phya/ /spyon pa 580

rnams kyis chos gtam byed/ /zog po rnams ni lta ba mtho/ /bka' gdams nyan thos chos zer smod/ /dus ngan bskal pa snyigs dus 'dir/ /khram pa zog po zhwa bzhin bkur/ /chos pa rnams ni lham bzhin brnyas/ /gang la bsams kyang skyo ba skye/ /de phyir blo ldan skye bo kun/ /bka' gdams gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /dgra gnyen gang gis mi mthong ba'i/ /ri khrod dben pa'i gnas mchog tu/ /ri dwags rmas ma ji bzhin du/ /gcig pur nyams len mdzad re ran/ /ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /gser gyi mdangs 'dzin spang ri la/ /na bun dngul mdog sked bcing byas/ /khor yug me tog gcal du bkram/ /nyams dga' de 'dra'i dben gnas su/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka 'tshengs pa yi/ /chos shig mi byed sdod ri shi /snyam du zhe mna' lan gsum skyol/ /ji ltar bsam pa de de bzhin/ /da ni nam zhig 'gyur snyam du/ /nyin mtshan kun tu de soms la/ /de yi don la brtson par mdzod/ /glu dbyangs 'di thos skal ldan mis/ /ri khrod dben pa'i gnas mchog tu//bka' gdams gong ma'i rnam thar de//ring min myur du skyong bar shog /ces pa 'di yang rgyal ba gnyis pa jo bo chen pos gsungs pas dus ngan snyigs ma'i spyod ngan phal cher mthong tshe tshogs drug rang grol gyis ngur sprig 'dzin pa rnams 581

la bya btang ba'o//dpon med g.yog med gnas la nges pa med/ /dgra med gnyen med nye ring phyogs ris med/ /chags med zhen med bya btang rnal 'byor ngas/ /cha med rgyus med ri nas glu dbyangs len/ /skyon med dal 'byor mi lus thob dus 'dir/ /nges med 'chi ba 'di la rab 'jigs nas/ /'gyod med lha chos snying nas mdzad 'dod na/ /zla med mi la ras pa'i rnam thar bzhin/ /don med tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis thongs/ /skyid med pha yul btson ra rgyab tu zhog /sdig med bza' btung slong mo la brten nas/ /mi med dben pa'i ri khrod rgyun du zungs/ /grogs med rang lus grib ma dang 'grogs nas/ /bslu med bla ma dkon mchog skyabs su bsten/ /nyams med sdom gsum mig 'bras bzhin du srungs/ /skyo med rang sems chos sku rtag tu skyongs/ /mtha' med 'gro la byams dang snying rje sgoms/ /yengs med nyin mtshan kun tu dge la 'bod/ /dpag med bsod nams ye shes tshogs bsags na/ /bla med byang chub myur du thob par 'gyur/ /zhesapa 'di yang slob bu bstan pa phan bdes bskul ngor tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//pha pha rol 'gro ba'i gtam la/ /bu bu mo bzang bos nyan bzhin/ /a a khu tshogs drug rang grol/ /khyod khyod rang glu 'di 582

nyon ya/ /rem rem nas las mi thub dus/ /bar bar du cung zad 'dug bzhin/ /bton bton nas 'don mi 'dod dus/ /kha kha rog skabs re sdod ya/ /khur khur nas 'khur mi thub dus/ /mtshams mtshams su ngal re gso bzhin/ /bsdad bsdad nas snang ba sun dus/ /skabs skabs su khams gseng gyes ya/ /'jen 'then nas gzhu mi thub dus/ /gzas gzas nas mda' re 'phen bzhin/ /bsgoms bsgoms nas bsgom mi 'dod dus/ /soms soms la mgur re 'then ya/ /zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la spras pa'o//ma yengs nyon dang skye ba pho yi mi skya rnams/ /mi lus rnyed dka' don che yid bzhin nor bu 'dra/ /mi rtag myur du 'chi ba nam mkha'i glog dang 'dra/ /'jig rten 'khor ba 'di ni me yi 'obs dang 'dra/ /bud med skyon med bzang ba u dum wa ra 'dra/ /chung ma bzang mor 'phrad pa shin tu dka' mo yin/ /chung ma ngan pa skyong dka' bdud mo lcags mchu yin/ /bzang ngan yin min smra ba yos ni 'gad 'gad byed/ /khyem tshang bza' bar mi 'cham khyem mtshes rnams dang 'khon/ /mgron po 'khrid nas 'ongs dus me bsad ja chu med/ /myur du ja skol bshad tshe lkog shub mang bo byed/ /bdud mo'i rnam 'gyur tshig gis mgron po 583

rgyags nas 'gro/ /phyin chad mgron po bzang rnams bos kyang 'ong ba dka'/ /mchod sbyin byed dus lag pa lha khang sgo bas dam/ /so nam bkal 'thag mi byed phag bzhin nyal la dga'/ /phyi 'dang mi rgyag gang yod pho ba'i nang du brub/ /kha la mi nyan mchu gcu phyin ci log brgyad byed/ /rdo dang dbyug pas brdungs na khyi bzhin nywa la 'ju/ /mgu ba'i dus med bdud mo nag mo mngon sum yin/ /pha dang mthun zhing byams pa'i bu ni nyin skar tsam/ /bu ngan nor rdzas brlags nas khye ldom bzhin du 'khyams/ /mi 'dod sna dgra thams cad pha yi thog tu 'dren/ /sdug bsngal mi bzod pa rnams pha yis rgyun du myong / /rang gzhan 'phung byed dgra bo lus las chad pa yin/ /phyi rol gang la song yang pha yi blo mi bde/ /bu ngan 'di yis de ring ci zhig byed dam snyam/ /bu yi spyod ngan de la nam yang 'dzad pa med/ /ba ni ma shi bar du rnyang ba 'dzad med 'dra/ /de 'dra'i bu dang chung mas ci byed gcig pu yin na bde/ /bu dang chung ma bzang rung chos med don go chung / /gshin rje chos rgyal dge sdig rtsis grangs zhib rabs yod/ /dmyal bar song na sdug min skyid ni yod rabs med/ /'u shig gshin rje chos rgyal drung nas med 'dod na/ /dkon mchog skyabs su bsten la rgyun du skyabs 'gro 584

gyis/ /mi dge sdig pa spongs la phyag dang skor ba rem/ /ngag gis long gtam ma mang kha ton bzlas brjod mdzod/ /sems ngan gzhan la ma 'dzin bsam pa dkar bo gyis/ /lha chos gtso bor bsgrubs la tshe 'di zhor la gyis/ /sngar byas sdig la 'gyod cing phyin chad sdom sems gyes/ /dkar nag las 'bras 'di la nam yang bslu ba med/ /tshe 'dir bzang ngan ci 'dra ba yi las byas pa/ /phyi mar 'bras bu bzang ngan de 'dra 'byung ba yin/ /dge ba chung ngu byas kyang phyi mar brgya 'gyur 'thob/ /de phyir dge ba mang bo da lta da lta gyis/ /ri la me sbar shig ni mer 'phen tsha ba'i las/ /byas na phyi mar gshin rjes rkang lag phur bas brgyangs/ /phyogs bzhi'i me btang lbu ba cir cir bsreg par byed/ /gnag lug ri dwags la sogs mang bo bsad gyur na/ /brag nag lug gi gdong 'dra'i bar du yang yang gcur/ /mi ni mtshon gyis bsad dam ra lug gson po ru/ /bshas na gshin rjes lus la thig btab sog les 'dra/ /ral gri sta res gshag cing brgya stong yang yang gshag /me shing gon pa rku 'phrog grang ba'i las byas na/ /phyi mar gshin rje'i pho nyas grang dmyal brgyad du 'phen/ /gzhan gyi chung mar spyod cing lag nas 'phrog gyur na/ /lcags kyi shal ma li la yar 'dzeg mar 'bab byed/ /rtsa rtse 585

khye dang bya khra gnyis kyis gson por za/ /rdzun ni smras na lce ni dpag tshad brgya bar 'gyur/ /gshin rjes glang gnyis dor bsdebs thong gshol btsugs nas rmo//phra ma byas na lce la lcags kyi phur ba 'debs/ /bre la g.yo sgyu byas na phyi mar gshin rje yis/ /lus po gtubs nas lcags kyi bre bo che nang 'gengs/ /rgya mar skyon ni byas na lus gtubs rgya mar 'jal/ /pha mar smra dbang mi ster tshig ngan smras gyur na/ /zangs skud kha bzo lce ni ma mchu'i 'og nas len/ /pha mar ngus dang brang brdung kha la thal ba zo/ /smras na ngu 'bod brang brdung me mur 'gam par skye/ /mdor na rang la mkho ba de nyid gzhan la'ang mkho/ /rang la mkho ba de 'dra gzhan la'ang byas gyur na/ /phyi mar rang la gang mkho thams cad 'ong ba yin/ /rang la mi mkho gzhan rnams la'ang mi mkho bas/ /rang la mi mkho de 'dra gzhan la byas gyur na/ /phyi mar rang la mi mkho'i sdug bsngal myong ba yin/ /da res mi lus thob pas lha chos byas gyur na/ /khyim pa'i skye bo yin yang byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /'dzig rten phyi mar song dus bde skyid nyi ma 'char/ /lha chos med na ya so can gyi ba glang yin/ /dpa' rtsal rab tu che yang rgya stag khra bo yin/ /tshe 'di'i 'dun ma mkhas rung dud 'gro rkang gnyis yin/ /sdod sa mtho rung brag 586

stod bya rgyal rgod po yin//gdon gyis ma smyos pa yi mi tsho'i smyon pa yin/ /rtswa chu mu 'thung ba yi g.yag rgan mgo ril yin/ /mi gtsang mi za ba yi mjug med khye rgan yin/ /'jig rten phyi mar song dus sdug bsngal mtsho brdol 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'di yang zhabs drung ri khrod pa ngag dbang blo bzang gis khyim pa rnams la phan pa'i mgur zhig dgos zhes bskul ngor tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//ma yengs nyon dang skye ba dman pa'i bud med rnams/ /dal 'byor tshang ba'i mi lus yang yang rnyed par dka'/ /'chi bdag bdud ni dgag tu med par myur du 'ong / /rang lus gces par bskyangs kyang 'chi tshe mal du 'jog /ras phrug rgyan gyis spras kyang phung bo g.yar bo yin/ /nor rdzas ci tsam yod kyang 'chi tshe lag stong 'gro/ /ci tsam las kyang tshar rgyu med de byed 'phro lus/ /bu khyo 'khor 'dab rgyas kyang 'chi tshe gcig pur 'gro/ /mi tshe ring ring 'dra yang skad cig yud tsam yin/ /'jig rten 'khor ba 'di ni rgyal po'i btson ra 'dra/ /khyo grogs bzang dang 'phrad pa shin tu dka' mo yin/ /khyo ngan bza' tshang khyem du 'tshogs na bza' sdigs byed/ /sha nye pha tshan gros la 'tshogs na 'thab rtsod byed/ /dpa' bo'i dpung tshogs dmag la 'gro na mjug sdud byed/ /'thab sar slebs na mtshon cha dgra yi lag 587

char 'phen/ /mig gnyis zim zim lta zhing lag gnyis spyi bor 'khur/ /dpung tshogs tshur la ldog na kun kyi 'go 'dren byed/ /rang ki khyim du slebs na dpa' skad lung ba 'gengs/ /bza' btung yod sa mthong na ngo tsha mi shes rgyug /las ka yod sa mthong na thabs kyis byol nas 'gro/ /gzhan la 'gro dgos byung na nad ro rnying ba ldang / /gang bzang nor rdzas btsongs nas gyong dang pham kha nyo/ /khyem na gang yod chang dang du ba'i rin la 'jal/ /khyim du mi chags khyi ldom bzhin du grong bar nyul/ /ci bshad thams cad zas nor bzang ngan kho na lab/ /khyim tshang skyid sdug mi shes kho rang rgyags pas chog /kho rang ma rgyags pha ma bu dang chung mar rdung / /khyim tshang mu ger 'chi rung phan thogs spu tsam med/ /khyo grogs yod ces ming zhig ma gtogs med dang mtshungs/ /bu yis rgas khar a mar phan pa re re tsam/ /bu ngan skyong dka' rgas dus a ma'i nyes skyon brjod/ /smra ba'i dbang med a ma khyod ni kha rog zer/ /lan rer kha ni zas kyis mi chod sgor song zer/ /lan rer kha la 'di zo zer zhing thal ba gtor/ /zhim po kho yis za zhing ngan ngon a mar ster/ /ja bzang kho yis 'thung zhing nyag nyog a mar ldud/ /dro 'jam kho yis gyon nas a mar dug hrul bskon/ /ci byas skyon 588

gyis bzung nas las ngan ma 'di zhes/ /tshig ngan snying rtsa trog cing mig log rgyab log byed/ /rkang tho lag thos brdungs nas rma med khong bsnad byed/ /bu ngan de 'dra'i ci byed rabs chad yin na bde/ /de phyir 'di phyir skyid pa'i dam pa'i lha chos gyis/ /mi lus stong log ma byed smyung gnas sdom pa srungs/ /bsags pa bzhag nas 'gro bas sbyin pa ci 'grub thongs/ /mgon skyabs mchog gsum thugs rje chen por gso la ba thobs/ /long gtam bshad kyang 'dzad med skyabs 'gro ma ṇi thon/ /rgyun du sdig pa spongs la dge ba'i so nam rem/ /de ltar byas na bud med yin yang skal ldan yin/ /'dir bde phyi mar byang chub go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ /bud med lha chos mi byed rnyang rkyal ba rgan yin//ji ltar gsog 'jog mkhas rung bye ba smug ril yin/ /gzugs byad rab tu mdzes rung lha khang logs bris yin/ /lus la bye dor yang yang byas rung bye la yin/ /yo byad mang bo 'dzoms rung yi dwags gter srung yin/ /bu dang bu mo mang rung rabs chad nag mo yin/ /'dre yis ma spyos pa yi mi tsho'i spyon ma yin/ /dbugs ni ma chad pa yi 'byung bo ro langs yin/ /'dir sdug phyi mar ngan 'gro'i gnas su lhung bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'di yang zhabs drung gi ri khrod pa ngag dbang blo bzang gis khyim pa rnams la phan pa'i mgur zhig dgos zhes 589

bskul ngor tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /nyon dang rdzogs chen rnal 'byor tsho/ /sems nyid dper na khang stong 'dra/ /rnam rtog khye rkun byung ba 'dra//byung yang brtag dpyad mi byed par/ /sngar bzhin sems nyid ngang gnas pa/ /khang ba g.yo 'gul mi byed par/ /sngar bzhin gnas pa lta bu yin/ /rnam rtog mi gnas yal ba de/ /khye rkun mi gnas 'gro dang 'dra/ /sems nyid dper na sbrul dang 'dra/ /rnam rtog sbrul mdud brgyab pa 'dra/ /sems nyid rang gi ngang bzhag pas/ /rnam rtog rang sar song ba de/ /sbrul ni rang gi stobs nyid kyis/ /mdud pa brgyab pa bshig pa 'dra/ /sems nyid dper na mi dang 'dra/ /rnam rtog dug mda' phog pa 'dra/ /sems nyid rang gi ngang bzhag pas/ /ting 'dzin bar ma chad pa de/ /dug gi mda' ni byung ma thag /blangs pas mi de ma shi 'dra/ /de phyir rnam rtog 'phro ba'i tshe/ /rtog dpyod gang yang ma byed par/ /sems nyid stong gsal ngang la zhog /rang sar 'gro bar the tshom med/ /'dis kyang 'gro la phan par shog /ces dbang bo rab kyi rnam rtog lam 'khyer 'di ni tshogs drug rang grol gyis spras pa'o//mda' mo mang bo 'phangs kyang / /'ben la kun gyes ma phog /mda' drang 'ga' re 'phangs dus/ /pha ri'i 'ben la 590

zug thal/ /chos gtam mang bo byas kyang / /mi rnams kun la ma phan/ /chos bshad 'ga' re byas dus/ /dad can 'ga' la phan thal/ /khe tshong mang bo byas kyang / /rgyal kha kun la ma lon/ /khe tshong 'ga' re byas dus/ /rang gis rgyal kha lon thal/ /skyo mgur mang bo 'then yang / /skyo shas kun la ma skyes/ /skyo mgur 'ga' re 'then dus/ /skyo shas shugs drag skyes thal/ /zhes pa 'di yang slob ma 'ga' res khyed kyis chos bshad byas pas gzhan la e phan dang / skyo mgur 'then dus skyo shas khyed la e skye gi lags zer ba'i lan du 'di yid la shar ba bris pa'o//skal ldan las 'phro can gnyis tshur la nyon/ /mi med rdza brag dam pa gong ma'i mkhar/ /gcig pur tshugs pa dam pa gong ma'i sras/ /pha mkhar rgyun du zin na bu rgod yin/ /sems nyid khye'u chung gzhon nu'i tshong ba yis/ /'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho chen por brgal/ /nges legs rin chen gling dang 'gro snyam na/ /dal 'byor tshang ba'i mi lus gru chen dang / /mtshan ldan bla ma ded dpon bzang bo gnyis/ /'dzoms pa'i dus 'dir sdod nga/'i dus ma yin/ /phyi nas 'di gnyis 'dzom pa shin tu dka'/ /lo zla zhag dang na rgas char rlung gis/ /rnyed dka'i gru gzings myur du 'jig la nye/ /mgon med tshong ba shin tu mang bas na/ /ded dpon de yang rgyun du mi sdod 'gro/ /de phyir myur du sbyin 591

sogs rgyags phye sgrubs/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen ded dpon bzang bo de/ /bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin 'bral med bsten/ /byams dang snying rje byang sems grogs dang 'grogs/ /tshul khrims thabs kyis gru gzings lam la chugs/ /nang du g.yo ba med pa'i ting 'dzin shing / /legs par tshugs la shes rab dar chen phyor/ /brtson 'grus mthun pa'i rlung gis myur du bskyod/ /dam pa'i chos kyi glu dbyangs len bzhin du/ /e ma sngon chad thos kyang ma mthong ba'i/ /bde chen thar ba'i rin chen gling mchog snyogs/ /shul na lus pa'i drin can ma rgan rnams/ /ring min myur du sgol ba'i dam bca' mdzod/ /ces pa 'di yang dad ldan bya btang ri khrod pa ngag dbang blo bzang dang blo bzang don 'grub gnyis la tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab slob dpon padma 'byung / /mnyam med jo bo kun mkhyen blo bzang grags/ /khyed rnams rim bzhin byon nas chos gsungs kyang / /da dung chos min sna tshogs byed pa yi/ /bod yul mi rnams snying la ci zhig zhugs/ /las ngan rnams la da dung thugs rjes gzigs/ /deng sang dus ngan bskal pa'i snyigs ma la/ /bslab pa blangs nas tshul bzhin mi bsrung bar/ /skog tu bud med nag chang rku 'phrog byed/ /tshul 'chos dngos su 592

ston pa'i rab byung dang / /dge slong rnams kyi snying la ci zhig zhugs/ /sdom shor rnams la da dung thugs rjes gzigs/ /po ti mang bo nyan bshad byas na yang / /gzhung lugs thams cad gdams par ma shar zhing / /mang bo brtsad kyang sgro 'dogs ma chod lus/ /las 'bras mi brtsi nor phyir chos btsong ba'i/ /ston chen rnams kyi snying la ci zhig zhugs/ /the tshom mkhan la da dung thugs rjes gzigs/ /mi tshe hril bo ri la bsdad na yang / /blun rmongs zhi gnas ltongs po'i ngang bzhag nas/ /nyams dang rtogs pa yon tan gang yang med/ /yun du bsgoms pa'i bsgom yus cher smras pa'i/ /sgom chen rnams kyi snying 'a/ ci zhig zhugs/ /snyom las mkhan la da dung thugs rjes gzigs/ /ma dad bsgyur byed mngon shes dzu 'phrul med/ /spyod pa tho co gcer rgyug la sogs byed/ /lha mthong 'dre mthong zer zhing gzhan mgo bskor/ /dad ldan sun 'byin grong ba'i khyi dkrog mkhan/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyi snying la ci zhig zhugs/ /snyom las mkhan la da dung thugs rjes gzigs/ /yi dam mi bsgrub 'gong bo than ltas bsgrub/ /chos kyi rnga chen mi brdung rnga nag rdung / /'phags pa'i nor bdun mi gsog rdzas ngan gsog /mthu gtad ser bas rang gzhan gnyis 'phung mkhan/ /sngags pa rnams kyi snying la ci 593

zhig zhugs/ /dad med rnams la da dung thugs rjes gzigs/ /mi mthun rkyen rnams phyi la bsgyur zer nas/ /dmar gtor g.yang gzhi rdzas ngan mdun du bzhag /'jigs pa'i zhwa gyon rnga gshang dkrol bzhin du/ /'o dod bos kyang don go sna gcig med/ /bon po rnams kyi snying la ci zhig zhugs/ /log spyod mkhan la da dung thugs rjes gzigs/ /rang 'dod khog bcug gzhan don skad du sgog /tsha grang nad ngo ma shes sman log gis/ /phyug po rmang dkon gces phrug mang bo gsod/ /byams dang snying rje med par dug ldud mkhan/ /sman pa rnams kyi snying la ci zhig zhugs/ /sman log ster la da dung thugs rjes gzigs/ /dang po bla ma spyi gtsug rgyan du 'dzin/ /bar du mdzad spyod rnams la skyon rtog byas/ /tha ma khye ro bzhin du ling gis bor/ /'di phyi gnyis med dmyal ba'i gting rdo mkhan/ /slob ma grwa ba'i snying la ci zhig zhugs/ /log lta mkhan la da dung thugs rjes gzigs/ /g.yo sgyu'i sgo nas pha rol gzhan nor len/ /khral dang 'u lag mang bos sde ba sun/ /ngo tsha khrel med bye la g.yo can dngos/ /las 'bras mi brtsi mgu ba'i mi gcig med/ /rje dpon rnams kyi snying la ci zhig zhugs/ /khrel med rnams la da dung thugs rjes gzigs/ /khyem tshang bza' ba'i lto rgyab gnyis kyi phyir/ /rdzun 594

gtam g.yo sgyu byas nas gzhan nor len/ /bu dang mna' mar de las 'di las zer/ /tha na ma ṇi lan re mi 'don pa'i/ /rgad po rnams kyi snying la ci zhig zhugs/ /snying med po la da dung thugs rjes gzigs/ /las su tsha bo yang tsha'i 'tsho rdzi byed/ /mgo dkar lus po sgur yang 'chi snyam med/ /sbyin pa mi gtong lag pa sgo bas dam/ /phyi ma mi dran yi dwags mgo dkar ma/ /rgan mo rnams kyi snying la ci zhig zhugs/ /lag stong ma la da dung thugs rjes gzigs/ /srog gcod rku 'phrog byas pa'i las lan du/ /gshin rje pho nyas 'khrid nas bcad gtubs tshe/ /bzod med sdug bsngal myong ba mi shes par/ /da dung 'di bsad 'di 'phrog kha pho bshad/ /pho skyes rnams kyi snying la ci zhig zhugs/ /sdig can rnams la da dung thugs rjes gzigs/ /ldang ba'i snga ma nyal ba'i phyi ma byed/ /tshar med las kyi nyin par khom skabs med/ /phan pa'i dge ba mi gsog zas nor gsog /khye mo tshang ma lta bu'i ser sna can/ /bud med rnams kyi snying la ci zhig zhugs/ /sems med ma la da dung thugs rjes gzigs/ /pha ma gnyis kyis gces par bskyangs bskyangs nas/ /gang bshadatshig la mi nyan phyir la bsdig /gzhon nu'i dus na pha mar rdung byed pa'i/ /khrel med ngo tsha med pa'i snying nag po/ /bu tsha rnams kyi snying la ci zhig 595

zhugs/ /bdud rigs po la da dung thugs rjes gzigs/ /mi lus thob nas dam chos mi byed par/ /me long chu nang bltas nas byi dor byed/ /snying du khyo bsam pha ma rgyab tu bskyur/ /don go med pa'i mi yi g.yog la 'gro/ /bu mo rnams kyi snying la ci zhig zhugs/ /mdo med ma la da dung thugs rjes gzigs/ /bsdigs rung brdungs rung mi yi g.yog la dga'/ /zas su ngan ngon gos su dug hrul gyon/ /sngon gyi las kyis tshe 'dir mi skyid kyang / /da dung dam chos mi byed glu tsho len//g.yog po g.yog mo'i snying la ci zhig zhugs/ /snying med rnams la da dung thugs rjes gzigs/ /zhes pa 'di yang rang gzhan chos la bskul phyir tshogs drug rang grol gyis spras pa'o//drin can bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /zhal gdams ster ro ma yengs nyon/ /rmi lam yul gyi rang gzhan rnams/ /stong ba'i dzun pa de bzhin du/ /bde 'gro ngan 'gro la sogs pa/ /sems nyid kho rang gis sprul bzhin/ /spang blang byed pa yin pas na//de ltar byed mkhan sems nyid la//byung gnas 'gro gsum dbyibs kha dog /la sogs e yod zhib tu tshol/ /'di zhes mdzub mo gtod sa zhig /mi rnyed stong ba nyid du 596

'gyur/ /stong sang de ka chos dbyengs yin/ /chos dbyings ngang du glod la zhog /mi gnas rnam rtog 'phro ba'i tshe/ /rnam rtog snga ma phyi ma dpyod/ /dbyebs dang kha dog e yod ltos/ /'gro sa byung sa gang 'dug tshol/ /ma rnyed stong ba chos dbyengs yin/ /chos dbyings ngang du glod la zhog /da dung 'phro na sngar bzhin du/ /'phros ma thag tu 'bur bcom gyes/ /rnam rtog ngo bo chos dbyings yin/ /byung na dga' ste skul 'debs bzang / /nyin gcig rnam rtog brgya byung na/ /btsal na chos dbyings brgya 'byung zhes/ /mnyam med jo bo'i zhal nas gsungs/ /rjes thob dus su chos rnams kun/ /sgyu ma sprul ba bzhin du ltos/ /rgyu ma mkhan gyi sprul sgyur bzhin/ /dge sdig spang blang la sogs pa/ /zhen med gyis dang ngo mtshar che/ /'di nyid thos tshad thams cad kyi/ /rgyud la phan thogs 'byung bar shog /ces pa 'di yang slob bu bstan pa phan bde la tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//nam mkha' 'dra ba'i sems kyi gnas lugs/ /cer mthong chos rgyal zhabs la 'dud do/ /ma mthong lta ba 'dod pa rnams la/ /sems gyi gnas lugs stong gsal ston cig /mi bsam dgu bsam mi 'khyug dgu 'khyug /dga' dang mi dga'i mkhan po sems nyid/ /ya ki spyi bo'i gtsug nas ma ki'i/ /rkang mthil 597

bar du zhib tu ltos shig /dngos bzung med par stong bar gyur tshe/ /stong ba yin yang sa le trig ge /gsal stong 'dzin med de nyid lta ba/ /de las ma yengs pa de bsgom pa/ /nam yang 'bral med skyong ba spyod pa/ /brtan pa thob pa'i dus su 'bras bu//nga ni pad 'byung gnyis pa'i thugs sras/ /lta ba'i glu dbyangs len mkhan yin no/ /glu dbyangs myur mgyogs che ba'i rta 'dir/ /skal ldan mi rnams zhon la chos dbyings/ /ri bo'i rtser phyin ngo mtshar ltad mo/ /sna tshogs ngoms med blta bar gyur cig /cesapa 'di ni mkhar sngon sngags 'chang rig 'dzin la tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//mtshan ldan bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /'dod chags dgra 'di thul bar byen gyis rlobs/ /bud med shin tu gzugs mjes mdog legs pa/ /mthong dus sems la 'dod chags sgyes pa'i tshe//bud med lus 'di ji ltar mdzes na yang / /nang na khrag dang chu ser gcin rtug dang / /snabs dang lud pa klad pa mkhris pa sogs/ /mi gtsang rdzas ni sum cu so gnyis kyis//gang ba'i rkyal ba gos kyis btums pa yin/ /sha yi nang du srin bu zhugs pa bzhin/ /lus la srin bu brgyad khri bzhi stong gnas//bu ga dgu nas mi gtsang dri ngan 'byung / /de la dga' zhing 'dod pa shin tu 'khrul/ /rgyal po btsan po'i bka' khrims 598

dam bo bzhin/ /chos kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas bcom ldan gyis/ /khrems su bcas pa'i 'dul khrims las 'das na/ /skye ba 'bum mam brgya yi bar dag tu/ /ngan song sdug bsngal myong ba'i chad pa yod/ /'jig rten 'di na shi ba thu mod kyi/ /de bas tshul khrims 'chal ba 'bum 'gyur sdug /tshul khrims ldan pa shi yang shi ba min/ /shi ma thag tu lus bzang len par 'gyur/ /tshul khrims nyams pa shi na gtan shi yin/ /shi ma thag tu ngan song gnas su 'gro/ /bzod med sdug bsngal yun ring myong bar 'gyur/ /bde 'gror skye ba phar zhog ming mi thos mar me gzugs la phye leb chags gyur na/ /dga' bzhin nang du mchongs nas 'tshig pa bzhin/ /rang nyid bud med mdzes mar sems chags nas/ /dga' bzhin sdom pa btang na 'phung bar 'gyur/ /me mdag chen po'i steng du rtswa skya btings/ /nyal tshe bde yang phyi nas sdug bsngal bzhin/ /bud med rnams la chags pa sbyad pa'i tshe//yud tsam bde yang phyi mar sdug bsngal myong / /bud med thar ba'i srog 'phrog gshed ma yin/ /dkar ba'i lo tog 'joms pa'i ser ba yin/ /phun sum tshogs pa 'phrog pa'i chom rkun yin/ /dge la bar chad byed pa'i bdud mo yin/ /'khor ba'i thar du mi ster btson srung yin/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal 599

'byung ba'i gzhi ma yin/ /snyam du bsams na chags pa skye mi 'gyur/ /bud med spyad pas sangs rgyas thob pa na/ /rgan rgon rnams tsho sngon nas sangs rgyas tshar/ /tshul khrims bsrungs pas sangs rgyas go 'phang thob/ /ngas ni tshul khrims mi bsrung ci'i phyir gtor/ /chos rnams sgyu ma yin zhes sangs rgyas gsungs/ /dper na sgyu ma mkhan gyes rab mdzes kyi/ /bu mo gzhon nur sprul nas skye bo'i tshogs/ /phal cher bslus nas lag nas rgyu nor blangs/ /phyi nas sprang bor gyur nas sdug phyong bzhin/ /bud med 'dis kyang nga yi sdom pa 'phrog /phyi nas tshe 'dir kun gyis brnyas smod mang //phyi mar ngan song gsum gye sdug bsngal myong / /sgyu ma mkhan gyis sprul ba'i bud med de/ /sgyu mar ma shes skye bo chags na yang / /shes rnams de la chags pa mi skye bzhin/ /chos kun sgyu mar ma shes skye bo rnams/ /bud med rnams la chags pa skyes na yang / /ngas ni chos rnams sgyu mar shes bzhin du/ /bud med mdzes kyang chags pa ci'i phyir skye//snyam du sgyu ma'i bu mo lta bur bsam/ /de ltar bsams pas 'dod chags zhi bar 'gyur//dge 'dis bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyis/ /'dod chags dgra 'di myur du thul bar shogamatshan ldan bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhe sdang dgra 600

'di thul bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag gi skye ba thog ma ma mchis pas//sems can thams cad skye ba sngon ma ru/ /bdag gi pha mar ma gyur gcig kyang med/ /ma 'ongs pa na da dung byed par 'gyur/ /khong tsho ma rig nyon mongs gdon gyis smyos/ /nga bu yin par ma shes gnod 'tshe byas/ /ngas ni shes bzhin drin can pha ma la/ /ci phan ma gtogs gnod byed ga la rung / /bdag gis rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob pa la/ /bzod pa'i phar phyin yongs su rdzogs dgos pas//gnod byed med na bzod pa su la bsgom/ /de phyir dgra 'di bdag gi dge ba'i grogs/ /ma nyes bzhin du sdigs rdung skur 'debs la/ /bzod pa bsgoms na sdig sgrib dpag med byang / /bzod pa'i 'bras bu mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku/ /des na dgra yang byang chub thob pa'i grogs/ /mdzad pa 'di la bdag ni cis mi dga'/ /snyam du khro med bzod pa bsgom par gyis/ /lha mi'i bde skyid thar ba tsam pa dang / /thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas go 'phang rnams/ /sems can rnams la brten nas thob dgos pas/ /sangs rgyas rnams la sems can drin can yin/ /drin can rnams la khong khro bya mi rung / /lhas sbyin drin la brten nas sangs rgyas kyang / /byams pas sngon nas rdzogs sangs rgyas zhes gsungs/ /de ltar 601

bsgoms pas khro ba ma zhi na/ /rang gi tshe 'di'i ma de mdun du bsgoms/ /de la gnod 'tshe rung ngam mi rung soms/ /tshe 'di'i ma la gnod 'tshe mi rung na/ /dgra bo 'di yang tshe rabs sngon gye ma/ /yin pas 'di la gnod 'tshe bya mi rung //sems can thams cad drin can ma yin zhes/ /sangs rgyas gsungs phyir 'di la rdzun zhig med/ /ma la khyad par 'byed pa khyod nyid blun//snyam du dgra la rang gi ma ltar gces/ /yang na rang nyid dgrar bsgoms pha rol dgra/ /rang du sgoms la khong khro e dga' dang / /gnod 'tshe byas na 'dod dam mi 'dod brtags/ /rang gis khong khro gnod pa mi 'dod na/ /dgras kyang khong khro gnod pa mi 'dod pas/ /des na rang gis rang la dpe longs la/ /dgra la khong khro gnod pa'i bsam pa spongs/ /dgra gnyen bar ma thams cad 'chi bar nges/ /nam 'chi cha med dgra yi sngon la yang rang nyid shi nas 'gro yang go shes med/ /dgra shi song rung rang yang phyi nas 'chi/ /des na mi tshe glog 'gyu tsam las med/ /dgra la lan zhig byas la dgos pa ci/ /tshong 'dus mgron bzhin so sor gyes nas 'gro/ /khong khros bskal pa mang bo'i dge rtsa 'joms /shi ma thag tu dmyal ba'i gnas su lhung / /dmyal mes lus po 'tshig tshe bzod thabs med/ /tshe 'dir khong khro bsran yang 602

bzod par nus/ /chos rnams thams cad mdang gi rmi lam 'dra/ /rmi lam 'khrul snang bzhin du tshe 'di yi/ /dgra gnyen bar ma sems kyi 'khrul snang yin/ /rmi lam dgra yis bsad na mi khro ltar/ /tshe 'di'i dgra yang de ltar shes nas ni//khong khro med par rmi lam lta bur sgormes/ /de ltar bsgoms pas zhe sdang zhi bar 'gyur/ /dge 'dis bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyis/ /zhe sdang dgra 'di myur du thul bar shog /mtshan ldan bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /gti mug dgra 'di thul bar byin gyes rlobs/ /'khor bar 'khyams pa'i rtsa ba ma rig pa/ /de las 'du byed de las rnam shes byung / /de las ming gzugs de las skye mched drug /de las reg pa de las tshor ba byung / /de las sred pa de las len pa byung / /de las srid pa de las skye ba byung / /de las rga shi rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyis/ /'khor bar 'khor zhing sdug bsngal mtha' med myong / /dper na sdong bo rtsa ba gcig bcad na/ /yal 'dab me tog 'bras bu bskam pa bzhin/ /ma rig 'gags na gzhan rnams rim gyis 'gag /de yang ma rig pa de gang zhe na/ /rang sems rang gis ma rig pa de yin/ /rang sems byung gnas 'gro gsum rtsad brdar chod/ /sems nyid dngos med nam mkha' lta bur 603

rtogs/ /chos rnams sprin 'ja' bzhin du 'phrul du go /de la goms pas ma rig 'gag par 'gyur/ /gti mug gnyid 'di dge ba'i chom rkun te/ /tshe phyed don med gti mug gnyid kyis 'dzad//gnyid la nyes pa nyi shu yod par bshad/ /de phyir gnyid bsran dge sbyor byed pa gces/ /srod dang tho rangs gti mug gnyid srab phyir/ /nub mo rang gi spyi bor mar me ni/ /rab tu gsal ba gcig sgom rig pa gtad/ /de yis gti mug gnyid ni srab par gsungs/ /shin tu gnyid 'bab dus su khyams nas 'dug /nam langs nyi ma shar ba yid la bya/ /de ltar bsgoms pas gti mug zhi bar 'gyur/ /dge 'dis bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyis/ /gti mug dgra 'di myur du thul bar shog /mtshan ldan bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs//nga rgyal dgra 'di myur du thul bar byen gyes rlobs/ /he te khyod la nga rgyal ci'i phyir skye/ /skyon zad yon tan kun ldan sangs rgyas kyi//yon tan de 'dra yod pa ma yin nam/ /de 'dra med kyang mngon shes dzu 'phrul can/ /dgra bcom pa rnams yon tan de 'dra zhig /khyod la yod nas nga rgyal skyes sam ci/ /yang na rig gnas lnga yi pha rol tu/ /son nas nga rgyal byas pa e yin ang / /de 'dra'i 604

yon tan cha tsam ma mchis na/ /khyod kyis nga rgyal ci zhig yod nas byas/ /kye ma sngon nas da bar 'khor bar 'khyams/ /da dung sun rgyu med pa'i snying rus can/ /sngon byon sangs rgyas bye ba grangs med kyi/ /bstan pa'i yun la ma grol las ngan po/ /tshe 'dir dbang lung khrid gsum mang thob kyang / /rang rgyud je gyong song ba'i tshe stug po//bstan pa'i sgor zhugs sdom pa gsum zhus kyang / /nyes ltung char ba 'bab pa'i khrims 'chal bo/ /yi dam lha yi bsnyen sgrub mang byas kyang / /lha zhal zur tsam ma mthong sgrib mthug po/ /chung nas da lta'i bar du dkor zos kyang / /da dung tshim pa med pa'i heb rgan po/ /tshig bzhi tsam rer 'grel ba mi phog par/ /da dung nga mkhas snyam pa'i ham pa can/ /dug lnga'i mgo bo cung zad mi gnon par//rang nyid bzang bor rlom pa'i mgo g.yog po/ /rang la gar 'gro'i gtad so cang med par/ /shi bo'i lam sna 'dren pa'i snying khams can/ /rang nyid nam 'chi nges pa med bzhin du//gson po'i bar chad sel ba'i byen rlabs can/ /legs par bsams na yi mug mi ldang ngam/ /bsam zhing bsam zhing brang la tig tig brdung / /de ltar bsgoms pas nga rgyal zhi bar 'gyur/ /dge 'dis bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyis/ /nga rgyal dgra 'di myur du thul bar 605

shog/mtshan ldan bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /phrag dog dgra 'di thul bar byen gyis rlobs/ /mi gzhan mtho zhing skyid na mi dga' ba'i/ /phrag dog 'di ni khyod kyis gang nas dran/ /kye ma khyod kyis byang chub sems bskyed zhus/ /de dus sangs rgyas byang sems dgongs shig ces/ /thal mo sbyar nas bdag gis 'gro ba kun/ /sangs rgyas sa la 'god ces dam bca' byas/ /dge sbyor gang byas mar gyur 'gro ba kun/ /'phral phugs bde ba'i phyir du yang yang bsngos/ /'gro kun bde dang bde ba'i rgyu ldan pa'i/ /sgon lam mang bo kha nas 'don bzhin du/ /'di 'dra dran pa khyod ngo mi tsha 'am/ /'gro kun bde zhing skyid na dga' ba'i sems/ /kho nas ma 'ongs tshangs pa'i lus 'thob gsungs/ /khyod kyis bde 'gro'i lus rten mi 'dod dam/ /gzhan la phrag dog mtho na mi dga'i sems/ /skyes na dmyal ba lha min gnas su skye/ /khyod kyis shes bzhin de yi rgyu bsgrub bam/ /de ltar bsams pas phrag dog zhi bar 'gyur/ /dge 'dis bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyis/ /phrag dog dgra 'di myur du thul bar shog /ces dug lnga'i gnyen po 'di ni a rig gi dge slong byams pa bstan skyong gis bskul ngor tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//606

pha bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /bu'i sems la phan par byen gyis rlobs//ri smug pa can gyi khrod cig na/ /rdza'i phug pa rang shong khra ldem me//phyogs phyogs na 'byor ldan yon bdag gi /sbra lha gur rbed dkar khra me re/ /ri'i ngos dang klung na rta nor ni/ /rtswa chu 'thung nyal ba khra shigs se/ /khong dzi bo mang bos glu chung len/ /gcig gcig la 'dzum zhing dgod di ri/ /sprin sngo dkar lang long mkha' la 'then/ /char nyi ma'i nang na zim zim 'bab/ /'ja' kha dog lnga ldan spang rir 'then/ /g.yu'i mdog 'dra'i khu byug lhang lhang grag /chu lhung lhung 'bab pas snyan pa sgog /spang bde mo'i g.yu mdog me tog tshogs/ /rlung cung zad g.yos pas ldem ldem byed/ /mdog sna tshogs ske tog tshal chen la/ /lus rab mdzes bung ba 'du tshogs mang / /sgra dar dir sgrog bzhin skor ba byed/ /rang spang gzhongs de ru 'dug snying 'dod/ /phyogs phyogs su ltad mo blta snying 'dod/ /rje'i gsol 'debs mgur dbyangs len snying 'dod/ /dus de tshe me tog thams cad ni/ /rang yid kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal bar 'bul/ /rje bla mar rgyang 'bod gsol 'debs gyis/ /nang rgyud la phan pa'i rgyang glu longs/ /lha'i zhing khams chung chung zhig de yin/ /gnas de 'dra bsten na ngo mtshar che//bu khyod kyis dben gnas 607

rnams tshor ci'i phyir med/ /khyod kyi sdom pa ma shor na/ /sa 'dir sdom shor ngas ma mthong / /thams cad sdom ldan ma yin nam/ /yang na khyod kyi bshad tshul 'dis/ /sdom shor sdom ldan rnams yin nam/ /rang gis bsam bzhin sdom pa btang / /bslab skyor byas nas yang skyes snyam/ /khyod la sdom pa zhig skyes na/ /ri bong rwa zhig skye mod snyam/ /ngo ni tsha rgyu med ni 'gas/ /da dung chos gos khur nas 'gro/ /da dung gzhan la chos tsho bshad/ /da dung gzhan la bslab pa 'bog /da dung gzhan la bslab skyor byed/ /sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis gzigs/ /zhal ras phyag gis bkab nas bzhad/ /mi la chos bshad ban rgan ang / /khyod la ci zhig byung ba yin/ /las 'bras mi brtsi sdig pa byed/ /khyod kyi chos 'di su yis bslabs/ /bla ma'i ming la ci zhig zer//rang skyon kha ba tsam pa bzhag /bla mas 'jog dgos gsung ngam ci/ /gzhan skyon ba mo tsam pa sprugs/ /rabs chad ser mo 'ga' re yis/ /ser sna byas nas rgyu nom pa/ /bu la ster ram bu mor ster/ /ban rgan nga yis bsams tsa na/ /de 'dra'i ster sa med mod snyam/ /'on kyang ltas ngan go shes med//ban rgan nub mo 'gro 'dug rgod/ /ster sa yod na khyod khag med/ /ster sa med na 'chi ba'i tshe/ /'khur nas 'gro rgyu ma yin nam/ /ban 610

rgan nga yis da snga yan/ /bla rgan zhig gis mang bo bsags//'chi dus khur bud song 'dug ces/ /da snga mthong thos gcig ma byung //'on kyang ltas ngan go rgyu med/ /ban rgan 'ga' re 'khur shed che//khur nas 'gro na khyod khag med/ /bsags pa khur nas mi 'gro na/ /'chi bdag gshin rjer gnang ba zhus/ /mi 'chi sdod rgyu ma yin nam/ /ban rgan nga yis da snga yan/ /'chi bdag gshin rjes gnang ba byin/ /tshe thar ban rgan gcig ma rig /'on kyang ltas ngan go shes med/ /gong ma'i khrims kyang 'chol tshul tshor/ /bltas na chos rgyal khrims de yang / /blon po glang mgo can sogs kyis/ /nom par brje gin yod na'ang thang / /gshin rjes sdod ces gsung byon nas/ /'dug rgyu yin na khyod khag med//gal te ster sa 'khyer sa med/ /mi 'chi sdod rgyu ma yin na//rgyu nom bsags par don go ni/ /ci yod his khar lag pa zhog /legs par bsam blo zhib tu thongs/ /da lta 'phyugs na 'phyugs btsog yin/ /ban rgan nga yi 'dod yin na/ /rtsa bzhi'i sdom pa nyams med bsrungs/ /ser sna'i mdud pa glod na snyam/ /byed dam mi byed khyed tsho mkhyen/ /gal te thugs kyis mi bzhed na/ /nga la bka' bkyon 'dra ma gnang / /a khu rnams tsho rlung khams che/ /bshags pa zhig kyang dgos na 'bul/ /bshags pa 611

'dul sprul ba ston/ /sangs rgyas byang sems bdud kyang sprul/ /dag zhing dmyal ba bde 'gror sprul/ /ngan 'gro nyin mo mtshan mor sprul/ /chos lugs rnam dag chos log sprul/ /gter ston gter rdzun gter log sprul/ /lta ba rnam dag lta log sprul/ /sdom ldan sdom pa med par sprul/ /dam ldan dam nyams rnams kyang sprul/ /thams cad rten 'brel ltos bzhag yin/ /ngan pa med na bzang mi 'byung / /grub mtha' gang la'ang gshe mi rung / /gang la dag snang legs po gyis/ /'di thos rgyud la phan par shog /drin can bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /dge bsnyen lcags kyi rkang ba can/ /po ta la ru lan gsum byon/ /lan gcig byon dus lam kha na/ /dge slong chos gos can zhig gis/ /bu dang chung ma zhing khar bzhag /lhung bzed shing gi yal gar bkal/ /zhing zhig rmo ba'i zhing thog na/ /srin bu mang bo shi ba mthong / /ban log khyod kyis zhing rmo na/ /lhung bzed chos gos ma 'dzin cig /sangs rgyas bstan par gnod smras pas/ /byen pas khyer 'ongs gtsang sar sbas/ /de nas po ta la ru song / /sngar bzhin lha tshogs gcig ma mthong / /phyag skor mang bo byas pa'i 'phror/ /sgol ma khro gnyer can sogs mthong / /rtsa ru song bas smug pas 614

btums/ /gzhal yas khang sgo 'byed ma thub/ /phyag skor mang byas nang du thar/ /sngar dang mi 'dra ci yin zhus/ /lan du khyod kyis lam bar nas/ /tshul khrims 'chal ba'i mi de yi/ /btsun pa'i cha lugs phud pas bsgribs/ /mi de btsun pa'i cha lugs dang / /ma bral bzhag na da dung yang / /btsun pa'i bag tsam sems la yod/ /da ni dge ba'i bag tsam yang / /sems la med de dmyal bar 'gro/ /gsungs pas tshur lam mi de yi/ /chos gos lhung bzed phyir la sprad/ /mdo sde padma dkar bo las/ /thub pa'i bstan la rab byung ba/ /tshe 'dir mi dge ci spyad kyang / /skye ba brgya stong 'bum phrag bar/ /ngan song sdug bsngal pyong na yang / /bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong gi rjes/ /sangs rgyas mos pa'i bstan pa yi/ /mjug la mi yi lus thob ste/ /theg dman rig 'dzin dgra bcom thob/ /theg chen yin na rab dga'i sa/ /thob ste 'khor ba'i gnas 'di nas/ /khrims 'chal gcig kyang mi lus par/ /thub pa'i smon lam mthu yin gsungs/ /de phyir mkhas grub thams cad kyis/ /ci 'ong cir 'gyur mkhyen na yang / /sdom pa thub dang mi thub par/ /mi dpyad zhus tshad thams cad la/ /bsnyen rdzogs gnang ba de la dgongs/ /sdom pa blangs nas bsrung ma thub/ /gal te shor 'dra song na yang / /610

'dzin chags ma mchis na/ /gol sar lhung ba ci las 'byung / /bar du nyams snang sprin ltar yal/ /bsgom bya sgom byed 'dzin par stor/ /'di bsgom de bsgoms gtad so med/ /'di yin de yin nges shes shig /nang du bkug nas bltas 'dra med/ /phyir bltas gsal ba 'dra ste med/ /blta sa lta mkhan so so ri/ /yod pa 'dra ba de yang med/ /'di 'dra de lta ci yang med/ /blta sa lta mkhan ro gcig tu/ /'dres nas 'di yin de yin dang / /'di bsgom de bsgoms gcig kyang med/ /kha rog bsdad pa 'dra zhig 'byung / /dper na sprin med ston gye mkha'/ /de la je gsal 'gro rgyu dang / /mi gsal sgrib rgyu med pa bzhin/ /de tshe mnyam gzhag ngo bo de/ /de las je gsal 'gro rgyu dang / /mi gsal 'grib rgyu med pa yin/ /de tshe thos pa chung ngu yis/ /nga yis ci yang mi bsgom par/ /'dug snyam yid gnyis the tshom ldang / /hwa shing lta ba e yin ang / /'dri sa yod na cig dris na/ /dga' snyam blo sna mang bo dran/ /de tshe mtshan ldan bla mar dris/ /bka' brgyud gsung dang rgyud sde sogs/ /dpe ltos byas pas rang sems kyi/ /ngo bo mthong ba yin par go /sgom med mnyam gzhag yin par go /'gyur med rtogs pa yin par go /da ni gzhan la 'dri rgyu med/ /snyam nas thag chod sems kyang dga'/ /tha ma rang 618

gsal mnyam gzhag ste/ /ma bcos rang bab glod nas skyongs/ /chos sku'i byang chub the tshom med/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' drin las/ /byung ba'i rdo rje'i glu dbyangs 'di/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /thos tshad gnas lugs mngon 'gyur shog /mtho g.ya' ri dang rdza ri nyil song na/ /dma' sa 'bur khyod sdod pa'i gnas yod dam/ /da rtsa ba la ba tshwa ma khol bar/ /rtser 'jag ma zhig myur du skye thub ltos/ /mtho ljon shing dang me tog bskams song na/ /dma' ldum bu khyod sdod pa'i dbang yod dam/ /da lo 'dab rnams je rgyas ma btang bar/ /mgor 'bras bu zhig myur du smin thub ltos/ /mtho rgyal po dang blon bo'ang shi song na/ /dma' sprang bo khyod sdod pa'i gnas yod dam/ /da chos rgyal kyi dbang du ma 'gro bar/ /chos rnam dag zhig myur du mdzad thub ltos/ /zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//'o 'o bya btang chogs drug rang grol/ /bsil ldan bod kyi yul 'dir/ /yang yang e skye ci shes/ /da lta skyes pa'i dus 'dir/ /skabs skabs sems la phan pa'i/ /glu dbyangs snyan mo 'then dang / /bod yul dad can mi rnams/ /sems la phan nges e go /ya yi yayi/ /'o 'o glu ba tshogs drug rang grol/ /bsil ldan ljongs 'dir skyes kyang / /reb gong gser mo lngongs 619

pa gtong la rtag tu sems spro ba/ /de yi grags pa rlung bzhin 'ur gyis ldang / /phongs pa slong ba mang bo 'du ba bzhin/ /'bul bar 'dod pa rnams ni de bas mang / /phar la phyin pas slar yang mi len la/ /skye bo dman pa'i brnyas pa dang du len/ /phan pa chung ngu tsam byas mi brjed pa/ /de ni bdag nyid chen po'i che rtags yin/ /ljon shing dul ba 'bras bu mang bo smin/ /rma bya dul ba'i mjug sgro rab tu bzang / /rta mchog dul ba 'gro dus myur mgyogs te/ /dam pa dul ba mkhas pa yin pa'i rtags/ /chen pos dgra bor rtag tu byams byas na/ /nam zhig dgra nyid de yi dbang du 'gyur/ /skye bo mang bos bkur bas kun bskyangs pas/ /kun gye rgyal por de nyid dbang bskur ro/ /bstod pa byas la dga' bar mi 'gyur la/ /smad par byas kyang mi dgar mi 'gyur zhing / /rang gi yon tan legs par gnas gyur pa/ /skye bo dman pa rnams kyi mtshan nyid yin/ /ji lta ji ltar rje dpon nyid kyis ni/ /rang gi 'khor la drin kyis bskyangs gyur na/ /de lta de ltar 'khor dang g.yog rnams kyis/ /rje dpon nyid kyi bya ba thams cad bsgrub/ /rtag tu rang don ma gtogs gzhan gyi don/ /mi sems pa yi mi de phyugs dang mtshungs/ /bza' btung 'ba' zhig dud 'gro rnams yin yang / /bsgrub 622

par nus pas mi yin ma sems shig /phan dang mi phan gang la'ang mi dpyod cing / /blo dang thos pa nam yang mi bsgrub par/ /lto 'grang 'ba' zhig don du gnyer ba de/ /lus la spu med pa yi phag pa yin/ /blun po mang bo'i dbus na dga' zhing rtse/ /mkhas pa'i mdun du 'ongs na zhum zhing 'dzum/ /mi de'i mgo na rwa co med na yang //ya so can gyi ltas ngan ba glang yin/ /bza' btung gang na yod sa de ru brgyug /dgos pa'i bya ba bcol na 'bros pa yi/ /mi des gtam dang bzhad gad shes na yang / /mjug ma med pa'i khyi rgan rda li yin/ /skye bo blo chung sems la 'khon 'dzin can/ /gnod pa byed pa bas kyang rnam 'gyur snga//khyi ngan pha rol dgra bo mthong ba na/ /rmugs pa'i thog mar ku co 'don dang 'dra/ /blun pos longs spyod gsog pa'i sdug bsngal nyid/ /myong ba ma gtogs de la longs spyad nas/ /nyin gcig tsam yang bde ba myong ba dkon/ /blun po rnams kyi drung du mkhas pa bas/ /spre'u 'dzin pa'i sprang bo khyad par 'phags/ /spre'u 'dzin pa zas dang nor gyis mchod/ /yon tan can gye mkhas pa lag stong 'gro/ /skyon rnams thams cad 'bad pas 'dzin byed cing / /yon tan gang yang rtsad nas mi chags pa/ /skyes bu ngan pa dper na chu tshags kyis/ /ngan pa 'dzin 623

rnams kyis brlags pa mang bo yod/ /mi gang bsod nams dag la spyod pa des/ /btang yang longs spyod slar yang char bzhin 'bab//bsod nams med pas longs spyod /bsags pa de/ /nam zhig don med gang zag gzhan gyis spyod/ /shes rab ldan pas dgra la mig bsrings pas/ /tha ma pha rol dgra bo dbang du sdud//drod chung rnams kyis dgra la lan byas pas/ /dka' ba rgyun mi 'chad pa thob pa yin/ /dman pa rnams kyis dgos pa chung ngu gsang / /gsang dgos rigs ni dgos pa med par smra/ /skye bo dam pas dgos med gsang mi 'gyur/ /gsang dgos pa rnams srog la bab kyang gsang / /yid la gzhan zhig byed bsam kha yis tshig /gzhan zhig smra bar byed pa de nyid ni/ /skye bo g.yo can zhes su grags pa des/ /g.yo sgyu ha cang mang na tha mar brlag /sdig spyod mi ni rgyal por bskos pa dang / /khang ba'i ka gdung phyogs gzhan 'khyor ba dang / /ri rtse zhig nas lhung la khad pa yi//'og tu gnas rnams rgyun du skrag pa skye//dregs pas yon tan rnams ni nyams par 'gyur/ /'dod pa'i dbang gis ngo tsha nyams par byed/ /g.yog dang 'khor rnams rgyun du sun phyung na/ /ring min rje dpon nyams par 'gyur ba yin/ /bya rog dag gis kha zas bskungs pa dang / /skye bo gzhung ngan rnams la 626

phan btags dang / /zhing ngan dbyed dus sa bon btab pa rnams/ /re ba mang ste spyod pa shin tu nyung / /ma brtags bar du pha rol su la yang / /yid ches mi rung brtag pa byed gal che/ /bag phab pa las skyon rnams byung ba dang / /gros btab pa las dgra bor gyur pa mang / /'jig rten khams na ngan pa mang mod kyang / /skye bo ngan pa 'dra ba'i 'jigs pa med/ /ngan pa gzhan dag slar la bcos rung gi /skye bo ngan pa bcos na 'jigs par 'gyur/ /skye bo ngan pa dag la yon tan brgyas/ /phan par byas kyang nam yang mgu ba dka'/ /gang zhig brten pa thams cad dgrar 'gyur ba/ /de ni skye bo ngan pa'i khyad chos yin/ /mi gang brjod bya ma yin pa yi tshig /skye bo gzhan gyi drung du brjod pa de/ /bden pa yin nam 'on te dzun yang rung / /mkhas pa de la bag zon byas na bzang / /gnod pa'i mtshan ma kha ru 'byin pa yi/ /dgra bo de dag myur du gzhom pa sla//phan pa'i tshig ka kha ru 'byen pa yi/ /dgra bo de dag gzhom pa shin tu dka'/ /rang gi snying la 'khon du dam bzung nas/ /kha la tshig ka bzang bo smra'o zhes/ /drang srong gdug sems can gye gdams pa ste/ /dam pa'i tshul dang 'gal ba yin pas spang / /dug gi sdong bo rtsad nas 'don pa ltar/ /dgra bo rnams ni rtsad nas gcad dgos zhes/ /627
