gyur nas//bzang bo'i spyod pa rgyun du byed par shog /rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul ba dngos/ /bod du dam chos dar zhing rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /chos rgyal chen po khri srong lde'u btsan la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bod khams brtse bas skyongs/ /tshe 'dir yun ring bde ba spyad byas kyang / /nam zhig 'khor nor longs spyod kun dang bral/ /rang dbang med par nges par 'chi dgos pas/ /'jig rten 'di la rtag par ma 'dzin cig /gnyen bshes thams cad 'ongs nas mtha' bskor te//gdong la bltas nas mchi ma mang bo 'byin/ /de tshe rang nyid gcig pur phyi mar 'gro/ /dge ba'i las rnams ma gtogs gzhan mi phan//dper na sdong bo gcig la skyes pa yi//lo ma rlung gis bskyod nas 'thor ba bzhin/ /rang dang 'grogs pa'i pha ma bu chung ma/ /lo brgya tshun la thams cad so sor 'bral/ /mdza' bshes kun dang so sor bral nas ni/ /nges par gcig pur 'chi ba shes bzhin du/ /da dung sos dal bde bar gnyid phebs pa/ /de dag rnams kyi snying rtsa rul ba yin/ /gnod par byed pa'i dgra bo gzhom 'dod na/ /rang gi rgyud kyi khro ba kho na choms/ /khro bas 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ /rang la gnod pa mtha' yas byas pa yin/ /gal te dgra kun brlag par 'dod na yang //630

bsad pas de kun nam yang 'dzad mi 'gyur/ /rang gi rgyud kyi khro ba gcig bcom pas/ /dgra rnams thams cad gcig char bsad pa yin/ /rab tu mthu che gzu lum spyod pa la/ /khros nas rang la lhag par gnod pa byed/ /skyes bu dam pa nye bar zhi ba la/ /khro bar bya ba'i rgyu ni ga la yod/ /gang zhig longs spyod nyung ngus chog shes pa/ /de yi longs spyod nam yang zad mi shes/ /chog shes med par longs spyod 'tshol ba la/ /mi 'dod sdug bsngal char bzhin rgyun du 'bab/ /rang la nam dgos tshe na len pa yi/ /nor ni sbyin pa yin zhes thub pas gsungs/ /bsags pa'i nor ni sbrang ma'i sbrang rtsi ltar/ /nam zhig gang zag gzhan gyis spyod par 'gyur/ /'jig rten 'di na phyug pos bun btang ba/ /dom bdag shi na thob pa'i nges pa med/ /slong ba rnams la byen na 'bad med par/ /dngos po chung yang brgya 'gyur 'thob pa yin/ /byin na rang nyid dbul bor 'gyur dogs nas/ /blo chung phyug po phal cher sbyin mi gtong / /ser sna nges par phongs par 'gyur mthong nas/ /blo ldan cung zad rnyed pa gzhan la gtong //bye ba stong phrag mi zad gter yod kyang //su zhig gzhan la gtong bar mi nus pa/ /de dag 'jig rten 'di na dbul bo zhes/ /thos mang rnams kyis de skad bshad pa yin/ /zan gcig 631

mkhas pa'i zhabs pad bsten nas ni/ /'bad pa du mas yon tan slob la 'bod//sgom thub thos pa byas pas ci bya zhes/ /blun po blo rgya chung ngu rnams kyis smra/ /thos pa med par yun ring bsgom byas kyang / /bsgom gnad ma shes dud 'gro'i sgrub thabs yin/ /des na thos pa byas te chos rnams kun/ /legs par rtogs nas sgom la sbyar ba na/ /las dang nyon mongs sgrib pa kun zad nas/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur/ /'di yang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol smras/ /legs bshad 'di nyid thos tshad thams cad kyis/ /tshe 'di'i bde la nam yang mi chags par/ /rgyun du dam pa'i lha chos byed par shog /dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can bla ma thams cad la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs//thugs rjes 'gro ba yongs la gzigs//rang la 'byor ba yod tsa na/ /mi rnams thams cad mgu ste legs/ /rgud pa'i dus su grogs yin yang / /spong bar 'gyur bas legs pa min/ /nor dang zas la yangs tsa na/ /kun gyes bkur gnas 'dzin te legs/ /nor zas bral na gzhan kun gyi//yid du mi 'ong legs pa min/ /rang bzhin bzang zhing bsod nams dang / /ldan na thams cad 634

'dud pas legs/ /khrel med rang bzhin ngan pa la/ /'grogs na mi bde legs pa min/ /smra tshad thams cad bden tsa na/ /mi kun tshig la nyan te legs//rdzun zer smra ba mang ba na//kun gyis mi nyan legs pa min//shes rig bzang na rang dbang mir/ /ma byin rang dbang thob pas legs/ /shes chung grogs la ma dris na/ /nyes pas 'phog pas legs pa min/ /chos mos dkon mchog gsum mchod na/ /'di phyi gnyis gar skyid pas legs/ /dad med sdig la dga' ba na/ /ngan song skye bas legs pa min/ /legs dang mi legs drug gi glu/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /thos tshad mi legs drug spangs nas/ /legs pa drug po byed par shog / sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /chos la spyod pa'i yul dbus su/ /skyes kyang dug lnga shin tu rags//rang rgyud rtag tu 'khrugs pa dang //rang rgyud blun zhing gti mug pa'i//sdig grogs dbang du song ba dang / /bdud kyi bshes gnyen dang 'phrad nas/ /lta spyod phyin ci log sogs dang / /chos la slob par 'dod na yang / /brtson 'grus gtan nas med pa yi/ /ha cang le lo can rnams dang / /635

bskal brgya byung ngo //de nas bskal pa rdzogs ldan zhes//bya bar sangs rgyas bye ba phrag /brgyud cu byung zhing de'i 'og tu/ /mtha' 'khob bskal pa brgya byung ngo / /de nas bskal pa bzang ldan zhes/ /bya bar sangs rgyas bye ba phrag /brgyad bcu rtsa bzhi byung ba'o/ /de 'og mun bskal lnga brgya byung / /de nas bskal pa mthong na dga'/ /sangs rgyas bye ba phrag brgyad cu/ /byung zhing de 'og mun bskal ni/ /bdun brgya tsam byung de'i 'og tu/ /bskal pa dga' ba ldan pa la/ /sangs rgyas stong phrag drug cu byung / /de rjes bskal pa bzang bo 'dir/ /sangs rgyas stong rnams rim bzhin 'byung / /'di yi 'og tu mtha' 'khob kyi/ /bskal pa rigs ngan drug cu 'byung / /de 'og bskal pa grangs ldan la/ /sangs rgyas stong phrag drug cu 'byung / /de yi 'og tu rigs ngan gye/ /bskal pa stong phrag bcu 'byung ngo / /de la sogs pa'i mun pa dang / /sgon me bskal pa du ma 'byung / /mun pa'i bskal pa dang 'phrad pa'i/ /dus su sangs rgyas ming tsam yang / /med ces dgongs 'dus las gsungs so/ /de phyir da re 'jig rten du/ /'byon par dka' ba'i sangs rgyas byon/ /gsung gi chos dang mjal dus 'dir/ /dam pa'i chos la 'bad par mdzod/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /'di nyid mthong thos dran 638

reg kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog /rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che/ /'dzin skyong spel ba'i thugs rje can/ /ngag dbang blo bzang bstan 'dzin la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /pha ma gnyis kyis gces phrug de/ /chung dus brtse bas skyong ba ltar/ /mtshan ldan bla ma bzang bo yis/ /snod ldan slob bu de ltar skyongs/ /rtsal ldan seng ge dkar mo yis/ /seng phrug chung dus skyong ba ltar/ /mtshan ldan bla ma bzang bo yis/ /snod ldan slob bu de ltar skyongs/ /bya rgyal thang dkar rgod po yis/ /rgod phrug chung dus skyong ba ltar/ /mtshan ldan bla ma bzang bo yis/ /snod ldan slob bu de ltar skyongs/ /rwa sngon bre ser 'brong bo yis/ /'brong phrug chung dus skyong ba ltar/ /mtshan ldan bla ma bzang bo yis/ /snod ldan slob bu de ltar skyongs/ /sman pa shin tu mkhas pa yis//nad pa brtse bas skyong ba ltar/ /mtshan ldan bla ma bzang bo yis//snod ldan slob bu de ltar skyongs/ /chos dang zang zing gnyis ka la/ /phangs pa med par slob bu skyongs/ /tshe 'di phyi ma bar do gsum/ /gang du brtse bas slob bu skyongs/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /'di nyid thos tshad thams cad kyis/ /snod dang ldan pa'i slob ma rnams/ /639

chos bzhin brtse bas skyong bar shog/pad 'byung thugs bcud rdzogs pa che/ /nyams blangs rtogs pa mngon gyur pa'i/ /bla ma dkon mchog chos 'phel la /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /mtshan ldan bla ma dam pa de/ /slob mas ji ltar bsten zer na/ /dang po zang zing longs spyod kyis/ /bla ma mnyes par bya ba'i tshul/ /bla mas zang zing mi 'dod kyang //rang gi bsod nams tshogs rdzogs phyir//'bru sman rin chen sna tshogs 'bul/ /bza' btung yid du 'ong bas mchod/ /bzhed na rang gi bu bu mo/ /chung ma bran g.yog gang dgos 'bul/ /gzhan gyi bu mo blus nas 'bul/ /nor rdzas gang la mnyes pa 'bul/ /bar du sgo gsum bsnyen bkur gyis/ /bla ma mnyes par bya ba'i tshul/ /lus kyis phyag dang skor ba dang / /bzhengs na ldang dang bsu skyel bya/ /bla mas bya ba gang bcol bsgrubs/ /ngag gis bla ma'i gsung sgros rnams/ /bzung nas gzhan la ston pa dang / /bla ma'i yon tan phyogs bcur sgog /zhes pa snyan par smra ba sogs/ /bla ma'i thugs dang mthun par byed/ /yid kyis rgyun du dad gus bya/ /thun bzhir bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom//tha mar sgrub pa'i sgo nas ni//bla ma mnyes par bya ba'i tshul//bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po sogs/ /gsungs pa'i 640

gdams pa zab mo rnams/ /tshe 'di blos btang dben pa bsten/ /ri dwags rmas ma ji bzhin du/ /gcig pur nyams su len par bya/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /thos tshad snod ldan slob ma yis/ /bla ma zang zing sgo gsum dang / sgrub pa'i sgo nas mnyes byed shog/rgya bod mkhas grub mang bo yi/ /skye ba brgyud nas 'gro don mdzad/ /bla ma bse yi grub chen la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs//bla ma bsten pa'i phan yon ni/ /zang zing phul nas mnyes byas na/ /nam mkha' gang ba'i sangs rgyas la/ /rin chen stong gsum gang phul bas/ /bla ma'i ba spu nyag gcig la/ /mar thigs gcig byugs bsod nams che/ /zas nor phul ba smos ci dgos/ /lus kyis bla mar gnod pa yi/ /ma rungs pa rnams bsad byas na/ /sems can 'bum tsho tsam zhig gis/ /srog bton pas kyang bsod nams che/ /bla mas bya ba gang bcol rnams/ /bsgrubs na bsod nams dpag med 'thob//ngag gis bla ma mnyes byas na/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs pa'i chos/ /bskal pa brgya phrag mang bo ru/ /bton las bsod nams lhag par 'gyur/ /yid kyis dad pa lan gcig byas/ /stong gsum gang ba'i sangs rgyas la/ /mchod pa stong gsum gang phul 641

bas/ /bsod nams shin tu che bar gsungs/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms byas na/ /gnas skabs kun gyi yid du 'ong / /ci bsam thams cad 'grub pa dang / /nad gdon bar chad thams cad ni/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub kyi//sems gsum rgyun du skye ba dang / /ting 'dzin rtogs pa khyad par can/ /'bad rtsol med par rgyud la skye/ /bla ma mnyes pas gsang mdzod gsungs/ /lta sgom spyod pa bogs thon zhing / /mkha' 'gro sprin bzhin 'du ba dang / /'khor dang longs spyod cher rgyas shing / /mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'thob/ /sgrub pa'i sgo nas mnyes byas na/ /bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / /dngos grub thams cad 'grub pa dang / /nyams chag skong zhing mtshams med lnga//la sogs sgrib pa rlabs chen 'dzad/ /ring min myur du sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /mdor na bla ma mnyes byas na/ /dpag bsam shing dang yid bzhin nor/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang 'dra ba yin/ /yon tan dpag tu med pa 'thob/ /de la dmigs te bla ma sten/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /'di nyid thos tshad thams cad kyis/ /bla ma tshul bzhin bsten pa'i mthus/ /tshogs rdzogs sgrib byang sangs rgyas shog /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku//drin can rtsa ba'i bla 642

ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyes rlobs/ /bka' drin che ba'i bla ma la/ /rmi lam tsam du mos pa log /brnyas na skye ba phyi ma la/ /khyi yi skye ba brgya blangs nas/ /sme sha can du skye bar 'gyur/ /de nas dmyal ba'i gnas su lhung / /tsha grang sdug bsngal nyams su myong / /gal te de las thar na yang / /bskal pa bye ba brgya stong du/ /dam chos ming yang thos mi 'gyur/ /dngos su brnyas na smos ci dgos/ /bla ma'i thugs dkrugs nyes pa ni/ /phyi ma rdo rje dmyal bar lhung / /phyi yi rgya mtsho chen po yi/ /chu de skra yi nyag gcig gis/ /gtor nas zad pa de tsam du/ /sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar 'gyur//bla ma smad pa'i nyes pa ni//tshe 'di nyid la sdug bsngal 'byung //rims dang dug dang dbyig dug dang / /ṭakki rnams kyis gtses pa dang / /gdon dang log 'dren gtum po yis/ /bsad nas dmyal ba'i gnas su ltung / /mos pa log dang brnyas pa'i grangs/ /bdun nam bcu tsam bshags pas 'dag /rang lo grangs 'das 'dag mi 'gyur/ /dus kun bla ma'i skyon mi rtog /bla ma'i yon tan dran byos la/ /sgo gsum g.yo sgyu zol khram spongs/ /nad pas sman pa bsten pa ltar/ /nyon mongs nad kun gso ba'i phyir/ /bla ma dam pa bsten par bya/ /tshong bas ded 643

dpon bsten pa ltar/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las sgol phyir/ /bla ma dam pa bsten par bya/ /mgron pos skyel ma bsten pa ltar/ /'khor ba'i 'jigs pa las sgol phyir/ /bla ma dam pa bsten par bya/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /'di nyid thos tshad thams cad kyis/ /bla ma mi mnyes bya ba rnams/ /skad cig tsam yang mi byed shog /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byen gyis rlobs/ /gsang sngags dbang bskur legs thob pa'i/ /phan yon snying gi me long las/ /dbang rnams rab tu thob byas nas/ /gsang sngags thams cad ma bsgrubs 'grub/ /ces gsungs pa dang klong gsal las/ /dbang thob rgyud smin chos sgo phye/ /gsang sngags don kun 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes dang khyad par de nyid las/ /dbang thob rigs kyi bu de nyid/ /tshe 'dir bsam pa kun 'grub dang / /phyi mar mngon par rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /zhes sogs dbang thob phan yon ni/ /rgyud sde rnams las mang bo gsungs/ /de phyir mtshan ldan bla ma la/ /rdo rje theg pa'i dbang bskur zhus/ /dbang bskur ma thob pa yi skyon/ /phyag chen kha sbyor thig le las/ /dbang ma thob par dngos grub med//bye ma 644

btsir yang mar med bzhin/ /zhes gsungs de bzhin lung gzhan las/ /dbang med pa yi rnal 'byor gang / /gsang sngags spyod par brtsams pa ni//mar 'dod bye ma btsir dang mtshungs//zhes gsungs pa dang klong gsal las/ /dper na zhing sa gshin po la//so nam rim par ma byas na//'bras bu smin par mi 'gyur ltar/ /sems la chos nyid gnas gyur kyang / /dbang gis smin par ma byas na/ /rnal 'byor dngos grub ga la thob/ /dbang med 'khor ba'i mtha' bsnyegs te/ /'di phyi'i bde ba thob pa med/ /zhes sogs rgyud sde mang bo nas/ /dbang ma thob la skyon mang gsungs/ /de phyir mtshan ldan bla ma la/ /gsang sngags dbang bskur tshad ldan zhus//glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs//'di nyid thos tshad thams cad kyis/ /gsang sngags smin byed dbang thob nas//grol byed gdams pa bsgom par shog /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyes rlobs/ /dbang bskur thog ma tha ma ru/ /dga' ston byas na dngos grub thob/ /dga' ston ma byas dngos grub med//dga' ston phan yon klong gsal las//bla ma dang ni de yi 'khor/ /de bzhin rang gi rdo rje'i spun/ /gcig dang gnyis dang 645

gsum dag nas/ /brgya stong grangs med dag la ni/ /tshogs kyi dga' ba bsu byas pa/ /ston mo yon dang bcas pa yis/ /rnal 'byor pa rnams mgu byas na/ /legs pa thams cad 'grub pa dang / /nyes pa kun las grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs gzhan yang de nyid las//dga' ston bar chad sel ba dang / /yon tan phun tshogs 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs dga' ston med pa yi/ /skyon ni snga ma de nyid las/ /dga' ston tshogs yon med pa na/ /bar chad rkyen ni sna tshogs 'byung / /dbang gi rgyal sa zhig pa dang / /dngos grub mi thob yi dwags skye//zhes gsungs pa dang rang shar las/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang / /mched grogs rdo rje'i srun la sogs/ /tshogs mchod yon gyis ma mnyes na/ /nad mang tshe thung bar chad mang / /thun mong dngos grub med pa dang / /mchog las ring du song ba dang / /tshe 'phos yi dwags skye ba brgyud/ /ces gsungs des na dbang zhu dus/ /yod na tshogs yon rgya chen 'bul/ /med kyang bsod nams spel ba'i phyir/ /rang gi ci 'byor dga' ston bya/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs//'di nyid thos tshad thams cad kyis//gsang sngags dbang bskur zhu ba'i dus/ /thog mthar dga' ston byed par shog /646

skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan gyi/ /shes rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /tshe 'di'i don gnyer blo log nas/ /chos la blo kha phyogs pa'i phyir/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran par bya/ /'chi ba ma dran tshe 'dir chags/ /dam chos yid la mi 'ong bas//'chi ba dran pa gal re che/ /skabs skabs 'di ltar dran par bya//rang gi pha ma bla ma dang / /grogs mched yon bdag pho mo dang / /sde ba tsho ba yul phyogs kyi//mi rnams mang bo shi ba bgrongs//rang yang 'di yi rang bzhin yin//sdod rtsis byas pas ci zhig bya/ /phyi mar 'gro ba'i grabs shom bya/ /snyam du phyag skor kha ton gyis/ /rang dang lo mnyam shi ba dang / /rang gi chung rnams shi ba soms//rang yang 'di yi rang bzhin yin//da snga ma shi ya mtshan che//ma shi na yang tshe 'di yi/ /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi'i dbang song nas/ /'jig rten phyi mar song ba'i tshe/ /phan pa'i dam chos ma byas na/ /skyon che chos la 'bad par bya/ /snyam du bla ma dkon mchog mchod/ /dbul phongs rnams la sbyin pa thongs/ /gzhan yang sgo phyugs shi ba dang / /bya dang ri dwags 'bu srin sogs/ /shi ba mthong dang thos na yang / /rang yang 'di yi rang bzhin yin/ /tshe 'dir chags pas ci zhig bya/ /phyi mar skyid pa'i chos 647

shig dgos//snyam du tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong gyis//gzhan yang shi ba'i ro rus pa//la sogs mthong dus 'di skyes nas/ /shi ba yin pas rang nyid kyang //nam zhig 'di yi rang bzhin yin/ /gnyid dang bza' btung dbang song nas/ /chos med lag stong 'gro nyen 'dug /phyi mar bde ba'i chos bya dgos/ /snyam du thos gsum sgom gsum gyis/ /'di yang tshogs drug rang grol blangs//dge 'dis rang bzhin ma lus pa//gnas skabs kun tu bde ba dang / /mthar thug rnam ma.o myur thob shog /nag po spyod pa'i sprul ba dngos/ /lung rtogs yon tan mdzod 'dzin pa'i/ /bla ma nags tshang sprul sku la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byen gyes rlobs/ /sangs rgyas gang la gang 'dul skur/ /bstan nas 'gro don mdzad pa yin/ /tshangs pa brgya byin 'khor los sgyur/ /la la bla chen rgyal blon tshul/ /sdig can bshan pa smad 'tshong ma/ /la la bdud kyi cha byad tshul/ /dug gsum nga rgyal phrag dog dang / /la la ser sna che ba'i tshul/ /zha long 'on lkugs bran g.yog dang / /la la dbul bo smyon pa'i tshul/ /bzang ngan sna tshogs tshul bstan nas/ /sems can rnams kyi don mdzad pa/ /so skye rnams kyis mi shes phyir/ /gang zag rab 'bring tha gsum su/ /gang la dag snang byas na bzang / /khyem pa ci yang 648

mi shes pas/ /pha ma'i lam sna 'dren mkhan gyi/ /yul phyogs bla ma phal cher gyis/ /yon bdag gang phul bsod nams tshogs/ /rdzogs phyir blangs nas gsog tsa na/ /bla ma de ba gsog 'jog che/ /ser sna che zer kha yis gtong / /de la dgos pa du ma yod/ /khyim pas bsags pa lta bu min/ /rang gi dge sbyor mthun rkyen dang / /bsdu bzhi'i gzhan don byed snyam dang / /sgu gsung thugs rten bzhengs snyam sogs/ /dgongs gzhi du ma yod pa yin/ /chags zhen spu tsam ma mchis na/ /ri tsam bsags kyang skyon mi gos/ /khyim pa phal gyes bsags bsags nas/ /dgra 'dre'i phyogs su gtong ba'am/ /ma ṇi tsam yang mi 'don par/ /mang bo zos nas g.yag char re/ /gnyid pa lta bu ga la yin/ /bla mas nangs nub thugs dam byed/ /sku gsung thugs rten du ma bzhengs/ /dgon la 'gyed phogs mang bo rgyag /chud zos cung zad tsam mi gtong / /de phyir rang gi yul phyogs kyi/ /bla ma dam pa phal cher gyis/ /ser sna che ba ltar mdzad kyang / /de la thugs dgongs ci 'dra yod/ /mi shes snyam du khas ma gtong / /bla mas ci mdzad thams cad po/ /legs pa'i yon tan yin soms la/ /dag snang gyis shig khyim pa tsho//gzhan yang bla ma phal cher gyis//gsang yum mtshan ldan bsten pa la/ /a kha zer nas kha yis 649

gtong / /gsang sngags bskyed rdzogs rnal 'byor pas/ /bsten kyang nyes pa cung zad med//de la brten nas sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang thob la nye bas na//khyem pas spyad pa lta bu min/ /blun po khyim pa ser mo rnams/ /phal gyis bla ma de ba tshang / /bud med bsten na kho bo tsho/ /bshad rgyu ci yod zer nas gzhan//bud med bsten pa dpe bzhag na/ /rma byas dug chen zos tsa na/ /lus po shin tu mdzes na yang / /khwa tas kho la ci skyon zhes/ /dug zos srog dang bral ba 'dra/ /de phyir khyim pa dad can tsho/ /de 'dra'i bla ma su la yang / /khas gtong mi rung dag snang gyis/ /bzang rung ngan rung bla ma mkho//nam zhig shi ba'i dus skabs su//rang gi yul phyogs bla ma de/ /sngas mgor byon nas dril bu dkrol/ /khrus chog bskur ba ma gtogs pa/ /skyon rnams thams cad kun zad cing //yon tan kun ldan phyogs gzhan gyi//bla ma bzang bo 'ong mi 'gyur/ /de phyir khyim pa bsam shes tsho/ /rang gi yul phyogs bla ma la/ /rgyun du mchod bstod bkur sti gyis/ /gzhan yang khyim pa phal cher gyes/ /rang gi yul phyogs ser mo la//sdom pa med zer kha yis gtong / /mo sdom tsam zhig med tsa na/ /khyim pa rnams dang khyad med zer/ /me tog tsam pa ka rgas kyang / /me tog phal gyis do zla min/ /rab byung tshul khrims 'chal gyur 650

kyang / /khyim pa phal gyis do zla min/ /khyim pa bzhin du srog gcod dang / /brkus dang 'phrog bcom sogs mi bya/ /thugs dam bzlas brjod mang bo byed/ /khyim pa lta bu ga la yin/ /mo sdom shor yang sdom pa gzhan/ /thams cad shor nas ga la 'gro/ /dper na phyug po'i rta brkus kyang / /ra lug g.yag gsum ga la 'chor/ /mo sdom tsam zhig med tsa na/ /de la sdom pa med do zhes/ /smras na nyes pa shin tu che/ /sdom pa tshang ma med na yang / /sdom pa re re med ni med/ /ser mo khyim pa lta bu min/ /dag snang gyis shig khyem pa tsho//sdom pa shor yang khyim par mkho//na tsha god kha byung tsa na//mdo sgrol gdugs dkar rnam 'joms sogs//sku rim 'don dus sdom shor dgos/ /'chi tshe rna bar chos kyi sgra/ /thar mdo kun rigs lhang lhang du/ /sgrog dus sdom shor rnams min med/ /thag ring yul phyogs gzhan zhig gi /dge slong sdom ldan zhig mi 'ong / /khrid la shog dang nged tshos blta/ /mkho dus yul phyogs bla rgan rnams/ /ma gtogs nges par dka' mod snyam/ /de phyir khyim pa pho mo tsho/ /rang gi yul phyogs ser mo rnams/ /'gab nas bzhag te ma brnyas par/ /bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa gyis/ /nam zhig mkho ba'i dus tshod 'byung //mdor na lhan pa ser bo zhig /gyon tshad khyim pas spyi bor 651

bkur/ /bsod nams dpag med 'thob par 'gyur/ /bla ma nags tshang rin po cher/ /gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i byen rlabs kyis/ /thos tshad yongs la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//dbu rdzogs phyag chen zhi byed gcod/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad la/ /gsol ba 'debs so grub mtha' la/ /phyogs ris med par byen gyis rlobs/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa/ /dper na ri zhig rtse dang 'dra/ /dbu rdzogs phyag chen zhi byed gcod/ /dper na phyogs bzhi'i lam dang 'dra/ /de rnams nyams len gang zag rnams/ /lam de rnams la 'gro mi 'dra/ /chos rnams cung zad mi gcig pa/ /dper na lam rnams mi gcig 'dra/ /chos rnams cung zad ma mthun na/ /gcig gis gcig la khyod kyi chos/ /chos log yin zhes smod pa de/ /dper na phyogs bzhi'i lam rnams kyi/ /che chung bde gzar 'khyog drang sogs/ /ma mthun gcig gis gcig po la/ /khyod kyi lam de lam ma yin/ /lam log zer nas smod dang 'dra/ /nyams su len tshul mi gcig pa/ /dper na la la rta bzang zhon/ /la las khal bkal la las yis/ /khur bo khur nas 'gro dang 'dra//myur dang mi myur khyad che ba/ /dper na rta ba sngon du 652

slebs/ /khal ma can rnams de'i 'phror bsleb/ /khur can phyi nas sleb dang 'dra/ /chos gang nyams su blangs tsa na/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang thob pa de/ /dper na lam bzhi'i gang gyen du/ /song yang ri rtser phyin dang 'dra/ /de phyir sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs/ /dbu rdzogs phyag chen zhi byed gcod/ /gang la'ang yod pas dag snang gyis//rang nyid gang mos nyams su longs/ /chos la dkar nag med pa la/ /grub mtha'i kha 'dzin chos la smod/ /thar ba'i 'ju thag chad pa yin/ /grub dbang mi la ras pas gsungs/ /chos dang skyes bu dam pa la/ /brten pa'i sdig pa mi bzad pas/ /phyogs 'dzin sdang shugs dor nas kyang / /dag snang nor bu'i 'od zer gyis/ /kun la khyab par mdzod cig ces/ /paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan gsungs/ /de bzhin mdzod ces thams cad la/ /tshogs drug rang grol gsol ba 'debs/ /bla ma gong ma thams cad la/ /gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs/ /dam pa gong ma'i byin rlabs kyis/ /chos la phyogs ris med par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku//drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so ci bsam kun/ /chos bzhin 'grub par byen gyis rlobs/ /dper na phyogs gzhan mi 'gro 653

bar/ /sdod pa'i blo de yod tsa na/ /'gro grabs mi byed mkhar brtsig dang / /so nam sogs kyi shom ra bting / /rgyun du sdod pa'i grabs byed ltar/ /nam zhig 'chi ba 'ong snyam pa/ /kun gyes shes kyang nyin re bzhin/ /de ring mi 'chi de ring yang / /mi 'chi 'dug go snyam pa'i blo/ /yod na 'chi brod chos mi byed/ /tshe 'di'i dgra 'dul gnyen skyong gi /dbang du 'gro ba chos nyid yin/ /dper na yul phyogs gzhan zhig tu/ /mgyogs par 'gro ba'i 'dun pa can/ /gzhi phab sdod pa'i grabs mi byed/ /khal rta la sogs 'gro ba la/ /mkho ba'i sta gon lhur len bzhin/ /sang tsam mi 'chi'i nges pa med/ /zla ba phyi ma'i grabs byas kyang / /de dus rang nyid lus rten 'di/ /bor nas byad dbyibs mi 'dra ba/ /rwa co zing nge ba zhig tu/ /mi skye nges pa ci zhig yod/ /snyam pa'i blo zhig yod tsa na/ /'dir snang bya ba mi brtson par/ /phyi mar phan pa'i thabs ngang ngam/ /shugs kyis byed pa chos nyid yin/ /dam chos don du gnyer rnams kyis/ /'chi ba bsgom pa shin tu gces/ /'di yang tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /thos tshad 'chi bas rgyud bskul nas/ /tshe 'di'i bya bas mi g.yeng bar//dam chos don du gnyer bar shog /bdag la dus gsum sangs rgyas las/ /drin che chos kyi rgyal 654

po la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan gyis/ /'chi ba dran par byin gyes rlobs//phyi snod stong gsum 'jig rten khams//ri rab gling bzhi nyi zla dang / /bcas pa'i sra brtan bskal pa'i bar/ /gnas pa 'di yang nam zhig na//'jig pa'i dus la bab tsa na/ /me chu rlung gsum gyis bshig nas/ /bsam gtan bzhi ba'i lha gnas man//thal ba tsam yang mi lus par/ /'jig par 'gyur ba'i tshul bsams te/ /'di tshor chags 'jig yod tsa na/ /shin tu nyam chung bdag gi lus/ /'di ni rtag pa smos ci dgos//snyam du sems la skyo shas skyed//nam zla dus bzhi rim pa bzhin/ /mi rtag 'gyur nas 'gro ba dang / /lo zla mi rtag rim bzhin 'gyur/ /nyi zla'i 'char nub nyin mtshan gnyis/ /mi rtag 'gyur ba'i tshul bsams nas//rang yang mi rtag 'di tsho bzhin//rim gyis 'gyur nas 'gro bar nges/ /snyam du bsams nas skyo shas skyed/ /bya rnams rang yul bsnyeg pa dang / /ri dwags nges med gnas 'pho dang //'bab chu'i dar rgud tshul bsams nas//rang yul mi sdod 'di dang mtshungs/ /nam zhig pha rol 'gro ba yin/ /snyam du bsams nas skyo shas skyed/ /'di yang tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i byen rlabs kyis/ /thos tshad 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ /bsams nas skyo shas skye bar shog /650

sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma la//gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /da lta tshe tshad drug cu tsam/ /thub pa'i dbang du byas na yang / /tshe ni lo re song nas 'dzad/ /lo de zla ba song nas 'dzad/ /zla ba nyin zhag song nas 'dzad/ /nyin zhag skad cig song nas 'dzad/ /skad cig ma'i rgyun khri li lis/ /'dzad pa dper na ri gzar kha'i//chu de mgyogs par babs dang 'dra/ /dper na thags de 'thag tsa na/ /lan rer spun nyag re bcug kyang / /myur du gting la gtugs pa ltar/ /mi tshe 'dzad pa'ang de dang 'dra/ /dper na nges par gsod pa zhig /gom pa re re spos na yang / /gsod sar myur du sleb pa ltar/ /mi tshe 'dzad pa'ang de dang 'dra/ /dper na 'bru mar bzhus nas ni//mar khu kong bu gang tsam la/ /sdong bu btsugs nas me sbar na//rim gyis zad nas 'gro ba ltar/ /mi tshe 'dzad pa'ang de dang 'dra/ /de bzhin dpe ni du ma'i sgos/ /mi tshe 'dzad pa'i tshul bsams nas/ /tshe 'di'i don med bya ba spongs//tshe mjug 'di la lha chos gyis/ /'dis kyang rang gzhan la phan nas/ /lha chos byas nas sangs rgyas shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs/ /'phral phugs bde ba'i bslab bya la/ /dad can 656

slob bu bstan dar nyon/ /gong du bsdad na nyes ltung 'byung / /'dug sa dben par gyes shig ang / /zas nor chos kyi bar chad yin/ /'dod chung chog shes gyis shig ang / /grogs ngan bsten na je ngan 'gro/ /rtag tu gcig pur sdod cig ang / /byang chub sems dpa' gang na bzhugs/ /mi shes kun la ma smod ang / /chos rgyal mdun du gsang mi thub/ /chos la ngo skog ma byed ang / /'chi dus phan mkhan mi gcig med/ /gnyen la sred pa ma che ang / /lkog tu gzhan gyi mtshang ma 'bru//lan po rang la 'khor ro ang / /rtag tu gzhan gyi skyon ma brtags/ /rang skyon rtogs la spongs shig ang / /yi dam lha la bzang ngan med//rang nyid gang mos sten cig ang / /dam pa'i chos la mi bzang med/ /dgos med kha sdig ma gsogs ang / /phyag dang mchod pas lus sgrib 'dag /nyin re bzhin du 'bod cig ang/ /kha ton bzlas pas ngag sgrib 'dag /don med long gtam ma lab ang / /rgyun du rang gi sems la ltos/ /chos sems rgyab 'gal ma gtong ang / /phan pa'i kha ta byed mkhan dkon/ /kun kyi kha la ma nyan ang / /gros ni 'dri na rgyal ba'i bkar/ /dris dang nam yang mi bslu ang / /glo bur nam 'chi nges pa med/ /sgom sgrub phyi bshol ma byed ang / /snying rus ma byas nyams rtogs 657

dka'/ /bsgom la brtson 'grus gyis shig ang / /bsgom yun ma thung tshe dang snyoms/ /don gyi gtso bo yin no ang / /dge 'dis dad can slob bu yis/ /ci bsam chos bzhin 'grub par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis slob bu byams pa bstan dar la mtsho snying nas smras pa'o//bla ma sangs rgyas 'bral med spyi bor bzhugs/ /byen rlabs dngos grub skal ldan bu la stsol/ /e ma blo ldan slob bu rab 'byams par/ /phan pa'i kha ta tshig 'ga' bshad kyis nyon//blo phugs gtod sa bla ma dkon mchog bzang / /rtag tu gsol ba thobs dang byin rlabs 'jug /grong dang dgon par bsdad na chags sdang gsog /ri khrod dben pa bsten na legs tshogs 'byung / /nor rdzas 'tshol la sems khur sdug bsngal che/ /'dod chung chog shes gyis dang bde zhing skyid/ /nye du 'brel ba 'khor bar 'ching byed sgog /chags zhen dor dang dam chos ngang gis 'ong //mi mang 'a 'ur dge sbyor 'phrog pa'i dgra//ngag mtshams dam po gyis dang dge sbyor 'phel/ /bag med gu yangs spyod pa byung ba'i rgyu//spyod pa chos mthun gyis dang rgyal ba dgyes//sos dal skyid chos bdud kyi cho 'phrul te/ /myur du dam chos gyis dang 'chi dus dga'//bya byed mang ba kun gyis khrel ba'i gzhi//658

rtag tu lha chos gyis dang mi yis smon/ /tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong byed pa sangs rgyas rgyu/ /mjug tu bsngo ba gyis dang 'dzad mi 'gyur//mi rtag 'chi ba chos la bskul ba'i grogs//nam 'chi cha med soms dang brtson 'grus 'byung / /dge 'dis skal ldan slob bus mi chos spangs/ /lha chos byas nas myur du 'tshang rgya shog /ces pa 'di yang slob bu rab 'byams pa la smras pa'o//rje dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku/ /pha bla ma chos kyi rgyal po la/ /bdag sgo gsum gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe blo yis thongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /yul dang po nyams dga' skyid skyid po//yul bar du chags sdang rgyun mi 'chad//yul tha ma bdud kyi btson ra yin/ /yul 'dzin na chos sku'i gtan yul zungs/ /grogs dang po lha mo bzhad kha ma//grogs bar du mi mo khro gtum can/ /grogs tha ma bdud mo ang mi khug /grogs 'grogs na chos mthun grogs dang 'grogs/ /bu dang po lha bu 'dzum kha bo/ /bu bar du zas gos nor brlag mkhan/ /bu tha ma gyod sna kha mchu'i gzhi/ /bu gso na rig pa'i khye'u chung gsos/ /nor dang po bdag skyid gzhan smon po/ /nor bar du ser sna phrag dog rgya//nor tha ma dgra bo'i g.yab mo yin/ /nor gsog na 'phags dro'i nor bdun gsogs/ /glu 'di yang tshogs drug 659

rang grol blangs/ /gang thos tshad skyes pas pha yul spangs/ /bu chung ma nor rdzas blos btang nas/ /chos nyams su blangs nas 'tshang rgya shog /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan rgyud/ /smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'dzam gling ri rgyal lho phyogs na/ /yan lag brgyad ldan rdzing bu yod/ /sdig sgrib dri ma 'khrud 'dod na/ /brgyad ldan chu yis khrus gyis ang / /rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs na/ /tsan dan sman gyi sdong bo yod/ /'du ba'i nad rnams sel 'dod na/ /tsan dan sman mchog longs shig ang / /'dod pa'i khams gyi lha gnas na/ /srab 'jam yang ba'i gos bzang yod/ /tsha grang gnyis las skyob 'dod na/ /lha yi gos bzang gyon cig ang / /khrus kyi dzing bu'i rtsa shed na/ /'dod pa 'jo ba'i ba mo yod/ /skom pa'i gdungs pa sel 'dod na/ /ba mo bzhos la thungs shig ang //rnam thos sras kyi mdzod khang na/ /ci za 'dod pa'i longs spyod yod//ltogs pa'i gdungs pa zhi 'dod na//gang mkho longs la zo zhig ang //bsil ldan ljongs 'di'i mdo smad na/ /gom can rgyug bzang rta pho yod/ /thag ring lam la 'gro 'dod na//rta bzang zhon la song zhig ang //bla ma dam pa'i spyan 660

snga na/ /zab rgya'i chos kyi gdams pa yod/ /'khor ba'i gnas las thar 'dod na/ /nyon la nyams su longs shig ang / /dpe drug don bdun glu dbyangs 'di/ /tshogs drug rang grol zhes byas blangs//thos tshad gnas skabs dam chos byas//mthar thug rnam mkhyen thob par shog /pha chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /grogs blo kha chos la myur du sgyur/ /sprang tshogs drug rang grol zhes bya ngas/ /nang sems la phan pa'i glu dbyangs len//khyod tshe lo mthar phyin dad ldan grogs//ming chos skyabs rgyal zhes bya ba nyon//rje bla ma dam par gsol btab na/ /rang ci 'dod dngos grub 'byung ba yin/ /phar grogs la ngan pa ma brjod na//tshur rang la lha bzhin mthong ba yin/ /mi gzhan la bsam pa ma gnag na//rang bsod nams mi 'dzad 'phel ba yin/ /tshe 'di la zhen pa ma che na//tshe phyi mar bde zhing skyid pa yin/ /rgyud zhe sdang nga rgyal ma skyes na/ /gzugs rab mdzes yid 'ong 'thob pa yin/ /sems gnas lugs rgyun du skyong nus na/ /mchog sangs rgyas myur du 'thob pa yin/ /mtshams dam dang smra bcad byas gyur na/ /ma mkha' 'gro'i byen rlabs 'jug pa yin/ /rang ci byed chos dang bstun shes na/ /dpal chos skyong srung mas bsrung ba yin/ /glu 'di 661

yis grogs po la phan nas/ /mchog sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob par shog /ces pa 'di yang dad can grogs po sngags rgan chos skyabs rgyal la smras pa'o//rje dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku/ /pha chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mi rang la rang gis gros 'di 'debs/ /tshig 'di la tshogs drug rang grol nyon/ /khyod gzhon dus dbang bo dar tsa na/ /yar na so rgas snyam mi gda' ste/ /rgas pa kho thog tu rim gyis 'ong / /da ma rgas gong 'dir lha chos sgrubs/ /'byung bzhi yi lus po dar tsa na/ /lus na tsha yongs snyam mi gda' ste/ /na ba kho steng du glo bur 'ong / /da ma na gong 'dir lha chos sgrubs/ /tshe 'di la zhen cing chags tsa na/ /rang 'chi ba 'ong snyam mi gda' ste/ /'chi bdag kho glo bur thog tu 'ong / /da ma shi gong 'dir lha chos sgrubs/ /khyod nges par dam chos mdzad 'dod na/ /zhing bzang bor ci 'byor mchod pa phul/ /rje bla ma rnams la zhabs tog gyis/ /lan re ba med pa'i sbyin pa thongs/ /phan ma nus pa la btags na bzang / /las rgyu 'bras chos la nges shes bskyed/ /rgyud dam pa'i chos dang stun la spyod//chos nyams su len na mang mi dgos/ /de cha bo rgyud la e 'byor ltos/ /glu 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyes/ /mi rang gi rgyud la phan phyir blangs/ /dge 'dis kyang rang gzhan ma lus pa/ /662

yar sangs rgyas go 'phang thob gyur cig /drin can bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rang gzhan blo kha chos la sgyur/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /rang gzhan yongs la gros 'di 'debs/ /lus 'di chu yi lbu ba 'dra/ /yid brtan rung ba ci yang med/ /nor rdzas g.yar ba'i rgyan cha 'dra/ /nam zhig gang zag gzhan gyis 'khyer/ /mdza' bshes lcang kha'i bye'u chung 'dra/ /mthun par 'grogs kyang myur du 'bral/ /gzhon pa sos ga'i me tog 'dra/ /rgas pa ba mo 'dra bas 'joms/ /na ba bye'u chung rdo phog 'dra/ /lus kyi stobs nus zad par 'gyur/ /'chi ba snum zad mar me 'dra/ /rtag par mi sdod nges pa yin/ /skyid sdug lam chen mgron po 'dra/ /da lta med kyang da lta 'byung / /sdig grogs dug gi sdong bo 'dra/ /gang bsten pa rnams brlag pa yin/ /bla ma sman gyi sdong bo 'dra/ /gang bsten pa rnams bde ba yin/ /chos spyod zhing ba'i so nam 'dra/ /gang rem pa rnams rgyal nas gda'/ /'chi bdag ri gzar rbab rdo 'dra/ /bkag pas khog pa dka' mo yin/ /de 'dra'i dus shig byung tsa na/ /dam chos ma gtogs skyabs gzhan med/ /sus thob rgyal ba dam pa'i chos/ /dam pa'i chos la 'bad na legs/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /thos 663

tshad lha chos byed par shog /rje bla ma chos rgyal rin po che/ /dus da nas bzung ste byang chub bar/ /mi bdag gi mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzod//khyod gnyen bshes 'khri ba bcad nas ni/ /rje bla ma dam pa bsten nus na/ /rang 'bad med gdams pa shugs las 'byung / /khyod yul la chags sems spangs nas ni/ /gnas ri khrod dben pa bsten nus na/ /'bad rtsol med dngos grub shugs las 'byung / /khyod nor la chags sems spangs nas ni/ /sems chags med zhen med byed nus na/ /bde chen gyi lam sna shugs las 'byung / /khyod 'khor g.yog 'khri ba bcad nas ni/ /rang gcig pur dben par sdod tshugs na/ /nyams rtogs pa'i yon tan shugs las 'byung/ /khyod tshe 'di blo yis btang nas ni/ /dus rgyun du lha chos sgrub nus na/ /'phral lto rgyab gnyis ka shugs las 'byung / /glu 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /'di thos tshad gnas skabs bde ba dang/ /mthar sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par shog /pha chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /sems skyo ba skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /khyod nyon dang tshogs drug rang grol ba/ /mi skye ba'i dus na sdug bsngal che/ /ma'i mngal du zhugs pa'i dus 664

skabs su/ /dpe nya mo dol la 'thum pa 'dra/ /khrag chu ser nang du nyal tsa na/ /dpe mi gtsang dong nang bcug pa 'dra/ /mas bza' btung mchong rgyug byas pa'i dus/ /sdug nyin re bzhin du sna tshogs myong / /zla dgu dang ngo bcu mngal du lus/ /ma'i mngal nas btsas pa'i dus su yang / /lus 'jur mig 'phrang la drangs pa 'dra/ /ma'i mngal sgo'i phyi ru thon tsa na/ /dpe tsher ma'i dong du lhung ba 'dra/ /mas brtse bas pang du blangs tsa na/ /dpe bye'u phrug khra yis 'khyer ba 'dra/ /mas mi gtsang dri ma phyis tsa na/ /phyi'i pags pa gson por bshus pa 'dra/ /gris lte ba'i thag pa bcad tsa na/ /rang khong ba'i srog rtsa bcad pa 'dra/ /mas 'dzong khug nang du bsnyal tsa na/ /dpe bkyigs nas btson dong bor ba 'dra/ /lar skye ba'i sbug bsngal mi 'byung ba'i/ /yar thar ba'i go 'phang ma thob na/ /mi'i sgye ba'i sdug bsngal bsam las 'das/ /khyod thar ba'i go 'phang 'thob 'dod na/ /da thob thabs dam pa'i lha chos gyis/ /glu 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /gang thos tshad thar 'dod blo skye shog /pha chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /sems skyo ba skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /yang nyon dang tshogs drug rang grol ba/ /mi rgas pa'i dus su sdug bsngal che/ /yar drang bor skyes pa'i lus 665

po sgur/ /yar langs nas 'gro dus gom pa 'khyor/ /mdog nag por skyes pa'i skra lo dkar/ /mig phyis nas bltas kyang rab rib mthong / /sgra nyan byed mgo zur rna ba 'on/ /lus mkhur mgo'i khrag gi tshom bu yal/ /byad brgyangs shing sna gzhom dung so bud/ /gtam smra ba'i rgyal po lce yang ldib/ /zas gnyen 'dun bsdus kyang phar la 'bros/ /rang mi 'dod sdug bsngal spangs kyang 'khor/ /tshig bden par smras kyang nyan mkhan med/ /rang gces par gsos pa'i bu tshas sdang / /gang yod tshad byen la drin gzo med/ /'di shi 'phyis zer zhing dmod mo mang / /lar rgas pa'i sdug bsngal mi 'byung ba'i/ /yar thar ba'i go 'phang ma thob na//mi'i rgas pa'i sdug bsngal bsam las 'das/ /khyod thar ba'i go 'phang 'thob 'dod na/ /da thob thabs dam pa'i lha chos gyes//glu 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /gang thos tshad thar 'dod blo skye shog /pha chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /sems skyo ba skye bar byen gyis rlobs/ /yang nyon dang tshogs drug rang grol ba//mi na ba'i dus su sdug bsngal che/ /lus glo bur nyid la nad kyis btab//sngon med pa'i zug gzer mang bo langs//mal bde mor nyal yang 'gre ldog mang //zas bzang bo zos kyang phyir la zlog /666

gnas bsil sar bsdad kyang me bas tsha/ /gos dron pos g.yogs kyang chu bas grang / /mal bde mor nyal yang tsher las rtsub/ /sngas mtho bar bzhag kyang dong las dma'//gnyen mdza' bshes rnams kyis mthar bskor yang / /rang na ba'i sdug bsngal bgo thabs med/ /thabs mkhas pa'i sman pa mo bon gyis/ /sngon las ngan na tsha sel bar dka'/ /lar na ba'i sdug bsngal mi 'byung ba'i/ /yar thar ba'i go 'phang ma thob na/ /mi'i na ba'i sdug bsngal bsam las 'das/ /khyod thar ba'i go 'phang 'thob 'dod na/ /da thob thabs dam pa'i lha chos gyis/ /glu 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /gang thos tshad thar 'dod blo skye shog /pha chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /sems skyo ba sgye bar byen gyis rlobs/ /yang nyon dang tshogs drug rang grol ba/ /mi 'chi ba'i dus su sdug bsngal che/ /khong 'chi bdag pho nyas zin pa'i tshe/ /mi phyug pos nor gyis blu sa med/ /mi dpa' bos ral kha sprod sa med/ /sman mdzes mas bslu brid byed sa med/ /khong mkhas pas lo rgyus bkrol sa med/ /mi phongs pas zhu ba byed sa med//mi sdar mas wa bros byed sa med//lus yan lag rtsa rnams mtha' nas 'dus/ /dpe bkyigs nas mal du bskyur ba 'dra/ /667

rang phan du re ba'i sman pas bor/ /rang skyob tu re ba'i mo bon bros/ /gzhan gang smras gtam la lan mi thebs/ /dbugs phyi nang 'gyu ba chad la nye/ /lus sngon chad med pa'i dri ma chags/ /drod me stag tsam pa mtha' nas bsdu/ /grogs bzang bo yod kyang 'grogs dbang med/ /zas zhim po yod kyang za dbang med/ /gos bzang bo yod kyang gon dbang med/ /nor mang bo yod kyang 'khyer dbang med/ /rang gces par bskyangs pa'i lus kyang bzhag /tshe phyi ma'i yul du gcig pur 'gro/ /dbugs phyi nang 'gyu ba chad ma thag /kho shi zer lus po sum lteb byas/ /mi la las gza' dang skar ma brtsi/ /gnyen mdza' bshes 'dus nas ngu 'bod byed/ /gzhan la las zas nor e thob snyam/ /rang tshe stod bsags tshad gzhan gyis spyod/ /ro bsreg gam yang na ri la 'phen/ /chu'i nang du 'phen nam dong du sba/ /re med par zin tshe kho thag chod/ /lar 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal mi 'byung ba'i/ /yar thar ba'i go 'phang ma thob na//mi'i 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal bsam las 'das//khyod thar ba'i go 'phang 'thob 'dod na/ /da thob thabs dam pa'i lha chos gyes/ /glu 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /gang thos tshad thar 'dod blo skye shog /pha chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /sems skyo ba skye bar 668

byin gyis rlobs/ /yang nyon dang tshogs drug rang grol ba/ /lha min la 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal che/ /lha'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa la/ /kho phrag dog skyes nas lha dang 'thab/ /lha rnams kyis mtshon cha'i 'khor lo yis/ /gnod 'ba' zhig bskyal bas lus rmas shing / /yan lag dang nying lag 'bral ba dang / /rgyob sod sogs mi snyan sgra mang sgog /de thos pas 'jigs skrag dngangs shing 'dar/ /kho la la bzung nas gson sreg byed/ /la la ni chur bskyur mgo bo gcod/ /don snying 'don nang khrol rlugs pa sogs/ /sdug lan gcig ma yin yang yang myong / /lar lha min 'thab rtsod sdug med pa'i//yar thar ba'i go 'phang ma thob na/ /lha min gyi sdug bsngal bsam las 'das/ /khyod thar ba'i go 'phang 'thob 'dod na//da thob thabs dam pa'i lha chos gyis/ /glu 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /gang thos tshad thar 'dod blo skye shog /pha chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /sems skyo ba skye bar byen gyes rlobs/ /yang nyon dang tshogs drug rang grol ba/ /lha rnams la 'pho ltung sdug bsngal che/ /'dod lha rnams 'chi la nye ba'i tshe/ /lus mdangs nyams stan la 'dug mi 'dod/ /me tog gi phreng ba rnying ba dang / /gos steng du sngon med dri ma chags/ /669

lus sngon med rdul 'byung 'od chung 'gro/ /lus khrus chu chags dang gos rgyan las/ /sgra mi snyan pa byung dzi ma 'khrab/ /yul gcig la chags pas 'chi ltas 'byung / /de byung tshe 'chi ltas yin par go /sems sdug bsngal myong dang khyad par du/ /rang gang du skye gnas brtags na shes/ /mar dmyal ba lta bur skye ba na/ /der skyes dang khyad med sdug bsngal ni/ /lha'i zhag po lnga sogs myong ba yin/ /gzhan stobs chen lha yis stobs chung lha/ /rang gnas nas gzhan du sgrod pa dang / /lha min la 'thab pa'i dus su yang / /mtshon phog nas sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong / /gzugs khams dang gzugs med khams gnyis na/ /mngon gyur kyi sdug bsngal med na yang / /sngon las kyi 'phen pa zad pa'i tshe/ /slar 'og tu ltung ba'i sdug bsngal yod/ /yar lha yi 'pho ltung sdug med pa'i/ /yar thar ba'i go 'phang ma thob na/ /lha'i 'pho ltung sdug bsngal bsam las 'das/ /khyod thar ba'i go 'phang 'thob 'dod na/ /da thob thabs dam pa'i lha chos gyes/ /glu 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /gang thos tshad thar 'dod blo skye shog /pha chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /sems skyo ba skye bar byin gyes rlobs//yang nyon dang tshogs drug rang grol ba/ /mar 670

dmyal ba'i gnas na sdug bsngal che/ /mtshon rnon pos phan tshun gshag res byed/ /thig nag po btab nas sog les 'dra/ /ri lug gdong 'dra ba'i bar du gcur/ /lcags khang ba me 'bar nang du bsreg /lcags khang ba nyis rim me 'bar bsreg /lcags zangs chen tsha ngar nang du bsreg /lcags zangs chen khro chu khol mar btso/ /me chen po 'bar bas lus kun 'tshig /lus grang bas chu bur byung zhing 'khum/ /la la ni grang bas chu bur rdol/ /la la ni grang bas kye hud zer/ /la la ni grang bas a chu zer/ /la la ni grang bas so tham tham/ /la la'i lus kha rlung chen pos btab/ /mdog sngo zhing ser kha lnga drug gas/ /la la'i mdog dmar zhing kha bcur gas/ /la la'i lus kha dog shin tu dmar/ /kha brgya tsam gas nas sdug bsngal myong / /lar dmyal ba'i tsha grang sdug med pa'i//yar thar ba'i go 'phang ma thob na//mar dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal bsam las 'das/ /khyed thar ba'i go 'phang 'thob 'dod na/ /da thob thabs dam pa'i lha chos gyis/ /glu 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /gang thos tshad thar 'dod blo skye shog /pha chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /sems skyo ba skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /yang nyon dang tshogs drug rang grol ba/ /yi 671

dwags la bkres skom sdug bsngal che/ /sha khrag skam mdog nag gdong skras khebs/ /kha shin tu bskams pa lce yis ldag /phyi'i sgrib pa can gyi yi dwags kyis/ /mtsho mtshe'u chu mig mthong na yang / /mtshon thogs pas bsrungs nas btung mi ster/ /nang sgrib pa can gyi yi dwags kyis/ /kha khab mig mgrin pa rta rnga tsam/ /rkang lag rnams 'jag skya lto ba'i tshad/ /lung phran tsam yod la zas mi rnyed/ /rnyed na yang kha ru mi shong zhing / /cung zad tsam song yang mgrin mi thar/ /thar na yang lto ba khengs mi 'gyur/ /zas skom gyi sgrib pa can rnams kyis/ /zas skom gang sbyad na me 'bar 'tshig /de dag la dgun dus nyi ma grang / /dpyid dus su zla ba'ang tsha ba yin/ /lar yi dwags bkres skom sdug med pa'i/ /yar thar ba'i go 'phang ma thob na/ /yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal bsam las 'das/ /khyod thar ba'i go 'phang 'thob 'dod na/ /da thob thabs dam pa'i lha chos gyis/ /glu 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /gang thos tshad thar 'dod blo skye sho ga /pha chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /sems skyo ba skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /yang nyon dang tshogs drug rang grol ba/ /dud 'gro la bkol spyod sdug bsngal che/ /dbus ri rab chu mtshams 672

man chad kyi/ /khong gseng na chang gi sbang ma bzhin/ /dud 'gro'i rigs mang bo 'dus nas yod/ /de che bas chung ba khyur mid byed//chung chung kun 'dus nas che ba za/ /mi'i yul gyi dud 'gro thams cad ni/ /ri dwags rnams rngon pa khye yis gsod/ /mi'i dbang du gyur rnams sna phug cing / /khal mi theg bzhin du bkal nas brdung / /'phongs rgyab rnams sgal bas khengs na yang / /nyin gcig tsam sos dal 'dug dbang med/ /phyugs la la sha dang pags pa'i ched/ /sar bsgyel nas gsod grabs byed pa'i tshe/ /skrag dngangs nas mig gis trig hrig blta/ /kha bsum mam lto ba phral nas gsod/ /gzhan dbang bo gcod dang spu 'breg dang / /rmo bcing dang zho bzho bkres skom dang / /tsha grang sogs sdug bsngal dpag med yod/ /lar dud 'gro'i bkol spyod sdug med pa'i/ /yar thar ba'i go 'phang ma thob na/ /dud 'gro yi sdug bsngal bsam las 'das/ /khyod thar ba'i go 'phang 'thob 'dod na/ /da thob thabs dam pa'i lha chos gyes/ /glu 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /gang thos tshad thar 'dod blo skye shog /mgon po 'od dpag med pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan kun/ /bde ba can gyi zhing khams su/ /myur du skye 673

bar byin gyis rlobs/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob 'dod pas/ /sangs rgyas zhing khams rnam dag tu/ /skye ba'i smon lam btab na bzang / /zhing khams bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /yod kyang bde ba can ma gtogs/ /zhing khams gzhan du tha mal ba'i/ /gang zag nyon mongs can rnams ni/ /smon lam btab kyang skye bar dka'/ /bde ba can gyi zhing khams su//tha mal nyon mongs dang bcas pa'i//gang zag su zhig yin na yang / /smon lam btab na skye bar gsungs/ /mtshams med lnga dang chos spangs pa/ /ma gtogs sgrib pa gzhan yod kyang / /mi sgrib zhing der skye bar gsungs/ /skyes na 'khor bar phyir mi ldog /sdug bsngal sgra yang mi grags shing / /nyon mongs sgrib pas gos mi 'gyur/ /ci bsam 'dod pa'i don thams cad/ /bsam ma thag nas 'grub par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas zhing khams gzhan gang la/ /lta zhing mjal du song na chog /bde skyid dpal la spyod bzhin du/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas thob na drin can gye/ /pha ma gtso byas 'gro ba kun/ /bde ba can du drangs na chog /zhing khams gzhan las khyad par du/ /'phags pa bde ba can zhing yin/ /bde ba can du skye 'dod pa'i/ /dad can skye bo pho mo tsho/ /dge rtsa ji snyed bsags pa rnams/ /zhing der skye ba'i ched 674

du sngos/ /yid gnyis the tshom ma byed par/ /zhing gi bkod pa yon tan rnams//dran bzhin smon lam yang yang thobs/ /'od dpag med mgon byin rlabs dang / /'dis mtshon bdag gi dge ba'i mthus/ /bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus pa//bde ba can du skye bar shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//yun ring tshogs gnyis bsags mthus rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'gro drug 'dren mdzad dus gsum sangs rgyas dang / /dbyer med rang don mthar phyin 'gro ba gzhan/ /smin grol 'god mdzad rje btsun bla mas dgongs/ /khyod gsung bdud rtsi bdag gis cung zad cig /myangs pa skal ba bzang snyam shin tu spro/ /da dung brtse bas lta sgom spyod 'bras bzhi'i/ /don zab go sla tshig nyung mgur du gsungs/ /de las 'ongs pa'i rab dkar dge ba dang / /sngon chad bsags dang phyin chad gsog 'gyur kun/ /gcig tu bsdus nas 'gro mgon khyod la 'bul/ /'khrul sked lta ba rtogs par byen gyes rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di ni slob bu ngag dbang chos 'phel gyis smras pas lan du/chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /slob bu'i sgo gsum byen gyis rlobs/ /tshogs drug rang grol glu dbyangs la//slob bu ngag dbang chos 'phel nyon/ /snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams 670

kun/ /thams cad rang gi sems su rtogs/ /rang sems don dam chos kyi skur/ /rtogs na 'khor ba ngan pa ru/ /ltung ngo snyam pa'i dogs pa de/ /med par gyur te ci'i phyir na/ /'khor ba rang snang rmi lam bzhin/ /bden med stong bar rtogs phyir ro/ /myang 'das bzang bo thob re ba'i/ /re ba med de ci'i phyir na/ /myang 'das rang du rtogs phyir ro/ /rang sems don dam chos kyi sku/ /shel dkar me long lta bu la/ /snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams kun/ /rang rang sa nas zur ma nyams/ /mdog ma 'gyur bar gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /so sor ma 'dres gsal na yang / /thams cad bden par ma grub tshul/ /rtogs na gang zag su yin yang / /gtan du bde zhing skyid par nges/ /de ltar rtogs na de'i shugs kyis/ /ma rtogs 'gro la snying rje skye//'di ni zab lam rdzogs chen gyi//lta ba rtogs pa'i khyad chos yin/ /stong nyid snying rje gnyis 'dzoms na/ /sems can re re'i phyir du yang / /mnar med dmyal ba'i me nang du/ /tsham tshom med par 'jug par nus/ /zhugs nas bskal pa'i bar gnas kyang / /lus sems thog tu sdug mi 'byung / /nam yang skyo ba skye mi 'gyur/ /de phyir skal ldan snying gi bu/ /'khor 'das sems su thag bcad nas/ /rang sems stong gsal chos kyi sku//nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang nyid 676

du/ /mnyam par 'jog pa lta ba yin/ /sems las gzhan pa'i lta ba zhig /btsal na dbul bos gter bzhag nas/ /gzhan gyi sgo ru sprang ba 'dra/ /bsgom pa stong gsal sgom med las/ /gzhan pa'i bsgom zhig btsal ba na//mar me rlung gis bskyod pa 'dra/ /spyod pa blang dor med pa las/ /gzhan pa'i spyod rgyu zhig btsal na/ /sbrang ma rgya ru tshud pa 'dra/ /'bras bu rang sems chos sku las/ /gzhan pa'i 'bras bu zhig btsal na/ /glang bo bzhag nas rjes 'tshol 'dra/ /de phyir ngag dbang chos 'phel khyod/ /myur du sangs rgyas 'thob 'dod na/ /dben pa'i gnas su drang srong bzhin/ /gcig pur gnas la dus kun tu/ /rang sems chos sku skyong bar mdzod/ /glu 'di mthong thos dran reg kun/ /rang sems chos sku skyong bar shog /ces smras so//dpe 'od dkar 'gyed nas gling bzhi la/ /mun 'thibs pa zla bas sel ba bzhin/ /gsung legs bshad chos kyis 'gro ba yi/ /blo'i rmongs pa sel mkhan bla mar 'dud/ /dpe srin bya dgod pa ltas ngan pa/ /gtong 'dod kyis dga' nas min pa bzhin/ /mi g.yo can snyan tshig smra ba de/ /kho'i rang don yin gyis gus phyir min/ /dpe nya bdas zas kyis kha 'khrid nas/ /nya lcags kyus bzung nas gsod pa bzhin/ /mi ngan pas thog mar 677

tshig gis brid/ /bag phebs su bcug nas bslu ba yin/ /dpe dug gi tsher ma ma smin par/ /gzhan rkang lag 'big par mi nus bzhin/ /mi dman pa ji srid nyam chung ba/ /de'i bar la rang bzhin bzang ba yin/ /dpe gzig lpags bkab pa'i bong bu yis/ /gzhan lo tog zos mthar bsad pa bzhin/ /mi ha cang g.yo sgyu che drags na/ /de re zhig grub kyang tha mar brlag /dpe rkun po 'ga' yis khyer btags pa'i/ /ra bskyur nas bram ze song ba bzhin/ /mi shes rab can gyes mngon sum du/ /rdzun bshad pas pha rol bslu bar nus/ /dpe lha chen smre sngags shor ba la/ /sdug bsngal ba bden par bsgrags pa bzhin/ /rang nyes pa mngon sum byed bzhin du/ /mi g.yo can tshig gis pha rol bslu/ /dpe rma bya gzugs mdzes sgra snyan yang / /de'i kha zas dug can yin pa bzhin/ /mi g.yo can tshul gzob ngag 'jam pa/ /de ma brtags bar du yid mi brtan/ /dpe ri dwags rnga ma bstan nas ni/ /gzhan khrel bdas bong bu'i sha 'tshong bzhin/ /mi g.yo can bzang bo'i tshul bzung nas/ /phyis don la bslu ba mang ba yin/ /dpe gañtsa'i yul gye rgyal phran 'gas/ /pha bsad la rgyal rnga rdung ba bzhin/ /khrel ngo tsha gting nas nyams pa rnams/ /rang gtam ngan ngo sor 'khyer ba yin/ /dpe skya ga'i 678

phru gus ma yi spu/ /de 'thog pa drin lan yin bsgom bzhin/ /mi shes chung rnams kyis phan btags pa/ /de 'ga' zhig gnod pa chen por 'gyur/ /dpe khyi rgan ya rkan phug pa'i khrag /de rus pa'i bcud snyam 'cha' ba bzhin/ /mi blo ngan las la spyod pa la/ /rang 'bad pas thob par sems pa yin/ /dpe spyon pas mgo yi rgyan blangs nas/ /smad rkang mgo sogs la 'dogs pa bzhin/ /mi blun po la las gnyen bcom nas/ /gzhan 'brel med mi rnams gso ba yin/ /dpe chu mig ngan pa dbyar 'bab kyi/ /dpyid dgos pa'i tshe na bskam pa bzhin/ /mi blun po dgos pa'i sar mi phyin/ /'gro mi dgos sa la mi thub 'chor/ /dpe mda' yis pha rol gsod pa 'am/ /yang min na rang nyid chag pa bzhin/ /mi blun po ha cang drang bo yis/ /gzhan brlag gam yang na rang nyid brlag /dpe 'od gsal nyi mas gling rnams kyi/ /mun mi sel ba na gzas zin bzhin/ /khong rgyal pos chos bzhin sa skyong ste/ /de min na rgyal po nyams pa'i rtags/ /dpe gcan gzan gdug po'i nags khrod du/ /mi bsam shes rtag tu mi sdod bzhin//grogs chung ma mdza' bo ngan pa dang / /rgyal ngan pa su zhig bsten par nus/ /dpe sol ba 'bad pas bkrus na yang / /mdog dkar bo 'ong ba mi srid bzhin/ /mi ngan pa ji 679

ltar bcos na yang / /de rang bzhin bzang bo 'byung mi srid/ /dpe sbrul gyis gtses pa'i sa phyogs su/ /gser nyag rdo mthong yang 'bros pa bzhin/ /gzhan skye bo ngan pas sun phyung ba'i//sa de ru dam pa mthong yang spong / /dpe 'o ma skyes bu'i bdud rtsi ste/ /de sbrul la byen na dug 'phel bzhin/ /khong dam pa mchod pa'i zhing du bzang / /mi ngan pa mchod na nyes pa'i gzhi/ /dpe char ba yang yang babs gyur na/ /ri brag la ser ka 'byung ba bzhin/ /dus rtag tu 'byed la brtson pa'i mis/ /gzhan mdza' bo brtan po'ang 'byed par 'gyur/ /dpe so nam brtson pa'i zhing gseb tu/ /ldum skye ba'i go skabs dka' ba bzhin/ /tshur rang don 'ba' zhig bsgrub pa yi/ /mi de dang 'grogs par su yis nus/ /dpe 'bad kyang 'bras bu mi smin pa'i/ /mi de la grogs byed ga la srid/ /dpe skam pas rtag tu bzung na yang / /lcags gong gis tshur la mi 'dzin bzhin/ /mi ngan par mang bo phar byin yang / /tshur rang la dgos na ga la ster/ /dpe shin tu gsal ba'i mig gis kyang / /sgra gang la'ang nyan par mi nus bzhin/ /mi shes rab phyogs gcig ldan pa yis/ /gzhan bya ba kun la mkhas pa dka'/ /dpe lam drang 'ga' zhig nor 'jigs la/ /dung g.yas 'khyel bkra shis byed pa bzhin/ /680

gtam drang bo smra ba'i skyon bcas dang / /'khyog smra ba yon tan ldan pa srid/ /dpe sman pa mkhas pa'i sman bzang de/ /mi nad can 'thungs na bde ster bzhin/ /khong mkhas pa gong ma'i legs bshad bzhin/ /glu 'di blangs kun la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o// dpe seng ge dkar mo'i ngar skad kyis/ /gzhan ri dwags zil gyis gnon pa bzhin/ /gsung 'chad rtsod rtsom pas log smra'i rigs/ /kun zil gyis gnon pa'i bla mar 'dud/ /dpe srog gi dbang bos ma bzung na/ /ro bzang yang su yis mi len bzhin/ /khong rgyal po nyid kyis ma brtsis na/ /kun shes kyang gzhan gyes bkur mi 'gyur/ /dpe mda' drang mkhas pas 'phangs gyur na/ /phar gang la gtad sar phog pa bzhin/ /khong blon po blo ldan drang bo yis/ /rje 'bangs kyi don kun 'grub par 'gyur/ /dpe srog chags grog ma'i tshogs 'dus nas/ /seng phru gu bsad ces grags pa bzhin/ /mi mang bo gcig tu blo mthun na/ /nyam chung yang don chen 'grub par srid/ /dpe glang bo shin tu stobs ldan yang / /de glang dzis bran du 'khol ba bzhin/ /sems zhum bcas rtsol rab dor ba'i mi/ /mthu stobs dang ldan rung gzhan dbang 'gyur/ /dpe rin chen 681

tshig gis bsgrag mi dgos/ /gzhan 'ching bu bsgrags kyang mi nyo bzhin/ /khong chen pos nga rgyal bya ci dgos/ /mi ngan pas nga rgyal byas ci phan/ /dpe bur shing zhim yang dus rgyun du/ /bsten che na phal cher 'dor ba bzhin/ /khong mkhas pa yon tan ldan pa dang / /bsten drags na phal cher skyo ba skye/ /dpe tsan dan bsil ba yin mod kyang / /de gtsub par gyur na 'bar ba bzhin/ /mi rang bzhin bzang bo rnams la yang / /dus rgyun du gces na gnod sems skye/ /dpe mkha' na lha gnas mang na yang / /'od gsal ba nyi zla gnyis yin bzhin/ /sa'i steng na rgyal po mang mod kyi/ /chos bzhin du skyong ba shin tu nyung / /dpe rgya mtsho'i nor bu rin gyes nyo/ /khong zug rngu sman gyes phyir 'don bzhin/ /phan byed na dgra bo yin yang bsten/ /gnyen yin yang gnod na spang bar byed//dpe chu yis yongs su gang ba'i tshe/ /sprin g.yo zhing 'brug sgra sgog pa bzhin//tshur nang du cung zad 'byor gyur na/ /phyi dregs pa'i rnam 'gyur ston pa yin/ /dpe kha zas ma zhu dug du 'gyur/ /dug sbyor ba shes na sman 'gyur bzhin/ /dang po nas dgra dang mdza' bo gnyis/ /'di yin zhes thag chod nges pa med/ /dpe phal cher na ba sman za yang / /mi la la gson por lceb pa bzhin/ /khong mkhas pas 682

rig pa yon gyes blu/ /mi blun por rig pa bslabs kyang spong / /dpe pags bye'u mkhas kyang spu sked pas/ /gzhan 'dab chags kun gyis spang ba bzhin//tshur nang na yon tan kun ldan yang / /phyi'i cha lugs ngan na kun gyis brnyas/ /dpe ma la ya nas byung gyur na/ /de'i sdong dum phal la'ang rin che bzhin/ /mi gang la nor yod smras pa'ang mdzes/ /nor med na bden par smras kyang spong / /dpe ne tsos smras pas gzeb tu bcug /gzhan 'dab chags lkugs pa bder rgyu bzhin/ /khas smra mang nyes pa 'dzin pa'i rgyu/ /gtam mi smra nyes pa spong ba'i gzhi/ /dpe ba yi 'o ma zad pa na/ /be'u yang mi 'khri 'gro ba bzhin/ /nor sbyin pas bsdus na dgra yang 'du/ /sbyin med na gnyen rnams yin yang spong / /dpe padma'i mtsho la ngang ba'i tshogs//ma bsdus kyang ngang gis 'du ba bzhin/ /dus rtag tu byams pas skyong ba yi//rje dpon gyis bran g.yog rnyed par sla//dpe ljon shing che la brten pa yi/ /'khri shing de rtse mor phyin pa bzhin/ /khong chen po rnams la brten bcas na/ /dman skye bo rnams kyang chen po 'thob/ /dpe char gyis mkhar la gnod mod kyang / /khong 'jig rten pa rnams dga' bskyed bzhin/ /khong yon tan ldan la skyon yod kyang / /yon tan la dga' bas bsten na bzang / /dpe rta 683

mchog 'gros dang mi ldan na/ /rtar bltas na legs rung rin chung bzhin/ /nang yon tan med na cha lugs kyis/ /khong mkhas pa dga' ba bskyed mi nus/ /dpe rna ba thog mar skyes na yang / /phyis skyes pa'i rwa rtser mi mnyam bzhin/ /mi blo ldan nor gyis 'byor na yang / /le lo che mthon po 'ong ba dka'/ /dpe dgra ngan dpung tshogs bcu gnyis po/ /de skyabs seng bu yis bcom pa bzhin/ /blo brtson 'grus gnyis ka yod gyur na/ /des bslab par mi nus gang yang med/ /dpe tshong bas rgya mtshor ma rnyed pa'i/ /nor rgyal po'i mdzod na mod pa bzhin/ /rang 'bad pas bya ba bsgrubs na yang / /de 'grub pa bsod nams shugs la rag /dpe khye rgan 'dzum na dga' rtags te/ /gshin rje de 'dzum na gsod rtags bzhin/ /mi blun po'i byams sdang rtags kyis go /khog grim pos byams sdang logs par ston//dpe dbang phyug chen po'i spyi bo'i rgyan/ /zla ba de lha min zas byed bzhin/ /khong chen po rnams kyis mchod bya ba/ /dman skye bo rnams kyis brnyas par 'gyur/ /dpe nyi ma'i 'od zer shar ba na/ /gzhan 'od zer thams cad brlag pa bzhin/ /khong skye bo phal cher rang nyid dang / /rigs mthun pas gnod pa byed pa mang / /dpe nyi mas rgyun du 'od 'byen te//bco lnga yi zla ba mar 'grib bzhin/ /684

khong bsod nams can la 'byor ba rtag /mi bsod nams med la rtag mi 'gyur/ /dpe rgod kyis 'phyi ba 'khur ba dang / /sram rnams kyis 'ug pa mchod pa bzhin/ /spyir sems can gang dang gang 'brel ba/ /de bya ba sngon gyi las kyis byed//dpe mkha' las g.yu 'brug grags pa na/ /sa'i rma bya dga' bas gar byed bzhin/ /glu 'di nyid thos tshad thams cad kyi/ /lus sems la dga' bde rgyas par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /'phral phugs bde ba'i dge legs stsol//gzhung ngan gzhan gyi bka' drin las//byung ba rang mthu yin par bsgom/ /ngo tsha med pas gzhan nor blangs/ /rang gi che ba bsgrub pa yod/ /skyes bu dam pa zhi ba la/ /ngan pa rnams kyis sdang bar 'gyur//bkyed na mi dros btud na 'tshig /rgyal po la la me chen 'dra/ /ha cang rlom sems che drags na/ /sdug bsngal rgyun mar thog tu 'bab//gzhung ngan nor la gces 'dzin pa/ /mdza' bshes yin yang yid mi brtan/ /rma gzhan mkhas na 'tsho srid kyi//nyes pa'i tshig rmar 'tsho dus med//gzu lum dag gi spyod pa yis/ /skye bo myur du rgud par 'gyur/ /kun gyi dpon du bskos gyur na/ /de yi bya ba shes pa dkon/ /chung yang rtsol ba cher bskyed na/ /chen po rnams kyang zil gyis 685

gnon/ /rang dbang thams cad bde ba ste//gzhan dbang thams cad sdug bsngal yin/ /blo dang rig pa mkhas par 'go /nor dang skye bo rgyal pos bsdu/ /blo ngan rigs ngan mdza' bo ngan/ /dgos tshe 'byung ba'i nges pa med/ /rtsod pa chen po byas pa'i mtha'/ /'dum nas mdza' bar 'gyur ba mang / /ser sna can nor phrag dog can/ /grogs kyi dga' ba bskyed mi nus/ /bya ba 'ga' rer mkhas na yang / /gzhan dag shes pa'i nges pa med/ /gang la yon tan gang yod pa/ /de yi grags pa de 'dra 'thob/ /skyes pa bud med rigs gcig kyang / /mchog dang dman pa'i khyad par yod/ /bsod nams ldan pa'i tshig tsam yang / /nyam chung rnams kyis bzod par dka'/ /nor gye mchog ni sbyin pa ste/ /bde ba'i mchog ni sems skyid yin//mi bslu ba yi grogs po bzang / /mdzes pa'i rgyan du thos pa bzang //bde sdug gnyis ka mi rtag par/ /dbyar dgun bzhin du brje bar 'gyur/ /nyam chung rnams kyis chen po'i ming / /bzung ba tsam gyes gzhan gyis bsrung / /phyug pos mchod sbyin btang ba na/ /'byor ba rgyas shing brtan par 'gyur/ /yul bzang yod bzhin yul ngan la/ /skye bo ngan pa chags nas 'dug /yon tan can la 'jig rten gus/ /yon tan 'bad pas bsgrubs na yong //chos lugs shes kyang mi 686

bsgrub na/ /de yi chos kyis ci zhig bya/ /las kyis mnar ba'i sems can la/ /longs spyod yod kyang spyod mi nus/ /rigs gzugs lang tsho ldan na yang //yon tan med na mdzes pa min/ /nyos pa'i bu dang g.yar ba'i rgyan//yod kyang gzhan gyis brtsi ba med/ /dgra bo'i nus pa ma brtags par/ /nyam chung na yang brnyas mi bya/ /bya ba brgya phrag 'go rtsom pas/ /mthar phyin bya ba gcig kyang med/ /las kyi shugs kyis khrid pa na/ /blo chen log pa'i lam du 'gro//mi gang khrims las 'da' ba rnams/ /re zhig rgyal yang pham par 'gyur/ /legs nyes mi dpyod gzhan la gnod/ /byas na phyi nas 'gyod pa skye/ /rtsol ba med pa'i skye bo yis/ /'di phyi gnyis ka 'grub mi 'gyur/ /bya ba ngan dang mi 'grub pa'i//las la 'jug pa'i skye bo blun//nor rnams bsags nas mi spyod na/ /rang sreg bud shing bsags pa yin/ /rig pas rnyed pa'i zas nor blangs/ /mi 'os gzhan la brnab sems spang / /chen po rnams kyis rtsed mo dang / /bde dang zas la chags pa spang / /rje bo 'bangs la mi gnod par/ /byams pas bskyangs na 'khor 'bangs rgyas/ /gang zhig nor 'dod skye bo yis/ /chos dang mthun par bsgrubs na bzang/ /gnyen la ha cang byams mi bya/ /dgra la ha cang gnod mi bya/ /'jam po byas 687

na don kun 'grub/ /de phyir gang la'ang 'jam pa bzang /'ga' re rang la mi byams kyang / /'di ngar mi byams zhes ma sgogs/ /mchod dang brnyas pa'i khyad mi shes/ /de 'dra'i gnas su sdod mi bya/ /yul gzhan legs par ma brtags par/ /snga ma'i gnas de 'dor mi bya/ /pha rol gnad du 'bebs pa'i tshig /dgra bo la yang smra mi bya/ /dgra bo byams kyang bsten mi bya/ /bya ba che chung gang byed kyang / /mkhas pas rtag tu bsgrims te bya/ /rang las mtho ba'i dam pa la/ /brten na rang la phan pa 'byung / /'gyur ldog che ba'i grogs po dang / /'grogs na nyon mongs khong khro skye/ /dus su ma bab pa yi gtam/ /gang smra mi der kun gyis 'phya/ /dngos po chen po thob pa'i dus/ /phran tshegs gzhan la ser sna spongs/ /longs spyod chen po gsog 'dod na/ /cha shas sbyin pa man ngag yin//gzhung bzang ngo tsha khrel yod na//dgra bo la yang yid rton rung / /tshur la dgra bos skyabs 'ongs na/ /de la mchod na snyan pa brjod/ /grogs ngan thos pa ngan pa dang / /bya ba ngan pa byas na 'phung / /rang gzhan gnyis ka 'tshengs pa yi/ /yon tan slob pa mkhas pas bsten/ /phar la gnod na tshur la yang //gnod pa che thub chung thub byed//phan pa byas na su yin yang / /dngos sam brgyud nas phan 'dogs 688

byed/ /phongs kyang gdung ba bskyed mi bya//las kyi 'phen pa rgyang ring bas/ /skyid sdug sna tshogs da gdod 'byung / /'di nyid thos tshad ma lus pa/ /'phral phugs dge legs gong 'phel shog /ces pa 'di yang sa skya'i legs bshad ltar skye bo pho mo yongs kyis go ba'i phyir tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//pha bla ma spyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs/ /bu bdag gzhan yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /nga bya btang rnal 'byor glu dbyangs la/ /khyod dad can rab byung rab 'byor nyon/ /mi gzhan gyis rang la gshe na yang / /slar lan du mi gshe ba dang gcig /mi gzhan dag rang la khro na yang / /slar lan du mi khro ba dang gnyis/ /mi gzhan gyis rang la brdegs na yang / /slar lan du mi brdeg pa dang gsum/ /mi gzhan gyis rang la mtshang brus kyang / /slar lan du mtshang mi 'bru dang bzhi/ /'di dge sbyor chos bzhi yin par gsungs/ /gzhan gshe khro brdeg mtshang 'bru ba'i tshe/ /slar lan mi byed na dge sbyong yin/ /lan byed na dge sbyong ma yin pas/ /'di'i steng nas dge sbyong yin min shes/ /'di bzhi la nam yang mi 'dzem par/ /nga dge sbyong yin zhes ma smra zhig /ming don mthun dge sbyong byed 'dod na/ /sngar bshad pa ltar du khyod rang gyis/ /glu 'di yis kun la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang slob bu rab 'byor gyis bskul ngor tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//689

rgya bod mkhas grub yongs la 'dud//'gro la legs tshogs ma lus stsol/ /myur du 'chi ba mi shes par/ /rtag par 'dzin rnams shin tu glen/ /nam 'chi nges pa med snyam nas/ /lha chos byed rnams mkhas pa yin/ /'di dang phyi ma gnyis ka la/ /bde ba'i thabs ni shes rab yin/ /shes rab can gyi gang zag de/ /'di phyi gang de'ang bde zhing skyid/ /sbyin pa gtong ba'i skye bo yis/ /snyan pa rgyun mi 'chad pa thos/ /ser sna che ba'i phyug po yis/ /dngos sam brgyud nas mi snyan thos/ /pha ma gnyis la byams gyur na/ /bu yi tshe bsod rgyas pa yin/ /byams pa'i gnyen la sdang ba na/ /sdang ba'i dgra ru 'gyur nyen yod/ /sdang ba'i dgra la byams byas na/ /byams pa'i gnyen du 'gro ba mang / /sdig pa dang ni mthu rtsal las/ /byung ba'i longs spyod longs spyod min/ /blun po rnams kyis mkhas pa yang / /mchod par 'gyur ba'i nges pa med/ /blun pos yon tan kha ru 'byin/ /mkhas pas yon tan khog tu sbed/ /skye bo ngan pas dam pa la/ /khyad gsod byed kyis dam pas min/ /skye bo ngan pa dar lbog bzhin/ /cung zad tsam la 'gyur ldog byed/ /ri rab cis kyang mi 'gul ba/ /bzhin du skye bo bzang bo brtan/ /nor rdzas rtswa kha'i zil ba 'dra/ /yod dus gzhan la gang mkho byed/ /phan pa byas 690

pa'i skye bo de/ /kun gyis mthong na dga' zhing gus//bza' tshang tshong 'dus mgron po 'dra/ /'khon 'dzing byed na blun po yin/ /dga' zhing spro bzhin las rnams byed/ /mthun par 'grogs pa'i khyim tshang skyid/ /lha chos byed pa'i dus skabs su/ /mar bshol byed pa'i khyem tshang dgra/ /gzhon dus lha chos byas pa'i mi/ /rgas dus skyid nyal byas kyang chog /mna' ma mnar ba'i a ne de/ /rgas na mna' mas lham bzhin brnyas/ /rgan rgon ha cang kha ngan na/ /shi na kun gyis tshad red zer/ /mtshan ldan bla ma bzang bo dang / /sha tsha'i grogs dang 'grogs na bde/ /mang bo smras las gnad 'gag gi /tshig gcig smras na don chen 'grub//jag rkun byed mi phal che ba//tha ma gri ru 'chi ba mang / /rgyal ba'i gsung las mo ba'i rdzun/ /nyan nas ngag bzhin byed pa mang / /rgyal po'i bka' las blon po'i tshig /'khor 'bangs phal gyes brtsi ba mang / /pha ma'i tshig las chung ma'i kha/ /bu ngan phal cher rgyug pa mang //rgyal po dran rgyu che ba de/ /rgyal srid nyams pa'i snga ltas yin/ /longs spyod yod bzhin spyod mi nus/ /de las dbul bo gzhan na med/ /rgyal po 'khor gyes ma bkur na/ /gzhan gyi mis kyang bkur mi 'gyur//bsten pa'i mi rnams dgrar gyur na//skye bo ngan pa'i khyad chos yin//gang yin gnyen du 'gyur ba de//691

skye bo bzang bo'i rtags shig yin/ /rdzun dang g.yo sgyu mi shes par//gang bcol go chod bran gyi rab/ /kha nyung lag pa gtsang ba dang / /khog pa yangs pa'i bud med bzang / /skye bo kun dang mthun pa dang / /chos dang mthun pa shin tu legs//glu 'di thos tshad mi rnams kyis/ /legs nyes blang dor shes par shog /cesapa 'di yang dam pa gong ma'i gsung bzhin bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//sngon dus gangs can bod yul du/ /mkha' la skar tshogs bkra ba bzhin/ /mkhas grub dpag med byon tshad la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byen gyes rlobs/ /rang gi tshe rabs thog med nas/ /mar gyur 'gro kun yal bar dor/ /rang nyid rgyun du gces par bzung / /rang don kho nar 'bad 'bad kyang / /rang don cung zad tsam ma 'grub/ /mi 'dod sdug bsngal sna tshogs myangs/ /des na rang nyid gces 'dzin de/ /rgud pa kun gyi gnas su 'dug /rang nyid gces 'dzin ma skyes pa/ /mi bskyed pa dang skyes pa rnams/ /dgra ru ltos la spong bar gyis/ /sangs rgyas rang nyid yal bar dor/ /sems can thams cad gces par bzung / /gzhan don 'ba' zhig sngon mdzad pas/ /mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas 'dug /rang yang de ltar byas na sngar/ /'tshang rgya ba la ma byas lan/ /des na gzhan rnams gces 'dzin 692

pa//yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas su//'dug pas gzhan rnams gces 'dzin blo/ /ma skyes bskyed dang skyes zin pa/ /gnyen du ltos la gong 'phel gyis/ /bod kyi sngon byon mkhas grub la/ /gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs/ /mkhas grub gong ma'i byen rlabs kyis//rang gzhan rgyud la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du sngon/ /grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi sogs/ /byon pa'i mkhas grub thams cad la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byen gyis rlobs/ /gzhan gyis rang la bstod smad gnyis/ /byas dus bstod dang snyan grags kyis/ /phyi mar phan pa phar la zhog /mi tshe 'dir yang tshe ring dang / /nad med bde dang bsod nams rnams/ /mi 'phel steng du don med pas/ /g.yeng ba'i dbang song chos mi 'ong / /gzhan gyis phrag dog bskyed par byed/ /'phung 'dre de yis ci zhig bya/ /snyam du bstod dang grags pa'i tshig /gang thos pa la mi dga' bar//kha lud bzhin du dor bar gyis/ /gzhan gyis rang la smad pa sogs/ /byas na snyan grags nyams pa'i rgyur/ /song nas rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi med/ /gnas skabs mthar thug bde ba gang / /sgrub kyang rang gi lag na yod/ /ci zhig sgrub kyang bsgrubs na 693

chog /'di ni bla ma dkon mchog gsum//byen rlabs yin snyam mi dga'i sems/ /nam yang ma byed dga' bzhin du/ /gtan du bde ba'i lha chos sgrubs/ /rdo mtshon dbyug pa la sogs pas/ /phog na lus la gnod mod kyang / /ngan smras sogs kyis lus sems gnyis/ /gang la'ang mi gnod tshul bsams nas//bstod smad gnyis la dga' ba dang / /sdug bsngal med par ro snyoms gyis/ /rgya gar sngon byon mkhas grub la//gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs/ /mkhas grub de rnams byin rlabs kyis/ /rang gzhan rgyud la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o spyi gtsug padma nyi zla'i steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma byen rlabs can//rgyal khams yongs la bde skyid kyi/ /nyi ma 'char bar byen gyis rlobs/ /tshul khrims bsrungs na phan yon che/ /zang zing sbyin pa dpag tu med/ /gzhan la byen las sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan pa 'jig la nye dus 'dir/ /tshul khrims rnam dag nyin mtshan gcig /tsam la bsrungs pa phan yon che/ /tshul khrims ma bsrungs nyes dmigs che/ /sngon dus sangs rgyas 'od srungs ni/ /'jig rten khams su byon pa'i tshe/ /dge slong zhig gis sangs rgyas kyi//bcas pa khyad du bsad nas shing //zhig gi yal 694

ga gcig bcad pas/ /klu ru skyes te mgo bo la/ /ta la'i sdong bo chen po zhig /skyes te sdug bsngal da lta'i bar/ /myangs shing ma 'ongs pa na yang / /sdug bsngal yun ring myong bar gsungs//de phyir rang gis khas blangs pa'i/ /tshul khrims tshul bzhin bsrung bar gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /blangs pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /sems can bde zhing skyid par shog /spyi gtsug padma nyi zla'i steng //rtsa ba'i bla ma byen rlabs can//rgyal khams yongs la bde skyid kyi/ /nyi ma 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rang gis ji ltar khas blangs pa'i/ /tshul khrims tshul bzhin bsrung 'dod na/ /mi shes ltung ba 'byung ba'i sgo/ /yin pas de yi gnyen po la/ /bslab bya rnams nyon shes par gyes/ /ma gus ltung ba 'byung ba'i sgo/ /yin pas de yi gnyen po la/ /ston pa de yis bcas pa dang / /de la tshul bzhin slob pa'i grogs/ /dge 'dun rnams la gus par gyis/ /bag med ltung ba 'byung ba'i sgo/ /yin pas de yi gnyen po la/ /dran shes ngo tsha khrel yod dang / /nyes spyod rnam smin la 'jigs nas/ /bag 'khum pa la bslab par gyis/ /nyon mongs mang ba lhung 'byung sgo/ /yin pas de yi gnyen po la/ /nyon mongs gang byung 'bur 695

bcom byas/ /nyes pas ma gos pa la 'bod/ /brgya la nyes pas gos na yang / /de ma thag tu phyir bcos dang / /stobs bzhi'i bshags sdom rnam dag gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /blangs pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /sems can bde zhing skyid par shog /spyi gtsug padma nyi zla'i steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma byin rlabs can/ /rgyal khams yongs la bde skyid kyi/ /nyi ma 'char bar byin gyes rlobs/ /mi lus phyin chad 'thob par dka'/ /bde 'gro ngan 'gro shi 'phos nas/ /ngan 'gror skyes pa sa rdul 'dra/ /bde 'gror skyes pa phyag sen rtser/ /bzhes pa'i rdul dang 'dra bar gsungs/ /de ni ci'i phyir yin zer na//mi dge byed mkhan shin tu mang //dge ba byed mkhan nyung phyir ro//ngan 'gror skyes kyang mi dge'i las/ /zad nas slar yang bde 'gror skye/ /de tsam dka' rgyu med snyam na//dper na rbab rdo chen po zhig /ri rtse'i rtsa bar shor ba de/ /slar yang ri bo mthon po'i rtser/ /byis pa zhig gis 'dren dka' bzhin/ /ngan 'gro'i gnas su skyes phyin chad/ /dge ba'i blo ni skye dka' zhing //sdig pa 'phral du gsogs pas na//ngan 'gro'i gnas nas shi 'phos kyang / /slar yang ngan 'gro'i gnas su skyes/ /dmyal ba'i gting rdo byed pa yin/ /bde 696

'gror skye ba phar la zhog /bskal pa bye ba brgya phrag bar/ /bde 'gro'i sgra tsam thos mi 'gyur/ /de phyir bde 'gro mi yi lus/ /thob dus sems can thams cad kyi/ /don du byang chub sems bskyed nas/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang thob thabs gyes/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang mi bsgrub kyang / /'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las/ /rang nyid gcig pu thar thabs gyis/ /thar ba thob thabs mi byed kyang / /phyi mar rigs gzugs 'byor ba che/ /mi lus gtsang ma thob thabs gyis/ /de gsum gang yang mi byed par/ /tshe 'di'i lto rgyab 'ba' zhig gi /don du mi dge'i las bsags nas/ /ngan 'gro'i gnas su 'gro phod pa/ /snying med yang na smyon pa yin//mi yin snyam du ma sems shig /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /blangs pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus//sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /sems can bde zhing skyid par shog/spyi gtsug padma nyi zla'i steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma byen rlabs can/ /rgyal khams yongs la bde skyid kyi/ /nyi ma 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /chos kyi sgra tsam mi thos pa'i/ /'jig rten khams ni dper bzhag nas/ /mtshan mo sprin nag 'khrigs pa yi/ /smag rum lta bu shin tu mang / /dam chos dar ba'i 'jig rten khams/ /mun pa'i nang du glog 'gyu bzhin/ /dkon pas chos 697

med 'jig rten du/ /skyes na blang dor gnas mi shes/ /dge ba nam yang byed mi 'gyur/ /mi dge'i las ni 'ba' zhig byed/ /sngon dus dam pa'i chos kyi sgra/ /tsam yang med pa'i 'jig rten du/ /yang yang skyes nas sdig pa'i las/ /phyi yi rgya mtsho tsam bsags nas//dge ba ku sha'i rtser blangs pa'i//chu thigs bzhin du bsags pa nyung / /de yi steng du tshe 'dir yang / /mi dge'i las ni mang bo bsags/ /dge ba legs po nyin gcig tsam/ /byas pa dran rgyu mi 'dug na/ /shi ma thag nas dmyal ba'i gnas//lhung nas sdug bsngal myong bar nges/ /dper na rang la gnod pa'i dgra//lo gcig tshun la 'ong nges shing / /de'i bar nam 'ong cha med par/ /shes nas dal bar mi sdod par/ /pha rol dgra yi 'jigs pa las/ /skyob mkhan dpon chen zhig btsal nas//skyid sdug khyed mkhyen zhu ba bzhin/ /ngan song gsum gye sdug bsngal gang / /lo brgya tshun la 'ong nges la/ /zla ba phyi ma mnar med gnyis/ /sngon du gang sba cha med par/ /shes nas ngan song 'jigs pa las/ /skyob mkhan bla ma dkon mchog bsten/ /rgyun du skyabs 'gror 'bad par gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /blangs pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /sems can bde zhing skyid par shog /698

spyi gtsug padma nyi zla'i steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma byin rlabs can/ /rgyal khams yongs la bde skyid kyi/ /nyi ma 'char bar byen gyis rlobs/ /dam chos rnam dag zhig byed na/ /gtad pa bzhi dang rdo rje gsum/ /bud bsnyegs thob gsum zhig byed dgos/ /blo phugs dam pa'i chos la gtad/ /chos kyi phugs ni sprang la gtad//sprang gi phugs ni shi la gtad/ /shi phugs brag la gtad par gyes//thebs med rdo rje sngon la btang / /khrel med rdo rje rjes la zhog /ye shes rdo rje rang dang 'grogs/ /'jig rten mi yi gral nas bud/ /dman pa khye yi gral bsnyegs na/ /lha gral ngang gis 'thob par 'gyur/ /'di bcu dam pa gong ma 'gas/ /phugs nor bcu zhes gsungs par skad/ /phugs nor 'di bcu su la yod/ /de yis ri khrod dben pa zin/ /lha chos rnam dag 'ong bar nges/ /dam chos rnam dag byed 'dod na/ /phugs nor 'di bcu 'chang bar gyes/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyes/ /blangs pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /sems can bde zhing skyid par shog/spyi gtsug padma nyi zla'i steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma byin rlabs can/ /rgyal khams yongs la bde skyid kyi/ /nyi ma 'char bar byen gyes rlobs/ /bya btang ri khrod pa rnams la/ /gzhan ma 699

mgu yang 'dod thog yin/ /kho ma dga' bas kho mi 'ong / /gzhan la kho yis ngan bsgrags pas/ /gzhan gyi mi yang 'ong mi 'gyur/ /de yi bar la rtsam thang re/ /tsam min za rgyu med na yang / /mal du blo sems bde 'bol le//dge sbyor rnam dag byar yod la/ /dge sbyor rnam dag zhig 'ongs na/ /gzhan don ngang gis 'byung ngo zhes/ /bka' gdams gong ma 'ga' res gsungs/ /de phyir bya btang ri khrod pas/ /'jig rten ma yi ngo 'dzin dang //zhim pa'i zas la sred pa dang //'jam pa'i gos la dga' ba spongs//gnas khang zas gos ngan ngon tsam//bsten la rtag tu dge sbyor gyis/ /de ltar byas na ri khrod pas/ /tshe mjug mthong thos 'gro ba la//dngos sam brgyud nas phan par 'gyur//glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /blangs pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /sems can bde zhing skyid par shog /spyi gtsug padma nyi zla'i steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma byen rlabs can/ /rgyal khams yongs la bde skyid kyi//nyi ma 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /phan gnod gang yang mi byed pa'i/ /tha mal ba dang tshul khrims sogs//yon tan can dang tshul 'chal sogs//skyon can rnams dang rang nyid las/ /dman dang mnyam pa lhag pa 700

dang / /'byor zhing skyid dang sdug phongs pa'i/ /sems can gang la'ang sbyin pa thongs/ /sbyin pa gtong dus 'dir brten nas/ /bdag gis bla na med pa'i tshogs/ /sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs par bya//snyam dang byang chub sems pa yi/ /yo byad ci yod thams cad po/ /sngon nas 'gro la btang zin pas/ /bcol ba len du 'ong ba ltar/ /rang gi longs spyod ci yod pa/ /gzhan gyi yin no snyam pa dang //sbyin yul rnams la 'di bdag gi /sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs byed pa'i/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin snyam dang / /gnod pa byed la byams pa'i sems/ /sdug bsngal can la snying rje'i sems/ /yon tan can la dga' ba'i sems//phan 'dogs can la btang snyoms kyi/ /sems kyis gang la gang 'os kyi/ /zas nor sbyin par gtong bar gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /blangs pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /sems can bde zhing skyid par shog /spyi gtsug padma nyi zla'i steng //rtsa ba'i bla ma byen rlabs can//rgyal khams yongs la bde skyid kyi/ /nyi ma 'char bar byen gyes rlobs/ /sbyin yul sems can gang la yang / /nye ring med par sems snyoms dgos/ /sbyin pa btang ba'i 'bras bu yang / /slong ba bo sogs nam mkha' dang / /mnyam pa'i ma gyur sems can 701

la/ /'phral phugs phan phyir bsngo bar gyes/ /na tsha sdug bsngal can rnams kyi/ /sbyin yul rnams la lhag par brtse/ /sbyin pa 'bras bu med snyam dang / /gnod 'tshe sbyin pa chos su 'gyur/ /snyam dang dge mtshan bkra shis dang / /sbyar te sbyin pa gtong mi bya/ /slong bar brnyas dang nor rdzas gang / /sbyin pa btang na kho bo ni//gtong phod can no gzhan de ltar//ma yin snyam pa'i rlom sems spongs/ /tshig gi gtang rag snyan grags re/ /e 'ong snyam nas sbyin mi gtong //gang la sbyin pa byed pa'i sngon/ /yid dga' sbyin tshe dwangs par byed/ /byen nas 'gyod pa med pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i sbyin pa ni//rgya che ba rnams thos na yang //zhum pa mi bya bdag nyid la/ /khyod ni de 'dra can min zhes/ /khyad gsod mi byed spro ba spel/ /dgra gnyen gang la chags sdang dang / /nye ring med par byams pa dang / /snying rje'i sgo nas sbyin gtong gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /blangs pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /sems can bde zhing skyid par shog /spyi gtsug padma nyi zla'i steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma byen rlabs can/ /rgyal khams yongs la bde skyid kyi//nyi ma 'char bar byen gyis rlobs/ /mar gyur sems can thams cad po/ /bde bas 702
