phongs dang sred pa yi/ /dbang du song nas sdug bsngal ba//sel ba'i mthu med rang bzhin gyis/ /sdug bsngal mthong nas de sel ba/ /bsam pas ster ba ma gtogs gzhan/ /pha rol po yis rang nyid la/ /'di yi lan du phan e thogs/ /re bas sbyin pa gtong mi bya//sems can don du sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang myur du thob phyir dang / /de ma thob pa tshun chad du/ /mngon mtho'i rten la 'khor longs spyod/ /phun sum tshogs nas 'gro ba gzhan/ /don byed snyam pa ma gtogs par/ /srid pa'i phun tshogs tsam zhig la/ /mthar thug 'thob byar bzung nas ni/ /de phyir sbyin pa gtong mi bya/ /sbyin pa btang na rgyal po sogs/ /gzhan gyes gtong phod can du bdag /shes nas bsnyen bkur byung na snyam/ /log pa'i 'tsho bas bsam pa dang / /byen na dbul bor 'gyur snyam nas/ /mi sbyin pa dang slong ba bo/ /bslu bsam pa dang yid mi dga'/ /khro dang sems g.yeng slong ba yis/ /log pa byas la skyo ba dang / /rang nyid bslu ba la sogs pa'i/ /slong ba bo yi skyon mthong yang / /gzhan la sgrog 'dod bsam pa rnams/ /spangs nas sbyin pa gtong bar gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /blangs pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus//sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /sems can bde zhing skyid par shog /703

spyi gtsug padma nyi zla'i steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma byin rlabs can/ /rgyal khams yongs la bde skyid kyi/ /nyi ma 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /myur du mi ster 'gyangs nas ster/ /nyon mongs byas nas ster ba dang / /chos sam 'jig rten tshul gang dag /mi mthun las rnams byed bcug nas/ /ster dang sngar dus 'di tsam zhig /ster zhes bshad nas phyis 'ongs dus/ /bshad bzhin mi ster ngan pa 'am/ /nyung ngu ster dang drin bgrang bzhin/ /ster dang dus gcig byin chog pa/ /nyung ngur byas nas ster ba dang / /rgyal por gyur nas gzhan gyi bu/ /chung ma phrogs nas ster ba dang / /pha ma bran sogs yo byad gang / /mi ster na yang nan gyes blangs/ /gzhan la ster dang gnod byed pa'i/ /thabs kyis sbyin pa gtong ba dang / /rang gis sbyin pa mi gtong bar/ /gzhan la byed du 'jug pa dang / /slong ba bo la 'phya ba dang / /zur gyis smod dang tshig rtsub dang / /sangs rgyas bcas pa dang 'gal nas/ /ster dang longs spyod 'phral du gang / /byung ba bzhin du mi gtong bar/ /yin ring bsags nas ster ba'i tshul/ /thams cad dor la sbyin gtong gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /blangs pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /sems can bde 704

zhing skyid par shog /spyi gtsug padma nyi zla'i steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma byen rlabs can//rgyal khams yongs la bde skyid kyi/ /nyi ma 'char bar byin gyes rlobs/ /sbyin pa che chung gang gtong dus/ /bzhin mdangs rab tu gsal zhing 'dzum/ /snyan tshig smra ba dang bcas pas/ /sbyin yul bzang ngan ci 'dra zhig /yin rung gus pas rim gro bskyed/ /rang gi lag gis ster ba dang / /slong ba'i dus las mi 'da' ster/ /gzhan la mi gnod dka' spyad kyi/ /sdug bsngal bsran nas sbyin gtong gyis//rim gro bgyes nas sbyin btang na//phyi mar rang la gnyen sogs kyis/ /gus pas rim gro byed par 'gyur/ /rang gi lag gis sbyin gtong na/ / longs spyod rgya chen rnyed par 'gyur/ /pha rol slong ba'i dus byed na/ /don rnams dus su 'grub par 'gyur/ /gzhan la gnod med sbyin btang na/ /longs spyod brtan la med mi 'gyur/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /blangs pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /sems can bde zhing skyid par shog /spyi gtsug padma nyi zla'i steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma byin rlabs can/ /rgyal khams yongs la bde skyid kyi/ /nyi ma 'char bar 705

byin kyis rlobs/ /rang la yo byad mang bo zhig /yod na sbyin gtong mi nus pas/ /ser sna can gyi khyem du song //pha rol mgu zhing bag phebs par/ /byas te de nas 'di skad smras/ /nga la yo byad mang bo yod/ /da ni nga yis sbyin pa yi/ /phar phyin rdzogs phyir slong ba bo/ /'dod pas o ni slong ba dang / /'phrad na phyir la ma gtong bar//nga yi nor rnams longs la sbyin/ /yang na tshur la 'khrid shog dang / /yo byad gang 'os sbyin zhes bshad//de skad smras na pha rol des/ /rang nor god pa ma mchis pas/ /rab tu dga' bas de bzhin byed//de ltar byas na goms shugs kyis/ /rang nor chung ngu ster bar nus//de la brten nas 'bring ster nus/ /der brten chen po gtong bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin rang gi gnyen grogs sogs/ /gtong mi nus pa thams cad la/ /yo byad med la yo byad sbyin/ /mchod sbyin byed du bcug nas rang / /mi byed 'di ni rang nyid kyis/ /bsod nams mang bo bskyed pa dang / /gzhan gyi kha cig nyon mongs 'dul/ /kha cig chos kyi 'dod pa bskangs/ /des na longs spyod yod rnams kyis/ /de ltar byas na shin tu legs/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyes//blangs pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /sems can bde zhing skyid par shog /706

spyi gtsug padma nyi zla'i steng //rtsa ba'i bla ma byen rlabs can//rgyal khams yongs la bde skyid kyi/ /nyi ma 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rang la yo byad med na bzo/ /las kyi nor sgrub ster ba dang / /yang na sgo ru slong ba gang / /byung ba dad can 'byor ldan gyi/ /khyem du btang nas rang yang der/ /song nas sbyin pa gtong grogs gyis/ /sbyin pa gtong ba'i dus skabs su/ /sbyin bya'i nor rdzas rnams spungs nas/ /bzang rim sngon du ster ba dang / /lhag ma med par gtong bar gyis/ /dngos po gang byin pa de 'phral/ /ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal bskyed byed kyi/ /rgyu dang bral bas bde myong la/ /phugs su phan pas sdig pa spongs/ /dge ba'i lam la 'god pa dang / /'phral du mi bde bar 'gyur yang / /phugs su phan na gtong bar gyes/ /dngos po gang btang ba de 'phral/ /sdug bsngal bskyed la phugs gnod par/ /'gyur na 'phral du bde na yang / /phugs su gnod na gtong mi bya/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /blangs pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /sems can bde zhing skyid par shog /spyi gtsug padma nyi zla'i steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma byin rlabs can/ /rgyal khams yongs la bde skyid kyi/ /nyi ma 'char bar byin 707

gyis rlobs/ /sngon nas byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /lus srog sems can thams cad la/ /bsam pa thag pas btang mod kyang / /lus kyi sha sogs slong ba la/ /byen pas na tshas 'gyod pa'i sems/ /mi bskyed snying rje chen po yi/ /bsam pa ma rgyas de srid du/ /gzhan gyes rang lus slong na yang / /de la rang lus sbyin mi bya/ /rang gi ngos na ser sna sogs//sbyin pa'i gegs byed dang bral zhing / /gzhan gyi ngos nas rang gi lus/ /ma btang sems can mang bo'i don/ /'grub pa'i dgos pa che ba'i tshe/ /yan lag la sogs rang gi lus/ /gzhan gyis slong yang sbyin mi bya/ /rang gzhan gnyis la gnod phyir du/ /rang lus slong yang sbyin mi bya/ /bdud ris lha dang des brlams pa'i/ /sems can rnams kyis mtho 'tshams pa'i/ /bsam pas slong la lus mi sbyin/ /smyos dang sems 'khrugs pa rnams kyis/ /slong na rang lus ster mi bya/ /'di dag bsam pas slong ba min/ /de phyir rang lus ma btang na//ltung ba cung zad tsam med par//ma zad byin na ltung bar 'gyur/ /de dag ma gtogs skabs gzhan du/ /rang lus slong la sbyin par bya/ /de yang yan lag la sogs pa/ /bsil nas gtan nas sbyin pa dang //chos ldan dgos pa bsgrub phyir du/ /bran du 'gro ba la sogs gyis/ /glu 'du tshogs drug 708

rang grol gyis/ /blangs pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /sems can bde zhing skyid par shog /spyi gtsug padma nyi zla'i steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma byin rlabs can/ /rgyal khams yongs la bde skyid kyi/ /nyi ma 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rab byung bsnyen gnas bsnyen rdzogs par/ /phyi dro kha zas ster mi bya/ /sdom brtson pa la zas skom gyi/ /lhag ma bshang gci mchil snabs dang / /skyug pa rnag khrag gis 'bags pa'i/ /bza' btung gang yang ster mi bya/ /sgog tsong sha chang mi 'thung ba'i/ /sdom ldan rnams la sgog tsong sha /chang mi ster dang de rnams kyis/ /'bags pa'i bza' btung ster mi bya/ /gzhan la khyod gtong bshad pa'i tshe/ /bu dang bran sogs 'thad na yang / /gnod sbyin srin po mi mdza' dang / /drag shul can gyis gnod pa 'am/ /byas la drin du mi gzo ba/ /rnams kyis slong la gtong mi bya/ /bza' btung mi 'phrod 'phrod pa yang / /tshod mi zin par slong ba bo/ /nad can rnams la ster mi bya/ /'grangs dang sred pa che ba yi//slong la kha zas mi 'phrod pa//ster dang bza' btung 'phrod na yang / /ha cang mang bo ster mi bya/ /glegs bam don shes 'dod pa min/ /nor phyir btsongs na 709

'dod pa yis/ /glegs bam slong na ster mi bya/ /rang gis glegs bam dgos pa bsgrubs/ /zin pa ma yin glegs bam la ser sna'i dri ma ye med tshe//glegs bam don shes 'dod pa yis/ /slong yang glegs bam ster mi bya/ /pha rol sems la mi gnod pa'i/ /thabs mkhas sgo nas gtong bar gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /blangs pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus//sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /sems can bde zhing skyid par shog /spyi gtsug padma nyi zla'i steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma byin rlabs can/ /rgyal khams yongs la bde skyid kyi/ /nyi ma 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rang gi pha ma srog chags dang / /bcas pa'i bza' ba btung ba dang / /gtong ba yin zhes ma bshad dang / /bshad kyang 'gro la mi 'thad pa'i/ /bu dang chung ma bran la sogs/ /mi 'thad bzhin du sbyin mi bya/ /bu dang chung ma skyid lobs rnams/ /gzhan gye bran du ster mi bya/ /chos gos rnam gsum de las gzhan/ /yo byad lhag pa sangs rgyas kyi/ /rjes su gnang ba ser sna yi/ /bsam pa med kyang nyer mkho ba/ /yin na gzhan gyes slong ba la/ /ma byen na yang nyes med gsungs/ /rang ngam gzhan la gnod pa'i phyir/ /dug mtshon me chang ster ba dang / /phyi mar ngan 'gro'i gnas 'gro ba'i/ /rgyu sogs dgag bya 710

dang ldan pa'i/ /dga' zhing rtsed mo rtse byed kyi//dngos po slong la sbyin pa dang / /rgya dang sa mda' la sogs pa/ /gzhan pa gnod phyir slob pa dang / /slong la slob dang sbyin pa dang / /skam mam gsher la gnas pa yi/ /srog chags rnams la gnod pa yi/ /sa chu slong la sbyin pa dang / /yul mi de 'am gzhan la gnod/ /skyel phyir rgyal srid slong ba la//sbyin dang mi mdza' ba rnams kyi/ /slong la de yi dgra ster ba//lta bu'i rang dang gzhan rnams la//gnod pa'i sbyin pa gtong mi bya/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyes/ /blangs pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /sems can bde zhing skyid par shog /spyi gtsug padma nyi zla'i steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma byin rlabs can/ /rgyal khams yongs la bde skyid kyi/ /nyi ma 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /ston pas ma bkag pa'i dus dang //slong la mi 'os sbyin pa ni/ /ma yin de dang 'tsham pa zhig /yin na gang yang dga' bas byin/ /ser sna can gyes glegs bam ni/ /glegs bam nor rdzas phyir btsong ba/ /ma yin glegs bam don shes par/ /'dod pas slong la sbyin dgos pas/ /de yang dpe cha gnyis yod na/ /de nyid ster dgos gnyis med na/ /dpe de 'bri ba'i rin ster dgos/ /de yang med na glegs bam 'di/ /byin pas tshe 711

'dir bdag khrugs par/ /gyur kyang sla yi ser sna ngas/ /dang du blang bar mi bya'o/ /snyam du bsams nas ser sna can/ /glegs bam slong la sbyin par gyis/ /rgyal po byed tshe gzhan gyi bu/ /chung ma la sogs kha phral nas//gzhan la byin du mi rung yang //grogs dang bcas te slong ba bo/ /rnams la sbyin par gtong bar gyis/ /ngan 'gro'i rgyu ru mi 'gyur ba'i/ /dga' zhing brtse ba'i dngos po dang / /gzhan la mi gnod rgya sogs dang / /srog chags dag la mi gnod na/ /srog chags gnas pa'i sa phyogs dang / /bza' btung slong la sbyin par gyis/ /rang ngam gzhan la phan phyir du/ /mtshon me chang sogs sbyin par gyes/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /blangs pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /sems can bde zhing skyid par shog /spyi gtsug padma nyi zla'i steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma byin rlabs can//rgyal khams yongs la bde skyid kyi/ /nyi ma 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zang zing sbyin pa gtong ba'i dus/ /slong ba bkren dang 'byor ldan gnyis/ /byung na ji ltar bya snyam na/ /gnyis ga'i 'dod pa rdzogs nus na/ /gnyis ga'i 'dod pa skong bar gyis/ /mi nus 'dug na bkren pa po'i/ /'dod pa rdzogs par bya snyam 712

pa/ /sngon du btang nas 'di skad zer/ /bzhin bzang nga yi yo byad 'di/ /bkren pa 'di la dang po nas/ /bsngos zin tshar bas khyod la ngas/ /ma byin snyam du ma sems shig /ces pa'i 'jam pa'i tshig shod la/ /bkren po'i 'dod pa skong bar gyes/ /slong ba'i dus su ser snas rang / /non na ji ltar bya snyam na/ /lus srog longs spyod dper na chu'i/ /lbu ba lta bur mi rtag pa'i/ /dngos po 'di dang rang gnyis ka /nges par myur du so sor 'bral/ /'dis kyang bdag dor bdag gis kyang / /'di nam 'dor la nges pa med/ /do nub yin yang 'dor nyen che/ /nam yang 'dor ba mnyam po la/ /da lta sbyin par btang gyur na/ /rang la sgye ba phyi ma la/ /btang ba chung yang brgya 'gyur 'thob/ /phongs shing dbul bar mi 'gyur la/ /'chi dus gang la chags mi 'gyur/ /'gyod pa med par rab tu dga'/ /snyam du soms la longs spyod la/ /chags pa med par gtong bar gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /blangs pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /sems can bde zhing skyid par shog / spyi gtsug padma nyi zla'i steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma byin rlabs can/ /rgyal khams yongs la bde skyid kyi//nyi ma 'char bar byen 713

gyes rlobs/ /sbyin bya'i rdzas rnams yod bzhin du/ /slong la sbyin mi 'dod pa'i dus/ /nyes pa 'di ni sbyin pa sngon/ /goms pa ma byas pas lan 'dug /da yang sbyin la ma goms na/ /skye ba phyi ma sbyin gtong la/ /bdag ni mi dga' 'gyur snyam du/ /rig par byas nas yo byad gang / /yod pa slong la sbyin par thongs/ /ma goms nyes pa'i dbang ma gtong / /longs spyod ha cang chung ba la/ /brten nas gtong sems mi skye dus/ /bdag sngon 'khor bar skyes pa'i tshe/ /gzhan la phan 'dogs ma byas par/ /sngon gyi las sam gzhan dbang du/ /gyur pas bkres skom la sogs pa'i/ /sdug bsngal mang bo myangs pa yod/ /da lta gzhan la phan btags par/ /brten nas byung ba'i sdug bsngal gyi/ /dbang gis tshe 'dir bdag 'chi yang / /phyi mar bsod nams dpag med thob//shi na rnyed pa legs po rnyed/ /longs spyod de dag med na yang / /sngo sogs ci yang rung bas 'tsho/ /snyam du soms la phongs pa'i sdug/dang du longs la sbyin gtong gyis//longs spyod yid 'ong mchog rnams la//chags nas slong la gtong mi 'dod//dus su chags pa'i nyes pa de/ /rig par byas nas sdug bsngal ba/ /bde'o snyam pa 'khrul nas gda'/ /'di nyid bzung na tshe 'dir yang / /dgra rkun la sogs mi 'dod pa'i//sdug bsngal du 714

ma thog tu 'dren/ /zhen cing chags na phyi ma la/ /'khor bar skye ba'i rgyu byed pa'i/ /phan phan tshul gyis gnod skyel ba'i/ /dngos po 'di yis ci zhig bya/ /snyam du soms la sbyin par gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /blangs pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /sems can bde zhing skyid par shog /spyi gtsug padma nyi zla'i steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma byin rlabs can//rgyal khams yongs la bde skyid kyi/ /nyi ma 'char bar byen gyis rlobs/ /sbyin pa btang ba'i phan yon ni/ /bsod nams tshogs ni yongs rdzogs nas/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob par 'gyur/ /de ma thob pa tshun chad du/ /mngon mtho'i rten bzang legs thob nas/ /longs spyod phun sum tshogs par 'gyur/ /mi tshe 'dir yang snyan grags dang / /bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa 'byung / /sbyin pa btang ba'i bsod nams la/ /gzugs su grub rgyu zhig yin na/ /gaṅgā'i bye ma snyed kyi ni/ /'jig rten khams su mi shong zhes/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs//des na bdag gi lus longs spyod/ /dge tshogs 'gro la gtong bar gyis/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyes/ /blangs pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /715

sems can bde zhing skyid par shog /spyi gtsug padma nyi zla'i steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma byen rlabs can/ /rgyal khams yongs la bde skyid kyi/ /nyi ma 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sde ba'i dpon po bzang bo yis//rang sde ma yis bu bzhin skyong / /khyad par gnyom chung rnams la byams/ /shin tu mkho ba'i dus ma gtogs/ /khral dang 'u lag 'jog mi 'gyur/ /mi bzang thams cad blon 'khor byed/ /sde ba'i skyid sdug legs nyes gzigs/ /mi bzang rnams la cho lo ster/ /ngan pa thams cad thabs kyis 'dul/ /thams cad dge ba'i lam la bskul/ /rgyun du dam pa'i lha chos byed/ /rang sde rnams la byams pa'i mthus/ /sde ba phyug cing je rgyas 'gro/ /sde bas dpon po'i snyan pa brjod/ /rgyun du mchod cing bkur bar 'gyur/ /kun gyis 'o skol dpon po 'di/ /sku tshe yun ring brtan na zer//na na dpon po ma shi na/ /sde ba 'di yi skyid la zer/ /shi na pha ma shi ba las//lhag pa'i mya ngan byed par 'gyur/ /phyi mar mtho ris gnas su skyes/ /bde skyid dpag med dpon pos myong / /phyi nas dpon ngan zhig skyes na/ /sngon gyis dpon po drin can po//de zer phyis kyi mi yis gleng / /de phyir sde ba'i dpon po tsho/ /spyir ni kun la byams na bzang / /khyad par rang sder byams par gyis/ /glu 'di 716

tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /blangs pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /sems can bde zhing skyid par shog /spyi gtsug padma nyi zla'i steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma byen rlabs can/ /rgyal khams yongs la bde skyid kyi/ /nyi ma 'char bar byin gyes rlobs/ /sde ba'i dpon po ngan pa yis/ /rang sde dgra bzhin gnod 'tshe byed/ /lhag par rgyu nom can la sdang / /nam yang ma thub mi 'gyu ba'i/ /khral dang 'u lag mang bo 'jog /mi ngan thams cad blon 'khor byed/ /bzang bo rnams la bka' bkyon mang //nyes can lag nas rgyu nom blangs//nyes med mi la chad pa gcod/ /nyes pa cung zad tsam re'i phyir/ /khyem tshang nyam thag gnyom chung gtor//thams cad dmag jag las la bskul/ /rgyun du 'thab rtsod 'khrug pa byed/ /rang sder rtag tu sdang ba'i mthus/ /sde ba dbul zhing je nyung 'gro/ /sde bas dpon por ngan smras mang / /mthong na rgyun du thams cad 'bros//sde ba'i che chung thams cad kyis//dpon po 'di nyid shi na zer/ /na tshe dpon po da shi na/ /sde ba 'di yi skyid la zer/ /shi tshe sdang dgra shi ba bzhin/ /skog nas thams cad rab tu dga'/ /phyi mar ngan 'gro'i gnas su skyes/ /sdug bsngal bzod med dpon pos 717

myong / /phyi nas dpon bzang zhig skyes na/ /sngon gyi dpon pos 'di byas zer/ /phyis kyi mi yis ngan tshul gleng / /de phyir sde ba'i dpon po tsho/ /spyir ni kun la byams na bzang / /khyad par rang sder byams par gyes/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /blangs pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /sems can bde zhing skyid par shog /spyi gtsug padma nyi zla'i steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma byen rlabs can/ /rgyal khams yongs la bde skyid kyi/ /nyi ma 'char bar byen gyis rlobs/ /zas la sred pa'i gnyen po la//de yi nyes dmigs bsgoms na bzang / /kha dog dri ro zhim pa'i zas/ /ci 'dra zhig kyang so yis bldad/ /mchil mas brlan nas skyug pa ltar/ /'gyur la mid pa phar 'dzur nas/ /zas ni bzang ngan gang yin yang / /rtug pa ma gtogs yon tan gzhan/ /gang yang mi 'byung ha cang za/ /che na na zug mang bo bskyed/ /ma zhu zas dug song nas 'chi/ /zas dang zas kyi rgyu'i don du/ /tsha grang sdug bsngal pyong bzhin du/ /'bad pa du ma byas nas bsgrub//ma grub mya ngan chen po byed/ /grub na chud zos song gis dogs/ /bsrung ba'i rtsol ba drag po dgos/ /de phyir pha bu la sogs pa/ /phan tshun rtsod cing 'thab pa dang / /de la sred pa cher gyur na/ /rgyal po la 718

sogs phan tshun du/ /g.yul sprod sdug bsngal du ma myong / /gzhan gyi zas la spyod rnams kyis/ /rje bo'i don du pha rol dang / /'thab na sdug bsngal mang bo myong / /zas dang zas kyi rgyu yi phyir/ /sgo gsum sdig pa bsags pa rnams/ /'chi tshe dran nas 'gyod bzhin 'chi/ /shi nas ngan 'gro'i gnas su 'gro/ /song na sdug bsngal bzod med myong / /de phyir sha thud mar sogs kyis/ /phan phan tshul gyis pham ster bas/ /ngan ngon lus 'tsho tsam ma gtogs/ /'phung 'dre de tshos ci zhig bya/ /snyam du bzang bor sred pa spongs/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /blangs pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /sems can bde zhing skyid par shog /spyi gtsug padma nyi zla'i steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma byin rlabs can/ /rgyal khams yongs la bde skyid kyi/ /nyi ma 'char bar byen gyis rlobs/ /zas la sred pa'i gnyen po la/ /nyes dmigs phan yon shes na bzang / /dad zas gshin po'i za ma dang / /grib can zas la longs spyad na/ /rgyud la nyams rtogs sngar skyes pa/ /'grib cing gsar du skye ba la/ /gegs byed bying rmugs gnyid gsum 'phel/ /tsho gsog gom gang 'gro mi nus/ /song na dbugs rnams khar 'tshangs nas/ /sdug bsngal myong ba ma 719

mthong ngam/ /sngon chad za ma mang bo dang / /zhim po zos nas du sangs rgyas/ /mthong thos dogs gsum gcig yod dam/ /da lta sangs rgyas song ba su/ /ma 'ongs par yang 'tshang mi rgya/ /sngon gyi rgyal sras thams cad kyes/ /lus 'tsho ngan ngon zas la brten/ /dka' spyad byas nas sangs rgyas 'dug /chos phyir dka' ba spyod nus na/ /lus sgrib srab cing 'dzad par 'gyur/ /dkor la sogs pas mi bsgrib par/ /rgyud la nyams rtogs skye sla sogs/ /phan yon mang bo yod pas na//lus 'tsho ngan ngon gang rnyed zas/ /brten la dge la gzhol bar gyis/ /zas ni mang dang zhim pa la/ /dga' ba'i chos pa grong du 'khyams/ /ri khrod 'grim pa'i skal ba med/ /gal te ri la bsdad na yang/ /zas phyir gsog 'jog mang bo byed/ /bya btang byed pa'i skal ba med/ /gsog srung sdug bsngal bsam mi khyab/ /lha chos byed pa'i skal ba med/ /lha chos ma 'ongs shi ba'i dus/ /sangs rgyas thob pa phar la zhog /mngon mtho'i lus rten bzang bo yang thob pa'i skal ba tsam yang med/ /de phyir zas la sred pa spongs/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /blangs pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /sems can bde zhing skyid par shog /720

o rgyan padma 'byung gnas/ /snyigs dus bdag gzhan snang ngor/ /slar yang chos rgyal tshul 'dzin/ /zhabs la gus pas 'dud do/ /rdzogs pa chen po zer ba/ /mi rtog ting 'dzin tsam gyi/ /rgyu ni chung chung zhig la/ /ma 'dzin rjes 'jug bu tsho/ /mdo sngags chos rnams ma lus/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i chos yin/ /de phyir kun mkhyen chen pos/ /mdo sngags chos rnams yongs 'dus/ /legs bshad zla med rdzogs chen/ /sems nyid ngal gso'i 'grel ba/ /shing rta chen por gsungs so/ /mdo sngags chos rnams ma lus/ /nyams len 'khyer shes de la/ /rdzogs chen rnal 'byor zer ro/ /glu 'di rang gi rjes 'jug /bu yis sems la zungs dang / /mdo sngags chos rnams ma lus/ /gdams par 'char ba yin ya/ /bla ma ngag gi dbang bo/ /klong chen legs bshad drin las/ /bdag gis rdzogs chen gzhung la/ /go ba cung zad chags byung //nga yi rjes 'jug bu tsho/ /kha ton tsam gyis mi chog /bla ma mkhas pa'i zhabs bsten/ /kun mkhyen legs bshad la sogs/ /dpe mang zhib tu ltos dang / /go ba bzang bo 'byung nges/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol/ /glu dbyangs 'di thos rnams kyis/ /bla ma mkhas pa bsten nas/ /dpe ltos byed par gyur cig / 721

rje bla ma spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /mi 'dir tshogs rnams la byen gyis rlobs/ /nga tshogs drug rang grol glu 'di la/ /snyan lhan ne nyon la sems la zungs/ /bka' cung zad bkyon yang rnam 'gyur btsog /nga slob ma bzang zhes ma smra zhig /rdzun mang zhing lag pa mi gtsang bar/ /nga nye gnas bzang zhes ma smra zhig /gang mkho dus g.yor skyi mi byed par/ /nga khyim mtshes bzang zhes ma spra zhig /rkyen ngan pa byung dus mi phan par/ /nga sha nye bzang zhes ma smra zhig /gnas a myes a ner mi 'cham 'khon/ /nga bu mo bzang zhes ma smra zhig /yul pha ma a khur mi byams par/ /nga bu tsha bzang zhes ma smra zhig /phogs mang bo brgyab kyang lkog lab mang / /nga grwa tshang bzang zhes ma smra zhig /brkus 'phrog bcom bcad kyin je mang 'gro//nga sde ba bzang zhes ma smra zhig /yar rgyal po'i bka' bzhin mi byed par/ /nga blon po bzang zhes ma smra zhig /phar gang la mngags kyang go mi chod/ /nga bran g.yog bzang zhes ma smra zhig /ngo mi rtag 'gyur ldog mang bo byed/ /nga grogs po bzang zhes ma smra zhig /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /gang thos tshad rgyud la phan par shog /ma rig nyon mongs las dbang gis/ /ma dag 'khor bar rtag 'khyams pa'i/ /mar gyur 'gro kun dag zhing du/ /ma lus 722

'dren mdzad bla mar 'dud/ /yon tan ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /drin can bla ma tshul bzhin du/ /bsten pa lam gyi rtsa ba ru/ /mthong nas bsam dang sbyor bas sten/ /dal 'byor tshang ba'i mi lus 'di/ /rnyed par dka' zhing 'jig par sla/ /tshul 'di bsams nas mi nor zas/ /ma chags ma zhen lha chos gyis/ /shi dus lus dang grib ma bzhin/ /dkar nag las 'bras phyir 'brang ba'i/ /nges pa rnyed nas mi dge'i las/ /spangs nas dge tshogs mtha' dag sgrubs/ /'khor ba'i phun tshogs ci tsam zhig /spyad kyang mi ngoms sdug bsngal rgyu/ /yid brtan mi rung tshul mthong nas/ /thar ba'i bde ba don du gnyer/ /rnam dag bsam pa des drangs pas/ /dran shes bag yod brtan pa yi/ /bsten pa'i rtsa ba so thar la/ /rtag tu sgrub pa snying bor mdzod/ /rang nyid srid mtshor lhung ba bzhin/ /nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa yi/ /ma gyur 'gro kun de 'dra bar/ /mthong nas byang chub sems skyed cig /byang chub sems tsam bskyed na yang / /tshul khrims gsum gyi nyams len la/ /ma goms byang chub mi 'grub par/ /mthong nas rgyal sras sdom par slobs/ / thun mong lam sbyangs snod gyur nas/ /theg pa kun mchog rdo rje'i theg /skal bzang skye bo'i 'jug ngogs der/ /bde blag nyid du 'jug 723

par mdzod/ /de tshe dngos grub rnam pa gnyis/ /'grub pa'i gzhi de dam tshig dang / /sdom pa tshul bzhin bsrung ba la/ /nges pa rnyed nas mig bzhin srungs/ /de nas rdo rje theg pa'i lam/ /gnad rnams ji bzhin legs rtogs nas/ /dben pa bsten nas nyams blangs na/ /dal 'byor thob pa don ldan 'gyur/ /bla ma blo bzang grags pa sogs/ /bla chen gong ma'i gsung bzhin du/ /bla ma'i rjes bzung bdag gis smras//bla rgan yongs la phan par shog/ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /nyon dang dad can pho mo tsho/ /rang gi yul phyogs dgon gnas kyi/ /bla ma dge 'dun 'dus pa las/ /lhag pa'i mchod gnas gzhan na med/ /de la zas nor mi 'bul bar/ /bzhag nas stod kyi dbus su song / /ser 'bras dge gsum mchod na yang / /lhag pa'i phan yon ngas ma mthong / /de phyir sde ba dad can tsho/ /rang gi yul phyogs bla ma dang / /dgon pa'i dge 'dun mchod bstod bkur/ /bsod nams dpag med thob par 'gyur/ /rang dang lhan cig 'grogs pa yi/ /rgas pa'i drin can pha ma dang //a khu bran g.yog sgo khyi las//lhag pa'i sbyin yul gzhan na med/ /de la zas gos mi ster bar/ /bzhag nas smad kyi rgya nang song / /rgya 724

sprang stong phrag mang bo la/ /zas gos sbyin pa btang na yang / /phan yon lhag pa ngas ma mthong / /de phyir dbang chen pho mo tsho /na so rgas pa'i rgan rgon dang / /a khu bran g.yog sgo khye la/ /zas gos sbyin la byams pas skyongs/ /phan yon mtha' yas thob par 'gyur/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /thos tshad rgyud la phan par shog /pha bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal nas/ /dus de ring rang la gros 'di 'debs/ /skyon cung zad byas na grwa slob 'ded/ /nga bla ma bzang zhes ma zer cig /sba'i dbyug pa thogs nas grong du 'khyams/ /nga ri khrod pa yin ma zer cig /gzhan nor rdzas phul ba kun blangs nas/ /nga 'dod pa chung zhes ma zer cig /nor zas gos yod kyang sbyin mi gtong / /nga ser sna med ces ma zer cig /gzhan ku re tsam zhig byas kyang khro/ /nga khog pa yangs zhes ma zer cig /ngo byu ru ltar gyur kha sha 'dar/ /nga zhe sdang ma langs ma zer cig /nangs snga bar mi lang nyal yun ring / /nga gti mug chung zhes ma zer cig /las mi dge bcu la mi 'dzem par/ /nga tshul khrims yod ces ma zer cig /pha bla ma grogs la ngan smras byas/ /nga dam tshig gtsang zhes ma zer cig /byams snying rje byang sems med bzhin du/ /nga chos pa yin zhes ma zer 725

cig /glu 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /dge 'di yis 'gro kun bde skyid shog/rje chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /kye nyon dang tshogs drug rang grol ming / /rgyud dug gsum rgyas pa'i mir ma 'grogs//de gang yin zer na kha cig gi /sna'i sgo na spu zhig zer mi rung / /ngo'i mdog 'gyur kha la sha 'gul rgyug /skad 'dzer zhing dgod rgyu lu rgyu mang / /mig cher bgrad kha nas tshig ngan smra/ /rdo dbyug pa lag tu gang byung 'phen/ /de'i nang na zhe sdang me bzhin du/ /'bar yod pa'i rtags yin der 'grogs na/ /rgyud zhe sdang bsam ngan skye bar 'gyur/ /yang kha cig nas rdog lhan po dang //rdo shing mchu yan chad tshags byas nas//yar na so rgas na rgas rgyags dgos/ /phyis 'chi ba'i tshe na dur zan dgos/ /tshogs gsog pa la yang nor dgos zer/ /nor med na lha chos mi 'ong zhes/ /bun gtong sogs log 'tsho 'ba' zhig byed/ /de'i nang na 'dod chags chu ltar du/ /khol yod pa'i rtags yin der 'grogs na/ /sems 'dod sred dbang du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /yang kha cig da lta yang dag pa'i/ /don bsgom pa'i dus min gol sa mang / /gzhan gyis dang khe che nyen chung zer/ /de'i nang na gti mug mun ltar du/ /'thibs yod pa'i rtags 726

yin der 'grogs na/ /blo yang dag don la rmongs par 'gyur/ /don de phyir dug gsum rgyas pa'i mir/ /dus nam yang ma 'grogs rnal 'byor pa/ /glu 'di nyid thos tshad thams cad kyis/ /grogs ngan pa gtan nas spang bar shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//chos mdzad khyu mchog chos rgyal rin po che//chos pa'i khyu nas bud pa rnams la gzigs/ /bla mas gang gsung bsgrub par mi nus kyang / /dad log byed na chos pa'i khyu nas bud/ /grogs la lus ngag phan 'dogs mi nus kyang / /ngan smra sdang na chos pa'i khyu nas bud/ /'dul khrims nyams med bsrung bar mi nus kyang / /rtsa bzhi nyams na chos pa'i khyu nas bud/ /gnod pa'i lan du phan 'dogs mi nus kyang //gnod pa byed na chos pa'i khyu nas bud/ /gang yod thun mong za bar mi nus kyang / /lkog zas mang na chos pa'i khyu nas bud/ /ci yod sbyin pa gtong bar mi nus kyang / /rnyed tshad gsog na chos pa'i khyu nas bud/ /bud drug glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /thos tshad chos pa'i khyu nas ma 'bud cig /chos mdzad dam pa gong ma thams cad kyis/ /chos dang mi mthun chos pa rnams la gzigs/ /tshul 'chos g.yo sgyur mkhas 727

pa'i chos pa de/ /g.yo can bye las dpon g.yog byas pa 'dra/ /ma grol grol rdzu byed pa'i chos pa de/ /smyon pas ral gri'i 'khor lo bskor ba 'dra/ /chos brgyad sgog tu tshud pa'i chos pa de/ /thar med btson rar tshud pa'i mi dang 'dra/ /byams dang snying rje med pa'i chos pa de/ /sha khrag rjen par za ba'i srin po 'dra/ /dben par nyams len mi byed chos pa de/ /ri sul stong bar gnas pa'i gla ba 'dra/ /snying gtam sems la mi 'dzin chos pa de/ /rwa mjug med kyang dud 'gro rnams dang 'dra/ /'dra drug glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /thos tshad de 'dra'i chos pa ma byed cig/pha rgan chos kyi rgyal por gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gzhan smin cing grol bar byen gyis rlobs/ /mang du thos nas rgyud la ma sbyar na/ /ston par 'chor te 'chi brod chos mi 'ong mthu che rtsal drags che na dgra 'dre gnyis/ /'dul bar 'chor te 'chi brod chos mi 'ong / /blo rno zas dad che na grong chog ni/ /byed la 'chor te 'chi brod chos mi 'ong / /smra mkhas g.yo sgyu zol zog khram che na/ /gtso bor 'chor te 'chi brod chos mi 'ong / /slob 'dod nan tan chung na mdo med pa'i/ /'chal bar 'chor te 'chi brod chos mi 'ong / /chos shes tshe 'dir zhen na chos 728

brgyad kyi/ /dbang du 'chor te 'chi brod chos mi 'ong mi 'ong drug gi mgur dbyangs snyan mo 'di/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol zhes byas blangs/ /mgur dbyangs 'di nyid thos tshad thams cad kyis/ /'chi brod dam pa'i lha chos byed nus shog /pha rgan chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo la/ /snying nas mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gzhan chos dang mthun par byin gyis rlobs/ /chags ldan bud med mdzes ma mthong ba bzhin/ /chos dang gang zag mdzad spyod mthong ba na//dga' spro dad pa khyad par can byed dgos/ /skyes bu skom pas gdungs pas chu 'tshol bzhin/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'bar ba'i mer 'jigs nas/ /snying nas mtshan ldan bla mar chos 'tshol dgos/ /ma bu mnyis ka 'phrad na yid ches bzhin/ /bla mar mjal nas dam chos gnang tsa na/ /the tshom med par yid ches skye ba dgos/ /nyi mas gdungs pa'i glang chen mtshor 'jug bzhin/ /chos la thos bsam sgom gsum byed pa'i tshe/ /rkyen ngan gang gis bar mi chod pa dgos/ /dgos pa bzhi yi glu dbyangs snyan mo 'di/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol zhes byas blangs/ /'di nyid thos tshad rgyud la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang grogs po bande ring mo la gdams pa'o//729

pha rgan chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo'i zhabs la 'dud/ /sgom sar bud med 'khrid pa bde ru re ste zhan/ /sgom sar longs spyod gsog pa rgyags su re ste zhan/ /sgom sar lag las byed pa phan du re ste zhan/ /sgom sar 'du long byed pa legs su re ste zhan/ /sgom sar chos 'chad byed pa mkhas su re ste zhan/ /sgom sar long gtam byed pa dga' ru re ste zhan/ /sgom sar 'dre 'dul byed pa phan du re ste zhan/ /zhan pa brgyad kyi glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /thos tshad dad can sems la phan thogs 'byung bar shog /pha rgan chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo'i zhabs la 'dud/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad blo yis btang na bzang / /blo yis btang nas ri khrod dben pa bsten na bzang / /bsten nas bla ma'i gdams ngag nyams su blangs na bzang / /gdams pa'i nang nas rang sems stong gsal bsgoms na bzang / /sgom dus mi g.yo rtse gcig nyams par bzhag na bzang / /mnyam par bzhag nas rtog med ngang la gnas na bzang / /ngang la gnas pa'i mnyam gzhag mtha' ru phyin na bzang //bzang bo bdun gyi glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /thos tshad skya ser pho mo'i sems la phan par shog /730

pha rgan chos kyi rgyal po'i/ /zhabs la gus pas 'dud do/ /pha yul rgyab tu spangs nas/ /'khri ba gcod pa gal che//khyem thab bya ba spangs nas / /gcig pur sdod pa gal che/ /las la zin pa med pas/ /'phral du chos byed gal che/ /nor rdzas chags zhen rgyu yin/ /'dod chung chog shes gal che/ /nye 'brel chags sdang rgyu yin/ /rgyang bsrings sdod pa gal che/ /'chi ba dge bskul mchog yin//rgyun du dran pa gal che/ /phyi mar gar 'gro cha med/ /dkon mchog skyel ma gal che/ /da re chos byas 'khor ba/ /rgyab gyes byed pa gal che/ /gal che brgyad kyi glu 'di/ /glu ba tshogs drug rang grol/ /rang la phan phyir blangs so/ /kun la phan par gyur cig /pha rgan chos kyi rgyal po/ /gtan gyi skyabs su 'dzin no/ /da re dam chos ma byas/ /phyi mar re bas mi 'ong / /dam chos zhe la med par/ /kha tshig rkyang bas mi 'ong //chos dang sems gnyis ma 'dres/ /rgyab 'gal btang bas mi 'ong / /tshe 'dir chos mi byed par/ /yid smon byas pas mi 'ong / /chos rang nyams len mi byed/ /gzhan la bshad pas mi 'ong / /'dod pa khog tu bcug nas/ /zog chos byas pas mi 'ong / /tshe 'di gtsor bzung dam chos/ /zhor la byas pas mi 'ong / /gzhon dus dam chos mi 731

byed/ /rgas khar re bas mi 'ong / /mi 'ong brgyad kyi glu 'di/ /tshogs drug rang grol blangs so//'dis kyang rang gzhan rgyud la//phan thogs 'byung bar gyur cig /bla ma dkon mchog gsum la gus pas 'dud/ /bdag dang 'gro la thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /bla mar gsol ba btab nas bslus pa med/ /dkon mchog skyabs su bsten nas bslus pa med/ /yi dam bsnyen sgrub byas nas bslus pa med/ /chos la nyams len byas nas bslus pa med/ /dge sdig blang dor byas nas bslus pa med/ /sdom pa gtsang ma bsrungs nas bslus pa med/ /dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrungs nas bslus pa med/ /thugs rje chen po bsten nas bslus pa med/ /yi ge drug pa bton nas bslus pa med/ /phyag dang skor ba byas nas bslus pa med/ /smyung gnas bsnyen gnas bsrungs nas bslus pa med/ /dbul bor sbyin pa btang nas bslus pa med/ /bslus med bcu gnyis glu dbyangs snyan mo 'di/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol zhes byas blangs/ /glu 'di thos tshad dad can pho mo yis/ /bslu med dam pa'i chos la 'bad par shog /bla dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /bande rnams la thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /mkhas pa rnams kyi zhal ni ma 732

mthong bar//shes su re ba'i bande blun te ngan//ri khrod dben pa mi bsten grong yul gye/ /'dun sar 'gro ba'i bande 'chal te ngan/ /yin rung min rung sgrub par byed pa yi/ /bande de nyid shin tu blun te ngan/ /dam nyams mang bo bsdus nas gsang sngags chos/ /'chad pa'i bande de nyid nyams te ngan//ra lug bya khye la sogs sems can gzhan/ /gsod pa'i bande de nyid blun te ngan/ /grong du 'khyams nas dmar chog mang bo ni/ /byed pa'i bande de nyid smyos te ngan/ /bsam pa med par nyal nas gnyid log pa'i/ /bande de nyid kun gyis khrel te ngan/ /slob dpon ngan zhes rang gi slob dpon ni/ /khyad du gsod pa'i bande nyams te ngan/ /chos kyi nyams len bor nas khe tshong la//zhugs pa'i bande de nyid 'khrul te ngan/ /bande ngan pa dgu yi glu dbyangs 'di//glu ba tshogs drug rang grol zhes byas blangs/ /'di nyid thos tshad bande thams cad kyis/ /bande ngan pa'i spyod pa spang bar shog /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams la 'dud/ /bande rnams la rtag tu thugs rjes gzigs/ /sgrub la brtson pa'i bande mthu la mkhas/ /thos bsam nan tan bande chos la mkhas/ /lag len ldan pa'i bande gdams pa mkhas/ /shes rab che ba'i bande 'gro don mkhas//brtson 'grus blo ldan bande tshig la mkhas//733

'dri klog byed pa'i bande dpe char mkhas/ /chos rgyus che ba'i bande bshad par mkhas/ /klog 'don sogs shes bande za chog mkhas//yon tan sna mang bande nor 'tshol mkhas/ /bande mkhas pa dgu yi glu dbyangs 'di/ /glu ba tshogs drug rang grol zhes byas blangs/ /'di nyid thos tshad bande chos bslabs nas/ /mkhas btsun bzang gsum yon tan ldan par shog/pha rgan chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /drang brtan 'gyur ba med pa'i gtso bo bzang / /thos bsam byas nas sgom pa'i dge bshes bzang / /chags med ri khrod gnas pa'i rnal 'byor bzang / /khrims ldan dge sbyor byed pa'i btsun pa bzang / /khrel 'joms phyi thag ring ba'i grogs po bzang / /brtan la sog rum mkhas pa'i bud med bzang //bzang drug glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /thos tshad bzang bo'i spyod pa byed par shog /pha rgan chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mi brtan 'gyur ldog che ba'i gtso bo ngan/ /chos med grags 'dod byed pa'i dge bshes ngan/ /ri khrod dor nas grong 'khyams rnal 'byor ngan/ /sdom med nor la zhen pa'i btsun pa ngan/ /khrel med zla grogs bslu ba'i grogs po ngan/ /mi brtan rgod la g.yem 'chor bud 734

med ngan/ /ngan drug glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /thos tshad ngan pa'i spyod pa 'dor bar shog /pha rgan chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /yon tan ldan pa bkur na yon tan 'ong / /sgo gsum dul na thams cad mgu ba 'ong / /yon tan nan tan bslabs na mkhas pa 'ong / /bla ma gus pas bsten na byin rlabs 'ong / /rtag tu thos pa byas na go ba 'ong / /pha yul spangs na chags sdang chung ba 'ong / /'ong drug glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /'di nyid thos tshad rgyud la phan par shog /pha rgan chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /sbyin pa btang na 'di phyir bsod nams 'phel/ /tshul khrims bsrungs na lha mi'i lus rten 'thob/ /bzod pa bsgoms na gzugs byad phun sum tshogs/ /brtson 'grus brtsams na bya ba gang yang 'grub/ /bsam gtan bsgoms na rang sems las su rung / /shes rab bskyed na chos kyi don shes 'gyur//phyin drug glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /thos tshad pha rol phyin drug spyod par shog /pha rgan chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /dkon mchog dran par gyis la skyabs 'gro mdzod/ /bla ma dran par gyes la gsol ba thobs/ /yid la dran par gyis la bskyed rim sgoms/ /735

mkha' 'gro dran par gyis la tshogs gtor thongs/ /'gro kun dran par gyis la snying rje sgoms//lta ba dran par gyis la ngang la zhog /dran drug glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /thos tshad rgyun du lha chos dran par shog /mkhas shing grub pa brnyas pa yi/ /bod kyi bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /rtag tu 'gro 'dug ma mang zhig /mang na dge sbyor chag rgyur 'gro//sdig pa chung yang ma byed cig /byas na ngan song gnas su 'gro/ /dge la rlom sems ma byed cig /byas na 'dzad pa'i rgyu ru 'gro/ /tha mal gseb tu ma 'dug cig /bsdad na rang yang tha mal 'gro/ /nor rdzas 'dod pa ma che zhig /che na zhe 'dod je cher 'gro/ /yul dang ltad mor ma dga' zhig /dga' na mal du mi tshugs 'gro/ /'gro drug glu dbyangs 'then mkhan de/ /tshogs drug rang grol ma gtogs su/ /'di nyid thos tshad thams cad kyi//sems la phan thogs 'byung bar shog /bod kyi sngon byon mkhas grub la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byen gyis rlobs/ /dug lnga'i me la 'jigs par gyis/ /rang rgyud bsregs na dmyal bar 'gro//mi dge bcu la 'jigs par gyis//ngan song gsum du skye ba yin/ /g.yo sgyu ser snar 'jigs par gyis/ /phyi mar yi dwags gnas su skye//nor rdzas 'di la 'jigs 736

par gyis/ /dgra 'dre 'bod pa'i g.yab mo yin/ /bud med 'di la 'jigs par gyis//nyon mongs bsgyed pa'i gzhi ma yin//dad zas 'di la 'jigs par gyis/ /dge sbyor med na 'ju ba dka'/ /'jigs pa drug gi glu dbyangs 'di/ /glu ba tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /thos tshad 'gro ba thams cad pos/ /mi dger 'jigs nas 'dor bar shog /bod kyi mi la lab sgron sogs/ /grub brnyes pho mo yongs la 'dud/ /las su byams dang snying rje sgoms/ /dam pa'i chos kyi rtsa ba yin/ /las su bskyed rdzogs bsgom par mdzod/ /mchog thun dngos grub thob pa yin/ /las su stong nyid bsgom par gyis/ /sangs rgyas dgongs par sbyor ba yin/ /las su gzhan la dam chos shod/ /rang gzhan rgyud la phan pa yin/ /las su kha ton bzlas brjod gyis/ /las ngan sdig sgrib 'dag pa yin/ /las su phyag skor mchod sbyin gyis/ /sgrib byang bsod nams 'phel ba yin/ /yin pa drug gi glu dbyangs 'di/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /'di nyid thos tshad thams cad kyis/ /las su lha chos byed par shog /chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /'du 'dzi spang dgos ma spangs na/ /g.yeng bas 737

khyer nas chos mi 'ong //bud med spang dgos ma spangs na/ /nyon mongs dbang song chos mi 'ong / /grogs ngan spang dgos ma spangs na/ /chos min byed pas chos mi 'ong / /bsod nams spang dgos ma spangs na/ /bar chad mang bas chos mi 'ong / /snyan grags spang dgos ma spangs na/ /chos brgyad dbang song chos mi 'ong / /grong yul spang dgos ma spangs na/ /tha mal gseb nas chos mi 'ong / /dgon dang ri khrod dang du longs//blangs na dge sbyor 'phel ba yin/ /chos spyod dang du len par gyis/ /blangs na sgrib pa byang ba yin/ /tshangs spyod dang du len par gyis/ /blangs na thar ba'i lam sna 'dren/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dang du longs/ /blangs na chos la brtson 'grus 'byung / /rgyun du stong nyid dang du longs/ /blangs na 'khor ba'i gnas las thar/ /'dod chung chog shes dang du longs/ /blangs na lus sems bde ba yin/ /mtshan ldan bla mar gus par gyis/ /byin rlabs rgyud la 'jug pa yin/ /dkon mchog gsum la gus par gyes/ /'khor ba'i 'jigs las skyob pa yin/ /yi dam lha la gus par gyis/ /mchog thun dngos grub ster ba yin/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong gus par gyis/ /'gal rkyen bar chad sel ba yin//pha dang ma la gus par gyis/ /tshe dpal bsod nams rgyas pa yin/ /mched grogs 738

rnams la gus par gyis/ /ci bsam thams cad 'grub pa yin/ /sdug bsngal rtsa ba khyem thabs yin/ /ma spangs sdug bsngal 'byung ba yin/ /bud med rnams la sred che na/ /phyir du lus srog 'dor ba yin/ /smra ba mang na dga' mi dga'i/ /phog thug mang bo 'ong ba yin/ /gti mug gnyid la dga' gyur na/ /ngoms med dge sbyor chag pa yin/ /myos byed chang la dga' gyur na/ /nga rgyal 'thab rtsod 'byung ba yin/ /zas dang nor la dga' gyur na/ /khyi ltar grong du 'khyam pa yin/ /bla ma bshes gnyen dam pa bsten//chos dang bde skyid 'byung ba yin/ /dkon mchog gsum po skyabs su bsten/ /'di phyi'i 'jigs las sgol ba yin/ /drin can pha dang ma gnyis bsten/ /tshe ring longs spyod 'phel ba yin/ /rtag tu dam tshig sdom pa bsten/ /'di dang phyi mar bde ba yin/ /ri khrod dben pa chos rgyags bsten/ /chos mthun dge sbyor 'phel ba yin/ /chos dang mthun pa'i grogs po bsten/ /rang nyid je bzang 'gro ba yin/ /rang dang bud med bstod ra brjod/ /gzhan smad grogs kyis khrel nyen yod/ /mi ngan rang dang mi mthun mi/ /blo dris log pa bslab nyen yod/ /thabs kyis gzhan gyi mgo bskor na/ /phyin chad yid mi ches nyen yod/ /gzhan la tshig rtsub smras gyur na/ /'phral du zag pa gsog nyen 739

yod//mdza' bshes ngan dang g.yo can mi'i/ /kha la nyan na bslu nyen yod//sdig can mi yi khar nyan na/ /phyi mar dmyal bar 'gro nyen yod/ /drug tshan drug gi glu dbyangs 'di/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /'di nyid thos tshad bod yul gye/ /mi rnams ci bsam 'grub par shog /ces pa 'di yang rang gzhan yongs la phan phyir mtsho snying dben pa'i gnas su dbyar nyams spro ba'i dus su blangs pa'o//lha 'dre gdug pa can rnams btul/ /bod khams bde la 'god mdzad pa'i/ /o rgyan padma 'byung gnas la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs//rig pa'i khye'u chung gzhon nu khyod//mi lus rtswa phung la brten nas/ /khams gsum 'khor ba'i brag logs kyi/ /'dod yon shing sil blangs nas zos/ /zos kyin 'dod pa je cher song / /yun ring za zhing bsdad pa'i bar/ /nyin mtshan bye ba dkar nag gis/ /rtswa phung nyag ma re re 'khyer//nam zhig rtswa phung zad pa'i tshe/ /thar ba'i bde sar 'gro 'dod kyang / /mar gyi rtsa ba'i ngan song gsum/ /chu brag 'thab pa'i gcong rong du/ /lhung nas sdug bsngal myong bar nges/ /rig pa'i khye'u chung ngang ring bo//rtswa phung phyed ka tshar bud thal//da ni sdod pa'i dus ma yin//'dod yon sil la su yid chags//tshur shog shes rab stong nyid rta//sna tshogs thabs kyis sga srab glo//'then 740

la rta bzang gong du zhon/ /'bad brtson lcag gis yang yang brobs/ /thar ba'i lam la gyen du rgyugs/ /tshe 'dir phyi mig mi blta bar/ /bde chen thar ba'i grong khyer snyogs/ /o rgyan padma 'byung gnas la//gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs/ /o rgyan padma'i byen rlabs kyis/ /rang gzhan rgyud la phan par shog /'jag ma bdun steng sku bdun sprul/ /tshogs 'khor tshim pa drug ldan mdzad/ /grub chen dam pa rgya gar la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byen gyis rlobs/ /e ma rig pa'i mgron po khyod/ /dal 'byor mi lus grub chen dang / /bla ma mnyan pa bzang bo gnyis//'phrad pa'i dus 'dir sdod mi rung / /'khor ba'i chu bo chen po nas/ /da ni ring min bgrod thabs gyis//mtshan ldan bla ma'i mnyan pa la/ /bsam sbyor gnyis kyis chu gla byin/ /dge tshogs rgyags phye mang bo khyer//stong nyid shing gis chu gshog la//tshu ri'i tshe 'dir mig ma blta/ /pha ri'i thar ba'i skam sar snyogs/ /grub chen dam pa rgya gar la/ /gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs/ /dam pa rgya gar byin rlabs kyis/ /rang gzhan rgyud la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo sogs//bka' drin can gye bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs//bla ma btsal na chos 741

la mkhas/ /sdom pa dam tshig ldan pa tshol/ /thugs gtsigs chung rung 'gyod pa med/ /slob ma btsal na shes rab che/ /dad can rang bzhin bzang ba tshol/ /zhabs tog chung rung 'gyod pa med/ /grogs po btsal na khog yangs shing //sha tsha blo gtad thub pa tshol/ /phan thogs chung rung 'gyod pa med/ /nyan na rgan pa nyams myong can/ /sha tsha byed pa'i gros la nyon/ /ma legs nor rung 'gyod pa med/ /blo mi gtad na sngar 'khon pa'i/ /mi la phyi nas blo ma gtod/ /dug mthu byung rung 'gyod pa med/ /byed na gzhon pa'i dus skabs su/ /phyi mar phan pa'i lha chos gyis/ /na rgas mnan rung 'gyod pa med/ /'gyod med drug gi glu dbyangs 'di/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /thos tshad rgyud la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang slob bu rin chen rgyal la smras pa'o//dpe ci 'dod dngos grub thams cad ni/ /gter chen po'i bum pa las 'byung bzhin/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub 'byung ba'i gnas/ /pha chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bor 'dud/ /dpe bung bas me tog 'tshol ba dang / /bya ngang bar chu slob mi dgos bzhin/ /khong dam pa dang ni dman pa yi/ /spyod bzang ngan gnyis ka goms shugs yod/ /dpe don ma grub pa'i skye bo 'ga'/ /rang 'gag gam mtshon btab 'chi ba bzhin/ /rgyal 742

ngan pa dgra dang 'phrad pa na/ /rang 'khor la chad pa gcod par 'gyur/ /dpe na ba'i bu la khyad par du/ /mas gdung ba skye bar 'gyur ba bzhin/ /khong chos rgyal dgra dang 'phrad pa na/ /lhag par du 'khor la byams pa skye/ /dpe gangs kyi chu ni rab zhim pa/ /phyi'i rgya mtshor 'dres na tshwar 'gyur bzhin/ /khong skyes bu dam pa ngan pa dang / /'grogs na ni ngan par 'gro ba yin/ /dpe gla rtsis byugs pa'i skye bo 'ga'/ /gla rtsi yi dri zhim 'byung ba bzhin/ /mi dman pas skye bo mchog bsten na/ /khong dam pa'i spyod pa 'go bar 'gyur/ /dpe seng ge lus kyi 'bu min pa/ /gzhan srog chags rnams kyis mi za bzhin/ /mi chen po rnams la pha rol gyi/ /dgra rnams las 'khor gyis gnod pa mang / /dpe snang bas gzugs la sgrib byed na/ /gzhan blta ba'i thabs ni med pa bzhin/ /khong rje bos gnod pa byas pa na/ /de skyob par byed pa su zhig yod/ /tshur rang la skyabs 'ongs bsad pa na/ /sus dpa' bo yin zhes mi sgog bzhin/ /khong chos spyod zhi bar gnas pa la/ /gnod byed par shin tu tha shal yin/ /dpe sbrul gdug zas su rlung za yang / /gzhan pha rol mthong na gsod pa bzhin/ /mi ngan pas rang la mi phan yang / /gzhan rnams la gnod pa byed pa yod/ /dpe chang 'thung bzi na bde snyam pa/ / 743

phyis mgo bo na zhing bskyug pa bzhin/ /mi'i 'dod pa bde'o snyam sems kyang / /de spyod pa sdug bsngal kho na'i rgyu/ /dpe bya rog gang rnyed sa la bskungs//lto 'grangs par za mi nus pa bzhin/ /mi phal cher gang rnyed bsags bsags nas/ /nor longs spyod yod kyang spyod mi nus/ /dpe lug thug 'thab pa'i khrag bldags pas/ /wa skyes kyi mgo bo bkas pa bzhin/ /nor longs spyod bsgrub par 'dod na yang / /gnas ma yin pa las su zhig len//dpe 'ug pa'i rgyal pos bya rog gi /blon bsten pas 'phung zhes grags pa bzhin//dus rgyun du 'grogs pa'i grogs spangs nas//gzhan gsar bu 'ga' zhig bsten mi rung / /dpe chu ni ji ltar bskol gyur kyang / /me dmar bo 'bar ba mi srid bzhin//mi ngan pa 'bad pas bsten byas kyang / /rang mi ru 'gro ba shin tu dka'/ /dpe chu mig kho rang ma bskams na/ /steng sa yis mnan yang mi thub bzhin/ /mi rang gis ngan spyod ma byas na/ /lha brgya byin gyes kyang smod mi nus//dpe khong ba'i nang du mi 'ju ba'i//zas zhim yang za mi rung ba bzhin/ /phugs bsgrub par mi nus bya ba yi/ /'phral legs kyang de la 'jug mi rung / /dpe 'bad pa med par zhing bzang la/ /ston lo tog legs po mi 'ong bzhin/ /mi rtsol ba med par 'dug pa yis/ /tshe 'di phyi'i don 744

gang 'grub mi 'gyur/ /dpe chu lud drod gsher bzang bo'i mthus/ /lo legs kyi snye ma 'khrungs pa bzhin/ /glu 'di nyid blangs pa'i bsod nams kyis//ma 'gro kun bde skyid ldan par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bor 'dud/ /bdag dang bdag 'dra'i 'gro ba kun//lugs gnyis gang la'ang blo gros kyi/ /rtsal shugs rgyas par byin gyis rlobs/ /dam pa dag la brten pa dang / /mkhas pa dag la 'dri ba dang / /gzhung bzang bo dang 'grogs pa gsum//rgyun du bde ba rnam gsum lags//lab lab mang bo'i grogs po dang //chags sdang bskyed pa'i 'khor g.yog dang //lam log ston pa'i bla ma gsum//bsten na 'phung ba rnam gsum lags/ /nor gyi mchog ni sbyin pa ste/ /rgyan gyi mchog ni thos pa yin/ /grogs kyi mchog ni mi bslu gsum/ /nor rgyan grogs kyi mchog gsum lags/ /pho yi rigs ni zhe sdang che//mo yi rigs ni 'dod chags che/ /klu gnyan sa bdag ko long che//'di ni che ba rnam gsum lags/ /bya rgod rnyi las shor ba dang / /bud med khyo gsum 'grims pa dang / /ban btsun chos la bred pa gsum/ /lam du mi 'gro rnam gsum lags/ /rgyal po chos min byed pa dang //bran g.yog nga rgyal che ba dang //dka' thub ldan 745

pa nor gso ga pa/ /tshul min zhugs pa rnam gsum lags/ /mi lcogs bya ba byed pa dang / /pha rol mang la 'khon pa dang / /ngan dang mdza' ba byed pa gsum/ /rang nyid brlag pa rnam gsum lags/ /nor med zas gos mchog 'dod dang / /gzhan la slong zhing nga rgyal che/ /bstan bcos mi shes rtsod 'dod pa/ /'gro ba'i bzhad gad rnam gsum lags//phyi rjes ring du blta ba dang / /khro med bzod bsran che ba dang / /'gyur ldog mi byed brtan pa gsum/ /kun gyes bkur gnas rnam gsum lags/ /ltogs na ngo gnag 'grangs na 'dzum//ngo mtshar gtam la mtshar mi 'dzin/ /mngon sum mthong yang slar 'dri ba/ /skye bo blun po'i rtags gsum lags/ /'gro dgos byung na nad ro ldang / /gros la 'tshogs na 'thab rtsod slong / /gsang gros lkog tu smra ba gsum/ /mi ngan tha chad rtags gsum lags/ /bza' btung yod sar ro bzhag 'ong / /dgos pa'i bya ba bcol yang 'bros/ /dgra la 'thab khar yib pa gsum/ /kun gyes khrel ba'i gzhi gsum lags/ /rta mchog 'gro ba'i tshe na shes/ /gser dngul bzhus na shes par 'gyur/ /mkhas pa bshad pa'i tshe na shes/ /'di ni shes pa rnam gsum lags/ /bstod pas dga' bar mi 'gyur la//smad pas mi dgar mi 'gyur zhing / /kun la bran bzhin gus pa 746

gsum/ /bzang bo'i mtshan nyid rnam gsum lags//mdzod chung nor gyis dgang ba sla/ /zhing chung sa bon dgang ba sla/ /blo chung rig pas mgu ba sla/ /'di ni sla ba rnam gsum lags/ /blo gros zhan pa'i 'dod gtam dang / /cang shes min pa'i rta mchog dang / /g.yul ngor lhung ba'i ral gri gsum/ /sus grogs ma nges rnam gsum lags/ /grogs po ngan pa 'grogs pa dang / /thos pa ngan pa 'tshol ba dang //bya ba ngan pa byed pa gsum//mkhas pas mi bya rnam gsum lags/ /blo gros ldan pa'i sgye bo dkon/ /ldan yang drang bor bshad pa dkon/ /bshad kyang tshig bzhin byed pa dkon/ /'di ni dkon pa rnam gsum lags/ /blun po smra ba nyung na mdzes/ /rgyal po lkog tu bsdad na mdzes/ /sgyu ma lan gcig mthong na mdzes/ /'di ni mdzes pa rnam gsum lags/ /longs spyod ldan pa spyod pa dang / /mkhas par gyur na dul ba dang / /chen pos dman pa skyong ba gsum/ /rang bde gzhan phan rnam gsum lags/ /dmus long ba la mar me dang / /ma zhu ba la kha zas dang / /blun po rnams la chos ston gsum//dgos pa chung ba rnam gsum lags/ /g.yul ngor 'jug pa'i dpa' bo dang / /rgyug bzang gom pa can gye rta/ /rab tu mkhas pa'i sman pa gsum/ /gar song brin pa rnam gsum lags/ /longs spyod 747

bsags na phyug por 'gyur/ /thos pa btsal na mkhas pa ra 'gyur/ /sgom sgrub byas na sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /'di ni 'gyur ba rnam gsus lags/ /sum tshan nyer gsum glu dbyangs 'di/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol smras/ /thos tshad lugs gnyis gang la yang / /blo gros ches cher rgyas par shog /ces pa 'di yang slob bu rin chen rgyal la smras pa'o//reb gong du nyi ma shar 'dra ba'i/ /rje skal ldan rgya mtsho'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bdag gzhan kun mgon khyod rnam thar bzhin//bstan 'gro la phan par byen gyes rlobs//dngos grub kyi 'byung gnas bla ma de/ /bsam sbyor bas bsten pa gal re che/ /dal 'byor gye mi lus thob dus 'dir/ /dam chos la 'bad pa gal re che/ /'chi bdag ni ring min myur du 'ong / /'chi brod kyi gdeng zhig gal re che/ /ngan song du mi 'gro'i blo gdeng med/ /skyabs 'gro la 'bad pa gal re che/ /las 'bras la nam yang bslu ba med/ /sdig spong dang dge sgrub gal re che/ /sdig ltung gis gos na de ma thag /phyir bcos dang bshags sdom gal re che/ /'khor ba yi sdug bsngal bsam byas nas/ /thar 'dod kyi blo bskyed gal re che/ /thar ba ru bgrod pa'i thabs gcig pu/ /bslab gsum la slob pa gal re che/ /sems can kun pha mar ma 748

gyur med/ /drin che'i tshul bsam pa gal re che/ /drin lan du byams dang snying rje dang / /byang chub sems bsgom pa gal re che//sbyin pa las longs spyod phun tshogs 'byung / /chags med kyi sbyin gtong gal re che/ /tshul khrims ni thar ba'i skas dang 'dra/ /mig 'bras bzhin bsrung ba gal re che/ /bzod pa ni gzugs bzang thob pa'i rgyu/ /dus rgyun du bsgom pa gal re che/ /brtson 'grus kyis nyams rtogs yon tan ster/ /nyams len gang la 'ang gal re che/ /bsam gtan gyis rang sems las rung 'gyur/ /g.yeng med du bsgom pa gal re che/ /shes rab kyis yon tan sna tshogs ster/ /nyin mtshan du sbyong ba gal re che/ /thams mkhas kyis bsdu ba rnam bzhi'i sgos/ /gzhan gyi don byed pa gal re che/ /gsang sngags kyi dbang thob don 'bras la/ /dam sdom la gces spras gal re che//rim gnyis la bag chags 'jog pa la//thun bzhi ru bsgom pa gal re che/ /dus rgyun du chos rnams sems steng bskor/ /nyams len la rem pa gal re che/ /bde sdug gi gdam dbang da re yod/ /gdam kha de ma nor gal re che/ /mtshams bcad rgya'i rgyal po ngag mtshams yin/ /lab lob de gcod pa gal re che/ /rang gzhan gyes dge ba gang byas la/ /dga' ba ni bsgom pa gal re che/ /lo mang nyung ran pa'i bsam shes la/ /khrid 749

dal bur 'bog pa gal re che/ /blo chung rnams mang na sun te bskyur/ /khrid nyung ngur ston pa gal re che/ /khrid lan gcig byen pas mi chog pas/ /lan gnyis gsum byed pa gal re che//tshe blos btang chos mthun 'khor slob rnams/ /chos bzhin du skyong ba gal re che/ /tshe 'dir zhen don med sdig gsog pa'i/ /'khor slob ma mi bsten gal re che/ /'khor slob mas skabs rer gang dran byed/ /der bzod pa bsgom pa gal re che/ /yon bdag gis res 'ga' kha drin smra/ /de btang snyoms bskyur ba gal re che/ /rang nyid kyi sna thag rgyun ldan du/ /rang nyid kyis 'dzin pa gal re che/ /chos byed la rkyen ngan bar chad mang / /sku rim dang tshe sgrub gal re che/ /phyogs phyogs nas phebs pa'i skyes chen la/ /dbang lung khrid zhu ba gal re che/ /'go ris kyi brag khung nyams dga' ru/ /rang gcig pur gnas pa gal re che//rang yun ring gnas pa'i don 'bras la//rgyud chos dang mthun pa gal re che/ /nyams rtogs pa'i nyi ma 'char ba la/ /tshe sgrub pa snyoms pa gal re che/ /rang dge ba gang byas thams cad kyi//mjug bsngo ba smon lam gal re che/ /gal che ba so brgyad glu dbyangs 'di/ /rje skal ldan gsung dang mthun par blangs/ /'dis mtshon pa'i dge bas rang gzhan gyis/ /rje skal ldan rnam thar zin par shog /750

ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//rje bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro yi/ /bdag 'dod pa zad par byen gyis rlobs/ /gdon 'dod pa khog na rtag nyal ba'i/ /khyod tshogs drug rang grol rang la nyon/ /khong 'jig rten pa rnams 'phung byed kyi/ /dgra 'dod pa 'di la khyod cig ltos/ /nor zas gos la sogs 'dod 'dod nas/ /de 'ong phyir 'thab rtsod la sogs pa'i//sdug mang bo myong ba ma mthong ngam/ /rang srog 'tsho ji ltar byas kyang sla//de'i lhag cig khyod la dgos pa ci//tshe yun thung nam 'chi nges pa med//gzhan glo bur shi ba rnams bgrongs la//tshe phyi ma'i 'dod don e 'grub ltos//nang 'dod sred che na 'jig rten pa/ /'dod cung zad yod kyang de yi rigs/ /nang 'dod pa che ba'i gang zag de//tshe 'di ru skye bo thams cad kyis//brnyas smod pa'i gnas su 'gyur ba yin/ /tshe phyi mar ngan song sdug bsngal myong / /nang 'dod pa zad na 'phags pa dngos/ /'dod chung na 'phags pa rnams kyi rigs/ /nang 'dod pa zad pa'i gang zag de/ /khong skye bo yongs kyis mchod bstod bkur/ /tshe phyi mar bde zhing skyid par 'gyur/ /dpe me ni shin tu chung dus kyang //rtswa'i phung bo chen po sreg pa ltar//nang 'dod pa chung ngu tsam sgyes kyang / /rang bde skyid kun 'joms rig pa sgrims/ /751

dpe lus la cung zad dug zhugs pa/ /de gal te ma bsal cher 'phel na/ /lus kun khyab brlag cing 'phung ba ltar/ /nang 'dod pa cung zad zhig skyes kyang / /de ma bsal rim bzhin cher 'phel na//khyod brlag cing 'phung bar 'gyur bas na//nang 'dod pa che chung gang skyes spongs/ /rang nang na 'dod pa yod phyin chad/ /las nyon mongs sprin nag bzhin du 'du/ /sdug kha ba bu yug bzhin du 'tshub/ /skyid nyi ma nam yang mthong mi 'gyur/ /khyod 'dod pa 'di la dgra ru ltos/ /kho nam byung dus su 'bur bcom gyis/ /yar rgyal po'i rgyal sa man chad dang //dman sprang bo'i dbyug pa yan chad po/ /mi gcig gis thob kyang chog shes med/ /khyod 'dod chung chog shes gyis shig ang / /glu 'di nyid blangs pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /rang gzhan gye 'dod pa zad par shog /bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag gzhan chos dang mthun par byin gyes rlobs/ /tshe 'di mi rtag mdang gi rmi lam 'dra/ /pha ma gnyen bshes tshong 'dus mgron po 'dra/ /nor rdzas mi rtag rtswa kha'i zil ba 'dra/ /mdzes pa'i gon pa bar snang 'ja' tshon 'dra/ /rin chen rgyan cha sha ba'i rwa co 'dra/ /bza' btung longs spyod sgyu ma'i dga' ston 'dra/ /phung bo shul du 752

bskyur ba'i khang rul 'dra/ /bar dor 'khyams pa cha med 'grul ba 'dra/ /skye gnas 'tshol ba sbrang tshang 'tshol ba 'dra/ /mtho ris skyes pa bde sar slebs pa 'dra/ /ngan 'gror skyes pa g.yang du lhung ba 'dra/ /phyi mar gar skye rang gi las la rag /las 'bras blang dor mdzod cig dad can tsho//glu 'di bya btang tshogs drug rang grol blangs//thos tshad las 'bras blang dor shes par shog /bla ma chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bor 'dud/ /bdag gzhan lha chos nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /mthon po thams cad tha ma dma' mor lhung //pha ma bla slob grogs mched 'dus pa 'bral//zas nor gos rgyan bsags pa 'dzad pa yin//yar la skyes pa'i tha ma 'chi bar nges/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i chos la snying bo med/ /snying bo yod pa dam pa'i lha chos yin/ /dam pa'i lha chos byed lugs mang na yang / /khyed rnams 'di bzhin mdzod cig dad can tsho/ /mtshan ldan bla ma bsten la dbang lung zhus//'chi blu tshe thar sbyin pa ci thub thongs/ /phyag dang skor ba bsnyen gnas smyung gnas srungs/ /bden par smra zhing gzhan gye yod tan brjod/ /skyabs 'gro ma ṇi rang gis gang shes thon/ /dad gus dag snang bsam pa dkar bo gyis/ /kha yi gso lugs dam pa'i chos dang stun/ /mdor na sgo gsum dge la 'bad par 753

mdzod/ /glu 'di bya btang tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /thos tshad 'di bzhin chos la spyod par shog /dpal ldan bla mas 'gro kun chos la skul//tshogs drug rang grol skul tshig dbyangs su len/ /bla mas chos bzhin gyis la lha chos gsungs//slob mas 'bul ba phul la bka' chos zhus//rgyal pos rgyal khams thams cad chos bzhin skyongs/ /blun po 'bangs kyis rgyal po yar la bkur/ /sngags pas mthu gtad dmar chog las ma byed/ /ser mo chang dang bud med la ma dga'/ /pho skyes jag rkun srog gcod las rnams spongs/ /bud med ser sna mngon lkog gtam ma mang / /phyug pos log dom ma gtong sbyin pa thongs/ /chos pas grong chog ma bda' nyams len gyes/ /bu tshas pha mar rgas khar ma brnyas bkur/ /a mchod chos 'don mkhan gyis rdzogs ma gtong / /sman pas tsha grang ma shes sman ma ster/ /mdor na mi dge shig tsam yan chad spongs//dge ba khab skud sbyin gtong yan chad gyis/ /'di yang tshogs drug rang grol zhes byas blangs/ /'di bzhin thos tshad kun gyis byed par shog /chos kyi rgyal bo'i zhabs la 'dud/ /chos byed 'dod pa'i snying gi bu/ /chos brgyad tshe 'di blos btang nas/ /chos bsgrub 754

nus par byin gyis rlobs//rnyed dang ma rnyed bde mi bde//snyan dang mi snyan bstod smad la/ /'jig rten chos brgyad zer ba yin/ /'dod phyogs bzhi bo bsgrub pa dang / /mi 'dod bzhi bo sel ba'i thabs//srog gcod la sogs mi dge ba//byed na chos brgyad nag po yin//chos 'chad la sogs dge ba yis//byed na chos brgyad dkar bo yin/ /dge dang sdig pa 'dres pa yis/ /byed na chos brgyad khra bo yin//chos brgyad dkar nag khra gsum gyi/ /bya ba thongs la dam pa'i chos/ /ji skad smras pa bzhin gyis dang / /bde skyid nyi ma 'char bar nges/ /tshe ring nad med smon lam 'tshal//zhes pa 'di yang slob bu ngag dbang chos 'phel gyis bskul ngor tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//rtag tu 'khor ba'i sems can kun la/ /rtag tu brtse mdzad pha rgan chos rgyal/ /rtag tu sdod snyam ngang ring bdag la/ /rtag tu thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs shig /'od gsal 'dzam gling nyi ma nub song / /bya rgyal rgod bo brag la 'phur song / /mi 'dod mun pa nag po slebs byung / /dgong kha'i mun pa rab rib mtshams su/ /yul bye'u khra ril gcig pu lus byung / /sa thag ring bo chod sa med gi /khang ba'i gshag gi bar zhig snyogs la/ /gshog chung phobs la bde mor nyol cig /rdzogs ldan dus 755

tshod bzang bo langs song / /sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams ni gshegs song / /mi 'dod rtsod ldan snyigs ma slebs byung / /skye dang 'chi ba gnyis kyi mtshams su/ /skal ngan rang nyid gcig pu lus song / /yar gyi thar lam chod sa med gi /bla ma dam pa'i drung zhig snyogs la/ /dam pa'i chos la thos bsam gyis shig /nam tsha dbyar gyi dus de shor song / /me tog rgya men rnams ni gshegs song / /mi 'dod grang reg ba mo slebs byung / /nam tsha ston dgun gnyis kyi mtshams su/ /stong ldan me tog gcig pu lus byung / /nam phugs ring bo thub sa med gi /dkon mchog lha khang mdun zhig snyogs la/ /dgyes pa'i mchod pa myur du phul cig /na tshod gzhon pa'i dus tshod shor song / /mtshan ldan bla ma phal cher gshegs thal/ /mi 'dod skra dkar gnyer ma slebs byung / /na dang rga ba gnyis kyi mtshams su/ /bya btang rgad po gcig pu lus byung / /nam phugs ring bo thub sa med gi /shin tu dben pa'i ri zhig snyogs la/ /bla ma gong ma'i rnam thar skyongs shig /dus bzhi rim gyis 'gyur nas bud song / /bya rgyal khu byug gzhan du 'phur song / /mi 'dod kha rlung gnyis ka slebs byung / /chu dang dar sob gnyis kyi mtshams su/ /chu bya nag mo gcig pu lus byung / /nam yang bde ba yod sa med 756

gi /yul phyogs bzang bo gzhan zhig snyogs la/ /sdug bsngal med par bde bar sdod cig /na tshod rim gyis 'gyur nas bud song / /chos grogs bzang bo rnams kyang gshegs song / /mi 'dod na zug gnyis ka slebs byung / /brag dang spang ri gnyis kyi mtshams su/ /sprang rgan bdag nyid gcig pu lus byung / /nam yang bde ba yod sa med gi /dro 'jam bde ba'i mal sa snyogs la/ /rtag tu bsgom la nan tan mdzod cig /pha ma ma byas sems can gcig med/ /'gro rnams rnam mkhyen sa la 'god phyir/ /mi rtag rtag 'dzin rang la bla mas/ /ci gsungs gsung bzhin bsgrub par sgon no/ /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//dkar ser dmar ljang gi me tog rnams/ /da lta phal cher ni mi sdod par/ /ne'u gsing spang gzhongs de rgyab tu bskyur/ /kha dog nyams bzhin du gshegs nas thal/ /me tog gzhan ma rnams rgod bzhin du/ /bde bar 'dug tshul tshor phar bltas na/ /dus kyi ba mo khos mi bcom zhes/ /khas len bzang bo zhig yod las che/ /med phyin lha khang drung mi bsnyeg na/ /me tog khyod rang tsho spyos sam ci/ /myur mor dkon mchog gi lha khang snyogs/ /dgyes pa'i mchod pa de 'bul re ran/ /ran pa'i mi tshad ki 757

'phyis nas 'dug /a kha sems med kyi me tog tsho/ /da lta da lta rang 'gro thabs gyes/ /ci 'dra'i spobs pa zhig che ni red/ /dgon sde skyong mkhan gyi bla ma rnams/ /da lta phal cher ni mi bzhugs par/ /dgon khog gzhi ma de rgyab tu bzhag /zhal chems 'jog bzhin du gshegs nas thal/ /bla ma gzhan ma rnams 'dzum bzhin du/ /dkor la spyod tshul tshor phar bltas na/ /na rga 'chi ba khos mi 'ong zhes/ /khas len bzang bo zhig yod las che/ /med phyin nyams len zhig mi byed na/ /bla ma khyed rang tsho smyos sam ci/ /myur mor nyams dga' yi ri khrod snyogs/ /chos la nyams len zhig byed re ran/ /ran pa'i mi tshad ki 'phyis nas 'dug /a kha sems med kyi bla ma tsho/ /da lta da lta rang nyams len gyis/ — /ci 'dra'i spobs pa zhig che ni red/ /phang phung g.yo ba yi shing lo rnams/ /da lta phal cher ni mi sdod par/ /shing sdong yal ga de rgyab tu bskyur/ /'dab sgra sgog bzhin du sa la lhung / /lo ma gzhan ma rnams dga' bzhin du/ /gar stabs byed tshul tshor phar bltas na/ /skyi ser rlung bo khos mi gtor zhes/ /zhal gsung bzang bo zhig yod las che/ /med phyin bde sa zhig mi bsnyeg na/ /lo ma khyod rang tsho snying rul lam/ /myur du pha bong gi zhabs drung du/ /bsnyegs nas bde mo 758

ru 'dug re ran/ /ran pa'i mi tshad ki 'phyis nas gda'/ /a kha snying med kyi lo ma rnams/ /da lta da lta rang bsnyeg grabs mdzod/ /ci 'dra'i spobs pa zhig che ni red/ /bza' tshang skyong mkhan gyi rgan rgon rnams/ /da lta phal cher ni mi sdod par/ /pha yul pha mkhar rnams rgyab tu bskyur/ /kha chems 'jog bzhin du phyi mar thal/ /rgan rgon gzhan rnams tsho rgas bzhin du/ /sdod shom byed tshul tshor phar bltas na/ /gshin rjes tshe thar du khyod gtong zhes/ /zhal gsung bzang bo zhig yod las che/ /med na lha chos shig mi byed na/ /rgan rgon khyed rang tsho'i snying rul lam/ /myur du rang nyid kyi mal sa de/ /bsnyegs nas ma ṇi la 'bad re ran/ /ran pa'i mi tshad ki 'phyis nas gda'/ /a kha snying med kyi rgan rgon tsho/ /da lta da lta rang ma ṇi thon/ /ci 'dra'i spobs pa zhig che ni red//ces pa 'di yang dgon gnas grwa tshang mi skyong /rang gis nyams len mi byed/ grong bar du nor rdzas btsal phyir rgyun du ngal med du 'gro ba'i bla ma sems med phal cher dang / 'chi ba 'ong snyam med pa'i tshe 'di'i bya bas rtag tu g.yengs nas/ oṃ ma ṇi lan re tsam yang khar mi 'don pa'i rgan rgon snying rul ba rnams la reb gong glu ba tshogs drug rang grol gyes ku re byas pa'o//pha rgan chos kyi dbang bor gsol ba 'debs/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /spang rgyan me tog rim bzhin mdog nyams bskams/ /'di yang mi rtag 'chi ba'i dpe gcig 759

red//ston dus shing lo ser zhing rim bzhin lhung //'di yang mi rtag 'chi ba'i dpe gcig red/ /dus kyi bya rnams rim bzhin rang yul bsnyegs//'di yang mi rtag 'chi ba'i dpe gcig red//dbyar gyi chu rnams rim bzhin 'khyags shing bskams/ /'di yang mi rtag 'chi ba'i dpe gcig red/ /sngo ljang rtswa rnams rim bzhin kha dog 'gyur/ /'di yang mi rtag 'chi ba'i dpe gcig red//yul mi rgan gzhon rim bzhin pha rol song //'di yang mi rtag 'chi ba'i dpe gcig red/ /bya btang ban rgan khyod kyang 'di dang 'dra/ /nam zhig 'chi ba'i lam po che la 'gro/ /da nas sdod grabs ma byed 'gro grabs gyis//nyer mkho chos kyi rgyags phye sgrig re ran/ /lam rgan nang du rdog rgan bzhag nas ni/ /'gro dus 'gyod kyang 'phyis so bya btang ba//'bod mkhan a khu chos rgyal nam 'ong med//da lta bos rung mi 'gyod chos shig gyis//de ltar gyis dang nam tshod bos na yang //bu ni pha khyem bos bzhin dga' bar 'gro//'di nyid thos tshad dad can pho mo yis//'chi tshe 'gyod med lha chos byed par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//'dren mchog mchog tu gyur pa snyigs dus 'gro ba'i mgon/ /mgon khyod khyod gsung gang gi rna bar lhung ba gang / /760

gang gsungs gsung bzhin kun gyis bsgrub mdzad chos kyi rgyal/ /rgyal bstan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin mdzad bla mar 'dud/ /kwa ye dam chos skal bar ldan pa'i bu gnyis ka /kha mkhas don ma rtogs kyi bya btang nga yi kha/ /ga ler nyon dang 'khor ba 'di la yid mug ga /nga bzhin mdzod dang 'chi tshe bar dor ya mi nga / /ca co'i rnam g.yeng grong bzhin rgya che'i khyem thab ca/ /cha byad chos dang bstun nas chos dang 'gal ba'i cha/ /ja mar nor rdzas bsags nas 'o mar bsres pa'i ja/ /nya shar rngams ltar 'thungs na nyams rtogs mar ngo'i nya/ /ta zig rgyal ltar zas nor 'dzems kyang phan med ta/ /tha mal 'jig rten bde la zhen na chos pa'i tha//da re tshe 'di'i bya ba rgyab tu bskyur nas da/ /na 'chi bsams nas rtse gcig thar lam sgrub dgos na/ /pa tra lta bur dran rgyu ma mang ri khrod pa/ /pha rgod bla ma ngan 'gro'i 'jigs las sgrol ba'i pha/ /ba be'ur gdung 'dras sten dang byin rlabs 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /ma rabs sdig las ma byed 'gro kun drin can ma/ /tsā ri la sogs dben pa sten cig snying bu tsa//tsha grang dmyal ba bsams na bu khyod sha mi tsha/ /dza hu bar bzhin sgoms dang bde skyid chu bo dza//wa bzhin 'gro 'dug mang na chags sdang chu la wa/ /zhwa ser dmar sogs bstan la bkur 761

sti dper na zhwa/ /za ma nor la zhen na ma rabs gdon mi za//'a 'ur 'du 'dzi che na bya btang min no 'a/ /ya mtshan rmad byung rdzogs pa chen po sgoms shig ya//rwa 'dra'i rang sems thul dang phyi dgra ri bong rwa/ /la la bzhin du rnam g.yeng ma byed nyams len la//sha stag gyis shig rang snying bstan yang nges par sha /sa 'dir legs bshad 'di bzhin mdzod dang gtan bde sa/ /ha ha thob bo glu 'di mkhas pas mthong na ha//a la la yis dgyes pa'i bzhad gad byed mod a//bde skyid ri khrod gnas na nga yi kha 'di bde/ /snyan dngags sdeb sbyor med kyang glu 'di shin tu snyan/ /legs bshad spel legs legs pa'i 'dis mtshon dge gang des//bla ma'i thugs dgongs dgongs pa ji bzhin rdzogs pa dang / /mdo sngags thub bstan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan rab bzung nas//lus can mtha' dag dag pa'i zhing du 'khrid par shog /ces pa 'di yang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyes slob ma gnyis la snang ba spro zhing rig pa dwangs pa'i dus shig tu smras pa'o//phyogs bcu'i zhing na bzhugs pa'i/ /bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas/ /byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ /chos skyong srung ma rnams kyis//ye shes spyan gyis rtag tu//skal ldan slob ma rnams la/ /nyin mtshan med par gzigs nas/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i 762

'gal rkyen/ /bar chad ma lus sol la/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub/ /ci 'dod thams cad ring min/ /myur ba myur du stsol cig /dad dang brtson 'grus snying rje/ /che zhing dbang bo rnon po/ /khog yangs dam ldan tshe 'di/ /blos btang slob bu khyed rnams/ /spyir ni mi rtag 'chi ba/ /sgos su nam 'chi cha med/ /yang sgos da lo ma gtogs/ /dben gnas nyams dga' mtsho snying / /lha yul gnyis pa 'di nas//lha dang 'dra ba'i chos mthun//bla ma mched grogs rnams dang / /yang yang e 'grogs mi shes/ /da lta 'grogs pa tshong 'dus/ /mgron bzhin yud tsam yin no/ /snyam du yang yang soms la//bla mar dad gus shugs drag /grogs po rnams la brtse gdung //yar ngo'i zla ba bzhin du/ /gong nas gong 'phel gtong bzhin/ /phan thogs gang nus gyis shig /phyin chad gang du bsdad kyang / /sngon dus mtsho snying ri nas//chos mthun bla ma mched grogs/ /nged tsho lhan cig 'grogs nas/ /chos ldan bya ba legs po/ /'di byas bya ba gzhan la/ /bshad rgyu lung ba gang gyis/ /khyad par spros med ting 'dzin/ /sgoms la kun gyi lus ni/ /dur khrod bor ba'i ro bzhin/ /g.yo 'gul med par drang bor/ /ngag ni pi wang rgyun thag /bcad pa bzhin du sgra med/ /sems ni skyes bu don snying / /bton bzhin rnam rtog med par/ /763

rna rtsar rnga chen brdungs kyang //nam yang sad par mi nus/ /ting 'dzin brtan po e yong / /phyir du brtson 'grus shugs skyed/ /tshes nas nyin mtshan 'di 'dra'i/ /bar du tang nge 'dzin la/ /gnas zhes bdag la smra dgos/ /de phyir yengs yengs ma byed/ /dge sbyor byed pa rnams kyis/ /dge sbyor gang zhig byed kyang / /dpa' mi zhum par dpa' bo/ /g.yul du 'jug pa 'dra ba/ /skyo ngal med par khyim bdag /so nam byed pa lta bu/ /bar mtshams med par chu bo/ /chen po'i rgyun bzhin gyes shig /tshes nas dge sbyor gang byas/ /dga' bzhin bdag la smra dgos/ /de phyir gnyid dang bza' btung / /dbang du ma 'gro rem rem tshes pa gcig gnyis yar la/ /sgom chen dge sbyor mkhan rnams//nga yi drung du shog dang / /chos dang 'jig rten gnyis kyi/ /gtang rag legs po 'bul lo//slob ma me dpung steng du//'phrin yig shing 'di bzhag pas/ /brtson 'grus shugs drag me lce/ /ches cher 'bar bar gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang mtsho snying du nged dpon slob 'ga' zla ba kha shas la phan tshun ma 'phrad par sgom dang dge sbyor byed dus tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /dad can yongs la thugs rjes gzigs//chags sdang rtsa ba pha yul yin//skyes pa'i pha yul rgyab tu spongs/ /sdug bsngal rtsa ba chung ma yin/ /gzhon 764

grogs bu mo rgyab tu spongs//'chi ba'i rtsa ba nor rdzas yin//zas nor longs spyod rgyab tu spongs/ /mtshan ldan bla ma dang du longs/ /rgyun du dad gus mos pas sten/ /ri khrod dben pa dang du longs//rgyun du pha yul bzhin du zungs//bskyed rdzogs gnyis po dang du longs/ /rgyun du zung 'brel bsgom par gyis/ /chos dang chos min ma nor bar/ /grub thob bar ma chad la nyon/ /bshad dang sgrub pa ma nor bar/ /rang gis bsgrubs pa gzhan la shod/ /chos dang rang rgyud ma nor bar/ /chos sems gnyis ka 'dres par mdzod/ /rgyab rten med kyis dogs mi bya/ /dkon mchog gsum po rgyab rten bzang / /rgas khar ltogs kyis dogs mi bya/ /chos pa ltogs nas shi ba med/ /rgyal khams 'phya yis dogs mi bya/ /gang la chags med zhen med gyis/ /dang por 'chi bar rab 'jigs nas/ /tshe 'di blo yis gtong ba dgos/ /bar du 'chi dus dam pa'i chos/ /snying ris bskyed nas bsgom pa dbos/ /tha ma 'chi dus bu pha khyim/ /'gro ba lta bu'i gdeng rnyed dgos/ /gtam 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /rang gzhan yongs la phan phyir smras/ /thos tshad yongs la phan thogs shog/dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /'gro kun thugs rje'i lcags kyus drongs/ /chang dang bud med la dga' na/ /nyes pa'i 765

rtsa ba yin pas spongs//las dang bya ba la dga' na//g.yeng ba'i rtsa ba yin pas spongs/ /nor dang rta lug mang drags na/ /sdig pa'i rtsa ba yin pas spongs/ /phyogs bcur rgyug pa'i rnam rtog gis/ /'gyu ba chod na sgom pa'i mchog /'khor ba mi rtag sdug bsngal du/ /shes na 'du shes rnams kyi mchog /thos bsam sgom gsum yar ngo yi/ /zla ltar 'phel na rnyed pa'i mchog /blo brtan gsang ba'i gros thub cing / /blo rgya che na grogs kyi mchog /dam tshig mi bsrung gsang sngags chos/ /'chal bar spyod na sngags pa min/ /'dul khrims tshul bzhin mi bsrung dang / /chos spyod med na btsun pa min//nor rdzas 'dzin pa shin tu che//chos bzhin mi byed bla ma min/ /kha nas chos bshad mang byas kyang / /sdig la mi 'jem chos pa min/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis ni ma spangs par/ /lta khams che na kha ltar gol//nyon mongs ma spangs sgom byas kyang //ming gi sgom chen nyid du gol//phyogs ris ma spangs rnal 'byor pa/ /byas kyang tshul 'chos nyid du gol/ /bya ba ma spangs pha yul las/ /thon yang tha mal nyid du gol/ /chos rang mi byed gzhan bshad pa/ /mi nag gtam rgyud bshad pa 'dra/ /gsang sngags zong du 'tshol ba de//dug dang bdud rtsi brje ba 'dra//man ngag yod bzhin mi bsgom pa//rin chen thogs nas spangs dang 'dra//766

lha chos bor nas tshong byed pa/ /skam sar mi 'dug 'dam byeng 'dra/ /'jig rten 'di la zhen che bas/ /'chi bar 'jigs zhes zer ba dzun//las 'bras khyad bsad chos spyod bcad//stong nyid sgom pa skad zer dzun/ /nor rdzas gsog 'jog che ba'i mis /chags med zhen med yin zer rdzun/ /ngan song gsum la mi 'jigs par//dam chos byed pa skad zer dzun//'di yang tshogs drug rang grol smras//thos tshad rgyud la phan par shog /pha rgan chos kyi rgyal por gsol ba 'debs//ci bsam chos bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /bre srang 'jal len byed pa'i rtsis ltar du/ /dang po ma nor chos bshad tshig 'dzin dgos//grogs po yid 'thad gnyis ni 'tshogs pa ltar//bar du chos kyi don la bsam pa dgos/ /rma byas mdongs la sems ni 'dzin pa ltar/ /tha ma yengs pa med par bsgom pa dgos/ /rgyal bu rgyal sar bton pa ji bzhin du/ /rang sems chos sku'i rgyal sa zin pa dgos/ /nyi mas gling bzhi'i mun pa sel ba ltar/ /'gro don phyogs ris med par byed pa dgos/ /'di yang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol smras/ /thos tshad 'gro kun bde zhing skyid par shog /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mos pa'i bu la byin gyis 767

rlobs/ /dper na gser dngul zangs rnams ni/ /sra zhing mkhregs pa 'ju dka' ba/ /sol ba'i me yis bsregs te bzhus/ /lha sku bzos pas thams cad kyis/ /mchod cing bkur sti byed pa bzhin//dad pa can gyis phul ba yi//nor rdzas shin tu 'ju dka' ba/ /blangs nas dkon mchog mchod pa dang / /sbyin gtong dge sbyor byas gyur na/ /sbyin bdag tshogs rdzogs bsod nams 'phel/ /rang gis dam pa'i chos bsgrub pa'i//mthun rkyen nyid du 'gro ba yin/ /dug chu khol ma ma 'thungs rab/ /gal te 'thungs na sman sngags sogs/ /med na rang srog 'phrog pa bzhin/ /dad zas dkor zas ma zos rab/ /za na bzlas brjod sogs med na/ /tshe 'dir mnar gcod sdug bsngal che/ /phyi mar yi dwags gnas su skye/ /de phyir dad zas gshin zas rnams/ /rig na khong 'dzum mang bo byas/ /heb kyis za ba'i ban rgan khyod/ /za re ze re bsam blo thongs/ /dug de bdud rtsi bzhin gsol ba/ /khyod kyi snying la ci zhig zhugs/ /rdzas sngags sman sogs yod gyur na/ /dug zos na yang mi gnod bzhin/ /tshul khrims rnam par dag pa srungs/ /shi chog la sogs dag par bton/ /yul nas dkor sbyong kha ton byos/ /dad zas gshin zas gang byung rnams/ /cha gsum byas nas cha gcig gis/ /bla ma 768

dkon mchog gsum po mchod/ /cha gcig dbul bor sbyin pa btang / /cha gcig rang gi lto gos gnyis//byas na 'phral phugs bde bar 'gyur/ /gtam 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyes/ /ban rgan rang pha phan phyir smras/ /bdag dang bdag 'dra'i dkor zan rnams//rgyud la phan thogs 'byung bar shog /dpe nor bur gsol ba btab pa'i tshe//gang 'dod pa'i re ba skong ba bzhin/ /rje mtshan ldan bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub bstsal tu gsol/ /dpe ma la ya yi tsan dan gyi/ /dri rlung gis phyogs bcur rgyas byed bzhin/ /dus rtag tu dam pa'i yon tan ni/ /khong skyes bu dam pas gzhan la sgog /dpe nor bu rgyal mtshan rtser mchod na/ /de'i yul phyogs dge legs bkra shis bzhin//khong dam pa dpon du bskos gyur na//gang bsam don 'grub cing bde skyid thob//dpe rims kyis btab pa'i skye bo 'gas//yar gangs chu yid la byed pa bzhin//rgyal ngan pas sdug la gtad pa'i tshe/ /sngon chos rgyal lhag par dran par 'gyur//dpe zho la rdul phran 'byar ba sel/ /chang sbang ma'i steng du phab 'debs bzhin/ /khong dam pas sdig pa chung yang spang //dman skye bos sdig chen yin yang byed//dpe me yi kha de thur bstan kyang //me lce ni gyen du 'bar ba bzhin//khong skyes 769

bu dam pa rgud gyur kyang //ya rabs kyi spyod pa 'dor mi 'gyur//dpe nyi ma mkha' la gnas na yang / /sa'i me tog padma skyong ba bzhin//khong dam pa rgyang na gnas na yang //'khor nye du rnams la phan par 'gyur//dpe sna ma'i me tog legs bkab kyang //dri zhim gyis phyogs kun khyab pa bzhin/ /khong dam pa'i yon tan sbas gyur kyang //phyi 'jig rten kun la khyab par gsal//dpe me tog phal cher nyin re'i rgyan/ /gtsug nor bu gang du'ang mchod pa bzhin/ /rang yul na rgyal po che ba tsam/ /khong dam pa gang du phyin kyang bkur/ /dpe zhing la sa bon khyad med kyang / /ston lo tog khyad par che ba bzhin//khong dam pa rnams dang phal ba la /phar byas pa mnyam yang drin mi 'dra//dpe tsan dan dri la skye bo dga'/ /mes tshig la mi dga' 'gyod pa bzhin/ /mi gzhan phan can de bde na dga'/ /rkyen ngan byung kun gyi blo mi bde/ /dpe zla ba re zhig gzas zin kyang / /de yun ring ma 'gor grol ba bzhin/ /mi chen po re zhig rgud na yang / /de sems sdug mi dgos sngar bzhin dar/ /dpe seng ge dkar mo bkres na yang / /dman mi gtsang ngan sgyug mi za bzhin/ /khong dam pa ji ltar rgud gyur kyang //sdig dag dang 'dres pa'i zas mi za//dpe rin chen gser ni bsregs bcad kyang / /de kha dog nyams par mi 770

'gyur bzhin/ /khong dam pa srog la bab na yang / /des rang bzhin bzang bo ga la 'dor/ /dpe ce spyang dregs pas skad 'byen yang / /gangs dar seng snying rje skye ba bzhin/ /khong skyes mchog rnams la dman pa yis/ /tshur khros kyang lan du khro ba min//dpe gser la bslad ni yod med blta//mgal dum la su yis mi dpyod bzhin//khong mi chen rnams la skye bo yis/ /skyon e yod 'tshol gyis dman la min/ /dpe rta la rgyun du byas pa de//rta'i bdag po nyid la mdzes pa bzhin/ /'khor rnams la phun sum tshogs gyur na/ /de rje dpon che ba yin pas bzang / /dpe dung dkar g.yas 'khyil bus pa'i sgra/ /gang thos tshad dge legs bkra shis bzhin/ /glu 'di nyid rna bas thos tshad po//kun bde zhing skyid pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras po'o//dpe yid bzhin nor bur gsol btab na//rang ci 'dod dngos grub stsol ba bzhin/ /rje drin can bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub bstsal tu gsol/ /dpe slob shes mi yis ne tso la/ /chos bslabs na 'don pa shes pa bzhin/ /khong blo gros ldan pas legs bskyangs na/ /dman skye bo yin yang mchog tu 'gyur/ /dpe chu yi thigs pa nyam chung 771
