yang / /mtsho chen por 'dres na mi skam bzhin/ /nyam stobs chungaskye bo yin na yang / /gzhan chen por brten na rtag tu bde/ /dpe lag pas dgra bo mi sod na/ /gzhan mtshon cha lag tu len pa bzhin/ /mi rang la blo gros mi ldan na/ /gzhan blo chen rnams la legs par dris/ /dpe dug chen lus la gnod mod kyang / /de'i sbyor ba shes na sman 'gyur bzhin/ /tshur gnod pa byed pa'i dgra bo yang / /thabs ldan na rang gi grogs su 'gyur/ /dpe khron pa'i chu ni 'phel 'dod na/ /de bcus na ches cher 'phel ba bzhin/ /mi mkhas pas longs spyod gsog 'dod na/ /cha kha shas sbyin dang bsrungs na 'phel/ /dpe chu la shing rtas mi bgrod cing / /thang rnams la gru yis mi sgrol bzhin/ /gzhan gang nus bya ba byed du 'jug /las mi nus pa la sbyar mi bya/ /dpe shin tu tsha ba'i chu nyid kyang / /mer 'phrad na me de gsod pa bzhin/ /yun ring bor 'khon pa'i dgra bo dang / /rang mdza' ba byed kyang bsre mi rung / /dpe mig ldan brtags nas 'gro ba la/ /g.yang che sar gom pa mi 'dor bzhin/ /blos legs par brtags nas byed pa la/ /rang bya ba nyams pa ga la srid/ /dpe byad la bye dor byed pa yis/ /sngon me long ngo de phyi ba bzhin/ /rang mtho bar 'dod pa'i skye bo 772

yis/ /sngon gzhan la phan pa 'ba' zhig gyis/ /dpe byi la zhi zhing dul na yang / /gzhan pha rol gsod la brtson pa ltar/ /dgras tshur la snyan par smras na yang / /mi blo ldan yid brtan byar mi rung / /dpe lcags kyu'i sne mo'i shar chags pa'i/ /nya rnams ni bzung nas gsod pa ba /mi ha cang 'dod la chags pa de/ /yun mi ring myur du rang nyid brlag /dpe sbrul la nor bu yod na yang / /mi bsam shes drung du mi sdod bzhin/ /khong rje dpon zhi ba dul ba dgos/ /don rgyu mtshan chung ngur khro mi rung / /dpe spre'us zlos gar ma byas na/ /sker thag pas btags nas mi 'khrid bzhin/ /rang spyod ngan 'bad pas sba bar bya/ /mi phal cher gsal bor bstan pas nyams/ /dpe khye phag mi gtsang za ba la/ /mi rnams kyis yid smon mi byed bzhin/ /mi gzhan gyis brnyas par 'gyur ba yi/ /nor zas gos rnams kyis ci zhig bya/ /dpe rang gi lus la phan 'dod rnams/ /gtar sreg gis nad rnams 'don pa bzhin/ /gzhan mi bsrun 'gro la byams stobs bskyed/ /de rtsub spyod kho nas 'dul bar bya/ /dpe glang bos dgra sde bcom pa yis/ /dus rgyun du rgyal pos bcibs pa bzhin/ /khong mkhas pas bya ba ma yin pa/ /bya shes kyang nam yang mi bya'o/ /dpe shel la me rdo byed pa 773

yi/ /yul de la shel rdo mi nyo bzhin/ /khong yon tan ldan pa mi bkur ba'i/ /gnas de ru mkhas pa su zhig sdod/ /dpe nor bu spyi gtsug rgyan byed dam/ /yang na ni rgya mtsho'i gling gnas bzhin/ /khong mkhas pas gzhan la bshad pa 'am/ /yang na ni zhi ba'i gnas su gnas/ /dpe lhun po'i ngos la gnas bcas pa'i/ /bya'i kha dog gser du snang ba bzhin/ /mi rang las mtho ba'i dam pa la/ /brten bcas na rang la phan pa 'byung / /dpe nyi ma'i 'od la nye ba yi/ /zla ba ni mar ngor 'gyur ba bzhin/ /mi chen po phrag dog ldan pa la/ /brten na yang chen po thob mi 'gyur/ /dpe rtag tu 'gul ba'i kha yi so/ /de bton na bde zhes rgan smra bzhin/ /mi bsrun pa'i skye bo rang mnyam du/ /yun ring du 'grogs kyang spangs na bde/ /dpe nags tshal chen po mes bsregs na/ /grogs rlung zhig ci nas dgos pa bzhin/ /rang bya ba chen po sgrub pa'i tshe/ /gzhan grogs bzang bsten na myur du 'grub/ /dpe dung dkar g.yas 'khyil bus pa'i sgra/ /gang thos tshad dge legs bkra shis bzhin/ /glu 'di nyid rna bas thos tshad po/ /kun bde zhing skyid pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//dpe yid bzhin nor bur gsol btab na/ /rang gang 774

'dod re ba skong ba bzhin/ /rje mtshan ldan bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog thun mong gnyis kyi dngos grub stsol/ /dpe bum pa chu yis gang ba'am//yang na ni stong ba bskur sla bzhin//khong yon tan kun ldan skye bo'am/ /yang na ni tha mal 'grogs na bde/ /dpe chus phyed gang ba'i bum pa de/ /mgo thog tu khur bar mi nus bzhin//yon tan ni cung zad bslabs pa'i mi de su zhig gis ni 'khur bar byed/ /dpe mar me thur du kha bstan na//gang ston mkhan lag pa 'tshig pa bzhin/ /khong skye bo blo ldan mgo smad na//gang smod byed nyid la nyes pa phog /dpe mkha' la mi gtsang gtor gyur na/ /de 'thor mkhan spyi bor 'bab pa bzhin//dma' skye bo ha cang bstod drags na//phyis bstod mkhan de nyid khyad du gsod/ /dpe yid bzhin nor bu mchod byas na//bkra shis shing bya ba 'grub pa bzhin/ /khong skyes bu dam pa mchod gyur na/ /bkra shis shing yid la ci bsam 'grub/ /dpe sgog skya rlung la phan mod kyang / /de mkhris pa'i nad la dug 'gyur bzhin//gzhan skye bo 'ga' la phan na yang //las la la de la 'jug mi rung / /dpe yur ba'i chu la brten pa yi/ /nya rnams ni zhing la 'grem pa bzhin/ /mi ngan pa rnams la brten bcas na/ /de ngan pa'i shugs kyis rang la gnod//dpe zhun mar snod 775

du bzhag gyur na/ /snod de la byi bas rmugs pa bzhin/ /mi nyam chung rtag tu skyong dgos dang / /'grogs 'grogs na chen po nyams dogs yod/ /dpe chu yis rab tu gang ba yi//dzing phyogs gzhan gcig nas ral ba bzhin/ /nor longs spyod ha cang 'phel drags na/ /yun mi ring rgud pa shin tu nye/ /dpe khyim du ltas ngan byung gyur na/ /dpon bos nas bzlog pa byed pa bzhin/ /mi gzhung ngan rang la brten bca' na/ /nor cung zad byen te phyir la thongs/ /dpe sbrul gyis zin pa'i sor mo de/ /gcod nus na lus kun bde ba bzhin//dus rgyun du khengs shing 'khor ba'i mi/ /'brel cung zad byen nas bskrad na bzang / /dpe yan lag brgyad ldan chu bskyur nas//'gram ba tshwa'i khron pa brko ba bzhin/ /mgon sangs rgyas bstan pa yod bzhin du/ /gzhan bstan la gus pas 'jug mi bya//dpe gtar sreg gis ni nad 'don pa/ /khong sman pa mkhas pa'i gzhung lugs bzhin/ /'phral cung zad tsam zhig sdug na yang / /dus rgyun du bde ba mkhas pas bsten/ /dpe sbrang mas sbrang rtsi nyin re la//cung zad re bsags pas cher 'gyur bzhin/ /rang dgos pa'i bstan bcos nyin re la/ /tshig re re bzung yang mkhas par 'gyur/ /dpe dung dkar g.yas 'khyil bus pa'i sgra/ /gang thos tshad dge 776

legs bkra shis bzhin//glu 'di nyid rna bas thos tshad po/ /kun bde zhing skyid pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//dpe gling bzhir mun pa 'thibs pa rnams/ /steng 'od gsal nyi mas sel ba bzhin/ /ma 'gro ba'i rgyud kyi ma rig pa/ /gsung chos kyis sel mdzad bla mar 'dud/ /dpe 'bab chu yar la bskyil na yang / /de lhag par thur du 'bab pa bzhin/ /dman sgye bo ngan pa 'byor thob kyang / /sngar bas kyang spyod pa ngan par 'gyur/ /dpe shel la nor bus kha bsgyur kyang / /chur 'phrad na rang mdog ston pa bzhin/ /dman skye bo spyod pa bzang byung yang / /de bcos ma yin pas rkyen mi thub/ /dpe srin bu'i kha chu dar skud du/ /'gro mkhas nas byung ba ma yin bzhin/ /mi blun pos bya ba legs 'grub kyang / /de stes dbang yin gyis bsgrubs pas min/ /dpe zhing bas lo zlar 'bad pa'i zhing / /de ser bas skad cig bcom pa bzhin/ /khong chen pos 'bad pas bsgrubs pa'i gros/ /mi ngan pas skad cig nyid la 'joms/ /dpe khwa tas mi gtsang zos pa'i mchu/ /sa gtsang ma gzhan la phyi ba bzhin/ /mi ngan pa phal cher rang gis spyod/ /gang byas pa gzhan la 'god par byed/ /dpe mig med gzhan 777

du mngags pa na/ /don mi 'grub g.yang la lhung ba bzhin/ /mi blun po bya ba la sbyar na/ /don de nyams rang yang nyams pa mang / /dpe gdon gyis btab pa'i skye bo 'ga'/ /sdug spong phyir rang nyid lceb pa bzhin/ /mi rmongs pa bde ba 'dod bzhin du/ /rgyu sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig sgrub par byed/ /dpe nags kyi shing drang rtsad nas gcod/ /mda' drang bos pha rol gsod pa bzhin/ /mi blo ngan drang bos rang nyid brlag /la la yis pha rol gzhan la gnod/ /dpe khyi yis gzhan la 'dzin pa'i tshe/ /sngon ku co mang bo sgog pa bzhin/ /mi blo chung sems la 'khon 'dzin can/ /phar gnod pa bas kyang rnam 'gyur snga/ /dpe gangs kyi yul du rgyun skyes pa'i/ /lo tog ni ltas ngan zhes sgrog bzhin/ /mi yon tan med pa'i skye bo 'gas/ /khong yon tan can la lhag par sdang / /dpe lba ba med na gling phran 'gar/ /yan lag cig nyams pa'i skyon byed bzhin/ /mi yon tan log par sbyangs pa yis/ /khong legs par sbyangs pa khyad du gsod/ /dpe rkang gcig tsu ta'i yul phyin na/ /mi rkang gnyis mi ru mi brtsi bzhin/ /mi cho ga nyams par byed pa yis/ /gzhan cho ga tshang bar byed la brnyas//dpe skyes bu khyi yi mgo can gyis//mi bzhin bzang bud med zhes brnyas bzhin/ /mi cho ga log 778

par bsgrub pa 'gas/ /khong yang dag cho ga byed la gshe /dpe spre'u rgan rnams kyis mi bzung nas/ /mjug med ces bzhad gad byed pa bzhin//mi log 'tsho'i zas nor rnyed pa yis//khong mkhas pa dbul zhes khyad du gsod//dpe rlung gis bdas pa'i ma li ka /dri zhim pa phyag dar khrod lhung bzhin/ /sngon las kyi dbang gis mkhas pa 'ga'/ /mi blun po mang bo'i nang na gnas/ /dpe rtsi rkyang mang bo bsdams na yang / /yar khang ba'i gdung ma bzod dka' bzhin/ /mi blo chung mang du 'dus na yang / /des bya ba chen po sgrub mi nus//dpe mkha' las char ba babs pa yis/ /sa'i rtsing shing ches cher 'phel ba bzhin/ /glu 'di nyid blangs pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /ma 'gro kun bde skyid cher 'phel shog/ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//dpe 'dod 'jo'i ba yi 'o ma de/ /nam mkho dus bzhos na'ang 'dzad med bzhin/ /rang nam 'dod dus su chos zhus kyang / /thugs skyo med chos ston bla mar 'dud/ /dpe glang chen stobs ldan khyur longs pa/ /blo ldan gyi ri bong gis btul bzhin//shes rab ni med pa'i blun po rnams//mang na yang dgra yi dbang du 'gro/ /dpe 'dod 'jo'i ba yi 'o ma ni/ /be'u yis 'thung ba re 'ga' bzhin/ /mi shes rab med pa'i longs spyod 779

kyang / /phal che ba rang la phan pa nyung / /dpe nyi ma shin tu 'od gsal ba/ /der 'byung bo'i bya rnams 'bros pa bzhin/ /mi blun po rnams kyis mkhas pa yang //yar mchod par 'gyur ba'i nges pa med/ /dpe chu yi kha ru gser bzhag na/ /de steng du mi theg gting gnas bzhin//mi ngan pa mang bo 'tshogs nang du//gzhan yon tan ldan yang ga la 'khur/ /dpe rgun 'brum smin pa za ba'i tshe/ /khar mchu nad rgyun du 'byung ba bzhin/ /nor longs spyod 'dzoms kyang dgra 'dre ldang //de thams cad spyod pa'i rang dbang med/ /dpe bya rog gis bzung rus sbal ni/ /sar mar la lhung zhes grags pa bzhin/ /dus rgyun du gzhan gyis skyong dgos pa'i/ /mi nam zhig ci nas nyams par 'gyur/ /dpe chu 'khyil steng du sbur ma'i rigs/ /gang song ba steng na 'dug pa bzhin/ /mi ngan pa mang bo yod sa ru/ /gzhan ngan pa song na bkur bar 'gyur//dpe srin bu song rjes ye ge ru//byung na yang yig mkhan min pa bzhin//blos ma dpyad pa la don 'grub pa//byung na yang mdzangs par su zhig brtsi/ /dpe bkres pa stag gi ngar sgra yis/ /shing rtse nas spre'u lhung ba bzhin/ /mi dman pa longs spyod che na yang / /khong rigs ldan rgud pas zil gyis gnon/ /dpe sog ma chu yi steng du 'phyo//nor bu ni steng bzhag gting bying bzhin//mi 780

blun pos yon tan kha ru 'byin//khong mkhas pas yon tan khog tu sbed/ /dpe chu phran chung ngur ku co che/ /rgya mtsho yis ca co mi sgrog bzhin/ /mi yon tan chung rnams nga rgyal che/ /khong mkhas pa zhi zhing dul bar gnas/ /dpe seng ges wa tshogs legs par skyong / /was wa yi rigs la 'gran pa bzhin/ /khong dam pas dman rnams thams cad skyong / /dman skye bos phan tshun khyad gsod byed/ /dpe gser dngul sra yang bzhus na sla/ /khye'i lud bzhus dri ngan 'byung ba bzhin//khong dam pa khros kyang btud na zhi/ /dman skye bor btud na lhag par khro/ /dpe rin po che la dgos dgu 'byung / /sbrul gdug pa nyes kun bsgyed pa bzhin/ /khong mkhas pa yon tan kun ldan te/ /mi blun po skyon rnams 'ba' zhig yin/ /dpe nags kyi gcan gzan khro ba dang / /grong rta mchog dul bar gnas pa bzhin/ /mi sdig spyod nags na gnas kyang nyams/ /khong dam pa grong na gnas kyang dul/ /dpe rma byas rang gi lus la rtog /srin bya yis ltas ngan gtong ba bzhin/ /khong skyes mchog rang gi skyon la rtog /dman skye bo ngan pas gzhan skyon 'tshol/ /dpe drod dang gsher bas legs bskyangs pa'i/ /mdog rab mdzes me tog cher rgyas bzhin/ /glu 'di nyid blangs pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /bod gangs can bsod 781

nams cher rgyas shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//dpe gang 'dod dngos grub ma lus pa/ /de dpag bsam shing la 'byung ba bzhin/ /rang ci 'dod re ba skong ba'i mgon//pha chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bor 'dud/ /dpe 'bras ldan shing gis rang gzhan bsrung / /shing skam pos rang gzhan bsreg pa bzhin/ /khong dam pa dul bas rang gzhan skyong / /mi ngan pas rang gzhan 'phung la gtong / /dpe rin chen gling du ring nas 'du/ /mtsho bskams na sus kyang spong ba bzhin/ /nor longs spyod 'dzoms dus thams cad gnyen/ /de rgud pa'i dus na thams cad dgra//dpe mdze can 'phrug na bde bar 'dzin//khong mkhas pa mje la 'jigs pa bzhin/ /mi blun po 'byor ba thob na bde/ /khong skyes mchog thams cad byin na bde/ /dpe nags me rlung gis sbar mod kyi//dpe sgon me chung ngu gsod pa bzhin//khong che la gnod byed grogs su 'gyur/ /dman skye bor gnod byed gnod par 'gyur/ /dpe bung bas me tog rig na dga'/ /sha sbrang ni de ltar min pa bzhin/ /khong mkhas pa yon tan can mthong dga'/ /mi blun po rnams ni dga' ba min/ /dpe tsan dan gser bas rin che ba/ /mi blun pos sol bar byas pa bzhin/ /khong mkhas pa mkhas pa'i nang na mjes/ /mi blun pos 782

mkhas pa ji ltar go /dpe khye rgan ku co 'don pa na/ /rgyu mtshan med gzhan dag brgyug pa bzhin/ /khong mkhas pa rang gis dpyod shes kyi/ /mi blun po grags pa'i rjes su 'brang / /dpe khye ngan dgra la phe 'debs te//byi la yis sgra med 'jab pa bzhin//mi kha cig smras pas grub par rtsi/ /la la yis mi smra don la 'bad/ /dpe lha rnams khros kyang sems can bsrung / /gshin rje ni 'dzum yang gzhan gsod bzhin/ /khong dam par rgol yang phan pa bsgrub/ /dman skye bo ngan pa mdza' yang gnod/ /dpe gser gyi kha dog 'gyur mi srid/ /rgya ma la mtho dman che ba bzhin/ /khong skye bo dam par 'gyur ldog med/ /dman skye bo ngan pa 'gyur ldog che/ /dpe padma 'dam skyes 'dam mi gos/ /de nyi mas rtag tu skyong ba bzhin/ /mi blo mthun rgyang ring gnas kyang phan/ /mi mthun par nye na lhag par 'bral/ /dpe rgyal ba'i sras la brnyas kyang brtse//kho 'chi bdag mchod kyang gsod pa bzhin//khong dam pa ma bcol legs par ston//dman skye bor dris kyang log par bshad//dpe zla ba shar na ku mu ta//kha 'byed kyang padma zum pa bzhin//bya gcig la phan par gyur pa yis//gzhan bya ba dag la gnod pa'ang srid//dpe rgod ma mang na nor 'phel la//dre'u mo sbrum na 'chi rnyed bzhin/ /rnyed la la legs pa'i rnyed pa 783

ste/ /rnyed la la gnod pa'i dgra bo yin/ /dpe ljon shing dang ni sol ba gnyis/ /gcod sbyor ba'i khyad par che ba bzhin/ /khong dam pa dbye dka' bzlum pa sla/ /dman sgye bo dbye sla bzlum pa dka'/ /dpe zla ba bri yang yar ngo 'byung / /mar me ni shi na gtan 'grib bzhin//khong dam pa re zhig rgud kyang dar//dman lan cig rgud na dar ba dkon/ /dpe seng ge khyu mchog gsod pa'i tshe/ /rwa gnyis la 'dzur na mi sdar bzhin/ /khong mkhas pa shin tu nyam nga ba'i/ /gnas 'dzur na dpa' ba'i rtags shig yin/ /dpe mar me'i 'od la 'dzing ba yi/ /sbrang bu 'di dpa' bar mi 'gro bzhin//blos rnam pa kun tu mi dpyod par//dgrar phar la 'chang ba blun rtags yin/ /dpe srin bus rang rten zad zad za/ /seng ge yis rang 'khor bsrung ba bzhin/ /mi ngan pa rang rten khyad par 'joms/ /khong dam pa gang la brten pa bsrung / /dpe wa skyes 'grangs na dregs pas brgyal//seng ge ni 'grangs na bder nyal bzhin//dman skye bo 'byor na dregs rgyu ste//khong dam pa 'byor na dul ba'i rgyu//dpe rdzogs ldan dus kyi mi rnams ni//dus kun tu bde zhing skyid pa bzhin//glu 'di nyid blangs pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /bod mi rnams bde zhing skyid par shog /ces pa 'di yang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyes smras pa'o//784

mdo sngags lam gyi rim pa mthar phyin nas//thar ba'i lam ston mtshan ldan bla ma rje/ /ma nor lam la mos pa'i ri ba ngar/ /byang chub lam rim khrid zhig gnang ba'i phyir//dam pa'i lha chos byed pa'i dam pa dang / /dkar tshogs lha klu la sogs bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /ngo mtshar lha yul dang mtshungs mtsho snying du/ /dar dkar lha lam brgyud nas 'byon par bskul/ /bod yul kha ba can gyi rgyal khams kyi/ /bya btang kha bde tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /dam chos kha tsam min par snying nas byed/ /'dod la kha rgyab mi phongs zas gos zhu//zhu yig yid 'ong bung ba khra bo yis//lha rdzas dri ma med pa'i gshog pa brgyangs/ /khyod zhabs pad dkar bzhad pa'i khor yug tu/ /nyams dga' mtsho snying brag phug tshang nas 'phur//zhes pa 'di yang mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms pa'i drin can bla ma nags tshang sprul sku rin po che'i drung du lam rim zhig gi khrid zhu ba'i phyir du phul ba'o//ma yengs nyon dang 'dir tshogs tsho/ /'o skol 'dir tshogs mig rno zhing / /rna ba gseng ba mang bo 'dug /sngon gyi mi 'di ma shi bar//tshe thar yin zhes gcig gnyis tsam//mthong dang thos pa yod dam med/ /mdzub mo tshugs dang gcig kyang med/ /de bas 'chi bdag ma 'ongs gong / /chos re gyis dang ngang ring rnams/ /zas nor 'dzoms pa'i phyug po tsho/ /bsags pa'i nor 785

rnams bskyur nas ni/ /'gro ba'i dus su 'gyod po mchi/ /nye 'khor 'dzoms pa'i dar bo tsho/ /nye 'brel 'khor g.yog bskyur nas ni/ /'gro ba'i dus su 'gyod po mchi//mchor can mchor bo mchor mo tsho/ /pags pa yan chad bzhag nas ni//'gro ba'i dus su 'gyod po mchi/ /dpa' bos 'thab pas mi thub cing / /phyug po'i nor gyis blu mi nus/ /bros shing gab pas mi skyob pas/ /rlung bo che dang char nang gi /mar me 'dra ba'i dus gcig 'ong / /'chi bdag nang du zhugs pa'i dus/ /sgo lcags dam pas ci la phan/ /na tsha byung ba'i dus skabs su/ /dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa dang / /dge 'dun rnams la bsnyen bkur dang / /yi dam snying bo'i bzlas pa dang / /'byung bor gtor ma gtong ba dang / /bla ma dge ba'i bshes bsten nas//chos la thos bsam sgom gsum dang //sdig spangs dge ba mi bsgrub pa//na tsha byung zer sgo 'gram la/ /tho bzhag khrims ldan dge slong la/ /nang du mi chud ma 'ongs zer/ /mo ba bon po rtsis pa gsum/ /rdzun dang zog gis mgo bskor zhing //lha ru 'gong bo khrid 'ongs pa//de nyid yar gyi phugs su bzhag /dam pa'i chos kyi rnga bo che/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad kyis/ /thos pa'i rnga de mi brdung bar/ /lus kyi pags pas btum pa yi/ /rnga nag brdung 786

ba'i lus shed dang / /hūṃ phaṭa rgyob sod ngag shed kyis//phan par 'dod pa'i yon bdag tsho//'dod ni phan par 'dod na yang //yin pa 'byung bo 'bod pa yi//g.yab mo kho na yin par 'dug /da dung nyon dang yon bdag tsho/ /bal skud shing gi rtse mor g.yengs/ /zan la mi gzugs sogs bcos nas//lam bo che yi gzhi mdor 'phangs/ /de tsug byas pas tshe thar ba/ /gcig tsam byung ngam ma byung ang //ngas ni da snga yan chad la//mo bon mang bo byas pa mthong / /rnga sgra che ba ma gtogs pa/ /tshe thar gcig kyang mthong ma myong / /ji ltar byas kyang mi phan par/ /'chi bar mthong ba shes bzhin du/ /dar/ pa'i chos shig ma byas na/ /nyam nga'i mun par 'gro ba'i mis/ /sgon me mi 'khyer tham thom du/ /song na g.yang la ltung ba ltar//bar do'i mun nag 'thug po ru//dam chos sgon me mi 'khyer bar//tham thom phyin na ngan song gi /g.yang sa chen por ltung bar 'gyur//de bas sgyu lus bde dus su//yon bdag pho mo lha chos mdzod//ces pa 'di yang a rig gi gnas mjal ba mang bo la bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis mtsho snying nas smras pa'o//nyon dang dad ldan skye bo tsho/ /tshe 'dir dam chos byed pa la//gegs ni chung ngu gzhon nu'i dus//da dung gzhon pas chos mi 'ong / /na so dar bab dus bya snyam//na tshod dar la bab tsa 787

na/ /da nga yar la ma rgas 'dug /mar la mi gzhon gang yang 'ong / /da lta nor bsags dgra rnams btul/ /gnyen bskyangs rgas khar bu tsha bo/ /mang bo byung nas mi rgan la/ /zhabs tog legs bo byed tsa na//kho bos dam chos bya'o snyam//na tshod yar la rgas tsa na/ /mdog nag skra rnams dung ltar dkar/ /drang bo'i lus po gzhu ltar gug /so rnams lo 'bras bzhin du lhung / /gnyer ma chu gnyer bzhin du mang / /ldang dus rtod phur 'don bzhin ldang / /'gro dus chang 'thung bzhin du 'khyor/ /sdod dus sa rdo chad bzhin 'dug/mal du ro bzhin log nas nyal/ /mig rna mi gsal brjed ngas che//chos dang 'jig rten bya ba gang //mi nus tsa na da nga rgas/ /dang po gzhon dus chos byas na/ /'ong ba yin te de ma byung / /da ni lus la na tshas gzir//'gro 'dug mi nus 'di 'dra byung //da khyed gzhon nu tshos gyis dang //zer zhing sug bzhi sa la btsugs/ /ldang dus a pha a ma zer/ /de dus re ltos byed sa bo//bu dang tsha bos sdug rgan dang //brlag rgan 'chi dus med pa 'di/ /shi na bzang ste mi 'chi zer/ /tshig ngan mang smras sdang zhing 'thab//de phyir blo ldan skye bo tsho//gzhon dang dar la bab tsa na/ /sgo gsum dge ba gang byed kyang / /'ong bas lha chos byed skabs yin/ /kha gzhon dus su lha chos gyis/ /sang bya 788

gnangs bya'i ngang nyid du/ /phyi bshol byas na chos skal chad/ /rgas nas 'chi ba'i nges pa med/ /de ring yin yang 'chi nyen yod/ /phyi bshol ma byed myur du mdzod//ces pa 'di yang dge 'dun gsang sngags sogs gnas mjal ba 'gas bskul ngor tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//chos spu tsam mi byed pho skyes/ /'ung 'ung zhig mi zer ma gtogs/ /rtswa mi za ba yi nor red/ /ming rwa med g.yag rgan mgo ril/ /chos nam yang mi byed bud med/ /ab ab cig mi zer ma gtogs/ /spu ma skyes pa yi khyi red/ /ming mjug med khye mo rnga lu/zhes pa 'di yang dam chos byed pa phar zhog byed snyam yid la yang mi dran pa'i tshe 'di'i lto rgyab kyi khol bor gyur nas/ mi tshe sdug zad la gtong ba'i khyim pa pho mo kha shas la reb gong glu ba tshogs drug rang grol gyis cho lo btags pa'o//dge sdig rnam dbye shes pa yi/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /dad can skya ser pho mo la/ /phyi mar skyid pa'i thabs shig ston/ /'jig rten phyi mar bde 'dod na/ /da lta'i dus 'dir 'di bzhin mdzod/ /che ba mi nas chung ba shig /yan chad gsod pa spang ba dang / /gzhan gyis mi dang ra lug dang / /ri dwags nya sogs gsod pa yang / /thabs mkhas du mas de dag rnams/ /gsod pa dgag cing tshe thar bya//tha na 'ba' 'bu nyi ma mes/ /'tshig dang sbrang chung chu nang du/ /lhung ba yan chad srog bskyab bya/ /nad pa'i nad g.yog bya ba dang / /sman ni gzhan la 789

ster ba dang / /bran g.yog sgo phyugs khyi sogs la//rdo dang dbyug pas mi brdung zhing / /gzhan gyes gzhan la rdo mtshon dang / /dbyug pas rdung ba bshol bar bya/ /gzhan la gnod 'tshe mi bya'o/ /snyam pa'i bsam pa brtan byas na//phyi mar rab tu tshe ring zhing / /nad kun med pa'i mi ru skye//'di rnams gyes shig 'dir tshogs tsho/ /khro med bzod pa bsgom pa dang / /rten la mar me me tog 'bul/ /gzhan la gos rgyan gsar ba rnams / /byin na phyi mar gzugs byad mjes/ /'di yang gyis shig 'dir tshogs tsho//nga rgyal bcom nas bla ma dang / /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal zhing / /khri dang gdan sogs 'bul ba dang //drin can pha ma la sogs pa'i//gzhan la bkur sti byas pa na//phyi mar rgyal po la sogs pa/ /mthon po'i rigs su skye ba yin/ /'di yang gyis shig 'dir tshogs tsho/ /zas gos nor gyis dge 'dun mchod/ /dbul bor sbyin pa gtong ba dang / /'byung bor gtor ma byin pa na/ /phyi mar 'khor dang longs spyod 'du/ /'di yang gyis shig 'dir tshogs tsho/ /rdzun spangs drang bor bshad pa dang / /phra ma spangs nas 'khon pa bsdum/ /tshig rtsub spangs nas 'jam por smra/ /ngag 'khyal spangs nas bla ma sogs/ /gzhan gyi yon tan brjod byas na/ /phyi mar rang gis gang smras tshig /gzhan gyis 790

mtshan mar 'dzin pa yin//'di yang gyis shig 'dir tshogs tsho//phyi mar rang la yon tan ni/ /sna tshogs 'byung ba'i smon lam 'debs//mchog gsum bla ma mkhan slob dang //pha ma la sogs mchod byas na/ /phyi mar yon tan ldan par skye/ /snyan grags che zhing gzhan gyes mchod//'di yang gyis shig 'dir tshogs tsho//pho yi yon tan la dga' zhing //mo yi lus la dga' ba spongs//pho yi dbang bo mi gcod cing //gzhan gyes gcod pa thar byas na//phyi ma pho lus 'thob pa yin/ /'di yang gyis shig 'dir tshogs tsho//gzhan gyis gtan nas mi nus pa//rang gis byed cing rang nyid dang / /bsdoms nas nus pa thams cad la/ /grogs byas bza' btung byin pa na/ /phyi ma'i dus na rang bzhin gyis/ /gnod pa chung zhing nad med dang //bya ba gang la'ang spro shugs che/ /'di yang gyes shig 'dir tshogs tsho/ /'di rnams legs par bsgrubs byas na/ /phyi mar bde skyid nyi ma 'char/ /zhes pa 'di yang dad can skya ser 'ga' zhig gis bskul ngor tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//rje btsun bla ma dam pa bdag la dgongs//mgon khyod sngon nas sangs rgyas tshar ba la/ /da ni yang sangs rgya rgyu ma mchis mod//'on kyang snyigs dus 'gro rnams sgrub pa la//bskul phyir tshe 'di'i mi nor zas gsum kun/ /'phongs phyis rdo bzhin 791

bskyur nas ring min du//ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su myur byon la/ /sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zungs shig ces/ /lag nyis thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs/ /phyi bshol btang snyoms cung zad ma mdzad par//glo bur kun gyis 'di ci snyam pa zhig /da ni lag len 'gel ba mgon khyod mkhyen/ /zhes pa 'di yang rtsa ba'i bla ma nags tshang sprul sku rin po cher gdul bya'i don du tshogs drug rang grol gyis skul tshig tu smras pa'o//sngon rang nyid mjal ba'i dus skabs su//gnas yid 'ong gdan la bla ma bzhugs//dus da lta bzhugs na dga' ba la//nga mos gus chung rung mjal snying 'dod/ /'khor skal bzang gdul bya tshogs pa'i dbus/ /chos zab la rgya che mang bo gsungs/ /dus da lta gsungs na dga' ba la/ /ngas zab chos zhus nas nyan snying 'dod/ /khong snying dang 'dra ba'i grogs rnams dang //skabs phal cher mnyam du lhan cig 'tshogs//dus da lta yod na dga' ba la/ /nga dag snang chung rung 'phrad snying 'dod/ /nang phan tshun kha sems mthun pa'i sgos/ /chos 'jig rten kha ta mang bo byas/ /dus da lta byas na dga' ba la/ /ngas gleng mo mang bo byed snying 'dod/ /pha bla ma dag pa'i zhing du gshegs/ /khong snying grogs rnams kyang zhing der song / /bdag 792

skal ba dman pa shul du lus/ /tshe 'di ru mi mjal kho thag chod/ /da skye ba 'di yi 'og rol tu/ /pha drin can bla ma gar bzhugs kyi/ /zhing de ru lhan cig 'dzom par smon/ /yid smon pa bzhin du 'grub gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang drin can bla ma dang snying grogs phal cher gshegs pas dran nas 'phrad 'dod skyes pa'i dus shig tu tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//thub bstan dri med lha lam yangs pa'i rgyan/ /'dzin ma'i khyon gyi gdul bya'i pad tshal gnyen/ /do bral bla ma nyi ma 'od po che/ /byams brtse'i 'od stong 'gyed bzhin bu la dgongs/ /ri khrod gling gzhan bskor du chas pa la/ /bdag blo pad dkar skyo ba'i dri bzhon gyis/ /lan gcig ma yin yang yang phyogs bcur bskyod/ /dga' spro'i 'dab stong bzhad pa zum la nye/ /kye ma kye hud slob bu pad dkar bzhag /bla ma nyi ma mi sdod gang du 'a gro//grogs ngan mun pa rkyen ngan ba mo yis/ /mnar dus slob bu pad dkar ji ltar bzod/ /slar yang mchog gsum thugag rje rta ljang gi /stobs kyis bla ma nyi ma legs drangs nas/ /yang yang slob bu pad dkar gtsug rgyan du/ /shar nas dga' spro'i 'dab stong bzhad par smon/ /zhes pa 'di yang snying grogs bstan 'dzin nyi ma'i mdun nas chos lung mang bo thob pa phyis bka' drin che shos kyi bla mar gyur/ lo gnyis kyi bar du gnas chen mtsho snying nas lhan cig bsdad/ de nas khong rin po che rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar phebs su nye ba'i tshe 793

tshogs drug rang grol gyis phul ba'o//steng mun pa sel ba'i nyi mas/ /lho 'dzam bu gling ba bzhag nas/ /gling gzhan gsum bskor du bzhud thal/ /slar 'od gsal nyi ma 'dzam gling //zhal myur du mjal na dga' ba/ /dus yang yang mjal na skyid pa//lus gser mig 'khyel ba'i nya mo//shar chu bo gaṅgā bzhag nas/ /phyi'i rgya mtsho'i nang du bzhud thal/ /slar gser nya chu bo gaṅgā//zhal myur du mjal na dga' ba/ /dus yang yang mjal na skyid pa//skad rab snyan khu byug sngon mo//shing 'dab rgyas yal ga bzhag nas/ /yul thag ring gzhan du bzhud thal/ /slar bya rgyal khu byug ljon shing / /zhal myur du mjal na dga' ba/ /dus yang yang mjal na skyid pa/ /pha mtshan ldan bstan 'dzin nyi mas//bu byams pa chos dar bzhag nas//gnas ri khrod gzhan du bzhud thal/ /slar thugs yid 'dres pa'i pha bu/ /zhal myur du mjal na dga' ba/ /dus yang yang mjal na skyid pa//zhes pa 'di yang phar phebs shul nas blangs pa'o//'od gsal mun sel nyi mas/ /'dzam gling smag tu btang thal/ /gling gzhan gsum gyi skyid la//gser mig 'khyel ba'i nya mos/ /gaṅgā stong bar bzhag thal/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i skyid la/ /pha rgan bstan 'dzin nyi mas/ /bu ngan shul du bskyur thal/ /rgyal 794

khams gzhan de'i skyid la/ /zhes pa 'di phyi nyin sems la skyo ba skyes tshe byams pa chos dar gyis gcig pur blangs pa'o//bdag gi spyi gtsug pad zla'i steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma byin rlabs can/ /byen rlabs can la gsol ba 'debs/ /pha ngas bskyangs pa'i slob bu rnams//thag ring ri la 'gro ba la/ /rdo rje'i sku yis byin gyes rlobs//tshangs dbyangs gsung gis byen gyis rlobs/ /'khrul med thugs kyis byin gyis rlobs//chos byed skal ldan slob bu rnams/ /ri bo rtse lngar da 'gro na/ /bla ma spyi bor bsgoms la song / /gdams ngag sems kyis ma brjed song / /gsal 'debs be'u bum bsnams te song //sba dbyug rta bzang zhon la song / /'phags pa'i nor bdun khyer la song / /lam skabs lus srog 'tshos la song / /ri bo rtse lngar slebs pa'i tshe/ /gnas su gong ma'i sgrub phug zungs/ /grogs med rang nyid gcig pur sdod/ /'tsho ba sprang zas dag la gyis/ /rgyu nor byung tshad dug bzhin spongs//bla ma'i gdams ngag rtse gcig sgoms//sgom yun ma thung tshe dang snyoms/ /sgyu ma'i phung bo ri la zhog /gson yang kha ta 'di min med/ /shi yang kha chems tshig 'di yin/ /'di bzhin lag tu khyed rnams longs/ /bde skyid nyi ma 'char bar nges/ /tshigs 'di skal ldan bu rnam kyi/ /sems la 795

brjed med gnas par shog/rtsal ldan dar seng phru gu rnams/ /gangs dkar ltongs su bde bar bzhud/ /slar yang dar seng phru gu rnams/ /yang dang yang du 'phrad par shog /'dab bzang bya rgod phru gu rnams/ /dgung sngon mkha' la bde bar bzhud/ /slar yang bya rgod phru gu rnams/ /yang dang yang du 'phrad par shog /dpa' bo rgya stag phru gu rnams/ /tsan dan nags la bde bar bzhud/ /slar yang rgya stag phru gu rnams/ /yang dang yang du 'phrad par shog /bya btang bdag gi slob bu rnams/ /ri bo rtse lngar bde bar bzhud/ /slar yang rnal 'byor dpon slob rnams/ /yang dang yang du 'phrad par shog /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i byen rlabs dang / /yi dam lha yi thugs rje dang / /mkha' 'gro chos skyong mthu stobs kyis//smon pa bzhin du 'grub gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang slob bu thub bstan rgya mtsho sogs kha shas ri bo rtse lngar 'gro ba'i tshe tshogs drug rang grol gyis 'gro rdzongs su blangs pa'o//spyi gtsug seng khri pad zla'i steng //ngo mtshar 'ja' gur phub pa'i dbus//'gran gyi do med sprul ba'i sku//pha rgan chos kyi rgyal po bzhugs/ /bdag dang bdag la re ltos pa'i/ /grwa ba bu slob thams cad la/ /da lta thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /sgu gsung thugs kyis byin gyis rlobs/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i bka' bzhin 796

du//sgrub pa lhur len rnal 'byor ngas//bde zhus lan du glu zhig len/ /'dir 'ongs skal ldan bu slob nyon/ /lta ba phyogs ris med pa de/ /dper na ci 'dra zer tsa na/ /stong gsal kun khyab nam mkha' 'dra/ /mtha' dbus med pa'i rnal 'byor bde/ /bsgom pa gsal 'grib med pa de//dper na ci 'dra zer tsa na//sprin med mkha' la nyi shar 'dra/ /gsal 'grib med pa'i rnal 'byor bde//spyod pa nyam nga med pa de//dper na ci 'dra zer tsa na//rtsal gsum rdzogs pa'i seng ge 'dra//nyam nga med pa'i rnal 'byor bde/ /'bras bu re dogs med pa de/ /dper na ci 'dra zer tsa na/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen 'dra/ /re dogs med pa'i rnal 'byor bde/ /dam tshig dri ma med pa de/ /dper na ci 'dra zer tsa na//shel kong lag mthil bzhag pa 'dra//nyes ltung med pa'i rnal 'byor bde/ /pha rgan chos rgyal bka' drin gyis//nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi mo'i gung yang bde legs shing / /nyin mtshan rtag tu rnal 'byor bde/ /rnal 'byor bde tshul glu dbyangs 'di/ /thos tshad ma gyur 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog /ces pa 'di yang skal ldan snying gi bu mchog padma rang grol dang / ngag dbang chos laphel/ngag dbang bkra shis/ blo bzang rin chen rnams kyis bde zhus byas pa'i lan 797

du tshogs drug rang grol gyes smras pa'o//mtshan ldan bla ma nor bu lta bu de/ /spyi gtsug rgyal mtshan rtse mo lta bur bzhugs/ /nyams rtogs med pa'i dbul bo lta bu la/ /byen rlabs 'dzad med dgos 'dod lta bur stsol/ /rnal 'byor bzang bo seng ma lta bu ngas/ /zhal gdams bzang bo 'o ma lta bu ldud/ /slob ma bzang bo seng phrug lta bu yis/ /rnam dpyod bzang bo ljags ring lta bus thungs/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas nyi ma lta bu yis/ /gsang gsum yon tan tsha zer lta bu de//mtshan ldan bla ma me shel lta bu la//brten nas slob ma spra ba lta bur 'pho//rim bzhin nyams rtogs me dpung lta bur 'bar/ /de yis las nyon bud shing ltu bur bsregs/ /de phyir bla ma me shel lta bu de/ /sus bsgoms myur du sangs rgyas lta bur 'gyur/ /zhes bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pa'i phan yon 'di ni slob ma dad can padma rang grol dang / ngag dbang chos 'phel/ngag dbang bkra shis/ blo bzang rin chen rnams la tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//rje bla ma chos kyi rgyal po la/ /bdag gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /pha tshogs drug rang grol glu dbyangs la/ /bu seng bzang rgya mtsho gus pas nyon//chos thams cad sems kyi cho 'phrul dang / /sems stong gsal chos sku shes pa lta/ /don de la mnyam par 'jog pa sgom/ /sbyin tshul khrims bsrung sogs rgyal sras spyod/ /mthar chos gzugs sku gnyis thob pa 'bras/ /bu lta 798

sgom spyod 'bras de ltar ltos/ /gzhi rang sems rin chen gling mchog na/ /sku ye shes yid bzhin nor bu yod/ /lam thabs shes gnyis kyi grur zhugs nas/ /las nyon mongs rgya mtsho sgrol nus na/ /'bras sku dang ye shes nor bu de/ /dus ring min lag tu lon par nges/ /bu gzhi lam 'bras gsum de ltar ltos/ /'di khyod la snying gtam byas pa yin//glu 'di blangs rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus//bus bdag gzhan don gnyis lhun 'grub shog /ces pa 'di yang slob bu seng bzang la tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//rgyal dang rgyal sras rnams kyi mkhyen brtse kun//gcig gis gcig tu bsdoms pa las lhag pa'i//kun mkhyen kun la nye ring med par brtse//dus snyigs dus kyi 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon rje/ /bdag ni chung nas da bar mgon khyod kyis/ /ma yis bu bzhin bskyangs pa bka' drin che//dus 'di nas bzung ji srid 'tsho yi bar//khyod gsung bsgrub pa ma gtogs gzhan ci yod//nam zhig bdag ni 'chi la nye ba'i tshe/ /zhing khams gang du skye ba'i smon lam 'debs//skyes chen 'degs tshe sems la bzung chog pa'i//zha' gdams go sla nyung 'dus gsung du gsol/ /'di phyi bar do'i skyabs mgon bla ma la/ /'di ltar 'chi chos zhus pa'i dge ba'i mthus//'di nas pha rol 'gro tshe pha rgan gyes//'di bzhin 799

gsung yod snyam nas dran par shog /ces pa 'di ni slob bu seng bzang gis smras pas lan du/'gro ba'i skyabs mgon chos rgyal rin po che/ /sangs rgyas zhing khams gang na bzhugs kyang rung //bu la ye shes spyan gyis legs gzigs nas/ /'di phyi'i bsam don 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /nyon dang dad ldan seng bzang rgya mtsho ba/ /skyes nas ma shi lus pa gcig tsam med/ /'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba gang yang med//'chi tshe sangs rgyas zhing khams rnam dag tu/ /skye ba'i smon lam 'debs pa shin tu gces//zhing khams gzhan las bde ba can zhing du/ /su yis smon lam btab na'ang skye bar gsungs/ /de phyir bu khyod nam zhig 'chi ba'i tshe sangs rgyas 'od dpag med pa bzhugs pa'i zhing //nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams su/ /skye ba'i smon lam thobs dang nges par skye/ /skyes na zhing khams gang du'ang song na chog /de dus pha bu yang yang mjal bar nges/ /nyams dga'i sangs rgyas zhing khams mang bo ru/ /lhan cig 'grogs nas 'gro bas skal ba bzang / /bu khyod sems la zungs la dga' bar gyes/zhes smras pa'o//bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la 'dud//chos dang mthun par byin gyes rlobs/ /rnal 'byor tshogs drug rang grol glu/ /bya btang ri 800

ba rnams tshos nyon/ /chos pa'i gnas su gang ngan na/ /pha yul btson khang chen po ngan/ /chos pa'i grogs su gang ngan na/ /'phung rgan sdig pa'i grogs po ngan//chos pa'i 'ching thag gang yin na//kha phyogs zhen phyogs khengs dregs yin//chos pa'i zas su gang ngan na/ /log 'tshos phung la gtod pa yin/ /chos pa'i spyod lam gang ngan na//rgyug dang mchong dang nyal ba yin//chos pa'i 'gal rkyen su che na/ /gnyen dang nor rdzas yin pas spongs/ /chos pa'i gnas mal gang bya na/ /sa bzang ri khrod dben par gyis//chos pas dben par ci byed na/ /nyin mtshan chos kyis 'da' ru chugs/ /chos pas 'chi lugs ci bgyid na/ /ri dwags rmas ma 'chi ltar gyis/ /chos pa shi nas gar 'gro na/ /shi na thar ba'i lam la 'gro//dga' zhing spro bzhin yar la 'gro//rnam thar gtsang ma'i zhing du 'gro/ /me tog padma'i sbubs su 'gro/ /gtam 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /dad can ri ba 'ga' la smras//dge 'dis ri ba thams cad kyis/ /chos bzhin byas nas 'tshang rgya shog /ces pa 'di yang ri ba 'gas bskul ngor smras pa'o//chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo'i zhabs la 'dud/ /'khrul ba'i blo snang dag la byin gyes rlobs/ /mtshan ldan bla ma tshul bzhin mi bsten par/ /tshe 'di'i dpon po ci mnyes byed pa 'khrul/ /801

nges pa'i man ngag mi 'tshol don med kyi//tha snyad mang bslabs nga rgyal byed pa 'khrul//ri khrod 'grims nas nyams len mi byed par/ /grong yul 'grims nas bde ba 'tshol ba 'khrul/ /gcig pur dam pa'i lha chos mi byed par/ /'khor ngan kha ta chos bshad byed pa 'khrul/ /nor rdzas yod pa mchod sbyin mi byed par/ /bsags nas dgra 'dre'i phyogs su gtong ba 'khrul//dam tshig sdom pa tshul bzhin mi bsrung bar/ /nor rdzas phyir du dam sdom gtong ba 'khrul/ /bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen gang shes mi bsgom par/ /'dod yon longs spyod phyir du rgyug pa 'khrul/ /'di thos mi yis 'khrul ba bdun po spangs//ma 'khrul ba bdun nyams su len par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o//chos kyi rgyal por gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag dang bdag la re ltos pa'i/ /grwa slob grogs mched yon bdag la/ /rtag tu thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sgo ru zhugs//bla ma du ma'i zhabs pad bsten/ /ci gsungs sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor nga'i/ /glu la blo bzang bstan dar nyon/ /gcig pur 'dug dus sems la ltos//mi dge'i bsam pa 'phel 'dug na//ngan song gsum las 'gro sa med/ /mi dge bsam pa de nyid 802—

spongs/ /dge ba'i bsam pa skyes 'dug na/ /mtho ris thar ba'i lam sna 'dren/ /dge sems de nyid gong 'phel thongs/ /khyad par sems nyid stong gsal gyi//ngang du shes pa lhod kyis glod//rtog med ngang la yun ring zhog /mang bo'i nang nas ngag la rtogs/ /ma bsams ku co smra ba yis/ /mi ni la las mtshang la phog /la la chags sdang phrag dog skye/ /la la g.yengs nas mi dga'i las/ /gsog pas smra ba nyung na mdzes/ /'ga' zhig smras kyang soms la smras//khyad par gzhan gyis rang la tshig /ngan pa bshad kyang de'i lan du//pha rol sems la gnod pa'i tshig /smra ba spongs la de'i sems la/ /phan pa'i gtam snyan smra bar mdzod/ /'di thos dad can pho mo yis/ /gcig pur 'dug dus sems la brtag /mang bo'i nang nas ngag la brtags/ /bsam ngan tshig ngan skyes pa spongs//dge sems gong nas gong 'phel btang //gzhan phan tshig 'jam smra bar shog /ces pa 'di yang lus ngag yid gsum dge la bkol ba'i khrims ldan blo bzang bstan dar la tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o// rje bla ma sangs rgya sprul ba'i sku//rig 'dzin tshogs drug rang grol zhes//snyigs dus 'gro ba yongs kyi mgon//mtshan ldan bla ma khyed la 'dud/ /gsung mgur thos pas bdag gi yid/ /cung 803

zad mos pa la brten nas//gnas mchog ma hā de ba ru/ /khyod kyi spyan sngar 'ongs pa lags/ /sngar byas sdig pa 'gyod pas bshags//phyin chad mi byed dam bca' 'bul//khyod min skyabs gzhan bdag la med/ /'di phyi'i mgon skyabs khyed rang yin/ /zab rgyas chos kyi dga' ston stsol/ /gang gsungs bsgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /sgrub la 'gal rkyen mi 'byung bar/ /mthun rkyen 'dzom par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di yang khog yangs bsam dkar ngang ring dug lnga shugs chung dad ldan ngag dbang bkra shis kyis smras pas lan du/pha rgan chos kyi rgyal po de/ /bdag gi spyi bo'i gtsug tu bzhugs/ /skal ldan bu la ting 'dzin gyi/ /dbang bskur sgo gsum byin gyis rlobs/ /e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /snying nas lha chos bya bsams na/ /dad pa gting nas skyes pa na/ /tshe 'dir phyi mig mi blta na/ /dben par nga bzhin byed snyam na/ /'di don soms la lan zhig thobs/ /gnyen tshan bdud kyi bshol 'debs de/ /spangs nas bla ma bsten nus sam/ /snying rus zhe bcad drag po yis/ /bla ma'i bka' bzhin sgrub nus sam//pha yul bdud kyi btson ra de//spangs nas ri khrod 'grim nus sam/ /zas nor bdud gyi bslu brid de/ /spangs nas dka' thub byed nus sam/ /grong yul dga' grogs spangs nas kyang / /804

gcig pur ri la 'dug nus sam/ /'jig rten chos brgyad spangs nas kyang //sgo gsum dman cha 'dzin nus sam/ /de kun nus na khyod nyid la/ /lha chos byed pa'i skal ba yod/ /mkha' 'gro'i zhal rlangs ma yal ba'i/ /zab mo'i gdams pa phangs med ster/ /bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub par nges/ /bu khyod snying nas dga' ba sgoms//zhes pa bdag gis smras pas lan du/e ma bla ma rin po che//bdag la brtse bas snyan gson cig /long med mi rtag 'chi ba dang / 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsams nas 'ongs//gnyen tshan bdud kyi bshol 'debs de//rtag tu spangs nas bla ma bsten/ /dka' spyad sdug khur drag po yis/ /bla ma'i bka' bzhin bsgrub par bgyi/ /pha yul bdud kyi btson ra de/ /rtag tu spangs nas ri khrod 'grim/ /zas nor bdud kyi bslu brid de/ /rtag tu spangs nas dka' thub bgyid//grong yul dga' grogs spangs nas kyang / /gcig pur ri la gnas par bya/ /'jig rten chos brgyad spangs nas kyang / /sgo gsum dman cha 'dzin par bgyi/ /mdor na bla ma rin po che/ /khyed kyis ci gsung bka' bzhin bsgrub/ /thos pas ngan song ltung mi srid/ /bsgoms pas 'khor bar 'khyams mi srid/ /zab lam rdzogs pa chen po yi/ /dbang khrid brtse bas gnang du 805

gsol//zhes smras pas dbang khrid la sogs byin pa'o//gzugs sku dri med zla gzhon 'dzam gling mkhar/ /legs bshad 'khrul med zab chos 'od dkar 'gyed/ /'gro ba grangs med mi shes mun pa yis/ /sgrib pa lhag med sel mkhan bla mar 'dud/ /dben gnas gnas byas rnar snyan glu yi dbyangs/ /dbyangs mang mang bo tshogs pa'i dbus su 'then/ /'then na na so rgan gzhon sems la phan/ /phan bde bde lam sgrub mkhan ngas glu len/ /ka ye kha rog ga ler nga la nyon//ca lag cha tshang ja gos nya ltor mtshungs//ta la'i tha snyad da lta na gzhon slobs//pā la pha sar ba zho ma 'thung byen/ /tsa ra tshwa bzhin dzā yā wa zhwa'i tog /zhwa gos za lham 'a cag ya ma phral/ /rwa co la ring sha gnas sa ru song / /ha cang a dur rem la nyams len gyis/ /bya ba thams cad btang ba bdag gi glu/ /gang gis thos pa dag gis tshe blos btang / /sa bzang brten nas lam bzang sgrub bzhin du/ /dben pa'i ri nas snyan pa'i glu len shog /ces pa 'di yang bya dka' ba'i tshig gis brgyan te tshe blos btang nas ri khrod bsten pa'i slob bu blo bzang rin chen la ku re'i tshul du tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//mi yi gru chen la brten nas/ /'khor ba'i pha rol mtsho chen bsgral/ /thar ba'i gling chen bsnyegs pa yi/ /sngon byon skyes chen 806

rnams la 'dud/ /rnam mang ma gyur 'gro ba kun/ /rnam mkhyen go 'phang la 'god phyir//rnam dkar dge la gzhol ba'i bus//rnam dkar dad pa'i sems kyis nyon/ /'jig rten khams ni grangs mang yang //'dzam bu'i gling du skye ba dkon//zha long 'on lkugs mang na yang //dal 'byor mi lus thob pa dkon//mngon mtho lha mi'i lus longs spyod/ /'khor rnams phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu/ /sbyin pa tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus/ /sogs kyang lus rten 'dis bsgrub nus/ /lha rnams phal cher 'chi ba'i tshe/ /mi lus thob la smon par gsungs/ /'dzam gling las kyi sa pa yin/ /tshe stod bsags pa'i las rnams ni/ /tshe smad dag la smin nus pas/ /snyigs dus tshe gcig lus gcig la/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par nus/ /bde ba can du skyes pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' phal cher gyis/ /'di nas shar gyi phyogs rol na/ /mi mjed 'jig rten khams shig na//snyigs dus tshe thung zhig la 'tshang //rgya ba'i lus rten khyad par can//yod pas de ru skye bar shog /ces pa'i smon lam 'debs par gsungs//da re stabs ka yag por 'phrod/ /smon gnas la khar brgyab dus 'dir/ /dam chos mi bsgrub nam tshod bsgrub/ /dper na mi mang tshogs dbus na/ /zas nor longs spyod med pa'i mis/ /dgos 'dod thams 807

cad 'byung ba yi/ /yid bzhin nor bu zhig rnyed na/ /rnyed la dga' zhing gzhan gyi mis//lag nas 'phrog 'dra e gtong snyam//'jigs pa dang bcas lta ba bzhin//mi khom gnas su yun ring bo/ /bskal pa brgyad khrir btsal gyur kyang / /rnyed dka'i dal 'byor mi lus 'di/ /rnyed la dga' zhing nad sogs kyis/ /blo bur shi 'dra e 'gro snyam//'jigs pa dang bcas dus rgyun du//dam pa'i chos la 'bad par mdzod/ /dge 'dis rnyed par dka' ba'i lus/ /gang gis rnyed rnams tshe 'di yi/ /don med rnyed bkur mi bsgrub par/ /shin tu rnyed dka'i chos byed shog /ces pa 'di ni mi lus rin po che'i gru la brten nas 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho brgal te thar ba'i gser gling bsnyeg pa'i slob bu ngag dbang chos 'phel la tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//srid 'byor rmi lam gyi dga' ston dang //rnyed bkur chu shing gi snying bo ltar/ /gzigs nas dam chos la gzhol ba yi/ /chos rgyal ngag dbang wang zhabs la 'dud/ /phyi rol rnam g.yeng ni med pa yi//ri khrod rnams la song gcig pur bsdad/ /dus dang rnam pa kun dam chos shig /bsam pa rnam dag gis byed snyam na/ /mi tshe glog 'gyu bzhin shin tu thung / /lang tsho 'ja' tshon bzhin myur du yal/ /snyan grags sgra snyan bzhin ming tsam yin/ /longs spyod sbrang rtsi bzhin gzhan gyis spyod/ /mi gtsang dri la 808

'khor sbrang ma yis/ /dga' spro'i 'phur lding ni g.yo ba bzhin/ /'jig rten phun tshogs la chags pa'i mi/ /dga' spro'i rnyed bkur gyi phyir du rgyug /kye kye mthon po'i mtha' dma' bar ltung / /lang tsho dar ba'i mtha' rga bas 'joms thams cad 'dus pa'i mtha' 'bral bar nges/ /longs spyod rgyas pa'i mtha' rgud pa sogs/ /gang gang 'gro mgon gyis gsungs pa rnams//nges nges da lta yi dus skabs 'dir//de de ji bzhin du snang gyur kyang / /bu bu mi rnams kyis ma mthong 'dug /sa dang bar snang rnams mi mtshon pa'i/ /stobs chen me 'bar ba'i nags khrod du/ /srog chags bag phab nas sos dal du/ /bde bar 'dug pa de ji ltar 'os/ /'chi nges gtan du 'dug snyam pa 'khrul/ /'khrul bar ma go bar rgas gyur na/ /na 'chi slebs pa'i tshe 'gyod pa skye/ /skyes kyang cung zad cig 'dug dbang med/ /mdor na srid 'byor ni kun gyis bslu/ /yid brtan rung ba de dam chos yin//de phyir mi rtag pa'i tshul soms la//mi lus thob pa 'di don yod mdzod/ /dge 'dis mi rnams ni thams cad kyis/ /chos rnams mi rtag par 'gyur tshul bsams/ /nam yang mi dge ba'i las rnams spangs/ /dge bas mi tshe gang 'da' bar shog /ces pa 'di yang 'chi ba la skrag nas lha chos byed pa'i slob bu ngag dbang bkra 809

shis la tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//skyabs mchog pha rgan chos rgyal gtsug na mjes/ /mdzes sku de la yid kyis gus phyag 'tshal/ /khyod kyis byang chub bar du bu nga skyongs/ /khyod min bdag la re sa gzhan ma mchis/ /sngon med bod kyi glu ba kha bde nga'i/ /glu dbyangs bod la phan par byin gyes rlobs//bum pa chung rung gter chen bum bzang yin//nor bu chung rung 'dod 'byung nor bu yin/ /ljon shing chung rung dpag bsam ljon shing yin//glu ba chung rung glu yi gter mdzod yin//glegs bam chung rung bklags na phan pa yin//'khor ba'i rgyun gcod 'khor lo rin chen yin/ /'dod dgu'i 'byung gnas nor bu rin chen yin/ /bde stong nyams ster btsun mo rin chen yin/ /phan bde blo ston blon po rin chen yin//bshad sgrub khur theg glang bo rin chen yin/ /dag zhing sgrod byed rta mchog rin chen yin//nyon mongs dpung 'joms dmag dpon rin chen yin/ /sngon med gsar byung rgyal srid sna bdun yin/ /tshogs drug rang grol bod la 'jog pa yin//nga dang 'phrod kyang bshad rgyu 'di tsho yin//nam zhig 'chi rung nga yi kha chems yin//'di ltar tshul bzhin nyams su len pa la/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyis byen gyis rlobs/ /sangs rgyas byang sems rnams 810

kyis thugs rjes gzigs/ /yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyis dngos grub stsol/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gros phyi nang bar chad sol/ /chos skyong srung mas las bzhi'i 'phrin las sgrubs/ /yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyis srung skyob gyis//mi dang mi min lha 'dres snyan pa sgogs//'di nyid 'dri zhing 'don dang thos tshad kyi//skye 'gro thams cad bde ldan zhing bzhin du/ /nyin bde mtshan bde nyi ma'i gung yang bde/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde ba'i bkra shis shog /glegs bam gang du gnas pa'i yul phyogs su/ /nyin yang bkra shis dpal 'bar ta la la/ /mtshan yang bkra shis dpal 'bar kyi li li/ /bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /ces kha pho'i 'brug ldir/'dod gsol gyi sprin bsdus/bkra shis kyi char phab pa'o//spyi gtsug pad zla'i gdan steng du/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas bzhugs//bdag gis glu dbyangs gang blangs rnams//phyi snod ma zhig bar gnas shog /gnas nas nang bcud sems can la/ /phan pa dpag med thogs par shog /ri ba gsar ba thams cad la/ /bla ma bzhugs bzhin phan thogs shog /gcig pur dben par 'dug pa la/ /grogs po lta bur 'gyur bar shog /khyim pa pho mo thams cad la//dge bskul mchog tu 'gyur bar shog /sdig pa byed mkhan sus thos kyang //'gyod cing sdig 811

pa'i 'phro gcod shog /gdug rtsub bsam ngan sus thos kyang / /gdug pa'i bsam sbyor kun zhi shog /pha mar sdang ba sus thos kyang //drin can pha mar byams par shog /tshul khrims 'chal ba sus thos kyang //slar yang tshul bzhin bsrung bar shog /dkor la rngams pa sus thos kyang / /tshogs bsags dkor spyong byed par shog /chos mi byed pa sus thos kyang //slar yang chos bzhin byed par shog /grong chog bda' mkhan sus thos kyang / /dmar chog nam yang mi byed shog /spyid lug zhum pa sus thos kyang / /brtson pas byang chub bsgrub par shog/dge ba byed mkhan sus thos kyang / /dga' nas lhag par byed par shog /lha 'dre mi gsum sus thos kyang / /byang chub sems dang ldan par shog /glegs bam gar bzhugs yul phyogs der/ /nad mug 'khrug rtsod mi 'byung shog /gang gis 'chad dang nyan pa rnams/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par shog /'dri 'don klog 'chang byed pa rnams/ /sgrib gnyis dag nas sangs rgyas shog /bla ma rgyal sras mthu stobs kyis/ /smon lam btab bzhin 'grub par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis lhag bsam dag pas smon lam btab pa'o//rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bkra shis shog /brgyud pa'i bla ma'i bkra shis shog /yi dam lha yi bkra shis shog /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas 812

bkra shis shog /byang sems nyan rang bkra shis shog /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis shog /chos skyong srung ma'i bkra shis shog /yul lha gzhi bdag bkra shis shog /rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che/ /phyogs bcur dar zhing rgyas pa dang / /bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu rnams/ /sku tshe brtan pa'i bkra shis shog /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag thams cad kyi/ /mnga' thang 'byor ba mtsho ltar rgyas/ /rtag tu bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams/ /mchod bstod bkur ba'i bkra shis shog /rgyal khams kun tu lo legs shing / /nad yams 'thab rtsod med pa dang / /thams cad rdzogs ldan dus bzhin du/ /bde zhing skyid pa'i bkra shis shog /gangs ri'i ra bas yongs bskor ba'i/ /gangs can khrod du skyes pa'i mi/ /gang gis chos dang mthun pa'i don/ /gang bsam 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /bdag cag dpon slob sbyin bdag rnams/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde zhing skyid/ /skyid dga' longs spyod lo re bzhin/ /'phel zhing rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di yang mgur 'bum gyi mjug tu bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis sbyar ba'o// 'dis kyang kun la phan thogs par gyur cigarnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rje btsun zhabs dkar rdo rje 'chang chen pos mchog dman bar ma'i gdul bya rnams la gang la gang 'tshams kyi rdo rje'i ma gur dpag tu med pa bzhengs pa yi ger bkod pa'i nang tshan las/ mtsho snying ma hā de ba nas skal bzang gdul bya ri ba'i tshogs kyi zhus lan zhal gdams kyi tshogs te/gnyis pa khyon bsdoms mgur tshan mkha' zla dus kyi grangs ldan gyi bdag nyid can gyi bu sta ka dang po'o// shu ste tu sarba dzra ga rta/813

mjug byang /smras pa/ /'gro ba yongs kyi sngon nas ma 'dris pa'i/ /mdza' bshes phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas dang / /de rnams gsung rab/'phags pa'i dge 'dun te/ /mchog gsum thugs rjes 'gro kun rtag tu skyongs/ /rnam 'dren sangs rgyas stong gi nang nas kyang / /padma dkar bo lta bur rab bsngags pa'i/ /'dren pa mnyam med zas gtsang sras po yi/ /gsung rab dgongs 'grel bzhin du rnal 'byor ngas/ /rnar snyan yid 'bab glu dbyangs blangs pa rnams/ /blo ldan slob ma yon bdag mang bo —yis/ /par du phud nas brgya stong spel byas na/ /bstan dang 'gro ba yongs la phan thogs snyam/ /lhag bsam rnam par dag pas kun nas bslangs/ /par gyi mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa sbyar//mdo khams chos yul reb gong gser mo ljongs//bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dgon par par du bskrun/ /de ltar bskrun pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal bstan dar zhing rgyas/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams kyi sku 814

khams bzang //mkha' mnyam 'gro kun bde zhing skyid par shog /khyad par par gyi kha 'go byed mkhan dang / /par shing gcod cing par yig 'bri mkhan dang / /par du brko mkhan mthun rkyen sbyor mkhan rnams/ /tshogs rdzogs sgrib byang sangs rgyas myur 'thob shog /phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal bstan rin po che/ /'jig rten khams 'dir ji srid nam gnas bar/ /mgur 'bum 'di yang mi nyams sa steng 'dir/ /gnas nas bstan 'gro yongs la phan thogs shog /gzhan yang 'jig rten khams 'di thams cad kyi/ /nad yams mu ge 'thab rtsod kun zhi zhing /char chu dus babs lo phyugs rtag tu legs/ /'gro kun bde zhing skyid pa'i bkra shis shog /ces mgur 'bum gyi mjug tu par byang smon tshig nyung 'dus 'di ni/ par yig 'bri mkhan dad can lha khang dbu mdzad dang / par du brko mkhan blo ldan skyi'i bla ma/ hor nag dge slong / ska gsar bsam 'grub/ slob bu kun dga' rnams kyis bskul ngor/ sems kha gzhan las yangs pa'i rnal 'byor zhabs dkar pas/ nyams dga' rig pa dwangs pa'i 'brong lung dben pa'i nags khrod nas sbyar ba'o// /sarba maṅgapaṃ// //815
